en: The station became a hospital during the war.
zh: 战争期间车站曾改作医院。
transfer: 问讲解员战争结束后桥是什么时候重建的。
transferEn: Ask a guide when the bridge was rebuilt after the fighting ended.

senseEn: act more quickly
en: We'd better hurry back before the tide rises.
zh: 我们最好赶在涨潮前快点回去。
transfer: 提醒队友赶紧去签到。
transferEn: Urge a teammate to reach check-in quickly.

senseEn: a verifiable piece of information
en: Can we check that fact against the original report?
zh: 我们能对照原报告核实这条事实吗？
transfer: 请同学区分报道中的事实和意见。
transferEn: Ask a classmate to separate verifiable details from opinions in a report.

senseEn: easy to understand
en: Your directions were very clear; we found the gate.
zh: 你指的路很清楚，我们找到门了。
transfer: 告诉讲师第二张图让步骤更容易理解。
transferEn: Tell an instructor how the second diagram improved your understanding.

en: I bet you a coffee that the blue team wins.
zh: 我跟你赌杯咖啡，蓝队会赢。
transfer: 和朋友拿洗碗当赌注，猜谁先到家。
senseEn: risk a stake on a prediction
transferEn: Wager the washing-up on who gets home first.

senseEn: belonging to a thing or animal
en: The kettle has lost its lid.
zh: 水壶的盖子丢了。
transfer: 说明书包的一条背带断了。
transferEn: Explain what happened to one of a backpack's straps.

senseEn: the color of fresh snow
en: Does the white shirt come in cotton?
zh: 这件白衬衫有纯棉的吗？
transfer: 请画材店员拿一支白色铅笔。
transferEn: Request a snow-colored pencil at an art store.

senseEn: pleased about an outcome
en: I'm glad you found your passport in time.
zh: 真高兴你及时找到了护照。
transfer: 向朋友表示听说她平安到家很高兴。
transferEn: Express relief and pleasure on hearing a friend arrived safely.

senseEn: a female child in relation to a parent
en: My daughter needs a smaller helmet.
zh: 我女儿需要一顶小一点的头盔。
transfer: 向教练介绍刚加入队伍的女儿。
transferEn: Introduce your female child to the coach on her first day.

senseEn: in the open air or beyond an enclosure
en: I'll wait outside while you collect the keys.
zh: 你去拿钥匙，我在外面等。
transfer: 问房东自行车能否放在室外。
transferEn: Ask a landlord whether a bicycle can stay outdoors.

senseEn: a large urban settlement
en: Which city has the nearest airport?
zh: 最近的机场在哪座城市？
transfer: 向新同事打听她以前居住的城市。
transferEn: Ask a new colleague which urban center she previously lived in.

sense: 针对女性的粗俗侮辱语
senseEn: a vulgar, offensive insult directed at a woman
en: Stop calling my colleague a bitch. Use her name.
zh: 别再用那个侮辱女性的粗词称呼我同事了。请叫她的名字。
transfer: 在群聊里制止对女队友的人身辱骂，请对方只讨论比赛。
transferEn: In a team chat, object to a sexist insult aimed at a teammate and redirect the discussion to the match.

senseEn: the darkest color
en: I'll take the black frame for this print.
zh: 这张画我选黑色画框。
transfer: 在前台描述丢失的黑色手套。
transferEn: Describe the color of a missing pair of dark gloves at reception.

senseEn: holding as much as it can
en: This bin is already full; is there another?
zh: 这个垃圾桶已经满了，还有别的吗？
transfer: 告诉车站工作人员储物柜全满了。
transferEn: Tell station staff that all the lockers are occupied.

senseEn: up to a given time
en: The desk is staffed till midnight.
zh: 柜台一直有人值班到午夜。
transfer: 问室友能否把灯开到你回来。
transferEn: Ask a roommate to leave the light on up to your return.

senseEn: unwell or ill
en: I was sick yesterday and missed the training.
zh: 我昨天生病了，没参加培训。
transfer: 向老师说明孩子生病了得待在家。
transferEn: Explain to a teacher why an ill child must stay home.

senseEn: a device that produces illumination
en: Could you leave the hall light on?
zh: 可以把走廊的灯开着吗？
transfer: 请司机打开车内灯找掉了的钥匙。
transferEn: Ask a driver to illuminate the car interior to find dropped keys.

senseEn: record images with a camera
en: Can we shoot the interview by the window?
zh: 我们能在窗边拍这段采访吗？
transfer: 询问管理员是否允许在庭院里拍短片。
transferEn: Ask permission to film a short scene in the courtyard.

senseEn: information about recent developments
en: Any news about the missing luggage?
zh: 丢失的行李有消息了吗？
transfer: 问活动组织者场馆维修有没有新消息。
transferEn: Ask organizers for an update on the venue repairs.

senseEn: fail to keep track of a possession
en: Zip the pocket so you don't lose your pass.
zh: 拉上口袋，别把通行证弄丢了。
transfer: 提醒队友把小钥匙拴好免得遗失。
transferEn: Suggest securing a small key so it cannot go missing.

senseEn: especially enjoyable or pleasing
en: What a wonderful view from this balcony!
zh: 这个阳台看出去的景色真美！
transfer: 演出结束后向演员夸赞精彩的表演。
transferEn: Compliment a performer on an excellent show.

senseEn: store digital work for later access
en: Please save a copy before you crop the photo.
zh: 裁照片前请先保存副本。
transfer: 提醒学生关电脑前保存作业。
transferEn: Remind a student to store the assignment before shutting down.

senseEn: a period of sixty minutes
en: The first hour of parking is free.
zh: 停车第一小时免费。
transfer: 问洗衣店一小时内能否取回衣服。
transferEn: Check whether laundry can be collected within sixty minutes.

senseEn: a nation with its own territory
en: Which country issued your passport?
zh: 你的护照是哪个国家签发的？
transfer: 在报名表上询问该填居住国还是出生国。
transferEn: Ask whether a form calls for the nation of residence or birth.

senseEn: an exclamation of surprise or admiration
en: Wow, you grew all these tomatoes yourself?
zh: 哇，这些番茄都是你自己种的？
transfer: 朋友展示修复好的旧钢琴时表达惊叹。
transferEn: React with admiration when a friend unveils a restored piano.

senseEn: having the capacity to do something
en: Will you be able to lift this crate safely?
zh: 你能安全地抬起这个箱子吗？
transfer: 问同事下周能否替你值一次班。
transferEn: Ask a colleague about their availability to cover a shift next week.

senseEn: exactly suitable
en: This bag is the perfect size for my laptop.
zh: 这个包的尺寸装我的笔记本正合适。
transfer: 告诉房东窗边的位置正适合摆书桌。
transferEn: Explain why the window spot suits your desk exactly.

senseEn: a young person before adulthood
en: Does a child under six need a ticket?
zh: 六岁以下儿童需要买票吗？
transfer: 替朋友打听儿童泳池的年龄限制。
transferEn: Check the age limit for a children's pool on a friend's behalf.

senseEn: an informal call to slow or stop
en: Whoa, not yet; the paint is wet!
zh: 哎，先别动，漆还没干！
transfer: 朋友正要推开一扇标着维修的门，叫他停一下。
transferEn: Stop a friend just before they push a door marked for repair.

senseEn: request food from a menu
en: Can we order dessert after the show?
zh: 我们能在演出结束后点甜点吗？
transfer: 在咖啡厅询问能否先点饮品再选餐。
transferEn: Ask a café server about requesting drinks before choosing food.

senseEn: living rather than dead
en: Is this plant still alive under the dry leaves?
zh: 这些枯叶下面的植株还活着吗？
transfer: 告诉邻居获救的小鸟还活着。
transferEn: Tell a neighbor the rescued bird survived.

senseEn: things people eat
en: Can we bring our own food into the park?
zh: 公园允许自带食物吗？
transfer: 询问夜班休息室有没有地方存放食物。
transferEn: Ask where to store meals in the night-shift break room.

senseEn: a favorable outcome by chance
en: Good luck with the audition tomorrow!
zh: 祝你明天试镜顺利！
transfer: 在朋友路考前向他道声好运。
transferEn: Wish a friend well before a driving test.

senseEn: the strands growing on the scalp
en: Please keep my hair long enough to tie back.
zh: 请把头发留到能扎起来的长度。
transfer: 预约理发时说明只想稍微剪短头发。
transferEn: When booking a haircut, explain that you want only a small trim.

senseEn: operate a road vehicle
en: Can you drive us to the station at seven?
zh: 你七点能开车送我们去车站吗？
transfer: 告诉朋友这段山路你愿意开车。
transferEn: Offer to take the wheel on a stretch of mountain road.

senseEn: give one's word to do something
en: I promise to return the camera by Friday.
zh: 我保证周五前归还相机。
transfer: 向室友保证今晚会把厨房收拾好。
transferEn: Give a roommate your word that the kitchen will be tidy tonight.

senseEn: a recorded biological classification
en: Do I have to fill in the sex field on this form?
zh: 这张表的性别栏一定要填吗？
transfer: 询问兽医宠物登记表的性别栏该怎么填。
transferEn: Ask a vet how to complete the male-or-female field on a pet record.

senseEn: organized sounds performed for listening
en: Could you turn the music down during the call?
zh: 打电话时能把音乐声调小吗？
transfer: 问主人聚会打算放什么音乐。
transferEn: Ask a host what they plan to play during the party.

senseEn: electricity supplied to equipment
en: The power came back just before dawn.
zh: 天快亮时恢复供电了。
transfer: 告诉房东楼道有电但厨房停电。
transferEn: Describe an outage affecting the kitchen but not the hallway.

senseEn: a type or category
en: What sort of paper works in this printer?
zh: 这台打印机适合用哪种纸？
transfer: 在五金店打听木门适合哪类油漆。
transferEn: Ask a hardware clerk which type of paint suits a wooden door.

senseEn: prepared for a particular purpose or occasion
en: We baked a special cake for the reunion.
zh: 我们为聚会特意烤了个蛋糕。
transfer: 请餐厅为寿星准备一份特制甜点。
transferEn: Request a dessert prepared especially for a birthday guest.

senseEn: requiring significant attention
en: Is the ankle injury serious enough to need a scan?
zh: 脚踝伤得严重到需要做扫描吗？
transfer: 向维修人员询问裂缝是否严重到需要关停电梯。
transferEn: Ask if a crack warrants shutting down an elevator.

senseEn: a public road lined with buildings
en: The hotel is on the same street as the post office.
zh: 酒店和邮局在同一条街上。
transfer: 问司机图书馆位于哪条街。
transferEn: Ask a driver for the road name where the library stands.

senseEn: the color of a ripe tomato
en: Can I see the red scarf in the window?
zh: 我能看看橱窗里的红围巾吗？
transfer: 向失物招领处描述你遗失的红色雨衣。
transferEn: Describe the tomato-colored raincoat you lost to staff.

senseEn: move rhythmically to music
en: Would you like to dance with me after dinner?
zh: 晚餐后愿意跟我跳支舞吗？
transfer: 问活动组织者晚会上有没有地方跳舞。
transferEn: Ask organizers if there will be space for moving to the music.

senseEn: attach something so it hangs from above
en: Can we hang the curtain without drilling?
zh: 我们能不打孔就挂上窗帘吗？
transfer: 请室友把湿外套挂在门口晾干。
transferEn: Ask a roommate to put a damp coat on a hook by the door.

senseEn: make physical contact
en: Don't touch the paint; the rail is still wet.
zh: 别碰油漆，栏杆还没干。
transfer: 提醒访客展品只能看，不能摸。
transferEn: Explain the museum's hands-off rule for exhibits.

senseEn: a group working toward a common goal
en: Our team shares one van for deliveries.
zh: 我们团队共用一辆面包车送货。
transfer: 向新同事介绍负责安排培训的团队。
transferEn: Introduce the group responsible for training to a new colleague.

senseEn: a business organization
en: Which company handles deliveries on this route?
zh: 这条线路由哪家公司配送？
transfer: 向房东询问哪家公司负责电梯检修。
transferEn: Ask who operates the building's elevator maintenance business.

senseEn: draw something toward oneself
en: Pull the handle toward you to open the hatch.
zh: 把把手朝自己拉就能打开舱门。
transfer: 指导孩子把抽屉轻轻拉开。
transferEn: Show a child how to draw a drawer open gently.

senseEn: an intended arrangement
en: What's the backup plan if the ferry is canceled?
zh: 如果渡轮取消，备用计划是什么？
transfer: 向队友介绍雨天训练预案。
transferEn: Explain an alternative training arrangement for rainy weather.

senseEn: having a sugary taste
en: Is this dressing sweet or sour?
zh: 这款沙拉汁是甜的还是酸的？
transfer: 在面包店询问有没有不太甜的蛋糕。
transferEn: Ask a bakery for a cake with a milder sugary taste.

senseEn: twice five
en: Boarding starts in ten minutes.
zh: 十分钟后开始登机。
transfer: 问店员十个鸡蛋是否够做两份蛋糕。
transferEn: Check whether ten eggs suffice for two cakes.

senseEn: a drink brewed from roasted beans
en: Could I get my coffee to go?
zh: 我的咖啡能打包带走吗？
transfer: 在早餐店点一杯不加奶的咖啡。
transferEn: Order a cup of brewed coffee without milk at breakfast.

senseEn: favored by chance
en: We were lucky to find a mechanic on Sunday.
zh: 我们运气好，周日还能找到修车师傅。
transfer: 告诉朋友你很幸运找回了失物。
transferEn: Describe your good fortune in recovering a lost item.

senseEn: something perceived through hearing
en: There's a clicking sound coming from the fan.
zh: 风扇发出咔嗒声。
transfer: 向房东描述夜里水管传来的声音。
transferEn: Describe a noise from the pipes at night to a landlord.

senseEn: free from significant danger
en: Is it safe to cross the stream here?
zh: 从这儿过溪安全吗？
transfer: 询问工作人员今晚的步道是否安全。
transferEn: Ask staff about the trail's safety this evening.

senseEn: a particular calendar day
en: Please circle the return date on the form.
zh: 请在表格上圈出归还日期。
transfer: 和旅伴确认订房的入住日期。
transferEn: Confirm the calendar day of check-in with a companion.

senseEn: the elected head of an organization
en: The club president will introduce the speakers.
zh: 俱乐部主席将介绍各位发言人。
transfer: 询问学生会主席什么时候接受提问。
transferEn: Ask when the head of the student association will take questions.

senseEn: a man acting personally
en: Ben fixed the wheel himself last night.
zh: 本昨晚亲自修好了车轮。
transfer: 告诉同事主管亲自给新员工打电话了。
transferEn: Tell a colleague the male supervisor personally called the new hire.

senseEn: appear to be a certain way
en: These directions seem out of date; the bridge is gone.
zh: 这份路线说明似乎过时了，桥已经没了。
transfer: 向房东描述窗锁看起来有些松。
transferEn: Explain that a window latch appears loose.

senseEn: the mixture of gases people breathe
en: Open the window for some fresh air.
zh: 开窗透透气。
transfer: 告诉旅伴隧道里的空气很闷。
transferEn: Describe the stuffiness inside a tunnel to a companion.

senseEn: a photograph
en: Could you take a picture of us by the lake?
zh: 可以帮我们在湖边拍张照吗？
transfer: 请维修员拍一张损坏零件的照片。
transferEn: Ask a repair worker for a photograph of the damaged part.

senseEn: a historical ruler of an estate
en: Which lord owned this castle before the fire?
zh: 火灾前这座城堡属于哪位领主？
transfer: 向讲解员打听当地领主过去住在哪儿。
transferEn: Ask a guide where the medieval estate holder lived.

senseEn: at a high speed
en: Don't ride too fast on the wet path.
zh: 这条路湿滑，别骑太快。
transfer: 告诉司机小区里开车别太快。
transferEn: Ask a driver to reduce speed in a residential area.

senseEn: possibly
en: Perhaps we could borrow a tent instead of buying one.
zh: 也许我们可以借顶帐篷，不必买。
transfer: 委婉提议把周末聚会移到室内。
transferEn: Tentatively suggest moving the weekend gathering indoors.

senseEn: reach transport in time
en: Can we catch the ferry if we leave now?
zh: 现在出发能赶上渡轮吗？
transfer: 问店员付款后还能否赶上末班公交。
transferEn: Check whether there is time to board the last bus after paying.

senseEn: travel as a passenger
en: Can we ride the tram with this ticket?
zh: 这张票能坐有轨电车吗？
transfer: 问朋友能否搭她的车去车站。
transferEn: Ask a friend to take you to the station in her car.

senseEn: finish first in a contest
en: Do we need one more point to win the match?
zh: 我们是不是再得一分就能赢下比赛？
transfer: 向教练询问决赛需要赢几局。
transferEn: Ask a coach how many sets secure victory in the final.

senseEn: at the highest level
en: The spare sheets are on the top shelf.
zh: 备用床单在最上层架子上。
transfer: 告诉客人最上面的抽屉装着茶包。
transferEn: Locate the teabags in the highest drawer for a guest.

senseEn: frightened by something
en: The dog is scared of thunder; keep it indoors.
zh: 这只狗怕雷声，让它待在屋里吧。
transfer: 向教练说明孩子害怕深水。
transferEn: Explain a child's fear of deep water to an instructor.

senseEn: an experience imagined during sleep
en: I had a strange dream about missing the same train twice.
zh: 我做了个怪梦，梦见自己两次错过同一班火车。
transfer: 向朋友讲述昨晚梦见的海边小屋。
transferEn: Describe a seaside cottage you imagined while asleep last night.

senseEn: a notice giving directions or information
en: Follow the green sign for the emergency exit.
zh: 跟着绿色指示牌走到紧急出口。
transfer: 问旅伴有没有看到写着码头方向的指示牌。
transferEn: Check whether a companion saw a notice pointing toward the pier.

senseEn: be understandable or logical
en: That route makes more sense if the bridge is closed.
zh: 要是桥封了，走那条路更合理。
transfer: 说明等大家到齐再讨论更合理。
transferEn: Explain why waiting for everyone before the discussion is more logical.

senseEn: defeat in competition
en: We finally beat the champions on their own court.
zh: 我们终于在冠军队主场击败了他们。
transfer: 告诉朋友你在棋赛中第一次击败教练。
transferEn: Describe your first victory over your chess coach.

senseEn: regulate how something operates
en: Which switch lets me control the fan speed?
zh: 用哪个开关能调风扇转速？
transfer: 询问技术员用哪个旋钮调节麦克风音量。
transferEn: Ask a technician which knob regulates microphone volume.

senseEn: take someone to a place by vehicle
en: Can you drop me off outside the library?
zh: 能把我送到图书馆门口下车吗？
transfer: 请朋友开车送箱子到回收站。
transferEn: Ask a friend to deliver boxes to the recycling center by car.

senseEn: a mild viral illness of the nose and throat
en: I'm getting over a cold, so my voice is rough.
zh: 我感冒快好了，所以嗓子还有些哑。
transfer: 向队友解释你因为感冒没参加训练。
transferEn: Explain to a teammate that a minor respiratory illness kept you from practice.

senseEn: an affectionate way to address a loved one
en: Darling, your tea is on the table.
zh: 亲爱的，你的茶在桌上。
transfer: 用亲昵称呼提醒伴侣别忘了围巾。
transferEn: Use an affectionate greeting to remind your partner about a scarf.

senseEn: solve or understand through thought
en: Can you figure out why this latch sticks?
zh: 你能弄明白这个门闩为什么会卡吗？
transfer: 和同事一起弄清两份账单为什么金额不同。
transferEn: Work with a colleague to understand why two bills differ.

senseEn: a male monarch
en: Which king built the original palace?
zh: 最初的宫殿是哪位国王修建的？
transfer: 请讲解员说明画像中的国王统治了多久。
transferEn: Ask how long the monarch in a portrait ruled.

senseEn: of low quality
en: The signal is poor indoors; try the balcony.
zh: 屋里信号很差，到阳台试试。
transfer: 向房东描述书桌旁光线很差。
transferEn: Describe inadequate lighting at the desk to a landlord.

senseEn: send through the air by hand
en: Throw the ball gently; the dog is small.
zh: 轻轻扔球，这只狗个子小。
transfer: 请朋友把沙滩球抛回水里。
transferEn: Ask a friend to toss a beach ball back into the water.

senseEn: record in written form
en: Please write your initials beside the correction.
zh: 请在修改处旁边写下姓名首字母。
transfer: 让旅伴把旅馆地址写在纸上。
transferEn: Ask a companion to put the hotel address on paper.

senseEn: imagine a possible situation
en: Suppose it rains; where could we host the picnic?
zh: 假设下雨，我们能在哪儿办野餐？
transfer: 向队友提出假设：场馆关门时该到哪里训练。
transferEn: Discuss an alternative training location under a hypothetical venue closure.

senseEn: limited in size
en: Is there a small locker for just a backpack?
zh: 有没有仅放背包的小储物柜？
transfer: 向花店要一个适合摆在窄窗台的小花盆。
transferEn: Request a little planter that fits a narrow windowsill.

senseEn: relating to people as distinct from machines
en: Can I speak to a human agent about the refund?
zh: 退款的事能转人工客服吗？
transfer: 询问译文有没有经过人工审校。
transferEn: Ask whether a person reviewed the translation.

senseEn: a portion broken or cut from a whole
en: Save me a piece of cake.
zh: 给我留一块蛋糕。
transfer: 请裁缝留一块布用于补衣服。
transferEn: Ask a tailor to set aside a scrap of fabric for patches.

senseEn: the person supervising one's work
en: My boss approved the switch to mornings.
zh: 我的上司批准我改上早班。
transfer: 告知同事你得先问上司才能换班。
transferEn: Explain that a shift swap requires your supervisor's agreement.

senseEn: a facility providing medical care
en: Which hospital is nearest the campsite?
zh: 离营地最近的医院是哪家？
transfer: 向司机说明你要去医院探病。
transferEn: Tell a driver you are going to visit a patient at a medical facility.

senseEn: a parent's brother or a parent's sibling's husband
en: My uncle runs the bakery by the bridge.
zh: 我叔叔经营桥边那家面包店。
transfer: 介绍来给你送钥匙的舅舅。
transferEn: Introduce your mother's brother when he delivers the keys.

senseEn: beyond a landmark on a route
en: Go past the fountain and turn left.
zh: 走过喷泉后左转。
transfer: 告诉骑行者经过木桥后找绿色标志。
transferEn: Direct a cyclist to look for a green marker after passing a wooden bridge.

senseEn: move behind someone along their route
en: Follow the guide across the courtyard.
zh: 跟着导游穿过庭院。
transfer: 请新同事跟你去领门卡。
transferEn: Invite a new colleague to come along behind you to collect a pass.

senseEn: a film shown on a screen
en: Is the movie subtitled tonight?
zh: 今晚这部电影有字幕吗？
transfer: 问朋友周末看的电影适不适合小孩。
transferEn: Ask whether the film a friend saw is suitable for children.

senseEn: a brief sound of laughter
en: Ha, you caught me eating the last cookie!
zh: 哈，我偷吃最后一块饼干被你发现了！
transfer: 朋友揭晓你猜错了谜底，轻笑回应。
transferEn: Respond with a little laugh after guessing a riddle incorrectly.

senseEn: forward without turning
en: Walk straight through the lobby to the lift.
zh: 穿过大厅一直走到电梯。
transfer: 指引访客过桥后继续直走。
transferEn: Direct a visitor to continue forward without turning after the bridge.

senseEn: a holiday celebrated on December 25
en: Is the clinic open on Christmas Day?
zh: 诊所圣诞节当天开门吗？
transfer: 向旅馆确认圣诞节是否提供早餐。
transferEn: Check holiday breakfast service for December 25 at a hotel.

senseEn: remove dirt from something
en: How do I clean the filter without damaging it?
zh: 滤网该怎么洗才不会坏？
transfer: 向皮具店询问怎样清洁新皮包。
transferEn: Ask a leather shop how to remove dirt from a new bag.

senseEn: touch with the lips affectionately
en: Can I kiss the baby goodnight?
zh: 我能给宝宝一个晚安吻吗？
transfer: 用英语问伴侣能否吻一下对方的脸颊。
transferEn: Ask a partner's permission for an affectionate peck on the cheek.

senseEn: one thousand thousands
en: Did the project cost a million dollars?
zh: 这个项目花了一百万美元吗？
transfer: 在展会上问装置是否真的用了百万颗珠子。
transferEn: Ask if an installation really used one thousand thousand beads.

senseEn: rest in a horizontal position
en: May I lie down until the dizziness passes?
zh: 我可以躺一会儿等头不晕了吗？
transfer: 请孩子先躺在毯子上观察星空。
transferEn: Invite a child to stretch out on a blanket to look at the stars.

senseEn: signals definite agreement
en: Certainly, I'll print you another copy.
zh: 当然，我再给您印一份。
transfer: 向询问能否寄存行李的客人作肯定答复。
transferEn: Respond affirmatively to a guest asking about luggage storage.

senseEn: one raised level on a staircase
en: Mind the bottom step; it's loose.
zh: 小心最下面一级台阶，有点松。
transfer: 提醒访客入口处有一级矮台阶。
transferEn: Warn a visitor about a low stair at the entrance.

senseEn: acquire knowledge or skill
en: Where can I learn to swim as an adult?
zh: 成人可以去哪儿学游泳？
transfer: 向同事打听哪里可以学做电子表格。
transferEn: Ask a colleague where to gain spreadsheet skills.

senseEn: autumn in American English
en: We rent the cabin every fall.
zh: 我们每年秋天都租那间小木屋。
transfer: 向游客描述秋天当地集市有哪些水果。
transferEn: Describe fruit available at the local market in autumn.

senseEn: a statement showing how much money is owed
en: Has the electricity bill arrived yet?
zh: 电费账单到了吗？
transfer: 用餐后请服务员拿来账单。
transferEn: Ask a server for the statement of what you owe after a meal.

senseEn: after a long wait or effort
en: The replacement key finally arrived this morning.
zh: 补配的钥匙今天早上终于送到了。
transfer: 告诉朋友你排了很久的队总算买到票了。
transferEn: Describe securing tickets after a long wait in line.

senseEn: a scheduled teaching session
en: What room is the evening class in?
zh: 晚课在哪间教室上？
transfer: 问教练明天的课需要带毛巾吗。
transferEn: Check with a coach about supplies for tomorrow's lesson.

senseEn: with little or no noise
en: Is there a quiet corner for a video call?
zh: 有安静的角落可以打视频电话吗？
transfer: 向前台询问是否有远离电梯的安静房间。
transferEn: Request a peaceful room away from the lift.

senseEn: think about a question with curiosity
en: I wonder why the clocks here show different times.
zh: 我想知道这里的钟为什么时间不一样。
transfer: 对公园里编号的树表示好奇。
transferEn: Express curiosity about numbered trees in a park.

senseEn: a farewell at parting
en: Let me say goodbye to the host before we leave.
zh: 我们走之前让我跟主人道个别。
transfer: 送朋友上车前向他道别。
transferEn: Say farewell to a friend before they board the bus.

senseEn: a rule established by public authority
en: Which law covers access to public records?
zh: 公开档案的查阅受哪部法律规范？
transfer: 问讲师这条法律是哪一年通过的。
transferEn: Ask an instructor when a particular statute was passed.

senseEn: come to be in a new state
en: Does the trail become muddy after rain?
zh: 这条步道下雨后会变泥泞吗？
transfer: 询问这种布料洗后会不会变软。
transferEn: Check whether a fabric gets softer after washing.

senseEn: broad rather than detailed
en: Give us a general outline before the figures.
zh: 讲数字前先给我们一个大致介绍。
transfer: 请老师先概括讲一下考试形式。
transferEn: Request a broad overview of the exam format.

senseEn: prefer one choice to another
en: I'd rather wait for a direct train.
zh: 我宁愿等直达列车。
transfer: 告诉朋友你更想在阳台吃饭。
transferEn: Express a preference for dining on the balcony.

senseEn: capable of being done
en: Is a morning pickup possible on Friday?
zh: 周五上午可以取货吗？
transfer: 询问裁缝今天改好袖子是否可行。
transferEn: Check whether a tailor can finish the sleeves today.

senseEn: a swear word expressing strong annoyance
en: The editor removed “goddamn” from my complaint about the broken latch.
zh: 编辑删掉了我抱怨门闩坏了时用的那句粗话。
transfer: 指出音频里哪句粗话表达了打印机又卡纸时的懊恼。
transferEn: Identify the swear word expressing frustration at another printer jam in a recording.

senseEn: except if a condition holds
en: We'll cycle unless it rains.
zh: 除非下雨，否则我们骑车。
transfer: 说明除非对方改期，你会按原时间赴约。
transferEn: Confirm the original meeting time except in the event of a change.

senseEn: angry, especially in informal speech
en: Are you mad at me for moving the desk?
zh: 我挪了桌子，你在生我的气吗？
transfer: 向朋友解释你在生自己的气。
transferEn: Explain to a friend that your anger is directed at yourself.

senseEn: with complete agreement or certainty
en: You're absolutely right about the missing signature.
zh: 你说得完全对，确实漏签了。
transfer: 在核实日期后，向同伴表达你完全确定。
transferEn: Express complete certainty after checking the date.

senseEn: in need of rest
en: I'm too tired to drive the next stretch.
zh: 我太累了，下一段路开不了了。
transfer: 向同伴提议因疲劳提前结束徒步。
transferEn: Suggest ending a hike early because you need rest.

senseEn: an unlawful intentional killing
en: The documentary revisits an unsolved murder case.
zh: 这部纪录片回顾了一起未侦破的谋杀案。
transfer: 向图书馆员询问一本记录旧时谋杀案庭审的书。
transferEn: Ask a librarian for a book about the trial following a historical killing.

senseEn: a route for vehicles
en: Is the coast road open after the storm?
zh: 风暴过后沿海公路通了吗？
transfer: 询问司机哪条道路通往码头。
transferEn: Ask a driver which roadway leads to the harbor.

senseEn: the organ used for sight
en: There's grit in my left eye.
zh: 我左眼进了沙粒。
transfer: 向护士描述哪只眼睛发痒。
transferEn: Tell a nurse which side of your vision is affected by itching.

senseEn: excluding a particular case
en: The pool opens daily except Monday.
zh: 泳池除周一外每天开放。
transfer: 告诉朋友清单上除了面包其他东西都买了。
transferEn: Explain that bread is the only item missing from the grocery list.

senseEn: an unspecified place
en: Can we stop somewhere dry to check the map?
zh: 能找个不淋雨的地方停下来看看地图吗？
transfer: 建议找个有插座的地方开会。
transferEn: Suggest meeting in a location with an electrical outlet.

senseEn: make something clear through details
en: Could you explain the symbols on this map?
zh: 能解释一下地图上的符号吗？
transfer: 请同事解释发票上两项费用的区别。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to clarify the difference between two invoice charges.

senseEn: a smaller amount
en: Could you use less salt in my soup?
zh: 我的汤能少放些盐吗？
transfer: 请裁缝做裙子时少用一些布。
transferEn: Ask a tailor to reduce the fabric needed for a skirt.

senseEn: not a single one
en: I tried three keys and none fit.
zh: 我试了三把钥匙，一把都不合适。
transfer: 告诉同事你找的箱子没有一个够大。
transferEn: Explain that all the boxes you found were too small.

senseEn: information kept from others
en: Keep the party a secret until Friday.
zh: 周五前请对聚会保密。
transfer: 请弟弟不要泄露生日礼物是什么。
transferEn: Ask your brother not to reveal a birthday gift.

senseEn: have clothing or accessories on one's body
en: Do we need to wear gloves in the workshop?
zh: 在车间需要戴手套吗？
transfer: 询问参观时能否穿凉鞋。
transferEn: Check if sandals are allowed on a tour.

senseEn: justifying the cost or effort
en: Is the sea view worth the extra twenty dollars?
zh: 海景房值得多花二十美元吗？
transfer: 和朋友讨论为提前入场多排一小时值不值。
transferEn: Discuss whether early admission justifies an extra hour in line.

senseEn: perform a role
en: Will you act in the school play this year?
zh: 今年你会参演学校的话剧吗？
transfer: 邀请朋友在短片里演主角的邻居。
transferEn: Invite a friend to play the lead character's neighbor in a short film.

senseEn: taking precautions to avoid harm
en: Be careful on the wet steps.
zh: 台阶湿，小心点。
transfer: 提醒同伴端热茶时小心。
transferEn: Urge caution when a companion carries hot tea.

senseEn: taking little time
en: Is there time for a quick lunch before boarding?
zh: 登机前来得及简单吃顿午饭吗？
transfer: 问经理开会前能否简短聊两句。
transferEn: Ask a manager for a brief conversation before a meeting.

senseEn: the part held to operate something
en: The door handle turns, but the latch won't move.
zh: 门把手能转，但锁舌不动。
transfer: 请店员换掉提手断了的篮子。
transferEn: Ask a clerk to replace a basket with a broken grip.

senseEn: hand something to another person
en: Could you pass the salt?
zh: 能把盐递过来吗？
transfer: 请同事把卷尺递给你。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to hand over the measuring tape.

senseEn: before the usual or expected time
en: The garage closes early on Saturdays.
zh: 修车厂周六关门早。
transfer: 告诉同学明天得提前到场签到。
transferEn: Explain that tomorrow's check-in requires arriving before the usual time.

senseEn: a written account of findings
en: Can I see the inspection report before signing?
zh: 我签字前能看看检查报告吗？
transfer: 请同事把测试报告发给新经理。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to forward the written test findings to a new manager.

senseEn: a region with its own government within a country
en: Which state issued your driver's license?
zh: 你的驾照是哪个州签发的？
transfer: 填邮寄地址时询问该选哪个州。
transferEn: Check which regional government area to enter in a mailing address.

senseEn: occupied with tasks
en: Are you busy after lunch, or could you help me pack?
zh: 你午饭后忙吗，能帮我打包吗？
transfer: 接电话时解释自己正在忙着接待客人。
transferEn: Explain to a caller that guests are keeping you occupied.

senseEn: a piece of furniture for meals
en: Could we have a table near the window?
zh: 能给我们安排靠窗的桌位吗？
transfer: 订餐时说明想要一张能坐六人的桌子。
transferEn: Request dining furniture for a group of six when booking.

senseEn: cause someone to stop sleeping
en: Please wake me before the train reaches York.
zh: 火车到约克前请叫醒我。
transfer: 请室友七点叫你起床赶考试。
transferEn: Ask a roommate to rouse you at seven for an exam.

senseEn: a round object used in play
en: The ball rolled under the bench.
zh: 球滚到长椅底下了。
transfer: 请教练借一个适合小孩练习的球。
transferEn: Ask a coach for a suitable round play object for a child.

senseEn: large in scale or effect
en: Is the lift due for a major repair?
zh: 这部电梯是不是要大修了？
transfer: 告诉同事排班表有重大调整。
transferEn: Explain a substantial change in the shift schedule.

senseEn: one more than six
en: The museum opens at seven tomorrow.
zh: 博物馆明天七点开门。
transfer: 为七名志愿者确认午餐份数。
transferEn: Confirm lunch portions for a group of seven volunteers.

senseEn: the opening used for eating or speaking
en: Can you open your mouth a little wider?
zh: 嘴能再张大一点吗？
transfer: 告诉牙医张嘴时下巴会疼。
transferEn: Describe jaw pain when opening wider at the dentist.

senseEn: join another person in marriage
en: Did your aunt marry her partner here in town?
zh: 你姨妈是在镇上和伴侣结婚的吗？
transfer: 问旧友他和现在的配偶是哪年结的婚。
transferEn: Ask an old friend when he wed his current spouse.

senseEn: responsibility for a mistake
en: The delay was my fault; I used the old address.
zh: 延误是我的错，我用了旧地址。
transfer: 向队友承认拿错钥匙是你的错。
transferEn: Take responsibility for bringing the wrong keys.

senseEn: a meal eaten around midday
en: Is lunch included in the workshop fee?
zh: 培训费包含午餐吗？
transfer: 问旅伴想在哪里吃中午那顿饭。
transferEn: Ask a companion where to have the midday meal.

senseEn: a commissioned military officer of a junior rank
en: The photo shows my aunt as a young lieutenant.
zh: 照片上是我姨妈年轻时担任尉官的样子。
transfer: 请展厅讲解员辨认纪念册里哪位尉官是后来那位将军。
transferEn: Ask a guide to identify the junior officer in an album who later became a general.

senseEn: anticipate a future event
en: When do you expect the delivery?
zh: 你预计什么时候到货？
transfer: 问工作人员何时预计重新开放入口。
transferEn: Ask staff for the anticipated reopening time of an entrance.

senseEn: an affectionate name for one's mother
en: Mama, look what I drew at school!
zh: 妈妈，看我在学校画了什么！
transfer: 用小孩的口气请妈妈给你讲故事。
transferEn: As a child, affectionately ask your mother for a story.

senseEn: relating to time still to come
en: Please send future invoices to this address.
zh: 今后的发票请寄到这个地址。
transfer: 告诉医生后续预约请用新号码联系你。
transferEn: Give a doctor a new number for appointments from now on.

senseEn: material used for writing or printing
en: Can we print this on recycled paper?
zh: 这份材料可以用再生纸印吗？
transfer: 问前台要一张纸抄地址。
transferEn: Request a sheet to write down an address at reception.

senseEn: a member of a police force
en: The officer at reception has your lost-property form.
zh: 接待处的警官拿着你的失物登记表。
transfer: 向警官打听在哪里领取找回的自行车。
transferEn: Ask a police employee where to collect a recovered bicycle.

senseEn: a business providing rooms to travelers
en: Does the hotel provide an airport shuttle?
zh: 这家酒店提供机场接驳车吗？
transfer: 请司机把你送回车站附近的酒店。
transferEn: Ask a driver to return you to your lodging near the station.

senseEn: a companion or close friend
en: I'm waiting for my hiking buddy at the trailhead.
zh: 我在步道起点等徒步伙伴。
transfer: 向教练介绍你的跑步搭档。
transferEn: Introduce your running companion to a coach informally.

senseEn: a person arranging services for clients
en: Our travel agent changed the return flight.
zh: 我们的旅行代理人改了返程航班。
transfer: 请租房代理带你再看一次厨房。
transferEn: Ask the rental representative for another look at the kitchen.

senseEn: the color of a clear daytime sky
en: I'll take the blue folder for the receipts.
zh: 我要那个蓝色文件夹装收据。
transfer: 告诉司机你的公寓有扇蓝门。
transferEn: Describe the sky-colored door of your apartment to a driver.

senseEn: relating to the United States
en: Does this edition use American spelling?
zh: 这个版本用的是美式拼写吗？
transfer: 在插座店询问美国插头能否使用这种转换器。
transferEn: Ask whether a plug from the United States fits an adapter.

senseEn: something done or recorded incorrectly
en: There's a mistake in the shipping address.
zh: 收货地址有个错误。
transfer: 向财务指出报销表中的日期写错了。
transferEn: Point out an incorrect date on an expense form to accounting.

senseEn: a ceremony celebrating a marriage
en: Is the wedding indoors if it rains?
zh: 如果下雨，婚礼改在室内举行吗？
transfer: 询问参加婚礼需要几点到场。
transferEn: Check arrival time for a marriage ceremony.

senseEn: items worn on the body
en: Pack dry clothes for the ride home.
zh: 带上干衣服回程穿。
transfer: 问旅馆哪里可以洗旅行时穿过的衣服。
transferEn: Ask a host where to wash used travel garments.

senseEn: unusual in a puzzling way
en: The fan makes a weird noise at low speed.
zh: 风扇低速运转时有个怪声。
transfer: 跟朋友描述手机屏幕上奇怪的紫色条纹。
transferEn: Casually describe unusual purple lines on a phone screen.

senseEn: a marked area for certain sports
en: Is the tennis court free after lunch?
zh: 午饭后网球场有空吗？
transfer: 向场馆询问能否预约室内羽毛球场。
transferEn: Ask a facility about reserving an indoor badminton playing area.

senseEn: the lower surface of a room
en: The kitchen floor is wet; use the other door.
zh: 厨房地板湿了，走另一扇门吧。
transfer: 请访客把包放在桌上而非地板上。
transferEn: Ask a guest to put a bag on the table instead of on the ground indoors.

senseEn: soil or ground
en: The earth is soft enough to dig now.
zh: 现在泥土很松软，可以挖了。
transfer: 询问园丁为何幼苗周围的土开裂了。
transferEn: Ask a gardener about cracks in the soil around seedlings.

senseEn: a casual term of address for a peer
en: Dude, your bus is pulling away!
zh: 老兄，你的车要开走了！
transfer: 跟熟友打招呼提醒他鞋带松了。
transferEn: Casually catch a close friend's attention about an untied shoe.

senseEn: bring a task to completion
en: Can we finish packing before the van arrives?
zh: 货车来之前我们能打包完吗？
transfer: 请同事先完成盘点再关门。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to complete the inventory before closing.

senseEn: a large vessel traveling on water
en: Which pier does our ship leave from?
zh: 我们的船从哪个码头开？
transfer: 问工作人员哪艘船会停靠岛上的港口。
transferEn: Ask staff which vessel calls at the island port.

senseEn: an organized group sharing an activity
en: Does the cycling club welcome beginners?
zh: 这个骑行俱乐部接收初学者吗？
transfer: 向图书馆员打听读书俱乐部何时见面。
transferEn: Ask a librarian when the reading group meets.

senseEn: mental focus
en: Pay attention to the minus sign in line three.
zh: 注意第三行的负号。
transfer: 提醒队友留意裁判的哨音。
transferEn: Ask teammates to focus on the referee's whistle.

senseEn: twice four
en: Meet me at eight sharp by the gate.
zh: 八点整在门边见。
transfer: 向裁缝询问八颗纽扣是否够用。
transferEn: Check whether eight buttons will be enough for a garment.

senseEn: an unpleasant physical sensation
en: Does the pain spread down your leg?
zh: 疼痛会顺着腿往下蔓延吗？
transfer: 向医生描述腹部什么时候开始疼的。
transferEn: Tell a doctor when your abdominal discomfort began.

senseEn: produce a tune with the voice
en: Can you sing the chorus one more time?
zh: 你能把副歌再唱一遍吗？
transfer: 邀请朋友在聚会上一起唱生日歌。
transferEn: Invite a friend to join in a birthday song at the party.

senseEn: send air from the mouth
en: Blow on the spoonful of soup before tasting it.
zh: 尝汤前先对着勺子吹一下。
transfer: 提醒寿星吹灭蜡烛。
transferEn: Ask the birthday guest to extinguish the candles with a breath.

senseEn: an option among alternatives
en: Is the refillable bottle the cheaper choice?
zh: 可以补充使用的瓶子是更便宜的选项吗？
transfer: 问旅伴夜班火车是否是更安静的选择。
transferEn: Compare the overnight train with another option for quiet travel.

senseEn: the anniversary of a person's birth
en: Can we reserve the booth for Dad's birthday on Friday?
zh: 我们能为爸爸周五过生日订那排卡座吗？
transfer: 请同事在给寿星的卡片上签名。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to sign a card celebrating someone's birth anniversary.

senseEn: adhere to a surface
en: Will this label stick to glass?
zh: 这张标签能粘在玻璃上吗？
transfer: 问店员这种挂钩能否粘在瓷砖上。
transferEn: Ask a clerk whether a hook will adhere to tile.

senseEn: release physical or mental tension
en: I relax by watering the plants after work.
zh: 下班后我通过浇花放松。
transfer: 问朋友长途旅行后怎样放松。
transferEn: Ask how a friend unwinds after a long journey.

senseEn: the day before today
en: I returned the key yesterday afternoon.
zh: 我昨天下午把钥匙还了。
transfer: 告诉修理工你昨天第一次听到异响。
transferEn: Tell a mechanic you first heard the noise the previous day.

senseEn: show public respect
en: The concert will honor the volunteers who rebuilt the hall.
zh: 这场音乐会将向重建礼堂的志愿者致敬。
transfer: 说明学校为什么要向退休教师致敬。
transferEn: Explain why the school is paying tribute to retired teachers.

en: He's a smart kid who figured out the lock on his own.
zh: 这孩子真聪明，自己就弄明白了怎么开锁。
transfer: 称赞队友想出一个省时间的聪明办法。
senseEn: showing good judgment or ingenuity
transferEn: Praise a teammate for coming up with a time-saving solution.

senseEn: a senior military officer below a general
en: The guest speaker retired as a colonel in the army.
zh: 这位特邀演讲者退休前是陆军上校。
transfer: 向博物馆讲解员确认照片中的上校叫什么名字。
transferEn: Ask a guide to identify a senior army officer of that rank in a photo.

senseEn: a vessel for traveling on water
en: Is the boat to the island running today?
zh: 去岛上的船今天开吗？
transfer: 问船主这条小船能坐几个人。
transferEn: Ask the owner how many passengers a small vessel can carry.

senseEn: an aircraft with wings
en: Our plane lands after the last bus leaves.
zh: 我们的飞机落地时末班公交已经开走了。
transfer: 问航空公司哪架飞机有婴儿摇篮位。
transferEn: Ask an airline which aircraft offers bassinet seats.

senseEn: one of the twelve calendar divisions
en: Can I renew the pass next month?
zh: 我可以下个月续通行证吗？
transfer: 询问课程在哪个月结束。
transferEn: Ask which calendar period contains the course end date.

senseEn: very pleasant or attractive
en: What a lovely spot for a picnic!
zh: 这地方可真适合野餐！
transfer: 向主人夸赞花园晚餐的愉快氛围。
transferEn: Compliment a host on a pleasant garden dinner.

senseEn: a connected series of rail vehicles
en: Does this train stop near the stadium?
zh: 这趟火车在体育场附近停吗？
transfer: 查明哪班火车可直达机场。
transferEn: Identify the direct rail service to the airport.

senseEn: treating people equitably
en: Is that a fair split of the cleaning duties?
zh: 这样分配清洁工作公平吗？
transfer: 和朋友商量怎样公平分担油费。
transferEn: Discuss an equitable way to share fuel costs.

senseEn: a sound expressing delighted surprise
en: Ooh, look at the colors on that butterfly!
zh: 噢，快看那只蝴蝶的颜色！
transfer: 看到朋友端来自制甜点时表示惊喜。
transferEn: React with delight to a homemade dessert a friend presents.

senseEn: screening for safety before entry
en: Allow time to get through security before boarding.
zh: 登机前给安检留足时间。
transfer: 询问演唱会的安检入口在哪里。
transferEn: Locate the safety screening entrance for a concert.

senseEn: place something over a surface
en: Cover the bowl while the dough rests.
zh: 面团静置时把碗盖上。
transfer: 提醒朋友下雨前用防水布盖住椅子。
transferEn: Ask a friend to put a tarp over chairs before rain.

senseEn: from one side to the other
en: Walk across the square to the clock tower.
zh: 穿过广场走到钟楼。
transfer: 告诉游客售票处在马路对面。
transferEn: Locate the ticket counter on the opposite side of the street.

senseEn: a container made for carrying things
en: Do you need a paper bag for the rolls?
zh: 面包卷需要用纸袋装吗？
transfer: 在前台询问有没有装湿泳衣的袋子。
transferEn: Request a container for carrying a wet swimsuit at reception.

senseEn: extremely unpleasant or poor
en: I had a terrible night with that dripping tap.
zh: 那个水龙头滴个不停，我一夜没睡好。
transfer: 告诉房东楼道里的气味很糟糕。
transferEn: Describe an unpleasant smell in a hallway to a landlord.

senseEn: a piece of music with lyrics
en: What's the last song on tonight's program?
zh: 今晚节目单上最后一首歌是什么？
transfer: 询问朋友想在婚礼上放哪首歌。
transferEn: Ask which musical number a friend wants played at a wedding.

senseEn: use money for a purpose
en: How much can we spend on the decorations?
zh: 我们能花多少钱买装饰品？
transfer: 和同伴商量午餐最多花多少。
transferEn: Agree on a spending limit for lunch with a companion.

senseEn: a large hoofed animal often ridden
en: Can this horse carry a beginner safely?
zh: 这匹马适合初学者骑吗？
transfer: 向农场主询问马平时在哪儿吃草。
transferEn: Ask a farmer where the riding animals usually graze.

senseEn: make a bell-like alert sound
en: Did your phone ring during the meeting?
zh: 会议期间是你的手机响了吗？
transfer: 问同住人今天早上闹钟有没有响。
transferEn: Ask a housemate whether the alarm sounded this morning.

senseEn: offer goods for money
en: Do you sell single stamps here?
zh: 这里卖单张邮票吗？
transfer: 问园艺店是否出售小袋装泥土。
transferEn: Check whether a gardening shop stocks small bags of soil for purchase.

senseEn: give something back
en: Where do I return the trolley?
zh: 手推车该还到哪里？
transfer: 向图书馆员确认归还借用耳机的地点。
transferEn: Check where to give borrowed headphones back at a library.

senseEn: belonging privately to an individual
en: Please use your work email, not your personal account.
zh: 请使用工作邮箱，不要用个人账户。
transfer: 向同事说明那个抽屉里放的是个人物品。
transferEn: Explain that a drawer contains your private belongings.

senseEn: a short piece of information sent to someone
en: May I leave a message for the caretaker?
zh: 我能给管理员留个言吗？
transfer: 问前台有没有司机给你的留言。
transferEn: Ask reception if the driver left a note for you.

senseEn: connected parts functioning together
en: The booking system is offline until noon.
zh: 预订系统到中午才能恢复在线。
transfer: 向技术人员报告门禁系统停止工作。
transferEn: Report a failure in the building's access controls.

senseEn: the period after midday
en: Can we reschedule for Thursday afternoon?
zh: 我们能改到周四下午吗？
transfer: 问诊所下午几点恢复接诊。
transferEn: Check when a clinic reopens after lunch.

senseEn: difficult to manage
en: Moving the freezer was a tough job on those stairs.
zh: 在那段楼梯上搬冰柜可真费劲。
transfer: 告诉队友逆风骑行的最后一段很艰难。
transferEn: Describe the difficulty of the final stretch cycling into a headwind.

senseEn: leave a job voluntarily
en: I quit my weekend job to finish the course.
zh: 为了读完这门课，我辞了周末那份工作。
transfer: 向朋友解释你为什么辞去晚班工作。
transferEn: Explain to a friend why you resigned from a night job.

senseEn: determine a quantity item by item
en: Let's count the chairs before we order more.
zh: 先数数椅子再决定要不要加订。
transfer: 让孩子数一数还剩几颗纽扣。
transferEn: Ask a child to work out the number of remaining buttons.

senseEn: a rigid container
en: Could I get a smaller box for this mug?
zh: 这个杯子能给我配个小一点的盒子吗？
transfer: 询问前台有没有能装靴子的盒子。
transferEn: Ask reception for a container large enough for boots.

senseEn: in attendance
en: Were both inspectors present at the handover?
zh: 交接时两位检查员都在场吗？
transfer: 确认排练时所有演员是否都到了。
transferEn: Check whether every actor attended rehearsal.

senseEn: restore electrical energy to a battery
en: Can I charge my camera overnight here?
zh: 我的相机能在这里充一晚电吗？
transfer: 询问车库能否给电动自行车充电。
transferEn: Check if a garage offers battery charging for an electric bicycle.

senseEn: facts or details about something
en: Where can we get information about accessible routes?
zh: 去哪儿可以查到无障碍路线的信息？
transfer: 向图书馆打听附近免费课程的资料。
transferEn: Ask a library for details about nearby free courses.

senseEn: trick someone into believing something
en: That painted doorway could fool a visitor.
zh: 那扇画出来的门可能会骗过游客。
transfer: 告诉朋友那只仿真猫一度骗过了你。
transferEn: Describe briefly mistaking a model cat for a real one.

senseEn: easy to do or understand
en: Is there a simple way to reset the clock?
zh: 有没有简单的方法重设时钟？
transfer: 向厨师请教一道简单的工作日晚餐。
transferEn: Ask a cook for an uncomplicated weekday dinner.

senseEn: the central area
en: I can see a red tent in the middle of the field.
zh: 我看见场地中间有一顶红帐篷。
transfer: 向同伴指出大厅正中的问讯台。
transferEn: Point out the information desk at the center of the hall.

senseEn: free from agitation
en: The dog stays calm around children.
zh: 这只狗在孩子身边很安静。
transfer: 向护士解释孩子听音乐时会平静下来。
transferEn: Explain that music helps a child remain relaxed.

senseEn: an unexpected pleasant event
en: The extra night was a lovely surprise.
zh: 能多住一晚真是个惊喜。
transfer: 告诉朋友意外收到明信片让你很惊喜。
transferEn: Describe your pleasure at receiving an unexpected postcard.

en: You made this for me? I'll keep it forever.
zh: 这是你为我做的？我会一直留着它。
transfer: 向老同学表达你会永远记得那次旅行。
senseEn: for all future time
transferEn: Tell an old classmate the trip will stay in your memory for life.

senseEn: having little light
en: The trail gets dark after sunset.
zh: 日落后这条步道会变暗。
transfer: 提醒同伴地下车库很暗。
transferEn: Warn a companion about poor lighting in an underground garage.

senseEn: at any location
en: Can we sit anywhere on this deck?
zh: 这一层甲板上随便哪里都能坐吗？
transfer: 询问访客证是否允许在楼内任意停车位停车。
transferEn: Check whether a visitor pass permits parking in any available building space.

senseEn: make a solemn assurance
en: I swear I locked the shed before leaving.
zh: 我发誓我走之前锁了棚门。
transfer: 向朋友郑重保证自己没拆礼物。
transferEn: Assure a friend emphatically that you did not unwrap the gift.

senseEn: come down onto the ground
en: What time do we land in Seattle?
zh: 我们几点在西雅图降落？
transfer: 问导游热气球将在哪里落地。
transferEn: Ask a guide for the balloon's landing location.

senseEn: charmingly attractive
en: What a cute little hat for the baby!
zh: 这顶婴儿小帽真可爱！
transfer: 夸朋友的幼犬睡觉时样子可爱。
transferEn: Compliment a friend on an adorable sleeping puppy.

senseEn: acquire thorough skill in something
en: How long did it take to master that rhythm?
zh: 你花了多久才掌握那个节奏？
transfer: 向教练说明你还没掌握转身动作。
transferEn: Tell a coach you have not fully learned the turn yet.

senseEn: a one-piece garment with a skirt
en: Can the hem of this dress be shortened?
zh: 这条连衣裙的裙摆能改短吗？
transfer: 问店员有没有适合户外婚礼的连衣裙。
transferEn: Ask a shop assistant for a one-piece outfit for an outdoor wedding.

senseEn: intense in flavor
en: This tea is too strong for me; could I add water?
zh: 这茶对我来说太浓了，能加点水吗？
transfer: 向咖啡师说明你想要味道浓一些。
transferEn: Ask a barista for a more intensely flavored cup.

senseEn: a shaped object that opens a lock
en: Does this key fit the back gate?
zh: 这把钥匙能开后门吗？
transfer: 打电话问前台能否补配储物柜钥匙。
transferEn: Ask reception about replacing the object used to unlock your locker.

senseEn: restore something to working order
en: Who can fix the latch before tonight?
zh: 谁能在今晚之前修好门闩？
transfer: 向修车铺打听他们是否能修车铃。
transferEn: Check if a bicycle shop repairs broken bells.

senseEn: holding attention through curiosity
en: The exhibition has an interesting section on old maps.
zh: 展览里有个介绍老地图的部分很有意思。
transfer: 向老师推荐一篇有趣的海洋研究文章。
transferEn: Recommend an engaging ocean research article to a teacher.

senseEn: unusual or unexpected
en: There's a strange smell from the charger.
zh: 充电器散发出一股怪味。
transfer: 向房东描述冰箱发出的陌生嗡嗡声。
transferEn: Describe an unfamiliar hum from the fridge to a landlord.

senseEn: the sound produced when someone speaks
en: Your voice keeps fading on this call.
zh: 通话里你的声音时有时无。
transfer: 请朋友在录音里认出讲述者的嗓音。
transferEn: Ask a friend to identify a narrator by the way they sound.

senseEn: a solid piece of natural stone
en: A flat rock is holding the gate open.
zh: 一块扁石头顶着门，让门开着。
transfer: 提醒骑行者小路上有块松动的石头。
transferEn: Warn a cyclist about a loose stone on the path.

senseEn: an informal term for a police officer
en: A cop helped us find the parade route.
zh: 一个警察帮我们找到了游行路线。
transfer: 跟熟人提起帮忙找回自行车的警察。
transferEn: Casually describe the officer who helped recover a bike.

senseEn: a glazed opening admitting light
en: Does this window open from the top?
zh: 这扇窗是从上面打开的吗？
transfer: 请室友关上浴室的窗户。
transferEn: Ask a roommate to close the glazed opening in the bathroom.

senseEn: a place serving alcoholic drinks
en: Does the bar serve food after nine?
zh: 这家酒吧九点以后还供应食物吗？
transfer: 询问旅馆的酒吧何时停止营业。
transferEn: Ask when the hotel's drinking establishment closes.

senseEn: entirely or completely
en: I totally forgot the spare cable.
zh: 我把备用线完全忘了。
transfer: 向朋友表示你完全理解他想早走的原因。
transferEn: Tell a friend that you fully understand their reason for leaving early.

senseEn: feel grateful for something
en: I appreciate your patience while we check the order.
zh: 我们核对订单期间，感谢您耐心等候。
transfer: 感谢邻居临时照看你的狗。
transferEn: Express gratitude for a neighbor minding your dog at short notice.

senseEn: a nation's land-based military force
en: My aunt joined the army as a nurse.
zh: 我姨妈以护士身份加入了陆军。
transfer: 询问展馆里哪组制服是陆军的。
transferEn: Ask which displayed uniforms belong to the land service.

senseEn: brief in duration
en: Is there time for a short walk before lunch?
zh: 午饭前来得及散会儿步吗？
transfer: 请主管允许你暂时休息一小会儿。
transferEn: Ask a supervisor for a brief pause.

senseEn: capture sound or images for later use
en: May I record the rehearsal for the absent singers?
zh: 我能把排练录下来给缺席的歌手吗？
transfer: 采访开始前询问对方是否允许录音。
transferEn: Seek permission to capture audio before an interview.

senseEn: a small plastic payment instrument
en: My card was declined; can I try another?
zh: 这张卡没刷过，能换一张吗？
transfer: 问集市摊主是否收银行卡。
transferEn: Ask a market stallholder if bank payments are accepted by plastic.

senseEn: having no doubt about something
en: Are you certain the gate closes at six?
zh: 你确定大门六点就关吗？
transfer: 在寄出包裹前确认同事对地址有把握。
transferEn: Check a colleague's confidence in an address before sending a parcel.

senseEn: an institution of higher education
en: Is the college library open to neighbors?
zh: 大学图书馆向附近居民开放吗？
transfer: 问朋友当年在哪所大学学设计。
transferEn: Ask where a friend studied design after secondary school.

senseEn: travel by aircraft
en: Is it cheaper to fly on Tuesday?
zh: 周二坐飞机是不是更便宜？
transfer: 向朋友说明你打算坐飞机而非坐火车去。
transferEn: Tell a friend you plan to travel by air.

senseEn: information supporting a conclusion
en: Do we have evidence of delivery, like a signed receipt?
zh: 有签收单这类送达证据吗？
transfer: 向主管指出照片能证明箱子到货时已破损。
transferEn: Explain how a photo supports a claim that a box arrived damaged.

senseEn: a financial institution
en: Is there a bank nearby that changes cash?
zh: 附近有能兑换现金的银行吗？
transfer: 向前台问银行周六是否营业。
transferEn: Ask reception about Saturday opening at a financial institution.

senseEn: in addition to
en: Who besides Mia has a key to this room?
zh: 除了米娅，还有谁有这间房的钥匙？
transfer: 问厨师除了面粉外还需要采购什么。
transferEn: Ask what ingredients are needed in addition to flour.

senseEn: in every respect
en: Let the keyboard dry completely before plugging it in.
zh: 键盘完全干透后再插电。
transfer: 提醒朋友等胶水完全干透再挂照片。
transferEn: Tell a friend to wait until glue is entirely dry before hanging photos.

senseEn: an assessment of knowledge or skill
en: Do we need pencils for the math test?
zh: 数学考试需要带铅笔吗？
transfer: 问教练游泳考核要游多少米。
transferEn: Ask a coach about the distance required in a swimming assessment.

senseEn: the recorded past
en: This exhibit traces the history of the ferry service.
zh: 这个展览回顾了渡轮服务的历史。
transfer: 请邻居介绍当地老市场的历史。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor about the past of the old market.

senseEn: pleased by an achievement
en: I'm proud of you for finishing that climb.
zh: 你完成了那次攀登，我为你骄傲。
transfer: 表达你为团队首次独立办展而自豪。
transferEn: Express pride in your team for mounting its first independent exhibition.

senseEn: the flesh of aquatic animals used as food
en: Is the fish grilled or fried?
zh: 这道鱼是烤的还是煎炸的？
transfer: 询问厨师汤里有没有放鱼。
transferEn: Ask a cook whether a soup contains seafood from finned animals.

senseEn: become a participant in a group
en: Can beginners join the hike on Saturday?
zh: 初学者能参加周六的徒步吗？
transfer: 问读书会组织者怎样加入。
transferEn: Ask an organizer how to become a reading-group member.

senseEn: go to a destination
en: Does this path lead to the lake?
zh: 这条小路通往湖边吗？
transfer: 问前台哪个楼梯通到屋顶。
transferEn: Find out which staircase reaches the roof.

senseEn: have a particular odor
en: Does this milk smell sour to you?
zh: 你闻着这牛奶有酸味吗？
transfer: 告诉店员你闻到包裹发出霉味。
transferEn: Describe a musty odor coming from a parcel.

senseEn: close to a location
en: Is there parking near the clinic?
zh: 诊所附近有停车位吗？
transfer: 问同伴有没有靠近车站的餐馆。
transferEn: Find a restaurant close to the station with a companion.

senseEn: a residence in a larger building
en: Does the apartment have its own meter?
zh: 这套公寓有独立电表吗？
transfer: 向搬家公司说明公寓楼里没有电梯。
transferEn: Tell movers about the lack of a lift in your residential building.

senseEn: take pleasure in an activity
en: Did you enjoy the boat ride despite the wind?
zh: 风那么大，你坐船还开心吗？
transfer: 问新同事是否喜欢周末的烘焙课。
transferEn: Ask a new colleague about their enjoyment of the weekend baking lesson.

senseEn: a written message sent to someone
en: A letter from the landlord came this morning.
zh: 今天早上收到一封房东的信。
transfer: 询问邮局这封信何时能寄到。
transferEn: Ask a postal clerk when a written message will reach its recipient.

senseEn: the circumstances at a particular time
en: What's the situation with the broken lift?
zh: 坏了的电梯现在情况怎么样了？
transfer: 请同事介绍场馆停电后的情况。
transferEn: Request an update on conditions after a venue lost power.

senseEn: a journey away from one's usual place
en: Is this trip suitable for a day off?
zh: 这趟旅行适合用一天假来玩吗？
transfer: 向朋友打听周末去海岛的旅行是否顺利。
transferEn: Ask how a friend's weekend journey to an island went.

senseEn: make a visible indication
en: Please mark the boxes that contain glass.
zh: 请标出装有玻璃制品的箱子。
transfer: 请同伴把想去的景点标在地图上。
transferEn: Ask a companion to identify desired sights with marks on a map.

senseEn: a place selling goods
en: Does the hardware store cut keys?
zh: 那家五金店能配钥匙吗？
transfer: 问前台附近有没有卖雨衣的商店。
transferEn: Locate a shop carrying raincoats near a hotel.

senseEn: a very informal way to greet or call someone
en: Yo, Sam, your train's on platform two!
zh: 嘿，萨姆，你的火车在二号站台！
transfer: 用熟人间很随意的招呼提醒队友轮到他了。
transferEn: Get a close teammate's attention casually when their turn comes.

en: There's an amazing view of the harbor from this bench.
zh: 从这张长椅上能看到令人惊叹的港口景色。
transfer: 音乐会后向朋友描述一段令人惊叹的独奏。
senseEn: causing strong admiration
transferEn: Describe a stunning solo to a friend after a concert.

senseEn: a distant body shining in the night sky
en: Which star is visible above the tower?
zh: 塔上方能看到的是哪颗星？
transfer: 告诉孩子天色太亮还看不到星星。
transferEn: Explain to a child why the sky is still too bright for stargazing.

senseEn: an unintended harmful incident
en: An accident on the bridge has delayed the bus.
zh: 桥上发生事故，公交车晚点了。
transfer: 告诉租车公司事故发生在哪个停车场。
transferEn: Identify the parking lot where a rental vehicle was involved in a mishap.

senseEn: form a mental picture
en: Can you imagine this room with the wall removed?
zh: 你能想象拆掉这面墙后房间的样子吗？
transfer: 请孩子想象花园被雪盖住时的样子。
transferEn: Invite a child to picture the garden covered in snow.

senseEn: a familiar informal form of address for a physician
en: Thanks, Doc, I'll bring the old scan.
zh: 谢谢医生，我会带来以前的检查图像。
transfer: 和熟悉的家庭医生道谢，说明会回来复查。
transferEn: Thank a familiar physician casually and confirm a follow-up visit.

senseEn: an enjoyable experience
en: It was a pleasure showing you around the garden.
zh: 带你参观花园我很开心。
transfer: 向主人表达与你们共进晚餐很愉快。
transferEn: Tell a host how enjoyable dining together was.

senseEn: indicates what would be advisable
en: We ought to check the weather before sailing.
zh: 我们出航前应该查天气。
transfer: 建议同伴寄信前核对邮编。
transferEn: Recommend verifying a postal code before sending a letter.

senseEn: an itemized written collection
en: Put batteries on the shopping list.
zh: 把电池写到购物清单上。
transfer: 请同事列出活动需要借的器材。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to itemize equipment to borrow for an event.

senseEn: intensely flavored and substantial
en: This sauce is too rich for a light lunch.
zh: 这酱汁味道太厚重，不适合清淡的午餐。
transfer: 向朋友描述巧克力蛋糕浓郁的味道。
transferEn: Describe the intense flavor of a chocolate cake.

senseEn: a facility provided for users
en: Is there a printing service at reception?
zh: 前台提供打印服务吗？
transfer: 询问车站是否提供行李寄存服务。
transferEn: Check what luggage storage facilities the station provides.

senseEn: including every part
en: Is the entire route wheelchair accessible?
zh: 整条路线都方便轮椅通行吗？
transfer: 询问今天是否需要关闭整层楼。
transferEn: Check whether every part of a floor must close today.

senseEn: a feature distinguishing things
en: What's the difference between these two fares?
zh: 这两种票价有什么区别？
transfer: 询问店员两种滤芯的区别。
transferEn: Ask a clerk how two filter cartridges differ.

senseEn: an official who decides matters in court
en: The judge asked for a clearer copy of the map.
zh: 法官要求提供更清晰的地图副本。
transfer: 向同学转述法官何时宣布休庭。
transferEn: Tell a classmate when the court official adjourned proceedings.

senseEn: frozen water used for cooling
en: No ice in my juice, please.
zh: 我的果汁请不要加冰。
transfer: 野餐前问朋友有没有冰块放保温箱里。
transferEn: Ask a friend for frozen cubes to put in a picnic cooler.

senseEn: a professional qualified to advise on legal matters
en: Our lawyer is reviewing the draft lease.
zh: 我们的律师正在审阅租约草案。
transfer: 向前台询问和律师的预约在哪间办公室。
transferEn: Locate the office for an appointment with a legal adviser.

senseEn: the oily component of food
en: Trim the visible fat before cooking the meat.
zh: 煮肉前把看得见的脂肪切掉。
transfer: 问厨师哪种奶酪的脂肪含量较低。
transferEn: Ask a cook which cheese has a lower lipid content.

senseEn: an informal expression of agreement
en: Alright, let's take the earlier bus.
zh: 好，那就坐早一点的公交吧。
transfer: 口头接受朋友改在咖啡馆碰面的提议。
transferEn: Casually accept a friend's suggestion to meet at a café.

senseEn: as a substitute
en: We're out of lime; can I use lemon instead?
zh: 青柠用完了，我能用柠檬代替吗？
transfer: 询问司机能否改在图书馆门口停车。
transferEn: Ask a driver to use the library entrance as an alternative stop.

senseEn: the length of time someone has lived
en: Is there a minimum age for this class?
zh: 这门课有最低年龄限制吗？
transfer: 报名时确认是否需要填写孩子的年龄。
transferEn: Check if a registration form requires the child's years of life.

senseEn: a stopping place for rail or bus services
en: Which station has step-free access?
zh: 哪个车站进出不用走楼梯？
transfer: 问司机最近的火车站离这里多远。
transferEn: Ask a driver about the distance to the nearest rail stop.

senseEn: become aware of a fact
en: I didn't realize the ferry needed a reservation.
zh: 我原先不知道渡轮需要预约。
transfer: 告诉朋友你刚意识到手表慢了五分钟。
transferEn: Tell a friend you have just noticed your watch is five minutes slow.

senseEn: a valuable yellow metal
en: Is the clasp solid gold or plated?
zh: 这个搭扣是纯金的还是镀金的？
transfer: 请珠宝商确认戒指含多少金。
transferEn: Ask a jeweler about the proportion of precious yellow metal in a ring.

senseEn: a place to sit
en: Is the aisle seat still available?
zh: 靠过道的座位还有吗？
transfer: 问前台有没有方便轮椅转移的座位。
transferEn: Ask about seating that allows an easy transfer from a wheelchair.

senseEn: ten times ten
en: Do these labels come in packs of a hundred?
zh: 这些标签有一百张一包的吗？
transfer: 询问场馆能否为一百名观众提供座位。
transferEn: Check a venue's seating capacity for one hundred guests.

senseEn: the warm season between spring and autumn
en: Does the ferry run later in summer?
zh: 夏天渡轮收班会晚些吗？
transfer: 询问泳池是否夏季才开放。
transferEn: Check whether the pool opens only during the warmest season.

senseEn: a heavenly figure often depicted with wings
en: Who carved the angel above the chapel door?
zh: 礼拜堂门上方的天使是谁雕刻的？
transfer: 向博物馆讲解员指出画里手拿花枝的天使。
transferEn: Identify the winged heavenly figure holding flowers in a painting.

senseEn: a dirty or disorderly state
en: Sorry about the mess in the hall; we're packing.
zh: 抱歉走廊里很乱，我们正在打包。
transfer: 请孩子收拾做手工留下的一团乱。
transferEn: Ask a child to tidy the disorder left after crafts.

senseEn: most important
en: What's the chief reason for moving the workshop?
zh: 工作坊换地方的主要原因是什么？
transfer: 向主管说明延期的首要原因。
transferEn: Explain the main reason for a delay to a supervisor.

senseEn: a device for receiving broadcast sound
en: Does this radio take batteries?
zh: 这台收音机用电池吗？
transfer: 问露营同伴有没有能听天气预报的收音机。
transferEn: Ask a camper for a receiver to hear a weather broadcast.

senseEn: needing food
en: I'm getting hungry; is there a café before the pass?
zh: 我有点饿了，过山口前有咖啡馆吗？
transfer: 问孩子练完球有没有饿。
transferEn: Check a child's appetite after ball practice.

senseEn: the relationship of spouses
en: They're celebrating fifty years of marriage tonight.
zh: 他们今晚庆祝结婚五十周年。
transfer: 问祖父母想怎样纪念他们的婚姻周年。
transferEn: Ask grandparents how they want to mark their years as spouses.

senseEn: the organ inside the skull responsible for thought
en: Does the scan show the whole brain?
zh: 这张扫描图能看到整个大脑吗？
transfer: 在科学展问哪个模型显示大脑如何处理声音。
transferEn: Ask which model shows how the organ of thought processes sound.

sense: 人，用于强调一个人也没有
senseEn: a person, especially in an emphatic negative
en: There wasn't a soul at the ticket desk.
zh: 售票处一个人也没有。
transfer: 形容清晨的海滩上一个人影也没有。
transferEn: Describe a beach completely deserted at dawn.

senseEn: stop blaming someone for a wrong
en: Can you forgive me for missing your show?
zh: 你能原谅我没去看你的演出吗？
transfer: 向朋友请求原谅你弄丢借来的书。
transferEn: Ask a friend to pardon you for losing a borrowed book.

senseEn: extending far below the surface
en: How deep is the water near the pier?
zh: 码头附近的水有多深？
transfer: 问园丁树苗坑需挖多深。
transferEn: Ask how far down to dig a hole for a sapling.

senseEn: a female romantic partner
en: My girlfriend booked the earlier train for us.
zh: 我女朋友替我们订了早一班火车。
transfer: 向朋友介绍和你一起搬来的女朋友。
transferEn: Introduce the female partner who moved in with you.

senseEn: moving at a low speed
en: Traffic is slow near the tunnel.
zh: 隧道附近车开得很慢。
transfer: 解释为什么那条慢速渡轮赶不上末班车。
transferEn: Explain why a slower ferry would miss the last bus connection.

senseEn: not open to others
en: Could we have a private conversation after class?
zh: 课后我们能单独谈谈吗？
transfer: 请前台找个能私下通话的地方。
transferEn: Ask reception for somewhere to speak without being overheard.

senseEn: within the time span of an event
en: Please mute your phone during the recital.
zh: 演奏会期间请将手机静音。
transfer: 询问工人施工期间还能否使用车库。
transferEn: Check whether the garage remains accessible while work is in progress.

senseEn: a sudden episode of illness
en: She had an asthma attack on the hike.
zh: 她在徒步时哮喘发作了。
transfer: 向护士说明上次偏头痛发作是什么时候。
transferEn: Tell a nurse when the last migraine episode occurred.

senseEn: an alcoholic drink brewed from grain
en: Is that beer brewed here in town?
zh: 那款啤酒是本地酿的吗？
transfer: 在餐馆问有没有不含酒精的啤酒。
transferEn: Ask a restaurant for a nonalcoholic version of the brewed drink.

senseEn: with certainty
en: The office is definitely closed on Monday.
zh: 办公室周一肯定不开。
transfer: 向同伴确认你肯定会带野餐毯。
transferEn: Assure a companion that bringing the picnic blanket is certain.

senseEn: someone working jointly with another
en: My lab partner kept a copy of the readings.
zh: 我的实验搭档保存了一份读数记录。
transfer: 向教练介绍你的双打搭档。
transferEn: Introduce your doubles teammate to a coach.

senseEn: a particular part of a place
en: Is this area reserved for residents?
zh: 这片区域是住户专用的吗？
transfer: 问管理员草坪哪片区域允许野餐。
transferEn: Ask which part of the lawn allows picnics.

senseEn: likely to cause harm
en: Is this crossing dangerous after dark?
zh: 天黑后过这个路口危险吗？
transfer: 提醒同伴暴雨后的山路有危险。
transferEn: Warn a companion about an unsafe mountain road after heavy rain.

senseEn: make something available
en: Do you offer refunds on unused tickets?
zh: 没用过的票可以退款吗？
transfer: 询问酒店是否提供机场接送。
transferEn: Check whether a hotel provides airport transfers.

senseEn: a continuous part of a play or film
en: Where was the market scene filmed?
zh: 集市那场戏是在哪里拍的？
transfer: 问导演明天排练哪场戏。
transferEn: Ask a director which part of the play will be rehearsed tomorrow.

senseEn: following the second
en: Our room is on the third floor.
zh: 我们的房间在三楼。
transfer: 指引骑车人在第三个路口左转。
transferEn: Direct a cyclist to turn left at junction number three.

senseEn: distressed or unhappy
en: Are you upset about the canceled trip?
zh: 旅行取消了，你难过吗？
transfer: 告诉朋友你为错过演出而难过。
transferEn: Explain your distress at having missed a performance.

senseEn: a road vehicle carrying many passengers on a route
en: Is this bus going to the harbor?
zh: 这辆公交车去港口吗？
transfer: 问前台周日最早的公交车几点开。
transferEn: Ask reception about the first public road service on Sunday.

senseEn: have an obligation to pay
en: How much do I owe you for the groceries?
zh: 买菜的钱我该给你多少？
transfer: 问室友你还欠多少电费。
transferEn: Check your unpaid share of the electricity bill.

senseEn: the language widely spoken in the UK and US
en: Is the tour given in English on Thursdays?
zh: 星期四有英语导览吗？
transfer: 询问展馆有没有英文地图。
transferEn: Check for a map in the language spoken in the US.

senseEn: several people considered together
en: Our group needs six lockers.
zh: 我们这组人需要六个储物柜。
transfer: 告诉司机你们一行人要去同一个地址。
transferEn: Tell a driver that all your companions share one destination.

senseEn: strike with the foot
en: Please kick the ball away from the windows.
zh: 请把球朝远离窗户的方向踢。
transfer: 请教练演示怎样轻轻把球踢给搭档。
transferEn: Ask a coach to demonstrate a gentle foot pass to a partner.

senseEn: morally very bad
en: Does the evil king return in the sequel?
zh: 续集里那个邪恶的国王还会出现吗？
transfer: 讨论童话里哪个人物被描写成邪恶的。
transferEn: Discuss which fairy-tale character is portrayed as wicked.

senseEn: a short remark or story intended to amuse
en: Could you explain the joke about the two bakers?
zh: 能解释一下两个面包师那个笑话吗？
transfer: 请朋友把你没听清的笑话结尾再说一次。
transferEn: Ask a friend to repeat the punchline you missed.

senseEn: a large vehicle for carrying goods
en: The delivery truck is blocking our driveway.
zh: 送货卡车挡住了车道。
transfer: 向搬家公司询问卡车能否驶过窄巷。
transferEn: Check whether a mover's freight vehicle fits down a narrow lane.

senseEn: help someone learn a skill
en: Could you teach me to mend this seam?
zh: 你能教我补这条衣缝吗？
transfer: 请朋友教你怎样换自行车内胎。
transferEn: Ask a friend for instruction in replacing a bicycle inner tube.

senseEn: the color of fresh grass
en: The green tag means the plant likes shade.
zh: 绿色标签表示这种植物喜阴。
transfer: 告诉同伴你把票装进绿色信封里了。
transferEn: Identify the grass-colored envelope containing your tickets.

senseEn: physical money such as notes or coins
en: Is this stall cash only?
zh: 这个摊位只收现金吗？
transfer: 询问司机有没有零钱找开纸币。
transferEn: Check whether a driver accepts physical currency and has change.

senseEn: toward the front
en: Move the seat forward a little so I can reach the pedals.
zh: 把座位往前挪一点，我才够得着踏板。
transfer: 请同伴把手推车往前推一点。
transferEn: Ask a companion to push a trolley a little farther ahead.

senseEn: truthful and sincere
en: I'd like your honest opinion on the first draft.
zh: 我想听听你对初稿的真实看法。
transfer: 请朋友直说新椅子坐起来舒不舒服。
transferEn: Ask for a friend's candid assessment of a new chair's comfort.

senseEn: a male romantic partner
en: My boyfriend works nights, so lunch suits us better.
zh: 我男朋友上夜班，所以午餐对我们更合适。
transfer: 向同事介绍来接你的男朋友。
transferEn: Introduce the male partner who has come to pick you up.

senseEn: leave a vehicle in a designated spot
en: Can visitors park behind the building?
zh: 访客可以把车停在楼后面吗？
transfer: 询问店员哪里可以临时停自行车。
transferEn: Ask a clerk for a place to leave a bicycle briefly.

senseEn: intended for one person
en: Do you have a single room for Tuesday night?
zh: 周二晚上有单人房吗？
transfer: 替独自出差的同事订一间单人房。
transferEn: Reserve accommodation for a colleague traveling alone.

senseEn: a job or role
en: Is the weekend position still open?
zh: 周末那个职位还在招人吗？
transfer: 问餐厅有没有适合学生的兼职职位。
transferEn: Ask a restaurant about part-time openings for students.

senseEn: treat someone's wishes with consideration
en: Please respect her decision to leave early.
zh: 请尊重她提前离开的决定。
transfer: 提醒访客尊重主人的隐私。
transferEn: Ask guests to honor the host's privacy.

senseEn: an act prohibited by criminal law
en: Did you witness the crime itself or only the aftermath?
zh: 你看到了犯罪过程，还是只看到了事后情形？
transfer: 向图书馆员询问一本分析历史犯罪事件的书。
transferEn: Ask a librarian for a book analyzing historical offenses.

senseEn: available for everyone to use
en: Is there a public toilet near the harbor?
zh: 港口附近有公共卫生间吗？
transfer: 询问这片海滩有没有公共入口。
transferEn: Check whether the beach has an entrance open to everyone.

senseEn: a small child's name for their mother
en: Mommy, my mitten fell off!
zh: 妈妈，我的连指手套掉了！
transfer: 用小孩的口气请妈妈把风筝拿下来。
transferEn: As a small child, ask your mother to get the kite down.

senseEn: an expression celebrating someone's achievement
en: Congratulations on finishing your first race!
zh: 恭喜你完成第一次比赛！
transfer: 向刚通过驾驶考试的朋友道贺。
transferEn: Celebrate a friend's success in passing a driving test.

senseEn: get something to eat informally
en: Can we grab lunch before the museum opens?
zh: 博物馆开门前我们能先去吃午饭吗？
transfer: 邀同事散会后一起去喝杯咖啡。
transferEn: Casually invite a colleague for coffee after the meeting.

senseEn: creative work made to be viewed or experienced
en: The café displays local art for sale.
zh: 咖啡馆里展出并出售本地艺术作品。
transfer: 问画廊今晚有没有学生创作的艺术作品。
transferEn: Ask a gallery about creative work by students on display tonight.

senseEn: an act of assistance
en: Could you do me a favor and sign for the parcel?
zh: 能帮我个忙，签收一下包裹吗？
transfer: 请邻居帮忙在你出差时浇花。
transferEn: Request a neighbor's help watering plants while you travel.

senseEn: on a higher floor
en: The spare blankets are upstairs in the cupboard.
zh: 备用毯子在楼上的柜子里。
transfer: 告诉客人楼上的卫生间可以用。
transferEn: Direct a guest to an available bathroom on the higher floor.

senseEn: a vertical structure dividing spaces
en: Can I put hooks on this wall?
zh: 我能在这面墙上装挂钩吗？
transfer: 请房东检查外墙上的裂缝。
transferEn: Ask a landlord to inspect a crack on the building's exterior surface.

senseEn: apply pressure to move something resistant
en: Don't force the drawer; there's a spoon caught inside.
zh: 别硬推抽屉，有把勺子卡在里面。
transfer: 提醒室友不要硬拧卡住的钥匙。
transferEn: Tell a roommate not to twist a jammed key with excessive pressure.

senseEn: a place where people are detained
en: The old jail reopened as a museum.
zh: 以前的监狱现在作为博物馆重新开放了。
transfer: 询问导游以前的看守所在镇上什么位置。
transferEn: Ask a guide where the town's former detention building stood.

senseEn: move something away by pressing
en: Please push the trolley into the bay.
zh: 请把手推车推回停放区。
transfer: 请伙伴帮忙把书架推靠墙。
transferEn: Ask a partner to move a bookcase toward the wall by pressing it.

senseEn: establish that something is true
en: Does the receipt prove I paid the deposit?
zh: 这张收据能证明我付了定金吗？
transfer: 询问管理员什么文件能证明住址。
transferEn: Check which documents establish your home address.

senseEn: as expected in ordinary use
en: Is that click normal when the heater starts?
zh: 暖气启动时有那声咔嗒响正常吗？
transfer: 向修车工确认新刹车的感觉是否正常。
transferEn: Check with a mechanic whether the feel of new brakes is expected.

senseEn: keep something safe from harm
en: Will this bag protect my camera from rain?
zh: 这个包能保护相机不被雨淋吗？
transfer: 问店员怎样保护木桌免于划伤。
transferEn: Ask a clerk how to guard a wooden tabletop against scratches.

senseEn: equipment performing a particular task
en: Does this machine accept coins?
zh: 这台机器收硬币吗？
transfer: 问自助洗衣店哪台机器能洗大毯子。
transferEn: Ask a laundromat which appliance can handle a large blanket.

senseEn: an open area of cultivated land
en: The path crosses a field of beans.
zh: 这条小路穿过一片豆田。
transfer: 请农场主指出种南瓜的田地。
transferEn: Ask a farmer to point out the plot where pumpkins grow.

senseEn: spring off the ground
en: Can you jump over the puddle without getting wet?
zh: 你能跳过水坑不弄湿鞋吗？
transfer: 向教练询问练习时该跳多高。
transferEn: Ask a coach about the height required in a jumping drill.

senseEn: the organ used for smelling and breathing
en: My nose feels blocked whenever I enter the shed.
zh: 每次进棚屋我都觉得鼻塞。
transfer: 向护士说明鼻子哪侧出血。
transferEn: Tell a nurse which nostril has been bleeding.

senseEn: put something where it cannot easily be seen
en: Where can we hide the present until Sunday?
zh: 我们能把礼物藏在哪儿直到周日？
transfer: 请同伴把彩蛋藏在花园里让孩子找。
transferEn: Ask a companion to conceal painted eggs in the garden for children.

senseEn: the star that lights Earth
en: Move the chair before the sun reaches this window.
zh: 太阳照到这扇窗前把椅子挪一下。
transfer: 询问露营地清晨哪一侧能见到太阳。
transferEn: Ask which side of the campsite gets morning sunlight.

senseEn: a building for Christian worship
en: The concert is in the old church by the river.
zh: 音乐会在河边的老教堂举行。
transfer: 询问游客今天是否可以参观教堂。
transferEn: Check whether visitors may enter the place of worship today.

senseEn: freedom from disturbance
en: I need some peace and quiet to finish this call.
zh: 我得找个清静的地方把电话打完。
transfer: 请室友给你半小时清静时间阅读。
transferEn: Ask your roommate for half an hour of undisturbed reading.

senseEn: a senior teacher at a university
en: Our professor moved the seminar to room twelve.
zh: 我们的教授把研讨课改到了十二号教室。
transfer: 询问系办公室教授什么时候接待学生。
transferEn: Ask a department office when a university teacher meets students.

senseEn: use something jointly
en: Can we share a taxi to the conference?
zh: 我们能拼车去开会吗？
transfer: 问邻居是否愿意共用一个堆肥箱。
transferEn: Invite a neighbor to use a compost bin jointly.

senseEn: the language spoken in France
en: Are the subtitles in French for tonight's film?
zh: 今晚的电影有法语字幕吗？
transfer: 询问博物馆有没有法语导览。
transferEn: Check whether museum tours are available in the language of France.

senseEn: a vulgar dismissal of a claim as nonsense
en: Calling the proposal “bullshit” in print would sound insulting.
zh: 在书面评论里用粗话说提案是胡扯，听起来很冒犯。
transfer: 帮同事把评论草稿里表示“胡扯”的粗话换成具体质疑。
transferEn: Help a colleague replace a vulgar dismissal in a draft with a specific objection.

senseEn: ten hundreds
en: Can this drive hold a thousand photos?
zh: 这个硬盘能存一千张照片吗？
transfer: 询问印一千份节目单的价格。
transferEn: Ask what it costs to print one thousand programs.

senseEn: a feeling of being frightened
en: My fear of heights made the glass walkway difficult.
zh: 因为恐高，那段玻璃栈道我走得很艰难。
transfer: 向教练说明你对深水的恐惧。
transferEn: Explain your apprehension about deep water to an instructor.

senseEn: a sticky strip for fastening things
en: Seal the seam with packing tape.
zh: 用封箱胶带封住接缝。
transfer: 问店员哪种胶带撕下时不伤墙漆。
transferEn: Ask a clerk for an adhesive strip that removes without lifting paint.

senseEn: a matching set of tailored clothes
en: Can you press this suit by Friday?
zh: 周五前能把这套西装熨好吗？
transfer: 试衣时问这套西装能否只换裤子尺码。
transferEn: Ask if the trousers in a matching formal outfit can be exchanged for another size.

senseEn: regarded as sacred in a religion
en: The guide asked us to be quiet at the holy site.
zh: 导游请我们在圣地保持安静。
transfer: 询问进入这座神圣建筑前是否要脱鞋。
transferEn: Ask about removing shoes before entering a sacred building.

senseEn: fuel used by many cars in the US
en: Is there enough gas in the tank to reach town?
zh: 油箱里的汽油够开到镇上吗？
transfer: 请租车柜台指出最近可以买汽油的地方。
transferEn: Ask a rental agent where to refuel a gasoline car nearby.

senseEn: the connection between people
en: What's your relationship to the patient?
zh: 您和患者是什么关系？
transfer: 在学校表格上说明紧急联系人和孩子的关系。
transferEn: State how an emergency contact is connected to a child on a school form.

senseEn: not one of two possibilities
en: Neither key opens the side gate.
zh: 两把钥匙都开不了侧门。
transfer: 告诉店员两双鞋都不合脚。
transferEn: Explain that both pairs of shoes failed to fit.

senseEn: one more than eight
en: The last entry is at nine.
zh: 最晚九点入场。
transfer: 问同伴九张椅子够不够坐。
transferEn: Check whether nine chairs will seat the group.

en: I'll pop into the bakery on my way home. Want anything?
zh: 我回家路上顺便去面包店。想带点什么吗？
transfer: 告诉邻居你午休时能顺路去邮局。
senseEn: make a brief informal visit
transferEn: Tell a neighbor you can stop at the post office during lunch.

senseEn: interrupt or inconvenience someone
en: Sorry to bother you during lunch; is this seat free?
zh: 抱歉打扰你吃午饭，这个位子有人吗？
transfer: 借用邻居电话时为打扰对方休息表示歉意。
transferEn: Acknowledge interrupting a resting neighbor before borrowing a phone.

senseEn: particularly or to a greater degree
en: Book early, especially on a holiday weekend.
zh: 尽早预订，尤其是节假日周末。
transfer: 提醒孩子过马路要小心，尤其是下雨时。
transferEn: Emphasize the need for caution at crossings in rainy weather.

senseEn: worried before a challenging event
en: I'm nervous about my first solo performance.
zh: 第一次独自演出让我很紧张。
transfer: 向驾校教练说明你在繁忙路口有点紧张。
transferEn: Describe your anxiety at busy crossings to a driving instructor.

senseEn: introduces two possible answers
en: Could you check whether the door locks automatically?
zh: 能帮我确认门会不会自动上锁吗？
transfer: 请同事查清会议是否需要预约。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to find out if a meeting requires booking.

senseEn: shaped like a circle
en: Do you have a round lid for this jar?
zh: 这个罐子有圆盖子吗？
transfer: 向店员描述你想要的圆餐桌。
transferEn: Describe a circular dining table to a clerk.

en: Leave the dirty towels in the basket by the shower.
zh: 用脏的毛巾放在淋浴间旁的篮子里。
transfer: 在餐馆请服务员换一个脏杯子。
senseEn: covered in something unclean
transferEn: Ask a server to replace a grimy glass.

senseEn: a small domestic feline
en: Please keep the cat indoors during the move.
zh: 搬家时请让猫待在室内。
transfer: 询问邻居有没有见过你家的猫。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor about a missing pet feline.

senseEn: the first meal of the day
en: What time is breakfast served on Sunday?
zh: 周日几点供应早餐？
transfer: 告诉主人你明早要早点吃早餐赶车。
transferEn: Explain that an early departure requires an early morning meal.

senseEn: an insulting term for someone considered foolish
en: Calling a customer an idiot isn't acceptable here.
zh: 在这里骂顾客是白痴是不能接受的。
transfer: 指出评论中哪个词侮辱了对方，并建议改为描述实际错误。
transferEn: Identify the personal insult in a review and suggest describing the mistake instead.

senseEn: available room for something
en: Is there space for a folding bike on board?
zh: 车上有地方放折叠自行车吗？
transfer: 问搬运工柜子旁有没有空间放书架。
transferEn: Check if there is room for a bookcase beside a cabinet.

senseEn: a facility where people serve criminal sentences
en: The tour includes a former island prison.
zh: 游览包括参观一座旧时的岛上监狱。
transfer: 询问哪部分展览介绍这所监狱关闭的原因。
transferEn: Ask which exhibit explains why a detention facility closed.

senseEn: take something with you
en: May I carry this bag into the gallery?
zh: 我能把这个包带进展厅吗？
transfer: 问工作人员登船时能否随身带水。
transferEn: Check whether passengers may take water aboard.

senseEn: shed tears in response to emotion
en: Did the loud bell make the baby cry again?
zh: 那一下响铃又把宝宝吓哭了吗？
transfer: 告诉朋友你看电影结尾时忍不住哭了。
transferEn: Describe shedding tears at the end of a film.

senseEn: an offensive insult directed at a person
en: The editor cut “bastard” from the letter because it attacked the writer personally.
zh: 编辑删掉了信里骂作者“混蛋”的话，因为那是人身攻击。
transfer: 帮朋友标出留言里的侮辱词，并改写为对行为的批评。
transferEn: Help a friend replace a personal insult in a comment with criticism of the behavior.

senseEn: visible gases and particles from burning
en: There's smoke coming from the toaster.
zh: 烤面包机在冒烟。
transfer: 向管理员说明楼道里哪个方向飘来了烟。
transferEn: Tell the building manager where a smoky haze was coming from.

senseEn: the limb extending from shoulder to hand
en: Can you raise your right arm above your head?
zh: 你的右臂能抬过头顶吗？
transfer: 向护士指出手臂上疼痛的位置。
transferEn: Point out the painful spot between shoulder and wrist to a nurse.

senseEn: a motion picture
en: Is the film shown in its original language?
zh: 这部电影是原声放映吗？
transfer: 问朋友哪部电影赢得了观众奖。
transferEn: Ask a friend which movie won the audience award.

senseEn: the body governing a country or region
en: Does the local government fund this museum?
zh: 这家博物馆是当地政府资助的吗？
transfer: 询问哪一级政府负责维护这座桥。
transferEn: Ask which level of the public administration maintains the bridge.

senseEn: a tall woody plant
en: The path starts under the tallest tree.
zh: 步道从最高的树底下开始。
transfer: 请园丁指出哪棵树秋天会结果。
transferEn: Ask a gardener which woody plant bears fruit in autumn.

senseEn: the body part below the ankle
en: Can you put weight on your left foot?
zh: 你的左脚能受力吗？
transfer: 向鞋匠指出右脚哪里磨出了水泡。
transferEn: Show a cobbler where the right shoe rubbed a blister.

senseEn: get in touch with someone
en: Who should I contact about a lost badge?
zh: 徽章丢了我该联系谁？
transfer: 请房东告诉你停水时联系谁。
transferEn: Ask your landlord whom to reach during a water outage.

senseEn: strike a door to request entry
en: Please knock first; the door sticks when opened suddenly.
zh: 请先敲门，这门猛一开容易卡住。
transfer: 提醒孩子进姐姐房间前先敲门。
transferEn: Tell a child to signal at the door before entering a sibling's room.

senseEn: share someone's opinion
en: I agree with Mia about moving lunch indoors.
zh: 我同意米娅的意见，午餐改在室内吃。
transfer: 告诉同事你同意留出更多检查时间。
transferEn: Express support for a colleague's suggestion to allow more checking time.

senseEn: a polite request for repetition
en: Pardon, did you say gate eight or eighteen?
zh: 不好意思，您是说八号门还是十八号门？
transfer: 没有听清预约姓氏时客气地请对方再说一遍。
transferEn: Politely request repetition of a surname on a booking.

senseEn: something given as a present
en: Could you wrap this as a gift?
zh: 能帮我把这个包装成礼物吗？
transfer: 询问同学要不要一起送老师一份礼物。
transferEn: Invite a classmate to contribute to a present for a teacher.

senseEn: the direction opposite north
en: The ferry terminal is south of the market.
zh: 渡轮码头在市场南边。
transfer: 告诉同伴营地在湖的南岸。
transferEn: Locate a campsite on the southern shore of a lake.

senseEn: a head covering
en: Is this hat washable?
zh: 这顶帽子能洗吗？
transfer: 请前台帮你找落在大厅的草帽。
transferEn: Ask reception about a straw head covering left in the lobby.

senseEn: for the benefit of something
en: For the sake of clarity, let's label each box.
zh: 为了清楚起见，我们给每个箱子贴上标签吧。
transfer: 向队友说明为了安全要推迟出发。
transferEn: Explain to teammates that safety justifies postponing departure.

senseEn: an affectionate form of address for a loved one
en: Sweetheart, your gloves are on the radiator.
zh: 亲爱的，你的手套在暖气片上。
transfer: 早晨用亲昵称呼提醒伴侣带午饭。
