transfer: 询问老师下次考试包括哪些单元。
transferEn: Ask a teacher which course sections are included in a test.

senseEn: the passage behind the mouth
en: My throat feels dry after the long talk.
zh: 长时间讲话后我的嗓子很干。
transfer: 向护士说明吞咽时喉咙疼。
transferEn: Describe pain at the back of your mouth when swallowing.

senseEn: an inland body of water
en: Can we walk all the way around the lake?
zh: 我们能沿湖走一整圈吗？
transfer: 问向导哪座湖能坐船游览。
transferEn: Find out which inland body of water offers boat trips.

senseEn: adds a second negative alternative
en: Neither the tickets nor the receipt were in the envelope.
zh: 信封里既没有票，也没有收据。
transfer: 说明两个入口都不能通到电梯。
transferEn: Explain that neither entrance provides access to a lift.

senseEn: the person directing a film or play
en: Did the director change the ending for the stage version?
zh: 导演为舞台版改了结尾吗？
transfer: 问剧团谁是新剧的导演。
transferEn: Ask a theater company who is directing its new production.

senseEn: sincerely or genuinely
en: I truly appreciate your patience with the repair.
zh: 你耐心等着修理，我真心感谢。
transfer: 跟老师表达你真心喜欢这次合奏。
transferEn: Tell a teacher you genuinely enjoyed playing in the ensemble.

senseEn: especially clever or impressive
en: Using the old drawers as planters was a brilliant idea.
zh: 拿旧抽屉当花盆，这主意太妙了。
transfer: 称赞队友想出的省力搬箱子的方法。
transferEn: Praise a teammate's ingenious method for moving boxes.

senseEn: a taxi
en: Can you call a cab for five thirty?
zh: 能帮我叫一辆五点半的出租车吗？
transfer: 问朋友从码头打车到机场要多久。
transferEn: Find out how long a taxi trip from harbor to airport takes.

senseEn: small sweet treats, especially in American English
en: Is this candy made with nuts?
zh: 这种糖果是用坚果做的吗？
transfer: 在糖果店询问有没有独立包装的糖果。
transferEn: Ask for individually wrapped sweets in a shop.

senseEn: lower in professional rank or experience
en: Does the junior designer have a mentor?
zh: 这位初级设计师有导师吗？
transfer: 向招聘人员询问这个初级职位需要几年经验。
transferEn: Ask a recruiter about experience requirements for an entry-level post.

senseEn: a small sewn compartment in clothing
en: Does the jacket have an inside pocket?
zh: 这件夹克有内袋吗？
transfer: 告诉裁缝裤子右侧口袋破了。
transferEn: Show a tailor a tear in the right compartment of your trousers.

senseEn: relating to law
en: Where can tenants get legal advice about a lease?
zh: 租客可以去哪儿咨询租约方面的法律问题？
transfer: 问接待员法律援助讲座在哪间教室。
transferEn: Locate the classroom for a talk about assistance with law-related problems.

senseEn: having knowledge of a fact
en: Are the drivers aware of the new entrance?
zh: 司机们知道新入口的事了吗？
transfer: 确认室友是否知道周五会停水。
transferEn: Check a roommate's awareness of a Friday water shutdown.

senseEn: the covering on top of a building
en: Does the roof leak above this window?
zh: 这扇窗上方的屋顶漏雨吗？
transfer: 问房东屋顶维修何时结束。
transferEn: Ask when repairs to the building's top covering will end.

sense: 亲爱的，亲密伴侣间的称呼
senseEn: a very informal affectionate name for a partner
en: Babe, your keys are still on the table.
zh: 亲爱的，你的钥匙还在桌上。
transfer: 用亲密语气提醒伴侣出门带围巾。
transferEn: Affectionately remind your partner to take a scarf.

senseEn: a system detecting objects or weather with radio waves
en: Does the weather radar show rain near the lake?
zh: 天气雷达上看得到湖边有雨吗？
transfer: 请向导看雷达图确认雨带往哪边移动。
transferEn: Ask a guide to check storm movement on a weather tracking display.

senseEn: a duty someone is accountable for
en: Is locking the gate my responsibility tonight?
zh: 今晚锁门是我的职责吗？
transfer: 向主管确认检查设备是否归你负责。
transferEn: Clarify whether equipment inspection is your assigned duty.

senseEn: a high natural elevation of land
en: Is the mountain trail marked above the tree line?
zh: 山路在林线以上有路标吗？
transfer: 问导游远处那座雪山叫什么。
transferEn: Ask a guide to name a distant snow-covered peak.

senseEn: the supporting bottom of an object
en: The lamp's base is cracked, but the bulb still works.
zh: 灯的底座裂了，但灯泡还能亮。
transfer: 请店员检查台扇底座是否稳固。
transferEn: Ask a clerk to check the stability of a desk fan's support.

senseEn: something belonging to the speaker's group
en: That tent by the birch is ours.
zh: 白桦树旁那顶帐篷是我们的。
transfer: 在前台确认蓝色箱子是你们的。
transferEn: Claim the blue case for your group at reception.

senseEn: resistant to pressure without being rigid
en: Can I try a firm mattress before ordering?
zh: 我下单前可以试一下偏硬的床垫吗？
transfer: 向旅馆询问有没有偏硬的枕头。
transferEn: Request a pillow with more resistance from a hotel.

senseEn: a person asked about as the object of a verb or preposition
en: To whom should I address the invitation?
zh: 邀请函应写给谁？
transfer: 正式询问设备故障应向谁报告。
transferEn: Formally ask who should receive a report about faulty equipment.

senseEn: give one item in exchange for another
en: Would you trade seats so we can sit together?
zh: 你愿意换个位子，让我们坐一起吗？
transfer: 问朋友愿不愿用一张重复的明信片交换你的。
transferEn: Propose exchanging duplicate postcards with a friend.

senseEn: expressing love or suited to a couple
en: Is the terrace quiet enough for a romantic dinner?
zh: 露台够安静，适合吃浪漫晚餐吗？
transfer: 请花艺师推荐浪漫的周年纪念花束。
transferEn: Ask a florist for flowers suited to a couple's anniversary.

senseEn: someone accused of deliberately saying something untrue
en: Calling her a liar won't help us check the receipt.
zh: 直接说她撒谎无助于我们核实收据。
transfer: 建议同事先查交接记录，再判断是否有人撒谎。
transferEn: Suggest checking handover records before accusing someone of dishonesty.

senseEn: a device moving air with rotating blades
en: Could we turn the fan away from the papers?
zh: 能把风扇转开，别吹到文件吗？
transfer: 问店员这台风扇能否调节转速。
transferEn: Check whether a device for circulating air has adjustable speed.

senseEn: organized instruction for a skill or role
en: Is the safety training paid time?
zh: 参加安全培训的时间计薪吗？
transfer: 询问新员工培训在哪个楼层举行。
transferEn: Locate the floor for new employees' instruction session.

senseEn: having substantial capacity or strength
en: Is this pump powerful enough for two tanks?
zh: 这台泵的功率够带动两个水箱吗？
transfer: 问店员小吸尘器能否有足够吸力清理地毯。
transferEn: Check whether a small vacuum has enough suction for a rug.

senseEn: on every occasion that
en: The kettle clicks whenever the water boils.
zh: 每当水烧开，水壶就会咔嗒一声。
transfer: 描述自动门每次开合都会发出的声音。
transferEn: Describe a sound repeated each time an automatic door opens.

senseEn: a system of words used for communication
en: Which language is the tour conducted in?
zh: 这场导览用哪种语言？
transfer: 问学校报名表可用哪种语言填写。
transferEn: Check which tongue a school accepts on its registration form.

senseEn: the reason something is done
en: What's the purpose of the second inspection?
zh: 第二次检查的目的是什么？
transfer: 问老师这个写作练习的目的。
transferEn: Ask a teacher what a writing exercise is intended to achieve.

senseEn: express good wishes after a sneeze
en: I heard you sneeze. Bless you!
zh: 我听见你打喷嚏了。保重！
transfer: 同桌打喷嚏时用英语说句礼貌的祝语。
transferEn: Offer the conventional polite response when a lunch companion sneezes.

senseEn: a casual negative reply
en: Nope, that key belongs to the shed.
zh: 不是，那把钥匙是工具棚的。
transfer: 熟人问你是不是今天值班，用轻松语气否认。
transferEn: Casually deny being on duty when a friend asks.

senseEn: unwanted or noticeable sound
en: Does the noise stop when the fan is off?
zh: 风扇关掉后噪声会消失吗？
transfer: 跟邻居说明昨晚吵醒你的是什么声音。
transferEn: Describe to a neighbor the sound that woke you last night.

sense: 糟透了，随意且粗鲁的评价
senseEn: a rude informal way to say something is very bad
en: Saying “the seats suck” sounds rude; tell the clerk they hurt your back.
zh: 说“这座位烂透了”很粗鲁，告诉店员坐着腰疼就好。
transfer: 把朋友对服务的粗鲁评价改成具体反馈。
transferEn: Rewrite a friend's rude dismissal of the service as specific feedback.

senseEn: feel like having something in British informal speech
en: Do you fancy a coffee before the train?
zh: 上火车前想喝杯咖啡吗？
transfer: 用英式口语约熟人一起吃冰淇淋。
transferEn: Casually invite a friend for ice cream in British English.

senseEn: causing eager enthusiasm
en: The most exciting part was watching the chicks hatch.
zh: 最让人激动的是看小鸡破壳。
transfer: 向朋友描述夜游途中最刺激的一个瞬间。
transferEn: Describe the most thrilling moment on a night tour.

senseEn: a person with exceptional ability
en: The restorer was a genius at matching old paint colors.
zh: 这位修复师是调配旧漆颜色的天才。
transfer: 称赞朋友特别擅长把废料变成家具。
transferEn: Praise a friend's exceptional gift for turning scraps into furniture.

senseEn: help people meet for the first time
en: Could you introduce me to the stage manager?
zh: 能介绍我认识舞台监督吗？
transfer: 请邻居把你介绍给负责花园的人。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor to connect you with the person in charge of the garden.

senseEn: payment for occupying a property
en: Does the rent include hot water?
zh: 房租包括热水费吗？
transfer: 向房东确认房租什么时候交。
transferEn: Confirm the payment date for your accommodation with a landlord.

senseEn: recognized from previous experience
en: That logo looks familiar to me; was it on the old tickets?
zh: 我觉得那个标志很眼熟，旧票上是不是有？
transfer: 告诉同伴你对回车站的路很熟。
transferEn: Let a companion know you recognize the way back to the station.

senseEn: relating to offenses against the law
en: Is this lecture about criminal law or contract law?
zh: 这场讲座讲刑法还是合同法？
transfer: 问档案馆刑事案件的记录在哪里查。
transferEn: Ask an archive where it keeps records of prosecutions.

senseEn: evidence establishing a claim
en: Will a utility bill count as proof of address?
zh: 水电账单可以作为住址证明吗？
transfer: 问售后服务人员哪些文件能作为购买证明。
transferEn: Check what paperwork establishes that an item was purchased.

senseEn: express a choice in a formal decision
en: Can members vote online for the new chair?
zh: 会员可以在线投票选新主席吗？
transfer: 询问委员会何时投票决定预算。
transferEn: Ask when the committee will ballot on its budget.

senseEn: identify something previously encountered
en: Do you recognize the handwriting on this label?
zh: 你认得这个标签上的笔迹吗？
transfer: 问邻居能不能认出照片里的老房子。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor to identify a familiar house in a photograph.

senseEn: the act of intentionally ending one's own life
en: The library is hosting a suicide prevention talk for families.
zh: 图书馆将为家庭举办一场预防自杀的讲座。
transfer: 询问主办方预防自杀讲座是否为照护者留有提问时间。
transferEn: Ask whether caregivers can ask questions at a prevention talk about intentional self-inflicted death.

senseEn: outdoor atmospheric conditions
en: Will the weather stay dry for the walk?
zh: 散步时天气能一直保持干燥吗？
transfer: 问导游山上天气会不会比镇上冷。
transferEn: Check how the conditions on the mountain compare with town.

senseEn: a substance used to treat illness
en: Should I bring my medicine bottles to the appointment?
zh: 就诊时要带上我的药瓶吗？
transfer: 向药师确认哪种药需要冷藏。
transferEn: Ask a pharmacist which medication needs refrigeration.

senseEn: a platform carrying people between floors
en: Is there a lift to the platforms?
zh: 有到站台的电梯吗？
transfer: 询问旅馆电梯是否能容下轮椅。
transferEn: Check whether a hotel's elevator accommodates a wheelchair.

senseEn: a matter needing attention
en: There's an issue with the delivery address on this order.
zh: 这笔订单的收货地址有问题。
transfer: 向技术支持说明票据打印过程中遇到的问题。
transferEn: Describe a difficulty printing tickets to technical support.

senseEn: a person's current emotional state
en: The music put me in a better mood.
zh: 这段音乐让我心情好多了。
transfer: 向朋友解释散步后心情有什么变化。
transferEn: Describe how a walk changed your emotional state.

senseEn: of the sex that produces sperm
en: How can we tell the male bird from the female?
zh: 怎么区分雄鸟和雌鸟？
transfer: 请农场主指出哪只山羊是公的。
transferEn: Ask a farmer to identify the buck among the goats.

senseEn: surrounded by or included in a group
en: Look among the maps for the bus timetable.
zh: 在那堆地图里找找公交时刻表。
transfer: 告诉同伴你把钥匙放在一堆工具中间了。
transferEn: Locate a set of keys in a group of tools.

senseEn: a device displaying broadcast programs
en: Can the television show subtitles?
zh: 这台电视机能显示字幕吗？
transfer: 问前台房间电视能不能调节音量上限。
transferEn: Check if the room's TV has an adjustable volume limit.

senseEn: following a customary schedule
en: Is this our regular meeting time now?
zh: 这以后就是我们固定的开会时间了吗？
transfer: 问店员周一是否恢复平时的营业时间。
transferEn: Check whether normal opening hours resume on Monday.

senseEn: at an unspecified future time
en: I'd like to return someday with my children.
zh: 我想将来有一天带孩子们再来。
transfer: 向朋友表达你将来有一天想开面包店。
transferEn: Share a future wish to open a bakery without naming a date.

senseEn: the part of the body associated with digestion
en: Does your stomach hurt before or after meals?
zh: 你是饭前还是饭后胃疼？
transfer: 向医生说明坐船时胃不舒服。
transferEn: Describe digestive discomfort on boat trips to a doctor.

senseEn: the color of a ripe lemon
en: Is the yellow tag the sale price?
zh: 黄色标签标的是特价吗？
transfer: 告诉队友你把黄色水瓶落在场边了。
transferEn: Describe the lemon-colored bottle left beside the field.

senseEn: a local administrative region
en: Which county office handles building records?
zh: 哪个县办事处保管建筑档案？
transfer: 问馆员这张旧地图画的是哪个县。
transferEn: Ask a librarian which local jurisdiction an old map depicts.

senseEn: almost but not quite
en: We've been waiting nearly an hour.
zh: 我们等了快一个小时了。
transfer: 告诉家人水壶快装满了。
transferEn: Tell a family member that a kettle is almost full.

senseEn: a casual term for one dollar
en: It's a buck extra for oat milk.
zh: 换燕麦奶要多一美元。
transfer: 跟朋友估算停车一小时要几美元。
transferEn: Casually estimate the cost of an hour's parking in dollars.

senseEn: cause fear
en: Please don't scare the kitten with the vacuum.
zh: 请别用吸尘器吓到小猫。
transfer: 告诉朋友你突然出现可能会吓到孩子。
transferEn: Warn that appearing unexpectedly could frighten a child.

senseEn: a small settlement outside a town
en: Can we buy bread in the village before hiking?
zh: 徒步前我们能在村里买面包吗？
transfer: 问导游下一个村庄还有多远。
transferEn: Ask a guide about the distance to the next small settlement.

senseEn: get something ready for later use
en: Could you prepare the room for twelve guests?
zh: 能为十二位客人准备一下房间吗？
transfer: 请同事提前准备几份登记表。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to get registration forms ready in advance.

senseEn: a baked flat base with toppings
en: Can we order one pizza with two different toppings?
zh: 我们能订一张比萨，两半选不同配料吗？
transfer: 问餐厅最小的比萨够几个人吃。
transferEn: Check how many people the smallest pie with toppings serves.

senseEn: a primate such as a macaque
en: Is the monkey exhibit open during feeding time?
zh: 喂食时猴子展区开放吗？
transfer: 请导游指出树梢上的猴子属于哪种。
transferEn: Ask a guide to identify the primate in the treetops.

senseEn: happening abruptly and unexpectedly
en: A sudden shower sent us back to the café.
zh: 一场突如其来的阵雨把我们赶回了咖啡馆。
transfer: 描述发车前突然更换站台的情况。
transferEn: Describe an abrupt platform change before departure.

senseEn: accept something without checking it first
en: Don't assume the door locks when it closes.
zh: 别想当然地认为关门就会自动上锁。
transfer: 提醒队友不要未经确认就认为场地免费。
transferEn: Warn teammates not to take free use of a venue for granted.

senseEn: bread browned by heat
en: Could I have my toast without butter?
zh: 我的吐司可以不抹黄油吗？
transfer: 问服务员烤面包旁配的是哪种果酱。
transferEn: Ask which jam accompanies the browned bread.

senseEn: a casual term for a man
en: The fella by the gate found your cap.
zh: 门边那个小伙子捡到了你的帽子。
transfer: 随口向朋友指出帮你推车的那位男士。
transferEn: Informally identify the man who helped push your cart.

senseEn: a short outer garment
en: Is this jacket waterproof at the seams?
zh: 这件夹克的接缝防水吗？
transfer: 请裁缝看看夹克拉链能否修复。
transferEn: Ask a tailor about repairing the zipper on a short coat.

senseEn: a marked strip of road for vehicles
en: Use the left lane for the ferry entrance.
zh: 去渡轮入口走左车道。
transfer: 问司机哪条车道是公交专用。
transferEn: Ask a driver which marked roadway strip is for buses only.

senseEn: involving interaction with other people
en: Is the social event open to new members?
zh: 这场社交活动对新会员开放吗？
transfer: 问组织者讲座之后有没有社交活动。
transferEn: Check whether guests can mingle at an event after a lecture.

senseEn: go from one place to another
en: Can we travel by rail the whole way?
zh: 我们全程可以坐火车吗？
transfer: 跟朋友说你更喜欢在淡季旅行。
transferEn: Explain a preference for taking trips outside peak season.

senseEn: at an unspecified time
en: Could you stop by sometime after lunch?
zh: 午饭后你能找个时间来一趟吗？
transfer: 约朋友下周找个时间看展。
transferEn: Propose seeing an exhibition at an unspecified time next week.

senseEn: land or buildings owned by someone
en: Does the property include the shed across the lane?
zh: 这处房产包括小巷对面的棚屋吗？
transfer: 问中介房产的边界在哪里。
transferEn: Ask an agent about the boundaries of a piece of real estate.

senseEn: the weekday after Sunday
en: Can the plumber come on Monday morning?
zh: 水管工星期一上午能来吗？
transfer: 提醒同事星期一之前要归还门卡。
transferEn: Remind a colleague to return a pass before the weekday following Sunday.

senseEn: continue in a particular state
en: Please remain seated until the ferry docks.
zh: 渡轮靠岸前请保持就座。
transfer: 请观众在灯亮前保持安静。
transferEn: Ask an audience to stay quiet until the lights come on.

senseEn: a person managing correspondence and arrangements
en: The club secretary sent the revised minutes.
zh: 俱乐部秘书发出了修订后的会议记录。
transfer: 问系秘书哪里可以预约会议室。
transferEn: Ask a department administrator where to book a meeting room.

en: Could you cover my shift so I can attend the funeral?
zh: 你能替我值班，让我去参加葬礼吗？
transfer: 向亲友确认葬礼在哪座教堂举行。
senseEn: a service honoring someone who has died
transferEn: Confirm with relatives which church will host the service.

senseEn: relating to sex or sexuality
en: Does the clinic offer confidential sexual health appointments?
zh: 诊所提供保密的性健康问诊吗？
transfer: 询问校园诊所哪里可以领取性健康资料。
transferEn: Locate materials about reproductive and intimate health at a campus clinic.

senseEn: a periodical publication containing articles
en: Can I borrow this travel magazine overnight?
zh: 我可以借这本旅游杂志一晚吗？
transfer: 问报摊新一期摄影杂志到了没有。
transferEn: Check a newsstand for the latest photography periodical.

senseEn: a member of a senate
en: Will the senator attend the town meeting?
zh: 那位参议员会参加镇民大会吗？
transfer: 问接待员应把写给参议员的信交给谁。
transferEn: Ask reception who receives letters for a member of the senate.

senseEn: an insulting informal term for an inconsiderate person
en: Calling the neighbor a jerk won't solve the parking dispute.
zh: 骂邻居讨厌鬼解决不了停车纠纷。
transfer: 建议朋友把留言里的人身攻击改成对停车行为的描述。
transferEn: Suggest replacing a personal insult with a description of the parking behavior.

senseEn: systematic investigation of a question
en: Can the public read your research on the marsh birds?
zh: 公众能读到你们关于湿地鸟类的研究吗？
transfer: 问导师关于老市场的研究用到了哪些档案。
transferEn: Ask a supervisor which archives informed a study of the old market.

senseEn: the ability to act or choose independently
en: Do volunteers have the freedom to choose their shifts?
zh: 志愿者可以自由选择值班时间吗？
transfer: 询问学生能否自由选择项目主题。
transferEn: Check whether students can choose their own project topics.

senseEn: put something in with what is already there
en: Should I add the herbs before or after baking?
zh: 香草该在烘烤前加还是烤完加？
transfer: 请同事把新联系人加到参会名单。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to include a new contact on a guest list.

senseEn: harm to an object's condition
en: Does the receipt mention the damage to the frame?
zh: 收据上注明了画框的损坏情况吗？
transfer: 向送货员指出柜门的损坏处。
transferEn: Show a courier the harm done to a cabinet door.

senseEn: say or do something again
en: Could you repeat the platform number more slowly?
zh: 能慢点再说一遍站台号码吗？
transfer: 请老师重复最后一句指令。
transferEn: Ask a teacher to say the final instruction again.

senseEn: attractive in appearance, often describing a man
en: Who's the handsome man beside Grandma in the photo?
zh: 照片里奶奶旁边那位英俊的男士是谁？
transfer: 称赞朋友婚礼照片中的新郎很英俊。
transferEn: Compliment the groom's appearance in a friend's wedding photo.

senseEn: like one option better than another
en: Do you prefer a booth or a table by the window?
zh: 你比较喜欢卡座还是靠窗的桌子？
transfer: 问同伴更愿意乘船还是坐火车。
transferEn: Find out a companion's preference between a ferry and a train.

senseEn: an organization sharing a particular interest
en: Does the historical society hold public tours?
zh: 历史协会举办面向公众的导览吗？
transfer: 询问摄影协会的入会条件。
transferEn: Ask about membership requirements for a photography association.

senseEn: capacity for physical or mental activity
en: Do you have enough energy for the walk back?
zh: 你还有力气走回去吗？
transfer: 告诉朋友睡一晚后你恢复了精力。
transferEn: Tell a friend a night's sleep restored your vitality.

senseEn: a narrow split in a surface
en: Has that crack in the ceiling grown since yesterday?
zh: 天花板上那条裂缝比昨天大了吗？
transfer: 向店家指出新花瓶底部的裂纹。
transferEn: Show a shopkeeper a split in the base of a new vase.

senseEn: time away from work for rest or travel
en: Can I take my vacation in September?
zh: 我可以九月份休假吗？
transfer: 询问邻居度假期间需要你照看什么。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor what needs attention while they are away on holiday.

senseEn: run after something moving away
en: Don't chase the ball into the road.
zh: 别追着球跑到马路上。
transfer: 在公园提醒孩子不要追赶鸭子。
transferEn: Ask a child not to run after ducks in the park.

senseEn: the legal ending of a marriage
en: After their divorce, they shared care of the dog.
zh: 离婚后，他们共同照顾这只狗。
transfer: 读小说时介绍人物离婚后的居住安排。
transferEn: Describe a character's living arrangements after their marriage ended.

senseEn: a person who actively supports a cause
en: The caretaker was an ally in getting the ramp repaired.
zh: 管理员支持我们修好坡道。
transfer: 向团队介绍支持图书馆延长开放时间的朋友。
transferEn: Introduce a supporter of longer library hours to your group.

senseEn: play intended to prevent a team from scoring
en: Our defense held until the final minute.
zh: 我们的防守一直撑到最后一分钟。
transfer: 问教练下次训练怎么加强防守。
transferEn: Ask a coach about improving the team's defensive play.

senseEn: a large rodent with a long tail
en: Did you see a rat near the compost bin?
zh: 你看到堆肥箱附近有老鼠吗？
transfer: 向管理员报告库房角落发现了一只大鼠。
transferEn: Report a large rodent in a storeroom corner to an attendant.

senseEn: an informal name for a grandfather
en: Grandpa, your glasses are inside the newspaper.
zh: 爷爷，你的眼镜夹在报纸里。
transfer: 请外公给你讲讲旧码头的故事。
transferEn: Ask your grandfather to tell you about the old pier.

senseEn: a mild exclamation of surprise
en: Goodness, the tide came in fast!
zh: 天哪，潮水涨得真快！
transfer: 朋友展示一大摞旧明信片时轻声表示惊讶。
transferEn: React with mild surprise to a large stack of old postcards.

senseEn: make information publicly available
en: Could you post the timetable on the noticeboard?
zh: 能把时刻表贴到公告栏上吗？
transfer: 请组织者把领票地点发到活动网页。
transferEn: Ask organizers to publish the pickup location on the event site.

senseEn: unable to understand clearly
en: I'm confused by the two different check-in times.
zh: 两个不同的签到时间让我有点糊涂。
transfer: 向老师解释图上的两种颜色让你犯迷糊。
transferEn: Tell a teacher why two colors on a diagram are puzzling.

senseEn: introduces unwelcome information
en: Unfortunately, the pool is closed for repairs.
zh: 很遗憾，泳池因维修关闭了。
transfer: 委婉告诉来宾晚场座位已订满。
transferEn: Introduce the unwelcome news that the evening show is fully booked.

senseEn: equipment for speaking to someone at a distance
en: Is there a telephone in the lobby for local calls?
zh: 大厅里有可以打本地电话的座机吗？
transfer: 问旅馆房间里的电话能不能打外线。
transferEn: Check whether the room's handset can dial outside numbers.

en: Who's taking Dad home after surgery?
zh: 谁在爸爸手术后接他回家？
transfer: 请假时告诉主管你的手术定在哪一天。
senseEn: a medical operation
transferEn: Ask your supervisor for leave and give the date of your operation.

senseEn: a formal agreement between parties
en: Does the contract include weekend repairs?
zh: 合同包含周末维修吗？
transfer: 询问演出合同什么时候寄来签字。
transferEn: Ask when the agreement for a performance will arrive for signature.

senseEn: a condition of being protected from harm
en: Who's running the safety briefing before the tour?
zh: 参观前的安全说明由谁主持？
transfer: 问活动组织者哪里领取安全须知。
transferEn: Ask where participants receive instructions for avoiding harm.

senseEn: having substantial height
en: Is the bookcase too tall for this corner?
zh: 这个书架放在这角落是不是太高了？
transfer: 告诉店员你需要一盏更高的落地灯。
transferEn: Request a floor lamp with greater height.

senseEn: someone trained and working in a field
en: Should we ask a professional to inspect the roof?
zh: 我们要不要请专业人士检查屋顶？
transfer: 建议找专业人士修复老照片。
transferEn: Suggest getting expert help to restore an old photograph.

senseEn: a period of instruction
en: Does the first lesson include equipment hire?
zh: 第一节课的费用包括租设备吗？
transfer: 向老师确认下次钢琴课的时间。
transferEn: Confirm the timing of the next piano session with a teacher.

senseEn: very small
en: There's a tiny scratch on the lens.
zh: 镜头上有道很小的划痕。
transfer: 提醒同伴零件非常小，容易掉。
transferEn: Warn a companion that a component is extremely small and easily dropped.

senseEn: someone who helps another person with work
en: The gallery assistant unlocked the side room.
zh: 画廊助理打开了侧厅。
transfer: 询问研究助理在哪里领取访客证。
transferEn: Ask where a research aide can collect a visitor pass.

senseEn: preserve by turning very cold
en: Can I freeze the leftover sauce in this jar?
zh: 剩下的酱汁能装在这罐子里冷冻吗？
transfer: 问面包师新鲜面包能不能冷冻留到下周。
transferEn: Check with a baker about storing a loaf below freezing until next week.

senseEn: an official permit for an activity
en: Do you need to see my driver's license?
zh: 需要看我的驾照吗？
transfer: 租船前询问是否需要出示驾驶船只的执照。
transferEn: Before renting a boat, check whether an operator's permit is required.

senseEn: a particular version of a product
en: Which model fits this charger?
zh: 哪种型号适配这个充电器？
transfer: 向维修员说明洗衣机的型号。
transferEn: Identify your washing machine's version for a repair worker.

senseEn: a movable barrier at an entrance
en: The garden gate opens at sunrise.
zh: 花园大门日出时打开。
transfer: 问快递员包裹放在哪扇门旁。
transferEn: Ask a courier which entrance barrier the parcel is beside.

senseEn: yielding gently to pressure
en: Is the lining soft enough for a baby's blanket?
zh: 这层衬布用来做婴儿毯够软吗？
transfer: 请店员推荐软一些的靠垫。
transferEn: Request a cushion that yields more comfortably to pressure.

senseEn: the organ used for hearing
en: My right ear feels blocked after the flight.
zh: 下飞机后我觉得右耳发堵。
transfer: 向护士说明哪只耳朵听不清楚。
transferEn: Tell a nurse which side has reduced hearing.

senseEn: the people working at an organization
en: Do all staff need new badges this month?
zh: 这个月所有员工都需要换徽章吗？
transfer: 问前台周末是否有人手帮搬行李。
transferEn: Ask reception about weekend employees available to help with luggage.

senseEn: the machine providing power to a vehicle
en: The engine rattles when the car first starts.
zh: 车刚启动时发动机会咔嗒响。
transfer: 告诉修理工引擎在哪个车速时会抖。
transferEn: Describe the speed at which a motor begins vibrating.

senseEn: the language spoken in Germany
en: Is the menu printed in German too?
zh: 菜单也有德语版吗？
transfer: 询问这场讲座有没有德语字幕。
transferEn: Check for captions in the language of Germany during a lecture.

senseEn: a representation of an area
en: Does the map show accessible entrances?
zh: 地图上标了无障碍入口吗？
transfer: 请前台给你一份标有公交站的地图。
transferEn: Request a printed guide showing nearby bus stops.

en: Is it safe to swim here when the tide comes in?
zh: 涨潮时在这里游泳安全吗？
transfer: 报名夏令营时说明孩子还不会游泳。
senseEn: move through water using the body
transferEn: When registering for camp, explain your child's current ability in the water.

senseEn: damage or injury
en: Will this cleaning spray harm the plants?
zh: 这种清洁喷雾会伤害植物吗？
transfer: 询问强光会不会损害展品。
transferEn: Ask whether intense light could damage an exhibit.

senseEn: an open public area in a town
en: Meet me in the market square after the parade.
zh: 游行结束后在集市广场见。
transfer: 问导游中央广场上哪座喷泉是集合点。
transferEn: Identify the meeting fountain in a town's central plaza.

senseEn: a precious pale metal
en: Is the chain made of solid silver?
zh: 这条链子是纯银的吗？
transfer: 请珠宝匠确认手镯是不是银制的。
transferEn: Ask a jeweler to identify the pale precious metal in a bracelet.

senseEn: showing courage in a difficult situation
en: It was brave of you to speak up at the meeting.
zh: 你在会上站出来发言，真勇敢。
transfer: 称赞孩子第一次独自登台时很勇敢。
transferEn: Praise a child's courage in their first solo appearance.

senseEn: the ability to enter or use something
en: Is there wheelchair access to the rooftop garden?
zh: 屋顶花园有轮椅通道吗？
transfer: 询问住客夜里能不能使用洗衣房。
transferEn: Check whether guests may enter the laundry room at night.

senseEn: expressing approval or optimism
en: Did the volunteers give positive feedback about the new route?
zh: 志愿者对新路线的反馈积极吗？
transfer: 向教练转述队员对训练的积极感受。
transferEn: Pass on teammates' favorable responses to a practice session.

senseEn: of the sex that produces eggs
en: The female turtle laid her eggs before dawn.
zh: 那只雌龟在黎明前产下了卵。
transfer: 问向导树上的鹰是雌性还是雄性。
transferEn: Ask a guide about the sex of an eagle in a tree.

senseEn: an unspecified location
en: Let's find someplace quiet to make the call.
zh: 找个安静的地方打这个电话吧。
transfer: 提议找个有遮阴的地方给孩子吃午饭。
transferEn: Suggest a shaded location for a child's lunch.

senseEn: low in strength or intensity
en: The signal is too weak to upload the video.
zh: 信号太弱，视频传不上去。
transfer: 告知前台床头灯的光线很弱。
transferEn: Describe faint light from a bedside lamp to reception.

senseEn: a recurring part of the year with particular conditions
en: When does the rainy season begin here?
zh: 这里雨季什么时候开始？
transfer: 向向导询问哪个季节适合观鲸。
transferEn: Ask a guide about the best time of year for whale watching.

senseEn: move or act in a hurry
en: There's no need to rush to the gate; boarding hasn't started.
zh: 不用赶去登机口，还没开始登机。
transfer: 告诉朋友慢慢吃，下一班车还早。
transferEn: Reassure a friend there is no need to eat hurriedly before the bus.

senseEn: especially impressive in informal speech
en: The view from the upper deck was awesome at sunset.
zh: 日落时上层甲板的景色棒极了。
transfer: 跟朋友夸奖乐队精彩的返场演出。
transferEn: Casually praise a band's impressive encore to a friend.

senseEn: frozen flakes falling from clouds
en: Is there still snow on the upper trail?
zh: 上面的步道上还有积雪吗？
transfer: 问邻居昨晚的雪有没有堵住车道。
transferEn: Check whether last night's snowfall blocked a driveway.

senseEn: the season following winter
en: Do the gardens reopen in spring?
zh: 花园春天会重新开放吗？
transfer: 询问农场春天能采摘哪些蔬菜。
transferEn: Ask a farm about vegetables available during the season after winter.

senseEn: distribute a substance over a surface
en: Spread the butter while the bread is warm.
zh: 趁面包还热，把黄油涂开。
transfer: 请孩子把果酱均匀涂在饼干上。
transferEn: Ask a child to coat a cracker evenly with jam.

senseEn: sparkling wine from Champagne in France
en: Would you like a glass of champagne for the toast?
zh: 祝酒时你想喝杯香槟吗？
transfer: 询问婚礼场地香槟按瓶还是按杯收费。
transferEn: Check how a wedding venue charges for French sparkling wine.

en: Can we ask the mayor when the bridge will reopen?
zh: 我们能问问市长，大桥什么时候恢复通行吗？
transfer: 社区会议上，请市长说明图书馆关闭的原因。
senseEn: the elected leader of a city
transferEn: At a community meeting, ask the city's leader why the library closed.

senseEn: a supernatural evil being
en: Does the demon appear in the last act?
zh: 恶魔在最后一幕出场吗？
transfer: 请演员描述扮演恶魔时用的面具。
transferEn: Ask an actor about a mask worn to portray an evil spirit.

senseEn: the person who wins a contest
en: When will the winner receive the trophy?
zh: 获胜者什么时候领奖杯？
transfer: 问老师哪位学生赢得了摄影比赛。
transferEn: Find out who took first place in a school photography contest.

senseEn: a formal French title for a woman
en: Should I address the letter to Madame Dupont?
zh: 这封信抬头该写杜邦夫人吗？
transfer: 排练法语场景时确认女主人的正式称呼。
transferEn: Check the formal French way to address a hostess in a rehearsal.

en: I burned my tongue on the soup. Could I have some water?
zh: 我喝汤烫了舌头。能给我点水吗？
transfer: 看牙时，告诉医生你的舌头哪一侧疼。
senseEn: the movable organ inside the mouth
transferEn: Tell your dentist which side of the organ inside your mouth hurts.

senseEn: someone directing a group
en: Who's the group leader for tomorrow's hike?
zh: 明天徒步谁带队？
transfer: 向前台询问合唱团的领队是否已签到。
transferEn: Check whether the person in charge of a choir has arrived.

senseEn: authorization to do something
en: Do we need permission to film in the courtyard?
zh: 在庭院拍摄要先获准吗？
transfer: 问房东在墙上钉钉子是否要得到许可。
transferEn: Ask a landlord about authorization for putting nails in a wall.

senseEn: washing one's body in a tub
en: Is there enough hot water for a bath?
zh: 热水够泡个澡吗？
transfer: 向前台询问哪里可以给宝宝洗个盆浴。
transferEn: Check where a guest can bathe a baby in a tub.

sense: 嗯，轻声表示欣赏或满意
senseEn: a soft sound showing pleasure or approval
en: Mm, this soup has just the right amount of ginger.
zh: 嗯，这汤里的姜放得正合适。
transfer: 尝到朋友烤的面包时用轻声赞叹表达喜欢。
transferEn: React appreciatively with a soft sound when tasting a friend's bread.

senseEn: a French title for a man
en: The invitation is addressed to Monsieur Laurent.
zh: 请柬的收件人是洛朗先生。
transfer: 排练法语场景时确认该如何正式称呼男店主。
transferEn: Check the formal French title for a male shopkeeper in a play.

senseEn: a period of violent weather
en: Is the pier closed because of the storm?
zh: 码头是因为暴风雨才关闭的吗？
transfer: 问向导风暴过后哪条步道还能通行。
transferEn: Ask a guide which trail remains open after severe weather.

en: I left a spare key with the neighbor downstairs.
zh: 我把一把备用钥匙留给了楼下邻居。
transfer: 骑车出游前问队友有没有备用内胎。
senseEn: kept in reserve for later use
transferEn: Before cycling, ask if a teammate has an extra inner tube.

senseEn: a guided visit around a place
en: Does the factory tour include the old workshop?
zh: 工厂导览会去旧车间吗？
transfer: 在前台报名参加下午的博物馆导览。
transferEn: Sign up at reception for a guided museum visit in the afternoon.

senseEn: an arrangement to meet at a particular time
en: Can I move my appointment to Thursday?
zh: 我的预约能改到星期四吗？
transfer: 告诉接待员你约了三点修眼镜。
transferEn: Tell reception about a three o'clock booking for glasses repair.

senseEn: the points achieved in a game
en: What's the score after the second set?
zh: 第二盘结束后比分是多少？
transfer: 问朋友半场休息时比分多少。
transferEn: Ask a friend how many points each team had at halftime.

senseEn: one item worn on a foot
en: The left shoe rubs against my heel.
zh: 左鞋磨我的脚跟。
transfer: 请鞋匠检查右鞋的鞋底。
transferEn: Ask a cobbler to inspect the sole on the right side.

senseEn: a major expanse of salt water
en: Can we see the ocean from the lighthouse?
zh: 从灯塔能看到大海吗？
transfer: 问导游河里的水最终流入哪个大洋。
transferEn: Ask which major body of salt water a river ultimately reaches.

senseEn: the actual situation
en: In reality, the walk takes twice as long uphill.
zh: 实际上，上坡走这段路要花两倍时间。
transfer: 说明样板房里的空间和实际房间有何差别。
transferEn: Contrast a showroom impression with the actual space in an apartment.

senseEn: the outline or form of an object
en: What shape is the socket on the back?
zh: 背面的插孔是什么形状？
transfer: 描述丢失胸针的形状帮店员辨认。
transferEn: Describe the outline of a lost brooch to identify it.

senseEn: remain alive despite difficult conditions
en: Will this lemon tree survive the winter outdoors?
zh: 这棵柠檬树能在室外过冬吗？
transfer: 问园丁幼苗在阴凉处能不能活下来。
transferEn: Ask a gardener whether seedlings can live in shade.

senseEn: a casual name for a group of friends
en: Is the whole gang coming to the picnic?
zh: 咱们这帮人都会来野餐吗？
transfer: 跟朋友确认老伙伴们是否都要去聚餐。
transferEn: Check casually whether all your usual companions are coming to dinner.

senseEn: a nonstandard conversational spelling of because
en: The lyric says “cos I'm tired”; use standard spelling in the email.
zh: 歌词里把“因为我累了”的“因为”写成了口语形式，邮件里要用标准拼写。
transfer: 帮朋友解释聊天记录里表示原因的口语拼写。
transferEn: Explain a casual written form introducing a reason in a friend's chat.

senseEn: a particular design or appearance
en: Does this style come with a longer strap?
zh: 这款有长一点的背带吗？
transfer: 问店员这件外套还有没有相同款式的衣服。
transferEn: Check for another coat with the same design.

senseEn: land used for growing crops or raising animals
en: Can visitors help pick apples on the farm?
zh: 游客可以在农场帮忙摘苹果吗？
transfer: 询问农场主人何时开始喂羊。
transferEn: Ask the owner of an agricultural property about feeding time for sheep.

senseEn: in a way that is easy to perceive
en: Can you hear me clearly through this microphone?
zh: 通过这个麦克风能听清我说话吗？
transfer: 告诉同伴你从后排也能清楚地看到字幕。
transferEn: Describe how legible the captions are from the back row.

senseEn: sexually attractive in appearance or manner
en: The costume brief says “sexy and glamorous”; is that the look you want?
zh: 服装说明写的是“性感华丽”，这是你们想要的造型吗？
transfer: 在成人舞台造型会议上确认设计师想表达的是性感还是典雅。
transferEn: Clarify whether an adult stage costume is meant to look sensual or elegant.

senseEn: an instance illustrating a point
en: Could you give an example of a refundable fee?
zh: 能举个可以退还的费用的例子吗？
transfer: 请老师举例说明什么是直接引语。
transferEn: Ask a teacher for an illustration of direct quotation.

senseEn: a mild exclamation of surprise
en: Gosh, the hall looks bigger without the seats!
zh: 天哪，撤掉座椅后大厅显得好大！
transfer: 看到朋友完成的巨大拼图时表达惊叹。
transferEn: React with mild surprise to a friend's enormous finished puzzle.

senseEn: a device or signal that wakes someone
en: Set an alarm for six so we can catch the ferry.
zh: 定个六点的闹钟，我们好赶渡轮。
transfer: 请室友确认明天的闹钟是否设好了。
transferEn: Ask a roommate to check tomorrow's wake-up signal.

senseEn: a plan listing activities and times
en: Has the rehearsal schedule changed since Friday?
zh: 排练日程从周五以来改过吗？
transfer: 问老师怎样查看最新的考试安排。
transferEn: Find out how to see the latest exam timetable.

senseEn: a very large sum of money
en: Replacing that window would cost a fortune.
zh: 换那扇窗得花一大笔钱。
transfer: 跟朋友感叹临时买节日机票很贵。
transferEn: Describe the enormous cost of a last-minute holiday flight.

senseEn: go inside a place
en: May we enter the garden through the kitchen door?
zh: 我们能从厨房门进花园吗？
transfer: 询问轮椅使用者可以从哪扇门进入礼堂。
transferEn: Identify the hall entrance accessible to wheelchair users.

senseEn: loss of blood from the body
en: Has the bleeding stopped since the nurse bandaged it?
zh: 护士包扎之后血止住了吗？
transfer: 向护士说明你的鼻子是什么时候开始流血的。
transferEn: Tell a nurse when a nosebleed started.

senseEn: a mixed drink served in a large bowl
en: Is the fruit punch alcohol-free?
zh: 这碗水果混合饮料不含酒精吗？
transfer: 为夏日聚会询问一碗水果饮料可供几杯。
transferEn: Check how many servings a bowl of mixed fruit drink provides for a party.

senseEn: ask someone to attend
en: Can we invite the neighbors to the garden opening?
zh: 我们能请邻居来参加花园开放活动吗？
transfer: 请孩子挑一位朋友来参加生日聚会。
transferEn: Ask a child to choose a friend to welcome to a birthday party.

senseEn: easy to see or understand
en: Is the entrance obvious from the main road?
zh: 从大路上能一眼看到入口吗？
transfer: 向设计师指出两种票的区别不够明显。
transferEn: Explain to a designer that two ticket types are hard to distinguish.

senseEn: a meeting to assess a job applicant
en: Is the interview online or at the office?
zh: 面试是线上进行还是到办公室？
transfer: 询问招聘人面试会持续多久。
transferEn: Ask a recruiter how long the meeting with applicants will last.

senseEn: a romantic relationship outside a marriage
en: Is the novel about an affair or a misunderstanding?
zh: 这部小说讲的是婚外情还是一场误会？
transfer: 在读书会上讨论人物何时发现配偶的婚外情。
transferEn: Discuss when a character discovers a spouse's secret romance.

senseEn: the language widely spoken in Russia
en: Is the film subtitled in Russian?
zh: 这部影片有俄语字幕吗？
transfer: 向馆员询问有无俄语版童话书。
transferEn: Ask a librarian for fairy tales in the language of Russia.

senseEn: in any place that meets a condition
en: Park wherever the signs show a blue P.
zh: 凡是标着蓝色 P 的地方都可以停车。
transfer: 告诉学员哪里有空座就在哪里坐。
transferEn: Tell students to sit in any available spot.

senseEn: very hard to believe
en: It's unbelievable that the letter arrived after forty years.
zh: 那封信过了四十年才寄到，真让人难以置信。
transfer: 向朋友表达你对他们意外找回戒指的惊讶。
transferEn: Express astonishment that a friend unexpectedly recovered a ring.

senseEn: direct one's attention to a task
en: I can't focus on the recording with that fan running.
zh: 风扇开着，我没法专心听录音。
transfer: 请同伴让你安静一会儿，好专心核对数字。
transferEn: Request quiet to concentrate on checking figures.

en: Could you use dark chocolate for the birthday cake?
zh: 生日蛋糕可以用黑巧克力吗？
transfer: 给同事买甜点时询问里面有没有巧克力。
senseEn: a sweet food made from cacao
transferEn: Check a dessert's ingredients for a colleague who wants to avoid cacao products.

senseEn: bring a legal claim against someone
en: Did the tenant sue the landlord over the deposit in that case?
zh: 那个案子里，租客是否因押金问题起诉了房东？
transfer: 问法学老师案例中是哪一方起诉了供应商。
transferEn: Ask a law teacher which party brought a claim against a supplier.

en: Could I borrow your charger until lunch?
zh: 我能借用你的充电器到午饭时间吗？
transfer: 图书馆里询问能借走这本书多久。
senseEn: take temporarily with permission
transferEn: Ask a librarian how long you may keep a particular book.

senseEn: a mark evaluating student work
en: Does the final grade include the group project?
zh: 最终成绩包含小组项目吗？
transfer: 向老师询问怎样查看作文的成绩。
transferEn: Ask a teacher where to see the mark for an essay.

senseEn: a formal written or spoken account
en: Has the venue issued a statement about refunds?
zh: 场馆就退款发表声明了吗？
transfer: 问组织者对活动取消是否有书面声明。
transferEn: Check whether organizers have issued a formal account of a cancellation.

senseEn: a systematic inquiry into what happened
en: Will the investigation report be available to residents?
zh: 居民能看到调查报告吗？
transfer: 询问物业漏水原因的调查有没有结束。
transferEn: Ask building management whether the inquiry into a leak is complete.

senseEn: an informal British term for a friend
en: A mate from work lent me his bicycle.
zh: 一位同事朋友把自行车借给了我。
transfer: 用英式口语介绍常跟你徒步的一位朋友。
transferEn: Use casual British English to introduce a hiking companion.

senseEn: put items into a vehicle
en: Can we load the cases before breakfast?
zh: 能在早饭前把箱子装车吗？
transfer: 请同伴帮忙把帐篷装上拖车。
transferEn: Ask a companion to put tents onto a trailer.

senseEn: a picture created with paint
en: Is the painting by the door for sale?
zh: 门边那幅画出售吗？
transfer: 问画廊哪幅画描绘的是以前的车站。
transferEn: Ask which artwork depicts the old station.

senseEn: a group of people sharing a place
en: Can the local community use the school garden?
zh: 当地社区居民能使用学校的花园吗？
transfer: 请组织者说明社区怎样参与清理河岸。
transferEn: Ask how neighborhood residents can join a riverbank cleanup.

senseEn: a reduction in money or other resources
en: Did the canceled shows cause a financial loss?
zh: 演出取消造成经济损失了吗？
transfer: 跟同事计算停电导致的库存损失。
transferEn: Work out with a colleague how much stock was lost in an outage.

senseEn: only just or by a very small margin
en: We barely caught the last ferry.
zh: 我们勉强赶上了末班渡轮。
transfer: 告诉朋友你差一点就没赶上签到。
transferEn: Describe reaching check-in with almost no time left.

senseEn: the people addressed acting independently
en: Did you make the costumes yourselves?
zh: 这些服装是你们自己做的吗？
transfer: 问学生是不是他们亲手布置了展台。
transferEn: Ask students whether they set up an exhibit without help.

senseEn: be real or still present
en: Does the old footpath still exist beyond the farm?
zh: 农场后面那条旧步道还在吗？
transfer: 问馆员那份报纸的原件是否还存在。
transferEn: Ask a librarian whether the original newspaper survives.

senseEn: a fixture or room for relieving oneself
en: Is there an accessible toilet near the platform?
zh: 站台附近有无障碍厕所吗？
transfer: 问公园管理员哪里有对外开放的厕所。
transferEn: Locate a public restroom with a park attendant.

senseEn: an occasion for eating food
en: Does the ticket include a hot meal?
zh: 票价包含一顿热餐吗？
transfer: 感谢主人招待的一顿丰盛午饭。
transferEn: Thank a host for a generous midday serving of food.

senseEn: discard a large amount of material
en: Please don't dump soil in the shared bins.
zh: 请不要把泥土倒进公用垃圾箱。
transfer: 问园丁清理出来的树叶可以倒到哪儿。
transferEn: Ask a gardener where to discard leaves after raking.

senseEn: a person belonging to an organization
en: Does each member get a locker key?
zh: 每位成员都能领一把储物柜钥匙吗？
transfer: 问书友会会员能否带客人参加活动。
transferEn: Check whether someone belonging to a book club may bring a guest.

senseEn: a strong reaction to an unexpected event
en: The sudden closure came as a shock to the staff.
zh: 突然停业让员工们很震惊。
transfer: 向朋友描述你听说老剧院拆除时的震惊。
transferEn: Describe your reaction to unexpected news of a theater demolition.

senseEn: a baked dish with a pastry case and filling
en: Is the apple pie served warm?
zh: 苹果馅饼是热着上的吗？
transfer: 请面包师为你留一块樱桃派。
transferEn: Ask a baker to set aside a slice of cherry-filled pastry.

en: There's been a crash at the crossing. Take the next street.
zh: 路口发生了碰撞事故。走下一条街吧。
transfer: 向保险人员说明哪位乘客目睹了撞车事故。
senseEn: an accident involving a collision
transferEn: Tell an insurer which passenger witnessed the collision.

senseEn: someone creating works of art
en: Will the artist sign prints after the talk?
zh: 讲座后艺术家会给版画签名吗？
transfer: 向馆员询问这幅壁画是哪位艺术家绘制的。
transferEn: Ask who created a gallery mural.

senseEn: a proposed explanation awaiting confirmation
en: My theory is that the latch sticks in damp weather.
zh: 我猜是天气潮湿时门闩容易卡住。
transfer: 向同事提出一个关于时钟为什么慢的推测。
transferEn: Offer a possible explanation for a slow clock.

senseEn: a feeling of great happiness
en: Seeing the first blossom brought her real joy.
zh: 第一朵花开了，她由衷高兴。
transfer: 向朋友描述全队夺冠时的喜悦。
transferEn: Describe the happiness of a team winning a championship.

senseEn: spoil something beyond easy repair
en: Will rain ruin the cushions if we leave them outside?
zh: 靠垫留在外面会被雨淋坏吗？
transfer: 提醒同伴把旧照片移开免得水汽毁掉它们。
transferEn: Suggest moving old photos away from damaging moisture.

senseEn: vehicles moving along roads
en: How bad is the traffic near the stadium?
zh: 体育场附近堵车严重吗？
transfer: 问同事早高峰车流什么时候减少。
transferEn: Ask a colleague when morning congestion eases.

senseEn: showing good practical judgment
en: Would it be wise to book the early ferry now?
zh: 现在订早班渡轮是不是明智些？
transfer: 建议朋友先试色再刷整面墙，并说明这样更明智。
transferEn: Suggest testing paint before covering a wall as a prudent choice.

senseEn: an idea or statement that makes no sense
en: That rumor about the pool closing is nonsense; I just spoke to the manager.
zh: 泳池要关的传闻没根据，我刚跟经理确认过了。
transfer: 用已经核实的事实反驳一则荒唐传言。
transferEn: Reject an absurd rumor using facts you have verified.

senseEn: a pale color between red and white
en: The pink label marks the fragrance-free soap.
zh: 粉红色标签标的是无香皂。
transfer: 向前台描述孩子丢失的粉红书包。
transferEn: Describe a child's pale rose-colored backpack at reception.

senseEn: twelve o'clock at night
en: Can we check in after midnight?
zh: 我们能在午夜之后入住吗？
transfer: 提醒同伴订票页面在午夜关闭。
transferEn: Warn a companion about a booking deadline at twelve at night.

senseEn: bring something to its recipient
en: Can you deliver the sofa upstairs?
zh: 能把沙发送上楼吗？
transfer: 问花店能不能在午饭前把花送到办公室。
transferEn: Check whether flowers can reach an office before lunch.

senseEn: a baked staple commonly made from flour
en: Is the bread baked here each morning?
zh: 面包是每天早上在这里烤的吗？
transfer: 请同伴带上剩下的面包做三明治。
transferEn: Ask a companion to bring the remaining loaf for sandwiches.

senseEn: a control operated by pressing
en: Which button opens the doors?
zh: 哪个按钮是开门的？
transfer: 请司机指出开阅读灯的按钮。
transferEn: Ask a driver which control switches on the reading light.

senseEn: first or authentic rather than a copy
en: Do you need the original receipt or is a scan fine?
zh: 你们要收据原件还是扫描件就行？
transfer: 向图书馆询问能否查看原始手稿。
transferEn: Ask a library about viewing the first manuscript rather than a reproduction.

senseEn: the origin of information or material
en: Can you cite the source of that map?
zh: 能注明那张地图的来源吗？
transfer: 请同学指出统计图的数据来源。
transferEn: Ask a classmate where a chart's data came from.

senseEn: a control that turns something on or off
en: The light switch is behind the curtain.
zh: 灯开关在窗帘后面。
transfer: 告诉客人排气扇开关在哪里。
transferEn: Locate the control for a ventilation fan for a guest.

senseEn: of a reasonably good standard
en: Can we find a decent umbrella for ten dollars?
zh: 十美元能买到一把像样的伞吗？
transfer: 问朋友哪里能吃到不错又实惠的早餐。
transferEn: Ask where to find a reasonably good breakfast on a budget.

senseEn: a very informal negative reply
en: Nah, I'm fine walking; thanks for the lift offer.
zh: 不用啦，我走过去就行，谢谢你愿意载我。
transfer: 随口婉拒朋友要再添一杯茶的提议。
transferEn: Casually decline a friend's offer of another cup of tea.

senseEn: at a lower position than something
en: The towels are below the basin in the cupboard.
zh: 毛巾在洗手池下方的橱柜里。
transfer: 告诉同伴地图上的图例在标题下方。
transferEn: Locate a map legend relative to the title above it.

senseEn: a series of steps to achieve something
en: What's the process for replacing a damaged badge?
zh: 更换损坏徽章要走什么流程？
transfer: 问接待员退还租车押金的流程。
transferEn: Ask reception about the steps for recovering a rental deposit.

senseEn: a very dry region with little vegetation
en: Does the desert trail have marked water stops?
zh: 沙漠步道上标有补水点吗？
transfer: 询问导游这片沙漠夜晚有多冷。
transferEn: Ask a guide about nighttime temperatures in an arid region.

senseEn: costing a lot of money
en: Is installation more expensive on weekends?
zh: 周末上门安装更贵吗？
transfer: 告诉同伴你觉得海景房太贵。
transferEn: Explain why an ocean-view room exceeds your budget.

senseEn: one specific item rather than any alternative
en: Do you need a particular brand of glue?
zh: 你需要某个指定牌子的胶水吗？
transfer: 问老师是否要求用某种特定颜色的笔。
transferEn: Check if a teacher requires a pen of one specific color.

senseEn: a length of time
en: Is there a waiting period before the pass works?
zh: 通行证要等一段时间才生效吗？
transfer: 问新员工试用期有多长。
transferEn: Ask the duration of a new employee's probation.

senseEn: the mother of someone's parent
en: My grandmother taught me this bread recipe.
zh: 这个面包配方是我外婆教我的。
transfer: 向展馆员工介绍照片里的祖母。
transferEn: Identify your father's mother in a photo for museum staff.

senseEn: satisfaction from an achievement
en: She takes pride in repairing old clocks by hand.
zh: 她以亲手修好老钟为荣。
transfer: 向队友表达你对小组成果的自豪。
transferEn: Express satisfaction in what your group achieved.

senseEn: a unit of currency used in several countries
en: Is the deposit one dollar per bottle?
zh: 每个瓶子的押金是一美元吗？
transfer: 问向导寄一张明信片需要几美元。
transferEn: Ask how many US currency units it costs to mail a postcard.

senseEn: a woman with magical powers in a story
en: Does the witch return the missing shoes in the last act?
zh: 女巫在最后一幕归还了丢失的鞋吗？
transfer: 问孩子故事里的女巫住在哪里。
transferEn: Ask a child where the magical woman in a story lives.

senseEn: extra money given for service
en: Is a tip included in the bill?
zh: 账单里包含小费吗？
transfer: 问向导当地通常怎样付小费。
transferEn: Ask a guide how gratuities are usually given locally.

senseEn: a living organism such as a flower or shrub
en: Does this plant need direct sunlight?
zh: 这种植物需要阳光直射吗？
transfer: 请邻居辨认阳台上开紫花的植物。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor to identify a purple-flowering specimen on a balcony.

sense: 想必，强调说话人的判断
senseEn: indicates a firm expectation
en: Surely there's another train before noon?
zh: 中午前应该还有另一班火车吧？
transfer: 表达你认为服务台一定留有备用钥匙，并请对方确认。
transferEn: State your strong expectation that reception keeps a spare key and seek confirmation.

senseEn: a sculpture of a person's head and upper chest
en: Who made the marble bust by the staircase?
zh: 楼梯边那尊大理石半身像是谁雕的？
transfer: 请馆员辨认铜制半身像中的人物。
transferEn: Ask a curator to identify a person represented in a bronze head-and-shoulders sculpture.

senseEn: the event of being born
en: Is my date of birth required on this card?
zh: 这张卡上必须填我的出生日期吗？
transfer: 询问登记表出生地点一栏填城市还是医院。
transferEn: Check what details about the place someone was born belong on a form.

senseEn: the point where bones meet
en: Does the knee joint feel stiff after sitting?
zh: 坐久后膝关节会觉得僵硬吗？
transfer: 向护士指出哪根手指的关节肿了。
transferEn: Identify the swollen knuckle to a nurse.

senseEn: a thin conductor carrying electricity
en: Is that wire connected to the doorbell?
zh: 那根电线连着门铃吗？
transfer: 向维修员指出台灯哪根电线的绝缘层破了。
transferEn: Show a technician the damaged insulation on a lamp lead.

senseEn: an adult male bovine
en: Is the bull kept in a separate field?
zh: 公牛是单独养在一片田里的吗？
transfer: 问农场主哪道栅门通向公牛所在的围场。
transferEn: Ask a farmer which gate leads to the male cattle enclosure.

senseEn: in the direction of
en: Walk towards the clock tower until you see the gate.
zh: 朝钟楼走，直到看见那扇门。
transfer: 告诉同伴小路是朝着海边延伸的。
transferEn: Explain that a path runs in the direction of the shore.

senseEn: move upward in level
en: How fast does the river rise after heavy rain?
zh: 大雨后河水涨得有多快？
transfer: 问向导潮水什么时候开始上涨。
transferEn: Ask when the tide begins moving upward.

senseEn: failing to hold attention
en: The kids found the long introduction boring.
zh: 孩子们觉得冗长的开场很无聊。
transfer: 向朋友解释你为什么觉得那个重复的游戏乏味。
transferEn: Explain why a repetitive game failed to interest you.

senseEn: feeling shame about something
en: I felt ashamed of shouting at the usher.
zh: 我对引座员大喊大叫，事后很羞愧。
transfer: 向队友承认你对甩锅给别人感到羞愧。
transferEn: Admit shame about blaming someone else.

senseEn: a distinct part of a larger whole
en: Which section explains how to clean the filter?
zh: 哪一节说明怎样清洗滤网？
transfer: 请老师指出手册里讲评分标准的部分。
transferEn: Ask a teacher where a handbook covers grading criteria.

en: That's a clever way to store lids in a narrow drawer.
zh: 在窄抽屉里这样收纳锅盖真巧妙。
transfer: 称赞朋友用镜子给走廊增加采光的点子。
senseEn: inventive and effective
transferEn: Praise a friend for using mirrors to brighten a hallway.

senseEn: used to introduce a candid statement
en: Honestly, I'd prefer the quieter room.
zh: 说实话，我更想要安静一点的房间。
transfer: 跟搭档坦诚说明你不喜欢早班训练。
transferEn: Candidly tell a partner that early practice sessions do not suit you.

senseEn: the achievement of a desired result
en: Was the fundraiser a success despite the rain?
zh: 尽管下雨，这次募捐活动成功了吗？
transfer: 请组织者解释这场书展为什么算成功。
transferEn: Ask organizers what made a book fair successful.

senseEn: a building or space for storing vehicles
en: Can I leave the bike in your garage overnight?
zh: 我能把自行车在你家车库存一晚吗？
transfer: 告诉快递员车库门口暂时被堵住了。
transferEn: Warn a courier that the vehicle storage entrance is blocked.

senseEn: relating to the body
en: Does the role involve heavy physical work?
zh: 这个岗位需要做重体力活吗？
transfer: 问教练恢复训练时先做哪些身体活动。
transferEn: Ask which bodily activities come first when returning to training.

senseEn: a scheduled onward travel service
en: Will the delay make us miss our connection in Leeds?
zh: 晚点会让我们错过在利兹的转乘吗？
transfer: 询问售票员哪班渡轮能衔接傍晚的火车。
transferEn: Ask which ferry leaves enough time to catch an evening train.

senseEn: having many parts or steps that are hard to follow
en: Is setup too complicated without the manual?
zh: 没有说明书，设置起来会不会太复杂？
transfer: 告诉老师最后一道题步骤复杂，请他再演示一次。
transferEn: Request another demonstration of a problem with many steps.

senseEn: feel sorry about a past choice
en: I regret leaving the old photos behind.
zh: 我后悔把那些老照片留在那里了。
transfer: 告诉朋友你后悔没有提前订票。
transferEn: Express remorse about failing to book ahead.

senseEn: the person who loses a competition
en: Does the loser of this round still get another game?
zh: 这一轮的败者还有一场比赛吗？
transfer: 问组织者决赛落败的一方是否也有奖牌。
transferEn: Check whether the runner-up in a final receives a medal.

senseEn: a built-in storage space for clothes or items
en: Is there room in the hall closet for wet coats?
zh: 门厅的衣橱能放湿外套吗？
transfer: 告诉客人备用毯子在卧室的衣橱里。
transferEn: Locate blankets in a bedroom's clothes-storage space.

senseEn: much larger than normal
en: Will that giant mirror fit in the lift?
zh: 那面巨大的镜子能放进电梯吗？
transfer: 向朋友描述展厅入口那盏巨大吊灯。
transferEn: Describe an oversized chandelier at an exhibition entrance.

senseEn: a circular part that turns to allow movement
en: One wheel on my suitcase won't turn.
zh: 我行李箱上有个轮子不转了。
transfer: 请维修员检查手推车上摇晃的轮子。
transferEn: Ask a technician to inspect a wobbly trolley wheel.

senseEn: twice ten
en: The walk takes twenty minutes from the station.
zh: 从车站走过来要二十分钟。
transfer: 询问二十把椅子能否塞进面包车。
transferEn: Check whether twenty chairs fit in a van.

senseEn: an established rule guiding decisions
en: What's the policy on returning opened items?
zh: 已拆封物品的退货规定是什么？
transfer: 询问旅馆关于宠物住宿的规定。
transferEn: Check a hotel's rules for guests bringing pets.

senseEn: pull or split material apart
en: Be careful not to tear the lining when removing the tag.
zh: 拆标签时小心别把衬里撕破。
transfer: 提醒朋友开信封时别撕破里面的照片。
transferEn: Warn a friend against ripping a photograph while opening an envelope.

senseEn: material obtained from trees
en: Is this wood treated for outdoor use?
zh: 这木材做过户外防护处理吗？
transfer: 向木工询问书架是用哪种木材做的。
transferEn: Ask a carpenter what timber was used for a shelf.

senseEn: the eventual outcome for someone or something
en: Does the sequel reveal the fate of the missing crew?
zh: 续集会揭晓失踪船员的命运吗？
transfer: 讨论故事结尾老剧院最后怎么样了。
transferEn: Discuss what ultimately became of an old theater in a story.

en: Could I have apple juice without ice, please?
zh: 请给我一杯不加冰的苹果汁，好吗？
transfer: 办野餐时询问要给孩子们带多少果汁。
senseEn: liquid extracted from fruit
transferEn: Ask how much fruit drink to pack for the children at a picnic.

senseEn: the elected head of a US state
en: Did the governor attend the new library's opening?
zh: 州长出席新图书馆的开馆活动了吗？
transfer: 问档案馆员照片拍摄时哪位州长在任。
transferEn: Ask which state leader was in office when a photograph was taken.

senseEn: not sleeping
en: Is the baby still awake after the car ride?
zh: 坐完车宝宝还醒着吗？
transfer: 给室友发消息问他是否还醒着方便接电话。
transferEn: Text a roommate to check if they are up for a call.

senseEn: land bordering the sea
en: Will the bus follow the coast all the way to town?
zh: 公交会一直沿海岸开到镇上吗？
transfer: 问导游离营地最近的海岸有多远。
transferEn: Ask the distance from a campsite to the shoreline.

senseEn: a person flying an aircraft
en: The pilot announced a short delay before takeoff.
zh: 飞行员宣布起飞前要稍等一会儿。
transfer: 问工作人员此次观光飞行由哪位飞行员执飞。
transferEn: Identify the person flying a sightseeing aircraft.

senseEn: an extraordinary, seemingly impossible event
en: It's a miracle the glass survived that fall.
zh: 玻璃杯从那么高摔下去都没碎，简直是奇迹。
transfer: 朋友的旧戒指在沙滩上失而复得，表达惊叹。
transferEn: Express amazement at a lost ring found again on a beach.

senseEn: someone with a strong liking for something
en: Is this guide suitable for a bird lover visiting in winter?
zh: 这本指南适合冬天来访的爱鸟人士吗？
transfer: 为一位音乐爱好者询问适合的生日礼物。
transferEn: Ask about a birthday gift for someone who loves music.

senseEn: on or onto a vehicle or vessel
en: Can we bring the stroller aboard the ferry?
zh: 我们能把婴儿车带上渡轮吗？
transfer: 询问自行车是否可以带上火车。
transferEn: Check if a bicycle may be taken onto a train.

senseEn: a small roll of tobacco for smoking
en: Please use the bin for cigarette ends.
zh: 请把烟头扔进垃圾桶。
transfer: 向房东说明房间里有香烟味。
transferEn: Tell a landlord there is a tobacco smoke smell in the room.

senseEn: feeling thankful
en: I'm grateful for the extra time to finish the forms.
zh: 谢谢你多给我时间填表。
transfer: 感谢同伴临时来车站接你。
transferEn: Express gratitude for a last-minute pickup at a station.

senseEn: very strong or impressive
en: The mighty river narrows sharply below the falls.
zh: 这条气势磅礴的河流在瀑布下方突然变窄。
transfer: 向游客描述海湾入口处强大的潮流。
transferEn: Describe a powerful tidal current at a bay entrance.

senseEn: a person who unlawfully kills another
en: Does the last chapter reveal the murderer?
zh: 最后一章揭晓凶手是谁了吗？
transfer: 请读书会成员讨论线索时不要说出凶手身份。
transferEn: Ask readers discussing clues to avoid identifying the killer.

senseEn: a cultivated outdoor area for plants
en: Can we eat in the garden if it stays dry?
zh: 如果不下雨，我们能在花园里吃饭吗？
transfer: 问房东谁负责给花园浇水。
transferEn: Check who waters the planted area at a rental.

senseEn: pull something along a surface
en: Don't drag the chair across the new floor.
zh: 别把椅子在新地板上拖。
transfer: 提醒朋友把箱子抬起来以免拖坏地毯。
transferEn: Ask a friend to lift a case instead of pulling it over carpet.

senseEn: following the third
en: Take the fourth turning after the bridge.
zh: 过桥后在第四个路口转弯。
transfer: 请同伴数一下队伍里第四辆车是不是你们的。
transferEn: Check whether the vehicle after the first three is yours.

senseEn: a loud high-pitched cry
en: Was that scream from the stage or the audience?
zh: 刚才那声尖叫是台上还是观众席传来的？
transfer: 跟朋友讲述孩子看到假蜘蛛时的尖叫。
transferEn: Describe a child's startled cry on seeing a toy spider.

senseEn: an organized occasion
en: Is the event open to families this year?
zh: 今年的活动对家庭开放吗？
transfer: 询问志愿者活动下雨时是否取消。
transferEn: Ask whether a volunteer gathering goes ahead in rain.

senseEn: a line of seats or objects
en: Are there two seats in the same row?
zh: 有两个同排的座位吗？
transfer: 指引朋友去找第二排的蓝色自行车。
transferEn: Direct a friend to the blue bicycle in the second line.

senseEn: a performer portraying a character
en: Which actor plays the stationmaster?
zh: 哪位演员演站长？
transfer: 问导演谁将接替生病的演员。
transferEn: Ask a director who will replace a sick performer.

senseEn: a place where someone is buried
en: Is the poet's grave marked on this cemetery map?
zh: 这张墓园地图上标了诗人的墓吗？
transfer: 问工作人员纪念花可以放在墓的哪一侧。
transferEn: Check where flowers may be placed beside a burial site.

senseEn: having a higher professional rank
en: Can a senior technician check the wiring?
zh: 能请一位资深技师检查线路吗？
transfer: 询问谁是本次项目的资深设计师。
transferEn: Find out which experienced designer leads a project.

senseEn: wanting to learn more
en: I'm curious about the carved dates above the door.
zh: 我对门上方刻着的日期很好奇。
transfer: 向讲解员表达你想知道旧钟如何运转。
transferEn: Show interest in how an old clock works.

senseEn: level and even
en: We need a flat surface for the workbench.
zh: 我们需要一个平整的台面做工作台。
transfer: 问露营者附近有没有平整地面搭帐篷。
transferEn: Locate level ground for pitching a tent.

senseEn: the cold season following autumn
en: Does the cable car run in winter?
zh: 缆车冬天运行吗？
transfer: 询问房东冬天如何给屋里供暖。
transferEn: Ask a host how the house is heated during the cold season.

senseEn: to a serious degree
en: Was your wrist badly bruised in the fall?
zh: 你摔倒时手腕淤青得严重吗？
transfer: 向送货员说明箱子的一角被压得很严重。
transferEn: Describe a badly crushed box corner to a courier.

senseEn: the joint area between arm and neck
en: Does your shoulder hurt when you lift the bag?
zh: 你提包时肩膀疼吗？
transfer: 告诉裁缝外套的肩部太宽。
transferEn: Explain that a jacket is too wide across the upper arms and neck.

senseEn: causing fear
en: Is the scary scene too intense for young children?
zh: 那个吓人的场景对幼童来说会不会太刺激？
transfer: 告诉朋友你觉得夜里走那段桥很吓人。
transferEn: Describe how frightening a bridge crossing felt at night.

senseEn: an informal intensifier meaning very
en: Thanks, that diagram was super helpful.
zh: 谢谢，那张图特别有帮助。
transfer: 跟熟人说取票过程特别顺利。
transferEn: Casually emphasize how smoothly ticket collection went.

senseEn: a religious leader conducting worship
en: The priest will open the chapel for visitors at noon.
zh: 神父中午会开礼拜堂接待访客。
transfer: 问教堂办公室哪位神父主持仪式。
transferEn: Ask which clergy member will conduct the ceremony.

senseEn: a medical condition affecting normal functioning
en: Does this leaflet explain how the disease spreads?
zh: 这份资料说明了这种病如何传播吗？
transfer: 请护士指出资料上哪一段讲这种病的症状。
transferEn: Ask a nurse where a leaflet describes symptoms of an illness.

senseEn: a long-bladed weapon, including a stage prop
en: Is the sword in this production a wooden prop?
zh: 这出戏里的剑是木制道具吗？
transfer: 向馆员询问画像中的剑是否纯属装饰。
transferEn: Ask a curator if the blade in a portrait was purely ceremonial.

senseEn: a young bird, especially a chicken
en: Has the last chick hatched yet?
zh: 最后一只小鸡出壳了吗？
transfer: 问农场主小鸡什么时候能跟母鸡出门。
transferEn: Ask when young birds can go outside with the hen.

senseEn: a matter causing worry
en: My main concern is the slippery entrance.
zh: 我最担心的是入口太滑。
transfer: 跟房东谈谈你对楼梯照明不足的担忧。
transferEn: Raise a worry about poor stair lighting with a landlord.

en: Maya has a talent for making shy children laugh.
zh: 玛雅很有本事，能逗笑害羞的孩子。
transfer: 推荐同事当主持人时说说他在哪方面有天赋。
senseEn: a natural aptitude
transferEn: Recommend a colleague as host and explain their natural strength.

senseEn: unwanted waste material
en: What day is garbage collected on this street?
zh: 这条街星期几收垃圾？
transfer: 问前台玻璃瓶要不要和普通垃圾分开。
transferEn: Check whether glass must be separated from ordinary waste.

senseEn: for the most part
en: The path is mostly level after the bridge.
zh: 过桥之后，这条路大部分都很平坦。
transfer: 说明参加活动的主要是本地居民。
transferEn: Explain that the majority of participants live nearby.

senseEn: a manner of thinking or behaving
en: Her calm attitude helped the team through the delay.
zh: 她沉着的态度帮助团队应对了延误。
transfer: 向经理表扬店员对初次来访的客人的友好态度。
transferEn: Praise a clerk's welcoming approach to first-time customers.

senseEn: a hard part forming the skeleton

transfer: 在科学展询问手中最长的骨头是哪一根。

zh: 这条线路最近改过吗？
transfer: 问邻居最近有没有收到物业通知。

zh: 工作人员对我那紧张的小孩很友善。
transfer: 告诉宠物寄养员你的猫见到人很亲近。

zh: 这个沙拉汁含生鸡蛋吗？

senseEn: in its essential aspects

zh: 新通行证用起来和旧的基本一样。

zh: 大门八点十五分关闭。
transfer: 约同伴九点差一刻在车站见。

zh: 围栏旁那架秋千适合幼童吗？

zh: 主出口旁有出租车候车点吗？

zh: 雾这么大，渡轮还可能开吗？
transfer: 问维修员今天修好洗衣机的可能性大不大。

zh: 语音导览有日语版吗？

zh: 我们周六特别需要有人帮忙看孩子。你有空吗？
transfer: 在断水的营地里，表达大家急需饮用水。

zh: 轮子上有泥，把手推车留在外面。

zh: 你祖父以前在海军服过役吗？

transfer: 请护士指出报告中哪个结果显示未检出。

zh: 从码头走到酒店有多远？
transfer: 询问两个营地之间的距离。

senseEn: a container holding fuel or liquid

zh: 取车时油箱是满的吗？
transfer: 问管理员饮水箱能装多少升水。
transferEn: Ask an attendant about the capacity of a drinking-water reservoir.

senseEn: information collected or stored for use
en: Can I export the temperature data as a spreadsheet?
zh: 我能把温度数据导出成电子表格吗？
transfer: 请同事保存周末的客流数据。

senseEn: a formal expression of something wanted

zh: 你们会雇学生上暑期班次吗？

zh: 申请人需要事先了解地图判读吗？

zh: 上高尔夫课要带自己的球杆吗？

transferEn: Check whether a nearby course welcomes beginners to the club-and-ball sport.

en: Close the gate. There's a cow in the lane.
zh: 关上大门，巷子里有头母牛。

senseEn: the time when daylight first appears

zh: 渔民们在黎明时出港。

senseEn: supplies available for sale

zh: 蓝色布料有现货吗？

transferEn: Ask when white tulips will be available for sale again.

senseEn: items needed for a task

zh: 租房费包含录音设备吗？
transfer: 请教练列出初学者必须自带的装备。

senseEn: a gathering for talks on a particular field

zh: 今晚会议报到处开放吗？
transfer: 问主办方会议是否有面向学生的票。

senseEn: bringing someone or something to safety

zh: 谁协调了那只搁浅海豹的救援？
transfer: 询问向导遇险游客的救援是否已结束。

senseEn: a period of reduced prices
en: Does the sale end before the weekend?
zh: 特卖会在周末前结束吗？
transfer: 询问打折活动是否包括雨衣。
transferEn: Check whether raincoats are included in a discount event.

zh: 我能因错过转乘申请退款吗？
transfer: 问保险公司修窗的钱能否申请理赔。

zh: 开始录制前请保持两秒安静。

zh: 调音没结束前观众可以入场吗？
transfer: 向导演描述观众对结尾的反应。

zh: 请提醒客人注意松动的台阶。

zh: 最后一章里法官为什么宽大处理？

senseEn: suitable or correct for a purpose

zh: 这个镜头怎样存放才正确？
transfer: 向餐厅主管询问摆放餐具的正确方法。
transferEn: Ask a restaurant supervisor about the correct way to set cutlery.

senseEn: bring something new into existence

zh: 我能建个文件夹存这些扫描票吗？

senseEn: all space, matter and energy

zh: 这个展览解释宇宙为什么在膨胀吗？

zh: 场地湿了会取消棒球训练吗？

transferEn: Check what glove a beginner needs for the bat-and-ball sport.

senseEn: a liquid dish often served warm

zh: 今天的例汤是用豆子做的吗？

senseEn: relating to Britain

zh: “lift”是电梯的英式说法吗？

zh: 这身衣服适合参加户外婚礼吗？

zh: 这次请慢慢念邮编。

zh: 我能把自行车放在你家后院吗？
transfer: 询问房东院子的门能不能锁。

senseEn: a man holding a high hereditary noble rank

zh: 是哪位公爵把这些肖像捐给了镇上？

transferEn: Ask which room a titled nobleman used to receive visitors.

senseEn: low land between hills or mountains

zh: 到桥之前这条路一直在山谷里吗？
transfer: 问向导山谷里哪个地方有信号。

senseEn: not mixed with another material
en: Is this blanket pure wool or a blend?
zh: 这条毯子是纯羊毛还是混纺的？
transfer: 向店员询问这条项链是否纯银。
transferEn: Check whether a necklace is made entirely of silver.

senseEn: a price per unit of time or service
en: What's the hourly rate for the studio?
zh: 这个工作室每小时的租金是多少？
transfer: 询问周末停车按什么费率计价。
transferEn: Ask the charge per unit of time for weekend parking.

senseEn: mark a happy event with a special activity
en: How should we celebrate your promotion?
zh: 我们怎么庆祝你升职？
transfer: 提议在河边野餐庆祝毕业。

senseEn: a large keyboard instrument with strings

zh: 明天排练用的钢琴调好音了吗？
transfer: 问老师能不能在课前用琴房的钢琴。
transferEn: Check access to the keyboard instrument before a lesson.

senseEn: clothing prescribed for members of a group

zh: 开放日志愿者需要穿制服吗？
transfer: 询问主管哪里领取新员工制服。
transferEn: Ask a supervisor where to collect prescribed staff clothing.

senseEn: a particular place or position
en: Has the pickup location changed since last week?
zh: 上车地点跟上周相比改了吗？
transfer: 请摄影师确认明天拍摄的地点。
transferEn: Ask a photographer to confirm tomorrow's shoot site.

senseEn: a common water bird with a broad bill
en: Is that duck nesting beside the footbridge?
zh: 那只鸭子在步行桥旁筑巢吗？
transfer: 问护林员湖边的鸭子是不是留在这里过冬。
transferEn: Ask a ranger if the ducks by the lake stay through winter.

senseEn: a toy figure representing a person
en: Can the doll's dress be washed separately?
zh: 这个玩偶的裙子可以单独洗吗？
transfer: 请店员找一只适合幼儿的布娃娃。
transferEn: Request a soft human-shaped toy suitable for a toddler.

senseEn: a quantity considered as a whole
en: What's the smallest amount of fabric I can order?
zh: 布料最少能订多少？
transfer: 问快递员最低保价金额是多少。
transferEn: Check the minimum insured sum for a parcel.

senseEn: in good physical condition
en: Are the rescued birds healthy enough to be released?
zh: 获救的鸟身体恢复到可以放归了吗？
transfer: 问兽医小猫是否健康到可以出门旅行。
transferEn: Ask a vet whether a kitten is fit enough to travel.

senseEn: located in the middle
en: Meet me at the central fountain in the square.
zh: 在广场中央的喷泉旁见。
transfer: 指引来宾去大楼中央的楼梯。
transferEn: Direct a guest to the staircase in the middle of a building.

senseEn: a writing tool that uses ink
en: Could I borrow a black pen for the form?
zh: 能借支黑笔填表吗？
transfer: 问监考老师能否用蓝色钢笔答题。
transferEn: Check whether blue ink is permitted in an exam.

senseEn: appealing or pleasing
en: The fare looks attractive until you add the baggage fees.
zh: 这票价乍看很诱人，加上行李费就不是了。
transfer: 解释为什么含早餐的套餐对你有吸引力。

senseEn: not meet the standard for passing
en: Can I retake the test if I fail the practical section?
zh: 如果实操部分没通过，我能补考吗？
transfer: 问老师没通过听力测试的人何时能重考。
transferEn: Ask about resits for students who did not pass a listening assessment.

senseEn: a narrow route for walking
en: Does this path end at the beach?
zh: 这条小路的尽头是海滩吗？
transfer: 问向导暴雨后哪条小路还干燥。
transferEn: Ask a guide which walking route stays dry after rain.

senseEn: a substance capable of causing serious harm if taken in
en: Keep the poison warning on the original bottle.
zh: 请保留原瓶上的有毒警告标签。
transfer: 在打扫储藏室时指出哪瓶物品的标签有毒物警告。

senseEn: a large or frightening animal
en: What beast leaves those tracks in the fairy tale?
zh: 童话里那些脚印是哪只野兽留下的？
transfer: 问舞台设计师森林里的野兽会用哪种木偶来表现。
transferEn: Ask which puppet will represent the forest creature onstage.

senseEn: as a result of nature without human intervention
en: Do these herbs grow naturally on the hillside?
zh: 这些香草是天然生长在山坡上的吗？
transfer: 问园丁这种花是否会自然结籽。
transferEn: Check whether a flower goes to seed without human help.

senseEn: a state of joy or contentment
en: The garden brought her happiness after the move.
zh: 搬家后，那座花园给她带来了快乐。
transfer: 在贺卡里祝新人婚后幸福。
transferEn: Wish a newly married couple lasting joy in a card.

senseEn: at whatever time is convenient
en: Call anytime after the rehearsal.
zh: 排练结束后随时打电话。
transfer: 告诉邻居周六可以随时来取梯子。
transferEn: Let a neighbor collect a ladder at any convenient time Saturday.

senseEn: in the end after some time
en: The fog eventually lifted enough for the ferry to sail.
zh: 雾终于散到足以让渡轮开航了。
transfer: 描述你找了很久终于在抽屉里找到票的经过。
transferEn: Describe finally locating tickets in a drawer after a long search.

senseEn: a television service broadcasting programs
en: Which channel carries the local weather forecast?
zh: 哪个频道播本地天气预报？
transfer: 问朋友比赛会在哪个频道播放。
transferEn: Find out which broadcaster is showing the match.

senseEn: a lift carrying people between floors
en: Does the elevator reach the rooftop café?
zh: 电梯能到屋顶咖啡馆吗？
transfer: 向工作人员询问哪部电梯可以到地下停车场。
transferEn: Ask staff which lift reaches the underground parking area.

senseEn: an archaic possessive meaning belonging to the listener
en: In the poem, “thy name” refers to the listener's name.
zh: 诗里“thy name”是古语，指听者的名字。
transfer: 向同学解释古诗里“你的家”一语中的旧式物主词。
transferEn: Explain an old possessive in a line about the listener's home.

senseEn: a strap worn around the waist
en: Does this belt come with the trousers?
zh: 这条腰带是裤子配的吗？
transfer: 请店员帮你选条能调松紧的腰带。
transferEn: Ask a clerk for an adjustable waist strap.

senseEn: fasten firmly
en: Can we secure the shelf without drilling new holes?
zh: 不钻新孔能固定好架子吗？
transfer: 搬家前提醒同伴固定住箱盖。
transferEn: Remind a companion to fasten a lid before moving a box.

senseEn: the father of someone's parent
en: My grandfather built the boat in this photograph.
zh: 照片里的船是我外公造的。
transfer: 向同事介绍退休后教你木工的祖父。
transferEn: Introduce the grandfather who taught you carpentry after retirement.

senseEn: keep away from something
en: Which route lets us avoid the roadworks?
zh: 哪条路线可以避开施工路段？
transfer: 问同伴在车站怎样避开拥挤的楼梯。
transferEn: Ask how to bypass crowded stairs at a station.

senseEn: a coin worth one hundredth of a pound or dollar
en: The total is a penny over five pounds.
zh: 总共比五英镑多一便士。
transfer: 问同行者有没有一枚便士硬币用于凑零钱。
transferEn: Ask a companion for a one-pence coin to make exact change.

senseEn: someone who steals property
en: Did the camera catch the thief leaving the bike shed?
zh: 摄像头拍到小偷离开自行车棚了吗？
transfer: 询问店员是否有人看到小偷往哪边走。
transferEn: Ask a clerk if anyone saw which way the person who stole the item went.

senseEn: an inlet of sea along a coast
en: Is the bay sheltered from the afternoon wind?
zh: 这个海湾能避开午后的风吗？
transfer: 问船员海湾的另一端叫什么。
transferEn: Ask a crew member to name the far side of an inlet.

senseEn: a woman getting married
en: Where should the bride wait before the ceremony?
zh: 仪式开始前新娘应该在哪儿等？
transfer: 问摄影师准备在哪里给新娘拍照。
transferEn: Ask the photographer where the woman getting married should pose.

senseEn: a strongly dismissive description of something very inadequate
en: The review calls the repair “pathetic”; a photo would show the fault better.
zh: 评论说维修“差劲透顶”，用照片说明故障会更清楚。
transfer: 把投诉草稿里轻蔑评价服务的词换成可核对的事实。
transferEn: Replace a contemptuous description of service with a verifiable fact.

senseEn: a surface reflecting an image
en: Can we hang the mirror opposite the window?
zh: 我们能把镜子挂在窗户对面吗？
transfer: 请店员给你一面镜子看看帽子的后面。
transferEn: Ask a clerk for a reflecting surface to see the back of a hat.

senseEn: the weekday following Wednesday
en: The choir meets on Thursday evenings.
zh: 合唱团每周四晚上排练。
transfer: 问维修员星期四上午能不能来。
transferEn: Check availability on the morning of the weekday before Friday.

senseEn: a group of twelve items
en: Can I order half a dozen rolls?
zh: 我能订半打小面包吗？
transfer: 问花店一打玫瑰的价格。
transferEn: Ask a florist the cost of twelve roses as a group.

senseEn: a course toward a place
en: Which direction leads back to the harbor?
zh: 哪个方向能回到港口？
transfer: 问司机哪边是去机场的方向。
transferEn: Ask a driver which way leads to the airport.

senseEn: exceptionally beautiful
en: The courtyard looks gorgeous at dusk.
zh: 庭院在黄昏时美极了。
transfer: 赞美朋友做的花束特别漂亮。
transferEn: Compliment the striking beauty of a friend's bouquet.

senseEn: without an intermediate transfer
en: Is there a direct train after six?
zh: 六点后有直达火车吗？
transfer: 询问旅馆是否有到机场的直达接驳车。
transferEn: Check for a shuttle to the airport without changes.

senseEn: unusual or unexpected
en: It's odd that the two keys have the same number.
zh: 两把钥匙编号一样，真奇怪。
transfer: 向工作人员指出票面日期和星期不符很奇怪。
transferEn: Point out a puzzling date and weekday mismatch on a ticket.

senseEn: a building for stage performances
en: Is the theater entrance around the corner?
zh: 剧院入口在拐角那边吗？
transfer: 问朋友看戏前要在哪家剧院门口见。
transferEn: Confirm which venue entrance to meet at before a play.

senseEn: the third month of the year
en: Does the garden reopen in March?
zh: 花园三月重新开放吗？
transfer: 问学校春季课程是不是三月底结束。
transferEn: Check whether a spring course ends in the third calendar month.

senseEn: authorized or formally issued
en: Is this the official timetable for the festival?
zh: 这是节庆活动的正式日程表吗？
transfer: 询问新政策的正式通知何时发出。
transferEn: Check when the authorized notice about a new policy will be sent.

senseEn: a result produced by something
en: What effect did the early opening have on queues?
zh: 提早开门对排队情况有什么影响？
transfer: 问店长改换照明后对客流有什么影响。
transferEn: Ask how a lighting change affected the number of visitors.

senseEn: the rear appendage of an animal
en: Why does that lizard have such a short tail?
zh: 那只蜥蜴的尾巴为什么这么短？
transfer: 请孩子辨认绘本里哪种动物尾巴最长。
transferEn: Ask a child to identify the illustrated animal with the longest rear appendage.

senseEn: the ability to see
en: Has your vision changed since your last eye test?
zh: 上次验光之后你的视力有变化吗？
transfer: 向护士描述光线变暗时你的视力怎样。
transferEn: Describe how well you can see in dim light to a nurse.

senseEn: fine dry particles settling on surfaces
en: There's dust inside the picture frame.
zh: 画框里面有灰。
transfer: 问维修员怎样清除键盘下的灰尘。
transferEn: Ask how to remove fine debris beneath a keyboard.

senseEn: prevent someone or something from getting free
en: Could that closing lid trap a finger?
zh: 盖子合上时会不会夹住手指？
transfer: 提醒朋友别把围巾夹在车门里。
transferEn: Warn a companion about a scarf getting caught in a car door.

senseEn: having substantial width
en: Is the gate wide enough for a wheelchair?
zh: 这扇门够宽，轮椅能过吗？
transfer: 询问走廊有多宽，看看沙发能不能搬进去。
transferEn: Check the corridor's width before moving a sofa.

senseEn: having an edge that cuts easily
en: Is this knife sharp enough to slice the tomatoes?
zh: 这把刀切番茄够锋利吗？
transfer: 提醒室友纸板边缘很锋利。
transferEn: Warn a roommate about a cardboard edge that could cut.

senseEn: a privilege or distinction, in British spelling
en: It's an honour to open the village festival.
zh: 能为村庄节庆活动揭幕，我深感荣幸。
transfer: 在欢迎词中表达能够介绍退休老师是你的荣幸。
transferEn: Express the privilege of introducing a retiring teacher in a welcome speech.

senseEn: to one side
en: Set the wet boards aside to dry.
zh: 把湿木板放一边晾干。
transfer: 请帮厨把装饰用的几颗莓果先放到一旁。
transferEn: Ask a kitchen helper to reserve some berries separately for decoration.

senseEn: a series of steps between levels
en: Are the stairs closed during the repainting?
zh: 重新刷漆时楼梯封闭吗？
transfer: 询问哪段楼梯通向天台。
transferEn: Ask which steps lead to the roof terrace.

senseEn: a level on a ship
en: Can passengers use the upper deck in this weather?
zh: 这种天气乘客能上层甲板吗？
transfer: 问船员哪层甲板可以寄放自行车。
transferEn: Ask a crew member which ship level has bicycle storage.

senseEn: courage in informal speech
en: It took guts to speak up when everyone disagreed.
zh: 所有人都反对，你还站出来发言，需要很大的勇气。
transfer: 跟朋友说你佩服她独自登台的勇气。
transferEn: Casually praise a friend's courage in going onstage alone.

senseEn: to a very high degree
en: The steps are extremely slippery after rain.
zh: 下过雨后这些台阶特别滑。
transfer: 告诉旅伴七月的营地夜间极冷。
transferEn: Emphasize how cold the campsite gets on July nights.

senseEn: different from what is normally expected
en: Is frost in May unusual here?
zh: 这里五月结霜少见吗？
transfer: 问园丁花朵在秋天再次开放是否不寻常。
transferEn: Check whether a second autumn bloom is out of the ordinary.

senseEn: very poor in quality, informally
en: We had a lousy view behind that pillar.
zh: 我们在那根柱子后面，视野糟透了。
transfer: 跟朋友抱怨车站的网络连接很差。
transferEn: Casually complain about poor connectivity at a station.

senseEn: a regularly published source of printed news
en: Did the local newspaper publish the new bus times?
zh: 本地报纸登了新的公交时刻表吗？
transfer: 问旅馆哪里可以买到今天的报纸。
transferEn: Ask a hotel where today's printed news is sold.

senseEn: the ability to act despite fear
en: It took courage to ask for help in front of the team.
zh: 在全队面前开口求助，需要勇气。
transfer: 向朋友说你佩服她第一次公开演讲的勇气。
transferEn: Tell a friend you admire her bravery in her first public talk.

senseEn: a firm round fruit grown on a tree
en: Can you slice the apple for the lunchbox?
zh: 能把苹果切片装进饭盒吗？
transfer: 问摊主哪种苹果适合做派。
transferEn: Ask a fruit seller which variety works best in a pie.

senseEn: the weekday following Monday
en: The repair van comes on Tuesday mornings.
zh: 维修车每周二上午来。
transfer: 询问周二下午能否取回干洗的外套。
transferEn: Check coat pickup availability on the afternoon after Monday.

senseEn: to a high degree, often expressing regret
en: I'm terribly sorry we sent the wrong tickets.
zh: 寄错票了，我们非常抱歉。
transfer: 向朋友表示你非常怀念旧街区。
transferEn: Emphasize how much you miss your old neighborhood.

senseEn: a vulgar informal term for urinating
en: The script uses “take a piss”; “use the restroom” fits the school version better.
zh: 剧本里用粗俗说法表示小便，学校版换成“上洗手间”更合适。
transfer: 向同伴解释为什么要把节目单里粗俗的小便说法改掉。
transferEn: Explain why a program should replace a vulgar expression for urination.

senseEn: an institution offering higher education and degrees
en: Can visitors use the university library on weekends?
zh: 访客周末能用大学图书馆吗？
transfer: 问同事她在哪所大学读的建筑。
transferEn: Ask where a colleague studied architecture for her degree.

senseEn: with attention and care
en: Read the delivery note carefully before signing.
zh: 签字前仔细读送货单。
transfer: 提醒同伴收拾玻璃器皿时要小心。
transferEn: Remind a partner to handle glassware with care.

senseEn: someone who creates written works
en: Will the writer sign copies after the reading?
zh: 朗读会后作家会签书吗？
transfer: 问馆员小说作者是否也写过儿童故事。
transferEn: Check whether a novelist has also written children's stories.

senseEn: the regular beat felt in an artery
en: Will the watch track my pulse during the walk?
zh: 走路时这块表会记录我的脉搏吗？
transfer: 问护士测脉搏前是否要先休息。
transferEn: Ask a nurse about resting before a heart-rate measurement.

senseEn: the outer limit of a surface
en: Keep the cup away from the edge of the desk.
zh: 把杯子放得离桌边远一点。
transfer: 告诉孩子别坐在舞台边缘。
transferEn: Ask a child not to sit at the outer rim of a stage.

senseEn: forbidden by law
en: Is parking here illegal after the market opens?
zh: 集市开始营业后，在这里停车违法吗？
transfer: 向工作人员确认在保护区摘花是否违法。
transferEn: Ask staff whether picking flowers in a reserve is prohibited by law.

senseEn: regret about an unfortunate outcome
en: What a pity the fog hid the lighthouse.
zh: 雾挡住了灯塔，真可惜。
transfer: 对朋友没能看成演出表示遗憾。
transferEn: Express regret that a friend missed a performance.

senseEn: something that prevents damage
en: Does the case offer protection against scratches?
zh: 这个外壳防刮吗？
transfer: 问店员这件外套能否防雨。
transferEn: Check how well a coat guards against rain.

senseEn: a long upholstered seat
en: Will the couch fit through the stairwell?
zh: 这张沙发能通过楼梯间吗？
transfer: 请室友找找沙发垫下面有没有遥控器。
transferEn: Ask a roommate to check under sofa cushions for a remote.

senseEn: a display surface for images or text
en: The screen goes dark whenever I unplug the charger.
zh: 我一拔掉充电线，屏幕就黑了。
transfer: 问维修员更换手机屏幕需多久。
transferEn: Check repair time for replacing a phone display.

senseEn: become visible
en: When will the confirmation number appear on the screen?
