zh: 确认号码什么时候会显示在屏幕上？
transfer: 问同伴地图图标是不是放大后才出现。
transferEn: Check whether a map icon becomes visible only after zooming in.

senseEn: of great personal value
en: These letters are precious to my grandmother.
zh: 这些信对我外婆很珍贵。
transfer: 向搬运工解释老照片为什么格外珍贵。
transferEn: Explain the sentimental value of old photos to a mover.

senseEn: a workspace for artistic or creative work
en: Can we visit the potter's studio after the demonstration?
zh: 演示结束后能参观陶艺家的工作室吗？
transfer: 询问哪间摄影工作室周日出租。
transferEn: Ask which photography workspace is available to rent on Sunday.

senseEn: take property from a person or place by force
en: Did someone rob the shop in the story, or was it a false alarm?
zh: 故事里真的有人抢劫了商店，还是虚惊一场？
transfer: 请同学确认小说里被抢的是哪位人物。
transferEn: Ask a classmate to identify the character robbed in a novel.

senseEn: having a rich yellow color
en: Bake the rolls until the tops are golden brown.
zh: 把小面包烤到表面呈金黄色。
transfer: 描述傍晚照在河面上的金色阳光。
transferEn: Describe the rich yellow light on a river at dusk.

senseEn: feeling fear
en: The puppy looks frightened by the fireworks.
zh: 小狗看起来被烟花吓到了。
transfer: 向老师解释孩子是被突然的铃声吓到了。
transferEn: Explain why a sudden bell scared a child.

senseEn: the person to whom something belongs
en: Has anyone found the owner of this suitcase?
zh: 有人找到这个箱子的主人了吗？
transfer: 问工作人员谁是停在门口的自行车车主。
transferEn: Find out who owns a bicycle parked by a doorway.

senseEn: relating to a monarch or their family
en: Is this the original royal carriage?
zh: 这就是当年的王室马车吗？
transfer: 向导游询问以前的王室花园对公众开放吗。
transferEn: Ask if a former monarch's garden now admits the public.

senseEn: have a plan to do something
en: Do you intend to keep the original shelves?
zh: 你打算保留原来的架子吗？
transfer: 告诉房东你计划再住一个月。
transferEn: Explain your plan to remain one more month to a landlord.

senseEn: the group of performers in a production
en: Will the cast stay for questions after the play?
zh: 戏结束后演员们会留下来回答问题吗？
transfer: 问主办方能否索取一份演员名单。
transferEn: Request a list of the performers from an organizer.

senseEn: someone held in prison
en: Was this diary written by a prisoner or a visitor?
zh: 这份日记是囚犯写的还是访客写的？
transfer: 问讲解员当年被关在岛上的囚犯住在哪栋建筑。
transferEn: Ask which building housed those detained on an island.

senseEn: liked or chosen by many people
en: Which trail is popular with families?
zh: 哪条步道受家庭游客欢迎？
transfer: 问餐厅哪道菜最受回头客欢迎。
transferEn: Ask which dish returning customers like best.

senseEn: a future thought to be determined in advance
en: Does the hero choose his own destiny in the ending?
zh: 结尾处英雄是自己选择命运的吗？
transfer: 讨论主人公是否相信自己的命运已经注定。
transferEn: Discuss whether a character believes their future is predetermined.

senseEn: an incident of theft by force or threat
en: Was anyone hurt in the robbery described in the report?
zh: 报道里那起抢劫案中有人受伤吗？
transfer: 问同学推理小说里的抢劫案发生在哪一年。
transferEn: Ask when a robbery in a mystery novel took place.

senseEn: making no sound
en: Is your phone on silent for the concert?
zh: 演出期间你的手机调静音了吗？
transfer: 提醒同伴进录音棚前把手表调静音。
transferEn: Ask a companion to mute a watch before entering a recording room.

senseEn: acts involving physical force intended to harm
en: Does the film contain graphic violence?
zh: 这部电影有直观血腥的暴力场面吗？
transfer: 帮朋友询问亲子场是否剪掉了暴力内容。
transferEn: Check whether a family screening removes violent material.

senseEn: relating to a country's central level of government
en: Is the bridge repair a federal project or a state one?
zh: 修桥是联邦项目还是州项目？
transfer: 问馆员档案出自州机构还是联邦机构。
transferEn: Ask if records come from a state or national government agency.

senseEn: something unexplained or unknown
en: Who moved the statue remains a mystery.
zh: 是谁移走了雕像，至今仍是个谜。
transfer: 向读书会说明故事中还有哪个谜没有解开。
transferEn: Identify an unresolved puzzle in a story for a book club.

senseEn: courage needed for an intimidating action
en: I finally got the nerve to sing at the open mic.
zh: 我终于鼓起勇气在开放麦唱了首歌。
transfer: 向同伴说明你终于敢向作者提问了。
transferEn: Tell a companion about finding the courage to question an author.

senseEn: a place lending or providing books
en: Does the library lend audiobooks to visitors?
zh: 图书馆会把有声书借给访客吗？
transfer: 问老师最近的公共图书馆在哪里。
transferEn: Locate the nearest public book-lending facility with a teacher.

senseEn: in the direction of a place
en: Turn toward the harbor at the clock tower.
zh: 到钟楼时朝港口方向转。
transfer: 指引孩子朝操场而不是朝停车场走。
transferEn: Direct a child to head for the playground instead of the car park.

senseEn: almost or nearly
en: The secondhand stove is practically new.
zh: 这台二手炉灶几乎是新的。
transfer: 告诉室友洗衣粉几乎用完了。
transferEn: Explain that the laundry powder is nearly gone.

senseEn: causing self-conscious discomfort
en: It was embarrassing to discover I'd worn two different shoes.
zh: 发现自己穿了两只不一样的鞋，真尴尬。
transfer: 和朋友说起在会议中叫错名字的尴尬经历。
transferEn: Describe the awkward experience of using the wrong name at a meeting.

senseEn: an image taken with a camera
en: Can you send the photo without the filter?
zh: 能把没加滤镜的照片发给我吗？
transfer: 请摄影师挑一张最清晰的合照。
transferEn: Ask a photographer to select the sharpest group picture.

senseEn: a tall narrow structure
en: Can visitors climb the clock tower on Sundays?
zh: 游客周日能登钟楼吗？
transfer: 询问从哪条小巷看得到古塔。
transferEn: Find out which alley offers a view of an old tall structure.

senseEn: a scheduled period of work
en: Who takes the night shift after me?
zh: 我之后谁上夜班？
transfer: 告诉同事早班几点开始。
transferEn: Tell a colleague when the morning work period begins.

senseEn: a close relationship between friends
en: Their friendship began at the village choir.
zh: 他们的友谊始于村里的合唱团。
transfer: 给老朋友写一句庆祝多年友谊的话。
transferEn: Write a line celebrating years of companionship with an old friend.

en: My grandmother worked as a maid in that house.
zh: 我祖母曾在那栋房子里当女佣。
transfer: 讲家族往事时介绍曾祖母年轻时的职业。
senseEn: a woman employed to do household work
transferEn: In a family story, describe your great-grandmother's job as a young woman.

senseEn: a small holder for cards and money
en: Has anyone handed in a brown wallet?
zh: 有人交来一个棕色钱包吗？
transfer: 告诉前台你的钱包留在出租车上了。
transferEn: Tell reception your card-and-cash holder was left in a taxi.

senseEn: a wrapped or boxed item for delivery
en: Can you leave the package with the caretaker?
zh: 能把包裹交给管理员吗？
transfer: 问邮局包裹是否需要签收。
transferEn: Check whether a parcel requires a signature.

senseEn: a selection covering several possibilities
en: Do you carry a range of sizes for children?
zh: 你们有多个儿童尺码吗？
transfer: 问美术店有没有一系列适合水彩的纸。
transferEn: Ask an art shop about its selection of watercolor papers.

senseEn: the blooming part of a plant
en: What flower blooms first in this garden each spring?
zh: 这座花园每年春天最先开的是什么花？
transfer: 请摊主帮你找香味淡的花。
transferEn: Ask a stallholder for a bloom with a mild scent.

senseEn: stable and not wobbling
en: Is the ladder steady on these tiles?
zh: 梯子放在这些地砖上稳吗？
transfer: 请同伴拿稳三脚架再拍照。
transferEn: Ask a companion to keep a tripod stable for a photograph.

sense: 干杯；也可在英式口语中表示谢谢
senseEn: a toast, also an informal British expression of thanks
en: Cheers to everyone who helped us finish the project!
zh: 为所有帮助我们完成项目的人干杯！
transfer: 在聚餐时举杯感谢团队的努力。
transferEn: Raise a glass at dinner to acknowledge your team's hard work.

senseEn: a thick strong cord
en: Is this rope long enough for the clothesline?
zh: 这段绳子用来当晾衣绳够长吗？
transfer: 向管理员借绳子扎好野餐毯。
transferEn: Borrow cord from an attendant for tying up a picnic blanket.

senseEn: precise, without approximation
en: Do I need the exact fare for the bus?
zh: 坐公交需要准备不多不少的零钱吗？
transfer: 向裁缝提供袖长的准确尺寸。
transferEn: Give a tailor the precise sleeve measurement.

senseEn: a visual representation
en: The projected image looks blurry on the left.
zh: 投影画面的左边看着有点模糊。
transfer: 请同事把网页上太暗的图像换掉。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to replace a dark graphic on a webpage.

senseEn: a machine used to transport people or goods
en: Can a delivery vehicle use the side entrance?
zh: 送货车辆可以走侧门吗？
transfer: 询问停车场可容纳多高的车辆。
transferEn: Check the height limit for transport entering a car park.

senseEn: meat from a large poultry bird often served at holidays
en: Is the turkey sandwich made fresh this morning?
zh: 火鸡三明治是今天早上现做的吗？
transfer: 问主人是否会用剩下的火鸡肉煮汤。
transferEn: Ask a host about using leftover holiday poultry in soup.

senseEn: without difficulty
en: Does the cover come off easily for washing?
zh: 这个套子容易拆下来洗吗？
transfer: 问店员这种雨衣能不能轻松折进口袋。
transferEn: Check whether a raincoat folds into a pocket without effort.

senseEn: particularly unpleasant
en: I got a nasty blister from those boots.
zh: 那双靴子把我脚磨出了个很难受的水泡。
transfer: 向房东描述水槽排水口那股难闻的气味。
transferEn: Describe a particularly unpleasant odor from a drain.

senseEn: dense tropical forest
en: Does the jungle trail require a guide?
zh: 走那条丛林步道必须有导游吗？
transfer: 问向导丛林里的步道何时最泥泞。
transferEn: Check when a tropical forest path is muddiest.

senseEn: reacting readily to a stimulus
en: My eyes are sensitive to bright light today.
zh: 我今天眼睛对强光很敏感。
transfer: 向理发师说明你的头皮对某些洗发水敏感。
transferEn: Tell a hairdresser your scalp reacts to certain shampoos.

senseEn: a deep container used for cooking
en: Will this pot fit on the small burner?
zh: 这口锅能放在小炉头上吗？
transfer: 请同伴把煮面的锅留给你。
transferEn: Ask a companion to leave you the cooking vessel for noodles.

senseEn: experience an unpleasant condition
en: Do you suffer from motion sickness on ferries?
zh: 你坐渡轮时会晕船吗？
transfer: 向医生说明你在花粉季常受鼻塞困扰。
transferEn: Describe recurring nasal congestion during pollen season.

senseEn: discarded waste in American usage
en: Where should guests put the trash on collection day?
zh: 收垃圾那天，客人该把垃圾放哪儿？
transfer: 问房东食物残渣是否能扔进普通垃圾里。
transferEn: Check whether food scraps belong with ordinary waste.

senseEn: an archaic singular subject pronoun for the listener
en: In this line “thou art” means “you are.”
zh: 这一行用的是古语，意思是“你是”。
transfer: 请给同学说明老剧本里称呼一个听者的主语怎样改成现代英语。
transferEn: Explain how to modernize an old subject pronoun addressing one listener in a play.

senseEn: a vehicle transporting patients for emergency care
en: Which entrance should the ambulance use?
zh: 救护车应该走哪个入口？
transfer: 向前台说明急救车辆已经到了侧门。
transferEn: Tell reception an emergency medical vehicle is at the side gate.

senseEn: the way someone acts
en: The notice explains what behavior is expected backstage.
zh: 告示说明了在后台应遵守的行为规范。
transfer: 向老师描述孩子换座位后的行为变化。
transferEn: Describe a child's change in conduct after switching seats.

senseEn: a frightening dream during sleep
en: Did a nightmare wake you up?
zh: 你是被噩梦惊醒的吗？
transfer: 告诉朋友你昨晚梦见自己迷路后惊醒。
transferEn: Describe waking from a frightening dream about being lost.

en: First prize is a weekend at the lake.
zh: 一等奖是在湖边度周末。
transfer: 问答比赛结束后，询问去哪里领取奖品。
senseEn: something awarded to a winner
transferEn: Ask where to collect your reward after a quiz.

senseEn: for each unit
en: Is parking charged per hour or per visit?
zh: 停车按小时还是按次收费？
transfer: 问旅馆早餐是按人还是按房收费。
transferEn: Check whether breakfast is priced by guest or by room.

senseEn: a long limbless reptile
en: Did the ranger identify the snake near the pond?
zh: 护林员辨认出池塘边那条蛇了吗？
transfer: 问动物园哪条蛇会在夜间活动。
transferEn: Ask a zookeeper which limbless reptile is active at night.

senseEn: a disease involving uncontrolled abnormal cell growth
en: Where is the cancer support group meeting tonight?
zh: 今晚癌症支持小组在哪里见面？
transfer: 问前台哪里能领取给癌症患者家属的资料。
transferEn: Locate information for families of people receiving oncology care.

senseEn: a citrus fruit with a thick peel
en: Could you peel an orange for the lunchbox?
zh: 能剥个橙子装进饭盒吗？
transfer: 问摊主哪种橙子适合榨汁。
transferEn: Ask a stallholder which citrus variety is suitable for juicing.

senseEn: organizations and channels reporting or distributing news
en: Will the local media cover the reopening?
zh: 本地媒体会报道重新开业的消息吗？
transfer: 询问组织者哪家媒体会直播音乐节。
transferEn: Check which outlet plans to broadcast a festival live.

senseEn: from another country
en: Does the machine accept foreign bank cards?
zh: 这台机器收外国银行卡吗？
transfer: 问租车公司是否接受外国驾照。
transferEn: Check if a rental company accepts licenses issued abroad.

senseEn: the language of Spain and many Latin American countries
en: Can visitors take the tour in Spanish?
zh: 游客可以参加西班牙语导览吗？
transfer: 询问这本童书有没有西班牙语版本。
transferEn: Check for an edition of a children's book in the language of Spain.

senseEn: a substance used to make something
en: What material is the seat cover made from?
zh: 座套是什么材料做的？
transfer: 问店员哪种材料的窗帘最遮光。
transferEn: Ask which curtain fabric blocks the most light.

senseEn: someone with specialized knowledge or skill
en: Is there an expert on old maps at the museum?
zh: 博物馆有研究老地图的专家吗？
transfer: 请馆员推荐熟悉古代陶器的专家。
transferEn: Request a specialist in ancient pottery from a curator.

senseEn: a benefit that makes something preferable
en: What's the advantage of booking both nights together?
zh: 连订两晚有什么好处？
transfer: 请店员解释可更换电池的优点。
transferEn: Ask a clerk about the benefit of a replaceable battery.

senseEn: showing poor manners or disrespect
en: Was it rude to leave before the final bow?
zh: 最后谢幕前离场是不是不礼貌？
transfer: 提醒同伴在讲解时插话显得无礼。
transferEn: Explain that interrupting a guide can seem discourteous.

senseEn: the edible interior of a fruit
en: Is the flesh of this melon usually pale green?
zh: 这种瓜的果肉通常是浅绿色的吗？
transfer: 向摊主询问哪种桃子果肉较硬。
transferEn: Ask a seller which peaches have firmer interiors.

senseEn: unhappy that expectations were not met
en: Were you disappointed with the sound in the hall?
zh: 你对礼堂里的音响效果失望吗？
transfer: 向旅馆说明你对房间景色感到失望。
transferEn: Describe your disappointment with the view from a room.

senseEn: someone officially checking compliance or condition
en: Will the building inspector need access to the roof?
zh: 建筑检查员需要上屋顶吗？
transfer: 告诉同事今天食品检查员会来。
transferEn: Notify a colleague of a visit from a food safety official.

senseEn: a seller's promise to address specified faults
en: Does the guarantee cover damage to the frame?
zh: 保修范围包括框架损坏吗？
transfer: 问店员维修后会不会提供书面保修。
transferEn: Check whether a repair comes with a written warranty.

senseEn: a group appointed to make decisions or manage a task
en: When does the planning committee review our application?
zh: 规划委员会什么时候审核我们的申请？
transfer: 询问哪位委员主持下次会议。
transferEn: Find out who will chair the next committee meeting.

senseEn: a raw, fast style of rock music
en: Is the punk band playing before the choir?
zh: 朋克乐队在合唱团之前演出吗？
transfer: 问唱片店哪张专辑适合第一次听朋克的人。
transferEn: Ask a record shop for an introduction to this fast rock style.

senseEn: in the central commercial part of a city
en: Can we park downtown after six without a permit?
zh: 六点以后在市中心停车可以不用许可证吗？
transfer: 告诉旅伴你的酒店位于市中心。
transferEn: Explain that your hotel is in the central urban district.

senseEn: a filling served between pieces of bread
en: Can I have the sandwich without mustard?
zh: 我的三明治能不放芥末吗？
transfer: 给朋友点一份能带上火车的三明治。
transferEn: Order a filled bread lunch for a friend to take on a train.

senseEn: moisture released through the skin
en: I need a towel to wipe the sweat off my face.
zh: 我需要条毛巾擦脸上的汗。
transfer: 向护士说明出汗是否发生在夜里。
transferEn: Tell a nurse whether perspiration happens at night.

senseEn: relating to government or public affairs
en: Does the archive keep old political posters?
zh: 档案馆收藏旧政治宣传海报吗？
transfer: 询问讲座是否介绍这次改革的政治背景。
transferEn: Check if a talk covers the political context of a reform.

senseEn: sudden strong fear impairing clear thought
en: The false alarm caused panic in the lobby.
zh: 误报把大厅里的人都吓慌了。
transfer: 描述站台临时关闭时人群的惊慌。
transferEn: Describe the alarm and confusion when a platform closed unexpectedly.

senseEn: without a pattern or decoration
en: Do you have a plain blue cover without the stripes?
zh: 有没有不带条纹的纯蓝色套子？
transfer: 询问是否有不印字的纯色购物袋。
transferEn: Ask for an unprinted shopping bag in a single color.

senseEn: a presentation for an audience
en: Is the evening performance sold out?
zh: 晚上的演出票卖完了吗？
transfer: 询问孩子能否在演出结束后见演员。
transferEn: Check whether children can meet the performers after the show.

senseEn: a deep loud resonant sound
en: Was that boom from the storm or the stage speakers?
zh: 那声轰隆响是雷声还是舞台音箱发出的？
transfer: 向管理员描述门关上时听到的轰隆声。
transferEn: Describe a deep resonant noise when a door closed.

senseEn: an organization representing workers' interests
en: Has the union approved the revised shift plan?
zh: 工会同意调整后的排班计划了吗？
transfer: 问工友怎样联系工会代表。
transferEn: Ask a coworker how to reach the workers' representative.

senseEn: edible produce such as apples and pears
en: Is fresh fruit included in the breakfast box?
zh: 早餐盒里有新鲜水果吗？
transfer: 请摊主推荐适合带上长途火车的水果。
transferEn: Ask a seller for produce that travels well on a long train ride.

senseEn: an insulated lead carrying power or signals
en: Does this cable fit the projector?
zh: 这条线能接这台投影仪吗？
transfer: 请同事带一条能连接笔记本和显示器的线。
transferEn: Ask for a lead connecting a laptop to a monitor.

senseEn: a stated reason against a proposal
en: Does anyone have an objection to meeting online?
zh: 有人反对线上开会吗？
transfer: 问委员会对提前开放场地有什么异议。
transferEn: Ask what concerns committee members have about opening a venue early.

senseEn: the informal British term for one's mother
en: My mum packed extra sandwiches for the trip.
zh: 我妈为这趟旅行多准备了些三明治。
transfer: 用英式口语告诉朋友你妈妈会来车站接你。
transferEn: Use casual British English to explain who in your family is collecting you.

senseEn: kept apart rather than combined
en: Could we have separate receipts for the two orders?
zh: 两笔订单能分别开小票吗？
transfer: 请服务员把甜点放在单独的盒子里。
transferEn: Ask a server to pack dessert in a box of its own.

senseEn: clothing worn beneath outer garments
en: Is thermal underwear available in children's sizes?
zh: 保暖内衣有儿童尺码吗？
transfer: 问店员打包好的内衣是否允许试穿。
transferEn: Check a shop's fitting policy for packaged undergarments.

senseEn: belonging to the distant past
en: Are the ancient tiles still in their original positions?
zh: 这些古代地砖还留在原来的位置上吗？
transfer: 向馆员询问古代钱币陈列在哪个展厅。
transferEn: Locate an exhibition of coins from the distant past.

senseEn: a fortified historic residence
en: Is the castle courtyard open without a ticket?
zh: 城堡庭院可以免票参观吗？
transfer: 问向导从车站步行到城堡需要多久。
transferEn: Ask how long it takes to walk from the station to a fortified residence.

senseEn: very pleasing in flavor
en: That delicious sauce has ginger in it, doesn't it?
zh: 那酱汁真好吃，里面有姜吧？
transfer: 称赞主人烤的面包美味。
transferEn: Compliment a host on the flavor of homemade bread.

senseEn: the amount something is worth
en: What value should I declare for this used camera?
zh: 这台旧相机该申报多少价值？
transfer: 询问保险单怎样计算自行车的价值。
transferEn: Ask how an insurer determines what a bicycle is worth.

senseEn: draw a ring around something
en: Please circle the date that works for you.
zh: 请圈出你方便的日期。
transfer: 让孩子把地图上的家所在地点圈出来。
transferEn: Ask a child to mark their home on a map with a ring.

senseEn: feeling extremely unhappy or uncomfortable
en: Those wet boots made the walk miserable.
zh: 穿着湿靴子走那段路难受极了。
transfer: 向室友形容暖气坏了那晚你有多难受。
transferEn: Describe your discomfort on a night when the heating failed.

senseEn: great honor or admiration won by achievement
en: The documentary looks beyond the glory of winning the cup.
zh: 这部纪录片还关注夺冠荣耀背后的事。
transfer: 谈谈冠军队在采访中将荣耀归功于谁。
transferEn: Discuss whom the champions credited for their moment of honor.

senseEn: a group of players selected for a team
en: Has the coach named the squad for Saturday?
zh: 教练公布周六的球队名单了吗？
transfer: 问队长替补门将是否加入本次阵容。
transferEn: Check whether a reserve goalkeeper made the selected team.

senseEn: throw away informally
en: Don't chuck that box; I need it for moving.
zh: 别把那箱子扔了，我搬家要用。
transfer: 随口问室友能否扔掉过期的传单。
transferEn: Casually ask a roommate about discarding outdated flyers.

senseEn: succeed in doing something despite difficulty
en: Did you manage to book a van for tomorrow?
zh: 明天的面包车你设法订到了吗？
transfer: 问同事最后是否成功修好打印机。
transferEn: Find out whether a colleague succeeded in repairing a printer.

senseEn: a deep round dish
en: Could I have a small bowl for the olives?
zh: 能给我个小碗放橄榄吗？
transfer: 请同伴拿个大碗拌沙拉。
transferEn: Ask a companion to fetch a deep dish for mixing salad.

senseEn: the numerical value of nothing
en: The scale should read zero before you add the flour.
zh: 加面粉前秤应该显示零。
transfer: 请同伴确认计时器已经归零。
transferEn: Check that a timer has been reset to nothing.

senseEn: success in a contest
en: Was that their first victory this season?
zh: 那是他们本赛季首胜吗？
transfer: 向队友提议庆祝刚取得的胜利。
transferEn: Suggest celebrating the team's latest win.

senseEn: uncomfortably self-conscious
en: I was embarrassed when my phone rang onstage.
zh: 我在台上时手机响了，真尴尬。
transfer: 告诉朋友你认错人后觉得不好意思。
transferEn: Describe the awkwardness of mistaking a stranger for someone else.

senseEn: a living animal or being
en: What creature made these tiny footprints?
zh: 这些小脚印是什么生物留下的？
transfer: 向向导打听岩石缝里发光的生物。
transferEn: Ask about a glowing animal in a rock crevice.

senseEn: state that a claim is untrue
en: Did the venue deny the rumor about moving the concert?
zh: 场馆否认了演出要换场地的传言吗？
transfer: 讨论当事人是否否认借过那辆自行车。
transferEn: Discuss whether someone said a claim about borrowing a bike was untrue.

senseEn: a court sport involving shooting into a raised hoop
en: Is there basketball practice after school today?
zh: 今天放学后有篮球训练吗？
transfer: 询问社区中心周末能否打篮球。
transferEn: Check weekend access for playing the hoop-based court sport.

senseEn: the path taken to a destination
en: Does this route avoid the steep steps?
zh: 这条路线能避开陡台阶吗？
transfer: 请导游指出回营地最短的路线。
transferEn: Ask a guide for the shortest way back to camp.

senseEn: not often seen or found
en: Is that bird rare in this valley?
zh: 那种鸟在这个山谷里少见吗？
transfer: 问馆员这枚钱币为何罕见。
transferEn: Ask a curator what makes a coin uncommon.

senseEn: a day when ordinary work often pauses
en: Is the ticket office open on the public holiday?
zh: 公共假日售票处营业吗？
transfer: 询问节假日期间公交按哪张时刻表运行。
transferEn: Check which bus timetable applies on a day off work.

senseEn: without a detour or intermediate stop
en: Does this bus go directly to the terminal?
zh: 这辆公交直达航站楼吗？
transfer: 请快递员把包裹直接交给接待员。
transferEn: Request hand delivery to reception without an intermediate stop.

senseEn: movement toward a goal
en: How can I track my progress in listening practice?
zh: 我该怎么跟踪听力练习的进展？
transfer: 向老师询问孩子在阅读方面的进步。
transferEn: Ask a teacher about a child's improvement in reading.

senseEn: take something away from its position
en: Can I remove the cover for washing?
zh: 我能把套子拆下来洗吗？
transfer: 请搬运工先卸下柜子的搁板。
transferEn: Ask movers to take the shelves out of a cabinet first.

senseEn: a moving ridge on water
en: That wave reached the bottom step of the pier.
zh: 那波浪拍到了码头最底下的台阶。
transfer: 提醒同伴海浪溅到了步道上。
transferEn: Warn that water from the surf is splashing onto a path.

senseEn: official power to decide or act
en: Who has authority to approve the repair?
zh: 谁有权批准这次维修？
transfer: 询问值班经理是否有权限免除改签费。
transferEn: Check whether a duty manager can authorize waiving a change fee.

senseEn: connected metal links
en: The bike chain came off near the bridge.
zh: 自行车链条在桥附近掉了。
transfer: 请修车工检查车链是否太松。
transferEn: Ask a mechanic about excessive slack in a bicycle's metal links.

senseEn: to a considerable degree
en: The guide comes highly recommended by our host.
zh: 我们的主人极力推荐这位导游。
transfer: 告诉学员教练高度评价他们的配合。
transferEn: Report a coach's strong approval of the students' teamwork.

senseEn: showing strong feelings
en: Her farewell speech was too emotional to finish in one go.
zh: 告别致辞时她太激动，没能一口气说完。
transfer: 形容队长在最后一场比赛结束后的激动心情。
transferEn: Describe the captain's strong feelings after a final match.

senseEn: a dark shape formed when light is blocked
en: The tree's shadow reaches the bench by noon.
zh: 到中午时树影就能遮到长椅。
transfer: 请摄影师避开落在脸上的阴影。
transferEn: Ask a photographer to avoid the dark patch across a face.

senseEn: contrary to fact
en: The notice gives a false impression that parking is free.
zh: 这张告示让人误以为停车免费。
transfer: 提醒同伴群里转的演出取消消息不实。
transferEn: Warn a companion about an untrue cancellation report.

senseEn: the color between black and white
en: The gray jacket by the door is mine.
zh: 门边那件灰夹克是我的。
transfer: 向店员描述你想买浅灰色窗帘。
transferEn: Request curtains in a pale shade between black and white.

senseEn: leave out a step or activity
en: Can we skip the introduction and go straight to questions?
zh: 我们能略过介绍，直接提问吗？
transfer: 问老师已做过的那段练习可不可以跳过。
transferEn: Check whether a completed exercise can be omitted.

senseEn: a large property comprising land and buildings
en: Does the estate tour include the walled garden?
zh: 庄园导览包括参观围墙花园吗？
transfer: 询问旧庄园的马厩是否开放参观。
transferEn: Check if stables on a historic property admit visitors.

sense: 贬损女性的粗俗侮辱词
senseEn: a strongly offensive sexual insult directed at a woman
en: The moderator removed the word “whore” because it was used to abuse a player.
zh: 管理员删除了这个粗俗词，因为有人用它侮辱一名球员。
transfer: 向管理员报告带性别羞辱的留言，并要求制止人身攻击。
transferEn: Report a sexually degrading comment and ask a moderator to stop personal abuse.

senseEn: a vehicle's audible warning device
en: Is the taxi's horn stuck? It's been sounding for a minute.
zh: 出租车的喇叭是不是卡住了？已经响了一分钟。
transfer: 向修理工说明汽车喇叭没有声音。
transferEn: Tell a mechanic that a car's warning sound does not work.

senseEn: a room or level below ground
en: Is the basement dry enough for storing books?
zh: 地下室够干燥，可以放书吗？
transfer: 问房东地下室有没有洗衣机。
transferEn: Ask whether the below-ground floor has a washing machine.

senseEn: enjoyable or agreeable
en: We had a pleasant walk back along the canal.
zh: 我们沿运河愉快地走了回来。
transfer: 告诉主人在她的花园里度过的下午很愉快。
transferEn: Tell a host how enjoyable the afternoon in her garden was.

senseEn: a distance of about 1.6 kilometers
en: Is the campsite less than a mile from the stop?
zh: 营地离车站不到一英里吗？
transfer: 问骑行同伴下一个补给点还差几英里。
transferEn: Ask a cycling partner about the remaining distance in miles.

senseEn: decline to accept or do something
en: Can I refuse the delivery if the box is open?
zh: 箱子如果打开了，我能拒收吗？
transfer: 向同事说明你为何拒绝临时换班。
transferEn: Explain to a colleague why you declined a last-minute shift swap.

senseEn: move closer to something
en: Please slow down as you approach the crossing.
zh: 接近人行横道时请减速。
transfer: 提醒同伴靠近码头时留意湿滑的台阶。
transferEn: Warn a companion about slick steps when nearing a pier.

senseEn: stop being visible
en: Does the icon disappear when the battery is full?
zh: 电池充满时图标会消失吗？
transfer: 问朋友屏幕上的提示什么时候消失。
transferEn: Check when a notice stops showing on a screen.

senseEn: a particular area within a city or region
en: Is the pottery fair in the old district?
zh: 陶艺集市是在老城区吗？
transfer: 问司机哪一区离海滩最近。
transferEn: Ask a driver which part of town lies closest to the beach.

senseEn: an error in software behavior
en: Has the calendar bug been fixed in this update?
zh: 这次更新修好日历的故障了吗？
transfer: 向客服描述应用把周五显示成周四的故障。
transferEn: Report an app fault that displays Friday as Thursday.

senseEn: a small long-eared mammal
en: Did the rabbit get into the vegetable patch again?
zh: 兔子又钻进菜地了吗？
transfer: 向寄养员说明你的兔子喜欢吃哪种干草。
transferEn: Tell a sitter which hay your long-eared pet prefers.

senseEn: an informal exclamation of surprise or irritation
en: Jeez, that ticket machine is slow!
zh: 哎呀，这售票机真慢！
transfer: 跟熟友对临时换站台表示惊讶。
transferEn: React informally to an unexpected platform change.

en: The defending champion plays on court two at noon.
zh: 卫冕冠军中午在二号球场比赛。
transfer: 向校报介绍刚刚获得市赛冠军的队友。
senseEn: the winner of a competition
transferEn: Introduce a teammate who won the city tournament to the school newspaper.

senseEn: move onward to a destination
en: Please proceed to gate fourteen for boarding.
zh: 请前往十四号登机口登机。
transfer: 用正式语气请来宾到大厅登记。
transferEn: Formally direct guests onward to registration in the lobby.

senseEn: an organized contest
en: When does the photography competition stop accepting entries?
zh: 摄影比赛什么时候截止收件？
transfer: 问组织者烘焙比赛能不能组队参加。
transferEn: Check whether teams may enter a baking contest.

senseEn: the state of being physically there
en: Is my presence required at the handover?
zh: 交接时我本人必须在场吗？
transfer: 问组织者排练是否需要家长到场。
transferEn: Check whether parents must attend a rehearsal in person.

senseEn: a period of one hundred years
en: Was the mill built in the nineteenth century?
zh: 这座磨坊是在十九世纪建的吗？
transfer: 请馆员确认展出的钟属于哪个世纪。
transferEn: Ask a curator to date a clock to a hundred-year period.

senseEn: eliminate an illness
en: Does the leaflet say the medicine can cure the infection or only ease symptoms?
zh: 说明书说这种药能治愈感染，还是只能缓解症状？
transfer: 请医生解释治疗目标是治愈疾病还是减轻不适。
transferEn: Ask a physician whether the goal is eliminating an illness or easing discomfort.

senseEn: having the ability to do something
en: Is this lift capable of carrying the piano?
zh: 这部电梯有能力承载这架钢琴吗？
transfer: 询问新泵能否同时给两套设备供水。
transferEn: Check whether a pump has the capacity to supply two machines.

senseEn: firmly persuaded of something
en: I'm convinced the noise comes from the hinge.
zh: 我确信声音是铰链发出的。
transfer: 根据照片向同伴解释为什么你确信找对了地点。
transferEn: Use a photograph to explain your certainty about the location.

senseEn: increase in size from fluid or injury
en: Did your ankle swell after the walk?
zh: 走完路以后脚踝肿了吗？
transfer: 向护士描述手腕什么时候开始肿。
transferEn: Tell a nurse when a wrist began increasing in size.

senseEn: a formal order issued by an authority
en: Does the exhibit show the original warrant or a copy?
zh: 展出的是令状原件还是复制件？
transfer: 请档案馆员辨认旧案卷里签发令状的日期。
transferEn: Ask an archivist to identify the date of a formal order in an old case.

senseEn: a possible source of harm
en: Does drought pose a threat to these young trees?
zh: 干旱会威胁这些树苗吗？
transfer: 问园丁寒潮是否会威胁新种的香草。
transferEn: Check whether a cold snap endangers newly planted herbs.

senseEn: for that reason
en: The hall is closed and therefore unavailable for rehearsal.
zh: 礼堂关闭了，因此不能用于排练。
transfer: 用书面语说明桥封闭，因此要改换路线。
transferEn: Explain in writing why a bridge closure requires a different route.

senseEn: put beneath soil or another covering
en: How deep should I bury the bulbs?
zh: 这些球茎应该埋多深？
transfer: 问园丁压在土里的根部要埋到什么位置。
transferEn: Ask how much of a plant's roots should be covered with soil.

senseEn: give out light
en: Does the sun shine into this room in the morning?
zh: 早上阳光会照进这间屋吗？
transfer: 问主人傍晚的阳光能不能照到露台。
transferEn: Check whether evening sunlight reaches a terrace.

senseEn: a hard precious gemstone
en: Is the diamond in this pendant certified?
zh: 这枚吊坠上的钻石有证书吗？
transfer: 问珠宝商修理前能否拍下钻石的位置。
transferEn: Ask a jeweler to photograph a gemstone setting before repairing it.

senseEn: the fourth month of the year
en: Are the gardens open in April?
zh: 花园四月开放吗？
transfer: 确认春季展览是否在四月最后一个周末结束。
transferEn: Check whether a spring exhibition ends on the last weekend of the fourth month.

senseEn: a piece of sports equipment for hitting a ball
en: Can I borrow a lighter bat for practice?
zh: 训练时我能借一根轻点的球棒吗？
transfer: 请教练说明儿童球棒适合的长度。
transferEn: Ask a coach about the ideal length of a child's hitting implement.

senseEn: a notification calling attention to something
en: Can I turn off the low-battery alert during recording?
zh: 录音时可以关掉低电量提示吗？
transfer: 问同伴怎样打开列车晚点提醒。
transferEn: Find out how to enable a notification about train delays.

senseEn: a thin crisp slice of fried potato
en: Is this potato chip flavored with vinegar?
zh: 这片薯片是醋味的吗？
transfer: 问店员哪袋薯片是原味无盐的。
transferEn: Ask a clerk for plain unsalted potato crisps.

senseEn: change from one service to another
en: Where do we transfer to the airport bus?
zh: 我们在哪儿换乘机场大巴？
transfer: 问工作人员从蓝线换红线是否需要出站。
transferEn: Check whether changing rail lines requires leaving the station.

senseEn: a complete unit of written or spoken language
en: Could you read the last sentence aloud?
zh: 能把最后一句读出来吗？
transfer: 请老师指出作文中哪一句需要添加主语。
transferEn: Ask a teacher which line of an essay lacks a subject.

senseEn: exceptionally enjoyable or impressive
en: The choir sounded fabulous in the new hall.
zh: 合唱团在新礼堂唱得棒极了。
transfer: 向同伴夸奖露台上的景色美极了。
transferEn: Praise a particularly splendid terrace view.

senseEn: a country considered as a political community
en: Which nation hosted the first tournament?
zh: 第一届比赛是哪个国家举办的？
transfer: 问馆员哪几个国家参与了这次联合考察。
transferEn: Ask which countries participated in a joint expedition.

en: We need unsalted butter for these cookies.
zh: 我们做这些饼干需要无盐黄油。
transfer: 早餐时请服务员给吐司配一小块黄油。
senseEn: a spread made by churning cream
transferEn: Ask a server for a small pat of dairy spread for your breakfast toast.

senseEn: a British nobleman holding a hereditary title below a marquess
en: Was the clock a gift from the earl?
zh: 这座钟是伯爵送的礼物吗？
transfer: 请导游指出伯爵以前在哪个房间接待来客。
transferEn: Identify the room where a British nobleman received guests.

senseEn: someone gathering and presenting news
en: Did the reporter interview the volunteers after the rescue?
zh: 救援结束后记者采访志愿者了吗？
transfer: 问组织者哪位记者在报道募捐活动。
transferEn: Ask who is covering a fundraiser for the news.

senseEn: a small enclosed stand at an event
en: Which booth sells the pottery workshop tickets?
zh: 哪个摊位卖陶艺工作坊的票？
transfer: 请主办方指出失物招领摊位。
transferEn: Locate the lost-property stand at an event.

senseEn: a venue offering gambling games
en: Is the concert hall inside the casino building?
zh: 音乐厅是在赌场大楼里面吗？
transfer: 问酒店前台能否不穿过赌场就到剧院。
transferEn: Ask hotel reception for a theater route avoiding the gaming venue.

senseEn: achieving the desired result
en: Was the successful trial repeated at both sites?
zh: 那次成功的试验在两个场地都复做过吗？
transfer: 问项目负责人怎样判断展会是否成功。
transferEn: Ask how an organizer judges an exhibition's success.

senseEn: a state of something being possible
en: Is there a possibility of an earlier appointment?
zh: 有可能约到更早的时间吗？
transfer: 向组织者询问活动改在室内的可能性。
transferEn: Check the chances of an event moving indoors.

senseEn: to a very high degree, informally
en: It's awfully cold by the open door.
zh: 门开着，旁边实在冷。
transfer: 向熟人说你非常感激他特地来帮忙。
transferEn: Informally emphasize gratitude for a friend's special effort.

senseEn: fine loose grains of rock
en: There's sand in the camera case after the beach trip.
zh: 去过海滩后，相机包里进沙了。
transfer: 提醒同伴把鞋里的沙倒出来。
transferEn: Ask a companion to empty beach grit from their shoes.

senseEn: a strong wish for something
en: Her desire to teach brought her back to the village.
zh: 当老师的愿望让她回到村里。
transfer: 向面试官说明你想学修复旧家具的愿望。
transferEn: Describe your strong wish to learn furniture restoration in an interview.

senseEn: bend forward in acknowledgment
en: Should we bow together after the last song?
zh: 最后一首歌后我们要一起鞠躬吗？
transfer: 问导演什么时候向观众鞠躬谢幕。
transferEn: Ask a director for the cue to bend forward for applause.

senseEn: an enclosure with bars or wire
en: Is the bird's cage door closed properly?
zh: 鸟笼的门关好了吗？
transfer: 向兽医询问小兔运输笼需要多大。
transferEn: Ask a vet about the appropriate size of a rabbit's travel enclosure.

senseEn: a wild canine that often lives in packs
en: Did the wolf tracks continue across the stream?
zh: 狼的足迹一直延伸到溪流对面了吗？
transfer: 问向导远处叫声是否来自一只狼。
transferEn: Ask a guide whether a distant howl came from a wild canine.

sense: 针对黑人的极端侮辱性种族歧视词，仅供识别
senseEn: an extremely offensive anti-Black racial slur
en: The exhibit identifies “nigger” as an anti-Black slur and explains its history.
zh: 展览指出这个词是针对黑人的种族侮辱语，并解释了它的历史。
transfer: 向活动管理员报告针对黑人的种族辱骂，无需重述原话。
transferEn: Report anti-Black racist abuse to an event moderator without repeating the wording.

senseEn: a distinct section of a large building
en: Is the portrait gallery in the east wing?
zh: 肖像画廊在东翼吗？
transfer: 向前台确认西翼病房是否另有入口。
transferEn: Ask reception whether the western hospital section has its own entrance.

senseEn: replace a purchase with another item
en: Can I exchange these gloves for a smaller pair?
zh: 这双手套可以换小一号吗？
transfer: 问客服损坏的杯子能否在店里直接换。
transferEn: Ask support about replacing a damaged mug in-store.

senseEn: having little thickness
en: Is the thin blanket warm enough for spring?
zh: 这条薄毯春天用够暖吗？
transfer: 询问店员有没有更薄的笔记本。
transferEn: Request a notebook with less thickness.

senseEn: feeling uninterested in what is happening
en: The children got bored waiting for the rain to stop.
zh: 孩子们等雨停等得无聊了。
transfer: 告诉朋友你在旅途中等换乘时觉得无聊。
transferEn: Describe losing interest during a long wait for a connection.

senseEn: an animal kept for companionship
en: Is there a pet fee for bringing our cat?
zh: 带我们的猫要付宠物费吗？
transfer: 向旅馆确认一间房能带几只宠物。
transferEn: Check the room limit for companion animals.

senseEn: tear fabric or paper
en: Did the zipper rip the lining again?
zh: 拉链又把衬里扯破了吗？
transfer: 提醒朋友拆包裹时别撕坏里面的海报。
transferEn: Warn a friend not to tear the poster while opening a parcel.

senseEn: a set of related works or events
en: Is this the first film in the series?
zh: 这是这个系列的第一部电影吗？
transfer: 询问图书馆是否备齐了同一系列的导览手册。
transferEn: Check whether a library has all the guides in a related collection.

senseEn: a serious narrative film or play
en: Is tonight's film a drama or a comedy?
zh: 今晚的电影是正剧还是喜剧？
transfer: 向馆员借一部以港口生活为背景的剧情片。
transferEn: Request a serious narrative film set in a harbor town.

senseEn: work assigned to be done outside class
en: Are we supposed to upload the homework by Friday?
zh: 我们是不是得在周五前上传作业？
transfer: 问老师纸质作业应该交给谁。
transferEn: Check who collects written assignments done at home.

senseEn: completely in every part
en: Is the new trail entirely paved?
zh: 这条新步道全程都铺了路面吗？
transfer: 询问会议是否完全在线上举行。
transferEn: Check whether every part of a meeting takes place online.

senseEn: an area designated for a particular purpose
en: Is the loading zone free after six?
zh: 装卸区六点后空着可以用吗？
transfer: 问管理员草地上哪片区域允许携犬进入。
transferEn: Locate the designated dog-friendly part of a lawn.

senseEn: an account making something understandable
en: Did the operator give an explanation for the delay?
zh: 运营方说明晚点原因了吗？
transfer: 请老师解释图中缺少的那个步骤。
transferEn: Ask a teacher to clarify the missing step in a diagram.

senseEn: a person secretly gathering information in a story or reality
en: Who plays the retired spy in the new series?
zh: 新剧里的退休间谍是谁演的？
transfer: 问读书会成员小说中的间谍在哪一章登场。
transferEn: Ask which chapter introduces a novel's secret agent.

senseEn: give someone confidence about something
en: I assure you the duplicate charge was removed.
zh: 我向您保证，那笔重复扣费已经撤销了。
transfer: 向客人保证客房钥匙已经停用。
transferEn: Reassure a guest that a room key has been deactivated.

senseEn: a breakdown in a system or machine
en: Was the delay caused by a signal failure?
zh: 这次晚点是信号故障引起的吗？
transfer: 向物业报告门禁系统故障。
transferEn: Report a breakdown in a building's access controls.

senseEn: pick up an item waiting for someone
en: Where do we collect the keys after hours?
zh: 非办公时间我们去哪里领钥匙？
transfer: 询问车站遗失物品该去哪里取。
transferEn: Ask where to pick up recovered belongings at a station.

senseEn: a sudden loud impact sound
en: I heard a loud bang when the shelf fell.
zh: 架子掉下来时我听到砰的一声巨响。
transfer: 向室友描述门被风吹上时的声音。
transferEn: Describe the sudden impact sound of a door closing in the wind.

senseEn: produce a paper copy
en: Could you print both sides of this form?
zh: 能帮我把这张表双面打印吗？
transfer: 问前台能不能打印一张登机牌。
transferEn: Ask reception to produce a paper boarding pass.

senseEn: introduce a service or product to the public
en: When will the library launch the app?
zh: 图书馆什么时候推出这个应用？
transfer: 询问新公交服务计划什么时候推出。
transferEn: Check when a new bus service will be introduced.

senseEn: unable to serve a useful purpose
en: This adapter is useless without the matching cable.
zh: 没有配套的线，这个转接头没用。
transfer: 解释为什么旧地图在新开的路段派不上用场。
transferEn: Explain why an old map cannot help on a newly built road.

senseEn: the transport of goods to a recipient
en: Can I choose a delivery time for the sofa?
zh: 沙发送货时间可以选吗？
transfer: 询问配送费用是否包括送上楼。
transferEn: Check whether a shipping charge covers carrying an item upstairs.

senseEn: a trip from one place to another
en: Does the return journey include a change of buses?
zh: 回程需要换公交吗？
transfer: 向朋友描述从码头到村庄那段旅程。
transferEn: Describe the trip from a pier to a village.

senseEn: a raised body temperature
en: Did the fever start before or after the rash?
zh: 是先发烧还是先出疹？
transfer: 向诊所说明昨晚测出发烧的时间。
transferEn: Tell a clinic when a raised temperature was measured last night.

senseEn: a physical activity played under rules
en: Is rowing the only sport offered at the camp?
zh: 营地只提供赛艇这一项运动吗？
transfer: 问新同学最喜欢哪种团队运动。
transferEn: Ask a new classmate which team activity they like best.

senseEn: a demanding task or difficulty
en: Our biggest challenge is moving the piano upstairs.
zh: 我们最大的难题是把钢琴搬上楼。
transfer: 向同事说明露天活动最大的困难是什么。
transferEn: Explain the hardest part of running an outdoor event.

senseEn: an item temporarily borrowed for use
en: The camera is on loan from the college.
zh: 这台相机是向学院借来的。
transfer: 告诉访客画廊那幅画是哪家博物馆借出的。
transferEn: Identify which museum lent a painting to a gallery.

senseEn: a regular sequence of actions
en: What's the morning routine at the camp?
zh: 营地早上通常怎么安排？
transfer: 向宠物寄养员描述狗每天晚上的作息。
transferEn: Describe a dog's regular evening activities to a sitter.

senseEn: a sweet carbonated soft drink
en: Can I swap the soda for sparkling water?
zh: 我能把汽水换成气泡水吗？
transfer: 问店员套餐汽水是否可以不加冰。
transferEn: Check whether a fizzy soft drink in a meal deal can come without ice.

senseEn: the storage compartment of a car
en: Will the stroller fit in the trunk of the taxi?
zh: 婴儿车放得进出租车的后备厢吗？
transfer: 告诉司机购物袋留在车的后备厢里。
transferEn: Tell a driver some bags were left in the car's luggage compartment.

senseEn: a covering worn over the face
en: Can the actor see through the mask onstage?
zh: 演员在舞台上戴着面具能看清吗？
transfer: 问孩子化装舞会上想戴什么面具。
transferEn: Ask a child which face covering they want for a costume party.

senseEn: the outcome of a test or process
en: When will the result of the placement test be posted?
zh: 分班测试的结果什么时候公布？
transfer: 向维修员询问压力测试的结果。
transferEn: Ask a technician for the outcome of a pressure test.

senseEn: a strong enthusiasm for an activity
en: Where did your passion for restoring clocks begin?
zh: 你对修复时钟的热爱是怎么开始的？
transfer: 采访邻居时问她如何爱上了合唱。
transferEn: Interview a neighbor about the origins of her enthusiasm for choir singing.

senseEn: a handbag for personal belongings
en: I left my purse under the café table.
zh: 我把手提包落在咖啡馆桌子下了。
transfer: 在失物处描述你那只装着眼镜的手提包。
transferEn: Describe the handbag holding your glasses at lost property.

senseEn: disagree in an angry exchange
en: Let's not argue over who forgot the key.
zh: 我们别为了是谁忘了拿钥匙争执了。
transfer: 请队友别再为球出没出界而吵。
transferEn: Ask teammates to stop quarreling over whether a ball was out.

senseEn: move upward using effort
en: Can we climb the tower before the tour starts?
zh: 导览开始前我们能登塔吗？
transfer: 问向导从营地爬到山顶需要多久。
transferEn: Check the time needed to ascend from camp to a summit.

senseEn: meat from cattle
en: Is the beef stew made with red wine?
zh: 这道炖牛肉加了红酒吗？
transfer: 询问面馆牛肉面用的是哪部位的肉。
transferEn: Ask which cut of cattle meat is used in noodle soup.

senseEn: bring something back to mind
en: Do you recall the name of the repair shop?
zh: 你还想得起修理店叫什么吗？
transfer: 问同伴是否记得最后一次看见车票是在何处。
transferEn: Ask a companion to remember where they last saw the tickets.

senseEn: relating to the mind
en: Does the clinic offer mental health support for students?
zh: 诊所为学生提供心理健康支持吗？
transfer: 向学校询问心理健康讲座在哪里举办。
transferEn: Ask where a school is holding a talk about psychological well-being.

senseEn: a small simple dwelling
en: Does the cabin have running water in winter?
zh: 小木屋冬天有自来水吗？
transfer: 预订前打听小木屋能住几个人。
transferEn: Check a rustic dwelling's capacity before reserving.

senseEn: the written dialogue and directions for a performance
en: Is this the revised script for tomorrow's rehearsal?
zh: 这是明天排练用的修订版剧本吗？
transfer: 请导演指出剧本中改过的台词。
transferEn: Ask a director to identify revised lines in the written play.

senseEn: made of material throughout rather than hollow
en: Are the table legs solid wood?
zh: 桌腿是实木的吗？
transfer: 询问吊坠是实心的还是空心的。
transferEn: Check whether a pendant has material throughout or a hollow center.

senseEn: a piece of writing in a publication
en: Who wrote the article about restoring the pier?
zh: 写码头修复的那篇文章是谁写的？
transfer: 请同学分享一篇介绍当地历史的文章。
transferEn: Request a published piece about local history from a classmate.

senseEn: the process of teaching and learning
en: Does the museum run education programs for adults?
zh: 博物馆有针对成人的教育项目吗？
transfer: 问主办方哪些活动属于音乐教育项目。
transferEn: Identify activities included in a music learning program.

senseEn: the seasoning commonly used to make food salty
en: Taste the broth before adding more salt.
zh: 再加盐之前先尝尝汤。
transfer: 请朋友把桌上的盐递给你。
transferEn: Ask a friend to pass the seasoning used to make food salty.

senseEn: find an answer to a problem
en: Would a longer ramp solve the problem?
zh: 换条长一点的坡道能解决这个问题吗？
transfer: 请技术员说明怎样解决打印歪斜的问题。
transferEn: Ask a technician how to fix crooked printing.

senseEn: belief in one's own or another's ability
en: That practice run gave me confidence to speak without notes.
zh: 那次试讲让我有了脱稿发言的信心。
transfer: 向教练说明你对在深水区游泳更有信心了。
transferEn: Describe greater assurance about swimming in deep water.

senseEn: speaking openly and honestly
en: Frankly, the room is too small for twelve desks.
zh: 坦率地说，这个房间摆十二张桌子太小了。
transfer: 坦诚告诉同伴周末行程安排得太满。
transferEn: Tell a companion openly that a weekend itinerary is overcrowded.

senseEn: be given or sent something
en: Did you receive the revised timetable by email?
zh: 你收到邮件里的修订版时刻表了吗？
transfer: 询问房东是否收到了维修照片。
transferEn: Check whether repair photos reached a landlord.

senseEn: a material such as iron, copper or aluminum
en: Is the frame metal or wood?
zh: 框架是金属的还是木头的？
transfer: 问管理员哪些金属可以放进回收箱。
transferEn: Ask which metallic materials belong in a recycling bin.

senseEn: strong displeasure or rage
en: I could hear the anger in his voice when the booking vanished.
zh: 预订消失时，我能听出他声音里的怒气。
transfer: 向朋友描述球迷对突然涨价的愤怒。
transferEn: Describe fans' strong displeasure at a sudden price rise.

senseEn: a business arranging services for others
en: Which agency arranged the airport pickup?
zh: 机场接送是哪家代理机构安排的？
transfer: 向朋友打听哪家中介帮他找到了工作室。
transferEn: Ask which intermediary found a studio for a friend.

senseEn: a small specific piece of information
en: One detail is missing: the return date.
zh: 漏了一项细节，就是归还日期。
transfer: 请同事核对邀请函上的一个小细节。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to verify a small point on an invitation.

en: Can you trace the payment using this reference number?
zh: 你能用这个编号追查这笔款项吗？
transfer: 包裹延迟时请客服追查它最后一次被扫描的位置。
senseEn: follow the route or history of something
transferEn: Ask customer service to locate a delayed parcel's last scan.

senseEn: a tube carrying water or another fluid
en: Is that pipe leaking behind the sink?
zh: 水槽后边那根管子在漏吗？
transfer: 告诉房东厨房哪根水管会震动。
transferEn: Tell a landlord which water tube vibrates in the kitchen.

senseEn: an evening meal
en: Will you be back for supper after practice?
zh: 训练后你会回来吃晚饭吗？
transfer: 邀邻居周日晚来吃顿简单的便饭。
transferEn: Invite a neighbor to a simple Sunday evening meal.

senseEn: the energy or work used to accomplish something
en: Thanks for the extra effort you put into packing the glass.
zh: 谢谢你特意下功夫把玻璃制品包好。
transfer: 感谢队友为排练付出的努力。
transferEn: Thank a teammate for the energy devoted to rehearsal.

senseEn: expel something from the mouth
en: Should I spit into this tube for the sample?
zh: 采样时要把唾液吐进这支管子吗？
transfer: 在牙科诊室询问漱口后该往哪个池子吐水。
transferEn: At the dentist, ask where to expel water after rinsing.

senseEn: put one's arms around someone affectionately
en: Would you like a hug before you go?
zh: 走之前想抱一下吗？
transfer: 与久别的老友见面时询问能否拥抱。
transferEn: Ask a long-absent friend if an embrace would be welcome.

senseEn: care intended to address a health condition
en: How long is today's treatment session?
zh: 今天这次治疗要多长时间？
transfer: 向诊所确认下一次治疗的预约日期。
transferEn: Confirm the date of a clinic session for ongoing care.

senseEn: promise to devote resources or time
en: Can you commit to one shift a month?
zh: 你能保证每个月值一次班吗？
transfer: 问队员能否承诺每周来参加一次排练。
transferEn: Check whether teammates can promise to attend weekly rehearsal.

senseEn: a mythical scaled creature
en: Does the dragon speak in the puppet show?
zh: 木偶戏里的龙会说话吗？
transfer: 问孩子为什么把画里的龙涂成蓝色。
transferEn: Ask a child why the mythical creature in a drawing is blue.

senseEn: the general opinion people hold about someone or something
en: Does that shop have a reputation for reliable repairs?
zh: 那家店修东西可靠的口碑好吗？
transfer: 问邻居本地哪位木工口碑最好。
transferEn: Ask which local carpenter is most highly regarded.

senseEn: the ability to learn and reason
en: Does the exhibit compare animal intelligence across different species?
zh: 展览有没有比较不同物种的智力？
transfer: 问讲师研究乌鸦智力时观察哪些行为。
transferEn: Ask a lecturer how crow reasoning is assessed from behavior.

senseEn: legal responsibility for a child's care
en: Does the story explain how they share custody of their daughter?
zh: 故事里有没有说明他们怎样共同监护女儿？
transfer: 在读书会讨论小说结尾孩子的监护权归谁。
transferEn: Discuss who is responsible for the child at a novel's ending.

senseEn: the capacity to do something
en: Will the test assess my ability to follow spoken directions?
zh: 考试会测试我听懂口头指路的能力吗？
transfer: 问教练如何评估新学员的游泳能力。
transferEn: Ask how a coach assesses beginners' swimming skills.

senseEn: a location used for a particular purpose
en: Is this the original site of the old market?
zh: 这里是老市场原来的位置吗？
transfer: 问工作人员新车站选址在哪里。
transferEn: Find out where a new station will be built.

senseEn: following the fourth
en: Our appointment is on the fifth floor.
zh: 我们预约的地点在五楼。
transfer: 提醒队友在第五个路口转弯。
transferEn: Tell a teammate to turn at the intersection after the first four.

senseEn: a marked path for walking or hiking
en: Is the lakeside trail suitable for a stroller?
zh: 湖边步道适合推婴儿车吗？
transfer: 问向导哪条步道能看到瀑布。
transferEn: Check which hiking path gives a view of a waterfall.

senseEn: a large official residence of royalty
en: Can we visit the palace kitchens on this ticket?
zh: 这张票能参观王宫厨房吗？
transfer: 问导游宫殿哪一侧能看到花园。
transferEn: Ask which side of a royal residence overlooks its gardens.

senseEn: jump on one foot
en: Can you hop on your left foot for this game?
zh: 玩这个游戏时你能左脚单脚跳吗？
transfer: 请教练示范怎样单脚跳过地上的线。
transferEn: Ask a coach to demonstrate a one-foot jump over a line.

senseEn: an effort to accomplish something
en: Did the second attempt to repair the latch work?
zh: 第二次尝试修门闩成功了吗？
transfer: 问朋友第一次做陶杯的尝试怎么样。
transferEn: Ask how a friend's initial effort at making a clay mug went.

senseEn: a handheld pointing device for a computer
en: Does this mouse work on a glass desk?
zh: 这个鼠标能在玻璃桌面上用吗？
transfer: 问同事能否借用无线鼠标。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to lend a wireless pointing device.

senseEn: make discomfort or difficulty less severe
en: Did resting ease the pain in your wrist?
zh: 休息让你的手腕疼痛减轻了吗？
transfer: 向护士说明垫子是否缓解了坐着时的不适。
transferEn: Tell a nurse whether a cushion reduced discomfort while sitting.

senseEn: a short period of illness or activity
en: He missed rehearsal after a bout of flu.
zh: 他得了一场流感，错过了排练。
transfer: 向教练说明你刚从一阵头晕中恢复。
transferEn: Explain that you have just recovered from an episode of dizziness.

senseEn: usual rather than special
en: Will an ordinary envelope protect this photograph?
zh: 普通信封能保护这张照片吗？
transfer: 问店员可否用普通电池驱动这盏灯。
transferEn: Check whether a lamp works with standard batteries.

senseEn: feeling admiration after seeing something
en: I was impressed by how quickly you found the fault.
zh: 你这么快找到故障，让我很佩服。
transfer: 向主人表达你对花园设计的赞赏。
transferEn: Tell a host that their garden design made a strong impression.

senseEn: clothing and linens for washing
en: Can I hang my laundry on the balcony?
zh: 我可以在阳台上晾衣服吗？
transfer: 请室友把洗衣机里的衣物取出来。
transferEn: Ask a roommate to take the wash out of the machine.

senseEn: valuable objects hidden or discovered together
en: Does the map lead to buried treasure in the story?
zh: 故事里这张地图会把人带到埋藏宝藏的地方吗？
transfer: 问孩子游戏里的宝藏藏在花园哪处。
transferEn: Ask a child where the hidden valuables are in a garden game.

senseEn: retaliation for a perceived wrong
en: Is the novel about revenge or forgiveness?
zh: 这本小说讲的是复仇还是宽恕？
transfer: 讨论故事结尾主角为何放弃报复。
transferEn: Discuss why a protagonist gives up the wish to retaliate.

senseEn: the likelihood of an outcome
en: What are the odds of finding a seat without booking?
zh: 不预订还能找到座位的可能性有多大？
transfer: 问向导清晨看到水獭的机会大不大。
transferEn: Ask a guide about the likelihood of spotting otters at dawn.

senseEn: a cheer expressing approval of a performance
en: Someone shouted “bravo” after the final solo.
zh: 最后一段独奏结束后，有人高喊“好！”
transfer: 向朋友描述谢幕时观众如何用喊声喝彩。
transferEn: Describe an audience cheering with an approving shout at curtain call.

senseEn: a person who works cattle, often on horseback
en: Was the cowboy in this photograph a local ranch hand?
zh: 照片里的牛仔是当地牧场的工人吗？
transfer: 问导游展出的鞍是不是牛仔用过的。
transferEn: Ask a guide whether a cattle herder used a saddle on display.

senseEn: relating to energy released from atomic nuclei
en: Does the exhibition explain nuclear power generation?
zh: 展览讲解核能发电吗？
transfer: 询问讲座是否比较了核能与风能发电。
transferEn: Check whether a lecture compares atomic energy generation with wind power.

senseEn: movement from one position to another
en: Does the hallway light detect motion after dark?
zh: 天黑后走廊灯能感应移动吗？
transfer: 问摄影师如何拍清移动中的物体。
transferEn: Ask a photographer about capturing an object in movement.

senseEn: a large complex containing shops
en: Is the mall entrance beside the bus station?
zh: 购物中心入口在公交站旁吗？
transfer: 询问商场哪里有寄存柜。
transferEn: Locate lockers in a shopping complex.

senseEn: a microscopic infectious agent that replicates in host cells
en: Does this leaflet explain the difference between a virus and a bacterium?
zh: 这份资料说明了病毒和细菌的区别吗？
transfer: 问科学老师课本的哪幅图画的是病毒。
transferEn: Ask a science teacher which textbook illustration depicts a viral particle.

senseEn: a large area covered with trees
en: Is the forest path closed during high winds?
zh: 大风时森林步道会封闭吗？
transfer: 向导游询问怎样从湖边走进森林。
transferEn: Ask a guide about reaching the wooded area from the lakeshore.

senseEn: a title used for certain members of the clergy
en: Will Reverend Hall speak at the memorial?
zh: 霍尔牧师会在追思会上致辞吗？
transfer: 写邀请函时询问应如何称呼主持仪式的牧师。
transferEn: Check the correct clerical title for a ceremony invitation.

senseEn: the sixth month of the year
en: Does the outdoor pool open in June?
zh: 露天泳池六月开放吗？
transfer: 询问六月最后一个周末还有没有空房。
transferEn: Check room availability on the last weekend of the sixth month.

senseEn: a narrow mark caused by scraping
en: Is that scratch on the screen or the protector?
zh: 那道划痕是在屏幕上还是在保护膜上？
transfer: 请店员查看新箱子侧面的划痕。
transferEn: Show a clerk a narrow scrape on the side of a new case.

senseEn: obtained from olives by mechanical means without refining
en: Does the recipe call for extra virgin olive oil?
zh: 配方需要特级初榨橄榄油吗？
transfer: 问店员哪瓶是初榨橄榄油。
transferEn: Ask a clerk to identify olive oil made without refining.

senseEn: possible but not yet realized
en: Have we checked the potential costs of a venue change?
zh: 我们核对过换场地可能产生的费用吗？
transfer: 向同伴说明改变出发时间的潜在好处。
transferEn: Describe a possible benefit of changing departure time.

senseEn: one more than eleven
en: Does this box hold twelve bottles?
zh: 这个箱子能装十二瓶吗？
transfer: 确认十二名来宾是否都领到了节目单。
transferEn: Check that twelve guests each received a program.

senseEn: five times ten
en: Can you change fifty dollars into smaller bills?
zh: 你能把五十美元换成小面额钞票吗？
transfer: 询问五十张邀请函印刷要多少钱。
transferEn: Ask the printing cost for fifty invitations.

senseEn: give reasons supporting a view or decision
en: How did the organizer defend the decision to move indoors?
zh: 组织者是怎样为改到室内的决定作解释的？
transfer: 请队长说明保留旧队服的理由。
transferEn: Ask a captain to justify keeping the old uniforms.

senseEn: an event in which entrants compete
en: Is the photo contest open to amateurs?
zh: 摄影比赛对业余爱好者开放吗？
transfer: 询问烘焙竞赛能否提交两件作品。
transferEn: Check whether two entries are permitted in a baking competition.

senseEn: a moldable synthetic material
en: Is the lid plastic or metal?
zh: 盖子是塑料的还是金属的？
transfer: 问前台塑料卡套可以投进哪个回收箱。
transferEn: Locate the correct recycling bin for a synthetic card sleeve.

senseEn: styles of dress currently or historically popular
en: Does the exhibit cover fashion in the 1960s?
zh: 这个展览介绍二十世纪六十年代的时尚吗？
transfer: 问馆员哪本书记录当地服饰潮流。
transferEn: Ask a librarian for a book on local clothing trends.

senseEn: a cover that closes a bottle
en: Twist the cap tightly before packing the bottle.
zh: 把瓶盖拧紧再放进包。
transfer: 向店员询问这种水壶能否单买盖子。
transferEn: Check if a replacement bottle closure can be bought separately.

senseEn: stop someone speaking or acting briefly
en: Sorry to interrupt the rehearsal; the van is here.
zh: 抱歉打断排练，面包车到了。
transfer: 开会时有紧急来电，请求暂时打断发言。
transferEn: Politely break into a meeting to report an urgent call.

senseEn: persuade someone to accept an idea
en: Did the second sample convince the client to order?
zh: 第二份样品说服客户下单了吗？
transfer: 解释哪条证据让你相信选对了路线。
transferEn: Describe the evidence that persuaded you the route was correct.

senseEn: shout encouragement or approval
en: Can families cheer from the finish line?
zh: 家属可以在终点线旁欢呼加油吗？
transfer: 邀请同事来为第一次参赛的朋友加油。
transferEn: Invite coworkers to shout encouragement for a first-time competitor.

senseEn: reach one's destination
en: What time should we arrive for the ferry?
zh: 我们几点应该到码头准备上船？
transfer: 告诉房东你会在日落后到达。
transferEn: Tell a host that you will reach the property after sunset.

senseEn: a quantity available for use
en: Is there a backup water supply at the campsite?
zh: 营地有备用供水吗？
transfer: 询问负责人茶水供应能否持续到排练结束。
transferEn: Check whether refreshments will last until rehearsal ends.

senseEn: observation of a place or activity over time
en: Does the sign say the car park is under video surveillance?
zh: 告示是不是说停车场有视频监控？
transfer: 问管理员大厅里是否贴有监控提示。
transferEn: Ask a building manager about notices of camera monitoring in the lobby.

senseEn: pay no attention to something
en: Can I ignore this warning if the printer is unplugged?
zh: 打印机没插电的话，我能忽略这项提醒吗？
transfer: 提醒朋友别忽略门上最新的通知。
transferEn: Ask a friend to take note of the latest notice on a door.

senseEn: a pointed fastener driven into material
en: Could you pull this nail out of the board?
zh: 能把这根钉子从木板上拔出来吗？
transfer: 问房东能否用一枚小钉子挂照片。
transferEn: Check permission to hang a photo with a small pointed fastener.

senseEn: an organized competition among teams
en: When does the summer league start?
zh: 夏季联赛什么时候开始？
transfer: 问教练有哪些球队参加本地联赛。
transferEn: Find out which teams are in a local sports competition.

senseEn: deputy to the holder of an office
en: Will the vice president chair the meeting today?
zh: 今天由副主席主持会议吗？
transfer: 询问社团副主席能否代签活动申请。
transferEn: Check if a club's deputy head can sign an event application.

senseEn: a North American holiday associated with giving thanks
en: Is the library open on Thanksgiving?
zh: 感恩节图书馆开放吗？
transfer: 问寄宿家庭感恩节聚餐几点开始。
transferEn: Ask a host family about dinner time on the holiday of giving thanks.

senseEn: two related-seeming events happening by chance
en: What a coincidence; we're on the same ferry!
zh: 真巧，我们在同一班渡轮上！
transfer: 跟新同学说你们曾住同一条街真是巧合。
transferEn: Remark on having lived on the same street as a new classmate by chance.

senseEn: an act of kindness or assistance, in British spelling
en: Could you do me a favour and collect my post?
zh: 能帮我个忙，替我取下邮件吗？
transfer: 用英式拼写给邻居留言，请他帮忙搬花盆。
transferEn: Write a British-English note asking a neighbor for help moving a planter.

sense: 可乐饮料，品牌名常大写
senseEn: a cola drink, often referring to the Coca-Cola brand
en: Is a Coke included with the lunch deal?
zh: 午餐套餐包含一杯可乐吗？
transfer: 在餐馆点一杯不加冰的可乐。
transferEn: Order a branded cola without ice in a restaurant.

senseEn: how good a product or service is
en: Can I check the quality of the fabric before I order?
zh: 下单前我能看看布料的品质吗？
transfer: 和朋友比较两张照片的打印质量。
transferEn: Compare how well two photographs were printed.

senseEn: the name of a book or other work
en: What's the title of the book you mentioned?
zh: 你提到的那本书叫什么名字？
transfer: 向主持人确认节目单上的演讲标题。
transferEn: Confirm the name of a talk in the printed program.

senseEn: an opinion formed from an initial experience
en: What was your first impression of the new studio?
zh: 你对新工作室的第一印象如何？
transfer: 向同事说说你第一次参观图书馆后的印象。
transferEn: Describe how a library struck you on your first visit.

senseEn: to a special or notable degree
en: The lower trail is particularly muddy near the stream.
zh: 下面那条步道靠近溪流的地方尤其泥泞。
transfer: 告诉朋友展览哪一部分让你特别感兴趣。
transferEn: Identify the exhibition section that interested you most.

senseEn: fair and sensible in the circumstances
en: Is thirty dollars a reasonable price for this repair?
zh: 这项维修收三十美元合理吗？
transfer: 问旅伴提前两小时出发是否合理。
transferEn: Check whether a two-hour head start seems sensible.

senseEn: a distinct section of an organization
en: Which division handles building maintenance?
zh: 哪个部门负责楼宇维护？
transfer: 询问公司的哪个部门招聘实习生。
transferEn: Find out which organizational unit recruits interns.

senseEn: an informal affectionate term for a rabbit
en: The little bunny is hiding behind the watering can.
zh: 小兔子躲在浇水壶后面。
transfer: 向孩子指出绘本里藏在胡萝卜旁的小兔子。
transferEn: Show a child the rabbit hiding beside carrots in a picture book.

senseEn: a large striped wild cat
en: Can visitors watch the tiger feeding this afternoon?
zh: 游客今天下午能看喂老虎吗？
transfer: 问讲解员如何通过条纹辨认每只老虎。
transferEn: Ask how a guide identifies individual striped big cats.

senseEn: a course of treatment for a condition
en: Which entrance do I use for physical therapy?
zh: 去做物理治疗该走哪个入口？
transfer: 问诊所能否更改下次治疗的时间。
transferEn: Check whether a clinic can move the next treatment session.

senseEn: an institution displaying objects of cultural or scientific interest
en: Does the museum ticket include the temporary exhibit?
zh: 博物馆门票包括临展吗？
transfer: 询问镇上哪家博物馆收藏旧船模型。
transferEn: Find the local institution displaying historic ship models.

senseEn: a strong iron-based alloy
en: Is the water bottle stainless steel inside?
zh: 这个水瓶的内胆是不锈钢的吗？
transfer: 问木工支架是否需要用钢制螺钉。
transferEn: Check whether a support requires fasteners made of a strong iron alloy.

senseEn: a senior government official leading a department
en: Did the transport minister visit the new station?
zh: 交通部长参观新车站了吗？
transfer: 询问讲座将介绍哪位部长推动的改革。
transferEn: Ask whose department led a reform being discussed in a lecture.

senseEn: usual or conforming to an accepted specification
en: Does the shelf fit a standard doorway?
zh: 这个架子能通过标准尺寸的门口吗？
transfer: 问店员灯具能不能用标准尺寸灯泡。
transferEn: Check whether a lamp accepts a bulb of the usual size.

senseEn: a person historically held in bondage and denied freedom
en: The panel quotes a slave narrative written after the author escaped bondage.
zh: 展板引用了一部作者逃离奴役后写下的被奴役者自述。
transfer: 向馆员询问展览里哪些自述来自亲历奴役的人。
transferEn: Ask a curator which accounts were written by people who endured enslavement.

senseEn: call out loudly
en: There's no need to yell across the hall; I can hear you.
zh: 不用隔着大厅喊，我听得见。
transfer: 告诉同伴灯亮时喊你一声。
transferEn: Ask a companion to call out loudly when a light comes on.

senseEn: a date marking another year since an event
en: Can we reserve this table for our wedding anniversary?
zh: 我们可以订这张桌子庆祝结婚纪念日吗？
transfer: 请朋友提醒你书店开业周年是哪一天。
transferEn: Check the anniversary date of a bookshop's opening with a friend.

senseEn: nervous around unfamiliar people
en: My son is shy around new classmates at first.
zh: 我儿子刚见新同学时会有点害羞。
transfer: 向朋友解释你的猫见到陌生人时很害羞。
transferEn: Describe how timid your cat is with visitors.

senseEn: causing suffering without kindness
en: That joke was cruel to the new student.
zh: 那个玩笑对新同学太刻薄了。
transfer: 读完故事后解释为什么主人的行为对动物很残忍。
transferEn: Discuss why a character's treatment of an animal was unkind.

senseEn: the Christian scriptures
en: Is the illustrated Bible on display an original edition?
zh: 展出的插图版《圣经》是原版吗？
transfer: 向馆员询问中文版《圣经》在哪个书架。
transferEn: Ask a librarian where the Christian scriptures in Chinese are shelved.

senseEn: try to obtain something needed
en: Where can tenants seek advice about the new lease?
zh: 租客可以去哪儿寻求新租约方面的建议？
transfer: 正式询问志愿者在活动现场该向谁寻求帮助。
transferEn: Formally ask whom volunteers should approach for assistance.

senseEn: call off a planned event or reservation
en: Can I cancel the booking before Thursday?
zh: 我能在周四前取消预订吗？
transfer: 打电话给诊所取消明天的预约。
transferEn: Call a clinic to call off tomorrow's appointment.

senseEn: especially desirable for a purpose
en: Is this a prime spot for watching the parade?
zh: 这里是看游行的好位置吗？
transfer: 问向导哪个位置最适合观鸟。
transferEn: Ask a guide for an especially good birdwatching location.

senseEn: having held a position in the past
en: My former supervisor can confirm the dates.
zh: 我以前的主管可以核实日期。
transfer: 向邻居介绍你以前的合唱团老师。
transferEn: Introduce the person who previously taught your choir.

senseEn: even to the touch without roughness
en: Is the board smooth enough to paint now?
zh: 这块木板现在够平滑，可以上漆了吗？
transfer: 请店员推荐表面光滑的书桌垫。
transferEn: Request a desk mat with an even, nonrough surface.

senseEn: the weekday following Tuesday
en: Can I move the pickup to Wednesday?
zh: 我能把取货改到星期三吗？
transfer: 问老师星期三下午是否有排练。
transferEn: Check rehearsal plans for the afternoon before Thursday.

senseEn: belonging to contemporary styles or methods
en: Will the modern lamp fit the old socket?
zh: 这盏现代灯能装在旧灯座上吗？
transfer: 询问展馆哪个展厅介绍现代家具。
transferEn: Locate the gallery devoted to contemporary furniture.

senseEn: the outer or upper face of something
en: Is this surface safe for putting down hot pans?
zh: 这个台面能直接放热锅吗？
transfer: 问木工怎样保护桌面不被磨花。
transferEn: Ask a carpenter how to protect the upper face of a table from scratches.

senseEn: the full duration of someone's life
en: Did she publish the diaries during her lifetime?
zh: 她生前出版过这些日记吗？
transfer: 询问这位画家一生中是否见过海。
transferEn: Ask if a painter ever saw the sea while alive.

senseEn: a person's function in an activity
en: What's my role during visitor registration?
zh: 访客登记时我负责什么？
transfer: 请队长说明你在彩排中的职责。
transferEn: Ask a team leader to clarify your function during rehearsal.

senseEn: a magical wish or spell causing misfortune in a story
en: Does the curse end when the clock strikes twelve?
zh: 钟敲十二下时诅咒会解除吗？
transfer: 问朋友童话里是谁解除了公主的诅咒。
transferEn: Find out who breaks a magical spell on a princess in a fairy tale.

senseEn: a place for indoor exercise
en: Does the hotel gym open before breakfast?
zh: 酒店健身房在早餐前开门吗？
transfer: 询问健身房有没有能寄存背包的柜子。
transferEn: Check an exercise facility for backpack lockers.

senseEn: roadside lodging often serving motorists
en: Does the motel have parking outside each room?
zh: 这家汽车旅馆每间客房外都能停车吗？
transfer: 问汽车旅馆能否深夜办理入住。
transferEn: Check late-night check-in at roadside lodging.

senseEn: a group of items gathered together
en: Can visitors see the collection of railway tickets?
zh: 游客能参观火车票藏品吗？
transfer: 请馆员介绍馆藏陶器中最古老的一件。
transferEn: Ask about the oldest item in a museum's pottery holdings.

senseEn: a piece of equipment serving a purpose
en: What device measures humidity in the gallery?
zh: 展厅里用什么装置测湿度？
transfer: 问店员哪种装置能显示电池电量。
transferEn: Ask a clerk for equipment that displays battery charge.

senseEn: a mild informal expression of frustration
en: Heck, I forgot the locker number again.
zh: 哎呀，我又忘了储物柜号码。
transfer: 跟熟友说又把两只手套忘在车上了，轻轻抱怨一句。
transferEn: Mildly express annoyance at leaving both gloves in the car again.

senseEn: an informal everyday verb for urinating
en: The little boy said he needed to pee before the bus ride.
zh: 小男孩说坐车前想尿尿。
transfer: 向朋友解释为什么小孩说的小便用语不适合写在正式告示上。
transferEn: Explain why a child's informal word for urinating does not suit a formal notice.

senseEn: twelve o'clock in the daytime
en: The parcel desk closes at noon on Saturdays.
zh: 周六包裹柜台中午十二点关闭。
transfer: 约同伴中午十二点在钟楼碰面。
transferEn: Arrange to meet at the clock tower at midday.

senseEn: at an earlier time
en: Has this room previously been used as a kitchen?
zh: 这间屋以前做过厨房吗？
transfer: 问同事过去是否用过这套记账工具。
transferEn: Check whether a colleague has used an accounting tool before.

senseEn: something offered in recognition of an action
en: Is there a reward for returning the lost camera?
zh: 归还丢失的相机有酬谢吗？
transfer: 替主人在寻猫启事中说明找回猫会给酬谢。
transferEn: Mention a token of appreciation for finding a cat in a lost-pet notice.

senseEn: a heated tool for smoothing fabric
en: Can I borrow an iron for my shirt?
zh: 能借个熨斗熨衬衫吗？
transfer: 提醒室友离开前拔掉熨斗插头。
transferEn: Remind a roommate to unplug the clothes-pressing appliance.

senseEn: a fast transport service making fewer stops
en: Does the airport express stop at the market?
zh: 机场快线在市场停吗？
transfer: 问售票员快车比普通车早到多少分钟。
transferEn: Compare the arrival times of fast and stopping services.

senseEn: something given up for another purpose
en: Working weekends was a sacrifice she made to finish the course.
zh: 为了读完这门课，她牺牲了周末去工作。
transfer: 解释为了排练你放弃了什么休闲活动。
transferEn: Describe a leisure activity you gave up to make time for rehearsal.

senseEn: a task given as part of study or work
en: Can we submit the assignment in pairs?
zh: 这份作业可以两人一组提交吗？
transfer: 问老师下次作业需要附参考资料吗。
transferEn: Check reference requirements for the next piece of coursework.

senseEn: a passage beneath ground or water
en: Is the pedestrian tunnel open after dark?
zh: 天黑后人行隧道开放吗？
transfer: 询问骑自行车能不能走河底隧道。
transferEn: Check whether cyclists may use the passage beneath a river.

senseEn: a main road for motor traffic
en: Which highway leads to the northern ferry port?
zh: 哪条公路通往北面的渡轮港？
transfer: 问司机避开收费公路会多花多久。
transferEn: Ask how much time avoiding a toll road adds.

senseEn: firmly require something
en: Does the venue insist on printed tickets?
zh: 场馆一定要求纸质票吗？
transfer: 问主办方是否坚持要求全员提前到。
transferEn: Check if organizers firmly require everyone to arrive early.

senseEn: a person leading and explaining a visit
en: Will the guide meet us inside the museum?
zh: 导游会在博物馆里面和我们见面吗？
transfer: 询问导游能否用中文讲解。
transferEn: Ask whether the person leading a tour can speak Chinese.

senseEn: one screen of a presentation
en: Could you show the previous slide again?
zh: 能再放一下上一张幻灯片吗？
transfer: 请同事把最后一张幻灯片发给没到场的人。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to send the final presentation screen to an absent attendee.

senseEn: clearly identified rather than general
en: Can you give me a specific date for the repair?
zh: 能告诉我确切的维修日期吗？
transfer: 请老师举一个具体的例子解释评分标准。
transferEn: Request a precise example illustrating grading criteria.

senseEn: cover by folding material around something
en: Could you wrap the mug in paper?
zh: 能用纸把杯子包起来吗？
transfer: 提醒朋友把湿伞用旧毛巾包起来。
transferEn: Suggest covering a wet umbrella with an old towel.

senseEn: a four-wheeled cart for carrying loads
en: Can we borrow the wagon to carry the picnic boxes?
zh: 能借那辆四轮小车运野餐箱吗？
transfer: 问农场主能否用小车把南瓜拉到门口。
transferEn: Ask about using a cart to move pumpkins to a farm gate.

senseEn: a formal dance for high-school students
en: Is the prom ticket price the same for guests?
zh: 毕业舞会的来宾票同价吗？
transfer: 问同学毕业舞会的集合地点。
transferEn: Ask a classmate where to meet for the formal school dance.

senseEn: be without a needed resource
en: We lack the space to store all twelve chairs.
zh: 我们没有足够的地方放十二把椅子。
transfer: 告诉组织者你们缺少接送来宾的车辆。
transferEn: Explain that your group does not have enough vehicles for guest pickups.

senseEn: physical activity for fitness
en: Does walking count as regular exercise for this log?
zh: 在这份记录里，步行算定期锻炼吗？
transfer: 问教练哪种锻炼适合雨天在室内做。
transferEn: Ask a coach about a suitable indoor workout for a rainy day.

senseEn: a person against whom a case is brought
en: Did the defendant speak at the hearing described in the article?
zh: 报道所述的听证会上，被告发言了吗？
transfer: 请老师指出模拟庭审中谁扮演被告。
transferEn: Ask a teacher who plays the person being tried in a mock hearing.

senseEn: break rules to gain an unfair advantage
en: Does looking at a partner's cards count as trying to cheat?
zh: 看搭档的牌算试图作弊吗？
transfer: 请裁判解释哪种做法在比赛里算作弊。
transferEn: Ask a referee which conduct would violate fair play.

senseEn: a set of items for a particular task
en: Does the repair kit include spare buttons?
zh: 修补包里有备用纽扣吗？
transfer: 出发前问队友急救包放在哪儿。
transferEn: Locate a first-aid set before a trip.

senseEn: an official guiding participants at an event
en: Ask the race marshal where the short course starts.
zh: 问赛事引导员短程赛道从哪里开始。
transfer: 请游行引导员指出参演队伍的集合点。
transferEn: Ask a parade official to identify the assembly area.

senseEn: the area seen behind the main subject
en: Could we use a plain background for the ID photo?
zh: 证件照能用素色背景吗？
transfer: 请摄影师避开照片背景中杂乱的箱子。
transferEn: Ask a photographer to leave stacked boxes out of the area behind a subject.

senseEn: a detail helping solve a problem or mystery
en: The postmark gave us a clue about the letter's date.
zh: 邮戳给了我们判断写信日期的线索。
transfer: 和读书会成员讨论哪条线索指向那幢老房子。
transferEn: Discuss which hint in a novel points to an old house.

senseEn: a physical attack on someone
en: Did the report give the time of the assault?
zh: 报道提到袭击发生的时间了吗？
transfer: 在阅读新闻课上辨认报道是否明确了袭击地点。
transferEn: In a news-reading class, check whether an attack's location was reported.

senseEn: three times five
en: The tour starts in fifteen minutes.
zh: 导览十五分钟后开始。
transfer: 确认十五名参与者是否都有名牌。
transferEn: Check that fifteen participants each have a badge.

senseEn: a live performance of music
en: Will the concert move indoors if it rains?
zh: 下雨的话音乐会会改在室内吗？
transfer: 问朋友音乐会结束后打算从哪个出口走。
transferEn: Choose a meeting exit after a live music performance.

senseEn: a building for religious worship
en: Can visitors enter the temple courtyard during prayers?
zh: 祈祷期间访客可以进入寺庙庭院吗？
transfer: 向导游询问寺庙大门何时开放。
transferEn: Check the opening time of a religious site's entrance.

senseEn: a farm for raising grazing animals
en: Does the ranch offer guided rides for beginners?
zh: 这个牧场为初学者提供带向导的骑马活动吗？
transfer: 问牧场主人冬季牛群住在哪里。
transferEn: Ask a cattle farmer about winter housing for the herd.

senseEn: a mythical being that feeds on blood
en: Is the vampire in this comic afraid of daylight?
zh: 这部漫画里的吸血鬼怕阳光吗？
transfer: 问剧团哪位演员扮演吸血鬼。
transferEn: Identify the actor playing a blood-drinking mythical figure.

senseEn: showing poor judgment
en: Would it be foolish to wait until the last ferry?
zh: 等到末班渡轮会不会不明智？
transfer: 解释为什么把唯一的钥匙留在屋里不明智。
transferEn: Explain the poor judgment involved in leaving the only key inside.

senseEn: an arrangement accepted by the parties involved
en: Does our agreement cover weekend access?
zh: 我们的协议包括周末使用权限吗？
transfer: 请同事确认双方对送货日期的约定。
transferEn: Confirm the agreed delivery date with a colleague.

senseEn: absence of light
en: Can we reach the cabin before darkness falls?
zh: 我们能在天黑前到达小木屋吗？
transfer: 向房东说明停电后楼梯间一片漆黑。
transferEn: Describe an unlit stairwell during a power outage.

en: Meet me under the red flag by the ticket office.
zh: 在售票处旁的红旗下跟我碰面。
transfer: 在游行人群中用队伍举着的旗子描述位置。
senseEn: a piece of cloth bearing a group's symbol
transferEn: Describe your spot in a parade crowd using the banner your group is carrying.

senseEn: a portable shelter made of fabric
en: Will the tent fit on this narrow pitch?
zh: 这块狭窄的营位能搭下帐篷吗？
transfer: 问同伴有没有记得带帐篷的地钉。
transferEn: Check whether a camper packed pegs for the shelter.

senseEn: decayed and unsuitable for use
en: One of the peaches in this box is rotten.
zh: 这盒桃子里有一个烂了。
transfer: 在果摊指出一只已经腐烂的梨。
transferEn: Point out a spoiled pear to a fruit seller.

senseEn: one division of the academic year
en: When does the autumn term begin?
zh: 秋季学期什么时候开学？
transfer: 问学校下学期的课程何时公布。
transferEn: Check when a school will announce classes for its next teaching period.

senseEn: an imagined being from another planet
en: Does the alien speak through the radio in this film?
zh: 这部电影里的外星人通过无线电说话吗？
transfer: 问孩子绘本里的外星人来自哪颗星球。
transferEn: Ask a child where an extraterrestrial character in a picture book comes from.

senseEn: make something available for use
en: Will the venue provide microphones for both speakers?
zh: 场地会为两位演讲者都提供麦克风吗？
transfer: 确认露营地是否提供干净的饮用水。
transferEn: Check if drinking water is supplied at a campsite.

senseEn: a piece of material covering a tear
en: Can you sew a patch over this tear?
zh: 能在破口上缝块补丁吗？
transfer: 问裁缝皮包上的小洞能不能加补丁。
transferEn: Ask a tailor about covering a hole in a leather bag.

senseEn: break suddenly with a sharp sound
en: Did the plastic clip snap when you closed the lid?
zh: 你关盖子时塑料卡扣是不是啪地断了？
transfer: 向修理工描述支架突然断裂时的情形。
transferEn: Describe a bracket breaking abruptly to a repair worker.

en: Use your imagination and draw what might live inside this shell.
zh: 发挥想象力，画出可能住在这个壳里的生物。
transfer: 哄孩子睡觉时，鼓励他发挥想象力给故事编个结尾。
senseEn: the ability to invent things in the mind
transferEn: Encourage a child to invent an ending to a bedtime story.

senseEn: temporary release pending further court proceedings
en: Does the article say she was released on bail?
zh: 文章说她获得保释了吗？
transfer: 问法学课同学模拟案中哪一段提到被告获准保释。
transferEn: Locate the part of a mock case describing conditional release before trial.

senseEn: real rather than estimated
en: What's the actual cost after delivery?
zh: 加上配送，实际花费是多少？
transfer: 把施工的实际结束日期告诉同事。
transferEn: Give a colleague the real completion date of some building work.

senseEn: a particular occurrence requiring attention
en: Where can I file an incident report about the spill?
zh: 关于液体洒出的那件事，我去哪儿提交事件报告？
transfer: 问值班人员是否记录了电梯停运事件。
transferEn: Check whether a lift outage was entered in the incident log.

senseEn: distilled alcoholic drink
en: Does this shop sell liquor or just wine?
zh: 这家店卖烈酒还是只卖葡萄酒？
transfer: 询问店员哪一排是烈酒货架。
transferEn: Locate the shelves for distilled spirits in a shop.

senseEn: a major event causing severe harm or loss
en: The exhibit shows how the town rebuilt after the disaster.
zh: 展览介绍了小镇在灾难后如何重建。
transfer: 请馆员推荐一本关于洪灾后社区恢复的书。
transferEn: Ask for a book on community recovery from a devastating flood.

senseEn: to the complete extent
en: Is the camera fully charged for the hike?
zh: 相机充满电准备好徒步用了吗？
transfer: 确认文件是否已经完整下载。
transferEn: Check whether a file has finished downloading in full.

senseEn: the amount of matter in an object
en: Should we measure the mass of the empty jar first?
zh: 我们要先测量空罐的质量吗？
transfer: 问老师天平上显示的是质量还是体积。
transferEn: Check whether a balance displays the amount of matter or the volume.

en: Could you comfort her while I call her parents?
zh: 我给她父母打电话时，你能安慰她一下吗？
transfer: 朋友错过决赛，问队长怎样安慰他。
senseEn: help someone feel less distressed
transferEn: Ask the captain how to console a friend who missed the final.

senseEn: a very short moment, informally
en: Hang on a sec; my shoelace is loose.
zh: 稍等一下，我的鞋带松了。
transfer: 接电话时随口请朋友稍等片刻，让你把炉子关掉。
transferEn: Casually ask a caller for a moment to turn off the stove.

senseEn: three times ten
en: Are there thirty sheets in each pad?
zh: 每本有三十张纸吗？
transfer: 询问会议室能否容纳三十名访客。
transferEn: Check seating capacity for thirty visitors.

senseEn: the dividing line between regions or countries
en: Does the bus stop before the border crossing?
zh: 公交车会在过境之前停靠吗？
transfer: 问向导村庄位于边界的哪一侧。
transferEn: Find out on which side of a boundary a village stands.

senseEn: a substance supplying energy for engines or heating
en: Does the rental price include fuel for the return trip?
zh: 租金包含返程的燃料费吗？
transfer: 问营地主人炉子使用哪种燃料。
transferEn: Check what energy source a camp stove uses.

senseEn: a traditional story passed down over time
en: Is there a local legend about that ruined tower?
zh: 那座残塔有什么当地传说吗？
transfer: 请导游讲讲湖泊得名的传说。
transferEn: Invite a guide to tell the traditional story behind a lake's name.

senseEn: powered by electricity
en: Can we rent an electric bike for the hill?
zh: 上山能租辆电动自行车吗？
transfer: 问营地主人炉子是电的还是用燃气的。
transferEn: Check whether a campground stove uses electricity or gas.

senseEn: the extent to which people want a product or service
en: Is there much demand for evening tours?
zh: 想参加夜间导览的人多吗？
transfer: 问店主冬天对雨衣的需求会不会增加。
transferEn: Ask whether customer interest in raincoats rises in winter.

senseEn: a staged drama in which much of the text is sung
en: Will the opera have subtitles above the stage?
zh: 这场歌剧舞台上方会有字幕吗？
transfer: 问售票处哪部歌剧适合第一次观看的人。
transferEn: Request a beginner-friendly sung stage drama at a box office.

senseEn: a traveling or staged show with acrobats and other acts
en: Is the circus tent accessible to wheelchairs?
zh: 马戏团的帐篷方便轮椅进入吗？
transfer: 问主办方马戏团会在镇上演几天。
transferEn: Check how long a traveling acrobatic show stays in town.

senseEn: existing or in use now
en: Is this the current timetable or last month's?
zh: 这是现在用的时刻表还是上个月的？
transfer: 请同事确认表格上的是当前地址。
transferEn: Verify with a colleague that a form lists the address now in use.

senseEn: a serious physical or psychological injury
en: Does the hospital offer counseling after emotional trauma?
zh: 这家医院提供心理创伤后的咨询吗？
transfer: 询问前台创伤康复服务在哪里登记。
transferEn: Locate registration for recovery services after a traumatic injury.

senseEn: a reptile with a protective shell
en: Has the rescued turtle returned to the lake?
zh: 那只获救的龟回到湖里了吗？
transfer: 请工作人员指出院子里哪块水池养着龟。
transferEn: Find the courtyard pond housing shelled reptiles.

senseEn: a dish of mixed ingredients often including vegetables
en: Can I get the salad dressing on the side?
