en: There's a piece of shell in the egg mixture.
zh: 蛋液里有一小片蛋壳。
transfer: 吃螃蟹时问有没有工具能敲开蟹壳。
transferEn: Ask for a tool to crack the crab's hard outer covering.

senseEn: farm animals raised for milk or beef
en: Drive slowly; the cattle are crossing the lane.
zh: 慢点开，牛群正在穿过小路。
transfer: 向牧场主人询问冬天把牛群养在哪里。
transferEn: Ask a rancher where the herd stays in winter.

senseEn: a small simple building
en: There's a hut near the summit where we can shelter.
zh: 山顶附近有间可以避风雨的小屋。
transfer: 请向导指出渔民存放渔网的小屋。
transferEn: Ask your guide to point out the small building where fishers store their nets.

senseEn: to smell very unpleasant
en: These wet shoes stink already. Can I leave them outside?
zh: 湿鞋已经臭了。我能把它们放在屋外吗？
transfer: 提醒室友厨余隔夜后会发臭。
transferEn: Warn a roommate about the smell food scraps will develop overnight.

senseEn: firm and unlikely to tip over
en: Is this ladder stable enough to use on gravel?
zh: 这架梯子放在碎石地上够稳吗？
transfer: 买书架时检查它放满书后是否稳固。
transferEn: Ask whether a bookcase will stand firm when fully loaded.

senseEn: a person who serves diners
en: Could you ask the waiter for another spoon?
zh: 能请服务员再拿把勺子吗？
transfer: 告诉同桌应该把账单交给哪位服务员。
transferEn: Tell your tablemate which member of the serving staff to give the bill to.

senseEn: a stack or mass of things
en: Put the clean sheets on the pile by the stairs.
zh: 把干净床单放到楼梯旁那一摞上。
transfer: 整理旧信件时请朋友找出要回收的那一堆。
transferEn: While sorting letters, ask a friend to identify the stack for recycling.

senseEn: a container often carried by a handle
en: Could I leave my basket here while I weigh these pears?
zh: 我去称梨时能把篮子放在这儿吗？
transfer: 野餐前问朋友篮子里还能不能放下水壶。
transferEn: Ask whether the picnic carrier has room for a water bottle.

senseEn: to beat an ingredient rapidly
en: Can you whip the cream while I slice the berries?
zh: 我切莓果时，你能把奶油打发吗？
transfer: 做蛋糕时请搭档把蛋白打成挺立的尖角。
transferEn: Ask your baking partner to beat the egg whites until they hold stiff peaks.

senseEn: a device that powers mechanical movement
en: The fan's motor runs, but the blades don't turn.
zh: 风扇的电机在转，但扇叶不动。
transfer: 向维修工描述吸尘器电机的怪声。
transferEn: Describe the strange noise from the part that powers your vacuum.

senseEn: extremely enjoyable or impressive
en: We had a marvelous evening at your concert. Thank you!
zh: 我们在你的音乐会上度过了美妙的夜晚。谢谢！
transfer: 给民宿主人留言称赞这次绝佳的住宿体验。
transferEn: Leave a note praising a wonderful stay at a guesthouse.

senseEn: a stage show that tells a story through songs
en: Are there seats left for the musical on Friday?
zh: 周五那场音乐剧还有座位吗？
transfer: 邀请同学去看由小说改编的音乐剧。
transferEn: Invite a classmate to a singing stage adaptation of a novel.

senseEn: a highly offensive insult for a person
en: He called the driver a fucker, and the driver asked him to leave.
zh: 他用一句很难听的脏话骂司机，司机让他下车。
transfer: 向调解员转述你在争执中听到的这个辱骂词。
transferEn: Report the offensive term you heard during an argument to a mediator.

senseEn: a historical form of address for a king
en: In the play, bow before saying “Yes, sire.”
zh: 演出时先鞠躬，再说“是，陛下”。
transfer: 排演宫廷戏时，以古代臣子的口吻向国王请示。
transferEn: During a palace scene, address the king as a subject would.

senseEn: a mother or father
en: Does a parent need to sign this swimming form?
zh: 这张游泳活动表需要家长签字吗？
transfer: 问校方每个孩子可以带几位家长参加音乐会。
transferEn: Ask the school how many mothers or fathers may attend the concert per child.

senseEn: a self-propelled military projectile
en: The museum label says this missile was never launched.
zh: 博物馆的标签说这枚导弹从未发射。
transfer: 参观历史展时询问这件导弹展品来自哪一年。
transferEn: At a history exhibit, ask what year the displayed projectile dates from.

senseEn: happening a short time ago
en: Do you have a recent photo for your new ID?
zh: 你有办新证件用的近照吗？
transfer: 问护士是否需要带上最近的检查结果。
transferEn: Ask a nurse whether to bring your latest test results.

senseEn: helpful for a purpose
en: That checklist was really useful on my first shift.
zh: 那张清单在我第一次值班时真管用。
transfer: 向同事指出培训材料里哪一页对接电话最有帮助。
transferEn: Tell a colleague which training page helped most with taking calls.

senseEn: made up of many connected parts
en: Could you draw a diagram? The wiring looks too complex to follow.
zh: 能画张图吗？线路太复杂，我看不明白。
transfer: 向老师说明哪道题太复杂，需要分步讲解。
transferEn: Tell your teacher which problem needs a step-by-step explanation because of its complexity.

senseEn: a screen used with a computer
en: Can you tilt the monitor away from the window?
zh: 你能把显示器转一下，避开窗户吗？
transfer: 向前台询问会议室里有没有可接笔记本的显示器。
transferEn: Ask reception whether the meeting room has a screen for your laptop.

senseEn: to a very high degree
en: It was incredibly quiet in the station after the last train.
zh: 末班车过后车站里安静极了。
transfer: 告诉朋友登顶后你有多累。
transferEn: Tell a friend just how tired you felt after reaching the summit.

senseEn: a group formed for a shared purpose
en: Which organization runs the weekend food bank?
zh: 哪家组织负责运营周末食品救济站？
transfer: 报名清河活动时问哪家机构负责保险。
transferEn: Ask which group handles insurance for a river cleanup.

senseEn: toward the rear
en: Could you step backwards a little so the doors can open?
zh: 能稍微往后退一点，让门打开吗？
transfer: 帮朋友泊车时请他缓缓向后倒。
transferEn: Guide a friend reversing slowly into a parking space.

senseEn: a particular way of swimming
en: Which swimming stroke is easiest on your shoulders?
zh: 哪种泳姿对你的肩膀负担最小？
transfer: 请教练示范比赛允许的另一种泳姿。
transferEn: Ask your coach to demonstrate another swimming style allowed in the race.

senseEn: to stop something from happening
en: Will this cover prevent dust from getting into the keyboard?
zh: 这个罩子能防止灰尘进入键盘吗？
transfer: 园艺课上问围网能不能防住兔子。
transferEn: In gardening class, ask whether netting will keep rabbits out.

senseEn: an agreement to marry
en: We announced our engagement at dinner last night.
zh: 我们昨晚吃饭时宣布订婚了。
transfer: 邀请堂姐参加庆祝两人订婚的聚会。
transferEn: Invite your cousin to celebrate your decision to marry.

senseEn: intended to last a limited time
en: My temporary badge stops working on Friday.
zh: 我的临时工牌周五就失效。
transfer: 家里修水管时向邻居说明临时供水点在哪里。
transferEn: Show a neighbor the short-term water supply point during pipe repairs.

senseEn: music with rhythmic spoken lyrics
en: Could you play some rap while we warm up?
zh: 我们热身时你能放点说唱音乐吗？
transfer: 给派对做歌单，问朋友最喜欢哪位说唱歌手。
transferEn: Ask which performer of rhythmic spoken lyrics your friend wants on a party playlist.

senseEn: a large waterbird with a long neck
en: Keep the gate shut; the goose keeps getting into the garden.
zh: 把门关好，那只鹅老是跑进花园。
transfer: 在池边指出哪只鹅的脚上有识别环。
transferEn: By a pond, point out the large long-necked bird with a band on its foot.

senseEn: the October holiday associated with costumes
en: Are you dressing up for Halloween this year?
zh: 你今年万圣节要换装打扮吗？
transfer: 问邻居节日讨糖从几点开始。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor when trick-or-treating starts on the October holiday.

senseEn: the greatest amount permitted
en: Is there a limit on how many tickets I can buy?
zh: 我能买多少张票有限制吗？
transfer: 交作业前问老师文章的字数上限。
transferEn: Ask a teacher the most words allowed in an essay.

senseEn: a casual greeting associated with the American South and West
en: The ranch host waved and called, “Howdy, folks!”
zh: 牧场主人挥手招呼道：“大家好啊！”
transfer: 排演西部小品时向刚进门的旅客热情打招呼。
transferEn: Greet arriving travelers informally in a Western sketch.

senseEn: even with a circumstance that might interfere
en: The market stayed open despite the rain.
zh: 尽管下雨，集市还是照常营业。
transfer: 告诉老师虽然列车晚点你仍按时赶到了。
transferEn: Explain that you arrived on time even with a train delay.

senseEn: to put forward an idea for consideration
en: I'd like to propose a change to the weekend rota.
zh: 我想提议调整周末值班表。
transfer: 向住户委员会提议增设自行车架。
transferEn: Suggest installing bicycle racks at a residents' meeting.

senseEn: better in quality than an alternative
en: Does the higher price buy superior sound or just a nicer case?
zh: 价格高是因为音质更好，还是只是外壳更漂亮？
transfer: 比较雨衣时解释哪件防水性能更好。
transferEn: Compare two raincoats and say which provides better waterproofing.

senseEn: a formal request to reconsider a decision
en: Where can I file an appeal against this parking fine?
zh: 我可以去哪里就这张停车罚单提出申诉？
transfer: 奖学金申请被拒后询问申诉截止日期。
transferEn: Ask the deadline for challenging a rejected scholarship application.

senseEn: a sliding storage compartment
en: The stamps are in the top drawer beside the phone.
zh: 邮票在电话旁边最上层的抽屉里。
transfer: 找剪刀时请室友打开书桌左边的抽屉。
transferEn: Ask a roommate to open the desk's left sliding compartment to look for scissors.

senseEn: the cutting part of a tool
en: The mower blade needs replacing before we cut the lawn.
zh: 割草前需要换割草机的刀片。
transfer: 买削皮器时问刀片能不能拆下来清洗。
transferEn: Ask whether the cutting part of a vegetable peeler comes off for washing.

senseEn: a thick covering for warmth
en: Could I have an extra blanket for the overnight bus?
zh: 坐夜班车能再给我一条毯子吗？
transfer: 露营时找一条能盖住两个人的毯子。
transferEn: Ask for a warm covering wide enough for two campers.

senseEn: who a person is
en: What can I bring as proof of identity on my first day?
zh: 入职第一天我可以带什么证明身份？
transfer: 领取挂号包裹前询问怎样核实收件人身份。
transferEn: Ask how the post office verifies who is collecting a registered parcel.

en: The last ferry leaves at eleven tonight.
zh: 最后一班渡轮今晚十一点开。
transfer: 订位时告诉餐厅你们一共有十一人。
senseEn: one more than ten
transferEn: Tell a restaurant how many people are in your party of ten adults and one child.

senseEn: to keep in good working condition
en: Who will maintain the lift after the warranty ends?
zh: 保修期结束后谁来维护电梯？
transfer: 租用单车时询问谁负责保养刹车。
transferEn: Ask who keeps the brakes in good condition on a rental bicycle.

senseEn: a roll of tobacco smoked without a paper wrapper
en: Someone left a cigar box on the counter.
zh: 有人把一个雪茄盒落在柜台上了。
transfer: 在旅馆前台描述失物盒上的雪茄图案。
transferEn: Describe the rolled tobacco pictured on a lost box at hotel reception.

senseEn: a disorderly crowd
en: The guard closed the gate as the mob surged forward.
zh: 眼看失控的人群向前涌去，警卫关上了大门。
transfer: 向记者描述在球场外砸窗的那群人。
transferEn: Describe the disorderly crowd breaking windows outside a stadium.

senseEn: a large strong bag
en: Could you help me lift this sack of rice?
zh: 能帮我抬一下这袋米吗？
transfer: 在花市询问一大袋土有多重。
transferEn: Ask the weight of a large bag of soil at a flower market.

senseEn: in the way something should be done
en: The door won't lock unless you close it properly first.
zh: 要先把门关好，门才能锁上。
transfer: 请技师看看洗碗机是否正常排水。
transferEn: Ask a technician to check whether the dishwasher drains as it should.

senseEn: a person serving customers in a shop
en: The store clerk can unlock that display case for you.
zh: 店员可以帮你打开那个展示柜。
transfer: 在文具店向同伴指出应该找哪位店员退货。
transferEn: Point out which shop employee can help your friend return an item.

senseEn: suitable for a particular situation
en: Are jeans appropriate for the site visit?
zh: 去现场参观穿牛仔裤合适吗？
transfer: 参加追悼会前问朋友什么颜色的花合适。
transferEn: Ask which flowers would be suitable for a memorial.

senseEn: to stop oneself from giving in to something
en: I couldn't resist the smell of fresh bread, so I bought a loaf.
zh: 新出炉面包的香味让我忍不住买了一条。
transfer: 和朋友说说你逛旧书店时最难抵挡哪种诱惑。
transferEn: Tell a friend which temptation is hardest to turn down at a used bookstore.

senseEn: an organized thing people do
en: Is the kayaking activity included in the camp fee?
zh: 营费包含划皮艇活动吗？
transfer: 向老师推荐一个全班下雨天也能参加的活动。
transferEn: Suggest something the whole class can do on a rainy day.

senseEn: a user's information page on a service
en: Please remove my old number from my profile.
zh: 请把我的旧号码从个人资料页删掉。
transfer: 在求职网站向朋友解释去哪里更新资料照片。
transferEn: Tell a friend where to change their picture on a job site.

senseEn: an organized procession in public
en: The bus stops here until the parade passes.
zh: 公交车要在这儿等到游行队伍过去。
transfer: 问游客中心哪里适合带孩子看节日游行。
transferEn: Ask where children can watch the holiday procession.

senseEn: a person who looks for athletic talent
en: A talent scout watched our goalkeeper at Saturday's game.
zh: 一个球探在周六比赛时观察了我们的守门员。
transfer: 向教练询问哪位球探想看你下一场比赛。
transferEn: Ask which recruiter for a sports team wants to see your next match.

senseEn: a device for lighting a space
en: Could you move the desk lamp closer to the map?
zh: 能把台灯挪到地图旁边一点吗？
transfer: 读睡前故事时请孩子打开床头灯。
transferEn: Ask a child to switch on the bedside light for a story.

senseEn: a prize given in recognition of achievement
en: Who can nominate a colleague for the service award?
zh: 谁可以提名同事参评服务奖？
transfer: 请主持人说明摄影奖的评选条件。
transferEn: Ask the host how entries are judged for a photography prize.

senseEn: not serious or extensive
en: It's a minor cut, but do you have a bandage?
zh: 只是个小伤口，不过你有创可贴吗？
transfer: 交还租车时向工作人员指出一处轻微刮痕。
transferEn: Point out a small scratch when returning a rental car.

senseEn: a spoken or written observation
en: Could you clarify your last comment about the deadline?
zh: 能再解释一下你刚才关于截止时间的评论吗？
transfer: 读完文章后请朋友在下方留一句评论。
transferEn: Invite a friend to leave a short response below an article.

senseEn: to enter water headfirst
en: Can we dive here, or is the water too shallow?
zh: 我们可以在这里跳水吗，还是水太浅了？
transfer: 在泳池询问哪一端允许跳水。
transferEn: Ask which end of a pool allows headfirst entry.

senseEn: to emerge from an egg
en: When do the turtle eggs usually start to hatch?
zh: 海龟蛋通常什么时候开始孵化？
transfer: 养蚕时问老师蚕宝宝还要几天才能破壳。
transferEn: Ask your teacher when the young silkworms should emerge from their eggs.

senseEn: the natural world around living things
en: Will the new packaging do less harm to the environment?
zh: 新的包装对环境的危害会更小吗？
transfer: 向游客解释把垃圾带走怎样保护自然环境。
transferEn: Explain to visitors why packing out litter protects the natural surroundings.

senseEn: medicine taken to treat a condition
en: Should I bring my medication to the appointment?
zh: 就诊时我该把自己服用的药物带来吗？
transfer: 旅行前请药师确认这种药物需要如何存放。
transferEn: Before traveling, ask a pharmacist how to store the medicine you take.

senseEn: a cheerful informal hello
en: Hiya, Sam! Is the seat beside you free?
zh: 嗨，萨姆！你旁边的位置空着吗？
transfer: 在咖啡馆偶遇老同学，用随意的招呼开场。
transferEn: Greet an old classmate casually when you run into them at a café.

senseEn: an athlete who competes in combat sports
en: Which fighter won the opening bout?
zh: 哪位格斗选手赢了开场那场比赛？
transfer: 向主持人询问哪位选手将首先上场参加拳赛。
transferEn: Ask the announcer which combat athlete enters the ring first.

senseEn: a look on someone's face
en: I couldn't tell from her expression whether she liked the gift.
zh: 我看不出她的表情是在说喜欢还是不喜欢这份礼物。
transfer: 给摄影师描述合照里孩子惊讶的表情。
transferEn: Describe the surprised look on a child's face in a group photo.

senseEn: very dearly loved
en: The library is collecting photos of our beloved teacher.
zh: 图书馆正在征集我们敬爱的老师的照片。
transfer: 向朋友介绍社区里那家深受喜爱的小影院。
transferEn: Introduce a neighborhood cinema that local people dearly love.

senseEn: a room used for formal meetings
en: The vote will take place in the council chamber upstairs.
zh: 投票将在楼上的市议会议事厅举行。
transfer: 参观议会时询问旁听者从哪里进入议事厅。
transferEn: Ask where observers enter the legislative meeting room.

senseEn: a piece of work to be completed
en: My first task is to count the returned keys.
zh: 我的第一项任务是清点归还的钥匙。
transfer: 策划聚餐时请朋友认领一项准备工作。
transferEn: Ask a friend to take on one job for a shared dinner.

senseEn: to pass food or liquid down the throat
en: These pills are hard to swallow whole. Is there a liquid version?
zh: 这些药片难以整片吞下。有液体剂型吗？
transfer: 向医生说明你吞咽冷水时是否也疼。
transferEn: Tell a doctor whether it hurts to get cold water down too.

senseEn: the city serving as a country's seat of government
en: Does this train go straight to the capital?
zh: 这趟火车直达首都吗？
transfer: 向笔友介绍从你家到首都需要多长时间。
transferEn: Tell a pen pal how long it takes to reach your country's seat of government.

senseEn: money earned by selling goods
en: Our ticket sales doubled after the review came out.
zh: 评论刊出后，我们的票房收入翻了一番。
transfer: 给店长汇报周末销售额是否超过上周。
transferEn: Report whether weekend revenue from purchases exceeded last week's.

senseEn: the part of the face below the mouth
en: Can you lift your chin a little for the photo?
zh: 拍照时能稍微抬一下下巴吗？
transfer: 告诉医生你跌倒时磕到了下巴。
transferEn: Tell a doctor which part below your mouth hit the ground when you fell.

senseEn: a large container for bathing
en: The bathroom tub won't drain. Could someone check it?
zh: 浴室的浴缸排不出水。能来看看吗？
transfer: 给小孩洗澡前请家人摸摸浴缸里的水温。
transferEn: Ask a family member to feel the water in the bath before bathing a child.

senseEn: an entrance hall in a public building
en: Meet the guide in the hotel lobby at eight.
zh: 八点在酒店大堂和导游碰面。
transfer: 告诉朋友你正在剧院大堂的售票窗口旁等他。
transferEn: Tell a friend you're beside the ticket window in the theater entrance hall.

senseEn: one of the digits on a foot
en: I stubbed my big toe on the bed frame.
zh: 我大脚趾撞到了床架。
transfer: 试登山鞋时告诉店员哪根脚趾被挤得疼。
transferEn: Tell the clerk which digit on your foot gets squeezed in the hiking boot.

senseEn: a thin cord for tying things
en: Tie a piece of string around these letters.
zh: 用根细绳把这些信捆起来。
transfer: 放风筝前检查细绳够不够长。
transferEn: Before flying a kite, check the length of its cord.

senseEn: territories ruled under one sovereign power
en: Which islands belonged to the empire on this old map?
zh: 这张旧地图上哪些岛屿属于这个帝国？
transfer: 在历史展上问一枚硬币是哪个帝国发行的。
transferEn: Ask which imperial state issued a coin in a history exhibit.

senseEn: an account of what something looks like or is like
en: Can you give me a description of the missing backpack?
zh: 你能描述一下丢失的背包吗？
transfer: 发布租房广告前，请室友补充厨房的描述。
transferEn: Ask your roommate to add details about the kitchen to a rental listing.

senseEn: a short sleep during the day
en: I'll take a quick nap before my night shift.
zh: 我上夜班前要小睡一会儿。
transfer: 和家人商量午后让幼儿睡一小觉的时间。
transferEn: Agree on a time for your toddler's short afternoon sleep.

senseEn: a device that moves air or liquid
en: Do you have a bicycle pump for this flat tire?
zh: 这车胎瘪了，你有自行车打气筒吗？
transfer: 给气垫床充气前，问营地有没有充气泵。
transferEn: Ask for a device to inflate an air mattress at a campsite.

senseEn: the process of making goods
en: Can we resume production of these mugs next week?
zh: 下周能恢复生产这批马克杯吗？
transfer: 问厂长新自行车的生产何时开始。
transferEn: Ask the factory manager when manufacturing the new bicycles begins.

senseEn: to tell someone something they need to know
en: Please inform reception if your guest arrives after six.
zh: 如果你的客人六点后到，请通知前台。
transfer: 航班改期后请同伴通知来接机的司机。
transferEn: After a flight change, ask your companion to notify the pickup driver.

senseEn: a trick intended to cheat someone
en: That prize email sounds like a con to me.
zh: 我觉得那封中奖邮件听起来像个骗局。
transfer: 提醒朋友一个要求先付费的求职广告可能是骗局。
transferEn: Warn a friend that a job ad demanding payment upfront may be a scam.

senseEn: to turn something with your hand
en: Gently twist the cap until it clicks.
zh: 轻轻旋转盖子，直到听到咔嗒一声。
transfer: 教孩子转动手柄打开音乐盒。
transferEn: Show a child how to turn the handle on a music box.

senseEn: hair growing on the chin and cheeks
en: Do you recognize him without his beard?
zh: 他刮了胡子你还认得出来吗？
transfer: 在理发店说明你想把胡子修短多少。
transferEn: Tell a barber how much shorter you want the hair on your chin.

senseEn: usual or characteristic
en: Is this fog typical for the coast in June?
zh: 六月海边常有这种雾吗？
transfer: 问寄宿家庭典型的周日早餐吃些什么。
transferEn: Ask your host family what an ordinary Sunday breakfast looks like.

senseEn: a long straight rod used for support
en: One tent pole is missing from the bag.
zh: 袋子里少了一根帐篷杆。
transfer: 装窗帘时请搭档扶住长杆的一端。
transferEn: Ask someone to hold one end of the rod while fitting a curtain.

senseEn: an offer of a price at an auction
en: What's the highest bid on the green vase?
zh: 那个绿花瓶现在的最高出价是多少？
transfer: 在慈善拍卖会上说明你愿为围巾出多少钱。
transferEn: State the amount you offer for a scarf at a charity auction.

senseEn: unusual enough to attract attention
en: That's a remarkable change in the river level overnight.
zh: 河水一夜之间变化这么大，真不寻常。
transfer: 在读书会上称赞译者惊人的记忆力。
transferEn: Praise a translator's extraordinary memory at a book club.

senseEn: to become aware of something
en: I didn't realise the doors locked at nine.
zh: 我原先不知道门九点就锁。
transfer: 向同伴解释你刚意识到两张票日期不同。
transferEn: Tell a companion you only just noticed the dates on the tickets differ.

senseEn: to express dissatisfaction
en: Who can I complain to about the delivery fee?
zh: 我可以向谁投诉这笔配送费？
transfer: 在酒店向前台投诉楼上的深夜噪音。
transferEn: Tell reception you're unhappy about noise upstairs late at night.

senseEn: performances or activities provided for enjoyment
en: Does the ferry have live entertainment on weekends?
zh: 渡轮周末有现场娱乐表演吗？
transfer: 筹办聚会时询问预算里有没有儿童娱乐节目的费用。
transferEn: Ask whether the party budget covers something to amuse the children.

senseEn: a game matching called numbers on a card
en: We're playing bingo tonight. Do you need a card?
zh: 今晚玩宾果。你需要游戏卡吗？
transfer: 在社区中心询问数字连线游戏几点开始。
transferEn: Ask when the number-matching game begins at a community center.

senseEn: a former romantic partner
en: I ran into my ex at the station this morning.
zh: 今天早上我在车站偶遇了前任。
transfer: 跟好友说明是谁把前任的书送还了。
transferEn: Tell a close friend who returned your former partner's books.

senseEn: the team sport played primarily by kicking a ball
en: Do you play indoor soccer when the field is wet?
zh: 球场积水时你们踢室内足球吗？
transfer: 问邻居哪里可以为孩子报名参加足球训练。
transferEn: Ask where children can sign up to train in the sport played by kicking a ball into a goal.

senseEn: a disrespectful or hurtful remark
en: I meant it as a joke, not an insult.
zh: 我本想开玩笑，并无侮辱之意。
transfer: 向主持人解释为何你把那条留言视为侮辱。
transferEn: Explain to a moderator why you found a posted comment offensive.

senseEn: to formally request consideration
en: Can students apply for this weekend job?
zh: 学生能申请这份周末工作吗？
transfer: 问图书馆如何申请借阅证。
transferEn: Ask a library how to submit a request for a borrowing card.

senseEn: a blow with an open hand
en: Did the referee see the slap after the whistle?
zh: 裁判看到哨响后的那一巴掌了吗？
transfer: 描述戏剧排练中那记假装打出的耳光。
transferEn: Describe the staged open-handed blow in a rehearsal.

senseEn: a hand tool for driving nails
en: Do we have a hammer small enough for these picture hooks?
zh: 我们有适合钉这些挂画钩的小锤子吗？
transfer: 在工具图书馆询问能否借把锤子修椅子。
transferEn: Ask at a tool library to borrow something for driving nails into a chair.

senseEn: a person overseeing a film or show
en: The film producer will answer questions after the screening.
zh: 放映后制片人会接受提问。
transfer: 在播客制作名单里询问谁负责统筹整期节目。
transferEn: Ask who oversaw the whole episode in the podcast credits.

senseEn: relating to the church led by the pope
en: Is there a Catholic church within walking distance of the station?
zh: 车站步行范围内有天主教堂吗？
transfer: 在校史馆询问这所学校是否由天主教修女创办。
transferEn: Ask whether nuns from the church led by the pope founded the school.

senseEn: tidy and well arranged
en: Please keep the hallway neat for tomorrow's inspection.
zh: 为了明天的检查，请保持走廊整洁。
transfer: 欣赏朋友摆得整整齐齐的工具架。
transferEn: Compliment a friend's tidily arranged tool rack.

senseEn: a practice session for a performance
en: Can we move the dress rehearsal to Thursday evening?
zh: 能把彩排改到周四晚上吗？
transfer: 问合唱团第一次排练要不要带乐谱。
transferEn: Ask whether singers should bring sheet music to their first practice.

senseEn: located at the back
en: Please use the rear door when leaving the bus.
zh: 下公交车请走后门。
transfer: 向停车场管理员描述车后窗的裂纹。
transferEn: Describe a crack in the car's back window to the parking attendant.

senseEn: a system of tracks for trains
en: The old railroad bridge is now a walking trail.
zh: 这座旧铁路桥现在成了步行道。
transfer: 问当地人哪条铁路线还在运煤。
transferEn: Ask which train line still carries coal locally.

senseEn: a device that stores electrical energy
en: Does the scale take one battery or two?
zh: 这台秤装一节电池还是两节？
transfer: 发现遥控器没电时询问备用电池在哪。
transferEn: Ask where spare cells are kept when the remote dies.

senseEn: a school for specialized instruction
en: Is the music academy accepting beginners this term?
zh: 音乐学院这学期招初学者吗？
transfer: 询问舞蹈学院入学是否需要试演。
transferEn: Ask whether entry to a specialized dance school requires an audition.

senseEn: a person who revises work for publication
en: Has the editor approved the photo caption yet?
zh: 编辑批准这段图片说明了吗？
transfer: 向杂志社询问应该把书评发给哪位编辑。
transferEn: Ask the magazine who handles submissions of book reviews.

senseEn: to mix food by lifting and turning it
en: Gently toss the salad just before serving.
zh: 上桌前轻轻把沙拉拌匀。
transfer: 做意面时请搭档把面和酱轻拌均匀。
transferEn: Ask a partner to mix pasta with sauce using a light lifting motion.

senseEn: a casual restaurant serving simple meals
en: The corner diner serves breakfast until noon.
zh: 街角那家简餐店供应早餐到中午。
transfer: 问司机附近有没有通宵营业的简餐店。
transferEn: Ask a driver about a nearby casual restaurant that stays open all night.

senseEn: a person who works aboard a ship
en: Ask the sailor which ropes we should leave alone.
zh: 问水手哪些绳索我们不该碰。
transfer: 在港口采访一名水手，询问他通常在海上待多久。
transferEn: Ask a ship's crew member how long a typical trip at sea lasts.

senseEn: a unit equal to one twelfth of a foot
en: Leave an inch between the shelf and the pipe.
zh: 架子与管道之间留一英寸。
transfer: 量相框时询问能否把宽度增加一英寸。
transferEn: Ask whether a picture frame can be widened by one twelfth of a foot.

en: My front tire went flat halfway home.
zh: 回家半路上，我的前轮胎瘪了。
transfer: 租自行车前，请店员检查后轮胎的气压。
senseEn: rubber covering on a wheel
transferEn: Before renting a bicycle, ask the clerk to check the air pressure in the back wheel.

senseEn: a raised spot on a surface
en: Watch for the bump just past the bridge.
zh: 留意刚过桥后的那处凸起。
transfer: 给维护人员描述人行道上绊倒你的凸起处。
transferEn: Describe the raised spot on the pavement that tripped you.

senseEn: an area of closely cut grass
en: Please keep bikes off the front lawn.
zh: 请别把自行车推上前面的草坪。
transfer: 和邻居商量周末谁给共用草坪浇水。
transferEn: Arrange who will water the shared grassy area this weekend.

senseEn: unable to be seen
en: The watermark is almost invisible on the printed copy.
zh: 这张打印件上的水印几乎看不见。
transfer: 向同伴解释夜里深色渔线在水里几乎看不见。
transferEn: Explain why a dark fishing line can barely be seen in the water at night.

senseEn: a seed often eaten as a snack
en: Does this cookie contain peanut flour?
zh: 这块饼干含花生粉吗？
transfer: 在甜品店询问表面撒的是不是花生碎。
transferEn: Ask a bakery whether the topping is made from crushed groundnuts.

senseEn: without making much noise
en: Could you speak more quietly? The baby just fell asleep.
zh: 能小声点说话吗？宝宝刚睡着。
transfer: 提醒夜间到达的朋友轻轻关门。
transferEn: Ask a late-arriving friend to close the door without much noise.

en: I'm fond of this cup because my daughter made it.
zh: 我很喜欢这个杯子，因为它是我女儿做的。
transfer: 向朋友说起你尤其喜欢的一处海边小镇以及原因。
senseEn: feeling affection for someone or something
transferEn: Tell a friend about a seaside town you particularly like and explain why.

senseEn: having a color between red and blue
en: Could I try the purple scarf with this coat?
zh: 我能试试这条紫围巾配这件大衣吗？
transfer: 布置聚会时请同伴找出葡萄色的气球。
transferEn: Ask a party helper for balloons the color of dark grapes.

senseEn: a distinct stage of a process
en: Does the testing phase begin before the holidays?
zh: 测试阶段在假期前开始吗？
transfer: 向装修队确认刷墙属于工程的哪一阶段。
transferEn: Ask the decorators which stage of the project includes painting.

senseEn: a large gathering for a shared profession or interest
en: Are badges required for the teachers' convention?
zh: 参加教师大会需要佩戴胸牌吗？
transfer: 问酒店前台漫画大会在哪一层举行。
transferEn: Ask the hotel desk which floor hosts the large gathering for comic fans.

senseEn: a major overthrow of an existing political order
en: Was this flag used before or after the revolution?
zh: 这面旗帜是在革命前还是革命后使用的？
transfer: 参观博物馆时询问哪份报纸最早报道了那场革命。
transferEn: Ask a museum guide which newspaper first covered the overthrow of the old regime.

senseEn: a feeling of eager anticipation
en: You could hear the excitement in her voice when the tickets arrived.
zh: 票送到时，你能从她的声音里听出兴奋。
transfer: 回忆孩子第一次坐火车时表现出的兴奋。
transferEn: Describe how thrilled a child sounded before their first train ride.

senseEn: items produced or sold
en: Where should we put damaged goods before the supplier collects them?
zh: 供应商取走前，我们该把破损商品放在哪儿？
transfer: 询问柜台是否接受没有标签的商品退货。
transferEn: Ask the desk whether they accept returns of merchandise without tags.

senseEn: one individual product
en: One item on my receipt was charged twice.
zh: 小票上有件商品收了两次钱。
transfer: 在结账前请收银员移除购物车里最后那件商品。
transferEn: Before paying, ask the cashier to remove the last product in your cart.

senseEn: as a result
en: The hall seats sixty and thus cannot hold both classes.
zh: 礼堂能坐六十人，因此容不下两个班。
transfer: 写邮件解释因大巴取消，到达时间也要推迟。
transferEn: Write an email linking a canceled bus to your later arrival.

senseEn: feeling a need to drink
en: I'm really thirsty after that climb. Is there a tap nearby?
zh: 爬完那段路我渴极了。附近有水龙头吗？
transfer: 训练时告诉教练你口渴，想停下来喝水。
transferEn: During training, tell your coach you need a drink and a short break.

senseEn: one installment of a series
en: Which episode did we stop at last night?
zh: 昨晚我们看到第几集了？
transfer: 向朋友推荐某期播客，说明那一期有你喜欢的嘉宾。
transferEn: Recommend the installment of a podcast that features your favorite guest.

senseEn: a shallow cooking vessel
en: Heat the pan before you add the mushrooms.
zh: 先把锅烧热，再放蘑菇。
transfer: 煎蛋时问室友哪只平底锅不会粘。
transferEn: Ask a roommate which shallow cooking vessel works best for eggs without sticking.

senseEn: to usually do something
en: These buses tend to fill up before the hospital stop.
zh: 这些公交车往往还没到医院站就坐满了。
transfer: 向新同事指出周一的会议往往会超时。
transferEn: Tell a new coworker that Monday meetings usually run long.

senseEn: a pleasure trip by ship
en: Does the sunset cruise leave from this pier?
zh: 看日落的游船是从这个码头出发吗？
transfer: 问旅行社沿河游船是否包含午餐。
transferEn: Ask whether lunch comes with the sightseeing boat trip along the river.

senseEn: a prolonged state of unconsciousness
en: The family said he woke from a coma on Monday.
zh: 家属说他周一从昏迷中醒来了。
transfer: 阅读采访时确认病人当时昏迷了多久。
transferEn: Ask how long the patient remained unconscious in an interview you read.

senseEn: essential to a successful outcome
en: Knowing the exit route is critical for tomorrow's drill.
zh: 熟悉疏散路线对明天的演习至关重要。
transfer: 告诉团队为什么及时送到冷藏箱是活动成败的关键。
transferEn: Explain why getting the cooler there on time is essential to the event.

senseEn: the process of creating or improving something
en: Who is leading the development of the new booking tool?
zh: 谁在负责新预订工具的开发？
transfer: 询问设计师新款童车的开发用了多久。
transferEn: Ask a designer how long creating the new stroller took.

senseEn: a sharp temporary increase
en: Did the backup cause a spike in network traffic?
zh: 是备份导致网络流量突然飙升的吗？
transfer: 查看能耗图时指出供暖开启后用电量陡增。
transferEn: Point to the sudden jump in electricity use when the heating came on.

senseEn: involving great sadness or suffering
en: The memorial marks a tragic accident at the old mine.
zh: 这座纪念碑纪念旧矿井发生的一场惨痛事故。
transfer: 在读书会上描述故事结局为什么让你感到悲痛。
transferEn: Explain to a book club why the ending of a story was deeply sad.

senseEn: from or relating to Mexico
en: Is there a Mexican restaurant near the theater?
zh: 剧院附近有没有墨西哥餐馆？
transfer: 请朋友推荐一款来自墨西哥的传统甜点。
transferEn: Ask a friend for a traditional dessert from Mexico.

senseEn: an official responsible for a public service
en: The parks commissioner will answer questions about the playground closure.
zh: 公园事务专员将就游乐场关闭一事答疑。
transfer: 在听证会上询问负责交通事务的专员何时到场。
transferEn: Ask when the official in charge of transportation will attend the hearing.

senseEn: close by and easy to use
en: Keep a towel handy while you defrost the freezer.
zh: 给冷冻室除霜时，把毛巾放在手边。
transfer: 到机场安检前提醒家人把护照放在随手可取的地方。
transferEn: Remind your family to keep their passports within easy reach at security.

senseEn: to finish a course of education successfully
en: Can I graduate in June if I finish this course online?
zh: 如果我在线完成这门课，能在六月毕业吗？
transfer: 问表弟预计哪一年大学毕业。
transferEn: Ask your cousin when they expect to complete their university degree.

senseEn: an idea offered for consideration
en: Do you have a suggestion for a quieter place to meet?
zh: 你能推荐个安静些的见面地点吗？
transfer: 请读者提出一条改善校刊的建议。
transferEn: Invite a reader to offer one idea for improving the school magazine.

senseEn: to recommend an action
en: Would you advise booking the interpreter before we confirm the venue?
zh: 你建议我们在确认场地前就预订口译员吗？
transfer: 向园丁请教是否应该等到春天再移栽。
transferEn: Ask a gardener whether they recommend waiting until spring to transplant.

senseEn: a person's handwritten name
en: We still need your signature on the last page.
zh: 最后一页还需要你的签名。
transfer: 签收包裹前问送货员电子签名是否有效。
transferEn: Ask the courier whether writing your name electronically is acceptable.

senseEn: a distinctive way of pronouncing words
en: I recognized his accent before I saw his face.
zh: 还没看到他的脸，我就听出了他的口音。
transfer: 在口述采访中描述你祖父说话的地方口音。
transferEn: Describe your grandfather's regional pronunciation for an oral history.

senseEn: work done by people, especially for pay
en: Does the repair price include parts and labor?
zh: 维修报价包含零件和人工吗？
transfer: 比较搬家报价时询问人工费用如何计算。
transferEn: Ask how the charge for the movers' work is calculated.

senseEn: a person who studies the natural world systematically
en: Can we interview the scientist who tested the lake water?
zh: 我们能采访检测了湖水的那位科学家吗？
transfer: 为校园讲座邀请一位研究鸟类迁徙的科学家。
transferEn: Invite a researcher studying bird migration to speak at school.

senseEn: having an empty space inside
en: Is this shelf solid wood or hollow inside?
zh: 这块搁板是实木的，还是里面中空的？
transfer: 做灯笼时问木球内部是不是空的。
transferEn: Ask whether a wooden ball for a lantern has an empty center.

en: Please clear the hallway so the robot can vacuum it.
zh: 请把走廊里的东西收起来，好让机器人吸尘。
transfer: 参观工厂时告诉孩子是哪台机器在给汽车喷漆。
senseEn: a machine programmed to perform tasks
transferEn: On a factory tour, point out the machine that paints cars to your child.

senseEn: as a representative of someone
en: I'm calling on behalf of my father about his lost keys.
zh: 我是代我父亲打电话来问他丢失的钥匙。
transfer: 在领奖时代表全队感谢志愿者。
transferEn: Thank the volunteers while accepting an award for your whole team.

senseEn: permission or opportunity to go in
en: Is entry to the garden free after four?
zh: 四点后进花园免费吗？
transfer: 带宠物去集市前询问宠物能否入场。
transferEn: Ask whether pets may enter the market.

senseEn: an exchange of views about a topic
en: Could we save the discussion about grades until after class?
zh: 我们能把关于成绩的讨论留到课后吗？
transfer: 在家庭会议上安排时间讨论假期预算。
transferEn: Set aside time at a family meeting to exchange views on the holiday budget.

senseEn: providing useful assistance
en: Your notes were especially helpful when the screen froze.
zh: 屏幕卡住时，你的笔记特别有帮助。
transfer: 给志愿者写便条，说明哪条指路信息帮到了你。
transferEn: Write to a volunteer explaining which directions assisted you.

senseEn: intended to last indefinitely
en: Do we need permission for a permanent sign outside the shop?
zh: 在店外装固定招牌需要许可吗？
transfer: 询问租房时能否在墙上装永久性的架子。
transferEn: Ask whether a wall shelf intended to stay indefinitely is allowed in a rental.

senseEn: people born around the same period
en: People of my grandmother's generation remember the old station.
zh: 我祖母那一代人还记得老车站。
transfer: 聊家谱时说明哪一代人最先迁居城市。
transferEn: Discuss which age cohort in your family first moved to the city.

en: The museum guide showed us where a servant slept in winter.
zh: 博物馆讲解员带我们看了一名仆人冬天睡觉的地方。
transfer: 看古装剧时，指出哪位角色是庄园里的仆人。
senseEn: a person employed to serve a household
transferEn: While watching a historical drama, identify the character who works for the estate household.

senseEn: a yellow metal made from copper and zinc
en: Are these handles solid brass or just plated?
zh: 这些把手是纯黄铜的还是只是镀了一层？
transfer: 清洁旧烛台前询问它是不是黄铜做的。
transferEn: Ask whether an old candlestick is made from the yellow copper alloy before cleaning it.

senseEn: an official document granting permission
en: Do I need a parking permit for this street?
zh: 在这条街停车需要许可证吗？
transfer: 露营前问护林员夜宿是否需要许可证。
transferEn: Ask a ranger whether overnight camping requires written authorization.

senseEn: a woman whose spouse has died
en: The artist's widow lent these sketches to the gallery.
zh: 这位艺术家的遗孀把这些素描借给了画廊。
transfer: 读传记时指出是哪位作家的遗孀整理了他的信件。
transferEn: Identify the writer's surviving wife who organized his letters.

senseEn: a person who uses violence to intimidate for political ends
en: The editor asked what evidence supported calling the suspect a terrorist.
zh: 编辑问，把嫌疑人称为恐怖分子有什么证据。
transfer: 在媒体课上询问报道为何引用了这个涉及政治暴力的称呼。
transferEn: In a media class, ask why a report quoted this label for a person linked to political violence.

senseEn: located higher up
en: The upper deck is closed because of the wind.
zh: 因为风大，上层甲板关闭了。
transfer: 给住客指路，告诉他们早餐厅在车站上层。
transferEn: Direct guests to the breakfast room on the higher level of the station.

senseEn: having a cutting edge that is no longer sharp
en: This dull knife keeps squashing the tomatoes.
zh: 这把钝刀总把西红柿切得稀烂。
transfer: 修剪花枝时请同伴换掉已经变钝的剪刀。
transferEn: Ask a gardening partner to swap the pruning shears that no longer cut cleanly.

senseEn: the seventh month of the year
en: Are there still rooms available in July?
zh: 七月份还有空房吗？
transfer: 告诉朋友夏令营从七月的第一个星期一开始。
transferEn: Tell a friend that camp starts on the first Monday of the seventh month.

senseEn: a US coin worth ten cents
en: I'm a dime short for the meter. Do you have change?
zh: 停车表还差一角钱。你有零钱吗？
transfer: 买邮票时问店员是否收一角硬币。
transferEn: Ask whether a postal clerk accepts US ten-cent coins.

senseEn: a physician specializing in mental health
en: Will I see the same psychiatrist at my next appointment?
zh: 我下次就诊还会见到同一位精神科医生吗？
transfer: 询问诊所预约精神科医生是否需要转诊。
transferEn: Ask whether seeing a medical specialist in mental health requires a referral.

senseEn: to find out something previously unknown
en: How did you discover the error in the survey totals?
zh: 你是怎么发现调查汇总数据里的错误的？
transfer: 请研究员讲讲她是怎样发现湖里那个新物种的。
transferEn: Ask a researcher how she first found the new species in a lake.

senseEn: to move along on hands and knees
en: Our baby can crawl across the rug now.
zh: 我们家宝宝现在能爬过地毯了。
transfer: 过低矮的游戏通道时，请孩子跟着你爬过去。
transferEn: Invite a child to follow you on hands and knees through a low play tunnel.

senseEn: a secure room used to store valuables
en: The original coins are in the museum vault.
zh: 真币存放在博物馆的保险库里。
transfer: 问银行负责人哪些文件需要放进保险库。
transferEn: Ask a bank manager which documents belong in the secure storage room.

senseEn: located below the surface of the ground
en: There's an underground passage between the terminals.
zh: 两个航站楼之间有一条地下通道。
transfer: 向司机说明商场的地下停车场从哪边进。
transferEn: Show a driver where to enter the shopping center's below-ground garage.

senseEn: a sour yellow citrus fruit
en: Would you like a slice of lemon in your tea?
zh: 你的茶里要加一片柠檬吗？
transfer: 买鱼时请店主再给你装一个适合挤汁的柠檬。
transferEn: When buying fish, ask for a sour yellow citrus fruit to squeeze over it.

senseEn: small balls of ice falling from clouds
en: Did the hail damage the greenhouse roof?
zh: 冰雹砸坏温室屋顶了吗？
transfer: 向保险公司描述砸在车顶的冰雹有多大。
transferEn: Describe to your insurer the size of the ice pellets that hit the car roof.

senseEn: a purchase at an unusually good price
en: At twenty dollars, this used desk was a real bargain.
zh: 这张二手书桌只要二十美元，真划算。
transfer: 逛跳蚤市场时告诉朋友哪件东西便宜得特别值。
transferEn: Point out an exceptionally good deal to a friend at a flea market.

senseEn: remaining faithful or supportive
en: She's been a loyal customer since the bakery opened.
zh: 面包店开张以来，她一直是忠实顾客。
transfer: 向教练介绍即使输球也始终支持球队的球迷。
transferEn: Describe a fan who sticks with the team even when they lose.

en: Grandpa told us a tale about a fox that stole a bell.
zh: 爷爷给我们讲了一个狐狸偷铃铛的故事。
transfer: 向图书管理员打听一本关于海盗的故事书。
senseEn: a story someone tells
transferEn: Ask a librarian about a book with a pirate story.

senseEn: soft earth used to shape objects
en: Keep the clay damp until the handles are attached.
zh: 装上把手前要让黏土保持湿润。
transfer: 上陶艺课前询问每人需要多少黏土。
transferEn: Ask how much modeling earth each student needs for pottery class.

senseEn: exactly and accurately
en: Could you mark precisely where the shelf should end?
zh: 你能精确标出搁板末端该到哪里吗？
transfer: 向裁缝说明袖子需要精确缩短多少。
transferEn: Tell a tailor exactly how much shorter the sleeves should be.

senseEn: two or more things used together
en: I like the combination of lime and mint in this drink.
zh: 我喜欢这杯饮料里青柠与薄荷的搭配。
transfer: 请店员推荐一种适合秋天的围巾和外套颜色组合。
transferEn: Ask a clerk to recommend scarf and coat colors that work together for autumn.

senseEn: a running written record of events
en: Please enter the return time in the vehicle log.
zh: 请在车辆使用记录簿里填上归还时间。
transfer: 值班交接时问同事把设备故障记在哪本记录簿。
transferEn: At handover, ask where your colleague records equipment faults.

senseEn: a lasting design inked on the skin
en: Did you design the tattoo on your wrist yourself?
zh: 你手腕上的纹身是自己设计的吗？
transfer: 向画师说明你希望把纹身放在肩膀哪个位置。
transferEn: Show an artist where on your shoulder you want the inked design.

senseEn: the information supporting a decision
en: What was the basis for choosing this supplier?
zh: 选择这家供应商的依据是什么？
transfer: 询问评委根据什么给作品排序。
transferEn: Ask the judges what they used to rank the entries.

senseEn: a clickable reference to an online resource
en: Could you resend the link to the registration form?
zh: 能重发一下报名表的链接吗？
transfer: 请同事给你发线上会议的入口。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to send the clickable address for an online meeting.

senseEn: a slender pointed tool used for sewing
en: Is this needle sharp enough for denim?
zh: 这根针够尖，能缝牛仔布吗？
transfer: 修布偶时向朋友借一根能穿粗线的缝衣针。
transferEn: Borrow a sewing tool with an eye large enough for thick thread.

senseEn: music known for improvisation and distinctive rhythms
en: Does the café have live jazz on Thursdays?
zh: 咖啡馆周四有现场爵士乐吗？
transfer: 为聚会找一张以萨克斯即兴演奏为主的爵士唱片。
transferEn: Ask for a record of improvised saxophone music for a party.

senseEn: a professional cook
en: Could you ask the chef whether the broth contains milk?
zh: 能帮忙问问厨师高汤里有没有牛奶吗？
transfer: 吃完饭后请服务员替你谢谢做甜点的厨师。
transferEn: Ask your server to thank the professional who made dessert.

senseEn: a woman in a relationship with someone else's spouse
en: Did the letters reveal his mistress to his family?
zh: 是这些信让家人知道他有婚外情人的吗？
transfer: 讨论小说时解释哪位角色是国王的婚外女伴。
transferEn: In a novel discussion, identify the woman having an affair with the married king.

senseEn: cured strips of pork
en: Could you leave the bacon off my breakfast sandwich?
zh: 早餐三明治能不加培根吗？
transfer: 买披萨前询问配料里有没有腌猪肉片。
transferEn: Ask whether a pizza includes strips of cured pork.

senseEn: someone claiming unusual powers of perception
en: The fair has a psychic offering palm readings by the entrance.
zh: 集市入口旁有个自称通灵的人在给人看手相。
transfer: 讨论侦探剧时指出哪位角色自称能与亡者交流。
transferEn: Identify the character in a detective show who claims to speak with the dead.

senseEn: the person presiding over a group
en: Will the chairman take questions after the vote?
zh: 投票结束后主席会接受提问吗？
transfer: 请董事会主席宣布会议休息十分钟。
transferEn: Ask the board's presiding officer to announce a ten-minute break.

senseEn: small in likelihood
en: There's still a slim chance of finding a cancellation tonight.
zh: 今晚仍有一线机会订到别人取消的名额。
transfer: 问招生办候补名单排到你还有没有一点希望。
transferEn: Ask admissions whether there is even a small chance of reaching your place on the waitlist.

senseEn: causing disappointment through bad luck
en: It's unfortunate that the rain started just before the concert.
zh: 音乐会快开始才下起雨，真遗憾。
transfer: 向朋友表示两个重要活动撞期实在可惜。
transferEn: Tell a friend you regret that two important events fall on the same day.

senseEn: a main division of a book
en: Do we need to read the whole chapter before Tuesday?
zh: 周二之前要读完整章吗？
transfer: 向读书会推荐描写主人公童年的那一章。
transferEn: Recommend the part of the book covering the main character's childhood.

senseEn: direct light from the sun
en: Move the seedlings where they'll get morning sunshine.
zh: 把幼苗挪到早上能晒到阳光的地方。
transfer: 订房时问哪个房间下午能晒到阳光。
transferEn: Ask which room gets direct sunlight in the afternoon.

senseEn: a person who grows crops or raises livestock
en: Ask the farmer when these pears were picked.
zh: 问问农户这些梨是什么时候摘的。
transfer: 带孩子参观菜地时，询问种菜的农民如何防霜冻。
transferEn: Ask the grower showing your child around a vegetable patch how they protect crops from frost.

senseEn: a vehicle propelled by expelled gases
en: Can we watch the rocket launch from the visitor center?
zh: 我们能在游客中心观看火箭发射吗？
transfer: 在太空展询问哪枚火箭把卫星送入轨道。
transferEn: Ask which launch vehicle carried a satellite into orbit at a space exhibit.

en: I caught my thumb in the drawer. Could you get some ice?
zh: 我的拇指被抽屉夹了。能拿点冰来吗？
transfer: 试手套时指出拇指处太紧。
senseEn: the short digit opposite the fingers
transferEn: When trying on gloves, say where the fit feels tight by the shortest digit.

senseEn: a small solid dose of medicine
en: Is this the pill I take after breakfast?
zh: 这是我早饭后要吃的那颗药吗？
transfer: 请药师确认包装里每颗药丸的剂量。
transferEn: Ask a pharmacist how much medicine each tablet contains.

senseEn: a small jumping amphibian
en: I spotted a frog under the watering can.
zh: 我在浇水壶下面看到了一只青蛙。
transfer: 池塘边请孩子安静听青蛙的叫声。
transferEn: Ask a child to listen quietly for a croaking amphibian at a pond.

senseEn: a work intended to amuse
en: Shall we watch a comedy after that long meeting?
zh: 开了这么久的会，咱们看部喜剧好吗？
transfer: 问售票员今晚的剧是喜剧还是悲剧。
transferEn: Ask whether tonight's play is intended to make the audience laugh or cry.

senseEn: a visible mass of condensed water in the sky
en: That dark cloud is moving toward our campsite.
zh: 那朵乌云正往我们的营地飘来。
transfer: 拍照时请朋友等那朵云从太阳前面移开。
transferEn: Ask a friend to wait for the mass of vapor blocking the sun to pass before taking a photo.

senseEn: used for eating meals
en: Leave the flowers on the dining table, please.
zh: 请把花放在餐桌上。
transfer: 看房时询问用餐区能否放下六把椅子。
transferEn: Ask whether the area for meals in a house has room for six chairs.

senseEn: a male police officer
en: A policeman directed us around the flooded street.
zh: 一名男警察指引我们绕过积水的街道。
transfer: 向朋友指出在车站帮你找回钱包的那位男警察。
transferEn: Point out the male officer who helped you recover your wallet at the station.

senseEn: working with one's true identity hidden
en: Was the reporter working undercover when she visited the factory?
zh: 记者参观工厂时是隐瞒身份的吗？
transfer: 在影评中说明哪位角色是秘密调查的警员。
transferEn: Identify the detective working under a concealed identity in a film review.

senseEn: a disparaging informal term for a sex worker
en: The editor flagged the word “hooker” as insulting.
zh: 编辑指出，这个称呼对性工作者带有侮辱意味。
transfer: 在翻译讨论中指出剧本用了哪个贬义称呼。
transferEn: Identify the disparaging label for a sex worker in a script translation discussion.

senseEn: used to express hope for an outcome
en: Hopefully the bus will arrive before the rain gets heavier.
zh: 但愿雨势变大前公交车能到。
transfer: 朋友等候化验结果时，表达你希望好消息快点来的心情。
transferEn: Express the hope that a friend waiting for test results will hear good news soon.

senseEn: to attach firmly in position
en: Can we mount the shelf above the desk?
zh: 我们能把搁板装在书桌上方吗？
transfer: 询问师傅能不能把屏幕固定在砖墙上。
transferEn: Ask an installer whether a screen can be attached to a brick wall.

senseEn: intended for one person
en: Could we have individual portions instead of one large pie?
zh: 可以把一个大派换成每人一份的小派吗？
transfer: 做活动预算时询问能否为每位参加者提供单独包装的午餐。
transferEn: Ask whether lunches can be packed separately for each participant.

senseEn: the state of being real or present
en: Do these photos prove the existence of a second entrance?
zh: 这些照片能证明还有另一个入口吗？
transfer: 讨论家谱时，问哪封信能证明确有这位亲属。
transferEn: Ask which letter establishes that a relative in the family tree really lived.

senseEn: a meal eaten outdoors
en: Let's have a picnic by the river after the walk.
zh: 散步后我们到河边野餐吧。
transfer: 公园天色转阴时请家人决定是否改天野餐。
transferEn: Ask your family whether to postpone an outdoor meal when the sky clouds over.

senseEn: a sector of economic activity
en: How did you get into the film industry?
zh: 你是怎样进入电影行业的？
transfer: 采访邻居时询问旅游业近年来发生了什么变化。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor how the tourism sector has changed in recent years.

senseEn: a professional who designs or evaluates technical systems
en: Has an engineer checked the crack in the bridge?
zh: 有工程师检查过桥上的裂缝了吗？
transfer: 向招聘人员询问谁负责面试电气工程师。
transferEn: Ask a recruiter who interviews applicants for the electrical engineering position.

senseEn: to shout disapproval at a performance
en: Why did the crowd boo the referee after the whistle?
zh: 哨声响后观众为什么朝裁判喝倒彩？
transfer: 讨论戏剧礼仪时说明你为何不会向演员喝倒彩。
transferEn: Explain why you wouldn't shout disapproval at actors during a play.

senseEn: an informal name for a helicopter
en: The rescue chopper landed on the school field.
zh: 救援直升机降落在学校操场上。
transfer: 给朋友描述飞越峡谷时见到的观光直升机。
transferEn: Casually describe a sightseeing helicopter you saw over a canyon.

senseEn: to think or suppose informally
en: Do you reckon we'll need a jacket for the ferry?
zh: 你觉得我们坐渡轮需要带外套吗？
transfer: 随口问朋友他觉得哪支队伍会先得分。
transferEn: Casually ask a friend which team they think will score first.

senseEn: to allow someone to use something temporarily
en: Could you lend me a stepladder until Saturday?
zh: 能把折梯借我用到周六吗？
transfer: 同学忘带画笔，主动提出借给他一支。
transferEn: Offer a classmate temporary use of a paintbrush they forgot to bring.

senseEn: continued faithfulness to a person or group
en: The team thanked its fans for their loyalty after a tough season.
zh: 艰难的赛季结束后，球队感谢球迷一直以来的支持。
transfer: 在离职致辞中感谢同事多年来对团队的忠诚。
transferEn: Thank a departing colleague for years of faithfulness to the team.

senseEn: exceptionally good or enjoyable
en: Thank you for a splendid meal; the lemon tart was my favorite.
zh: 谢谢你准备了丰盛的一餐，我最喜欢柠檬挞。
transfer: 给导游写卡片，称赞你们在山上度过的美好一天。
transferEn: Write a guide a card praising an exceptionally enjoyable day in the hills.

senseEn: a place offering protection from the weather or danger
en: There's a shelter beside the trail if the storm gets worse.
zh: 如果风雨变大，步道旁有个可以躲避的地方。
transfer: 询问救援人员附近哪里有临时避难所。
transferEn: Ask a rescue worker where people can find temporary protection nearby.

senseEn: an informal affirmative reply
en: “Is that your coat?” “Yup, that's mine.”
zh: “那是你的外套吗？”“嗯，是我的。”
transfer: 朋友问你是不是带了钥匙，随口答是。
transferEn: Give a casual affirmative answer when a friend asks whether you brought the keys.

senseEn: the people responsible for running an organization
en: Has the management approved the extra night shift?
zh: 管理层批准加开夜班了吗？
transfer: 问酒店员工如何将意见反馈给管理层。
transferEn: Ask hotel staff how to pass feedback to the people who run the property.

senseEn: a thick textile floor covering
en: Please take your muddy shoes off before stepping on the carpet.
zh: 踏上地毯前，请脱掉沾泥的鞋。
transfer: 租房交接时指出地毯上原本就有的污渍。
transferEn: Point out an existing stain on a textile floor covering at move-in.

senseEn: extremely pleasing or delightful
en: That divine lemon sauce made the fish my favorite dish.
zh: 那道绝妙的柠檬酱让我最喜欢这盘鱼。
transfer: 尝过朋友做的蛋糕后，热情称赞奶油馅的味道。
transferEn: After trying a friend's cake, enthusiastically praise its exceptionally good filling.

senseEn: to reveal a surprise and reduce enjoyment
en: Please don't spoil the ending; I'm only halfway through.
zh: 请别剧透结局，我才看到一半。
transfer: 给比赛录播观众发消息时，请群友别泄露比分。
transferEn: Ask a group chat not to ruin a recorded match by revealing the score.

senseEn: in a position directly below
en: The spare key is beneath the mat by the side door.
zh: 备用钥匙在侧门旁的垫子下面。
transfer: 给朋友指路，说明自行车架在楼梯下方。
transferEn: Tell a friend the bicycle rack is directly below the staircase.

senseEn: a large piece of cloth used on a bed
en: Do you have a fitted sheet for the guest bed?
zh: 客床有合适的床笠吗？
transfer: 向酒店说明床单上有污渍，需要更换。
transferEn: Tell a hotel that the bed linen has a stain and needs replacing.

senseEn: in or relating to the south
en: The southern trail is shorter but much steeper.
zh: 南边那条步道更短，可是陡得多。
transfer: 向游客推荐从南侧入口进入公园。
transferEn: Recommend entering the park through the entrance on the south side.

senseEn: sexually explicit material intended for adults
en: Can I report a porn ad that appeared in this puzzle app?
zh: 我能举报这个益智应用里出现的色情广告吗？
transfer: 向版主说明有人在公共讨论区贴了色情内容。
transferEn: Tell a moderator that someone posted sexually explicit material in a public discussion.

senseEn: the way someone or something looks
en: Has the repair changed the appearance of the frame?
zh: 修理后镜框的外观变了吗？
transfer: 比较翻修前后的照片，说明建筑外观有何变化。
transferEn: Describe changes in a building's looks using photos taken before and after renovation.

senseEn: unwilling to make an effort
en: I feel too lazy to cook tonight. Shall we get soup downstairs?
zh: 我今晚懒得做饭。咱们去楼下喝汤好吗？
transfer: 跟朋友解释你周日懒得出门买报纸。
transferEn: Explain to a friend that you didn't feel like making the effort to go out for Sunday's paper.

en: I missed the first scene. Can you fill me in on the plot?
zh: 我错过了第一场。你能给我讲讲剧情吗？
transfer: 推荐小说时，请朋友不要透露最后一章的情节。
senseEn: the events that make up a story
transferEn: When recommending a novel, ask your friend to keep the final chapter's events secret.

senseEn: cured meat from a pig's leg
en: Could you make the ham sandwich without mustard?
zh: 火腿三明治能不加芥末吗？
transfer: 点早餐时问煎蛋卷里有没有火腿。
transferEn: Ask whether a breakfast omelet contains cured pork from the leg.

senseEn: someone paid to work for an employer
en: Does every employee get a locker on the first day?
zh: 每位员工入职第一天都有储物柜吗？
transfer: 向经理确认兼职员工能否参加培训。
transferEn: Ask a manager whether a part-time staff member can attend training.

senseEn: a metal award for an achievement
en: Can I see the medal you won in the relay?
zh: 能看看你接力赛赢得的奖牌吗？
transfer: 比赛颁奖前问奖牌上是否刻有选手姓名。
transferEn: Ask whether the athletes' names are engraved on their metal awards.

senseEn: a person's characteristic way of behaving
en: Her calm manner helped the children settle down.
zh: 她沉着的举止让孩子们平静下来。
transfer: 向主管称赞前台接待客人时亲切的举止。
transferEn: Compliment a receptionist's friendly way of dealing with guests.

senseEn: a woman who serves diners
en: The waitress brought extra bowls so we could share the soup.
zh: 女服务员拿来了多余的碗，好让我们分汤。
transfer: 在咖啡馆向同伴指出是哪位女服务员帮你找到了钥匙。
transferEn: Point out the woman serving diners who found your keys at the café.

senseEn: a team game played with sticks and a ball or puck
en: Does the rink rent ice hockey helmets?
zh: 冰场出租冰球头盔吗？
transfer: 问邻居孩子所在的冰球队每周在哪里训练。
transferEn: Ask where a neighbor's child practices the team sport played with sticks and a puck.

en: The photos show the destruction of nesting sites after the storm.
zh: 照片显示了风暴过后筑巢地的损毁情况。
transfer: 向博物馆访客介绍一场火灾对老城区造成的破坏。
senseEn: damage that leaves something ruined
transferEn: Tell museum visitors how a fire ruined parts of the old town.

en: Is there a visual guide showing how the parts fit together?
zh: 有没有图解能说明这些零件怎么装在一起？
transfer: 给新生做导览时，建议在文字说明旁增加视觉提示。
senseEn: related to what can be seen
transferEn: Suggest adding cues students can see alongside written directions on an orientation tour.

senseEn: a large bird of prey
en: There's an eagle circling above the ridge. Can you see it?
zh: 山脊上方有只鹰在盘旋。你看到了吗？
transfer: 向向导确认悬崖上的大鸟是不是鹰。
transferEn: Ask your guide whether the large bird of prey on the cliff is an eagle rather than a vulture.

senseEn: regularly moving or exercising
en: How do you stay active when the walking trail is icy?
zh: 步道结冰时你怎么保持运动？
transfer: 问退休的朋友最近参加什么活动来保持活力。
transferEn: Ask what activities keep a retired friend moving these days.

senseEn: food prepared as one part of a meal
en: Which vegetable dish goes well with the grilled fish?
zh: 哪道蔬菜适合配烤鱼？
transfer: 聚餐时向朋友介绍你带来的拿手菜。
transferEn: Introduce the prepared food you brought to a shared dinner.

senseEn: a young dog
en: Could you watch our puppy while I answer the door?
zh: 我去开门时你能照看一下我们的小狗吗？
transfer: 问邻居那只刚领养的小狗几个月大了。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor the age of their newly adopted young dog.

senseEn: energy supplied through electrical systems
en: Is electricity included in the monthly rent?
zh: 月租包括电费吗？
transfer: 停电后向物业询问什么时候恢复供电。
transferEn: Ask building management when power will return after an outage.

senseEn: something newly found or learned
en: Which discovery changed the team's original theory?
zh: 哪项发现改变了团队最初的理论？
transfer: 读新闻时向朋友介绍考古队最近的一项发现。
transferEn: Tell a friend about something an archaeological team recently found.

senseEn: not awake or able to respond
en: Was the passenger still unconscious when help arrived?
zh: 救援人员到时，那位乘客还没有恢复意识吗？
transfer: 告诉医护人员病人失去意识大约有多久。
transferEn: Tell a clinician approximately how long a patient was unresponsive.

senseEn: a scented liquid worn on the body
en: Do you have this perfume in a smaller bottle?
zh: 这款香水有小瓶装吗？
transfer: 给朋友挑礼物时询问有没有花香调的香水。
transferEn: Ask for a floral fragrance as a gift for a friend.

en: I lost my temper when he tore up my drawing.
zh: 他撕了我的画，我当时发了火。
transfer: 向队友道歉，解释你在输球后发了脾气。
senseEn: a tendency to become angry
transferEn: Apologize to a teammate for losing control of your anger after a defeat.

senseEn: a building used for live performances
en: Does the theatre have a lift to the balcony seats?
zh: 这家剧院有到楼座的电梯吗？
transfer: 问司机从火车站打车到剧院要多久。
transferEn: Ask how long a taxi takes from the train station to the live-performance venue.

senseEn: a soft support for the head in bed
en: Could I have a firmer pillow for tonight?
zh: 今晚能给我换个硬一点的枕头吗？
transfer: 露营前问朋友要不要带充气枕头。
transferEn: Ask a friend whether to pack an inflatable headrest for camping.

senseEn: having a strong natural ability
en: She's a talented violinist. Could we invite her to play?
zh: 她是个很有才华的小提琴手。我们能邀请她来演奏吗？
transfer: 推荐同学参展时，描述他在摄影上的天赋。
transferEn: Recommend a classmate for an exhibition by praising their natural gift for photography.

senseEn: a person who shares one's living space
en: My new roommate works nights, so please knock quietly.
zh: 我的新室友上夜班，所以请轻点敲门。
transfer: 向房东询问能不能让室友一起签租约。
transferEn: Ask whether the person sharing your apartment can sign the lease too.

senseEn: to give official permission
en: Who can approve this expense before the office closes?
zh: 下班前谁能批准这笔开支？
transfer: 约教室前问谁负责批准周末用房申请。
transferEn: Ask who can authorize a weekend classroom booking.

en: One more goal would be enough to defeat the visitors.
zh: 再进一球就足以击败客队。
transfer: 向朋友解释你们要击败哪支队伍才能晋级。
senseEn: to win against an opponent
transferEn: Explain which team you must beat to advance.

senseEn: based on systematic observation or investigation
en: Is there scientific evidence for that claim about memory?
zh: 那个关于记忆力的说法有科学依据吗？
transfer: 看产品广告时问它有没有经过科学试验。
transferEn: Ask whether a product advertised online has undergone controlled testing.

senseEn: a large mammal with a trunk
en: The young elephant is standing behind its mother.
zh: 小象正站在母象身后。
transfer: 游览保护区时询问大象一天大约吃多少草料。
transferEn: Ask a reserve guide how much the large trunked animal eats in a day.

senseEn: an adult male chicken
en: Our neighbor's cock crows before the alarm goes off.
zh: 邻居家的公鸡总在闹钟响之前打鸣。
transfer: 参观农场时问孩子哪只鸟清晨会打鸣。
transferEn: Ask a child to identify the male chicken that calls at dawn.

senseEn: in a similar way or appearance
en: Those twins look alike even with different haircuts.
zh: 那对双胞胎就算剪了不同发型，看起来也很像。
transfer: 在旧照片中指出哪两位亲戚长得相像。
transferEn: Point out two relatives in an old photo who resemble each other.

senseEn: an image captured with a camera
en: May I borrow this photograph for the school exhibition?
zh: 我可以借这张照片参加校展吗？
transfer: 给失物处提供一张丢失单车的照片。
transferEn: Offer lost property a camera image of your missing bike.

sense: 辱骂女性性行为的贬称
senseEn: an offensive sexual insult usually directed at a woman
en: She reported the insult “slut” to the moderator.
zh: 她向版主举报了那句针对女性的性羞辱。
transfer: 在媒体课讨论中解释剧本里这个词为什么属于辱骂。
transferEn: Discuss why this gendered sexual slur in a script is abusive.

senseEn: a substance with a particular composition
en: Which cleaning chemical left a mark on the tiles?
zh: 哪种清洁剂在瓷砖上留下了痕迹？
transfer: 向物业询问泳池使用了哪种水处理剂。
transferEn: Ask building staff which substance is used to treat the pool water.

senseEn: a short preview of a film
en: Has the trailer for the new animation come out yet?
zh: 那部新动画的预告片出来了吗？
transfer: 看过电影后和朋友比较预告片与正片的气氛。
transferEn: Compare the tone of the film's short preview with that of the full movie.

senseEn: to become healthy again after an injury
en: How long should the cut take to heal?
zh: 这道伤口大概多久能愈合？
transfer: 复诊时告诉医生擦伤是否已经愈合。
transferEn: At a follow-up appointment, report whether a graze has closed up.

senseEn: from or relating to Greece
en: Could we order the Greek salad without onions?
zh: 希腊沙拉可以不加洋葱吗？
transfer: 请朋友推荐一道来自希腊的家常菜。
transferEn: Ask a friend for a home-style dish from Greece.

senseEn: complete and without exception
en: Is Friday an absolute deadline, or can I submit on Saturday?
zh: 周五是不能再延的截止时间吗，还是周六也可以提交？
transfer: 询问场馆的禁食规定是否对婴儿食品也毫无例外。
transferEn: Ask whether the venue's food ban allows any exceptions for baby food.

senseEn: suited to everyday needs
en: White cushions aren't very practical with a muddy dog at home.
zh: 家里有一只常弄得满身泥的狗，白靠垫不太实用。
transfer: 给通勤朋友推荐一款下雨天也实用的背包。
transferEn: Recommend a backpack suited to a rainy commute.

senseEn: intense anger
en: He shook with rage when he saw the broken windows.
zh: 他看到碎裂的窗户时气得发抖。
transfer: 描述小说主人公发现被骗时的强烈愤怒。
transferEn: Describe the main character's intense anger on discovering the deception.

senseEn: to become smaller
en: Will this sweater shrink in hot water?
zh: 这件毛衣用热水洗会缩水吗？
transfer: 送洗窗帘时问店员面料烘干后会不会缩小。
transferEn: Ask a cleaner whether tumble drying will make the curtain fabric smaller.

senseEn: identifying an individual item in a series
en: Where can I find the serial number on this printer?
zh: 这台打印机的序列号在哪里？
transfer: 报修相机时问客服需要机身上的哪组识别编号。
transferEn: Ask support which unique identifying number on the camera body they need.

senseEn: by a small degree
en: Could you move the mirror slightly higher?
zh: 你能把镜子稍微移高一点吗？
transfer: 试菜时告诉厨师这次汤比上次咸一点。
transferEn: Tell the cook the soup tastes a little saltier this time.

senseEn: a starchy edible tuber
en: Is that a baked potato or a bread roll on the side?
zh: 配菜是烤土豆还是小面包？
transfer: 采购晚餐食材时询问哪种土豆适合做泥。
transferEn: Ask which variety of the starchy vegetable is best for mashing.

senseEn: the sound of hands clapping in approval
en: Wait for the applause to fade before introducing the next singer.
zh: 等掌声平息后再介绍下一位歌手。
transfer: 描述演讲结束后大家持续了多久的掌声。
transferEn: Describe how long the audience kept clapping after a speech.

senseEn: as an unavoidable consequence
en: A shorter queue doesn't necessarily mean a shorter wait.
zh: 队伍较短不一定意味着等的时间更短。
transfer: 向同伴解释价格更高不一定更耐用。
transferEn: Explain why a higher price does not automatically mean greater durability.

senseEn: to bring an activity to a stop
en: Can we halt production until the gauge is checked?
zh: 能否暂停生产，等仪表检查完再继续？
transfer: 发现名牌有错时请印刷厂暂时停止印制。
transferEn: Ask the printer to stop work temporarily after spotting a name error.

senseEn: a spirit flavored with juniper
en: Is there gin in this cocktail, or is it alcohol-free?
zh: 这杯鸡尾酒里有金酒吗，还是无酒精的？
transfer: 买礼物时请店员推荐一款杜松子风味的烈酒。
transferEn: Ask a shop clerk for a juniper-flavored spirit as a gift.

senseEn: a large marine mammal
en: Did you see the whale surface beyond the boat?
zh: 你看到船那边浮出水面的鲸了吗？
transfer: 向向导询问这片海域什么时候最常看到鲸。
transferEn: Ask the guide when visitors most often see the huge marine mammals here.

senseEn: a person who makes public or broadcast announcements
en: I couldn't hear the announcer over the music. Which gate did she say?
zh: 音乐盖过了播音员的声音。她说的是哪个登机口？
transfer: 在体育馆问同伴现场播音员刚宣布了哪项纪录。
transferEn: Ask a companion which record the person on the stadium loudspeaker just announced.

senseEn: quiet and free from disturbance
en: Is the campsite still peaceful when the festival is on?
zh: 节庆期间那个营地还安静吗？
transfer: 向房东描述你想要一个夜间宁静的住处。
transferEn: Tell a host you'd like somewhere quiet and undisturbed at night.

senseEn: to move slowly and quietly
en: Try to creep past the nursery; the baby just fell asleep.
zh: 尽量轻轻地经过婴儿房，宝宝刚睡着。
transfer: 在戏剧排练中请演员悄悄走到幕布旁。
transferEn: In rehearsal, ask the actor to move quietly toward the curtain.

senseEn: a person responsible for overseeing a place
en: Ask the park warden whether this trail is open.
zh: 问问公园管理员这条步道开放了吗。
transfer: 向宿舍管理员报告楼道的灯坏了。
transferEn: Report a broken hallway light to the person in charge of the dormitory.

senseEn: happening without delay
en: Does the leak need immediate attention, or can it wait until morning?
zh: 漏水需要马上处理，还是可以等到早上？
transfer: 给供应商写信，说明哪项订单需要立即回复。
transferEn: Tell a supplier which order needs a response without delay.

senseEn: to make something straight
en: Can you straighten the rug before someone trips?
zh: 能把地毯铺平吗？免得有人绊倒。
transfer: 拍照前请朋友把领带整理端正。
transferEn: Ask a friend to adjust a crooked tie before a photograph.

senseEn: a live performance, especially by musicians
en: Our next evening gig is at the little café on King Street.
zh: 我们下一场晚间演出在国王街的小咖啡馆。
transfer: 询问乐队周末的演出是否还有票。
transferEn: Ask whether tickets remain for the band's weekend performance.

en: Can the van transport the boxes in one trip?
zh: 这辆面包车能一次把箱子运完吗？
transfer: 向花店询问他们怎样运送高大的盆栽。
senseEn: to carry people or things between places
transferEn: Ask a florist how they move tall potted plants.

senseEn: a professional who treats teeth and gums
en: Can the dentist check this chipped tooth today?
zh: 牙医今天能看看这颗磕缺的牙吗？
transfer: 搬家后向邻居打听有没有接新病人的牙医。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor about a local tooth-care professional accepting new patients.

senseEn: to have something as part of a whole
en: Does this price include delivery to the fifth floor?
zh: 这个价格包含送到五楼吗？
transfer: 预订房间时确认价格里有没有早餐。
transferEn: Ask whether breakfast comes with the room rate.

senseEn: to have an effect on something
en: Will the road closure affect deliveries on Monday?
zh: 封路会影响周一的送货吗？
transfer: 问老师缺一次课是否会影响最后成绩。
transferEn: Ask a teacher whether missing one class will influence your final grade.

senseEn: having a sharp unsweetened taste
en: Is the dark roast more bitter than this one?
zh: 深烘的那款比这杯更苦吗？
transfer: 品尝果酱后描述柚子皮带来的一点苦味。
transferEn: Describe the sharp taste grapefruit peel gives a jam.

senseEn: causing unease or fear
en: That empty hallway felt pretty creepy after dark.
zh: 天黑后那条空走廊让人挺发毛的。
transfer: 指出恐怖片中哪段音乐让你不自在。
transferEn: Identify the part of a horror film's music that made you uneasy.

senseEn: unable to improve a situation
en: I felt completely helpless when the bus left with my bag.
zh: 公车带着我的包开走时，我觉得特别无助。
transfer: 描述语言不通又找不到路时的无助感。
transferEn: Describe feeling unable to help yourself when lost without a shared language.

senseEn: a desk where visitors check in
en: Leave the key at reception before you go.
zh: 离开前把钥匙放在前台。
transfer: 初次去诊所时打听在哪里登记。
transferEn: Ask where the visitor desk is on your first clinic visit.

senseEn: footwear covering the ankle or higher
en: There's a pebble in my left boot. Can we stop?
zh: 我左靴里有颗石子。能停一下吗？
transfer: 给孩子试雨靴时，问右脚那只会不会磨脚。
transferEn: Ask a child whether the right piece of rain footwear rubs their foot.

senseEn: one thousand million
en: Did the report say a billion dollars or a million?
zh: 报告说的是十亿美元还是一百万美元？
transfer: 在课堂上确认图表中的人口是否超过十亿。
transferEn: Check whether a population on a classroom chart exceeds a thousand million.

senseEn: a government or administrative office
en: Which local bureau issues fishing permits?
zh: 哪个地方机构发放捕鱼许可证？
transfer: 在游客中心询问失物招领处几点开门。
transferEn: Ask when the office handling lost property opens.

senseEn: bags and cases carried when traveling
en: Can we leave our luggage here after checkout?
zh: 退房后可以把行李寄存在这里吗？
transfer: 登机前问工作人员哪里能称行李。
transferEn: Ask airport staff where to weigh your travel bags.

senseEn: a spirit distilled from wine or fruit
en: Does this cake contain any brandy?
zh: 这个蛋糕含白兰地吗？
transfer: 在饭后酒单上询问哪款白兰地是苹果酿的。
transferEn: Ask which after-dinner spirit on the menu was distilled from apples.

en: Text me when you've arrived safely at the hostel.
zh: 平安到旅舍后给我发条消息。
transfer: 暴雨后向邻居报平安，说你已安全回家。
senseEn: without coming to harm
transferEn: Reassure a neighbor that you reached home unharmed after the storm.

senseEn: to interrupt someone's rest or activity
en: Can I leave a note so I don't disturb the meeting?
zh: 我能留张纸条，以免打扰会议吗？
transfer: 室友在睡觉，请访客别打扰他。
transferEn: Ask a visitor not to interrupt your roommate's sleep.

senseEn: to carry out an activity
en: Who will conduct the interviews for the new assistant?
zh: 谁负责给新助理的应聘者面试？
transfer: 向社区说明谁将进行噪音调查。
transferEn: Tell residents who will carry out a survey about noise.

senseEn: a structure built by birds for raising young
en: There's a nest above the porch light. Let's leave it alone.
zh: 门廊灯上方有个鸟巢，别去碰它。
transfer: 向孩子指出树枝间鸟儿育雏的地方。
transferEn: Show a child where birds are raising chicks among the branches.

senseEn: sound judgment gained through experience
en: I could use your wisdom before I choose an apprenticeship.
zh: 选择学徒岗位前，我想听听你的经验之谈。
transfer: 退休聚会上，感谢师傅把多年积累的智慧传给新人。
transferEn: Thank a retiring mentor for passing on years of good judgment.

senseEn: a particular purpose something serves
en: What is the function of this extra switch?
zh: 这个额外开关有什么功能？
transfer: 新相机到货后请朋友解释某个按钮的作用。
transferEn: Ask a friend what a particular button does on a new camera.

senseEn: rubbing muscles to ease tension
en: Can I book a shoulder massage for Saturday?
zh: 能预约周六的肩部按摩吗？
transfer: 询问酒店的足部按摩持续多久。
transferEn: Ask how long a hotel treatment involving rubbing the feet lasts.

senseEn: very excited and pleased
en: We're thrilled to hear that your bakery is opening.
zh: 听说你的面包店要开了，我们特别高兴。
transfer: 得知被选入校队后，向教练表达喜悦。
transferEn: Tell a coach how delighted you are to have made the team.

senseEn: to make goods for use or sale
en: Can your workshop produce twenty stools by Friday?
zh: 你们作坊周五前能做好二十把凳子吗？
transfer: 问果园一年能产多少箱苹果。
transferEn: Ask how many boxes of apples an orchard can turn out each year.

senseEn: decorative items worn on the body
en: Should I remove my jewelry before the fitting?
zh: 试衣前我要摘掉首饰吗？
transfer: 在机场失物处描述装首饰的小袋。
transferEn: Describe a pouch for rings and necklaces at airport lost property.

senseEn: a detailed examination to understand something
en: Does your analysis explain why sales fell in May?
zh: 你的分析解释了五月销量为何下降吗？
transfer: 请实验室提供水样的详细分析。
transferEn: Request a detailed examination of a water sample from a laboratory.

senseEn: an unexpected period of waiting
en: Is the delay long enough for us to miss our connection?
zh: 这次晚点会让我们赶不上转车吗？
transfer: 告诉接机的朋友飞机晚点了多久。
transferEn: Tell the friend picking you up how far behind schedule the flight is.

senseEn: a derogatory label for someone perceived as unstable
en: The coach apologized for calling a fan a psycho.
zh: 教练为用“疯子”这样的词骂球迷道了歉。
transfer: 在班会上指出这个给同学贴标签的词为什么伤人。
transferEn: Explain in class why this insulting label for a person is hurtful.

senseEn: a sheltered area where boats dock
en: Can we walk around the harbor before the ferry leaves?
zh: 渡轮出发前我们能逛逛港口吗？
transfer: 问渔民暴风雨来临时会停靠哪个港口。
transferEn: Ask which sheltered port the fishers use before a storm.

senseEn: to officially sign up
en: Do I need to register for the workshop in advance?
zh: 参加工作坊需要提前报名吗？
transfer: 向社区中心询问怎样给孩子报名游泳课。
transferEn: Ask how to sign your child up for swimming at the community center.

senseEn: the language of ancient Rome
en: Is the inscription in Latin or in Italian?
zh: 这段铭文是拉丁语还是意大利语？
transfer: 问图书馆员哪里能找到读古罗马原文的入门教材。
transferEn: Ask for a beginner's textbook in the language used in ancient Rome.

senseEn: the ninth month of the year
en: Will the evening classes resume in September?
zh: 夜校课程九月会恢复吗？
transfer: 给家人写信，说你会在九月中旬搬家。
transferEn: Tell your family you're moving in the middle of the ninth month.

senseEn: to drive backward
en: Could you reverse a little so I can open the gate?
zh: 能往后倒一点，让我把大门打开吗？
transfer: 在车位旁提醒司机只能缓慢向后开。
transferEn: Guide a driver moving backward slowly into a parking space.

senseEn: a small storage building
en: The folding chairs are in the garden shed.
zh: 折叠椅在花园的小棚屋里。
transfer: 向邻居借工具时问小棚屋的钥匙放在哪里。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor where the key to their garden storage building is.

senseEn: a process in which people vote for representatives
en: When is the next election for the school board?
zh: 下一次学区委员会选举是什么时候？
transfer: 问社区组织者镇议会选举在哪里投票。
transferEn: Ask where to vote for the town council.

senseEn: what someone means to do
en: It wasn't my intention to leave your name off the poster.
zh: 我本来没打算把你的名字漏在海报外。
transfer: 解释改座位原本是为了让老人更方便。
transferEn: Explain what you meant to achieve by changing an older guest's seat.

senseEn: money left after costs are paid
en: Did the book sale make a profit after we paid for the hall?
zh: 扣除场租后，这次图书义卖有盈余吗？
transfer: 摆摊后和搭档算算扣除食材成本还赚了多少。
transferEn: Work out with a stall partner how much you earned after ingredient costs.

senseEn: an exclamation expressing sudden pain
en: Ouch, my elbow! I hit the shelf.
zh: 哎哟，我的胳膊肘！撞到架子了。
transfer: 被纸边划到手时，脱口说一句表示疼痛的话。
transferEn: React aloud to the pain of a paper cut.

senseEn: to go and bring something back
en: Could you fetch a towel from the upstairs bathroom?
zh: 能去楼上浴室拿条毛巾来吗？
transfer: 清理颜料前请孩子去取一桶水。
transferEn: Ask a child to bring back a bucket of water to clean up paint.

senseEn: to pass the tongue over something
en: Don't let the dog lick the plate before we clear it.
zh: 收盘子前别让狗舔盘子。
transfer: 宝宝想舔雪地上的冰，提醒他不要这么做。
transferEn: Stop a toddler from running their tongue over ice on the ground.

senseEn: a vertical arrangement of entries
en: Enter the delivery dates in the last column.
zh: 把送货日期填在最后一列。
transfer: 讲解时刻表时，指出哪一列是周末班次。
transferEn: Point out the vertical set of weekend services on a timetable.

senseEn: very severe or far beyond usual
en: Will the hike be canceled in extreme heat?
zh: 如果酷热异常，徒步活动会取消吗？
transfer: 问营地负责人设备能否经受极端低温。
transferEn: Ask whether the campsite equipment can withstand unusually severe cold.

senseEn: help or support
en: My father needs assistance with the steps onto the train.
zh: 我父亲上火车台阶时需要帮助。
transfer: 请工作人员帮一位访客找到无障碍入口。
transferEn: Request help finding the accessible entrance for a visitor.

senseEn: an informal word for alcoholic drinks
en: Who's bringing the booze for Friday's party?
zh: 星期五聚会谁带酒？
transfer: 和朋友随口说野餐只准备软饮，不带酒。
transferEn: Casually tell friends that your picnic will have soft drinks only.

senseEn: someone employed to do a job
en: A construction worker showed me the temporary entrance.
zh: 一名建筑工人指给我看了临时入口。
transfer: 谢过替你找到快递的仓库工人。
transferEn: Thank the warehouse employee who located your parcel.

senseEn: a formal decision reached by a jury
en: Has the jury reached a verdict yet?
zh: 陪审团作出裁决了吗？
transfer: 问记者何时会宣读该案件的裁决。
transferEn: Ask a reporter when the jury's decision will be read out.

senseEn: unconvincing or weak
en: Saying I lost the map was a lame excuse for being late.
zh: 我拿丢地图当迟到的借口，实在说不过去。
transfer: 朋友打算假称忘记日期，告诉他这个借口不太像样。
transferEn: Tell a friend that claiming to have forgotten the date sounds unconvincing.

senseEn: a move to a higher position at work
en: Will the promotion mean moving to another branch?
zh: 升职意味着要调到另一家分店吗？
transfer: 祝贺同事升职，并问他今后负责哪个团队。
transferEn: Congratulate a coworker on moving up and ask which team they'll lead.

senseEn: a powered fixed-wing aircraft
en: Is that our airplane parked by gate six?
zh: 停在六号登机口旁的那架是我们的飞机吗？
transfer: 向孩子解释他从窗外看见的飞机正要起飞。
transferEn: Explain to a child that the aircraft outside the window is about to take off.

senseEn: an undergarment supporting the breasts
en: Does this sports bra come with adjustable straps?
zh: 这款运动胸罩的肩带可以调节吗？
transfer: 试衣时问店员这款胸罩有没有更小的下围尺码。
transferEn: Ask for a smaller band size of a supportive undergarment.

senseEn: the German title equivalent to Mr.
en: Should I address him as Herr Weber in this letter?
zh: 我在信中应该称呼他为韦伯先生吗？
transfer: 第一次见一位德国男教师时，用正式头衔和姓氏问候。
transferEn: Greet a male German teacher formally using his title and surname.

senseEn: an exclamation after a small mistake
en: Oops, wrong drawer. The spoons are on the left.
zh: 哎呀，拉错抽屉了。勺子在左边。
transfer: 不小心按错电梯楼层时，用简短感叹承认失误。
transferEn: React briefly when you press the wrong elevator button.

senseEn: a repeated pattern of beats
en: Can you clap the rhythm before we add the words?
zh: 加歌词前，你能先把节奏拍出来吗？
transfer: 学舞时请老师放慢速度，帮你听出节奏。
transferEn: Ask a dance instructor to slow the music so you can hear its beat pattern.

senseEn: a mixed alcoholic drink
en: Which cocktail on the menu has fresh lime?
zh: 菜单上哪款鸡尾酒加了鲜青柠？
transfer: 点酒时询问调酒师能否少加一点糖浆。
transferEn: Ask a bartender for a mixed drink with less syrup.

senseEn: ordinary or used regularly
en: These glasses are for everyday use, not just holidays.
zh: 这些杯子平时就用，不只留到过节。
transfer: 挑鞋时说明你要一双日常通勤穿的鞋。
transferEn: Ask for shoes suitable for your regular commute.

en: The press corps waited outside the courtroom.
zh: 记者团在法庭外等候。
transfer: 介绍随团出访的外交人员队伍。
senseEn: an organized body of people doing related work
transferEn: Introduce the group of diplomats accompanying a delegation.

senseEn: unwilling to change one's mind
en: Dad's too stubborn to ask for directions.
zh: 爸爸太固执了，不肯问路。
transfer: 描述小说人物为什么明知走错路仍坚持往前走。
transferEn: Describe the inflexible attitude of a character who keeps walking down the wrong road.

senseEn: a long spear associated with mounted knights
en: Is the knight's lance in this painting longer than his horse?
zh: 画中骑士的长矛比他的马还长吗？
transfer: 向导览员询问游行道具长矛是什么材质。
transferEn: Ask a guide what the mounted knight's parade prop is made of.

senseEn: a general idea used to understand something
en: Could you explain the concept of interest with a savings example?
zh: 你能用储蓄的例子解释利息这个概念吗？
transfer: 给小学生用蛋糕讲分数的概念。
transferEn: Use cake to explain the idea of fractions to a child.

en: Bring warm clothing for the evening boat ride.
zh: 晚上坐船请带上保暖衣物。
transfer: 向捐赠中心询问他们需要哪些儿童衣物。
senseEn: things people wear
transferEn: Ask a donation center what kinds of children's garments they need.

senseEn: a large round squash
en: Should I peel the pumpkin before roasting it?
zh: 烤南瓜前要削皮吗？
transfer: 买菜时问哪种南瓜适合做派。
transferEn: Ask which variety of round squash is best for pie.

senseEn: deep sorrow, often after a loss
en: She asked for time alone with her grief.
zh: 她想独处一段时间，慢慢面对悲痛。
transfer: 写信慰问失去家人的朋友，承认他的悲痛。
transferEn: Acknowledge a bereaved friend's sorrow in a letter.

senseEn: a story told through sequential drawings
en: Can I borrow your comic after you finish reading it?
zh: 这本漫画你看完能借我吗？
transfer: 向书店询问一部图像连载有没有单行本。
transferEn: Ask a bookshop for a collected edition of an illustrated serial.

senseEn: a person's sense of worth and entitlement to respect
en: Knock before entering to protect residents' dignity.
zh: 进门前请敲门，尊重住户的尊严。
transfer: 讨论采访礼仪时说明怎样维护被采访者的尊严。
transferEn: Describe how to preserve an interviewee's sense of personal worth.

senseEn: in position number six
en: Get off at the sixth stop, just after the bridge.
zh: 过桥后在第六站下车。
transfer: 帮朋友在剧院找到第六排。
transferEn: Help a friend find the row after the fifth one at the theater.

senseEn: a first payment to reserve something
en: Is the deposit refundable if the event moves indoors?
zh: 活动改到室内的话，订金可以退吗？
transfer: 向裁缝询问定制外套要预付多少订金。
transferEn: Ask a tailor how much you must pay upfront to reserve a custom coat.

senseEn: made ready quickly by adding water
en: Is there instant coffee in the guest kitchen?
zh: 客用厨房有速溶咖啡吗？
transfer: 准备露营早餐时问有没有加热水就能吃的燕麦。
transferEn: Ask for oats that can be prepared quickly with hot water at camp.

senseEn: a firm promise to do something
en: Can we get a written commitment to finish repairs by May?
zh: 能让对方书面承诺在五月前完成维修吗？
transfer: 组织演出时请场地方确认是否承诺保留周六档期。
transferEn: Ask a venue to confirm its promise to hold Saturday for a performance.

senseEn: someone traveling in a vehicle without driving
en: Does each passenger need a separate ticket?
zh: 每位乘客都需要单独买票吗？
transfer: 司机出发前询问最后一名乘客是否上车了。
transferEn: Before departure, check whether the last person traveling on the bus has boarded.

senseEn: a person belonging to the Jewish people
en: In her memoir, she describes growing up as a Jew in Paris.
zh: 她在回忆录里讲述了身为犹太人在巴黎长大的经历。
transfer: 在读书会上转述作者如何介绍自己的犹太身份。
transferEn: Report how an author identifies herself as a member of the Jewish people.

senseEn: without allowing exceptions
en: Access is strictly limited to staff after six.
zh: 六点以后严格限制进入，仅限员工。
transfer: 问实验课老师护目镜规定是否严格执行。
transferEn: Ask how firmly the goggles rule is enforced in science class.

senseEn: during every part of a period
en: The café stays open throughout the festival.
zh: 节庆期间咖啡馆一直营业。
transfer: 问图书馆整个假期是否都可以还书。
transferEn: Ask whether books can be returned for the whole holiday period.

senseEn: the soft edge of the mouth
en: I caught my lower lip on the cup's chipped rim.
zh: 杯口的缺口划到了我的下唇。
transfer: 换护齿器时告诉牙医哪边嘴唇被磨到了。
transferEn: Tell a dentist which side of your mouth the guard rubs against.

senseEn: showing an original approach
en: That's a creative way to reuse the broken tiles.
zh: 这样重新利用碎瓷砖很有创意。
transfer: 称赞朋友把空箱子改成玩具剧场的想法。
transferEn: Praise a friend's original idea for turning empty boxes into a toy theater.

senseEn: regular pay for employment
en: Is the starting salary listed before or after tax?
zh: 标明的起薪是税前还是税后？
transfer: 面试结束前问这份工作的年薪范围。
transferEn: Ask about the range of annual pay before ending an interview.

senseEn: an implement used to carry out a job
en: What tool do I need to tighten this hinge?
zh: 拧紧这个合页需要什么工具？
transfer: 在工具租赁处描述你需要用来修剪树枝的工具。
