transferEn: Describe the implement you need for trimming branches at a rental shop.

senseEn: an evergreen shrub often bearing red berries
en: Did you plant the holly beside the front gate?
zh: 前门旁的冬青是你种的吗？
transfer: 询问园丁门边结红果的冬青什么时候修剪。
transferEn: Ask when to prune the red-berried evergreen beside the gate.

senseEn: lasting forever
en: Why does the poet call the sea an eternal witness?
zh: 诗人为什么称大海为永恒的见证者？
transfer: 在导览时询问纪念碑上永不熄灭的火焰象征什么。
transferEn: Ask what the memorial's never-ending flame represents.

senseEn: a thin disposable paper for wiping
en: Could you pass me a tissue? My glasses are wet.
zh: 能递我一张纸巾吗？眼镜湿了。
transfer: 出门前问伙伴有没有随身带纸巾。
transferEn: Ask whether a friend has any disposable wipes before you go out.

senseEn: a long usually yellow fruit with soft flesh
en: Could you slice one banana into the oatmeal?
zh: 能切一根香蕉放进燕麦粥吗？
transfer: 去市场询问青香蕉要放几天才会熟。
transferEn: Ask a vendor how long the green bunch of curved fruit will take to ripen.

senseEn: a long thin rigid bar
en: The curtain rod is loose on the left.
zh: 窗帘杆左边松了。
transfer: 换毛巾架时问横杆有多长。
transferEn: Ask the length of the horizontal bar on a replacement towel rack.

senseEn: an urban train system often running underground
en: Is the subway station inside this mall?
zh: 地铁站在这座商场里面吗？
transfer: 演出结束后问坐地铁回家最晚能赶上哪班。
transferEn: Ask about the last underground train home after a show.

senseEn: the buildings and grounds of an educational institution
en: Where can visitors park on campus?
zh: 访客可以在校园哪里停车？
transfer: 邀请新生参观校园里你最喜欢的花园。
transferEn: Invite a new student to visit your favorite garden on school grounds.

senseEn: the head of the Roman Catholic Church
en: Is the pope visiting this cathedral during the festival?
zh: 教皇会在节庆期间访问这座大教堂吗？
transfer: 参观档案馆时询问是哪位教皇签署了那封信。
transferEn: Ask which leader of the Roman Catholic Church signed an archived letter.

senseEn: feeling sure of one's abilities or judgment
en: Do you feel confident enough to lead the tour alone?
zh: 你有信心独立带这次参观吗？
transfer: 练习完演讲后说说哪一段你最有把握。
transferEn: After rehearsing a speech, describe which section you feel sure about.

senseEn: unreasonably suspicious of others
en: Maybe I'm being paranoid, but did someone move my notes?
zh: 可能是我太多疑了，不过是不是有人动过我的笔记？
transfer: 向朋友承认你也许过于怀疑陌生来电。
transferEn: Admit to a friend that you may be unduly suspicious of an unfamiliar caller.

senseEn: without a stable place to live
en: Does the center offer homeless families somewhere to stay tonight?
zh: 中心今晚有地方安置无家可归的家庭吗？
transfer: 询问图书馆有哪些服务面向没有固定住处的人。
transferEn: Ask what library services are available to people lacking stable housing.

senseEn: to make something necessary
en: Does this position require weekend work?
zh: 这个岗位要求周末上班吗？
transfer: 订住宿前确认旅馆是否要求出示带照片的证件。
transferEn: Check whether a hotel makes photo identification mandatory.

senseEn: a special opportunity one feels grateful for
en: It was a privilege to hear your grandmother's story firsthand.
zh: 有幸亲耳听到你祖母的故事，我很感激。
transfer: 受邀颁奖时，向主办方表达你的荣幸。
transferEn: Tell the organizers how honored you feel to present the award.

senseEn: a large round container used for storage
en: Is the cider aged in a barrel or in a tank?
zh: 这款苹果酒是在木桶还是储罐里熟成的？
transfer: 参观农场时打听门边的大木桶过去用来装什么。
transferEn: Ask what used to be stored in a large wooden cask beside a farm door.

senseEn: meat from a young sheep
en: Is the lamb stew served with bread?
zh: 炖羊肉配面包吗？
transfer: 为客人订餐前问他吃不吃羊羔肉。
transferEn: Ask a guest whether they eat meat from young sheep before ordering.

senseEn: a fictional character who performs magic
en: Which actor plays the wizard who guards the bridge?
zh: 守桥的巫师是哪位演员扮演的？
transfer: 给孩子讲睡前故事，请他替会施魔法的角色取个名字。
transferEn: Invite a child to name a magical character in a bedtime story.

senseEn: a senior manager in an organization
en: Which executive approved the new travel policy?
zh: 哪位高管批准了新的差旅规定？
transfer: 询问人事部门由哪位高管负责新人欢迎会。
transferEn: Ask human resources which senior manager leads the welcome session.

senseEn: money set aside for a particular purpose
en: Can alumni donate to the scholarship fund online?
zh: 校友能在网上向奖学金基金捐款吗？
transfer: 向住户解释楼宇维修基金用来支付哪些费用。
transferEn: Explain which expenses the money reserved for building repairs covers.

senseEn: to die from being unable to breathe underwater
en: Did anyone drown in last year's floods?
zh: 去年的洪灾中有人溺亡吗？
transfer: 阅读航海史时，询问报道中哪些船员是在海中遇难的。
transferEn: Ask which sailors in a historical account died by submersion.

senseEn: more than one
en: Can I use multiple gift cards for one purchase?
zh: 一次购物可以用多张礼品卡吗？
transfer: 问老师一道题能不能有多个正确答案。
transferEn: Ask whether one question can have more than one correct answer.

senseEn: to record an image or sound
en: Did the camera capture the moment she crossed the line?
zh: 相机拍到她冲线的那一刻了吗？
transfer: 请朋友录下第一次演出的开场掌声。
transferEn: Ask a friend to record the opening applause of a first performance.

senseEn: a sculpted figure of a person or animal
en: Meet me by the stone statue outside the museum.
zh: 在博物馆外的石雕像旁碰面。
transfer: 问向导广场上骑马的雕像表现的是谁。
transferEn: Ask a guide whom the sculpted rider in the square represents.

senseEn: someone who betrays a group or cause
en: When does the audience learn who the traitor is?
zh: 观众什么时候才知道谁是叛徒？
transfer: 在读书会上讨论是谁背叛了探险队。
transferEn: Discuss who betrayed the expedition in a book-club story.

senseEn: a group of vehicles operated together
en: How many vans are in your delivery fleet?
zh: 你们的配送车队里有多少辆面包车？
transfer: 询问出租车公司的车队今年是否增购电动车。
transferEn: Ask whether the taxi company's collection of vehicles will gain any electric cars.

senseEn: four times ten
en: The ferry takes forty minutes in calm weather.
zh: 风平浪静时渡轮要开四十分钟。
transfer: 订餐时告诉店家要为四十位同事准备午餐。
transferEn: Order lunch for four groups of ten coworkers.

senseEn: in a considerate or generous way
en: The porter kindly carried my suitcase upstairs.
zh: 门房好心帮我把旅行箱搬上了楼。
transfer: 写感谢信，提到邻居好心照顾花园。
transferEn: Thank a neighbor for generously looking after your garden.

senseEn: money given to settle an amount owed
en: Has my payment for the reservation gone through?
zh: 我的预订款付成功了吗？
transfer: 问维修师傅是否接受银行转账付款。
transferEn: Ask a repairer whether you can settle the bill by bank transfer.

senseEn: to find a size or amount using a standard unit
en: Could you measure the doorway before we order the sofa?
zh: 订沙发前能量一下门口吗？
transfer: 挂窗帘前问室友是否量过窗户高度。
transferEn: Ask a roommate whether they checked the window's height before hanging curtains.

senseEn: delightful or lovable
en: What an adorable photo of your puppy!
zh: 你家小狗的照片真可爱！
transfer: 夸朋友给孩子做的手偶十分可爱。
transferEn: Compliment the charming hand puppet a friend made for a child.

senseEn: a farm animal often kept for milk
en: The goat got through the open gate again.
zh: 那只山羊又从敞开的门溜出去了。
transfer: 带孩子参观农场，问哪只山羊可以喂。
transferEn: Ask which horned farm animal the child may feed.

senseEn: meat from a pig
en: Is this dumpling filled with minced pork?
zh: 这个饺子是猪肉馅的吗？
transfer: 给客人点菜前向厨师确认汤里有没有猪肉。
transferEn: Check whether the soup contains meat from pigs before ordering for a guest.

senseEn: producing the intended result
en: Which reminder was most effective at getting replies?
zh: 哪种提醒最能让人回复？
transfer: 询问园丁哪种遮阳办法对幼苗最有效。
transferEn: Ask a gardener which shade method works best for young plants.

senseEn: a band worn around an animal's neck
en: Is the dog's name on its collar?
zh: 项圈上有这只狗的名字吗？
transfer: 带猫旅行前确认项圈松紧是否合适。
transferEn: Before traveling, check the fit of the band around your cat's neck.

senseEn: an educational talk to an audience
en: Will the guest lecture be recorded for evening students?
zh: 嘉宾讲座会录下来供夜校学生观看吗？
transfer: 向图书馆询问周六园艺讲座是否需要预约。
transferEn: Ask the library whether you need to book Saturday's gardening talk.

senseEn: the part of a plant that absorbs water from soil
en: Try not to bend the main root when you move the seedling.
zh: 移栽幼苗时尽量别把主根折弯。
transfer: 种树时问园丁根部应该埋多深。
transferEn: Ask a gardener how deeply the underground part of a tree should be buried.

senseEn: attention gained through media coverage
en: The rescue brought unexpected publicity to our tiny shelter.
zh: 这次救援让我们小小的收容所意外受到公众关注。
transfer: 问剧团当地报纸的报道有没有为演出带来关注。
transferEn: Ask a theater group whether newspaper coverage drew attention to its show.

senseEn: an official document used for international travel
en: Do you need my passport to check me in?
zh: 办理入住需要我的护照吗？
transfer: 去机场前提醒同伴核对护照有效期。
transferEn: Remind a travel companion to check when their international travel document expires.

senseEn: relating to ancient Rome
en: Are these Roman coins from the same century?
zh: 这些古罗马硬币属于同一个世纪吗？
transfer: 在遗址询问哪面墙是古罗马时期建的。
transferEn: Ask which wall at a ruin dates from ancient Rome.

senseEn: having pale yellow hair
en: Is the blond boy by the piano your nephew?
zh: 钢琴旁边那个金发男孩是你的外甥吗？
transfer: 在人群中用浅金色头发来描述你要找的朋友。
transferEn: Describe a friend you are looking for by their light-colored hair.

senseEn: numbered cubes rolled in games
en: Did the dice roll under the sofa?
zh: 骰子滚到沙发底下了吗？
transfer: 开玩桌游前问一回合要掷几颗骰子。
transferEn: Ask how many numbered cubes to roll each turn in a board game.

senseEn: conditional release before a prison term ends
en: Was he on parole when the documentary was filmed?
zh: 拍纪录片时他正处于假释期吗？
transfer: 读传记时询问那个人是哪一年获准假释的。
transferEn: Ask when the person in a biography was conditionally released from prison.

senseEn: a man whose job is selling goods
en: The shoe salesman found a wider pair for me.
zh: 鞋店的男销售员帮我找到了一双更宽的鞋。
transfer: 向朋友指出车行里为你安排试驾的男销售员。
transferEn: Point out the man at the dealership who arranged your test drive.

senseEn: one of two children born at the same birth
en: Is that your twin in the graduation picture?
zh: 毕业照里的那个人是你的双胞胎手足吗？
transfer: 在家庭聚会上介绍和你同一天出生的双胞胎兄弟。
transferEn: Introduce the brother who shared your birth date and birth at a family gathering.

senseEn: forms and documents needed for an official process
en: Can we finish the paperwork before I collect the keys?
zh: 取钥匙前能把手续办完吗？
transfer: 入职前向人事问哪些手续能网上办。
transferEn: Ask human resources which forms can be completed online before starting work.

senseEn: a fitting inserted into an electrical socket
en: This plug won't fit the hotel socket. Is there an adapter?
zh: 这个插头插不进酒店插座。有转换头吗？
transfer: 出国前确认充电器插头的形状。
transferEn: Before traveling abroad, check the shape of the part of your charger that goes into the wall.

senseEn: an unverified story passed between people
en: Have you heard the rumor about the cinema closing?
zh: 你听说电影院要关门的传言了吗？
transfer: 向校方核实有关校车改线的传言。
transferEn: Ask the school to verify an unconfirmed story about the bus route changing.

senseEn: a movable textile floor covering
en: Could we put a rug beside the bed? The floor gets cold.
zh: 能在床边铺块小地毯吗？地板会凉。
transfer: 打扫前请室友把走廊的小地毯卷起来。
transferEn: Ask a roommate to roll up the loose hallway floor covering before cleaning.

senseEn: a person employed to care for children
en: Can the nanny collect Maya from school on Fridays?
zh: 周五保姆能去学校接玛雅吗？
transfer: 面试保姆时问她是否照顾过双胞胎。
transferEn: Ask a prospective paid childcare provider whether she has cared for twins.

senseEn: in contrast to someone or something
en: Unlike the old bus, this one has space for a wheelchair.
zh: 与旧巴士不同，这辆车有轮椅位。
transfer: 对比两个泳池，说明新泳池周一也开放。
transferEn: Contrast two pools by explaining that the new one opens on Mondays.

senseEn: to rest against something for support
en: Please don't lean on the newly painted railing.
zh: 请不要倚靠刚刷好的栏杆。
transfer: 帮朋友拍照时让他轻靠在砖墙上。
transferEn: Ask a friend to rest lightly against a brick wall for a picture.

senseEn: the voice or person telling a story
en: Does the narrator know why the letter was burned?
zh: 叙述者知道信为什么被烧掉吗？
transfer: 听有声书时问讲故事的人是不是主人公本人。
transferEn: Ask whether the voice telling an audiobook story is also the main character.

senseEn: the exchange of information
en: Can we improve communication between the day and night shifts?
zh: 我们能改善早班与夜班之间的沟通吗？
transfer: 带队出游时说明手机没信号会如何影响联络。
transferEn: Explain how losing phone service would affect contact on a group trip.

senseEn: to work together toward a common goal
en: Can the two shops cooperate on a shared delivery route?
zh: 这两家店能合作共用一条配送路线吗？
transfer: 请旅行团成员配合导游清点人数。
transferEn: Ask a tour group to work with the guide during a head count.

senseEn: a pollinating insect that often makes honey
en: There's a bee on your sleeve. Stand still a moment.
zh: 你袖子上有只蜜蜂，先站着别动。
transfer: 在花园给孩子指出正采花蜜的小昆虫。
transferEn: Point out the honey-making insect collecting nectar in a garden.

senseEn: deserving attention or recognition
en: Is this bridge worthy of a stop on our walking tour?
zh: 这座桥值得徒步导览专门停下来看看吗？
transfer: 在颁奖讨论中说明某位志愿者值得特别表扬。
transferEn: Explain why a volunteer deserves special recognition at an awards meeting.

senseEn: the joint connecting hand and forearm
en: My watch leaves a mark on my wrist. Could you loosen it?
zh: 手表在我腕上勒出了印子。能帮我调松吗？
transfer: 看医生时说明转动手腕会不会疼。
transferEn: Tell a clinician whether turning the joint between hand and arm hurts.

senseEn: very large in scale or size
en: There's an enormous queue outside the passport office.
zh: 护照办事处外排着极长的队。
transfer: 搬家前告诉伙伴那只衣柜大得进不了电梯。
transferEn: Warn a helper that a wardrobe is far too large for the lift.

senseEn: unable to stop thinking about something
en: My nephew is obsessed with trains. Is there a railway museum nearby?
zh: 我外甥特别迷火车。附近有铁路博物馆吗？
transfer: 形容朋友近来对陶艺的痴迷。
transferEn: Describe a friend's recent all-consuming interest in pottery.

senseEn: severe unhappiness or discomfort
en: The all-night drilling made our stay a misery.
zh: 整夜的钻孔声让我们住得苦不堪言。
transfer: 谈谈错过末班车又要在雨里等候的痛苦。
transferEn: Describe the misery of waiting in the rain after missing the last bus.

senseEn: the time when the sun disappears below the horizon
en: Can we reach the viewpoint before sunset?
zh: 我们能在日落前赶到观景台吗？
transfer: 向船员询问几点能从甲板看到落日。
transferEn: Ask a crew member when the sun will go down as seen from the deck.

senseEn: a secret plan by several people to do something wrong
en: In the novel, who uncovered the conspiracy to rig the vote?
zh: 小说中谁揭穿了操纵投票的阴谋？
transfer: 讨论电影时解释哪封信揭露了那项密谋。
transferEn: Explain which letter exposed a secret wrongdoing in a film.

senseEn: an arrangement to hold a place in advance
en: Could you move my reservation from Friday to Sunday?
zh: 能把我的预订从周五改到周日吗？
transfer: 到餐厅时说明订位用的是你姐姐的姓。
transferEn: Tell a restaurant that the table booking is under your sister's surname.

senseEn: a statement communicated to a group
en: Could you repeat the announcement about the platform change?
zh: 能再播一遍换站台的通知吗？
transfer: 学校临时停课时请前台把通知发给家长。
transferEn: Ask the school desk to send parents the notice about a class cancellation.

senseEn: fabric hung to cover a window
en: Could you draw the curtain? The screen is hard to see.
zh: 能拉上窗帘吗？屏幕看不清。
transfer: 租房时问卧室窗帘晚上能不能遮光。
transferEn: Ask whether the bedroom window covering blocks light at night.

senseEn: to find the position of something
en: Can you help me locate the exit on this map?
zh: 能帮我在地图上找到出口吗？
transfer: 问图书馆员如何查到一份旧报纸存放的位置。
transferEn: Ask a librarian to find where an old newspaper is stored.

senseEn: with exact details rather than in general
en: What specifically needs changing on the booking form?
zh: 预订表上具体要改什么？
transfer: 请同事说清报告里具体缺少哪些数据。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to identify the exact figures missing from a report.

senseEn: a rugged vehicle used on rough roads
en: Will the jeep have room for all four backpacks?
zh: 那辆吉普车放得下全部四个背包吗？
transfer: 在步道入口问哪辆越野吉普会来接游客。
transferEn: Ask which rugged off-road vehicle picks up visitors at the trailhead.

senseEn: an expression of praise
en: That was a lovely compliment about my singing. Thank you.
zh: 你夸我唱得好，真让人开心。谢谢。
transfer: 转告厨师客人对甜点的称赞。
transferEn: Pass a guest's praise for dessert on to the cook.

senseEn: difficult to move freely
en: My neck feels a little stiff after the long drive.
zh: 开了很久的车，我脖子有点僵。
transfer: 向理疗师描述肩膀早上有多僵硬。
transferEn: Tell a physiotherapist how hard your shoulders are to move in the morning.

senseEn: not having the ability or opportunity
en: I'm unable to attend on Tuesday. Is Thursday possible?
zh: 我周二无法出席，可以改到周四吗？
transfer: 向客服说明你目前无法访问预订页面。
transferEn: Tell support that you cannot access the booking page.

senseEn: improper or harmful use of something
en: Who handles complaints about abuse of authority?
zh: 关于滥用职权的投诉由谁处理？
transfer: 问组织者如何举报有人滥用会员资格。
transferEn: Ask organizers how to report misuse of membership privileges.

senseEn: playfully or deliberately misbehaving
en: Our naughty puppy hid both slippers under the sofa.
zh: 我们那只淘气的小狗把两只拖鞋都藏到了沙发下。
transfer: 给家人讲孩子小时候做过的一件淘气事。
transferEn: Tell your family about a mischievous thing a child once did.

senseEn: an amount of money
en: Can I pay the full sum when I pick up the bike?
zh: 取车时我可以付清全部金额吗？
transfer: 和合租人核对维修费用的总金额。
transferEn: Check the total amount of a repair bill with your flatmate.

senseEn: a formal style of theatrical dance
en: Is the ballet performance suitable for young children?
zh: 这场芭蕾演出适合小孩子吗？
transfer: 给孩子报班时询问初学芭蕾要穿什么鞋。
transferEn: Ask what shoes a beginner needs for classical stage dance.

senseEn: anxious or strained
en: Everyone went quiet during the tense pause before the vote.
zh: 投票前暂停的那一刻气氛紧张，大家都安静下来。
transfer: 说明你在面试开始前感到多紧张。
transferEn: Describe how anxious you felt shortly before an interview.

senseEn: selected without a fixed pattern
en: Pick a random page and read me the first line.
zh: 随便翻一页，把第一行读给我听。
transfer: 上课时建议用抽签随机选择发言顺序。
transferEn: Suggest drawing lots to choose the speaking order by chance.

senseEn: a sandwich with a patty in a bun
en: Could I get the bean burger without cheese?
zh: 豆饼汉堡可以不放奶酪吗？
transfer: 告诉服务员你点的汉堡想换成全麦面包。
transferEn: Ask for a whole-grain bun on the patty sandwich you ordered.

senseEn: a collection of released musical recordings
en: Which song opens the new album?
zh: 新专辑的第一首歌是哪首？
transfer: 询问唱片店这张专辑有没有黑胶版。
transferEn: Ask a record shop whether this collection of songs comes on vinyl.

senseEn: willingly and with pleasure
en: I'd happily take the earlier shift if you need Friday off.
zh: 如果你周五需要休息，我很愿意上早班。
transfer: 主动表示愿意带新邻居熟悉小区。
transferEn: Offer with pleasure to show a newcomer around the neighborhood.

senseEn: relating to a company as an organization
en: Do I need corporate approval before booking the venue?
zh: 订场地前我需要公司批准吗？
transfer: 报销前确认哪张是公司信用卡。
transferEn: Before claiming expenses, check which credit card belongs to the company.

senseEn: very strong in degree
en: The intense heat inside the tent kept me awake.
zh: 帐篷里酷热难耐，我一直睡不着。
transfer: 描述期末演出前你感到的强烈压力。
transferEn: Describe the powerful pressure you felt before an end-of-term performance.

senseEn: to make someone feel admiration
en: Will the prototype impress the judges without a live demo?
zh: 不做现场演示，原型能给评委留下深刻印象吗？
transfer: 说说哪种待客细节会给初次到访的人留下好印象。
transferEn: Describe a hosting detail that would win the admiration of first-time visitors.

senseEn: physical harm to the body
en: Is the knee injury keeping you out of Sunday's match?
zh: 膝伤会让你缺席周日的比赛吗？
transfer: 问教练哪位选手因肩伤退赛。
transferEn: Ask a coach which competitor withdrew because of a hurt shoulder.

senseEn: the eighth month of the year
en: We're moving in August, before school starts.
zh: 我们八月搬家，赶在开学之前。
transfer: 询问民宿八月的最后一周有没有空房。
transferEn: Check a guesthouse's availability in the final week of the eighth month.

senseEn: the sound of a firearm being discharged
en: Was that a gunshot in the film or a car backfiring outside?
zh: 那是电影里的枪声，还是外面的汽车回火声？
transfer: 讨论戏剧音效时指出哪一幕传来枪声。
transferEn: Identify which scene uses the sound of a firearm in a discussion of theatrical effects.

senseEn: small in degree or extent
en: I felt a slight pain when I bent my elbow.
zh: 我屈肘时感觉有轻微疼痛。
transfer: 和木工确认门与门框之间的轻微缝隙是否正常。
transferEn: Ask a carpenter whether a small gap beside the door frame is normal.

en: The chicken is still raw in the middle. Could you cook it longer?
zh: 鸡肉中间还是生的。能再做久一点吗？
transfer: 备餐时提醒朋友把生鱼和熟菜分开。
senseEn: not cooked
transferEn: During meal prep, remind a friend to keep uncooked fish away from cooked dishes.

senseEn: something given importance ahead of other things
en: Which repair is the top priority before guests arrive?
zh: 客人到来前哪项维修最优先？
transfer: 在项目会议上确认本周最该先处理的工作。
transferEn: Clarify which job should come first this week at a project meeting.

senseEn: the way parts are organized together
en: Could you show me the structure of the training course?
zh: 能给我看看培训课程的结构吗？
transfer: 请编辑解释文章调整后的结构。
transferEn: Ask an editor how the revised article's sections are arranged.

senseEn: a rectangular block used in construction
en: One loose brick on the step needs replacing.
zh: 台阶上有块松动的砖需要更换。
transfer: 在建材店确认这些砖是否适合铺花园小路。
transferEn: Ask whether the building blocks are suitable for paving a garden path.

senseEn: a statement expressing dissatisfaction
en: Where do I file a complaint about the broken lift?
zh: 电梯坏了，我该去哪儿投诉？
transfer: 询问快递公司如何追踪上周提交的投诉。
transferEn: Ask a courier how to track last week's report of poor service.

senseEn: an unintended escape of liquid or gas
en: There's a small leak under the washing machine.
zh: 洗衣机下面有点漏水。
transfer: 向房东描述天花板上的渗水位置。
transferEn: Tell a landlord where water is seeping through the ceiling.

senseEn: a small elongated animal without legs
en: I found a worm in the soil under the pot.
zh: 我在花盆底下的泥土里发现了一条虫。
transfer: 在堆肥箱旁指出蚯蚓钻入泥土的位置。
transferEn: Point to where the long legless creature burrowed into the compost.

senseEn: a person portrayed as a skilled fighter
en: Which actor plays the warrior in the village legend?
zh: 村庄传说里的武士由哪位演员扮演？
transfer: 参观画展时描述画中武士的服饰。
transferEn: Describe the clothing of a historical fighter in a painting.

senseEn: the state of continuing to live
en: Shade is important for the survival of these young trees.
zh: 遮阴对这些小树的存活很重要。
transfer: 询问向导干旱如何影响当地青蛙的生存。
transferEn: Ask a guide how drought affects the ability of local frogs to stay alive.

senseEn: to lose blood
en: Does your gum bleed when you brush there?
zh: 刷到那里时牙龈会出血吗？
transfer: 向护士说明擦伤是否还在出血。
transferEn: Tell a nurse whether blood is still coming from a scrape.

senseEn: unaffected by alcohol
en: Who's staying sober tonight to drive everyone home?
zh: 今晚谁不喝酒，负责开车送大家回家？
transfer: 聚会前确认指定司机是否会一直保持清醒。
transferEn: Confirm that the designated driver will remain alcohol-free at a gathering.

senseEn: the dead body of a person
en: In the mystery novel, who first found the corpse?
zh: 推理小说里是谁最先发现尸体的？
transfer: 讨论电影时确认警察在哪一幕发现死者遗体。
transferEn: Discuss which film scene shows police finding the dead person's body.

senseEn: a covering for the hand with separate fingers
en: I dropped one glove near the bus stop.
zh: 我有一只手套落在公交站附近了。
transfer: 滑雪前问朋友能否借你一只右手手套。
transferEn: Ask a friend for a right-hand covering before a ski lesson.

senseEn: a clear distilled spirit
en: Does the sauce contain any vodka?
zh: 这个酱汁里有伏特加吗？
transfer: 为聚会准备饮料时询问哪瓶是伏特加。
transferEn: Ask which bottle contains the clear distilled spirit while preparing party drinks.

senseEn: a written or electronic record
en: Could you send the signed document as a PDF?
zh: 能把签过字的文件以 PDF 格式发来吗？
transfer: 办借书证时询问可用哪份文件证明地址。
transferEn: Ask which written record establishes your address when applying for a library card.

senseEn: a type of explosive historically used in blasting
en: The museum label mentions dynamite used in nineteenth-century mining.
zh: 这张博物馆说明牌提到了十九世纪采矿时用的炸药。
transfer: 读历史报道时询问其中提到的矿山爆炸物叫什么。
transferEn: Ask which historical blasting material a mining report mentions.

senseEn: an eight-legged animal that often spins webs
en: There's a spider on the outside of the window.
zh: 窗户外面有一只蜘蛛。
transfer: 向孩子指出是哪种八条腿的小动物结了网。
transferEn: Show a child which eight-legged creature made the web.

senseEn: one local outlet of a larger organization
en: Can I return this lamp to another branch?
zh: 我可以把这盏灯退到别的分店吗？
transfer: 向银行询问哪家分行周六营业。
transferEn: Ask which local bank office opens on Saturday.

senseEn: after a short time
en: The next ferry leaves shortly after noon.
zh: 下一班渡轮中午刚过就开。
transfer: 向客人说明甜点会在咖啡之后不久送来。
transferEn: Tell guests that dessert will arrive soon after the coffee.

senseEn: an amount allocated for spending
en: The blue sofa is over our budget. Is there a cheaper size?
zh: 蓝沙发超预算了。有没有便宜些的尺寸？
transfer: 订酒店前和同伴确定每晚预算。
transferEn: Agree on a nightly spending allowance before booking a hotel.

senseEn: a paper covering for a letter
en: Write the flat number on the envelope, please.
zh: 请在信封上写上公寓门牌号。
transfer: 寄照片时问邮局有没有加厚的信封。
transferEn: Ask a post office for a padded paper mailer for photographs.

senseEn: a small firearm held in one hand
en: Is the pistol on the film poster a painted prop?
zh: 电影海报上的手枪是上色的道具吗？
transfer: 在博物馆询问玻璃柜中的手枪道具来自哪场演出。
transferEn: Ask which show supplied the handgun prop in a museum case.

senseEn: a book-length fictional story
en: Is the novel told entirely through letters?
zh: 这部小说完全是用书信讲述的吗？
transfer: 让图书管理员推荐一本以海边为背景的长篇小说。
transferEn: Ask a librarian for a book-length fictional story set by the sea.

senseEn: a long firearm traditionally associated with bird hunting
en: The prop list includes a wooden shotgun for the farmhouse scene.
zh: 道具清单上有一支用于农舍场景的木制霰弹枪。
transfer: 参观电影服道具展时问橱窗里的木制长枪出自哪部西部片。
transferEn: Ask which Western featured the wooden sporting-gun prop in a display.

senseEn: dishonest deception for financial gain
en: How do I report suspected fraud on this invoice?
zh: 我该如何举报这张发票涉嫌诈骗？
transfer: 询问银行怎样报告未经本人同意的虚假收费。
transferEn: Ask a bank how to report a deceptive charge you did not authorize.

senseEn: for the duration of one night
en: Can we leave the bikes here overnight?
zh: 我们能把自行车在这里放一夜吗？
transfer: 问主人能不能让小狗留宿一晚。
transferEn: Ask a host whether a puppy may stay until morning.

senseEn: a handled container for carrying liquid
en: Could you put a bucket under the dripping pipe?
zh: 能在滴水的管子下放个桶吗？
transfer: 洗车时请孩子把桶装半桶水就好。
transferEn: Ask a child to half-fill the handled container for washing the car.

senseEn: in a pleasant or considerate way
en: If you ask nicely, the librarian may hold the book for you.
zh: 如果你客气地问，图书管理员也许能帮你留书。
transfer: 提醒孩子向邻居借球时要客气。
transferEn: Remind a child to be pleasant when asking a neighbor for a ball.

senseEn: a formal request submitted for consideration
en: Has my application for the traineeship arrived?
zh: 我的实习申请送到了吗？
transfer: 问学校补交申请材料的最后日期。
transferEn: Ask a school when supporting papers for a formal admissions request are due.

senseEn: a large building for storing goods
en: Can I collect the chair from your warehouse?
zh: 我可以去你们的仓库自提椅子吗？
transfer: 问公司节前货物将送到哪个仓库。
transferEn: Ask which storage building will receive the shipment before the holiday.

senseEn: a formal title used when addressing a high official
en: Should the invitation begin with “Your Excellency”?
zh: 请柬是否应该以“阁下”开头？
transfer: 排练正式欢迎辞时，用合适的敬称称呼大使。
transferEn: Use the formal honorific for an ambassador while rehearsing a welcome speech.

senseEn: to look fixedly at something
en: Please don't stare at the people at the next table.
zh: 请别盯着邻桌的人看。
transfer: 朋友盯着屏幕好久，问他在看什么。
transferEn: Ask what has held a friend's gaze on a screen for so long.

senseEn: extremely large or heavy
en: A massive tree fell across the cycle path.
zh: 一棵大树倒在自行车道上，把路挡住了。
transfer: 向搬运工形容那面需要两人抬的大镜子。
transferEn: Describe a mirror so large that two movers must lift it.

senseEn: a list of dishes available to order
en: Could we see the lunch menu before we sit down?
zh: 入座前能看看午餐菜单吗？
transfer: 询问餐厅有没有单独的儿童菜单。
transferEn: Ask whether the restaurant has a separate list of dishes for children.

senseEn: a garment hanging from the waist without separate legs
en: Does this skirt have pockets on both sides?
zh: 这条裙子两边都有口袋吗？
transfer: 请裁缝把裙摆改短到膝盖以下。
transferEn: Ask a tailor to shorten a waist-hung garment to below the knee.

senseEn: a substance giving food tartness
en: Is citric acid on the ingredient list for this jam?
zh: 这款果酱的配料表里有柠檬酸吗？
transfer: 读饮料标签时指出哪种酸带来酸味。
transferEn: Identify the sour-tasting substance on a drink label.

senseEn: a senior male servant managing a household
en: Does the butler carry the missing letter in the play?
zh: 剧中失踪的信是在男管家手里吗？
transfer: 参观古宅时询问男管家过去住在哪个房间。
transferEn: Ask which room housed the head male servant in a historic home.

senseEn: located on the inside
en: The ticket is in the inner pocket of my coat.
zh: 票在我外套的内袋里。
transfer: 更换靠垫套时请伙伴检查内层的接缝。
transferEn: Ask a partner to check the seam on the inside layer of a cushion cover.

senseEn: money awarded to support a student's education
en: Does the scholarship cover books as well as tuition?
zh: 这项奖学金除了学费也包含书费吗？
transfer: 询问音乐奖学金是否需要现场试演。
transferEn: Ask whether the music study award requires a live audition.

senseEn: continuing without interruption
en: The constant noise from the fan makes calls hard to hear.
zh: 风扇一直响，电话听不清。
transfer: 向管理员反映走廊灯持续闪烁的问题。
transferEn: Tell a manager that the hallway light keeps flickering without a break.

senseEn: the tenth month of the year
en: Do the outdoor markets continue into October?
zh: 露天集市会一直办到十月吗？
transfer: 告诉同事展览在十月的最后一天结束。
transferEn: Tell a coworker the exhibition closes on the last day of the tenth month.

senseEn: a person who advises students about personal or academic matters
en: Can the school counselor help me choose next term's courses?
zh: 学校辅导员能帮我选择下学期的课吗？
transfer: 问办公室怎样预约辅导员讨论转学事宜。
transferEn: Ask the school office to arrange a meeting with an adviser about transferring.

senseEn: from or relating to Korea
en: Which Korean dish on this menu comes with rice cakes?
zh: 这份菜单上哪道韩国菜配年糕？
transfer: 问朋友能否推荐一家卖韩国食材的店。
transferEn: Ask a friend for a shop selling ingredients from Korea.

senseEn: a dirty layer on a liquid or wet surface
en: What's the best way to remove soap scum from the tiles?
zh: 瓷砖上的皂垢怎么清除最有效？
transfer: 让管理员看看水池表面那一层浮垢。
transferEn: Ask a caretaker to inspect the dirty layer floating on the pool.

senseEn: the middle or main part of a place
en: Does this tram go to the city centre?
zh: 这趟电车开往市中心吗？
transfer: 在英国问如何从镇中心走到车站。
transferEn: Ask how to walk from the middle of a British town to the station.

senseEn: an organized celebration or program of performances
en: Are dogs allowed at the music festival?
zh: 音乐节可以带狗吗？
transfer: 询问电影节哪一天有导演交流。
transferEn: Ask which day of a celebration of cinema includes a director talk.

senseEn: to be determined by something else
en: Does the price depend on how early I book?
zh: 价格取决于我订得有多早吗？
transfer: 问向导出发时间是否取决于潮汐。
transferEn: Ask whether the departure time is determined by the tide.

senseEn: an event marking a happy occasion
en: Is the anniversary celebration open to former staff?
zh: 周年庆邀请以前的员工吗？
transfer: 为朋友毕业筹备庆祝活动，问谁负责订蛋糕。
transferEn: Ask who is ordering the cake for a friend's graduation festivities.

senseEn: capable of causing death
en: The guide warned us about deadly currents near the rocks.
zh: 向导告诫我们岩石附近有致命的水流。
transfer: 看展时询问哪种野生蘑菇可能致命。
transferEn: Ask at an exhibit which wild mushroom can cause death.

senseEn: to inspect something closely
en: Could you examine this tooth before replacing the filling?
zh: 换补牙材料前，能检查一下这颗牙吗？
transfer: 请钟表师仔细查看表盘上的裂痕。
transferEn: Ask a watchmaker to inspect a crack in the dial.

senseEn: a solemn formal promise
en: Did the mayor take the oath in the town hall?
zh: 市长是在市政厅宣誓的吗？
transfer: 在入籍典礼前询问宣誓词有没有书面版本。
transferEn: Ask whether the formal promise at a citizenship ceremony is available in writing.

senseEn: an unmarried man
en: Was your uncle still a bachelor when he bought the house?
zh: 你叔叔买这栋房子时还是单身吗？
transfer: 谈论小说时描述那位终身未婚的男邻居。
transferEn: Describe a male neighbor in a novel who never married.

senseEn: a writing tool with a solid erasable core
en: Should I bring a pencil for the drawing test?
zh: 绘图考试要带铅笔吗？
transfer: 做木工记号前向朋友借一支铅笔。
transferEn: Borrow an erasable writing tool to mark a piece of wood.

senseEn: not treating people equally or justly
en: It seems unfair to charge both groups when only one used the hall.
zh: 只有一组用了礼堂，两组都收费似乎不公平。
transfer: 讨论排班时解释为什么总让同一个人上晚班不公平。
transferEn: Explain why always assigning nights to one person is unjust.

senseEn: a common short name for a refrigerator
en: The soup is in the fridge, on the middle shelf.
zh: 汤在冰箱中层。
transfer: 到民宿后问哪里能把牛奶冷藏起来。
transferEn: Ask where to chill your milk at a holiday rental.

senseEn: intended for use inside an organization
en: Can guests access the internal directory, or only staff?
zh: 来宾能查内部通讯录吗，还是只有员工能查？
transfer: 发邮件前确认内部简报能不能转给客户。
transferEn: Check whether an in-house bulletin may be forwarded to clients.

senseEn: to spring back after hitting a surface
en: Does this ball bounce well on grass?
zh: 这个球在草地上弹得起来吗？
transfer: 让孩子观察球在地毯上能弹多高。
transferEn: Ask a child how high a ball springs back from a carpet.

senseEn: a heavy responsibility or difficulty
en: Could we share the driving to ease the burden on Ana?
zh: 能轮流开车，减轻安娜的负担吗？
transfer: 向邻居说明轮流采购能减轻照护者的负担。
transferEn: Explain how taking turns shopping eases a caregiver's workload.

senseEn: the central seeded part of certain fruits
en: Cut out the apple core before slicing the fruit.
zh: 苹果切片前先去掉果核。
transfer: 做梨馅时让搭档把中间带籽的部分挖掉。
transferEn: Ask a partner to remove the seeded middle of a pear for a pie.

senseEn: a highly addictive opioid drug
en: The exhibit explains heroin addiction through patients' stories.
zh: 这场展览通过患者经历介绍海洛因成瘾。
transfer: 在公共卫生纪录片讨论中指出片中提及的是哪种毒品。
transferEn: Identify the addictive opioid discussed in a public health documentary.

senseEn: not boastful about one's achievements
en: She stayed remarkably humble after winning the prize.
zh: 她获奖后仍然非常谦逊。
transfer: 向同事介绍一位乐于分享功劳的谦逊队长。
transferEn: Describe a modest captain who shares credit with teammates.

senseEn: a model shaped like a person for practice or display
en: Can we practice bandaging on the training dummy?
zh: 我们能在训练用人体模型上练习包扎吗？
transfer: 向服装老师询问哪具人台适合展示外套。
transferEn: Ask a fashion teacher which human-shaped model fits the coat.

senseEn: a ceremony marking completion of studies
en: Are guests allowed to film the graduation ceremony?
zh: 来宾可以拍摄毕业典礼吗？
transfer: 问学校今年的毕业典礼是否在室外举行。
transferEn: Ask whether this year's degree ceremony takes place outdoors.

senseEn: a competition deciding the best team or player
en: Where is the national championship being held this year?
zh: 今年的全国锦标赛在哪里举行？
transfer: 问教练如何取得参加地区锦标赛的资格。
transferEn: Ask a coach how teams qualify for the regional title competition.

senseEn: a preserved body, especially from ancient Egypt
en: Is photography allowed near the Egyptian mummy?
zh: 在埃及木乃伊旁边可以拍照吗？
transfer: 在博物馆向讲解员询问这具木乃伊的年代。
transferEn: Ask a guide how old the preserved body in the museum is.

senseEn: to burst apart suddenly
en: Did the balloon explode in the heat of the parked car?
zh: 气球是在晒热的车里爆开的吗？
transfer: 听见巨响后问同伴是不是又有一个气球爆了。
transferEn: After a loud pop, ask a companion whether another balloon burst.

senseEn: to end one's working career
en: Does Maya plan to retire next spring?
zh: 玛雅打算明年春天退休吗？
transfer: 请老师讲讲退休后想如何度过第一个月。
transferEn: Ask a teacher about plans for the first month after leaving work permanently.

senseEn: strikingly large or noticeable
en: Was there a dramatic change in attendance after fares dropped?
zh: 票价下降后到场人数有显著变化吗？
transfer: 向朋友描述翻修前后厨房采光的巨大变化。
transferEn: Describe the striking difference in light after a kitchen renovation.

senseEn: to watch closely and attentively
en: May we observe the rehearsal without interrupting?
zh: 我们可以安静地观摩排练吗？
transfer: 请同学在池塘边观察蝌蚪的动作。
transferEn: Ask a classmate to watch how tadpoles move in a pond.

senseEn: to cook with dry heat in an oven
en: Should I roast the peppers before peeling them?
zh: 这些甜椒要先烤再剥皮吗？
transfer: 准备晚餐时问土豆需要烤多久。
transferEn: Ask how long potatoes need to cook in the oven for dinner.

senseEn: a fine fabric made from fibers spun by silkworms
en: Can I hand-wash this silk scarf?
zh: 这条丝巾能手洗吗？
transfer: 买枕套时确认面料是真丝还是合成纤维。
transferEn: Ask whether a pillowcase is made from silkworm fiber or synthetic material.

senseEn: a basketball player who shoots the ball
en: Who's the best shooter on your basketball team?
zh: 你们篮球队里谁投篮最准？
transfer: 讨论最后一投时，指出教练选了哪位投篮手。
transferEn: Identify the basketball player chosen to take the final shot.

senseEn: in a way that is not the same
en: Would you arrange the tables differently this time?
zh: 这次你会换种方式摆桌子吗？
transfer: 问老师这道题能不能换个方法解释。
transferEn: Ask a teacher to explain a problem another way.

senseEn: to make information known publicly
en: When will you announce the winners of the photo contest?
zh: 什么时候宣布摄影比赛的获奖者？
transfer: 请站务员广播公布新的检票口。
transferEn: Ask station staff to make the new gate known over the speakers.

senseEn: a person serving drinks at a bar
en: Can the bartender make the same drink without alcohol?
zh: 调酒师能把这款饮料做成无酒精的吗？
transfer: 在婚宴上询问哪位调酒师负责软饮。
transferEn: Ask which person serving at the bar handles soft drinks at a wedding.

senseEn: money demanded in exchange for a captive's release
en: In the novel, does the family pay the ransom?
zh: 小说中那家人付赎金了吗？
transfer: 在读书会上讨论哪一章首次提到了赎金。
transferEn: Discuss which chapter first mentions money demanded for a captive.

senseEn: an instinctive feeling or judgment
en: My gut feeling is that the earlier train is safer.
zh: 我直觉觉得坐早一点的火车更稳妥。
transfer: 在两幅封面之间犹豫时，请朋友说说第一直觉。
transferEn: Ask a friend for an instinctive reaction to two possible covers.

senseEn: resources committed in the hope of future benefit
en: Is the new printer a good investment for such a small office?
zh: 对这么小的办公室来说，新打印机值得投资吗？
transfer: 讨论雨水回收装置是否值得小区投入资金。
transferEn: Discuss whether a rainwater system is worth the community's money.

senseEn: in position number seven
en: We're on the seventh floor, opposite the lift.
zh: 我们在七楼，电梯对面。
transfer: 问书店你要的书是不是系列第七本。
transferEn: Ask whether a book is number seven in its series.

senseEn: a platform where boats load or unload
en: Which dock does the island ferry use?
zh: 开往岛上的渡轮停靠哪个码头？
transfer: 约朋友在钓鱼船旁的码头碰面。
transferEn: Arrange to meet a friend at the landing platform beside the fishing boats.

senseEn: a piece of metal used as money
en: Does this locker take a coin or a card?
zh: 储物柜是投币还是刷卡的？
transfer: 在旧货市场询问硬币上铸的是哪一年。
transferEn: Ask a market seller which year is stamped on a piece of metal currency.

senseEn: the carrying out of a plan
en: Who oversees the execution of the move after we approve the plan?
zh: 方案批准后，谁负责搬迁的执行？
transfer: 请负责人说明展览搭建计划是如何落实的。
transferEn: Ask a coordinator how the exhibition setup plan was carried out.

senseEn: jewelry worn around the neck
en: Can you shorten this necklace by one link?
zh: 能把这条项链缩短一节吗？
transfer: 向失物处描述遗失的珍珠项链。
transferEn: Describe a missing strand of pearls worn around the neck.

senseEn: something used to attract fish to a hook
en: Is live bait allowed at this lake?
zh: 这个湖允许用活饵吗？
transfer: 到码头商店问哪种鱼饵适合当地的鱼。
transferEn: Ask a dockside shop what attracts the local fish.

senseEn: having little or no hair on the head
en: Was the host bald in the original series too?
zh: 原版节目里的主持人也是秃头吗？
transfer: 给素描老师描述你画的角色头顶没有头发。
transferEn: Describe a character with no hair on top to a drawing teacher.

senseEn: unreasonable to the point of seeming ridiculous
en: Charging for an empty seat seems rather absurd to me.
zh: 空座位也收费，我觉得相当荒谬。
transfer: 讨论明明有钥匙却要破门的剧情安排有多荒唐。
transferEn: Discuss why breaking down a door despite having a key seems unreasonable.

senseEn: without writing or marks
en: Please leave the last box blank for the office stamp.
zh: 最后一个框请留空，供办公室盖章。
transfer: 填申请表时问不适用的栏目能否留空。
transferEn: Ask whether an irrelevant field can be left unfilled on a form.

senseEn: human beings considered together
en: Why does the speaker call clean water a challenge for all humanity?
zh: 演讲者为什么说清洁饮水是全人类的挑战？
transfer: 讨论一张地球照片对全人类的意义。
transferEn: Discuss what a photograph of Earth might mean to people as a whole.

senseEn: the way a hand holds something
en: Could you check my grip on the tennis racket?
zh: 能看看我握网球拍的方式吗？
transfer: 羽毛球课上请老师演示反手握拍。
transferEn: Ask a badminton teacher to show how the hand holds the racket for a backhand.

senseEn: a charge for a service
en: Is there a fee for changing the delivery date?
zh: 改送货日期收费吗？
transfer: 问学校补办学生证的费用是多少。
transferEn: Ask a school what it charges to replace a student ID.

senseEn: an organ that filters waste from blood
en: Does this scan show the left kidney clearly?
zh: 这张影像能看清左肾吗？
transfer: 在人体模型上请老师指出右侧肾脏的位置。
transferEn: Ask a teacher to identify the right blood-filtering organ on a model.

senseEn: to impose a penalty for wrongdoing
en: Will the league punish the club for selling extra seats?
zh: 联盟会因超卖座位而处罚这家俱乐部吗？
transfer: 讨论班规时问老师会如何处理故意作弊。
transferEn: Ask how a teacher would penalize deliberate cheating under the class rules.

senseEn: the mood or feeling of a place
en: I liked the relaxed atmosphere at the little café.
zh: 我喜欢那家小咖啡馆轻松的氛围。
transfer: 向同事描述面试现场的气氛。
transferEn: Describe the mood in the room at a job interview.

senseEn: a long seat for several people
en: Let's wait on the bench under the clock.
zh: 我们在钟下面的长椅上等吧。
transfer: 带老人散步时问公园哪里有能休息的长椅。
transferEn: Ask where an older walker can find a long seat to rest on in the park.

senseEn: to rub a surface until it shines
en: What should I use to polish the brass handles?
zh: 我该用什么擦亮黄铜把手？
transfer: 宴会前请朋友帮你把银勺擦亮。
transferEn: Ask a friend to shine the silver spoons before dinner.

senseEn: a primate such as a gorilla or chimpanzee
en: Which great ape made that call in the wildlife film?
zh: 野生动物影片里的叫声是哪种大型类人猿发出的？
transfer: 博物馆里问无尾的这种灵长类叫什么。
transferEn: Ask a museum guide what this tailless primate is called.

senseEn: to establish a link between devices
en: Can I connect my tablet to the projector without a cable?
zh: 我的平板能无线连接投影仪吗？
transfer: 向店员询问耳机能否同时连两部手机。
transferEn: Ask whether the headphones can be linked to two phones at once.

senseEn: to scatter fine droplets
en: Please spray the leaves with water before we move the pots.
zh: 搬花盆前请给叶子喷水。
transfer: 清洁镜子时问能不能把清洁剂喷在布上。
transferEn: Ask whether cleaner can be misted onto a cloth for cleaning a mirror.

senseEn: a sheltered area outside a building entrance
en: Leave the wet umbrella on the front porch.
zh: 把湿伞放在前门廊上。
transfer: 请快递员把箱子放在有顶的门廊里。
transferEn: Ask a courier to leave a box in the covered entrance area.

senseEn: to build up a skill or quality
en: How can I develop a habit of reading before bed?
zh: 我怎样才能养成睡前阅读的习惯？
transfer: 问教练如何培养判断落点的能力。
transferEn: Ask a coach how to build skill in predicting where a ball will land.

senseEn: an examination of a body to determine cause of death
en: Has the autopsy report been released to the family?
zh: 尸检报告已经交给家属了吗？
transfer: 阅读新闻时核对尸检何时完成。
transferEn: Check when the postmortem examination in a news report was completed.

senseEn: extremely frightened
en: I'm terrified of heights. Can we take the lower path?
zh: 我特别怕高。能走下边那条路吗？
transfer: 暴风雨后描述小狗当时吓成什么样。
transferEn: Describe how frightened your puppy was during a storm.

senseEn: an estimated price for work
en: Could you send a written quote for replacing the windows?
zh: 能发一份更换窗户的书面报价吗？
transfer: 向搬家公司询问报价是否包括纸箱。
transferEn: Ask movers whether their price estimate includes boxes.

senseEn: natural light during the day
en: Can we check the paint in daylight before choosing?
zh: 选定之前能在日光下看看漆的颜色吗？
transfer: 提醒同伴趁天还亮时把帐篷搭好。
transferEn: Remind a companion to pitch the tent while natural light remains.

senseEn: the speed at which someone moves
en: Could we walk at a slower pace until the hill ends?
zh: 到坡顶之前能走慢点吗？
transfer: 问领跑员明天的慢跑会保持多快的速度。
transferEn: Ask the lead runner what speed tomorrow's easy run will maintain.

senseEn: subject to death
en: Is the hero still mortal after drinking the potion?
zh: 主人公喝了药水后还会死吗？
transfer: 谈论神话时指出哪位角色虽然有神力仍有寿命限制。
transferEn: Identify which mythical character has powers but can still die.

senseEn: to wish one had another person's good fortune
en: I envy your patience with the youngest students.
zh: 我羡慕你对年龄最小的学生那么有耐心。
transfer: 向朋友表达你羡慕她能步行上班。
transferEn: Tell a friend you wish you could walk to work like her.

senseEn: a passage connecting rooms
en: Please keep the hallway clear for people with strollers.
zh: 请让走廊保持畅通，方便推婴儿车的人通行。
transfer: 向访客说明洗手间在走廊尽头。
transferEn: Tell a visitor the washroom is at the far end of the passage.

senseEn: to get in the way of something
en: Would drilling at noon interfere with your online class?
zh: 中午钻孔会影响你上网课吗？
transfer: 询问路边施工会不会妨碍商店送货。
transferEn: Ask whether roadside work will disrupt deliveries to a shop.

senseEn: a daughter of one's sibling
en: My youngest niece starts school on Monday.
zh: 我最小的外甥女周一开学。
transfer: 介绍合照里你姐姐的女儿。
transferEn: Introduce your sister's daughter in a group picture.

en: Turn left at the old mill just past the bridge.
zh: 过桥后在那座老磨坊左转。
transfer: 参观村庄时询问磨坊过去加工哪种谷物。
senseEn: a building where grain is ground
transferEn: On a village visit, ask which grain used to be ground in the old building.

senseEn: easily damaged
en: Wrap the delicate cups separately before packing them.
zh: 装箱前把这些易碎的杯子分别包好。
transfer: 送洗衣服时提醒店员蕾丝面料易损。
transferEn: Warn a cleaner that a lace fabric needs careful handling.

senseEn: a device for weighing things
en: Could you put the empty bowl on the kitchen scale first?
zh: 能先把空碗放到厨房秤上吗？
transfer: 在机场问哪里有称行李的秤。
transferEn: Ask where you can find a weighing device for luggage at an airport.

senseEn: to clean with a broom
en: I'll sweep the stairs after the boxes are upstairs.
zh: 等箱子都搬上去，我来扫楼梯。
transfer: 晚餐后请室友扫一下桌子底下的碎屑。
transferEn: Ask a roommate to remove crumbs under the table with a broom.

senseEn: to hit something suddenly and hard
en: Did the gate smack your elbow when it swung shut?
zh: 门甩上时是不是撞到了你的胳膊肘？
transfer: 描述风把百叶窗猛地拍在墙上的声音。
transferEn: Describe the sound of a shutter hitting a wall in the wind.

senseEn: a professional who provides a form of treatment
en: Can my physical therapist show me how to adjust the brace?
zh: 物理治疗师能教我调节支具吗？
transfer: 问康复中心能否继续预约上一次的治疗师。
transferEn: Ask a rehab center to book you with the same practitioner as last time.

senseEn: a woman who is romantically attracted to women
en: The author writes about coming out as a lesbian to her family.
zh: 作者写到了向家人坦言自己是女同性恋者的经历。
transfer: 在读书会上转述女主人公对自己性取向的描述。
transferEn: Report how a female protagonist describes her attraction to women.

senseEn: coming before the present one
en: Is the previous edition still acceptable for this course?
zh: 这门课还能用上一版教材吗？
transfer: 问房东之前的租客有没有留下窗帘。
transferEn: Ask a landlord whether the people who lived there before left the curtains.

senseEn: a period away for rest or focused practice
en: Does the weekend retreat include meals?
zh: 这次周末静修包餐吗？
transfer: 向写作中心询问静修期间能否使用图书室。
transferEn: Ask whether a writing getaway includes use of the library.

senseEn: to look closely into a problem or event
en: Will someone investigate the delay in our delivery?
zh: 会有人调查这次送货延误吗？
transfer: 请管理处调查公共走廊频繁停电的原因。
transferEn: Ask building management to look into repeated power cuts in the hallway.

senseEn: for a short time
en: Can we sit awhile before climbing the last flight?
zh: 爬最后一段楼梯前能坐一会儿吗？
transfer: 朋友冒雨到了，邀请他稍坐再走。
transferEn: Invite a friend in from the rain to stay for a short time.

senseEn: one hundredth of a dollar
en: The receipt is off by one cent. Can we check the tax?
zh: 小票差了一美分。能核对一下税额吗？
transfer: 付款后告诉收银员找零少了一美分。
transferEn: Tell a cashier the change is short by one hundredth of a dollar.

en: Could you add July to the sales chart before the meeting?
zh: 开会前能把七月份的数据加到销售图表里吗？
transfer: 看电费账单时，请室友指出图表上用电最多的月份。
senseEn: a diagram that displays data
transferEn: Ask your roommate to point to the month with the highest power use on the bill's graph.

senseEn: protective headgear
en: Does the bike rental include a helmet?
zh: 租自行车包含头盔吗？
transfer: 滑冰前问有没有儿童尺寸的头盔。
transferEn: Ask for protective headgear in a child's size before skating.

senseEn: to achieve the intended result
en: What helped your team succeed on the second attempt?
zh: 是什么让你们组第二次尝试获得了成功？
transfer: 向一位刚通过驾考的朋友询问这次成功的原因。
transferEn: Ask a newly qualified driver what helped them pass this time.

senseEn: a plan agreed by the people involved
en: Does our arrangement still work if the ferry is late?
zh: 渡轮晚点的话，我们原来的安排还行吗？
transfer: 向同事确认周五轮流值班的安排。
transferEn: Confirm the plan for sharing Friday duty with a colleague.

senseEn: a plan for achieving a goal
en: What's your strategy for keeping time on the long climb?
zh: 爬这个长坡时你打算怎么控制用时？
transfer: 请棋友解释他在开局时采用的策略。
transferEn: Ask a chess partner to explain their plan for the opening.

senseEn: a goodbye marking someone's departure
en: We're planning a farewell dinner for our retiring librarian.
zh: 我们要给即将退休的图书管理员办一场告别晚餐。
transfer: 离开寄宿家庭前写一封告别信。
transferEn: Write a goodbye note before leaving a host family.

senseEn: to express approval of someone's actions
en: I'd like to praise the driver who found my keys.
zh: 我想表扬那位找到我钥匙的司机。
transfer: 给老师写信表扬一位耐心帮新生的同学。
transferEn: Write to a teacher commending a classmate who patiently helped a newcomer.

senseEn: the study of matter, energy and forces
en: Do first-year students need physics lab coats?
zh: 一年级学生上物理实验课需要穿实验服吗？
transfer: 问老师物理课什么时候开始学光学。
transferEn: Ask when the class studying matter and energy will begin optics.

senseEn: tiny airborne droplets reducing visibility
en: The ferry won't leave until the fog lifts.
zh: 雾散了渡轮才会开。
transfer: 早晨开车前向邻居打听山路上有没有雾。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor whether mist is limiting visibility on the mountain road.

senseEn: a vehicle designed for flight
en: Is this aircraft large enough for a full-size wheelchair?
zh: 这架飞机放得下全尺寸轮椅吗？
transfer: 参观航空馆时问哪架飞机飞过大西洋。
transferEn: Ask which flying vehicle in an aviation museum crossed the Atlantic.

senseEn: very serious or intense
en: The intake form asks about severe allergies. Does mine belong here?
zh: 登记表要填严重过敏史，我这种要填在这里吗？
transfer: 向前台说明你因为剧烈疼痛想提前预约。
transferEn: Tell reception that intense pain has led you to seek an earlier appointment.

senseEn: an effect on people or conditions
en: Has the new route had an impact on shop traffic?
zh: 新线路对商店客流有影响吗？
transfer: 询问学校较晚上课对出勤有何影响。
transferEn: Ask a school how a later start affected attendance.

senseEn: trousers ending above the knees
en: Are these shorts suitable for swimming?
zh: 这条短裤适合游泳吗？
transfer: 收拾行李时问同伴山区徒步可不可以穿短裤。
transferEn: Ask a companion whether short-legged trousers suit a mountain walk.

senseEn: to produce a digital image of a document
en: Can I scan the receipt here instead of posting it?
zh: 我可以在这里扫描收据，不用邮寄吗？
transfer: 请同事把旧地图扫描成电子文件。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to make a digital image of an old map.

senseEn: an insulting label for someone seen as dangerously uncontrolled
en: The reporter removed the label “maniac” from the headline.
zh: 记者从标题中删掉了“疯子”这个带侮辱性的称呼。
transfer: 在编辑会上解释为何不宜用这个词形容一名陌生人。
transferEn: Explain to editors why this insulting label should be avoided when describing a stranger.

senseEn: a state of complete disorder
en: The duplicate seat numbers caused chaos at the entrance.
zh: 重复的座位号导致入口处一片混乱。
transfer: 向同事描述突然断电后前台的混乱。
transferEn: Describe the disorder at reception after a sudden power cut.

senseEn: three times as much or as many
en: Is this room really triple the price on weekends?
zh: 这间房周末的价格真是平时的三倍吗？
transfer: 比较两种储物盒，说明大的容量是小的三倍。
transferEn: Compare two boxes by saying the larger holds three times as much.

senseEn: a person outside the armed forces
en: Was the photographer a civilian or an army employee?
zh: 那名摄影师是平民还是军方雇员？
transfer: 在历史展问哪些日记是平民写的。
transferEn: Ask which diaries at a history exhibit were written by people outside the military.

senseEn: to clear a toilet using water
en: Please don't flush the toilet while the plumber tests the pipe.
zh: 水管工检查管道时请先别冲马桶。
transfer: 告诉房东楼上的马桶冲水后会一直响。
transferEn: Tell a landlord that the upstairs toilet keeps making noise after you clear it with water.

senseEn: a storage room below ground
en: Keep the apples in the cool cellar until Friday.
zh: 周五之前把苹果存在阴凉的地窖里。
transfer: 问房主自行车能不能放在地下储物间。
transferEn: Ask a homeowner if bikes may be kept in the underground storage room.

senseEn: free from control by another party
en: Did an independent reviewer check the figures?
zh: 有独立审核人核对这些数据吗？
transfer: 问修缮委员会是否会请独立专家检查房屋。
transferEn: Ask whether someone unaffiliated with the repair firm will inspect the house.

senseEn: a craft used for travel on water
en: Which vessel leaves first for the island?
zh: 哪艘船最先开往岛上？
transfer: 参观码头时询问哪艘船用来运送淡水。
transferEn: Ask which craft at a dock transports fresh water.

senseEn: another available option
en: Is there an alternative to the stairs for strollers?
zh: 推婴儿车的人除了走楼梯还有别的通道吗？
transfer: 请餐厅提供一款可以代替奶油的配料。
transferEn: Ask a restaurant for an option to use in place of cream.

senseEn: the vertical measurement of something
en: What's the height of the shelf above the sink?
zh: 水槽上方的架子有多高？
transfer: 订货车时询问车库入口限高。
transferEn: Check the allowed vertical clearance at a garage before booking a van.

senseEn: to make previously hidden information known
en: When will they reveal the winner of the audience vote?
zh: 他们什么时候公布观众投票的获胜者？
transfer: 请朋友别把密室谜题的答案揭晓。
transferEn: Ask a friend to keep the solution to an escape-room puzzle secret.

senseEn: an exclamation of joy or relief
en: Hallelujah, the lift works again! I can get the pram upstairs.
zh: 谢天谢地，电梯终于修好了！我能把婴儿车推上楼了。
transfer: 找回丢失的车票时，用一句欢呼表达如释重负。
transferEn: Give a joyful exclamation of relief after finding a lost ticket.

senseEn: a highly vulgar intensifier
en: The editor cut the word “motherfucking” from the family edition.
zh: 编辑从家庭版中删掉了那个极粗俗的语气词。
transfer: 在审稿时指出哪处粗俗强调词需要向读者说明语域。
transferEn: Flag a highly vulgar intensifier and explain its register to an editor.

senseEn: someone who offers help without pay
en: Do you need another volunteer at the registration desk?
zh: 登记台还需要一名志愿者吗？
transfer: 问社区花园每位志愿者需要带什么工具。
transferEn: Ask what tools each unpaid helper should bring to a community garden.

senseEn: an action, especially one judged by its moral quality
en: Returning that wallet was a kind deed.
zh: 归还那个钱包是件善举。
transfer: 采访邻居时请他回忆陌生人为他做过的一件善事。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor to recall a good act a stranger once did for him.

senseEn: in a position with the top below the bottom
en: The label is upside down. Could you turn the jar over?
zh: 标签倒过来了，能把罐子翻过来吗？
transfer: 提醒同伴检查地图是不是拿反了。
transferEn: Ask a companion to check whether the map's top is pointing downward.

senseEn: exceptionally enjoyable or beautiful
en: We had glorious weather for the whole bike ride.
zh: 整个骑行途中天气都好极了。
transfer: 写明信片称赞从山脊看到的壮丽日出。
transferEn: Praise a magnificent sunrise seen from a ridge in a postcard.

senseEn: a structured exchange of opposing arguments
en: Who's opening the debate on free school lunches?
zh: 关于免费校餐的辩论谁先发言？
transfer: 问主持人环保议题辩论何时接受观众提问。
transferEn: Ask when the audience can question speakers in an environmental debate.

senseEn: to briefly lose consciousness
en: I felt like I might faint on the crowded train.
zh: 在拥挤的列车上我感觉自己快晕过去了。
transfer: 告诉医生你抽血时曾短暂晕倒。
transferEn: Tell a doctor you once briefly lost consciousness during a blood draw.

senseEn: having no value for a purpose
en: Is the voucher worthless after the shop closes?
zh: 商店关闭后这张券就一文不值了吗？
transfer: 问修表师没有机芯的旧表是否完全不值钱。
transferEn: Ask whether an old watch with no movement still has any value.

senseEn: a mistake or fault
en: Which error message appeared when the upload stopped?
zh: 上传中断时出现了哪条错误提示？
transfer: 校稿时指出地址中的一处错误。
transferEn: Point out a mistake in an address while proofreading.

senseEn: fossilized resin used in jewelry
en: Is the bead made of real amber or colored glass?
zh: 这颗珠子是真琥珀还是彩色玻璃？
transfer: 在博物馆问哪块琥珀里面保存了昆虫。
transferEn: Ask which piece of fossilized resin at a museum contains an insect.

senseEn: a portable structure with rungs for climbing
en: Can I borrow your ladder to reach the smoke alarm?
zh: 能借你家的梯子去够烟雾报警器吗？
transfer: 整理阁楼时提醒同伴扶着梯子底部。
transferEn: Ask a companion to steady the bottom of the climbing frame while you reach the attic.

senseEn: in relation to the body
en: The long shift left me physically exhausted but pleased with our work.
zh: 长班让我身体疲惫，不过我对我们的工作很满意。
transfer: 向教练描述哪部分训练对体力要求最高。
transferEn: Tell a coach which part of training places the heaviest demands on your body.

senseEn: a message sent by telegraph
en: Who sent the telegram announcing the ship's arrival?
zh: 宣布轮船抵达的电报是谁发的？
transfer: 在历史展询问那封电报是什么时候收到的。
transferEn: Ask when a telegraph message shown at a history exhibit arrived.

senseEn: at all, for emphasis in a negative statement
en: There was no warning whatsoever before the lights went out.
zh: 断电前完全没有任何预警。
transfer: 向客服强调备用钥匙根本没有任何作用。
transferEn: Emphasize to customer service that a spare key didn't help at all.

senseEn: the system of websites accessible on the internet
en: Is the timetable on the web as well as in the app?
zh: 除了应用里，网上也能查到时刻表吗？
transfer: 请老师推荐能在网上公开阅读的旧报纸。
transferEn: Ask a teacher about old newspapers publicly accessible through websites.

senseEn: a person who writes verse
en: Will the poet read her own work at the library?
zh: 那位诗人会在图书馆朗读自己的作品吗？
transfer: 问书店这本诗集是哪位诗人翻译的。
transferEn: Ask which writer of verse translated a poetry collection.

senseEn: a small clue that helps someone solve something
en: Can you give me one hint without telling me the answer?
zh: 能给一个提示，但不直接说答案吗？
transfer: 朋友卡在拼图上时，提供一个关于边角的小线索。
transferEn: Offer a friend a small clue about the edges of a puzzle.

senseEn: very enjoyable or charming
en: What a delightful surprise to hear the choir outside!
zh: 听到外面的合唱真是个令人愉快的惊喜！
transfer: 写便条感谢房东安排了一场愉快的花园晚餐。
transferEn: Thank a host for an especially enjoyable garden dinner.

senseEn: entertaining in a funny way
en: The captions were more amusing than the photos themselves.
zh: 配文比照片本身还好笑。
transfer: 告诉朋友讲座中哪个小故事最逗。
transferEn: Tell a friend which anecdote in a talk made you laugh the most.

senseEn: extra pay in addition to regular wages
en: Is the year-end bonus paid with December's salary?
zh: 年终奖跟十二月工资一起发吗？
transfer: 问人事入职不满一年的员工能否领奖金。
transferEn: Ask HR whether new employees qualify for extra annual pay.

senseEn: a difficult feat performed for entertainment
en: Was the rooftop stunt filmed in front of a green screen?
zh: 那个屋顶特技是在绿幕前拍的吗？
transfer: 演出结束后问哪一个特技动作由替身完成。
transferEn: Ask which difficult performance feat was done by a double.

senseEn: having a color between black and white
en: Do you have this grey coat in a smaller size?
zh: 这件灰色外套有小一号的吗？
transfer: 向英国店员描述你丢失的灰手套。
transferEn: Describe the grey-colored gloves you lost to a British shop assistant.

senseEn: with careful attention
en: Look closely at the date stamped on the coin.
zh: 仔细看硬币上刻着的日期。
transfer: 核对合同时提醒同事仔细读取消条款。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to read the cancellation terms with care.

senseEn: to a moderate but noticeable degree
en: The path is fairly steep after the footbridge.
zh: 过了人行桥之后，小路相当陡。
transfer: 向游客说明即使在工作日展厅也相当拥挤。
transferEn: Tell a visitor that the gallery is rather crowded even on weekdays.

senseEn: a genre intended to frighten its audience
en: Is tonight's film a horror movie or a mystery?
zh: 今晚放的是恐怖片还是悬疑片？
transfer: 向书店询问有没有不太吓人的恐怖小说。
transferEn: Ask for a novel in the frightening genre that isn't too scary.

senseEn: to break someone's trust deliberately
en: I won't betray her trust by sharing that letter.
zh: 我不会把那封信传出去，辜负她的信任。
transfer: 讨论小说时解释主人公为什么觉得朋友背叛了他。
transferEn: Explain why a fictional character feels his friend broke his trust.

senseEn: a small amount of food between meals
en: Should we pack a snack for the long train ride?
zh: 长途坐火车我们要带点零食吗？
transfer: 问校方课间能不能吃水果点心。
transferEn: Ask whether pupils may eat fruit between lessons.

senseEn: a judgment reached after considering evidence
en: What led you to that conclusion about the missing file?
zh: 你是怎么就文件丢失得出那个结论的？
transfer: 请研究者说明新数据是否会改变原先结论。
transferEn: Ask whether new data would change a researcher's original judgment.

senseEn: steadfast in one's support or affection
en: He's been a faithful supporter of the choir since it began.
zh: 合唱团刚成立时他就一直忠实地支持着它。
transfer: 为志愿者致谢时称赞她多年来一直支持图书馆。
transferEn: Praise a volunteer's steady support for the library over many years.

senseEn: corn kernels heated until they puff up
en: Can we share a small popcorn before the film starts?
zh: 电影开场前我们分一小份爆米花好吗？
transfer: 在摊位前询问爆米花有甜的还是咸的。
transferEn: Ask a vendor whether the popped corn is sweet or salty.

senseEn: someone who takes photographs professionally or artistically
en: Did the photographer send the family portraits yet?
zh: 摄影师发来全家福了吗？
transfer: 请活动负责人确认谁是毕业典礼的摄影师。
transferEn: Ask an organizer who will take the graduation photographs.

senseEn: a partnership between groups for a shared purpose
en: Which towns joined the alliance to protect the river?
zh: 哪些城镇加入了保护这条河的联盟？
transfer: 采访市集组织者时问小商户为什么结成联盟。
transferEn: Ask why local vendors formed a partnership to pursue shared goals.

senseEn: to a certain but limited extent
en: The new timetable is somewhat easier to read.
zh: 新时刻表看起来稍微清楚了一些。
transfer: 向裁缝说明修改后的袖子还是略长。
transferEn: Tell a tailor the adjusted sleeves are still a little long.

senseEn: the people living in a place considered as a total
en: Has the town's population grown since the station opened?
zh: 车站开放后镇上的人口增加了吗？
transfer: 准备地理报告时比较两个岛的人口。
transferEn: Compare how many people live on two islands for a geography report.

senseEn: a group of words expressing a meaning
en: Which English phrase would sound natural on a wedding invitation?
zh: 婚礼请柬上用哪个英文短语比较自然？
transfer: 请老师解释邮件中一个陌生的词组。
transferEn: Ask a teacher to explain an unfamiliar group of words in an email.

senseEn: wonderfully enchanting
en: The street lights made the snowy square feel almost magical.
zh: 路灯让雪中的广场显得梦幻迷人。
transfer: 形容孩子第一次看萤火虫时那美妙的夜晚。
transferEn: Describe an enchanting evening when a child first saw fireflies.

en: Who can walk your dog during recovery?
zh: 你康复期间谁可以帮你遛狗？
transfer: 手术后向医生询问康复期间能做哪些家务。
senseEn: the process of getting well again
transferEn: Ask your doctor which chores you can do while healing after surgery.

senseEn: a financial charge for breaking an agreement or rule
en: Is there a penalty for returning the van late?
zh: 还车迟了要交罚金吗？
transfer: 解约前询问提前结束套餐的罚金。
transferEn: Ask what you would be charged for ending a service plan early.

senseEn: an organized series of competitive matches
en: Is the chess tournament open to beginners?
zh: 这次国际象棋锦标赛接受初学者报名吗？
transfer: 问队长下月排球锦标赛在哪个体育馆办。
transferEn: Ask a captain where next month's series of volleyball matches will be held.

senseEn: situated on the outside
en: Remove the outer wrapping before you heat the tray.
zh: 加热餐盒前请拆掉外包装。
transfer: 收拾旅行包时说明护照放在外侧口袋。
transferEn: Tell a companion the passport is in the pocket on the outside.

senseEn: to break food down with the teeth
en: This bread is hard to chew with my new braces.
zh: 戴了新牙套，这个面包嚼起来很费劲。
transfer: 和牙医说哪一侧咀嚼时有点疼。
transferEn: Tell a dentist which side hurts when you use your teeth to break down food.

senseEn: the ability to keep oneself following a plan
en: Practicing piano every morning takes real discipline.
zh: 每天早晨坚持练琴很需要自律。
transfer: 向同学请教独自在家学习时如何保持自律。
transferEn: Ask a classmate how they stay self-controlled when studying alone at home.

senseEn: an occupation requiring particular preparation or skill
en: What drew you to the teaching profession?
zh: 是什么吸引你从事教师职业的？
transfer: 采访建筑师时询问进入这个职业需要哪些训练。
transferEn: Ask an architect what preparation their occupation requires.

senseEn: a wheeled basket used for shopping or carrying things
en: Can I take the shopping cart out to my car?
zh: 我可以把购物车推到车旁边吗？
transfer: 买盆栽时请店员找辆小推车来搬运。
transferEn: Ask for a wheeled carrier to move potted plants at a shop.

senseEn: the glowing part of a fire
en: The candle flame keeps flickering by the window.
zh: 窗边的烛火一直在摇曳。
transfer: 吃饭时提醒小孩袖口离蜡烛的火焰远一点。
transferEn: Ask a child to keep their sleeve away from the candle's burning tip.

senseEn: the distance around a shape or area
en: Do we need the perimeter or the area to order the fence?
zh: 订围栏要量周长还是面积？
transfer: 请同学算一下三角形花坛的周长。
transferEn: Ask a classmate to calculate the distance around a triangular flower bed.

senseEn: a substance used to make candles and coatings
en: How can I get candle wax off the tablecloth?
zh: 桌布上的蜡怎么去掉？
transfer: 做手工时确认蜡冷却后会是什么颜色。
transferEn: Ask what color the candle material will be once it cools.

senseEn: a box used to hold a dead person's body
en: Was the letter placed in the coffin at his request?
zh: 那封信是应他的要求放进棺材的吗？
transfer: 阅读家族回忆录时核实谁抬了棺材。
transferEn: Ask who carried the burial box in a family memoir.

senseEn: being the final goal or deciding point
en: Is the ultimate goal to reopen the whole trail?
zh: 最终目标是重新开放整条步道吗？
transfer: 向学生解释这次长期练习最终想达到什么目标。
transferEn: Explain the final aim of a long practice program to students.

senseEn: considerate care shown toward others
en: I'll remember your kindness when my flight was canceled.
zh: 我会记得航班取消时你给予的善意。
transfer: 在感谢卡里提到邻居照看宠物时的善意。
transferEn: Acknowledge a neighbor's thoughtful care for a pet in a thank-you card.

senseEn: with little force or pressure
en: Press gently on the frame until it clicks.
zh: 轻轻按压边框，直到听见咔嗒一声。
transfer: 教孩子抚摸猫咪时手要轻一点。
transferEn: Show a child how to stroke a cat with very little pressure.

senseEn: extreme fear
en: I saw the terror in her face when the lights failed.
zh: 灯灭时，我从她的脸上看到了惊恐。
transfer: 讲述迷路经历时描述你起初感到的强烈害怕。
transferEn: Describe the intense fear you first felt when you lost your way.

senseEn: goods carried by a vehicle or ship
en: Has the cargo from the island reached the harbor?
zh: 从岛上运来的货物到港了吗？
transfer: 向航空公司询问乐器能否作为货物运输。
transferEn: Ask whether an instrument can be shipped as freight on an airplane.

sense: 美国北方人（有时带贬义）
senseEn: an informal, sometimes disparaging name for a northerner in the US
en: Does the term “Yankee” sound friendly in this Civil War diary?
zh: 这本美国内战日记里称人“北方佬”，听起来友好吗？
transfer: 讨论历史书信中这个对北方人的称呼是否带敌意。
transferEn: Discuss the tone of this nickname for a northerner in a historical letter.

senseEn: to connect one thing with another in one's mind
en: I associate that tune with summer afternoons at my aunt's.
zh: 那段曲子会让我想到在姨妈家过的夏日午后。
transfer: 告诉朋友什么气味让你联想到开学第一天。
transferEn: Tell a friend which smell brings your first day of school to mind.

senseEn: an official investigating the circumstances of a death
en: When will the coroner publish the findings?
zh: 验尸官什么时候公布调查结果？
transfer: 读报道时问是哪位官员负责调查死因。
transferEn: Ask who officially investigated the death described in a report.

senseEn: a garment covering a foot and part of a leg
en: I found one blue sock behind the dryer.
zh: 我在烘干机后面找到一只蓝袜子。
transfer: 洗衣后向室友问哪只袜子是他的。
transferEn: Ask a roommate to identify their foot garment after laundry.

senseEn: an official document confirming an achievement or fact
en: Can I collect my certificate after the language test?
zh: 语言测试结束后我能领证书吗？
transfer: 询问培训证书上的名字可否更正。
transferEn: Ask for a name correction on an official training document.

senseEn: a personal record written over time
en: Grandpa kept a diary of every voyage he made.
zh: 爷爷把每次航行都记进了日记。
transfer: 向朋友讲讲自己什么时候最喜欢写日记。
transferEn: Tell a friend when you prefer to write your personal daily record.

senseEn: wet, often wooded ground with standing water
en: Does this boardwalk cross the swamp or go around it?
zh: 这条木栈道是穿过沼泽还是绕过去？
transfer: 问向导沼泽里生活着哪些鸟类。
transferEn: Ask a guide which birds live in the wooded wetland.

en: Meet me at the fruit stall by the station.
zh: 到车站旁的水果摊找我。
transfer: 问市集工作人员卖旧唱片的摊位在哪里。
senseEn: a small stand where goods are sold
transferEn: Ask market staff where to find the stand selling used records.

senseEn: meat from the front of a bird's body
en: Could you slice the chicken breast thinly for the sandwiches?
zh: 可以把鸡胸肉切薄一些做三明治吗？
transfer: 买火鸡肉时说明你想要胸肉而非腿肉。
transferEn: Ask for the meat from the front of the turkey rather than its leg.

senseEn: to transmit a program to an audience
en: Will the station broadcast the concert live?
zh: 电台会直播这场音乐会吗？
transfer: 询问电视台何时播放采访的完整版。
transferEn: Ask when the channel will air the full interview.

senseEn: a desire to eat
en: Has your appetite come back since the fever went down?
zh: 退烧以后你的胃口恢复了吗？
transfer: 长途徒步后描述自己胃口有多好。
transferEn: Describe how hungry you feel after a long hike.

senseEn: of several different kinds
en: The shop sells various sizes of frames. Bring the print along.
zh: 店里卖各种尺寸的画框，把那张画带上吧。
transfer: 介绍校庆会上有哪些不同类型的表演。
transferEn: Describe the different sorts of performances at a school celebration.

senseEn: appearing to have no chance of success
en: It looked hopeless until a seat opened on the last train.
zh: 本来看起来没希望了，直到末班车空出了一个座位。
transfer: 描述球队在最后一分钟前一度看似无望的局面。
transferEn: Describe how the team's chances looked before the final minute.

senseEn: a particular skilled way to do something
en: Could you show me the technique for folding these dumplings?
zh: 能给我示范一下包这种饺子的手法吗？
transfer: 请老师演示用炭笔画阴影的技巧。
transferEn: Ask a teacher to demonstrate a method for shading with charcoal.

senseEn: to follow a rule or instruction
en: Do cyclists need to obey the same signals as cars here?
zh: 这里骑车的人也要遵守跟汽车一样的信号灯吗？
transfer: 在步道入口提醒同伴遵守保护区的规定。
transferEn: Remind a companion to follow reserve rules at a trail entrance.

senseEn: a substance that flows
en: Does this bottle count as a fluid under the airport rules?
zh: 按机场规定这瓶东西算液体吗？
transfer: 询问护士检查前可以喝哪些液体。
transferEn: Ask a nurse which liquids you may drink before a test.

senseEn: unfriendly or antagonistic
en: Why did the crowd give the speaker a hostile reception?
zh: 听众为什么对演讲者表现出敌意？
transfer: 描述辩论中态度是如何从友好变为敌对的。
transferEn: Describe how the mood of a debate turned unfriendly.

senseEn: to take a chance on an uncertain outcome
en: I wouldn't gamble on the last bus showing up in this storm.
zh: 我不会冒险指望末班车在这场风暴里准点出现。
transfer: 讨论活动场地时，说明你是否愿意冒天晴的险。
transferEn: Say whether you'd risk relying on good weather for an event venue.

senseEn: a repeated activity given personal meaning
en: Saturday pancakes are a family ritual at our house.
zh: 在我家，周六做薄煎饼是一项家庭惯例。
transfer: 介绍你每次演出前都会做的小仪式。
transferEn: Describe a personal routine you repeat before every performance.

senseEn: an outdoor meal where food is grilled
en: Are we still having the barbecue if it rains?
zh: 如果下雨，烧烤聚会还照办吗？
transfer: 邀请邻居参加院子里的烧烤并问他吃不吃素。
transferEn: Invite a neighbor to a grilled outdoor meal and ask about vegetarian preferences.

senseEn: a hard sudden hit
en: The loose shutter gave the wall a loud whack.
zh: 松动的百叶窗砰地猛撞了一下墙面。
transfer: 向修理工描述树枝撞上车顶时的一声重响。
transferEn: Describe the hard hit a falling branch gave a car roof.

senseEn: a two-wheeled motor vehicle
en: Is there motorcycle parking near the ferry terminal?
zh: 渡轮码头附近有摩托车位吗？
transfer: 订车票前问车船能否运一辆摩托车。
transferEn: Ask whether a ferry carries two-wheeled motor vehicles before booking.

senseEn: opposite to what was said or expected
en: I didn't dislike the ending. On the contrary, it was my favorite part.
zh: 我并不讨厌结尾。正相反，那是我最喜欢的部分。
transfer: 朋友以为你嫌旅馆太安静，纠正他说你恰好喜欢清静。
transferEn: Correct a friend who assumes you disliked the quiet hotel when you loved it.

senseEn: a point where something is less effective
en: What's the main weakness in our plan for a rainy day?
zh: 我们的雨天预案主要短板在哪里？
transfer: 请老师指出论证中一个可以加强的弱点。
transferEn: Ask a teacher which weak spot in an argument needs strengthening.

senseEn: a small stream
en: Cross the creek at the wooden bridge, not on the stones.
zh: 过小溪走木桥，别踩石头。
transfer: 问露营地旁的小溪夏天会不会干涸。
transferEn: Ask whether the small stream beside camp dries up in summer.

senseEn: a sale where people compete by offering prices
en: Is the bicycle being sold at auction or for a fixed price?
zh: 这辆自行车是拍卖还是一口价出售？
transfer: 给慈善拍卖捐书前问活动哪天举行。
transferEn: Ask when a charity bidding sale takes place before donating books.

senseEn: easy to cut or chew
en: Are the beans tender enough to mash now?
zh: 这些豆子现在够软，可以压成泥了吗？
transfer: 点炖肉时问哪道肉最软嫩。
transferEn: Ask which stew has meat that is easiest to chew.

senseEn: an enclosed appliance for baking or roasting
en: Is the oven free after you bake the bread?
zh: 你的面包烤好后烤箱能给我用吗？
transfer: 住民宿时问烤箱的温度用什么单位显示。
transferEn: Ask what temperature units the baking appliance uses at a rental home.

senseEn: relating to inner life or religious belief
en: Does the guide explain the spiritual meaning of the bell?
zh: 导览有解释这口钟在信仰层面的意义吗？
transfer: 讨论诗歌时问那段旅程在精神上象征什么。
transferEn: Ask what a journey in a poem represents for the character's inner life.

senseEn: a publication featuring scholarly articles
en: Which medical journal published the study?
zh: 这项研究发表在哪本医学期刊上？
transfer: 问导师适合投稿的教育类学术期刊。
transferEn: Ask an adviser which scholarly education publication accepts submissions.

senseEn: to enter a phone number to make a call
en: Do I dial zero to reach the hotel desk?
zh: 联系酒店前台要拨零吗？
transfer: 从办公室打外线前，问需不需要先拨某个数字。
transferEn: Ask whether you must enter a prefix to call outside the office.

senseEn: space for keeping things until needed
en: Is there storage under the guest bed?
zh: 客床底下有储物空间吗？
transfer: 租自习室前问是否有储物空间放书。
transferEn: Ask about space to keep your books when renting a study room.

senseEn: very frequently or without interruption
en: The old tap drips almost constantly at night.
zh: 那只旧水龙头夜里几乎一直滴水。
transfer: 告诉网管复印机不停地显示同一条错误。
transferEn: Tell IT that the copier keeps displaying the same error again and again.

senseEn: to make someone feel awkward or self-conscious
en: Would singing at the table embarrass your sister?
zh: 我们在餐桌上唱歌会让你妹妹尴尬吗？
transfer: 组织惊喜活动时询问怎样避免让寿星难堪。
transferEn: Ask how to avoid making the birthday guest feel awkward during a surprise.

senseEn: to restore something damaged to working condition
en: Can you repair the zip without replacing the whole bag?
zh: 能只修拉链，不换整个包吗？
transfer: 请房东安排人修理卡住的窗户。
transferEn: Ask a landlord to have a stuck window fixed.

senseEn: a utensil with prongs for eating
en: Could I have a clean fork for the cake?
zh: 能给我一把干净的叉子吃蛋糕吗？
transfer: 野餐前提醒同伴沙拉需要带几把叉子。
transferEn: Remind a friend how many pronged utensils to bring for picnic salad.

senseEn: a gathering of people who have been apart
en: Will teachers attend the class reunion too?
zh: 老师们也会参加同学聚会吗？
transfer: 和表姐商量家庭团聚的日期。
transferEn: Agree on a date to bring the extended family together after time apart.

senseEn: without intending to do so
en: I accidentally packed your mug in my box. I'll bring it back.
zh: 我不小心把你的杯子装进了我的箱子。我会拿回来。
transfer: 向同事解释你不小心发了旧版文件。
transferEn: Explain that you sent an older file by mistake.

senseEn: colored makeup worn on the lips
en: Does this red lipstick come in a matte finish?
zh: 这款红色口红有没有哑光的？
transfer: 在试衣间请朋友看看衣领上有没有口红印。
transferEn: Ask a friend to check a collar for marks from lip color.

senseEn: a sharp-tasting spice made from peppercorns
en: Could you pass the black pepper for my soup?
zh: 能把黑胡椒递给我调汤吗？
transfer: 向厨师询问酱汁中是否加了白胡椒。
transferEn: Ask whether the sauce contains the pale version of the ground spice.

senseEn: a sudden expulsion of air from the throat
en: My dry cough keeps waking me up. Is an appointment available?
zh: 干咳老把我弄醒。还有能预约的时间吗？
transfer: 向老师说明你今天因咳嗽没去合唱排练。
transferEn: Explain that repeated coughing kept you from choir practice today.

senseEn: a plan formally offered for consideration
en: Can we review the proposal before the committee votes?
zh: 委员会投票前，我们可以先看看提案吗？
transfer: 请社区负责人说明公园改造提案交给谁。
transferEn: Ask whom to send a formal plan for improving a park.

senseEn: a public expression of opposition
en: Will the protest affect bus stops near city hall?
zh: 抗议活动会影响市政厅附近的公交站吗？
transfer: 读新闻时询问居民举行抗议的原因。
transferEn: Ask why residents publicly expressed opposition in a news report.

senseEn: human beings considered collectively
en: Why did the author dedicate the book to all mankind?
zh: 作者为什么把这本书献给全人类？
transfer: 阅读旧演讲时指出哪个词用来统指全人类。
transferEn: Identify the older collective term for humanity in a historical speech.

senseEn: a sudden sharp pain
en: I felt a stab of pain when I turned my ankle.
zh: 我转动脚踝时感到一阵刺痛。
transfer: 向牙医形容咬冰时牙齿突然刺痛。
transferEn: Describe a sudden sharp sensation in a tooth when biting ice.

senseEn: the eleventh month of the year
en: Does the museum close in November for repairs?
zh: 博物馆十一月会闭馆维修吗？
transfer: 确认运动会是否推迟到了十一月。
transferEn: Check whether the sports day moved to the eleventh month.

senseEn: highest in power or rank
en: Did the Supreme Court hear the appeal last spring?
zh: 最高法院去年春天审理了这次上诉吗？
transfer: 看历史展时问哪个机构当时拥有最高权力。
transferEn: Ask which institution held the highest authority in a historical period.

senseEn: a female deity in a belief system
en: Which Greek goddess is shown with an owl?
zh: 哪位希腊女神常与猫头鹰一起出现？
transfer: 在博物馆问壁画里的女神象征什么。
transferEn: Ask what the female deity in a museum mural represents.

senseEn: a powerful tropical storm
en: Was the old pier rebuilt after the hurricane?
zh: 老码头是飓风过后重建的吗？
transfer: 向导游询问海岸展览中哪张照片拍于飓风之后。
transferEn: Ask which coastal exhibit photo was taken after a powerful tropical storm.

senseEn: someone coming to see a place or person
en: Does each visitor need to sign in separately?
zh: 每位访客都要分别登记吗？
transfer: 问前台访客能否使用地下停车场。
transferEn: Ask reception whether guests may use the underground car park.

senseEn: having unlimited power
en: Does the hymn describe God as an almighty ruler?
zh: 这首赞美诗把上帝形容为全能的统治者吗？
transfer: 在文学课上讨论故事中的神明是否真的无所不能。
transferEn: Discuss whether a deity in a story actually has unlimited power.

senseEn: an illness caused by invading organisms
en: Does the note say an ear infection or just ear pain?
zh: 记录写的是耳部感染，还是只有耳痛？
transfer: 复诊时询问上次发现的感染是否已经消退。
transferEn: Ask at a follow-up whether the previously diagnosed illness has cleared.

senseEn: to come to an end or stop an activity
en: When will the factory cease production at this site?
zh: 工厂什么时候停止在这里生产？
transfer: 询问旧版软件何时停止提供更新。
transferEn: Ask when updates will stop for an old software version.

senseEn: a long structural support in a building
en: Is the wooden beam above the doorway original?
zh: 门上方那根木梁是原来的吗？
transfer: 看房时询问屋顶中哪根梁需要维修。
transferEn: Ask which roof support needs work during a house viewing.

senseEn: luckily or by good fortune
en: We missed the bus, but fortunately the ferry was running late.
zh: 我们错过了公交车，幸好渡轮晚点了。
transfer: 解释虽然丢了票，但幸好手机里有电子副本。
transferEn: Explain the good fortune of having a digital copy when a ticket went missing.

senseEn: an overlap that makes two plans incompatible
en: There's a scheduling conflict between the tour and my train.
zh: 导览时间和我坐火车的时间冲突。
transfer: 请同事帮忙解决两场面试的时间冲突。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to resolve an overlap between two interviews.

senseEn: most important or central
en: Is safety the primary concern with the new entrance?
zh: 对新入口而言，安全是最主要的考虑吗？
transfer: 问导师研究的主要目标是什么。
transferEn: Ask an adviser what the most important goal of the study is.

senseEn: the visual quality distinguishing red, blue and other hues
en: What colour is the lining of the grey coat?
zh: 灰色外套的衬里是什么颜色？
transfer: 在英国店铺询问能不能换一种颜色的灯罩。
transferEn: Ask a British shop about exchanging a lampshade for a different hue.

senseEn: a large heavy gun, especially one of historical interest
en: Is the bronze cannon outside the museum original or a replica?
zh: 博物馆外的青铜大炮是原物还是复制品？
transfer: 参观城堡展览时询问那门大炮的年代。
transferEn: Ask how old the displayed artillery piece is at a castle museum.

senseEn: an infectious illness caused by influenza viruses
en: Can I reschedule? I'm at home with the flu.
zh: 可以改期吗？我得了流感，正在家休息。
transfer: 请假时说明医生诊断的是流感。
transferEn: Explain that a clinician diagnosed influenza when requesting time off.

senseEn: a small shellfish often served as food
en: Does the noodle broth contain dried shrimp?
zh: 这碗面汤里有虾干吗？
transfer: 点炒饭时询问能否把虾换成蔬菜。
transferEn: Ask to replace the small shellfish in fried rice with vegetables.

senseEn: a hoofed animal whose males often grow antlers
en: We saw a deer beside the trail at dawn.
zh: 天刚亮时我们在步道旁看见了一只鹿。
transfer: 向护林员询问鹿通常什么时候来河边喝水。
transferEn: Ask a ranger when the antlered animals usually visit the river to drink.

senseEn: a place where people are buried
en: Is the old village cemetery open to visitors?
zh: 村里的老公墓对访客开放吗？
transfer: 向当地人询问去公墓正门怎么走。
transferEn: Ask a local for directions to the main entrance of the burial ground.

senseEn: in a way relating to sexual contact
en: Does the clinic offer screening for sexually transmitted infections?
zh: 诊所提供性传播感染的筛查吗？
transfer: 看健康宣传册时询问它所说的传播方式是否为性接触。
transferEn: Ask whether a health leaflet is referring to transmission through sexual contact.

senseEn: the science of substances and how they react
en: Is the chemistry lab open for the afternoon class?
zh: 化学实验室下午上课时开放吗？
transfer: 询问图书馆哪一层收藏化学教材。
transferEn: Ask a librarian where textbooks on substances and their reactions are kept.
