transferEn: Identify the body part that pumps blood on an anatomy model.

senseEn: to mark an option with a check
en: Should I tick both boxes if both dates work?
zh: 两个日期都行的话，我要把两个框都打勾吗？
transfer: 告诉同学如何在申请表上勾选无障碍座位。
transferEn: Tell a classmate how to mark the accessible-seating option on a form.

senseEn: legally or contractually responsible
en: Who's liable for damage during delivery under this contract?
zh: 按这份合同，送货途中受损由谁负责？
transfer: 签租约前询问租客是否承担共用走廊的维修责任。
transferEn: Ask who bears responsibility for shared hallway repairs before signing a lease.

senseEn: an outdoor area behind a house
en: Could we dry the chairs in the backyard?
zh: 我们能把椅子放在后院晾干吗？
transfer: 问房主后院有没有地方停自行车。
transferEn: Ask a homeowner whether the outdoor space behind the house has room for bikes.

senseEn: deserving respect for acting with integrity
en: Returning the prize money was an honorable decision.
zh: 退还奖金是个可敬的决定。
transfer: 说明为什么你尊敬一位主动承认失误的队友。
transferEn: Explain why you respect a teammate who owned up to a mistake.

senseEn: an informal name for a student residence
en: Is the dorm within walking distance of the labs?
zh: 宿舍离实验室近到能走过去吗？
transfer: 问学长宿舍里周末能否洗衣服。
transferEn: Ask an older student whether laundry is available at the residence on weekends.

senseEn: a precious stone used as decoration
en: Is the blue jewel in the clasp original?
zh: 搭扣上的蓝色宝石是原配的吗？
transfer: 在博物馆询问皇冠中央那颗宝石的产地。
transferEn: Ask where the precious stone at the center of a crown came from.

senseEn: a procedure or treatment that ends a pregnancy
en: Is confidential counseling available before an abortion?
zh: 人工流产前是否可以接受保密咨询？
transfer: 向诊所询问能否预约讨论人工流产后复诊安排。
transferEn: Ask a clinic about arranging a discussion of follow-up care after ending a pregnancy.

senseEn: shared or felt by both sides
en: Moving the rehearsal was a mutual decision.
zh: 排练改期是双方共同作出的决定。
transfer: 告诉朋友你们对彼此的信任是相互的。
transferEn: Tell a friend that the trust between you goes both ways.

senseEn: the quality of telling the truth
en: I appreciate your honesty about the missed deadline.
zh: 我很感谢你如实说出错过期限的情况。
transfer: 向孩子解释即使打碎杯子，说实话也值得肯定。
transferEn: Praise a child's truthfulness after a cup was broken.

senseEn: someone who repeatedly intimidates or mistreats others
en: Did the school speak to the bully after the report?
zh: 收到举报后，学校找那名霸凌者谈话了吗？
transfer: 讨论故事时指出哪个角色反复欺负新来的学生。
transferEn: Identify the character who repeatedly intimidates a new student in a story.

senseEn: a prepared talk sharing information with an audience
en: Can we download the slides after the presentation?
zh: 报告结束后能下载幻灯片吗？
transfer: 问同事客户演示要不要准备实物样品。
transferEn: Ask a colleague whether a client talk needs a physical sample.

senseEn: a gathering where people express shared support
en: Is the public rally taking place in the square?
zh: 公众集会是在广场上举行吗？
transfer: 问组织者支持图书馆的集会几点开始。
transferEn: Ask when the gathering in support of the library begins.

senseEn: a military group smaller than a company
en: Was her grandfather's platoon photograph taken before the voyage?
zh: 她祖父那张全排合照是在启航前拍的吗？
transfer: 参观历史展时询问日记作者属于哪个排。
transferEn: Ask which small military unit a diary writer belonged to in a history exhibit.

senseEn: happening once every year
en: Is the annual book fair moving indoors this year?
zh: 今年一年一度的书展要改到室内吗？
transfer: 问协会一年一度的会员大会何时举行。
transferEn: Ask when the association's once-a-year members' meeting takes place.

senseEn: to officially let someone know
en: Please notify the desk if you leave before sunrise.
zh: 如果日出前离开，请通知前台。
transfer: 报名后询问学校会怎样通知候补名额。
transferEn: Ask how a school will tell applicants that a waitlist place has opened.

senseEn: the quality of acting honestly and consistently
en: The award recognized her integrity in reporting the missing funds.
zh: 她如实报告资金缺失，这个奖表彰了她的正直。
transfer: 举例说明哪件小事让你相信一位同事的人品。
transferEn: Give an example that made you trust a colleague's honesty.

senseEn: made of wood
en: Can we use wooden spoons with this pan?
zh: 这口锅能用木勺吗？
transfer: 订家具前确认椅子是木制还是金属制。
transferEn: Check whether chairs are made of wood or metal before ordering.

senseEn: to depend on something or someone
en: Can we rely on the shuttle for the first flight?
zh: 搭最早航班时能指望接驳车吗？
transfer: 问组织者户外演出能否依靠备用电源。
transferEn: Ask whether an outdoor performance can depend on backup power.

senseEn: to arrange to have something held for later use
en: Can I reserve a table by the window for six?
zh: 我能订六点靠窗的桌子吗？
transfer: 向图书馆询问如何预订一间学习室。
transferEn: Ask how to book a study room at a library.

senseEn: a showing of how something works
en: Will the demonstration include cleaning the machine?
zh: 示范会包括如何清洁机器吗？
transfer: 请陶艺老师先示范如何给杯子装把手。
transferEn: Ask a pottery instructor to show how to attach a mug handle.

senseEn: a generous quantity of something good
en: Our neighbors shared the bounty of their plum tree with us.
zh: 邻居把自家李子树丰收的果实分给了我们。
transfer: 写便条感谢对方送来一大批菜园收成。
transferEn: Thank someone for sharing an abundant harvest from their garden.

senseEn: a lawyer presenting a criminal case for the state
en: Which witness will the prosecutor question next?
zh: 检察官接下来要询问哪位证人？
transfer: 讨论庭审报道时区分检察官和辩护律师的发言。
transferEn: Distinguish statements by the state's lawyer from those by the defense in a court report.

senseEn: the side of the face below the eye
en: There's a scratch on your left cheek.
zh: 你的左脸颊上有道划痕。
transfer: 给孩子擦脸时提醒他另一侧脸颊也有果酱。
transferEn: Tell a child there is jam on the other side of their face too.

senseEn: courteous and considerate toward others
en: Our host was gracious about the unexpected extra guest.
zh: 我们意外多带了一位客人，主人仍然亲切有礼。
transfer: 写信称赞获奖者如何彬彬有礼地感谢其他参赛者。
transferEn: Praise the winner's courteous thanks to the other contestants in a letter.

senseEn: traditional and shared within a community
en: Is that a folk song from your village?
zh: 那是你们村的民歌吗？
transfer: 在节庆活动上询问哪套服装用于当地民间舞。
transferEn: Ask which costume is worn for the local traditional dance at a festival.

senseEn: extremely fierce or violent
en: Did last night's savage storm damage the pier?
zh: 昨夜的猛烈风暴损坏码头了吗？
transfer: 根据旅行日记描述山谷里凶猛的阵风。
transferEn: Use a travel diary to describe fierce gusts in a valley.

senseEn: sometimes but not regularly
en: Does the ferry occasionally stop at the smaller island?
zh: 渡轮偶尔会在小岛停靠吗？
transfer: 告诉朋友你平时走路上班，偶尔骑车。
transferEn: Tell a friend you usually walk to work and only sometimes cycle.

senseEn: unnecessary noise or concern about something
en: Please don’t make a fuss about my birthday at work.
zh: 请别在办公室为我的生日大张旗鼓。
transfer: 告诉朋友晚餐只是随意聚聚，不必特意张罗。
transferEn: Tell a friend a casual supper needs no special fanfare.

senseEn: among members or parts of a group
en: Was your sketch amongst the entries chosen for display?
zh: 你的速写是入选展出的作品之一吗？
transfer: 描述你在一堆旧信里找到一张照片。
transferEn: Describe finding a photograph among old letters.

senseEn: the bony structure holding the teeth
en: Does your jaw hurt when you open your mouth?
zh: 张嘴时你的下颌疼吗？
transfer: 看牙时指出下颌哪一侧感觉紧。
transferEn: Tell a dentist which side of your lower face feels tight.

senseEn: a material with a particular composition
en: What substance formed on the glass after the water dried?
zh: 水干了以后，玻璃上形成的是什么物质？
transfer: 请老师指出清单中哪种物质会溶于水。
transferEn: Ask a teacher which material on a list will dissolve in water.

senseEn: a condition disrupting normal physical or mental functioning
en: Does the leaflet list the symptoms of a sleep disorder?
zh: 这张宣传页列出了睡眠障碍的症状吗？
transfer: 向医生询问哪家门诊专门看平衡障碍。
transferEn: Ask a doctor which clinic specializes in conditions affecting balance.

senseEn: uncertainty caused by unclear information
en: The two gate numbers caused some confusion. Which is right?
zh: 两个登机口号码让人有点糊涂，哪个才对？
transfer: 向组织者说明邮件日期不一致让报名者困惑。
transferEn: Explain that conflicting dates in emails left applicants unsure.

senseEn: to find how heavy something is
en: Could you weigh these pears before I choose a bag?
zh: 我选袋子前能先把这些梨称一下吗？
transfer: 寄包裹前请柜员称一下箱子。
transferEn: Ask a postal clerk to find the weight of a box before mailing it.

senseEn: a sweet soft dessert set with gelatin or a similar ingredient
en: Has the fruit jelly set enough to serve?
zh: 水果冻凝固到能上桌了吗？
transfer: 问聚会主人有没有不加明胶的果冻。
transferEn: Ask whether a host has a wobbly fruit dessert made without gelatin.

senseEn: a chart or system showing dates
en: Can you put the rehearsal on the shared calendar?
zh: 你能把排练记到共享日历上吗？
transfer: 核对墙上日历，告诉朋友这个月最后一个周五是哪天。
transferEn: Use a wall date chart to identify the last Friday of the month.

senseEn: a festive event with rides, costumes or public entertainment
en: Is admission to the school carnival free for families?
zh: 家人参加学校嘉年华要门票吗？
transfer: 问居民今年嘉年华游行在哪条街开始。
transferEn: Ask residents where this year's festive parade begins.

senseEn: unpleasantly severe or critical
en: Was my feedback too harsh for a first rehearsal?
zh: 对第一次排练来说，我的反馈是不是太严厉了？
transfer: 请朋友帮你把邮件中过于严厉的一句改得委婉些。
transferEn: Ask a friend to soften an overly severe sentence in an email.

senseEn: causing death
en: Does the memorial list everyone lost in the fatal accident?
zh: 纪念碑上列出了那起致命事故中所有遇难者吗？
transfer: 读老报纸时询问报道中的哪些事故造成了死亡。
transferEn: Ask which accidents in an old newspaper report resulted in deaths.

senseEn: unable to stop laughing or crying from strong emotion
en: We were hysterical with laughter when the puppet sneezed.
zh: 木偶一打喷嚏，我们笑得停不下来。
transfer: 描述一段家庭录像中大家为何笑得直不起腰。
transferEn: Describe why everyone in a family video found it impossible to stop laughing.

senseEn: a source of ideas or creative motivation
en: Was your grandmother's garden the inspiration for this painting?
zh: 这幅画的灵感来自你祖母的花园吗？
transfer: 问设计师那盏灯的造型灵感从何而来。
transferEn: Ask a designer what gave them the idea for a lamp's shape.

senseEn: in the middle of a size range
en: Do you have a medium jacket in this color?
zh: 这个颜色的夹克有中号吗？
transfer: 买饮料时说明你想要中杯。
transferEn: Ask for the middle cup size when buying a drink.

senseEn: in or relating to the north
en: Does the northern entrance open before the main gate?
zh: 北入口比大门开得早吗？
transfer: 告诉游客岛的北岸更适合看海鸟。
transferEn: Tell visitors the north side of an island is better for spotting seabirds.

senseEn: a vessel designed to travel underwater
en: Is the museum submarine open for tours this weekend?
zh: 博物馆的潜艇这个周末开放参观吗？
transfer: 询问展出的潜艇以前能容纳多少名船员。
transferEn: Ask how many crew members used to fit inside a displayed underwater vessel.

senseEn: to pull or carry a heavy load
en: Can we use the trolley to haul the boxes upstairs?
zh: 我们能用推车把箱子搬上楼吗？
transfer: 请邻居搭把手搬一袋沉重的土。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor to help move a heavy sack of soil.

senseEn: an injury from overstretching a muscle
en: Is this shoulder pain a muscle strain?
zh: 这种肩痛是肌肉劳损吗？
transfer: 向教练解释因背部拉伤要缺席训练。
transferEn: Explain to a coach that an overstretched back muscle will keep you from practice.

senseEn: a substance made of chemically bonded elements
en: Which compound formed when the two elements reacted?
zh: 这两种元素反应后形成了什么化合物？
transfer: 请老师说明为什么水是化合物而不是混合物。
transferEn: Ask why water counts as chemically bonded elements rather than a mixture.

senseEn: a sound word for a sudden impact
en: The comic says “Bam! The door shut” in huge letters.
zh: 漫画用大字写着“砰！门关上了”。
transfer: 给舞台剧描述箱子落地的突然巨响。
transferEn: Imitate the sudden noise of a box hitting the floor in a stage story.

senseEn: a long narrow elevated crest
en: Does the path follow the ridge all the way to camp?
zh: 这条路一直沿山脊通到营地吗？
transfer: 问向导从哪段山脊能看见两个山谷。
transferEn: Ask which high crest offers a view into both valleys.

senseEn: to leave something open to contact with a condition
en: Will this window expose the fabric to direct sun?
zh: 这扇窗会让布料受到阳光直射吗？
transfer: 问档案员照片能不能长时间暴露在灯光下。
transferEn: Ask an archivist whether photos can be left under lights for long.

senseEn: an exclamation of sudden realization
en: Aha, that's why the map looked upside down!
zh: 啊哈，怪不得地图看起来是倒的！
transfer: 解开拼图后，用感叹词表达你突然明白了。
transferEn: Express a sudden realization after solving a puzzle.

senseEn: relating to Europe
en: Does the pass cover European trains outside the capital cities?
zh: 这张通票涵盖欧洲各国首都以外的火车吗？
transfer: 问导游这座市场里有哪些欧洲传统食品。
transferEn: Ask which traditional foods in a market come from Europe.

senseEn: a joke or comic device in a performance
en: Was the falling hat a planned gag or an accident?
zh: 帽子掉下来是设计好的笑料还是意外？
transfer: 和朋友讨论喜剧片里重复出现的笑料。
transferEn: Discuss a recurring comic joke in a film with a friend.

senseEn: a structure honoring someone or an event
en: Who designed the memorial in the station garden?
zh: 车站花园里的纪念碑是谁设计的？
transfer: 问当地居民纪念物上的名字属于哪些人。
transferEn: Ask local residents whose names appear on a commemorative structure.

senseEn: a part of an economy or field of activity
en: Do graduates usually enter the public sector after this course?
zh: 这门课程的毕业生通常进入公共部门吗？
transfer: 询问哪类行业最常使用这些翻译服务。
transferEn: Ask which part of the economy uses these translation services most.

senseEn: a group of animals moving or living together
en: Wait for the herd to cross before opening the gate.
zh: 等兽群过去，再开大门。
transfer: 向向导询问山谷里看到的是不是同一群鹿。
transferEn: Ask a guide whether the deer in the valley belong to one group.

senseEn: relating to the former Soviet Union
en: Is this Soviet poster from the space exhibition?
zh: 这张苏联海报来自航天展吗？
transfer: 在历史图集中问哪张地图显示的是苏联时期的边界。
transferEn: Ask which historical map shows borders during the USSR era.

senseEn: in the present period
en: Do people still dry fish here nowadays, or only for visitors?
zh: 如今人们还在这里晒鱼吗，还是只给游客演示？
transfer: 问祖父以前的售票亭如今有什么用途。
transferEn: Ask what an old ticket booth is used for these days.

senseEn: valued chiefly for the feelings or memories it evokes
en: The watch has sentimental value; it was my mother's.
zh: 这块表对我有纪念意义，它以前是我母亲的。
transfer: 解释为什么你不想卖掉一件并不值钱的旧家具。
transferEn: Explain the emotional attachment that keeps you from selling inexpensive old furniture.

senseEn: the sustained effort to achieve something
en: Did she travel alone in pursuit of a music career?
zh: 她是为了追求音乐事业而独自旅行的吗？
transfer: 向朋友解释一位研究者为追求知识作出的选择。
transferEn: Discuss a researcher's choices in seeking knowledge.

senseEn: a result that an effort aims to achieve
en: What's the main objective of Friday's workshop?
zh: 周五工作坊的主要目标是什么？
transfer: 给志愿者说明这次清理活动要达到的目标。
transferEn: Tell volunteers what the cleanup aims to accomplish.

senseEn: older in relation to another family member
en: Does your elder sister live near the school?
zh: 你姐姐住在学校附近吗？
transfer: 介绍合照时指出兄弟二人中年长的那位。
transferEn: Identify the older of two brothers in a family photograph.

senseEn: demanding close compliance with rules or limits
en: Is there a strict limit on the essay length?
zh: 文章字数有限制得很严吗？
transfer: 问营地是否严格规定熄灯时间。
transferEn: Ask how firmly the camp enforces its lights-out time.

senseEn: to express pleasure at someone's good news or success
en: Could you congratulate Maya on the award for me?
zh: 能替我祝贺玛雅获奖吗？
transfer: 给刚开店的朋友写条祝贺消息。
transferEn: Message a friend with good wishes on opening a shop.

senseEn: having little width
en: Can the van fit through the narrow gate?
zh: 面包车能通过这道窄门吗？
transfer: 向访客说明上楼的楼梯很窄。
transferEn: Warn a visitor about the limited width of the staircase.

senseEn: an agreement involving concessions on both sides
en: Would Friday afternoon be a fair compromise for both teams?
zh: 周五下午对两组来说是个公平的折中方案吗？
transfer: 和室友为客厅的温度协商一个折中办法。
transferEn: Suggest a middle ground for the living-room temperature.

senseEn: the distance from one end to the other
en: What's the length of the curtain rail above the bed?
zh: 床上方的窗帘杆有多长？
transfer: 买桌布前确认桌面的长度。
transferEn: Check the end-to-end size of a table before buying a cloth.

senseEn: a sharp, burning pain
en: Did you feel a brief sting when the plaster came off?
zh: 撕掉创可贴时你有没有短暂的刺痛感？
transfer: 向护士描述洗伤口时有多刺痛。
transferEn: Describe the sharp sensation when a wound was washed.

senseEn: a flexible insulated cable carrying electric power
en: Is the lamp's power cord long enough to reach the outlet?
zh: 灯的电源线够长，能接到插座吗？
transfer: 问维修员能否更换磨损的熨斗电线。
transferEn: Ask whether a worn iron cable can be replaced.

senseEn: someone legally responsible for another person's care
en: Does the school need a guardian's signature for the trip?
zh: 这次校外活动需要监护人签字吗？
transfer: 在报名表上核实紧急联系人是否也必须是监护人。
transferEn: Check whether the emergency contact must also be legally responsible for a child.

senseEn: the offspring of a mare and a male donkey
en: Is the mule carrying our bags all the way to the lodge?
zh: 这头骡子会一直驮着我们的包走到旅舍吗？
transfer: 在农场问骡子与驴的区别。
transferEn: Ask how the horse–donkey cross at a farm differs from a donkey.

senseEn: in a way that is pleasing to the senses
en: You sang beautifully tonight, especially in the final verse.
zh: 你今晚唱得真优美，尤其是最后一段。
transfer: 告诉朋友窗边的花束布置得很漂亮。
transferEn: Compliment the pleasing arrangement of flowers by a window.

senseEn: to state a formal answer to a criminal charge
en: Did the character plead guilty in the final courtroom scene?
zh: 最后一场庭审戏里那个角色认罪了吗？
transfer: 讨论纪录片中被告何时正式表示不认罪。
transferEn: Discuss when the defendant formally denied the charge in a documentary.

senseEn: a document sent by transmitting a scanned image over a phone line
en: Can the clinic accept a fax from my old doctor?
zh: 诊所能接收我原来医生发来的传真吗？
transfer: 向档案馆询问有签名的传真件是否有效。
transferEn: Ask whether the archive accepts a signed copy sent over a phone line.

senseEn: sad from lack of company
en: The house feels rather lonesome since our guests left.
zh: 客人走了以后，家里觉得有点冷清。
transfer: 写信给朋友，说你搬到新城后有些孤单。
transferEn: Tell a friend you miss company after moving to a new town.

senseEn: working without manual control
en: Can I turn off automatic renewal before the trial ends?
zh: 试用结束前能关闭自动续订吗？
transfer: 问摄影老师怎样关闭相机的自动对焦。
transferEn: Ask how to disable a camera's self-adjusting focus.

senseEn: leaves prepared for smoking or related uses
en: Does the museum display old tobacco tins from this factory?
zh: 博物馆有没有展示这家工厂旧时的烟草罐？
transfer: 在历史展上询问哪种作物曾用于制作卷烟。
transferEn: Ask which crop in a historical display was once grown for cigarettes.

senseEn: a feeling of pleasure at a result
en: Finishing the repairs gave me real satisfaction.
zh: 把维修都做完让我很有满足感。
transfer: 描述你独立做成第一顿晚餐后的满足。
transferEn: Describe how pleased you felt after cooking a whole dinner on your own.

senseEn: at the beginning, before later changes
en: Was this station originally built for coal trains?
zh: 这座车站最初是为运煤列车建的吗？
transfer: 询问展览原定在哪里举办。
transferEn: Ask where an exhibition was first planned to take place.

senseEn: marked by a close personal bond
en: Were the two painters intimate friends before they collaborated?
zh: 这两位画家合作前就是亲密朋友吗？
transfer: 讨论传记时描述作家与姐姐之间的亲密关系。
transferEn: Describe the close personal bond between a writer and her sister.

senseEn: a horizontal surface used for storing things
en: Can the top shelf hold these dictionaries?
zh: 顶层架板能放这些词典吗？
transfer: 问室友该把干净毛巾放到哪层架子上。
transferEn: Ask a roommate which storage ledge is for clean towels.

senseEn: a woman belonging to a religious order
en: Was the school founded by a nun from the nearby convent?
zh: 这所学校是附近修道院的一位修女创办的吗？
transfer: 在历史照片中指出哪位修女曾经是校长。
transferEn: Identify the woman from a religious order who served as headteacher in a historical photo.

senseEn: to withstand difficult conditions
en: Can these plants tolerate frost on the balcony?
zh: 这些植物在阳台上能耐霜冻吗？
transfer: 问店员木制餐盘能否耐受洗碗机高温。
transferEn: Ask whether wooden plates withstand the dishwasher's heat.

senseEn: in terms of feelings rather than physical state
en: The interview was emotionally draining for both sisters.
zh: 这次采访让姐妹俩在情绪上都很疲惫。
transfer: 说明朋友的陪伴如何在情感上支持了你。
transferEn: Describe how a friend's company supported your feelings during a hard time.

senseEn: hard to notice immediately
en: Can you hear the subtle difference between the two recordings?
zh: 你听得出这两段录音之间的细微差别吗？
transfer: 向设计师指出布料样品颜色上的微妙差别。
transferEn: Point out a slight difference between two fabric colors.

senseEn: people living together as one domestic unit
en: Does each household receive its own recycling bin?
zh: 每户人家都会分到单独的回收桶吗？
transfer: 向管理员确认水费是按户还是按人数收。
transferEn: Ask whether the water fee is charged per home or per person.

senseEn: the loudness of sound
en: Could you turn the volume down during the announcement?
zh: 广播通知时你能把音量调低吗？
transfer: 问老师坐在最后一排能否听清目前的音量。
transferEn: Ask whether the current loudness is adequate for the back row.

senseEn: fatty or oily residue
en: What gets the grease off this oven tray?
zh: 怎样才能去掉这个烤盘上的油污？
transfer: 洗工作服前问怎样清掉裤脚上的油渍。
transferEn: Ask how to remove oily residue from work trousers before laundering them.

senseEn: a small piece of jewelry fastened close to the ear
en: I lost one silver stud near the changing room.
zh: 我在试衣间附近丢了一只银耳钉。
transfer: 问珠宝商这副耳钉有没有更短一点的针。
transferEn: Ask a jeweler whether this pair of small post earrings comes with shorter posts.

senseEn: a regular activity done for enjoyment
en: Was photography a hobby before it became your job?
zh: 摄影在成为你的工作之前是你的爱好吗？
transfer: 相亲自我介绍时谈谈你花时间最多的爱好。
transferEn: Introduce the leisure activity you spend most time on when meeting a date.

senseEn: light reflected from the moon
en: Can we see the lake by moonlight from the terrace?
zh: 我们在露台上能看到月光下的湖吗？
transfer: 描述夜游时月光怎样映在雪地上。
transferEn: Describe the light from the moon on the snow during a night walk.

senseEn: one major division of an academic year
en: Can I take the lab course next semester?
zh: 我能下学期再上这门实验课吗？
transfer: 向教务处询问春季学期结束时间。
transferEn: Ask the academic office when the spring teaching term ends.

sense: 对某领域着迷的人（口语）
senseEn: an informal term for an enthusiast, sometimes teasing
en: As a map geek, I'd love to see the old atlas room.
zh: 我对地图特别着迷，很想参观旧地图集陈列室。
transfer: 向同好幽默地介绍自己对火车时刻表的痴迷。
transferEn: Playfully introduce yourself to fellow enthusiasts as someone fascinated by train schedules.

senseEn: someone addressing an audience
en: Will the guest speaker take questions after lunch?
zh: 午饭后嘉宾讲者会接受提问吗？
transfer: 向主持人核实第二位讲者的姓名。
transferEn: Confirm the name of the second presenter with a host.

en: Does the resort have a shuttle from the airport?
zh: 度假村有从机场出发的接驳车吗？
transfer: 订房时询问度假村有没有儿童泳池。
senseEn: a vacation property with guest facilities
transferEn: Ask whether the vacation property has a children's pool.

senseEn: an offensive label implying sexually unacceptable behavior
en: The moderator removed the insult “pervert” from the comments.
zh: 版主从评论里删除了“性变态”这一辱骂用语。
transfer: 在审核培训中解释为什么不能把这个辱称当作事实描述。
transferEn: Explain in moderation training why this sexual insult is inappropriate as a factual description.

senseEn: a traditional story explaining a belief or natural event
en: Which ancient myth explains the seasons in this painting?
zh: 这幅画引用哪个古代神话来解释四季？
transfer: 请图书管理员推荐一个关于月亮起源的神话。
transferEn: Ask a librarian for a traditional story about the moon's origin.

senseEn: a structure sending water into the air
en: Meet us beside the fountain in the main square.
zh: 在主广场的喷泉旁和我们碰面。
transfer: 询问公园里那座音乐喷泉什么时候开始喷水。
transferEn: Ask when the musical water feature in a park starts playing.

senseEn: a shellfish with claws and a broad shell
en: Does the soup contain real crab or imitation seafood?
zh: 汤里用的是真蟹肉还是仿制海鲜？
transfer: 去海产摊位问今天的螃蟹是否按重量卖。
transferEn: Ask a seafood stall whether today's clawed shellfish are sold by weight.

senseEn: a casual written representation of yes
en: The message reads, “Yah, I'll come after class.”
zh: 消息写着：“嗯，我下课后来。”
transfer: 和同学讨论聊天记录里哪个随意的词表示同意。
transferEn: Identify the informal affirmative in a classmate's chat transcript.

senseEn: at the present time
en: Is the photo archive currently open to researchers?
zh: 照片档案馆目前对研究人员开放吗？
transfer: 告诉访客儿童区目前正在整修。
transferEn: Tell visitors the children's area is under renovation at present.

senseEn: within a single country
en: Do domestic flights leave from this building?
zh: 国内航班从这栋楼出发吗？
transfer: 问快递柜台国内包裹是否需要单独的表格。
transferEn: Ask whether parcels staying within the country need a separate form.

senseEn: a person aged thirteen to nineteen
en: Can a teenager volunteer here with a parent's permission?
zh: 青少年经父母同意可以在这里做志愿者吗？
transfer: 咨询青少年营对十四岁孩子的住宿安排。
transferEn: Ask how a camp houses a fourteen-year-old participant.

senseEn: the attractive force pulling objects toward a mass
en: Does lower gravity explain the astronauts' long hops?
zh: 宇航员一跳那么远是因为重力较弱吗？
transfer: 问老师为什么月球上的重力比地球小。
transferEn: Ask why objects weigh less on the moon than on Earth.

senseEn: a tag identifying or describing a product
en: Does the label say this coat can be machine-washed?
zh: 标签上说这件外套能机洗吗？
transfer: 买果汁时请同伴看标签上的含糖量。
transferEn: Ask a companion to check the sugar content on a juice container's information tag.

senseEn: a tool used to shave hair
en: Does this electric razor work while charging?
zh: 这款电动剃须刀充电时可以用吗？
transfer: 旅行前询问酒店是否提供一次性剃须刀。
transferEn: Ask whether disposable shaving tools are available at a hotel.

senseEn: a serious promise to give or do something
en: Did the sponsor honor its pledge to fund the new benches?
zh: 赞助方兑现出资安装新长椅的承诺了吗？
transfer: 在募捐晚会后确认对方承诺的捐赠金额。
transferEn: Confirm the amount a donor promised after a fundraising evening.

senseEn: a metal fastener fitted with a nut
en: Is this bolt long enough to hold the shelf bracket?
zh: 这颗螺栓够长，能固定搁板托架吗？
transfer: 装床架时向五金店询问要用哪种螺栓。
transferEn: Ask which threaded fastener fits a bed frame.

senseEn: a formal vote in favor
en: Did the clerk record your vote as a yea?
zh: 书记员把你的票记为赞成了吗？
transfer: 读会议记录时核对有几票赞成。
transferEn: Check the count of affirmative votes in formal meeting minutes.

senseEn: strongly interested and willing
en: I'm eager to see how the repaired clock works.
zh: 我很想看看修好的钟运转起来怎么样。
transfer: 在面试中表达你很想学习新技能。
transferEn: Tell an interviewer how keen you are to learn a new skill.

senseEn: untidy or disorganized
en: Sorry about the messy counter; we're sorting the recycling.
zh: 台面有些乱，我们正在给回收物分类。
transfer: 请室友帮忙整理凌乱的工具箱。
transferEn: Ask a roommate to help organize an untidy toolbox.

senseEn: relating to the years from thirteen to nineteen
en: Is this from your teenage years in Brighton?
zh: 这是你在布赖顿度过青少年时期时留下的吗？
transfer: 采访祖母时问她少女时代最爱什么音乐。
transferEn: Ask your grandmother what music she liked during adolescence.

senseEn: smooth and slippery
en: Watch your step on the slick tiles near the pool.
zh: 小心泳池旁湿滑的地砖。
transfer: 提醒朋友雨后的木桥很滑。
transferEn: Warn a friend that the wooden bridge is slippery after rain.

senseEn: in position number eight
en: Our table is the eighth one on the left.
zh: 我们的桌子在左边数第八张。
transfer: 打电话确认八号是否是课程的最后一天。
transferEn: Confirm whether the day after the seventh is the final day of a course.

senseEn: to send goods to a destination
en: Can you dispatch the parcel before the office closes?
zh: 办公室下班前能把包裹寄出吗？
transfer: 问店家现货订单通常什么时候发出。
transferEn: Ask a shop when it normally sends out orders for stocked items.

senseEn: using digital or electrical technology
en: Will the venue accept an electronic ticket on my phone?
zh: 场馆接受手机上的电子票吗？
transfer: 问人事部门能否用电子签名签表格。
transferEn: Ask HR whether a digitally made signature is accepted on a form.

senseEn: deep sadness after loss or disappointment
en: The letter expressed deep sorrow at the loss of the orchard.
zh: 信中表达了对果园被毁的深切悲伤。
transfer: 给朋友写信，表达听到老邻居去世后的悲痛。
transferEn: Write to a friend about your sadness at an old neighbor's death.

senseEn: a sale to remove remaining stock
en: Are clearance items eligible for exchange?
zh: 清仓商品可以换货吗？
transfer: 问店员清仓价是否也适用于陈列样品。
transferEn: Ask whether stock-reduction prices apply to display pieces.

senseEn: a casual word for food
en: Where can we get some chow before the game?
zh: 开赛前我们能去哪儿吃点东西？
transfer: 随口问朋友徒步时带了什么吃的。
transferEn: Casually ask what food a friend packed for a hike.

sense: 针对同性恋者的极冒犯性辱称
senseEn: a highly offensive anti-gay slur
en: The moderator deleted the slur “faggot” and documented the abuse.
zh: 版主删掉了针对同性恋者的辱称，并记录了这次辱骂。
transfer: 面向编辑说明为什么不能用这个词指代同性恋者。
transferEn: Explain to an editor why this anti-gay slur is unacceptable as a label for people.

senseEn: a member of Germany's historical National Socialist party
en: Was the official identified as a Nazi in the original archive?
zh: 原始档案里有把那名官员列为纳粹党员吗？
transfer: 参观历史展时核对展签描述的是党籍还是政府职位。
transferEn: Check whether a historical exhibit label describes party membership or an official post.

senseEn: a sound reflected back after being made
en: Can you hear the echo under this bridge?
zh: 你能听到桥下的回声吗？
transfer: 参观音乐厅时询问怎样消除后排回声。
transferEn: Ask how reflected sound at the back of a concert hall was reduced.

senseEn: an extremely vulgar and offensive gendered insult
en: The style guide flags the slur “cunt” as extremely offensive.
zh: 文风指南把这个性别辱称标为极具冒犯性。
transfer: 审阅采访字幕时说明为什么该词绝不能当作中性人物描述。
transferEn: Explain why an extremely vulgar gendered slur in subtitles cannot serve as a neutral description.

senseEn: a tool that holds things tightly in place
en: Will this clamp hold the frame until the glue dries?
zh: 这只夹具能把框架固定到胶干吗？
transfer: 制作书挡时向工具室借一个能夹住木板的夹具。
transferEn: Borrow a tool to hold boards in place while making bookends.

senseEn: regular work keeping equipment in good condition
en: Is lift maintenance scheduled for Monday morning?
zh: 电梯保养安排在周一早上吗？
transfer: 租房前确认锅炉保养由谁负责。
transferEn: Ask who handles routine boiler upkeep before renting.

senseEn: a large drinking cup with a handle
en: Could I have a mug of hot water for my tea?
zh: 能给我一马克杯热水泡茶吗？
transfer: 在陶器店问这只带把大杯能不能进洗碗机。
transferEn: Ask whether a large handled cup at a pottery shop can go in the dishwasher.

senseEn: a tool with a broad blade for lifting soil or snow
en: Where's the snow shovel for clearing the steps?
zh: 清台阶用的雪铲放在哪儿？
transfer: 种树时问邻居能否借一把铲土的工具。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor for a tool to lift soil while planting a tree.

senseEn: an edible seed from a legume
en: Is this bean soup made with white beans or lentils?
zh: 这道豆汤用的是白豆还是扁豆？
transfer: 问店家哪种豆适合做凉拌沙拉。
transferEn: Ask a grocer which edible pulse is best for a cold salad.

senseEn: an urgent heartfelt request
en: Did the council respond to the residents' plea for a crossing?
zh: 市议会回应居民增设人行横道的恳求了吗？
transfer: 写读后感时转述主人公对朋友留下来帮忙的恳求。
transferEn: Describe the protagonist's urgent request for a friend to stay and help.

sense: 小矮子（可能伤人的绰号）
senseEn: a nickname for a short person that can be belittling
en: He asked the team to stop calling him “Shorty” at practice.
zh: 他让队友训练时别再叫他“小矮子”。
transfer: 讨论同伴交往时解释为什么以身高取绰号可能伤人。
transferEn: Explain why a nickname based on someone's short stature may hurt.

senseEn: the physical parts of a computer or device
en: Will this update work on older hardware?
zh: 这次更新能在较旧的硬件上运行吗？
transfer: 报修时问问题出在软件还是硬件。
transferEn: Ask whether a repair problem concerns the program or the device's physical parts.

senseEn: a place or feature visitors come to see
en: Which local attraction opens earliest on Sunday?
zh: 哪个当地景点周日开得最早？
transfer: 问导游雨天哪处室内景点适合带孩子去。
transferEn: Ask a guide about an indoor place of interest for children on a rainy day.

senseEn: showing practical good judgment
en: Would it be sensible to book a later train?
zh: 订一班晚点的车会更稳妥吗？
transfer: 讨论预算时指出哪项开支最合理。
transferEn: Explain which expense shows the best practical judgment when discussing a budget.

senseEn: an insulting term for a foolish or inconsiderate person
en: The presenter apologized for calling the guest a jackass.
zh: 主持人为用“蠢驴”这个辱称骂嘉宾道了歉。
transfer: 在编辑讨论中指出访谈里哪句话贬低了对方。
transferEn: Identify the insult that belittled a guest in an interview.

senseEn: awake and aware of one's surroundings
en: Was she fully conscious when the nurse arrived?
zh: 护士到时她完全清醒吗？
transfer: 向医生说明跌倒之后你始终清醒。
transferEn: Tell a doctor you remained aware after a fall.

senseEn: to hold a position for an image
en: Could the family pose by the old gate for a photograph?
zh: 一家人能站到老门旁摆个姿势合影吗？
transfer: 素描课上请模特侧身摆姿势。
transferEn: Ask a model to hold a sideways position for a drawing class.

senseEn: a person one works with
en: Could my colleague join the call to explain the figures?
zh: 能让我同事加入通话解释数据吗？
transfer: 给客户介绍接替你处理订单的同事。
transferEn: Introduce the person at work who will take over a customer's order.

senseEn: an informal name used instead of a formal one
en: Is “Pip” your nickname or the name on your badge?
zh: “皮普”是你的昵称还是胸牌上的名字？
transfer: 问新同学希望用本名还是昵称来称呼。
transferEn: Ask a new classmate whether they prefer a formal or familiar name.

senseEn: worry or unease about what might happen
en: Did seeing the room beforehand ease your anxiety?
zh: 事先看过房间有没有缓解你的焦虑？
transfer: 向老师描述上台前你担心的具体事情。
transferEn: Describe the worry you feel before going on stage to a teacher.

senseEn: a route that returns to its starting point
en: Does the bus run a loop around the lake?
zh: 公交车是绕湖一圈回到原处吗？
transfer: 规划步行路线时问能否绕一圈回到游客中心。
transferEn: Plan a circular walk ending back at the visitor center.

senseEn: from or relating to Africa
en: Which African countries are represented at the film festival?
zh: 本届电影节有哪些非洲国家参展？
transfer: 问策展人展出的面具来自哪个非洲地区。
transferEn: Ask which region of Africa a mask in an exhibition comes from.

senseEn: the act of stealing property
en: Where do I report the theft of a bicycle?
zh: 自行车被盗应该去哪里报案？
transfer: 问保险公司理赔时需要哪些失窃证明。
transferEn: Ask an insurer what evidence is needed after something is stolen.

senseEn: a duty one is expected or required to fulfill
en: Are we under any obligation to renew the agreement?
zh: 我们有义务续约吗？
transfer: 报名志愿者活动前确认参加培训是否是义务。
transferEn: Check whether attendance at training is a duty before joining as a volunteer.

senseEn: informal shorthand for psychology
en: Is the psych lecture in the science building today?
zh: 今天的心理学讲座在理科楼吗？
transfer: 向同学随口打听心理学导论课是哪位老师教。
transferEn: Casually ask who teaches the introductory psychology course.

senseEn: someone paid to apply paint to surfaces
en: Will the painter cover the sofa before starting?
zh: 油漆工开工前会把沙发盖好吗？
transfer: 问房东油漆工什么时候来刷门。
transferEn: Ask a landlord when the professional painting the door will arrive.

senseEn: a drawing in which winners are chosen by chance
en: Is entry to the ticket lottery free?
zh: 参加门票抽签要钱吗？
transfer: 问学校演出多余的座位是否通过抽签分配。
transferEn: Ask whether spare school show seats are allocated by a random draw.

senseEn: relating to the mind or emotions
en: Does the clinic offer psychological support after an accident?
zh: 诊所提供事故后的心理支持吗？
transfer: 询问长时间住院可能给孩子带来哪些心理影响。
transferEn: Ask how a long hospital stay might affect a child's emotions.

senseEn: a short private road leading to a building
en: Please don't block the driveway when the van arrives.
zh: 货车到时请不要堵住通往房子的车道。
transfer: 问房东车道上能否并排停两辆车。
transferEn: Ask whether the private approach to a rental house fits two cars side by side.

senseEn: to try to attract or win someone over
en: How will the market woo shoppers on rainy weekends?
zh: 市集打算怎样在下雨的周末吸引顾客？
transfer: 向团队介绍如何争取以前没关注过展览的观众。
transferEn: Explain how to attract visitors who have never taken an interest in the exhibition.

senseEn: not often
en: We rarely see seals this close to the pier.
zh: 我们很少在离码头这么近的地方看到海豹。
transfer: 跟朋友说自己工作日很少在外面吃早餐。
transferEn: Tell a friend you seldom eat breakfast out on weekdays.

senseEn: with firm conviction or great intensity
en: The residents strongly support keeping the trees.
zh: 居民们强烈支持保留这些树。
transfer: 在会议上坚定表达你支持增加无障碍入口。
transferEn: Express firm support at a meeting for adding an accessible entrance.

senseEn: intended to be kept private
en: Is this confidential report safe to share with the client?
zh: 这份保密报告可以发给客户吗？
transfer: 在咨询开始前确认谈话会不会保密。
transferEn: Before a consultation, check whether the conversation stays private.

senseEn: the reasoning connecting ideas or decisions
en: What's the logic behind numbering the seats this way?
zh: 座位这样编号的逻辑是什么？
transfer: 向同事解释排班优先顺序背后的道理。
transferEn: Explain the reasoning behind shift priorities to a coworker.

senseEn: to discuss terms in order to reach an agreement
en: Can we negotiate a later deadline before we sign?
zh: 签字前能协商一下延后的截止日期吗？
transfer: 租办公室时询问租金能不能商量。
transferEn: Ask whether the rent is open for discussion when leasing an office.

senseEn: using an internet connection
en: Can I renew my library card online this time?
zh: 我这次能在网上续办借书证吗？
transfer: 问学校家长会是线上还是到校参加。
transferEn: Ask whether a parents' meeting takes place over the internet or on-site.

senseEn: a large celebratory meal
en: Who cooked the wedding feast for all those guests?
zh: 是谁为这么多宾客做了婚宴？
transfer: 为丰收节安排一顿丰盛的大餐，问邻居能带哪道菜。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor to contribute a dish to a large harvest celebration meal.

senseEn: a soft porous pad used for cleaning
en: Use a soft sponge on the painted surface.
zh: 请用软海绵擦油漆表面。
transfer: 清洁鱼缸前问哪块海绵没有碰过洗洁精。
transferEn: Ask which porous cleaning pad has not been used with detergent.

senseEn: a person who delivers religious sermons
en: Is the visiting preacher speaking at both services?
zh: 来访的讲道者两场礼拜都发言吗？
transfer: 研究历史录音时询问布道的是哪位讲道人。
transferEn: Ask who delivered the sermon on a historical recording.

senseEn: a Jewish religious teacher or leader
en: Will the rabbi answer visitors' questions after the service?
zh: 礼拜后拉比会回答访客的问题吗？
transfer: 安排犹太会堂导览时询问是否能向拉比请教节日传统。
transferEn: Ask whether a synagogue's religious leader can explain holiday traditions during a tour.

senseEn: the first month of the year
en: Do lessons start in January or after the winter break?
zh: 课程一月就开，还是要等寒假结束？
transfer: 订房时确认新年一月份的价格。
transferEn: Check the rate for the first month of the new year when booking a room.

senseEn: a two-bladed cutting tool
en: Can I borrow the kitchen scissors to open this packet?
zh: 我能借厨房剪刀剪开这个包装吗？
transfer: 做手工时问老师哪把剪刀适合剪布。
transferEn: Ask which two-bladed tool in craft class is suitable for fabric.

senseEn: a place offering lodging, often in the countryside
en: Does the mountain lodge provide bedding?
zh: 山间旅舍提供床上用品吗？
transfer: 问向导步行到湖边旅舍要多久。
transferEn: Ask a guide how long it takes to walk to the lakeside guesthouse.

senseEn: a formal, binding promise or agreement
en: Does the old deed mention a covenant about keeping the garden open?
zh: 旧契据提到了让花园保持开放的正式约定吗？
transfer: 在历史课中请老师解释两方当时订立了什么盟约。
transferEn: Ask a history teacher what formal promise two sides made to each other.

senseEn: a closed path through which electric current flows
en: Does the model light up when the circuit is complete?
zh: 电路接通后模型会亮起来吗？
transfer: 在科学展上指出控制风扇的电路。
transferEn: Identify the current path controlling a fan at a science exhibit.

senseEn: a long or high jump
en: Was the final leap in the dance meant to look effortless?
zh: 舞蹈最后那个跳跃是要显得毫不费力吗？
transfer: 看回放时指出运动员腾空一跃的时刻。
transferEn: Point out the athlete's long jump in a replay.

senseEn: the international association known as the Commonwealth of Nations
en: Which Commonwealth countries took part in the games that year?
zh: 那年的运动会有哪些英联邦国家参加？
transfer: 遇到展签上的“英联邦”时询问哪些成员来自加勒比地区。
transferEn: Ask which members of this association of nations are in the Caribbean.

senseEn: to strongly encourage someone to act
en: Can we urge the council to fix the crossing before term starts?
zh: 我们能敦促市议会在开学前修好人行横道吗？
transfer: 写信呼吁主办方给家长更多通知时间。
transferEn: Write to strongly encourage organizers to give parents more notice.

senseEn: the act of making sure rules are followed
en: Who handles parking enforcement on market days?
zh: 集市日由谁负责执行停车规定？
transfer: 问工作人员如何落实公园的禁烟规定。
transferEn: Ask how staff ensure the park's no-smoking rule is followed.

senseEn: a huge system of stars held together by gravity
en: Can this telescope show a galaxy beyond the Milky Way?
zh: 这台望远镜看得到银河系以外的星系吗？
transfer: 听天文讲座时问照片里哪个星系离我们最近。
transferEn: Ask which system of stars in an astronomy photo is nearest to us.

senseEn: to hold a different opinion
en: I disagree with the estimate. Can we check the figures together?
zh: 我不同意这个估算。能一起核对数据吗？
transfer: 讨论路线时礼貌表示你和同伴的看法不同。
transferEn: Politely express a different view of a suggested travel route.

senseEn: seeming to continue without an end
en: How did you stay patient during the endless wait?
zh: 等了那么久，你怎么还能保持耐心？
transfer: 描述雨天迟迟不来的公交车让时间显得多么漫长。
transferEn: Describe how never-ending the wait for a rainy-day bus seemed.

senseEn: unsuitable for the situation
en: Would jeans be inappropriate for the awards dinner?
zh: 穿牛仔裤参加颁奖晚宴会不合适吗？
transfer: 编辑校刊时说明某张照片为什么不适合刊登。
transferEn: Explain why a photo may be unsuitable for a school magazine.

senseEn: wanting more than one's fair share
en: Would taking the last two slices look a bit greedy?
zh: 把最后两片都拿走会不会显得有点贪心？
transfer: 读寓言时说明主人公哪个决定体现了贪心。
transferEn: Identify the character's decision to take more than their share in a fable.

senseEn: a substance made of atoms of one kind
en: Which element has the chemical symbol Fe?
zh: 哪种元素的化学符号是 Fe？
transfer: 请同学在周期表上找出氧元素。
transferEn: Ask a classmate to locate oxygen on a periodic table.

senseEn: one of the light structures covering a bird
en: Is this feather from the owl we saw yesterday?
zh: 这根羽毛是昨天看到的猫头鹰掉的吗？
transfer: 问向导为什么有些鸟的羽毛能防水。
transferEn: Ask why some birds' outer coverings repel water.

senseEn: a small round mark
en: Does the blue dot show our current position?
zh: 蓝点表示我们现在的位置吗？
transfer: 解释表格上姓名旁边的红点是什么意思。
transferEn: Explain the small red mark beside a name on a form.

sense: 对罗姆人的旧称（常具冒犯性）
senseEn: a dated term for a Roma person, widely considered offensive
en: The curator explains the label “Gypsy” rather than adopting it in the new display.
zh: 策展人在新展览中解释这个旧称，而没有用它称呼罗姆人。
transfer: 审查旧图注时注明这个词的历史背景和冒犯性。
transferEn: Add a historical usage note to a dated and offensive label in an old caption.

senseEn: a data storage medium read by a computer
en: Is there enough disk space for the audio files?
zh: 磁盘空间够存这些音频文件吗？
transfer: 问技术人员旧电脑里的磁盘是否还能读取。
transferEn: Ask a technician whether an old computer's storage medium can still be read.

senseEn: trousers made of denim
en: Can you shorten these jeans without cutting off the original hem?
zh: 这条牛仔裤能保留原裤边改短吗？
transfer: 试衣时询问深色牛仔裤有没有直筒款。
transferEn: Ask whether dark denim trousers come in a straight-leg cut.

senseEn: a two-wheeled vehicle powered by pedaling
en: Can I take my bicycle on the morning ferry?
zh: 我可以把自行车带上早班渡轮吗？
transfer: 询问旅社是否有地方锁自行车。
transferEn: Ask a hostel for a secure place to lock a pedal-powered two-wheeler.

senseEn: to formally leave an activity or program
en: Can I withdraw from the course before Friday?
zh: 我能在周五前退课吗？
transfer: 问主办方已经报名后如何退出比赛。
transferEn: Ask how to leave a competition after registering.

senseEn: how often something occurs
en: Will the bus frequency increase during the festival?
zh: 节庆期间公交班次会更频繁吗？
transfer: 询问维护人员滤芯多久需要更换一次。
transferEn: Ask how often maintenance staff change the filter.

senseEn: the padded part of a bed used for sleeping
en: Can we try the firmer mattress before ordering?
zh: 订购之前可以试试更硬一点的床垫吗？
transfer: 给客床买床单前问床垫有多厚。
transferEn: Ask how thick the padded sleeping surface is before buying guest-bed sheets.

senseEn: a system in which people participate in choosing their government
en: How does the textbook distinguish direct democracy from representative government?
zh: 课本怎么区分直接民主与代议制？
transfer: 讨论学生会投票时，举例说明民主决策。
transferEn: Give an example of democratic decision-making in a student council vote.

senseEn: a short written message within an organization
en: Did everyone receive the memo about revised opening hours?
zh: 大家都收到关于调整开放时间的内部通知了吗？
transfer: 请同事发一份简短备忘录记录会议决定。
transferEn: Ask a colleague for a short internal note recording a meeting decision.

senseEn: a sequence of notes forming a recognizable tune
en: Can you hum the melody without the words?
zh: 你能不唱歌词，只哼旋律吗？
transfer: 请音乐老师指出哪种乐器演奏主旋律。
transferEn: Ask which instrument carries the main tune in a piece.

senseEn: an idea or understanding, often not fully formed
en: Where did you get the notion that the library closes at noon?
zh: 你是从哪儿听说图书馆中午就关门的？
transfer: 问朋友是什么改变了他对乡村生活的看法。
transferEn: Ask what changed a friend's idea of life in the countryside.

senseEn: the state of being free from guilt
en: Does the missing receipt prove her innocence in the story?
zh: 在故事里，那张失踪的收据能证明她的清白吗？
transfer: 讨论推理剧时指出哪位证人能证实被告无罪。
transferEn: Identify a witness who may establish the accused person's lack of guilt in a mystery.

senseEn: a reddish metal commonly used in wiring and plumbing
en: Is the kettle made of solid copper?
zh: 这把水壶是纯铜的吗？
transfer: 在科学馆问哪根导线里面用的是铜。
transferEn: Ask which exhibit wire contains the reddish conductive metal.

senseEn: a dark fossil fuel mined from the ground
en: Did these trains carry coal from the valley mines?
zh: 这些列车以前从山谷的矿井运煤吗？
transfer: 参观老工厂时询问冬天烧煤还是烧木头。
transferEn: Ask whether an old factory burned the dark mined fuel or wood in winter.

senseEn: careful thought given to a matter
en: Is the garden site still under consideration?
zh: 花园那个场地还在考虑之中吗？
transfer: 谢谢房东认真考虑你养猫的请求。
transferEn: Thank a landlord for giving thought to your request to keep a cat.

senseEn: participating for interest rather than as a profession
en: Can amateur photographers submit work to the show?
zh: 业余摄影师能向这个展览投稿吗？
transfer: 问跑步协会业余选手能否参加接力赛。
transferEn: Ask whether nonprofessional runners can join the relay.

senseEn: a long robe worn for formal occasions
en: When should I collect my graduation gown?
zh: 我什么时候领取毕业礼袍？
transfer: 询问仪式结束后该把礼袍还到哪里。
transferEn: Ask where to return a formal robe after a ceremony.

senseEn: in position number nine
en: We're ninth on the waiting list. Is there still a chance?
zh: 我们排在候补名单第九，还有希望吗？
transfer: 告诉朋友演出安排在本月九号。
transferEn: Tell a friend the show is on the day after the eighth.

senseEn: a device making a loud warning sound
en: Was that a siren from the fire station?
zh: 刚才是消防站的警笛声吗？
transfer: 看展时询问演示中的警报声来自哪种车辆。
transferEn: Ask which vehicle made the loud warning sound in a demonstration.

senseEn: the state or period of carrying a developing baby
en: Does the clinic offer classes during pregnancy?
zh: 这家诊所有孕期课程吗？
transfer: 预约产检时说明目前是孕期第几周。
transferEn: State how many weeks along you are when booking a prenatal checkup.

senseEn: a structure extending from shore into water
en: Does the boat leave from the old pier?
zh: 这艘船从旧栈桥码头开吗？
transfer: 约朋友在木栈桥尽头看日落。
transferEn: Arrange to watch sunset at the end of a wooden landing stage.

senseEn: the worldwide network connecting computers
en: Does the cabin have internet access in winter?
zh: 这间小木屋冬天能上网吗？
transfer: 远程开会前确认公寓网络是否稳定。
transferEn: Check whether a flat's network connection is reliable enough for a remote meeting.

senseEn: a fish with pink flesh often eaten fresh or smoked
en: Is the grilled salmon served with rice?
zh: 烤三文鱼配米饭吗？
transfer: 在鱼铺问烟熏三文鱼按片还是按重量卖。
transferEn: Ask whether the smoked pink fish is sold by the slice or by weight.

senseEn: a professional who designs buildings
en: Can we meet the architect before approving the extension?
zh: 批准扩建前我们能见见建筑师吗？
transfer: 参观剧院时询问哪位建筑师设计了屋顶。
transferEn: Ask who designed the roof of a theater on a tour.

senseEn: the right-hand side of a ship when facing forward
en: Can passengers see the island from the starboard side?
zh: 乘客能从右舷看到岛吗？
transfer: 请船员解释面向船头时哪边是右舷。
transferEn: Ask a crew member which nautical term means right when facing forward.

senseEn: one more than thirteen
en: We have fourteen guests confirmed for lunch.
zh: 午餐已经确认有十四位客人。
transfer: 告诉老师十四名学生需要借画板。
transferEn: Tell a teacher that a group of thirteen plus one needs drawing boards.

senseEn: a long walk, usually in the countryside
en: How long is the hike from the lake to the hut?
zh: 从湖边徒步到小屋要多久？
transfer: 邀请朋友周末参加一段适合初学者的远足。
transferEn: Invite a friend on a beginner-friendly countryside walk this weekend.

senseEn: the process of signing up officially
en: Does registration close at noon or midnight?
zh: 报名是中午截止还是午夜截止？
transfer: 问社区中心能否现场办理游泳课报名。
transferEn: Ask whether you can sign up for swimming in person.

senseEn: liquid fuel used in many cars
en: Does the rental price include a tank of gasoline?
zh: 租车费含一箱汽油吗？
transfer: 还车前向工作人员确认要不要加满汽油。
transferEn: Check whether the petrol tank must be full when returning a car.

senseEn: the field of applying science to design and build things
en: Does the engineering course include a workshop placement?
zh: 工程学课程包含车间实习吗？
transfer: 问顾问哪些工程学专业会学桥梁设计。
transferEn: Ask an adviser which branch of applied design and construction studies bridges.

senseEn: a period of staying at school as a punishment
en: Will I miss the bus if detention ends at four?
zh: 如果留校处罚四点结束，我会错过公交车吗？
transfer: 询问老师哪天要留下来完成留校处罚。
transferEn: Ask a teacher which day the after-school disciplinary session is scheduled.

senseEn: unsuccessful despite effort
en: We searched in vain for the lost earring on the beach.
zh: 我们在海滩上找那只耳环，却徒劳无功。
transfer: 描述你试图联系已经关门的售票处却没有结果。
transferEn: Describe trying without success to contact a ticket office that had closed.

senseEn: liquid waste passed by the body
en: Do I need to bring a urine sample to the appointment?
zh: 就诊时我需要带尿样吗？
transfer: 问诊所尿样容器在哪里领取。
transferEn: Ask a clinic where to collect the container for a urinary sample.

senseEn: a short electronic signaling sound
en: Wait for the second beep before leaving your message.
zh: 等第二声哔响后再留言。
transfer: 问同事刷卡机发出三声短响代表什么。
transferEn: Ask a colleague what three short electronic tones on a card reader mean.

senseEn: to say a word using particular sounds
en: How do you pronounce the name on this street sign?
zh: 路牌上的名字怎么念？
transfer: 请老师示范一个菜名末尾的音怎么读。
transferEn: Ask a teacher how to say the final sound in a dish's name.

senseEn: large enough to matter
en: Did the shorter route make a significant difference to delivery times?
zh: 较短路线对送货用时的影响明显吗？
transfer: 问老师哪个变化对提高出勤率最显著。
transferEn: Ask which change had a meaningful effect on attendance.

senseEn: a violent public disturbance involving a crowd
en: Did the museum close during the riot described in this diary?
zh: 这本日记记载的骚乱期间，博物馆闭馆了吗？
transfer: 阅读历史报道时问公共交通在骚乱后何时恢复。
transferEn: Ask when transit resumed after the public disturbance in a historical report.

senseEn: to take someone away against their will
en: In the film, why did the villains kidnap the pianist?
zh: 影片中反派为什么绑架了钢琴家？
transfer: 讨论一本小说时指出哪位角色险些被绑架。
transferEn: Identify the character who narrowly avoided abduction in a novel.

senseEn: a room equipped for scientific work
en: May visitors enter the laboratory during the open day?
zh: 开放日允许访客进实验室吗？
transfer: 问导师样本要送到哪间实验室。
transferEn: Ask a supervisor which room for scientific testing should receive a sample.

senseEn: informal shorthand for a program of rehabilitation
en: Does the hospital offer cardiac rehab in the evenings?
zh: 医院晚上有心脏康复治疗吗？
transfer: 复诊时询问膝盖手术后的康复项目在哪儿进行。
transferEn: Ask where the rehabilitation program after knee surgery takes place.

senseEn: a company operating flights for passengers or freight
en: Which airline operates the final leg of this trip?
zh: 这次行程最后一段由哪家航空公司执飞？
transfer: 问旅行社哪家航空公司接受折叠轮椅。
transferEn: Ask a travel agent which carrier accepts a folding wheelchair.

senseEn: a strong opioid medicine used to treat pain
en: Does my chart list morphine among the medicines I received?
zh: 我的病历有列出我用过吗啡吗？
transfer: 核对病历时询问哪条记录写的是这种强效止痛药。
transferEn: Ask which record refers to this strong opioid pain medicine when checking a chart.

en: The Senate will vote on the rail bill tomorrow.
zh: 参议院明天将就铁路法案投票。
transfer: 向同学解释这项提案何时送交参议院。
senseEn: the upper chamber of a legislature
transferEn: Explain when a proposal goes before the upper chamber.

senseEn: to include as part of an activity
en: Will the job involve travel outside the county?
zh: 这份工作需要到本县以外出差吗？
transfer: 问主办方志愿者岗位是否包括搬桌子。
transferEn: Ask whether moving tables is part of a volunteer role.

senseEn: to be unable to breathe normally because something blocks the throat
en: Could a toddler choke on these small pieces?
zh: 这么小的碎块会不会让幼儿噎住？
transfer: 向托儿所询问菜单会如何避免会噎到的食物。
transferEn: Ask a nursery how meals avoid foods that can block a child's airway.

senseEn: a tall cupboard for storing clothes
en: Can the bedroom wardrobe fit two winter coats?
zh: 卧室衣柜放得下两件冬大衣吗？
transfer: 问房东衣柜里有没有衣架。
transferEn: Ask a landlord whether the tall clothes cupboard contains hangers.

senseEn: a daughter of one's son or daughter
en: My eldest granddaughter drew this map for our walk.
zh: 这张徒步地图是我最大的孙女画的。
transfer: 向同伴介绍第一次来看你演出的外孙女。
transferEn: Introduce your daughter's daughter, who has come to see you perform for the first time.

senseEn: showing little experience or excessive trust
en: Was I naive to assume the price included every fee?
zh: 我以为价格里含了所有费用，是不是太天真了？
transfer: 回顾第一次租房时说明你当时哪个想法太天真。
transferEn: Reflect on an inexperienced assumption you made when first renting a home.

senseEn: the process of growing in size or number
en: Did the cold spell slow the growth of the seedlings?
zh: 那阵寒潮减慢了幼苗的生长吗？
transfer: 向园丁询问光照会怎样影响花的生长。
transferEn: Ask a gardener how light affects the development of flowers.

senseEn: a sharp sauce made from mustard seeds
en: Could I have the mustard on the side?
zh: 芥末酱能另外放吗？
transfer: 帮朋友点三明治前问他想不想加这种辛辣的黄酱。
transferEn: Ask if a friend wants the sharp yellow condiment on a sandwich.

en: The old mansion now houses the town library.
zh: 那座老宅邸如今是镇图书馆。
transfer: 给游客指路，告诉他们过桥后会看到一座白色大宅。
senseEn: a large impressive house
transferEn: Tell visitors they will see a large white house after crossing the bridge.

senseEn: someone who leads organized support for a team
en: Was your sister a cheerleader at the final game?
zh: 决赛时你妹妹是啦啦队员吗？
transfer: 问学校体育老师新啦啦队员去哪里参加排练。
transferEn: Ask where new members of the team's cheer squad rehearse.

senseEn: a dish slowly cooked in liquid
en: Does the vegetable stew come with bread?
zh: 这道炖蔬菜配面包吗？
transfer: 做野餐计划时问朋友能带多少份炖菜。
transferEn: Ask a friend how many portions of a slow-cooked dish they can bring.

senseEn: an impolite informal verb for passing intestinal gas
en: The script uses the verb “fart” for a childish joke.
zh: 剧本用“放屁”这个不雅动词开了个孩子气的玩笑。
transfer: 解释为什么正式健康手册会把这个俚语换成医学表述。
transferEn: Explain why a formal health booklet uses a medical expression in place of this impolite verb.

senseEn: an adult male sheep
en: Is the ram in a separate field from the lambs?
zh: 公羊和小羊分在不同的草场吗？
transfer: 参观农场时请孩子指出哪只是成年的公羊。
transferEn: Ask a child to identify the adult male sheep on a farm.

senseEn: to make something last longer
en: Can we extend our booking by one night?
zh: 我们可以续订一晚吗？
transfer: 向老师询问能否把交作业时间延长到周一。
transferEn: Ask a teacher to move the assignment deadline to Monday.

senseEn: to actively follow a goal or career
en: What made you pursue a career in sound design?
zh: 是什么让你选择从事音效设计？
transfer: 告诉顾问毕业后你想继续追求哪个研究方向。
transferEn: Tell an adviser which research interest you want to follow after graduation.

senseEn: the place where someone or something is
en: Has anyone confirmed the whereabouts of the missing suitcase?
zh: 有人确认丢失的行李箱在哪里了吗？
transfer: 询问服务台是否知道遗失地图册的下落。
transferEn: Ask a help desk whether anyone knows where a lost atlas is.

senseEn: in total when everything is counted
en: How much will the flowers and delivery cost altogether?
zh: 鲜花和配送总共多少钱？
transfer: 向活动负责人确认全组一共有多少人。
transferEn: Ask an organizer for the total head count of a group.

senseEn: to move slowly with wind or water
en: Will the raft drift toward the bank when the tide turns?
zh: 潮水转向时，筏子会漂向岸边吗？
transfer: 让孩子观察纸船会顺水漂到哪里。
transferEn: Ask a child where a paper boat will move with the current.

senseEn: likely to upset or insult people
en: Did anyone find the joke offensive during rehearsal?
zh: 排练时有人觉得那个玩笑冒犯人吗？
transfer: 请同事帮你检查广告文案里有没有可能冒犯读者的措辞。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to flag advertising language that readers might find insulting.

senseEn: to release a patient from hospital care
en: Can the hospital discharge him before the follow-up is booked?
zh: 复诊还没约好，医院能让他出院吗？
transfer: 问护士医生什么时候会允许你离院。
transferEn: Ask a nurse when the doctor expects to release you from the hospital.

senseEn: to select something with a mouse or similar device
en: Click the calendar to see available appointment times.
zh: 点击日历查看可预约的时间。
transfer: 指导同事点哪一个按钮才能下载发票。
transferEn: Tell a colleague which button to select to download an invoice.

senseEn: an aromatic rootlike ingredient used in cooking
en: Is there fresh ginger in this broth?
zh: 这汤里放了鲜姜吗？
transfer: 买菜时问这道菜用姜粉能不能代替鲜姜。
transferEn: Ask whether ground spice can replace the fresh aromatic root in a recipe.

senseEn: a long or purposeful search
en: What starts the hero's quest for the lost bell?
zh: 是什么让主人公踏上寻找失落之钟的旅程？
transfer: 给孩子讲一个小狐狸长途寻找家园的故事。
transferEn: Tell a child about a fox's long search for a home.

senseEn: strict in manner or tone
en: Was that stern warning meant for the whole class?
zh: 刚才那句严厉的警告是对全班说的吗？
transfer: 描述电影里校长第一次开口时严肃的语气。
transferEn: Describe the headteacher's strict tone in the opening scene of a film.

senseEn: by good fortune
en: The café was closed, but luckily the bakery still had sandwiches.
zh: 咖啡馆关门了，幸好面包店还有三明治。
transfer: 说明你赶不上车时幸好有人愿意送你。
transferEn: Explain your good fortune when someone offered a lift after you missed a bus.

senseEn: to cause someone to agree through reasons or encouragement
en: Did the photos persuade them to repair the footbridge?
zh: 这些照片说服他们维修人行桥了吗？
transfer: 与室友讨论怎样说服房东装上窗帘。
transferEn: Discuss how to convince a landlord to install curtains.

senseEn: the process of recovering from a wound or injury
en: Is the cut healing well under the bandage?
zh: 绷带下面的伤口愈合得好吗？
transfer: 复诊时请医生比较两次照片中的愈合进度。
transferEn: Ask a clinician to compare wound recovery in two photos.

senseEn: written works studied or valued for artistic expression
en: Is children's literature part of the course?
zh: 课程包括儿童文学吗？
transfer: 请图书管理员推荐研究海洋主题文学的读物。
transferEn: Ask a librarian for reading about ocean themes in literary works.

senseEn: relating to a clinical loss of contact with reality
en: Does the leaflet explain psychotic symptoms in plain language?
zh: 这份宣传页用通俗语言解释精神病性症状了吗？
transfer: 向医护人员询问临床记录中这个描述症状的词是什么意思。
transferEn: Ask a clinician to explain this term for symptoms involving altered contact with reality.

senseEn: informal shorthand for technology or technical work
en: Can tech support restore the missing printer settings?
zh: 技术支持能恢复丢失的打印机设置吗？
transfer: 问公司前台线上会议的技术问题该找哪个团队。
transferEn: Ask reception which technical team handles online meeting problems.

senseEn: a man-made waterway
en: Does the cycle path follow the canal to the station?
zh: 自行车道是沿运河通到车站吗？
transfer: 向游客中心询问运河游船在哪个码头出发。
transferEn: Ask which dock the boat touring the artificial waterway leaves from.

senseEn: a company transporting passengers or goods
en: Is the smaller carrier responsible for my connecting flight?
zh: 我的转机航班由那家较小的航空公司承运吗？
transfer: 行李晚到时问应该联系哪家承运公司。
transferEn: Ask which transport company to contact about a delayed bag.

senseEn: an underwater military projectile
en: Is the torpedo on display an empty historical shell?
zh: 展出的鱼雷是空的历史遗物吗？
transfer: 在海事馆询问这件鱼雷展品是哪年入藏的。
transferEn: Ask when the maritime museum acquired its underwater projectile exhibit.

senseEn: first or preliminary
en: Is the initial estimate still valid after today's measurements?
zh: 今天测量后，最初的估价还有效吗？
transfer: 问老师初次测试会多久出结果。
transferEn: Ask when results of the first assessment will be ready.

senseEn: by means of this formal statement
en: The form says, “I hereby confirm my attendance.”
zh: 表格写着：“本人特此确认出席。”
transfer: 拟一份正式声明，书面确认归还了钥匙。
transferEn: Draft a formal written statement confirming that the keys were returned.

senseEn: to buy goods or services
en: Can I purchase tickets at the door tonight?
zh: 今晚能在入口买票吗？
transfer: 给供应商写信询问能否单独购买一个替换盖。
transferEn: Ask a supplier whether you can buy a replacement lid separately.

senseEn: dried cut grass used as animal feed
en: Where do you store the hay when rain is forecast?
zh: 预报有雨时你们把干草存在哪儿？
transfer: 参观马厩时询问每匹马一天吃多少干草。
transferEn: Ask how much dried grass each horse eats at a stable.

senseEn: a community with shared kinship, culture or political identity
en: How does the tribe describe its history in its own museum?
zh: 这个部族在自己的博物馆里如何介绍自己的历史？
transfer: 查当地资料时询问某一部族使用的自称。
transferEn: Ask how a particular community of shared heritage refers to itself in local sources.

senseEn: a sudden shaking of the ground
en: Was the bridge inspected after the earthquake?
zh: 地震后这座桥检查过了吗？
transfer: 读地方史时问哪次地震改变了河道。
transferEn: Ask which ground-shaking event altered a river in a local history.

senseEn: a male member of the US House of Representatives
en: Will our congressman attend the town meeting?
zh: 我们选区的国会众议员会出席市民会议吗？
transfer: 读新闻时确认受访者是州议员还是国会议员。
transferEn: Check whether an interviewed man serves in the state legislature or the US House.

senseEn: undamaged and complete
en: Was the seal still intact when the package arrived?
zh: 包裹送到时封条还完好吗？
transfer: 归还古书时请馆员检查封面是否完好。
transferEn: Ask a librarian to verify that an old book's cover is undamaged.

senseEn: causing sadness or discouragement
en: Seeing the playground empty was rather depressing.
zh: 看到游乐场空荡荡的，让人有些沮丧。
transfer: 告诉朋友这部电影的哪个结尾让你心情沉重。
transferEn: Explain which ending of a film left you feeling low.

senseEn: to cause someone to feel fear
en: Will the loud bell frighten the puppy?
zh: 这么响的铃声会吓到小狗吗？
transfer: 在排练时问突然熄灯会不会吓到年幼观众。
transferEn: Ask whether a sudden blackout in a show might scare young viewers.

senseEn: money, property and other valuable assets
en: Was the family's early wealth built on shipping?
zh: 这家人早年的财富来自航运吗？
transfer: 在历史课讨论港口贸易如何带来财富。
transferEn: Discuss how trade brought riches to a port in history class.

senseEn: a British informal term for a man or boy
en: Ask the chap in the blue cap; he runs the bookstall.
zh: 问问戴蓝帽子的小伙子，那家书摊是他开的。
transfer: 在英国朋友间聊天时，随口提起给你指路的那位男子。
transferEn: Casually mention the man who gave you directions when talking to British friends.

senseEn: grain-based food usually eaten with milk
en: Is there unsweetened cereal at the breakfast bar?
zh: 早餐台上有无糖麦片吗？
transfer: 为孩子挑早餐时问哪款麦片不含坚果。
transferEn: Ask which grain-based breakfast contains no nuts.

senseEn: a round soft fruit with a large stone
en: Is this peach ripe enough to eat today?
zh: 这个桃子今天够熟可以吃了吗？
transfer: 为水果馅饼买料时问需要几颗桃子。
transferEn: Ask how many of the soft stone fruits you need for a pie.

senseEn: to find someone guilty in a court
en: Was there enough evidence to convict the defendant in the film?
zh: 电影里的证据足以判被告有罪吗？
transfer: 讨论法庭剧时说明陪审团最终判谁有罪。
transferEn: Explain which person the jury found guilty in a courtroom drama.

senseEn: to ride ocean waves on a board
en: Can beginners surf here before the tide rises?
zh: 涨潮前初学者可以在这里冲浪吗？
transfer: 问教练第一次冲浪是否需要自带板。
transferEn: Ask an instructor whether to bring your own board for a first wave-riding lesson.

senseEn: to set up something intended to last
en: Can we establish a routine for checking returned keys?
zh: 我们能建立核对归还钥匙的固定流程吗？
transfer: 向老师建议建立一个每周读书小组。
transferEn: Suggest setting up a weekly reading group to a teacher.

senseEn: extremely unreasonable or shocking
en: Isn't that an outrageous price for a paper bag?
zh: 一个纸袋卖这个价也太离谱了吧？
transfer: 向朋友描述一次贵得离谱的停车报价。
transferEn: Describe an unreasonably high parking quote to a friend.

senseEn: a variety of domesticated animal with shared traits
en: Which breed of dog is pictured on the poster?
zh: 海报上画的是什么品种的狗？
transfer: 参观农场时问哪种绵羊产的羊毛最细。
transferEn: Ask which variety of sheep on a farm produces the finest wool.

senseEn: a person who accompanies another
en: Can my companion board the bus with me?
zh: 我的同行者能和我一起上车吗？
transfer: 报名博物馆活动时询问同行者是否要单独登记。
transferEn: Ask whether an accompanying guest needs separate registration at a museum.

senseEn: to cook using dry heat in an oven
en: How long should I bake the rolls if they're smaller?
zh: 如果面包卷做小一点，需要烤多久？
transfer: 做生日蛋糕时确认两层能否同时烤。
transferEn: Check whether two cake layers can cook in the oven at the same time.

senseEn: below the surface of water
en: Did they use an underwater camera to film the reef?
zh: 拍珊瑚礁时他们用了水下相机吗？
transfer: 在水族馆问哪块屏幕能看到水下影像。
transferEn: Ask which aquarium screen shows images from beneath the water.

senseEn: a small area of standing water
en: Is there a fence around the pond behind the school?
zh: 学校后面池塘周围有围栏吗？
transfer: 向向导询问哪一处池塘能看到蝌蚪。
transferEn: Ask a guide which small body of still water has tadpoles.

senseEn: a period of being away from a usual place
en: Who handled bookings in my absence?
zh: 我不在的时候谁负责预订？
transfer: 向老师解释昨天缺席排练的原因。
transferEn: Explain why you were away from yesterday's rehearsal.

senseEn: having a pleasant flavor
en: That tasty green sauce goes well with grilled fish.
zh: 那种美味的绿色酱汁很配烤鱼。
transfer: 品尝新菜后夸它美味，并说明最喜欢哪个配料。
transferEn: Praise a delicious new dish and name the ingredient you liked most.

senseEn: covered with noticeable hair
en: Why are the stems so hairy on this tomato plant?
zh: 这株番茄的茎为什么长了那么多毛？
transfer: 观察昆虫时描述它长满细毛的腿。
transferEn: Describe the fine hairs covering an insect's legs.

senseEn: a batch of goods sent to a destination
en: Did the shipment of folding chairs arrive this morning?
zh: 那批折叠椅今天早上到了吗？
transfer: 请店员确认下一批颜料何时到货。
transferEn: Ask a shop when the next batch of paints will arrive.

senseEn: a place where people have established homes
en: Was there a fishing settlement here before the bridge was built?
zh: 建桥以前这里是渔村聚落吗？
transfer: 在旧地图上指出山谷里最早的居民点。
transferEn: Point out the earliest inhabited community in a valley on an old map.

senseEn: from or relating to Switzerland
en: Is this Swiss chocolate made with hazelnuts?
zh: 这款瑞士巧克力加了榛子吗？
transfer: 在钟表展问哪款手表是瑞士制造的。
transferEn: Ask which watch at a fair was made in Switzerland.

senseEn: relating to the whole world
en: Is the survey local, or does it track global trends?
zh: 这项调查是本地调查，还是追踪全球趋势？
transfer: 请同学区分全球平均数和本地平均数。
transferEn: Ask a classmate to distinguish a worldwide average from a local one.

senseEn: a prediction presented as foretelling the future
en: Does the prophecy come true in the final chapter?
zh: 最后一章里那个预言实现了吗？
transfer: 问读书会成员故事里的预言是谁最先说出的。
transferEn: Ask who first foretold the future event in a book-club story.

senseEn: an exclamation of relief
en: Whew, we made it before the gate closed!
zh: 呼，我们赶在关门前到了！
transfer: 找回丢失的钥匙后用一声感叹表示松了口气。
transferEn: Give an exclamation of relief after finding lost keys.

senseEn: graceful and stylish
en: Does this elegant black dress come in navy?
zh: 这条优雅的黑裙有藏青色吗？
transfer: 称赞朋友为邀请函挑选的字体很优雅。
transferEn: Compliment the graceful typeface a friend chose for an invitation.

senseEn: a narrow bed, often one of a stacked pair
en: Can I reserve a lower bunk on the night train?
zh: 夜班火车上能预订下铺吗？
transfer: 到青年旅舍时问哪个铺位已经有人了。
transferEn: Ask which narrow bed in a hostel dorm is already taken.

senseEn: a brief flash of light from an electrical discharge
en: Did you see a spark when the lamp went out?
zh: 灯熄灭时你看到火花了吗？
transfer: 向维修员说明开关出现火花的时间。
transferEn: Tell a technician when you noticed a flash from the switch.

senseEn: a contract granting use of property for a period
en: Does the lease allow us to repaint the kitchen?
zh: 租约允许我们重新粉刷厨房吗？
transfer: 续租前问下一份租约期限有多久。
transferEn: Ask how long the next rental contract lasts before renewing.

senseEn: a recognized group of symptoms occurring together
en: Does this leaflet explain the syndrome named in the report?
zh: 这份宣传页介绍了报告里提到的综合征吗？
transfer: 请医生解释这个综合征可能包括哪些症状。
transferEn: Ask a clinician which symptoms belong to the named condition.

senseEn: a fabric with a short soft pile
en: Can I touch the velvet sample before choosing the curtains?
zh: 选窗帘前能摸一下天鹅绒样布吗？
transfer: 询问裁缝天鹅绒外套可否熨烫。
transferEn: Ask a tailor whether a soft pile-fabric coat can be pressed.

senseEn: lacking knowledge about something
en: I'm ignorant of the local customs. Could you explain the greeting?
zh: 我不了解当地习俗，能解释一下怎么问候吗？
transfer: 向同事坦言自己对这套旧系统知之甚少。
transferEn: Admit to a colleague that you lack knowledge of an old system.

senseEn: intentionally rather than by accident
en: Was the empty seat deliberately left for the musician?
zh: 这个空位是特意留给乐手的吗？
transfer: 问设计师海报上的空白是否有意保留。
transferEn: Ask a designer whether blank space on a poster was intentional.

senseEn: concern for someone suffering coupled with a desire to help
en: Thank you for showing such compassion when our cat died.
zh: 谢谢你在我们的猫去世时给予那么多关怀。
transfer: 在感谢信中提到护士对焦虑病人的关怀。
transferEn: Mention a nurse's caring response to an anxious patient in a thank-you letter.

senseEn: a possible or imagined set of circumstances
en: In that scenario, who would open the shop if both buses were late?
zh: 照那种设想，两班车要是都晚点，谁来开店？
transfer: 活动筹备时讨论突降大雨的假设情形。
transferEn: Discuss a possible situation in which sudden rain interrupts an event.

senseEn: a coarse informal verb meaning to vomit
en: The subtitles use “I might puke” to show how seasick he feels.
zh: 字幕用“我快吐了”这种不雅口语来表现他晕船的程度。
transfer: 向编辑说明讲述晕车经历时用了哪个不太文雅的词。
transferEn: Identify the coarse word for vomiting in a story about motion sickness.

senseEn: an American whiskey made chiefly from corn
en: Does this dessert contain bourbon whiskey?
zh: 这道甜点含波本威士忌吗？
transfer: 问餐厅酱汁里的美式玉米威士忌能不能不加。
transferEn: Ask whether an American corn-based whiskey can be left out of a sauce.

senseEn: a device supporting an injured body part
en: Should I bring my knee brace to the follow-up?
zh: 复诊时我要带上膝关节支具吗？
transfer: 问治疗师腕部支具能否清洗。
transferEn: Ask a therapist whether a wrist support can be washed.

senseEn: a device that signals after a set interval
en: Set the timer for eight minutes once the pasta goes in.
zh: 意面下锅后把计时器设为八分钟。
transfer: 做课堂游戏时请同学把计时器设成三十秒。
transferEn: Ask a classmate to set a thirty-second countdown for a game.

senseEn: work beyond regular scheduled hours
en: Do we need approval before working overtime on Friday?
zh: 周五加班前需要批准吗？
transfer: 问主管上个月的加班时数在哪里核对。
transferEn: Ask a supervisor where to check last month's extra hours.

senseEn: to state exactly what a term means or includes
en: How does the survey define a household?
zh: 这份调查怎样界定一户人家？
transfer: 问老师评分标准如何定义合格的论证。
transferEn: Ask how the marking criteria characterize an acceptable argument.

senseEn: a narrow tube for drinking
en: Could I have a paper straw for this smoothie?
zh: 这杯冰沙可以配一根纸吸管吗？
transfer: 点外卖时告诉店家不用放吸管。
transferEn: Tell a takeaway shop you don't need a drinking tube.

senseEn: the area reached by a network or service
en: Is there mobile coverage along the whole trail?
zh: 整条步道都有手机信号吗？
transfer: 租公寓前问无线网络能否覆盖阳台。
transferEn: Ask whether the wireless network reaches the balcony before renting.

senseEn: bags taken along by a traveler
en: Where can we leave our baggage until boarding starts?
zh: 登船前我们能把行李放在哪儿？
transfer: 问服务台行李领取区在哪一层。
transferEn: Ask a service desk which floor has the bag collection area.

senseEn: to rub something hard to clean it
en: Should I scrub the tiles before applying the sealant?
zh: 涂密封剂之前需要先擦洗瓷砖吗？
transfer: 清洗泥靴时请室友用刷子用力刷鞋底。
transferEn: Ask a roommate to brush mud firmly off the soles of boots.

sense: 针对智力障碍的冒犯性旧称
senseEn: an outdated, offensive term used to demean intellectual disability
en: The school removed the slur “retarded” from the display.
zh: 学校从展板上删去了这个贬损智力障碍者的词。
transfer: 校对历史材料时说明这个旧称为何需要语域注释。
transferEn: Explain why this derogatory old term in historical material requires a usage note.

senseEn: a male reproductive cell
en: Does the biology diagram show a sperm cell entering the egg?
zh: 这张生物示意图画的是精子进入卵细胞吗？
transfer: 请老师指出生殖细胞模型中哪一个是精子。
transferEn: Ask a teacher which model represents the male reproductive cell.

senseEn: a tree often found by water with long flexible branches
en: Meet me under the willow by the pond.
zh: 在池塘边那棵柳树下见。
transfer: 问园丁哪棵柳树的枝条需要修剪。
transferEn: Ask which of the flexible-branched trees beside the water needs pruning.

senseEn: a loud high-pitched sound
en: Was that a screech from the bus brakes?
zh: 那阵尖锐的声音是公交车刹车发出的吗？
transfer: 描述门铰链转动时发出的刺耳声音。
transferEn: Describe the piercing sound a hinge makes when a door moves.

senseEn: to travel through or examine an unfamiliar place
en: Can we explore the old town before the market opens?
zh: 集市开门前能逛逛老城区吗？
transfer: 带孩子第一次去图书馆时，邀请他探索儿童区。
transferEn: Invite a child to discover the children's section on a first library visit.

senseEn: something used in place of a damaged or missing item
en: Will you send a replacement for the cracked bowl?
zh: 这只碗裂了，你们会寄替换品吗？
transfer: 问售后哪种灯泡能替换坏掉的那颗。
transferEn: Ask support which bulb can take the place of the broken one.

senseEn: a device measuring consumption or another quantity
en: Could you photograph the water meter before we move in?
zh: 我们入住前能拍一下水表吗？
transfer: 告诉维修工电表在车库外墙上。
transferEn: Tell a technician where the device measuring electricity consumption is mounted.

senseEn: a derogatory term for a badly behaved child
en: The parent objected to the label “brat” in the note.
zh: 家长反对纸条里用“熊孩子”这种贬称。
transfer: 说明家校沟通时为何应描述行为而非用这个贬称。
transferEn: Explain why school notes should describe behavior instead of using a disparaging label.

senseEn: to remove writing or stored data
en: Will restarting the tablet erase my notes?
zh: 重启平板会清掉我的笔记吗？
transfer: 换白板前问老师哪些字可以擦掉。
transferEn: Ask a teacher which writing can be removed from the board.

senseEn: a failure to honor an agreement or obligation
en: Would early closure be a breach of our rental agreement?
zh: 提前关门会违反租赁协议吗？
transfer: 问负责人迟交设备是否构成违约。
transferEn: Ask whether returning equipment late breaks the agreement.

senseEn: a high steep bank or cliff
en: Is the lighthouse visible from the bluff above the river?
zh: 从河边的陡岸上能看见灯塔吗？
transfer: 向导览员打听哪段步道能俯瞰海边断崖。
transferEn: Ask which path overlooks a steep coastal bank.

senseEn: historical soldiers serving on horseback
en: Are those cavalry uniforms in the parade photograph?
zh: 游行照片里那些是骑兵制服吗？
transfer: 在军事史展上问骑兵的马匹由谁照料。
transferEn: Ask who cared for mounted soldiers' horses in a historical exhibit.

senseEn: from water onto land
en: Can passengers go ashore during the short stop?
zh: 短暂停靠时乘客可以上岸吗？
transfer: 问船员行李何时会运上岸。
transferEn: Ask when the bags will be taken from the ship onto land.

senseEn: not needed for a purpose
en: Is a second signature unnecessary for this small purchase?
zh: 这么小的一笔采购是不是不用第二个人签字？
transfer: 向旅行伙伴解释为什么没必要带两台相机。
transferEn: Explain why packing two cameras would serve no purpose.

senseEn: the usual time to go to bed
en: Will the fireworks finish before bedtime?
zh: 烟花表演能在睡觉时间前结束吗？
transfer: 照看孩子时问家长平常几点上床。
transferEn: Ask a parent when a child usually goes to bed before babysitting.

senseEn: to successfully deal with a difficulty
en: What helped you overcome your nerves before speaking?
zh: 演讲前什么办法帮你克服了紧张？
transfer: 请朋友分享他如何克服在水里睁眼的恐惧。
transferEn: Ask how a friend managed their fear of opening their eyes underwater.

senseEn: a practice traditionally followed by a community
en: Is bringing bread a local custom when visiting a new neighbor?
zh: 拜访新邻居时带面包是当地习俗吗？
transfer: 请主人解释节日前夜的一项家庭习俗。
transferEn: Ask a host about a family tradition observed before a festival.

senseEn: containing alcohol
en: Are alcoholic drinks included in the ticket price?
zh: 票价包括含酒精饮料吗？
transfer: 买果汁饮品时向店员确认它是不是含酒精。
transferEn: Check whether a fruit drink contains alcohol before buying it.

senseEn: a mark that is hard to remove
en: Can this cloth lift a coffee stain from linen?
zh: 这块布能擦掉亚麻布上的咖啡渍吗？
transfer: 退房前告诉前台地毯上的污渍原先就有。
transferEn: Tell hotel reception that a mark on the carpet was already there.

en: Will my wheelchair fit through that doorway?
zh: 我的轮椅能通过那道门吗？
transfer: 预订出租车时询问后备厢能否放下折叠轮椅。
senseEn: a chair on wheels for someone with limited mobility
transferEn: Ask a taxi company whether its trunk can hold a folding mobility chair.

senseEn: a small bed with high sides for a baby
en: Could the hotel put a crib in our room?
zh: 酒店能在我们房里放张婴儿床吗？
transfer: 去亲戚家前问婴儿床是否需要自带床单。
transferEn: Ask a relative whether to bring a sheet for the baby's bed.

senseEn: an evergreen tree bearing needles and cones
en: That tall pine tree shades the whole picnic table.
zh: 那棵高松树给整张野餐桌都遮了阴。
transfer: 让孩子在林地里找一棵结松果的树。
transferEn: Ask a child to find a cone-bearing evergreen in the woods.

senseEn: in or to a different place
en: If the hostel is full, should we look elsewhere for a room?
zh: 如果旅舍满了，我们是不是该去别处找房间？
transfer: 问图书管理员这场讲座是不是改到别处举办了。
transferEn: Ask whether a library talk has been moved to a different location.

senseEn: under the influence of too much alcohol
en: Did the drunken passenger get off at the next stop?
zh: 那个醉酒的乘客在下一站下车了吗？
transfer: 转述目击者对深夜醉酒吵闹的描述。
transferEn: Report what a witness said about noisy behavior caused by intoxication.

senseEn: polite and reasonable in behavior
en: Can we have a civilized discussion about the shared kitchen?
zh: 我们能有礼有节地谈谈共用厨房的事吗？
transfer: 请两位同学在辩论时保持礼貌和理性。
transferEn: Ask two classmates to keep a debate polite and reasonable.

senseEn: arriving at a place or device
en: Who checks incoming mail while the office is closed?
zh: 办公室关闭时谁检查收到的邮件？
transfer: 问同事新到货物在哪个区域登记。
transferEn: Ask where newly arriving goods are recorded.

senseEn: relating to the teeth or their treatment
en: Does the plan cover dental checkups twice a year?
zh: 这个方案包含每年两次的牙科检查吗？
transfer: 去学校前问孩子有没有带牙科预约单。
transferEn: Ask a child whether they packed their tooth-care appointment slip.

senseEn: a professional who prepares or checks financial records
en: Should the accountant sign off on these travel expenses?
zh: 这些差旅费需要会计确认吗？
transfer: 开工作室前咨询会计应该保留哪些票据。
transferEn: Ask a financial records professional which receipts to keep for a new studio.

senseEn: settled and no longer uncertain
en: Do we have a definite date for reopening the pool?
zh: 泳池重新开放的日期确定了吗？
transfer: 问同事能否在周五前给出明确答复。
transferEn: Ask a colleague for a firm answer by Friday.

senseEn: to suffer from a severe lack of food
en: Did the rescue team reach the animals before they began to starve?
zh: 救援队在那些动物开始挨饿之前赶到了吗？
transfer: 看纪录片时询问寒冬里动物怎样避免断粮挨饿。
transferEn: Ask how animals avoid a severe lack of food during winter in a documentary.

senseEn: the price charged for a journey
en: Does the bus fare include a transfer?
zh: 这趟公交的票价包含换乘吗？
transfer: 坐船前问儿童票价。
transferEn: Ask what children are charged for a ferry crossing.

senseEn: to draw someone into active involvement
en: How can we engage new volunteers before the first cleanup?
zh: 第一次清理活动前，我们怎样吸引新志愿者参与？
transfer: 向老师建议一个能让安静学生参与讨论的方法。
transferEn: Suggest a way to involve quieter pupils in discussion.

senseEn: a soft sweet dessert
en: Is the rice pudding served warm or cold?
zh: 米布丁是热吃还是冷吃？
transfer: 在甜品店问这款布丁里有无鸡蛋。
transferEn: Ask whether a soft set dessert contains eggs.

senseEn: a woman who holds a noble rank equivalent to a count
en: Was the countess who donated the portrait also its subject?
zh: 捐出肖像的女伯爵也是画里的人吗？
transfer: 看历史剧时问哪位演员扮演女伯爵。
transferEn: Ask which performer plays a woman holding the rank of count in a historical drama.

senseEn: to receive guests socially
en: Could we entertain six guests in this small dining room?
zh: 这么小的餐厅能招待六位客人吗？
transfer: 看房时问阳台适不适合招待朋友吃午饭。
transferEn: Ask whether a balcony suits hosting friends for lunch.

senseEn: to confirm that something has been received
en: Could you acknowledge receipt of my application by email?
zh: 能发邮件确认收到我的申请吗？
transfer: 请同事收到归还的钥匙后给你一个确认。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to confirm that returned keys reached them.

senseEn: the joint between upper arm and forearm
en: I scraped my elbow when I slipped on the path.
zh: 我在小路上滑倒，擦破了胳膊肘。
transfer: 试外套时指出肘部太紧。
transferEn: Point out that a coat feels tight where the arm bends.

senseEn: a medical doctor
en: Can my physician send the report directly to this clinic?
zh: 我的医生能把报告直接发给这家诊所吗？
transfer: 问前台是否要先约家庭医生再见专科医生。
transferEn: Ask whether to see a primary care doctor before scheduling a specialist.

senseEn: a dishonest scheme intended to trick people
en: Could this ticket offer be a scam? The venue has no such show.
zh: 这张票的优惠会不会是骗局？场馆没有这场演出。
transfer: 告诉朋友你为什么怀疑某条中奖短信是骗局。
transferEn: Explain why a prize message seems fraudulent to you.

senseEn: the raised area where train passengers board
en: Which platform does the coastal train leave from?
zh: 海岸线列车从哪个站台发车？
transfer: 约朋友在三号站台的钟下碰面。
transferEn: Arrange to meet beneath the clock where trains board on track three.

senseEn: goods taken as loot
en: Where did the pirates hide the stolen booty in the story?
zh: 故事里的海盗把抢来的财宝藏在哪里了？
transfer: 读历史小说时询问船从岛上带走了哪些战利品。
transferEn: Ask what spoils a ship carried away from an island in a historical novel.

senseEn: a piece of writing developing an argument or idea
en: Can I revise my essay after the feedback session?
zh: 反馈会后我可以修改文章吗？
transfer: 向老师确认申请短文最多能写多少字。
transferEn: Ask the word limit for a short piece of application writing.

senseEn: with great intensity or force
en: It's raining heavily at the campsite. Are you still coming?
zh: 营地在下大雨，你们还来吗？
transfer: 向朋友描述回家路上雪下得有多大。
transferEn: Describe how intensely it snowed on your way home.
