senseEn: involving a striking reversal of expectations
en: Isn't it ironic that the clockmaker was the only one late?
zh: 钟表匠是唯一迟到的人，是不是挺讽刺？
transfer: 讲述一本讲整理的书偏偏被弄丢的反差。
transferEn: Describe the irony of losing a book about staying organized.

senseEn: a small amount held between finger and thumb
en: Add a pinch of salt before tasting the soup.
zh: 尝汤前加一小撮盐。
transfer: 做饼干时问一小撮肉桂是否足够。
transferEn: Ask whether a tiny amount of cinnamon between the fingers is enough for cookies.

senseEn: a meeting arranged for a particular time and place
en: Is our rendezvous still at the clock tower at noon?
zh: 我们还是中午在钟楼碰面吗？
transfer: 和分头参观的游客约定集合地点。
transferEn: Set up an agreed meeting with visitors exploring separately.

senseEn: a sheltered home used by a wild animal
en: Is that a fox den beneath the roots?
zh: 树根底下是狐狸窝吗？
transfer: 问向导冬眠的熊通常在哪里筑窝。
transferEn: Ask where a hibernating bear usually makes its sheltered home.

senseEn: a large venue with stands for sports events
en: Which stadium entrance is nearest our seats?
zh: 体育场哪个入口离我们的座位最近？
transfer: 询问周日体育场能否参观更衣室。
transferEn: Ask whether a large sports venue offers locker-room tours on Sunday.

senseEn: the currency unit of Japan
en: Can I pay in yen at this counter?
zh: 这个柜台可以用日元付款吗？
transfer: 问菜单上的价格是按日元还是美元标的。
transferEn: Ask whether menu prices use Japanese or US currency.

senseEn: a pile of items placed one on top of another
en: Put the clean bowls on that stack beside the sink.
zh: 把洗好的碗放到水槽旁那摞上。
transfer: 整理讲义时问哪一摞要发给新生。
transferEn: Ask which pile of handouts is for new students.

senseEn: causing discomfort or displeasure
en: There's an unpleasant smell coming from the drain.
zh: 排水口散发出一股难闻的气味。
transfer: 描述你在闷热车厢里的不愉快体验。
transferEn: Describe an uncomfortable experience in a stuffy train carriage.

senseEn: extremely large in extent
en: Can visitors walk across the vast salt flats in winter?
zh: 游客冬天可以走过那片辽阔的盐滩吗？
transfer: 向朋友描述山顶视野覆盖的广阔平原。
transferEn: Describe the immense plain visible from a mountain summit.

senseEn: a piece of fabric used for wiping
en: Use a damp cloth to wipe the table.
zh: 用湿抹布把桌子擦一擦。
transfer: 清理颜料时问哪块布可以弄脏。
transferEn: Ask which piece of fabric you may stain while cleaning paint.

senseEn: a large container for taking a bath
en: Does the room have a bathtub as well as a shower?
zh: 这间房除了淋浴还有浴缸吗？
transfer: 告诉房东浴缸边缘的裂缝在哪里。
transferEn: Tell a landlord where the edge of the bath has cracked.

senseEn: a claim formally brought before a court
en: Was the lawsuit settled before the trial began?
zh: 这起诉讼在开庭前就和解了吗？
transfer: 阅读报道时核实诉讼是由谁提起的。
transferEn: Identify who brought a legal claim in a news report.

senseEn: a person whose job is to examine an incident
en: Will the insurance investigator need photos of the roof?
zh: 保险调查员需要屋顶的照片吗？
transfer: 问物业哪位调查员会查看漏水情况。
transferEn: Ask which person examining the incident will inspect a building leak.

senseEn: someone who gathers and reports news
en: Did the journalist interview both shop owners?
zh: 那位记者采访了两家店的店主吗？
transfer: 给读书会介绍要来报道活动的记者。
transferEn: Introduce the news reporter covering a book-club event.

senseEn: in a favorable or encouraging way
en: Did the students respond positively to the later start?
zh: 学生们对推迟上课时间反应积极吗？
transfer: 告诉同事顾客对新版菜单反响很好。
transferEn: Tell a coworker that customers reacted favorably to the new menu.

senseEn: to have something as an ingredient or component
en: Does this dressing contain sesame oil?
zh: 这种调料含芝麻油吗？
transfer: 问服务员餐包里有没有牛奶。
transferEn: Ask a server whether milk is an ingredient in the rolls.

senseEn: the act of bringing something new into being
en: What inspired the creation of this mural?
zh: 创作这幅壁画的灵感来自哪里？
transfer: 采访作曲家时询问这首歌的创作经历。
transferEn: Ask a composer how a song came into being.

senseEn: one more than seventeen
en: We need eighteen copies for the afternoon group.
zh: 下午组需要十八份。
transfer: 订桌时告诉餐厅两桌一共十八位客人。
transferEn: Reserve two tables for a total of nine plus nine guests.

senseEn: writing that tells invented stories
en: Is this shelf for historical fiction or biographies?
zh: 这排书架放的是历史小说还是传记？
transfer: 问图书管理员哪里可以找到以城市为背景的虚构故事。
transferEn: Ask where to find invented stories set in cities.

senseEn: the repeated main section of a song
en: Can everyone join in the chorus after the second verse?
zh: 第二段主歌唱完后，大家能一起唱副歌吗？
transfer: 请乐队先排练那段重复出现的副歌。
transferEn: Ask the band to rehearse the recurring part of the song first.

senseEn: a newly designed device or method
en: Which invention won the science fair this year?
zh: 哪项发明赢得了今年的科学展评奖？
transfer: 请讲解员说明展柜里这项发明原本解决什么问题。
transferEn: Ask what problem a novel device in a display originally solved.

senseEn: a sweet tangy tomato condiment
en: Could we have some ketchup for the fries?
zh: 能给点番茄酱配薯条吗？
transfer: 点外卖时请店家不要放番茄酱包。
transferEn: Ask a takeaway shop to leave out packets of the sweet tomato condiment.

en: Is your name spelled correctly on the badge?
zh: 胸牌上的名字拼对了吗？
transfer: 安装完成后，向师傅确认滤芯装得是否正确。
senseEn: in the right way
transferEn: Ask the installer whether the filter is fitted the right way.

senseEn: intended to prevent damage or injury
en: Should I remove the protective film from this shelf?
zh: 这层搁板上的保护膜要撕掉吗？
transfer: 买平板时询问是否有能保护四角的外壳。
transferEn: Ask whether a tablet case offers cover for all four corners.

senseEn: an old object valued for its age or craftsmanship
en: Is this lamp an antique or a modern copy?
zh: 这盏灯是古董还是现代仿品？
transfer: 在旧货市集问那件古董有没有来历记录。
transferEn: Ask a flea market vendor whether an old collectible has documented provenance.

senseEn: the time when the sun first appears above the horizon
en: Will the lookout open before sunrise tomorrow?
zh: 明天观景台会在日出前开放吗？
transfer: 跟朋友约好在海滩上看日出。
transferEn: Arrange to see the sun first appear from a beach.

senseEn: a toothed tool for arranging hair
en: Has anyone seen my comb by the mirror?
zh: 有人在镜子旁看见我的梳子了吗？
transfer: 旅行前请同伴帮你买一把小梳子。
transferEn: Ask a companion to buy a small toothed hair tool before traveling.

senseEn: to give support or confidence
en: How can we encourage shy students to join the discussion?
zh: 我们可以怎样鼓励害羞的学生参与讨论？
transfer: 朋友第一次演出前，鼓励他大胆上台。
transferEn: Give a friend confidence to go onstage for a first performance.

senseEn: an improper payment offered to influence a decision
en: Did the official report the attempted bribe?
zh: 官员举报了那次行贿企图吗？
transfer: 讨论电影时说明哪笔款项被认定为贿赂。
transferEn: Identify the payment considered corrupt in a film.

senseEn: a small amount added to food or drink
en: Add a dash of vinegar before serving the soup.
zh: 汤上桌前加少许醋。
transfer: 请服务员在咖啡里加一点点牛奶。
transferEn: Ask a server for just a small splash of milk in your coffee.

senseEn: a person who plays or creates music
en: Which local musician composed the theme for the show?
zh: 哪位本地音乐人为这个节目创作了主题曲？
transfer: 在婚礼筹备会上问谁负责联系演奏者。
transferEn: Ask who will contact the music performer for a wedding.

senseEn: a comfort beyond what is ordinarily necessary
en: A private bathroom is a luxury on this camping trip.
zh: 这趟露营有独立浴室算是奢侈享受。
transfer: 比较两家旅馆时说说哪项额外享受值得加钱。
transferEn: Compare two hotels and name the extra comfort worth paying for.

senseEn: in a phrase meaning to reach or contact someone
en: Were you able to get ahold of the caretaker?
zh: 你联系上管理员了吗？
transfer: 说说包裹送错后你有没有联系到送货员。
transferEn: Say whether you managed to reach the courier after a misdelivery.

en: She's passionate about restoring old cinemas.
zh: 她热衷于修复老电影院。
transfer: 面试志愿者时介绍自己长期热衷的环保事业。
senseEn: deeply enthusiastic about something
transferEn: In a volunteer interview, describe an environmental cause you have supported enthusiastically for years.

senseEn: originating somewhere far away or outside the local region
en: Are these exotic plants kept indoors all winter?
zh: 这些外来植物整个冬天都养在室内吗？
transfer: 问园丁哪种外来花卉最早引入了这里。
transferEn: Ask a gardener which flower from another region was introduced here first.

senseEn: extremely angry
en: She was furious about the extra charge on the final bill.
zh: 她对最终账单上的额外收费非常生气。
transfer: 告诉朋友丢失行李为什么让一位乘客勃然大怒。
transferEn: Explain why a lost bag made a passenger extremely angry.

senseEn: a long journey by sea
en: How many days did the voyage from Lisbon take?
zh: 从里斯本出发的航程用了几天？
transfer: 问博物馆导游船员在远航中如何记录日期。
transferEn: Ask how sailors tracked the days on a long sea journey.

senseEn: an aromatic bulb used in cooking
en: Can we order the noodles without garlic?
zh: 点面时能不放大蒜吗？
transfer: 问做饭的朋友这道菜要几瓣大蒜。
transferEn: Ask how many cloves of the aromatic bulb a dish needs.

senseEn: a large deer species found in North America and parts of Asia
en: Was that an elk by the trail camera last night?
zh: 昨晚步道相机旁拍到的是马鹿吗？
transfer: 向向导询问什么时候最常在草原上看见马鹿群。
transferEn: Ask when herds of the large North American deer most often appear in the meadow.

senseEn: to remove something completely
en: Can we eliminate the duplicate entries before printing?
zh: 打印前能把重复项全部去掉吗？
transfer: 向主管建议一种消除排班重叠的方法。
transferEn: Suggest how to remove all overlaps from a shift schedule.

senseEn: genuine in feeling or intention
en: Please accept my sincere thanks for finding the missing drawings.
zh: 谢谢你找回丢失的图纸，请接受我真诚的谢意。
transfer: 给寄宿家庭写一段真心的道别。
transferEn: Write a heartfelt farewell to a host family.

senseEn: to guide the direction of a vehicle
en: Do both passengers get a turn to steer the boat?
zh: 两位乘客都能轮流掌舵吗？
transfer: 在自行车课上问老师急弯时该怎么控制方向。
transferEn: Ask a cycling instructor how to guide a bicycle through a tight bend.

senseEn: a large printed notice or picture for display
en: Who designed the poster for the school concert?
zh: 谁为学校音乐会设计了海报？
transfer: 问店主能否在橱窗张贴寻猫海报。
transferEn: Ask a shopkeeper to display a large printed notice for a missing cat.

senseEn: a device used to slow or stop a vehicle
en: Does the rear brake rub when you spin the wheel?
zh: 转动车轮时后刹车会不会蹭到？
transfer: 租车前请店员检查脚踏车的前刹车。
transferEn: Ask a rental shop to inspect the device that stops the bicycle's front wheel.

senseEn: an area sheltered from direct sunlight
en: Let's move the picnic into the shade before noon.
zh: 中午前把野餐挪到阴凉处吧。
transfer: 问园丁哪种植物适合种在树荫下。
transferEn: Ask a gardener which plant thrives out of direct sunlight beneath a tree.

senseEn: a person overseeing work and workers
en: Can my supervisor sign this expense form?
zh: 我的主管可以签这张报销单吗？
transfer: 问新同事今天当班的主管是谁。
transferEn: Ask a new colleague who oversees today's shift.

senseEn: a distinctive smell, often pleasant
en: Is that citrus scent from the peel in the tea?
zh: 这股柑橘香气来自茶里的果皮吗？
transfer: 试香水时描述你最先闻到的香调。
transferEn: Describe the first smell you notice when testing a perfume.

senseEn: sound reproduced through separate channels
en: Was the concert recorded in stereo?
zh: 音乐会是用立体声录制的吗？
transfer: 请店员演示音箱左右声道的立体声效果。
transferEn: Ask a shop assistant to demonstrate separate left and right sound channels.

senseEn: a separate enclosed part of a larger space
en: Can I reserve a sleeping compartment for two?
zh: 我能订一间双人卧铺包厢吗？
transfer: 请同伴看看行李箱外侧隔层里有没有护照。
transferEn: Ask a companion to check a suitcase's separate outer section for a passport.

senseEn: an adult male duck
en: Is the green-headed drake paired with that brown duck?
zh: 那只绿头公鸭和那只褐色鸭子是一对吗？
transfer: 在湿地参观时请向导指出哪只是公鸭。
transferEn: Ask a wetland guide to point out the male duck.

senseEn: to heat liquid until it bubbles vigorously
en: Should I boil the water before adding the noodles?
zh: 下面条前要把水烧开吗？
transfer: 露营时请同伴烧开一壶水泡茶。
transferEn: Ask a camper to bring a kettle of water to a bubbling point for tea.

senseEn: to look upon something, in literary style
en: The narrator invites us to “behold the sunrise” over the ruins.
zh: 叙述者邀请我们“观赏”废墟上的日出。
transfer: 在舞台朗诵中用文学语气请观众观看眼前的景象。
transferEn: Invite an audience to look upon a scene using literary diction.

senseEn: a formal court judgment of guilt
en: Was the conviction overturned when the new witness appeared?
zh: 新证人出现后，原来的有罪判决被推翻了吗？
transfer: 读案件摘要时分清起诉与定罪发生的日期。
transferEn: Distinguish the date of the charge from the date guilt was formally established.

senseEn: a formal room for receiving guests in an older house
en: Was the front parlor used for music lessons?
zh: 以前临街的客厅是用来上音乐课的吗？
transfer: 参观古宅时询问会客室里的沙发是不是原物。
transferEn: Ask whether a sofa in the old reception room is original to a historic house.

senseEn: the highest point of a mountain
en: Can we see the snowy peak from the village?
zh: 从村里能看到积雪的山峰吗？
transfer: 问向导哪座山峰在晴天可以看到。
transferEn: Ask a guide which summit is visible on a clear day.

senseEn: looseness or extra length in a cord or rope
en: Leave some slack in the cable so the lamp can move.
zh: 电线留一点余量，让灯能挪动。
transfer: 系秋千椅时问绳子需要留多少松量。
transferEn: Ask how much looseness a swing chair's rope needs.

senseEn: an ability to express ideas cleverly and humorously
en: Did her quick wit help her handle the awkward question?
zh: 她是凭机智化解了那个尴尬的问题吗？
transfer: 向朋友介绍一个以机智幽默出名的主持人。
transferEn: Introduce a host known for clever humor to a friend.

senseEn: a small label showing postage has been paid
en: Will one international stamp cover this postcard?
zh: 这张明信片贴一枚国际邮票够吗？
transfer: 在邮局询问能否买一整版纪念邮票。
transferEn: Ask a post office whether it sells full sheets of commemorative postage labels.

senseEn: a portable battery-powered light
en: Did you pack a flashlight for the walk back?
zh: 你带了手电筒照亮回去的路吗？
transfer: 停电时请室友找出抽屉里的手电筒。
transferEn: Ask a roommate for the portable light in the drawer during a power cut.

senseEn: long thin strands of pasta
en: Can I order the spaghetti with tomato sauce instead of cream?
zh: 意大利细面能配番茄酱而不配奶油酱吗？
transfer: 做晚饭前问这种长面条需要煮几分钟。
transferEn: Ask how many minutes the long thin pasta takes to cook.

senseEn: a person hired or politically motivated to murder a prominent figure
en: Does the audience learn the assassin's identity before the final scene?
zh: 观众在最后一幕前就知道刺客是谁了吗？
transfer: 讨论悬疑剧时指出哪位演员演刺客。
transferEn: Identify the actor playing a hired killer in a mystery drama.

senseEn: a large strip of material displaying a message
en: Where can we hang the welcome banner for the fair?
zh: 集市的欢迎横幅可以挂在哪儿？
transfer: 请活动负责人确认横幅上的日期。
transferEn: Ask an organizer to check the date on a large printed hanging sign.

senseEn: a group of animals of one kind living together
en: Is the penguin colony visible from the boardwalk?
zh: 从栈道上能看见企鹅群落吗？
transfer: 问向导观察海鸟聚居地时要离多远。
transferEn: Ask how far to stand from a breeding group of seabirds.

senseEn: to make less heavy
en: Can we lighten the suitcase by mailing these books?
zh: 把书寄走能给行李箱减重吗？
transfer: 徒步前和同伴商量拿掉哪个物件可以减轻背包重量。
transferEn: Discuss what to remove to make a hiking pack less heavy.

senseEn: dependable and consistent in performance
en: Is the Wi-Fi reliable enough for a video interview?
zh: 无线网络稳定到能做视频面试吗？
transfer: 问邻居哪班公交清晨最可靠。
transferEn: Ask which early bus a neighbor can count on.

senseEn: to mix by moving a spoon around
en: Could you stir the sauce while I slice the bread?
zh: 我切面包时你能搅一下酱汁吗？
transfer: 请孩子把牛奶和可可粉搅匀。
transferEn: Ask a child to mix cocoa powder into milk with a spoon.

senseEn: not deep
en: Is the water shallow enough for children near the steps?
zh: 台阶附近的水够浅，适合孩子吗？
transfer: 种薄荷时询问浅盆能否容下根系。
transferEn: Ask whether a low-depth pot is adequate for mint roots.

senseEn: despite what has just been stated
en: The room is small; nevertheless, it fits all six desks.
zh: 房间虽小，仍能放下全部六张桌子。
transfer: 报告中说明调查人数虽少，结果仍值得讨论。
transferEn: Explain that a survey is worth discussing despite its small sample.

senseEn: to shout loudly, in informal speech
en: Give me a holler when the parcel arrives.
zh: 包裹到了就喊我一声。
transfer: 在嘈杂的操场上请朋友看到教练就喊你。
transferEn: Ask a friend to call out when the coach appears on a noisy field.

senseEn: the way a person writes by hand
en: Can you read the handwriting on this old recipe?
zh: 你能看懂这张旧食谱上的字迹吗？
transfer: 通过明信片上的笔迹判断是谁写的。
transferEn: Identify a postcard writer from the way the letters were formed.

senseEn: a loan secured by real estate
en: Does the budget include the monthly mortgage payment?
zh: 预算里包括每月房贷吗？
transfer: 讨论搬家时问一位亲戚还需多久还清房贷。
transferEn: Ask a relative how much longer they expect to repay their home loan.

senseEn: a curved chest bone
en: Does it hurt along the lower rib when you breathe in?
zh: 吸气时下方那根肋骨附近疼吗？
transfer: 请医生指出影像上哪根肋骨受了伤。
transferEn: Ask a doctor which curved chest bone appears injured in an image.

senseEn: a red fruit commonly used as a vegetable
en: Can we share the tomato salad before the main course?
zh: 主菜前我们可以分一份番茄沙拉吗？
transfer: 在菜市场问哪种番茄适合熬酱。
transferEn: Ask a market seller which variety of the red fruit makes good sauce.

senseEn: without clothing, often in an artistic depiction
en: Does the exhibition include a nude figure study?
zh: 展览包括一幅裸体人物习作吗？
transfer: 参观美术课时询问哪些练习属于裸体人体写生。
transferEn: Ask which drawings in an art class study the unclothed human form.

senseEn: a common medium-sized bird often found in towns
en: Did the pigeon on the ledge have a leg band?
zh: 窗沿上的鸽子脚上有环吗？
transfer: 问管理员广场上是否可以喂鸽子。
transferEn: Ask whether feeding the common city birds is allowed in the square.

senseEn: an open public square
en: Does the night market start in the main plaza?
zh: 夜市是从主广场开始的吗？
transfer: 在旅行日记上写下广场中央的雕像。
transferEn: Describe the statue in the center of a public square in a travel diary.

senseEn: to glide over ice on bladed footwear
en: Can we skate outdoors if the rink is closed?
zh: 冰场关闭时我们能去室外滑冰吗？
transfer: 问老师初学者是否能在课程前先滑一圈。
transferEn: Ask whether beginners can glide around the ice before the lesson.

senseEn: added beyond what is already provided
en: Is there an additional charge for wrapping the gift?
zh: 礼品包装要额外收费吗？
transfer: 预订会议室时问能否再加两把椅子。
transferEn: Ask for two extra chairs when booking a meeting room.

senseEn: relatively small or limited
en: We need a modest kitchen with room for two people.
zh: 我们需要一间不大的厨房，能容下两个人就好。
transfer: 介绍社区如何用不多的预算办成展览。
transferEn: Describe how a neighborhood organized an exhibition with limited funds.

senseEn: careless and lacking attention to detail
en: The missing dates make the report look sloppy.
zh: 日期缺失让这份报告显得很马虎。
transfer: 给草稿提意见时，具体指出哪里检查得不仔细。
transferEn: Explain which detail of a draft appears careless during feedback.

senseEn: the place a journey is intended to reach
en: Is the island our final destination or just a stop?
zh: 那座岛是我们的终点，还是只停靠一下？
transfer: 买火车票时把目的地写给售票员看。
transferEn: Write down where you intend to travel for a ticket clerk.

senseEn: the physical need to eat
en: Did the bowl of soup ease your hunger?
zh: 那碗汤让你没那么饿了吗？
transfer: 远足回来描述为何一小份点心没有解饿。
transferEn: After a hike, describe why a small snack did little to satisfy your need for food.

senseEn: to travel by bicycle
en: Can we cycle along the river path after dark?
zh: 天黑后可以沿河边小路骑车吗？
transfer: 邀请同事天气好的时候一起骑车上班。
transferEn: Invite a colleague to commute on bicycles together in good weather.

senseEn: relating to living organisms
en: Which biological processes change as the seed sprouts?
zh: 种子发芽时哪些生物过程会发生变化？
transfer: 在科学课上问池水变化有哪些生物因素。
transferEn: Ask which factors involving living things may change pond water.

senseEn: a substance that sticks things together
en: Will wood glue hold the loose drawer front?
zh: 木工胶能粘住松掉的抽屉面板吗？
transfer: 做纸模型时问哪种胶水干后透明。
transferEn: Ask which adhesive dries clear when making a paper model.

senseEn: a careful examination to assess condition or compliance
en: Will the lift reopen after the safety inspection?
zh: 电梯会在安全检查后重新开放吗？
transfer: 看房前确认是否能看看最近的检查记录。
transferEn: Ask for the most recent examination record before viewing a property.

senseEn: material fired from weapons, discussed as a historical category
en: Is the cabinet marked “historical ammunition” part of the new museum exhibit?
zh: 标着“历史弹药”的柜子是博物馆新展的一部分吗？
transfer: 向导览员询问展签中“弹药”一词在旧军需清单里指哪类物资。
transferEn: Ask a guide about the category for projectiles in an old supply list.

senseEn: repeated unwanted conduct causing distress
en: Who receives harassment complaints during the festival?
zh: 节庆活动期间谁受理骚扰投诉？
transfer: 向管理员询问如何记录反复骚扰你的消息。
transferEn: Ask a moderator how to document repeated unwanted messages.

senseEn: an international voice distress call
en: Did the documentary include the Mayday call from the fishing boat?
zh: 纪录片里有渔船发出的遇险呼叫吗？
transfer: 参观海事馆时询问录音中的遇险呼叫是哪艘船发出的。
transferEn: Ask which boat made the recorded international distress call at a maritime museum.

senseEn: to walk around without a fixed route
en: Can we wander through the market before lunch?
zh: 午餐前能在集市里随意逛逛吗？
transfer: 邀请朋友没有目的地在老街散步。
transferEn: Invite a friend to stroll through old streets without a set route.

senseEn: a feeling that hope has been lost
en: What pulled the narrator out of despair after the failed expedition?
zh: 探险失败后，是什么让叙述者走出绝望？
transfer: 讨论小说人物得知回家无望时的心情。
transferEn: Discuss a fictional character's loss of hope about returning home.

senseEn: a long padded seat for several people
en: Will the sofa fit through the narrower doorway?
zh: 这张沙发能搬过那道比较窄的门吗？
transfer: 告诉留宿的朋友毯子放在沙发靠垫后面。
transferEn: Tell a guest where to find blankets behind the cushions of the long seat.

senseEn: the latest time for completion
en: Can we move the deadline to Friday afternoon?
zh: 能把截止时间改到周五下午吗？
transfer: 询问摄影比赛收作品的最后日期。
transferEn: Ask the latest date for submitting pictures to a contest.

senseEn: a Mexican spirit made from blue agave
en: Does the sauce contain any tequila, or just lime juice?
zh: 酱汁里有龙舌兰酒，还是只有青柠汁？
transfer: 在菜单上确认哪款鸡尾酒含有龙舌兰蒸馏酒。
transferEn: Ask which cocktail on the menu contains the agave spirit.

senseEn: designed for use across different types or models
en: Will this universal adapter work with our old projector?
zh: 这个通用转接头能配我们的旧投影仪吗？
transfer: 在店里确认通用遥控器是否支持自家的电视。
transferEn: Ask whether a multi-model remote works with your television.

senseEn: an initial employment period used to assess suitability
en: Is paid leave available during probation?
zh: 试用期可以休带薪假吗？
transfer: 询问招聘人员试用期结束时如何评估工作表现。
transferEn: Ask a recruiter how performance is reviewed at the end of the trial employment period.

senseEn: as indicated by available evidence
en: The sign is still up, but evidently the shop has moved.
zh: 招牌还在，不过看样子店已经搬走了。
transfer: 看到新座位表后说明演出安排显然已更改。
transferEn: Infer from a new seating chart that a performance arrangement has apparently changed.

senseEn: to successfully finish something intended
en: What can we accomplish before the hall opens at nine?
zh: 九点礼堂开放之前，我们能完成哪些事？
transfer: 结束小组学习前总结今天达成了什么。
transferEn: Summarize what the study group managed to finish today.

senseEn: to separate something into parts
en: Can we divide the dough into twelve equal pieces?
zh: 我们能把面团分成十二个等份吗？
transfer: 分摊住宿费时问大家想按人还是按房间来分。
transferEn: Ask how to split lodging costs between travelers.

senseEn: a particular capability of a product
en: Does the timer have a pause feature?
zh: 这个计时器有暂停功能吗？
transfer: 询问订票应用的哪项功能能追踪票价。
transferEn: Ask which capability in a booking app tracks fares.

en: Use a pencil to poke a hole in the cardboard.
zh: 用铅笔在硬纸板上戳个洞。
transfer: 做花盆时请朋友在纸杯底戳一个排水孔。
senseEn: to make an opening by pushing something through
transferEn: Ask a friend to make a drainage hole in the base of a paper cup planter.

senseEn: to identify someone or something encountered before
en: Did you recognise the tune before the singer came in?
zh: 歌手开唱前你就认出曲调了吗？
transfer: 写信问英国朋友能不能认出旧照片中的街道。
transferEn: Ask a British friend whether they can identify a familiar street in an old photograph.

senseEn: a person employed to clean and care for rooms
en: Did the housekeeper find my scarf behind the door?
zh: 客房清洁人员在门后找到我的围巾了吗？
transfer: 告诉前台你想向整理房间的工作人员道谢。
transferEn: Tell reception you want to thank the person who cared for your room.

senseEn: a military unit usually made up of companies
en: Which battalion name appears on the old memorial?
zh: 旧纪念碑上刻着哪个营的名称？
transfer: 在历史档案中询问这张合影记录的是哪个营。
transferEn: Ask which military unit of several companies appears in an archival group photograph.

senseEn: a nonfiction film presenting real events or subjects
en: Does the documentary include interviews with former miners?
zh: 这部纪录片有对老矿工的采访吗？
transfer: 向朋友推荐一部记录候鸟迁徙的影片。
transferEn: Recommend a nonfiction film following migrating birds.

senseEn: with an urgent or intense need
en: We desperately need one more driver for tomorrow's trip.
zh: 明天出游我们急需再找一位司机。
transfer: 向朋友解释为什么失物招领处那天急需译员。
transferEn: Explain why lost property urgently needed an interpreter that day.

senseEn: having a sharp acidic taste
en: Are the green plums too sour to eat yet?
zh: 青李子现在是不是还太酸，不好吃？
transfer: 试酱汁后告诉厨师你觉得有点酸。
transferEn: Tell a cook the sauce tastes slightly acidic.

senseEn: unclear, especially in an image or memory
en: The date is too fuzzy to read in this photo.
zh: 照片上的日期太模糊，看不清。
transfer: 向同学说明自己对上次讲座的细节记不太清了。
transferEn: Tell a classmate that the details of the last lecture are unclear in your memory.

senseEn: loose clothes worn for sleeping
en: Did you pack warm pajamas for the cabin?
zh: 去住小木屋你带了保暖睡衣吗？
transfer: 为孩子买睡衣时问有没有棉质的。
transferEn: Ask for cotton sleepwear when shopping for a child.

senseEn: a small individual baked cake or bread
en: Does the blueberry muffin contain walnuts?
zh: 蓝莓松饼里有核桃吗？
transfer: 买早餐时请面包师把松饼对半切。
transferEn: Ask a baker to halve a small breakfast cake.

senseEn: to close something forcefully and noisily
en: Please don't slam the gate; the latch is loose.
zh: 请别猛关大门，门闩松了。
transfer: 提醒同伴别用力摔出租车门。
transferEn: Remind a companion to close a taxi door without banging it.

senseEn: a statement explaining what a word or concept means
en: Does this dictionary give a simpler definition of erosion?
zh: 这本词典有没有给出更简单的“侵蚀”定义？
transfer: 请老师说明统计作业中“样本”的定义。
transferEn: Ask a teacher how the statistics assignment defines a sample.

senseEn: one less than eighteen
en: There are seventeen names on the volunteer list.
zh: 志愿者名单上有十七个名字。
transfer: 发讲义时告诉老师十八份里已经发了十七份。
transferEn: Tell a teacher how many of eighteen handouts you have distributed if one remains.

sense: 祝用餐愉快（借用法语短语）
senseEn: part of a borrowed French wish for an enjoyable meal
en: Our host said “Bon appétit” as she served the soup.
zh: 主人端上汤时说了句“祝大家用餐愉快”。
transfer: 开饭前，借用法语短语向客人送上用餐祝福。
transferEn: Wish guests an enjoyable meal using a borrowed French expression.

senseEn: a system of production, trade and employment in a place
en: How important is fishing to the island economy?
zh: 渔业对这座岛的经济有多重要？
transfer: 问导游旅游业如何改变了当地经济。
transferEn: Ask a guide how tourism changed local trade and employment.

sense: 酷儿（部分人自我认同用语，用于他人须顾及语境）
senseEn: a reclaimed LGBTQ+ identity term that can offend when imposed on others
en: The artist describes herself as a queer woman in the catalog.
zh: 艺术家在目录中把自己描述为酷儿女性。
transfer: 介绍一位作家时，准确转述作者为自己选用的身份称呼。
transferEn: Introduce a writer using the LGBTQ+ identity term the writer chose for themself.

senseEn: a professional who treats animals
en: Can the vet see our rabbit before closing?
zh: 兽医下班前能看看我们的兔子吗？
transfer: 问邻居哪位兽医周末看诊。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor which animal doctor works on weekends.

senseEn: relating to traditional systems of combat practiced as disciplines
en: Is the martial arts class open to absolute beginners?
zh: 武术课接受完全没有基础的人吗？
transfer: 向运动中心询问传统武术表演的时间。
transferEn: Ask a sports center when the traditional combat-arts demonstration begins.

senseEn: a group of monkeys living together
en: Did you see a troop of monkeys near the stream?
zh: 你在溪边看到一群猴子了吗？
transfer: 向向导询问观察到的两个猴群是否生活在同一区域。
transferEn: Ask whether the two observed groups of monkeys occupy the same area.

senseEn: extremely funny
en: That hilarious scene with the broken umbrella got the loudest laugh.
zh: 那段坏雨伞的戏特别好笑，引来了最大的一阵笑声。
transfer: 向朋友推荐一段让你笑个不停的短片。
transferEn: Recommend a short film that made you laugh uncontrollably.

senseEn: required by duty or agreement
en: Are we obliged to return the boxes to the supplier?
zh: 我们必须把箱子退回供应商吗？
transfer: 问主办方志愿者是否有义务出席所有例会。
transferEn: Ask whether every regular meeting is compulsory for volunteers.

senseEn: a continuous sequence of similar results
en: Did the draw end their winning streak?
zh: 这场平局终结了他们的连胜纪录吗？
transfer: 问朋友她连续每天跑步的纪录持续了多久。
transferEn: Ask a friend how long her series of uninterrupted daily runs lasted.

senseEn: the local area around someone's home
en: Is this a quiet neighbourhood after the shops close?
zh: 商店关门后这个街区安静吗？
transfer: 给英国朋友写信，介绍新家附近的街区。
transferEn: Describe the local area around your new home to a British friend.

senseEn: to pull a vehicle with another vehicle
en: Will the garage tow my car from the station?
zh: 修车厂能从车站把我的车拖走吗？
transfer: 问管理员临时停在入口的车是否会被拖走。
transferEn: Ask whether a vehicle left in an entrance will be removed by a tow truck.

senseEn: a Spanish title equivalent to Mr.
en: Does this old program print “Senor Rivera” without the Spanish accent mark?
zh: 这份旧节目单是否没写西班牙语附加符号，印成了“Senor Rivera”？
transfer: 编辑英文历史引文时，核对西班牙语先生称谓的转写。
transferEn: Check the transliteration of a Spanish title for a man in an English historical quotation.

senseEn: a range of different kinds
en: Does the market sell a variety of local cheeses?
zh: 市场上卖多种本地奶酪吗？
transfer: 给朋友推荐一个有各种难度步道的公园。
transferEn: Recommend a park with paths at a range of difficulty levels.

senseEn: informally, stylish in an elegant way
en: That classy little lamp would look great in the guest room.
zh: 那盏雅致的小灯放在客房里会很好看。
transfer: 称赞朋友挑的请柬既简单又有格调。
transferEn: Compliment a friend's simple, stylish choice of invitation.

senseEn: a separate page within a browser window
en: Can you open the map in a new tab?
zh: 你能在新标签页里打开地图吗？
transfer: 远程演示前提醒同事关闭私人邮箱标签页。
transferEn: Remind a colleague to close their personal email page before screen sharing.

senseEn: to clean with a powered suction device
en: Could you vacuum the rug before our guests arrive?
zh: 客人到之前能给地毯吸一下尘吗？
transfer: 向酒店询问何时方便给房间吸尘。
transferEn: Ask a hotel when staff can clean the room using a suction cleaner.

senseEn: a thin crisp savory biscuit
en: Can I try a plain cracker with this cheese?
zh: 能拿一片原味薄脆饼干配这块奶酪尝尝吗？
transfer: 打包便当时问孩子想带哪种咸饼干。
transferEn: Ask a child which savory crisp biscuits they want in their lunchbox.

senseEn: a social event where people dance to recorded music
en: What time does the school disco finish on Friday?
zh: 周五学校的迪斯科舞会几点结束？
transfer: 为慈善舞会做准备时确认谁负责放舞曲。
transferEn: Check who will play recorded dance music at a charity dance.

senseEn: a written order instructing a bank to pay someone
en: Can I pay the deposit by cheque?
zh: 我可以用支票交订金吗？
transfer: 问英国学校支票抬头应该写给谁。
transferEn: Ask a British school whose name belongs on an order for bank payment.

senseEn: to feel bitterness about unfair treatment
en: Do the volunteers resent the change to their shifts?
zh: 志愿者对排班变动有怨气吗？
transfer: 向朋友解释为什么你对最后一刻才被告知决定感到不快。
transferEn: Explain why being told of a decision at the last minute made you feel bitter.

senseEn: the bound edge of a book
en: Is the title still visible on the spine?
zh: 书脊上的书名还看得见吗？
transfer: 借书时向馆员指出书脊原本就有裂口。
transferEn: Show a librarian that the bound edge of a book was already split.

senseEn: relating to the face
en: Does the clinic treat facial injuries on weekends?
zh: 诊所周末处理面部受伤吗？
transfer: 问摄影老师应如何拍摄面部表情。
transferEn: Ask a photography teacher about capturing expressions of the face.

senseEn: a soft steady light
en: Can you see the orange glow above the hills?
zh: 你看得见山丘上方的橙色光辉吗？
transfer: 描述夜灯在墙上投出的柔和光亮。
transferEn: Describe the soft light a nightlight casts on a wall.

senseEn: resentment arising from envy or fear of losing affection
en: Does the final letter reveal his jealousy?
zh: 最后那封信显露了他的嫉妒吗？
transfer: 讨论故事时解释某次争吵如何源于嫉妒。
transferEn: Explain how envy triggered an argument in a story.

senseEn: matching other information or actions
en: Are these totals consistent with the signed invoices?
zh: 这些合计数和签过字的发票一致吗？
transfer: 请同事确认两份公告的开放时间一致。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to check that two notices give matching opening hours.

senseEn: a cereal grain used for flour
en: Does this loaf contain wheat flour?
zh: 这条面包含小麦粉吗？
transfer: 问农场主哪块田种的是小麦。
transferEn: Ask a farmer which field grows the grain used in bread flour.

senseEn: a rotating cylinder used to spread or move something
en: Should I use a paint roller on this wide wall?
zh: 这么宽的墙要用滚筒刷吗？
transfer: 到五金店询问哪种滚筒适合粗糙墙面。
transferEn: Ask which cylindrical painting tool suits a rough wall.

senseEn: a child whose parents have died
en: Does the novel say when she became an orphan?
zh: 小说有没有说她什么时候成了孤儿？
transfer: 讨论传记时解释谁在孩子失去父母后抚养了他。
transferEn: Explain who raised the child in a biography after both parents died.

senseEn: an exclamation expressing delight or celebration
en: Hooray, the garden is open again!
zh: 太好了，花园重新开放了！
transfer: 队友宣布比赛获胜后，发出一声庆祝的欢呼。
transferEn: Give a cheer when a teammate announces that your team won.

senseEn: a barrier holding back a body of water
en: Can visitors walk across the dam on Sundays?
zh: 周日游客可以步行穿过水坝吗？
transfer: 问导游建坝之前河谷是什么样。
transferEn: Ask a guide what a valley looked like before the water barrier was built.

senseEn: tending to cling to a surface
en: The tabletop is still sticky after the juice spill.
zh: 果汁洒了以后，桌面还是黏黏的。
transfer: 给孩子洗手前指出他手指上沾了黏糖浆。
transferEn: Point out the syrup clinging to a child's fingers before washing hands.

senseEn: to be alert to a possible danger
en: The sign says “Beware of falling rocks” beyond this bend.
zh: 牌子上写着“弯道前方当心落石”。
transfer: 给访客写个简短提醒，叫他们小心湿滑台阶。
transferEn: Write a short warning to visitors about slippery steps.

senseEn: someone who cares for and maintains a building
en: Could the janitor unlock the art room before class?
zh: 楼宇管理员能在上课前打开美术教室吗？
transfer: 向学校办公室打听谁能联系到当天值班的管理员。
transferEn: Ask the school office how to reach the building caretaker on duty.

senseEn: relating to a navy
en: Is the naval museum open during the harbor festival?
zh: 港口节期间海军博物馆开放吗？
transfer: 请讲解员指出海军制服与商船制服的区别。
transferEn: Ask a guide how a navy uniform differs from a merchant sailor's.

senseEn: someone employed to protect another person
en: Was the actor accompanied by a bodyguard at the premiere?
zh: 那位演员出席首映时有保镖陪同吗？
transfer: 讨论电影时说明哪位角色受雇保护歌手。
transferEn: Identify the character hired to protect a singer in a film.

senseEn: an amount that fits in one hand
en: Add a handful of chopped herbs before serving.
zh: 上桌前加一把切碎的香草。
transfer: 分装零食时让孩子抓一把坚果。
transferEn: Ask a child to take as many nuts as fit in one hand when packing a snack.

senseEn: the amount of light reaching a camera sensor
en: Was the exposure too long for a moving cyclist?
zh: 拍摄移动中的骑车人时是不是曝光时间太长了？
transfer: 夜拍前问摄影老师应该如何调整曝光时间。
transferEn: Ask a teacher how to adjust the time the camera sensor receives light for a night photo.

senseEn: an edible plant or part of one used in a savory meal
en: Which vegetable goes into the soup first?
zh: 做这道汤时先放哪种蔬菜？
transfer: 问朋友能否带一种时令蔬菜来野餐。
transferEn: Ask a friend to bring a seasonal vegetable for a picnic.

senseEn: the end of a sleeve around the wrist
en: Could you repair the frayed cuff on this jacket?
zh: 能帮我修一下这件夹克磨毛的袖口吗？
transfer: 试衬衫时说明左边袖口有点紧。
transferEn: Explain that a shirt feels tight at the left wrist when trying it on.

senseEn: someone with wealth of at least a million currency units
en: Was the inventor a millionaire when she sold the company?
zh: 发明家卖掉公司时已经是百万富翁了吗？
transfer: 读传记时问主人公何时积累了百万身家。
transferEn: Ask when a biography's subject reached a million in personal wealth.

senseEn: a historical period with particular characteristics
en: Were these lamps common in the steam era?
zh: 这些灯在蒸汽时代常见吗？
transfer: 问讲解员那座车站属于铁路发展的哪个时代。
transferEn: Ask which period of railway development a station belongs to.

senseEn: water overflowing onto normally dry land
en: Did the footbridge survive last year's flood?
zh: 人行桥经受住了去年的洪水吗？
transfer: 向老人询问洪水过后哪条街最先恢复通行。
transferEn: Ask which street reopened first after the inundation.

senseEn: a motor vehicle used on roads
en: Is this vintage automobile still driven in the summer parade?
zh: 这辆老爷车现在还会在夏季游行里上路吗？
transfer: 参观交通展时问哪辆汽车最早使用电力。
transferEn: Ask which car at a transport exhibit first used electric power.

senseEn: a person trained to provide medical care, often at events
en: Is there a medic at the finish line?
zh: 终点线有医护人员吗？
transfer: 问组织者哪位现场医护负责接待不舒服的选手。
transferEn: Ask which medical worker will see competitors who feel unwell.

senseEn: to draw attention or interest
en: Will the book swap attract more families to the library?
zh: 图书交换能吸引更多家庭来图书馆吗？
transfer: 和同事讨论怎样吸引新人加入合唱团。
transferEn: Discuss how to draw new members to the choir.

senseEn: to make fun of someone, playfully or unkindly
en: Please don't tease him about his first-day mistake.
zh: 请别拿他第一天犯的错来取笑他。
transfer: 当同学拿新生的口音开玩笑时劝他停止。
transferEn: Ask a classmate to stop making fun of a newcomer's accent.

senseEn: to start again after a pause
en: Will the ferry service resume tomorrow if the wind drops?
zh: 如果风小了，渡轮明天会恢复吗？
transfer: 问老师排练休息后几点继续。
transferEn: Ask a teacher when rehearsal will start again after a break.

senseEn: to say someone did something wrong
en: Did anyone accuse the driver before checking the camera?
zh: 有人在查监控前就指责司机了吗？
transfer: 讨论推理剧时说明是谁最先指控了管家。
transferEn: Explain who first blamed the housekeeper in a mystery drama.

senseEn: in one's mind or emotional state
en: I was mentally prepared for the interview, but I forgot my notes.
zh: 我面试的心理准备都做好了，却忘带笔记。
transfer: 向教练解释你在比赛前如何调整心态。
transferEn: Tell a coach how you prepare your mind before competition.

senseEn: an organized electronic collection of records
en: Is my old address still in the customer database?
zh: 客户数据库里是否还存着我的旧地址？
transfer: 问图书管理员哪个数据库可以检索旧报纸。
transferEn: Ask which collection of searchable electronic records contains old newspapers.

senseEn: a short section of video or sound
en: Can I show a short clip from the rehearsal?
zh: 我能放一小段排练录像吗？
transfer: 请朋友发一段宠物第一次游泳的视频片段。
transferEn: Ask a friend for a brief video of a pet's first swim.

senseEn: an informal expression of praise often addressed to a boy
en: The coach called “Attaboy, Ben!” after the catch.
zh: 本接住球后，教练喊道：“好样的，本！”
transfer: 在讲述队史时转述教练对小球员的一句称赞。
transferEn: Retell a coach's informal praise for a young player in a team history.

senseEn: a device that produces electricity
en: Does the backup generator power the freezer too?
zh: 备用发电机也给冰柜供电吗？
transfer: 问露营场工作人员发电机夜里会不会响。
transferEn: Ask campground staff whether the electricity-producing machine runs noisily at night.

senseEn: a squat amphibian usually with rough skin
en: Was the toad under the pot when you moved it?
zh: 你挪花盆时那只蟾蜍在下面吗？
transfer: 在自然课比较青蛙和蟾蜍的皮肤。
transferEn: Compare a frog's skin with that of the rough-skinned amphibian in nature class.

senseEn: striking and impressive to look at
en: Is the waterfall as spectacular in winter as it is in spring?
zh: 瀑布冬天和春天一样壮观吗？
transfer: 给朋友描述烟花表演最壮观的一刻。
transferEn: Describe the most impressive moment of a fireworks show.

senseEn: able to cause death
en: The sign warns of lethal currents beyond the rocks.
zh: 警示牌提醒岩石外有致命水流。
transfer: 问护林员哪种野果对人可能致命。
transferEn: Ask a ranger which wild berries can cause death if eaten.

senseEn: a subject that occupies someone's thoughts persistently
en: When did collecting maps become an obsession for you?
zh: 你从什么时候开始对收藏地图如此痴迷？
transfer: 描述小说主人公对找回旧钟的执着。
transferEn: Describe a fictional character's consuming interest in recovering an old clock.

senseEn: a dining place where customers select food at a counter
en: Does the cafeteria serve dinner after the evening lecture?
zh: 晚间讲座结束后食堂还供晚餐吗？
transfer: 向学校问食堂是否接受访客现金付款。
transferEn: Ask whether visitors may pay cash at the school dining hall.

senseEn: formal intensive questioning
en: In the film, does the interrogation take place before the lawyer arrives?
zh: 影片里审讯是在律师到来之前进行的吗？
transfer: 讨论庭审报道时确认正式讯问持续了多久。
transferEn: Check the duration of formal questioning in a court report.

senseEn: an amount lifted with a rounded serving utensil
en: Could I have one scoop of lemon sorbet?
zh: 能给我一勺柠檬雪葩吗？
transfer: 买咖啡粉时问冲一壶需要几勺。
transferEn: Ask how many rounded measures of ground coffee are needed for a pot.

en: My sister sells her handmade bowls at the craft fair.
zh: 我姐姐在手工艺集市上卖她亲手做的碗。
transfer: 给夏令营报名时，询问有没有手工艺课。
senseEn: the making of things by hand
transferEn: Ask whether summer camp offers classes in making things by hand.

senseEn: an informal term for a dishonest person or criminal
en: In the story, how does the clerk realize the buyer is a crook?
zh: 故事中店员是怎么意识到买家是骗子的？
transfer: 讨论小说时区别哪个角色真是骗子、哪个只是被误会。
transferEn: Discuss which fictional character is actually dishonest and which was wrongly suspected.

senseEn: informal shorthand for information gathered about something
en: Any fresh intel on when the café reopens?
zh: 咖啡馆什么时候重开，有新消息吗？
transfer: 随口问朋友音乐节的排队情况有什么新消息。
transferEn: Casually ask a friend for the latest information on lines at a festival.

senseEn: an organized journey for exploration or research
en: Who keeps the field notes on the research expedition?
zh: 这次科考远征由谁记录实地笔记？
transfer: 问博物馆这支海洋考察队用了哪艘船。
transferEn: Ask which vessel a team used on an organized ocean research trip.

senseEn: certain to happen despite efforts to prevent it
en: Is a delay really inevitable, or can we open the side gate?
zh: 延误真的不可避免吗，还是可以打开侧门？
transfer: 和同事讨论材料涨价是否一定会导致预算增加。
transferEn: Discuss whether higher material prices must result in a bigger budget.

senseEn: comfortably warm and inviting
en: Can we sit in the cozy corner by the fireplace?
zh: 我们能坐在壁炉旁那个温馨的角落吗？
transfer: 向朋友形容冬天的小旅馆有多温暖舒适。
transferEn: Describe the warm, welcoming feel of a small winter inn.

senseEn: in the end after various developments
en: Who ultimately decided to move the exhibition outside?
zh: 最后是谁决定把展览移到室外的？
transfer: 回顾搬家计划时说说最终选择了哪个社区。
transferEn: Looking back on a move, say which neighborhood you chose in the end.

senseEn: great pleasure or happiness
en: To my delight, the old camera still worked.
zh: 令我高兴的是，那台老相机还能用。
transfer: 讲述孩子拆开礼物时的欣喜。
transferEn: Describe a child's great pleasure at opening a gift.

senseEn: regarded as decent and worthy of respect
en: The memoir portrays him as a respectable neighbor who quietly helped others.
zh: 回忆录把他描写成一位默默助人的可敬邻居。
transfer: 介绍一位凭诚信赢得社区敬重的店主。
transferEn: Introduce a decent shopkeeper who earned the community's respect.

senseEn: a small roughly built structure
en: Is the fishing shack by the harbor still in use?
zh: 港口旁那间简陋的渔屋还在用吗？
transfer: 给徒步者指路，告诉他红色小棚屋在哪里。
transferEn: Direct a hiker to a roughly built red hut.

senseEn: the curved path of one body around another in space
en: Will the map show the satellite's orbit during the eclipse?
zh: 地图会显示食期间卫星的轨道吗？
transfer: 请老师画出月球绕地球运行的路线。
transferEn: Ask a teacher to draw the moon's path around Earth.

senseEn: to change slightly to fit a need
en: Can you adjust the shelf so taller bottles fit?
zh: 能调一下搁板，让高瓶子也放得下吗？
transfer: 骑车前请店员把车座调到合适高度。
transferEn: Ask a shop assistant to set a bicycle seat to the right height.

senseEn: the most important defining quality or idea
en: Does this caption capture the essence of the whole exhibition?
zh: 这段说明抓住了整个展览的核心吗？
transfer: 用一句话向同学解释故事最核心的主题。
transferEn: Explain a story's central idea to a classmate in one sentence.

senseEn: to keep something in good condition for the future
en: How can we preserve these letters without damaging the ink?
zh: 我们怎样才能保存这些信又不损坏墨迹？
transfer: 向园丁请教怎样保存这一季采集的种子。
transferEn: Ask a gardener how to keep seeds collected this season in good condition.

senseEn: a pulling force created by lower pressure
en: Has the vacuum lost its suction since yesterday?
zh: 吸尘器从昨天起吸力就减弱了吗？
transfer: 问店员这只浴室挂钩的吸盘吸力是否够用。
transferEn: Ask whether a bathroom hook's suction cup can support a towel.

senseEn: a person hired to drive passengers in a car
en: Will the chauffeur wait inside the terminal or at the curb?
zh: 专车司机会在航站楼里等，还是在路边等？
transfer: 向婚庆公司确认司机几点来接新人。
transferEn: Confirm when the hired wedding driver will collect the couple.

senseEn: a chamber or structure for the dead
en: Does the tour enter the royal tomb or stop outside?
zh: 导览会进入王室墓穴，还是只在外面停留？
transfer: 问博物馆展出的壁画是否来自墓室。
transferEn: Ask a museum whether a displayed mural came from a burial chamber.

en: Does my summer internship satisfy the requirement for this course?
zh: 我的暑期实习符合这门课的要求吗？
transfer: 向房东确认电子账单能否满足住址证明要求。
senseEn: to meet a requirement
transferEn: Ask your landlord whether an electronic bill meets the proof-of-address requirement.

senseEn: the part of a garment covering an arm
en: Can you shorten the left sleeve by a centimeter?
zh: 可以把左袖改短一厘米吗？
transfer: 试雨衣时说袖子举手后会滑到哪里。
transferEn: When trying a raincoat, explain where the arm covering ends when you reach up.

senseEn: the purpose behind an action
en: Was the intent to help visitors find the entrance?
zh: 原意是帮助访客找到入口吗？
transfer: 解释你重新安排座位的用意。
transferEn: Explain the purpose behind a seating change you made.

senseEn: closely connected to the matter at hand
en: Are last year's figures still relevant to this estimate?
zh: 去年的数字对这次估算还有参考价值吗？
transfer: 写求职信时问哪段经历与岗位最相关。
transferEn: Ask which prior experience is most closely connected to the role.

senseEn: to gradually lose color or brightness
en: Will this fabric fade in sunlight?
zh: 这种布料在阳光下会褪色吗？
transfer: 问摄影师怎样防止纸质照片变淡。
transferEn: Ask a photographer how to keep prints from losing their colors.

senseEn: an angry disagreement between people
en: Did the quarrel start over the seating plan?
zh: 那场争吵是因为座位安排引起的吗？
transfer: 讨论小说里两姐妹为什么停止争吵。
transferEn: Discuss why two sisters in a novel ended their angry disagreement.

senseEn: the range of matters covered by a task
en: Is the courtyard within the scope of the repairs?
zh: 院子在这次维修范围内吗？
transfer: 和客户确认翻译任务是否包括图片说明。
transferEn: Clarify whether translating captions falls within a client's assignment.

senseEn: a broadleaf tree that produces acorns
en: Can we meet beneath the old oak by the gate?
zh: 我们能在大门旁的老橡树下碰面吗？
transfer: 问管理员哪棵树的橡果可以用来做自然课展示。
transferEn: Ask which acorn-bearing tree can provide specimens for a nature lesson.

senseEn: to leave a place because of danger
en: Which exit should visitors use if they must evacuate the hall?
zh: 如果必须撤离礼堂，访客应该走哪个出口？
transfer: 在消防演习说明会上问轮椅使用者如何撤离。
transferEn: Ask how wheelchair users should leave the building during a drill.

senseEn: a terrible fate or threatened disaster
en: Did the music suggest impending doom before the storm scene?
zh: 风暴那场戏之前，音乐是否暗示厄运将至？
transfer: 描述小说中哪条征兆让主人公觉得厄运临头。
transferEn: Describe the sign that makes a fictional character expect disaster.

senseEn: a state whose head is not a hereditary monarch
en: When did the country become a republic on this timeline?
zh: 时间轴上这个国家何时成为共和国？
transfer: 请历史老师解释为何新宪法采用了共和国这个称号。
transferEn: Ask a history teacher why a new constitution describes the nation as a republic.

senseEn: a bird of prey associated with nighttime activity
en: Was it an owl calling beyond the garden last night?
zh: 昨夜花园那边叫的是猫头鹰吗？
transfer: 去观鸟时向向导询问哪棵树上有猫头鹰栖息。
transferEn: Ask a birdwatching guide which tree is used by a nocturnal bird of prey.

senseEn: trouble in doing or understanding something
en: Are you having difficulty reading the small labels?
zh: 你看这些小标签有困难吗？
transfer: 向辅导员说明你在哪个研究步骤遇到了困难。
transferEn: Tell an adviser which research step you are having trouble with.

senseEn: to seek professional advice from someone
en: Should we consult an engineer before moving that wall?
zh: 移动那面墙前要咨询工程师吗？
transfer: 旅行前询问是否该向医生咨询疫苗问题。
transferEn: Ask whether to seek a clinician's advice about vaccinations before traveling.

senseEn: a serious category of crime in certain legal systems
en: Does the old court record describe the charge as a felony?
zh: 旧法庭记录有没有把这项指控列为重罪？
transfer: 在阅读美国案件摘要时核实记录中的定罪类别。
transferEn: Identify the serious crime category recorded in a US case summary.

senseEn: unwanted material to be thrown away
en: Which day is the rubbish collected on this street?
zh: 这条街星期几收垃圾？
transfer: 在英国度假屋询问厨余垃圾要放进哪个桶。
transferEn: Ask a British host where to put kitchen waste.

senseEn: an informal, often child-oriented word for feces
en: Is that dog poop beside the garden gate?
zh: 花园门旁边那是狗便便吗？
transfer: 提醒遛狗的朋友带上捡便袋。
transferEn: Remind a friend to take bags for picking up a dog's waste.

senseEn: relating to a president or the office of president
en: Is the presidential archive open to the public on Mondays?
zh: 总统档案馆星期一向公众开放吗？
transfer: 问老师哪份报纸刊登了总统选举结果。
transferEn: Ask which newspaper printed the results of the election for president.

senseEn: a school celebration welcoming former students back
en: Can alumni bring guests to the homecoming parade?
zh: 校友能带客人参加返校游行吗？
transfer: 向校友会确认今年返校活动在哪周末举办。
transferEn: Ask the alumni office which weekend former students are invited back.

senseEn: relating to the behavior of matter and energy at very small scales
en: Does the quantum physics lecture assume any calculus?
zh: 量子物理讲座需要微积分基础吗？
transfer: 问老师关于量子理论的入门读物是否适合高中生。
transferEn: Ask whether an introductory book about physics at atomic scales suits high-school students.

senseEn: an unexpected meeting
en: Did your encounter with the artist change how you saw the painting?
zh: 你偶遇画家以后，对那幅画的看法改变了吗？
transfer: 向朋友讲述旅途中意外遇见旧同学的经历。
transferEn: Tell a friend about unexpectedly meeting an old classmate on a trip.

senseEn: one beat or the rhythm of the heart
en: Could you hear the heartbeat through the stethoscope?
zh: 你通过听诊器听到心跳了吗？
transfer: 问护士监护仪上哪个数字表示心跳频率。
transferEn: Ask a nurse which monitor number shows how often the heart beats.

senseEn: to take over someone's duty so they can leave
en: Can you relieve me at reception at noon?
zh: 中午能到前台接替我吗？
transfer: 在志愿活动中询问谁来接替入口处的值班员。
transferEn: Ask who will take over the entrance volunteer's shift.

senseEn: a powerful desire, often for pleasure or power
en: Does the novel portray his lust for power as his downfall?
zh: 小说是否把他对权力的强烈欲望写成了他垮台的原因？
transfer: 在读书会上说明角色对名利的强烈渴望。
transferEn: Describe a character's consuming desire for fame and wealth.

senseEn: a passage connecting spaces inside a building
en: Is the lift at the end of this corridor?
zh: 电梯在这条走廊尽头吗？
transfer: 向护士说明你在哪条走廊捡到了一副眼镜。
transferEn: Tell a nurse which passage you found a pair of glasses in.

senseEn: a sleeveless garment for the upper body
en: Does the safety vest come in a child's size?
zh: 这件安全背心有儿童尺码吗？
transfer: 骑车前问同伴是否带了反光背心。
transferEn: Ask a companion whether they packed a reflective sleeveless garment.

senseEn: recorded or transmitted sound
en: Can you hear the audio when I share this video?
zh: 我分享这个视频时你能听见声音吗？
transfer: 请编辑把采访的音轨单独发给你。
transferEn: Ask an editor to send the sound recording of an interview separately.

senseEn: someone who teaches or coaches a skill
en: Will the trainer show us how to adjust the exercise bikes?
zh: 教练会教我们调健身车吗？
transfer: 向健身房询问哪位教练带初学者伸展课。
transferEn: Ask which coach leads the beginners' stretching class.

senseEn: the means of moving people or goods between places
en: Is transportation from the station included in the tour price?
zh: 团费包括从车站过来的交通吗？
transfer: 询问学校远足是否由家长自行安排交通。
transferEn: Ask whether parents arrange travel for a school outing.

senseEn: to carry out a plan or task
en: Can our small team execute the plan before the hall opens?
zh: 礼堂开放前我们这个小组能执行完计划吗？
transfer: 向负责人确认由谁执行搬迁的最后一步。
transferEn: Confirm who will carry out the final part of a move.

senseEn: to fall down after losing structural support
en: Did the shed roof collapse under the snow?
zh: 棚屋屋顶是被雪压塌的吗？
transfer: 搭帐篷时问哪根支杆缺失会导致整个帐篷塌下。
transferEn: Ask which missing pole would make the tent fall down.

senseEn: the person supervising a crew of manual workers
en: Has the site foreman seen the updated delivery schedule?
zh: 现场工头看过新的送货时间表了吗？
transfer: 问谁能把新来的工人介绍给工头。
transferEn: Ask who can introduce new workers to the crew supervisor.

senseEn: a large ground-dwelling African ape
en: Was the young gorilla asleep during your visit?
zh: 你去参观时那只小大猩猩在睡觉吗？
transfer: 问动物园向导哪块展板介绍大猩猩的食物。
transferEn: Ask which zoo panel describes the diet of the largest African ape.

senseEn: covered with fine dry particles
en: The top shelf is still dusty after the move.
zh: 搬完家后最上层架子还是落满灰。
transfer: 请房东检查通风口是不是积了很多灰。
transferEn: Ask a landlord whether the air vent is coated with dust.

senseEn: an event featuring competitive ranch-riding skills
en: Are tickets for the rodeo sold separately from fair admission?
zh: 牛仔竞技表演的票和集市门票是分开卖的吗？
transfer: 问主办方牛仔竞技表演在哪个场地举办。
transferEn: Ask which arena hosts the competitive ranch-riding event.

senseEn: to make something less tight
en: Could you loosen the strap before I lift the case?
zh: 我抬箱子前你能松一下带子吗？
transfer: 试头盔时请店员把下巴带调松一点。
transferEn: Ask a shop assistant to make a helmet's chin strap less tight.

senseEn: the same in every relevant detail
en: Are these cables identical apart from the color?
zh: 这些线除了颜色以外都一样吗？
transfer: 退货前确认替换品与原来的型号完全相同。
transferEn: Check whether a replacement matches the original model exactly.

senseEn: the ability to focus attention
en: Does background music help your concentration while reading?
zh: 阅读时背景音乐有助于你集中注意力吗？
transfer: 跟室友解释持续的铃声如何影响你的专注。
transferEn: Explain how a persistent ringing sound affects your ability to focus.

senseEn: to send something for official consideration
en: Where should I submit the signed form?
zh: 签好的表格应该交到哪里？
transfer: 参加摄影比赛时确认可以提交几张照片。
transferEn: Check how many photos you may send in for a contest.

senseEn: describing the first journey or use of something
en: Was the ferry's maiden voyage open to residents?
zh: 渡轮首航对居民开放了吗？
transfer: 问博物馆这架飞机首次飞行是哪一年。
transferEn: Ask a museum when an airplane made its first flight.

senseEn: extremely enjoyable or delicious
en: That heavenly smell is coming from the bread oven.
zh: 那股诱人的香味是烤面包的炉子里飘来的。
transfer: 给朋友形容你刚尝过的甜点有多美味。
transferEn: Describe a wonderfully delicious dessert you just tasted.

senseEn: the fundamental legal framework of a state
en: When was the constitution in this display adopted?
zh: 展柜里的这部宪法是哪一年通过的？
transfer: 向老师询问宪法哪一章描述选举制度。
transferEn: Ask which chapter of a country's fundamental legal document describes elections.

senseEn: a pattern of crossing lines forming cells
en: Draw the town plan on a grid so the streets line up.
zh: 把城镇平面图画在方格网上，让街道对齐。
transfer: 请同学在方格纸上标出花园小径的位置。
transferEn: Ask a classmate to mark a garden path on a network of squares.

senseEn: a high-speed road with controlled entry and exits
en: Do we need to take the freeway to reach the airport?
zh: 到机场必须走高速公路吗？
transfer: 问司机不走高速能否到达海滨小镇。
transferEn: Ask a driver whether a coastal town can be reached without using the expressway.

senseEn: a small red fruit with seeds on its surface
en: Is the strawberry tart made with fresh fruit today?
zh: 今天的草莓挞是用新鲜水果做的吗？
transfer: 买冰激凌时问草莓味里有没有果肉。
transferEn: Ask whether the red berry ice cream contains pieces of fruit.

senseEn: someone entering a building to steal
en: In the film, how does the gardener recognize the burglar?
zh: 影片里园丁是怎么认出入室窃贼的？
transfer: 读新闻时区分目击者与被怀疑入室盗窃的人。
transferEn: Distinguish the witness from the suspected house thief in a news report.

senseEn: a city area where a marginalized group was segregated, often by force
en: Does the map show the wartime ghetto boundary?
zh: 地图上标出战时隔离区的边界了吗？
transfer: 在历史展说明为什么应尊重语境，不把这种称呼随意用于普通街区。
transferEn: Explain why this historical term for forced segregation should not be casually applied to neighborhoods.

senseEn: a vehicle making repeated short trips between two points
en: Does the airport shuttle stop at both terminals?
zh: 机场接驳车在两个航站楼都停吗？
transfer: 问酒店是否需要提前预约接驳车。
transferEn: Ask whether to reserve the hotel's transfer vehicle in advance.

senseEn: a very large northern deer with a broad muzzle
en: Did a moose cross the road before you reached the lake?
zh: 你到湖边前有一头驼鹿横穿马路吗？
transfer: 在自然展上请讲解员指出成年驼鹿的脚印。
transferEn: Ask a guide to identify the tracks of a large northern deer.

senseEn: a sweet fizzy drink of a familiar spicy flavor
en: Could I have a small cola with no ice?
zh: 可以给我一小杯不加冰的可乐吗？
transfer: 给晚会买饮料时问大家要无糖可乐还是果汁。
transferEn: Ask guests whether they prefer sugar-free brown soda or juice.

senseEn: sensible and reasonable in a difficult situation
en: Is waiting for daylight the only sane choice in this fog?
zh: 雾这么大，等天亮是不是唯一明智的选择？
transfer: 跟团队讨论怎样把过满的日程改得更合理。
transferEn: Discuss a sensible alternative to an overloaded schedule.

senseEn: an offensive insult for someone regarded as contemptible
en: The editor asked the columnist to remove the insult “scumbag”.
zh: 编辑要求专栏作者删去“卑鄙小人”这个辱称。
transfer: 说明如何把这种人身辱骂改成对具体行为的描述。
transferEn: Explain how an editor could replace this personal insult with a description of conduct.

senseEn: an animal hunted by another animal for food
en: What prey do these owls catch in winter?
zh: 这些猫头鹰冬天捕食什么猎物？
transfer: 请向导指出食物网里哪种动物是狐狸的猎物。
transferEn: Ask a guide which animal in a food web is hunted by foxes.

senseEn: a careful physical check by a clinician
en: Will the eye examination include a vision test?
zh: 眼科检查包括视力测试吗？
transfer: 预约前询问体格检查大约需要多久。
transferEn: Ask how long a physical checkup takes before booking it.

senseEn: relating to an immediate plan during competition
en: Was the early substitution a tactical decision by the coach?
zh: 提前换人是教练的战术决定吗？
transfer: 赛后询问中场休息时球队做了什么战术调整。
transferEn: Ask which change in game strategy the team made at halftime.

senseEn: a sweet drink made with lemon juice
en: Is the homemade lemonade included with lunch?
zh: 午餐包含自制柠檬水吗？
transfer: 在摊位询问能否把柠檬水调得不那么甜。
transferEn: Ask a stall to make the sweet lemon drink less sugary.

senseEn: a large group of musicians playing multiple instrument families
en: Where does the youth orchestra rehearse on Saturdays?
zh: 青年管弦乐团周六在哪里排练？
transfer: 音乐会前问管弦乐团指挥是谁。
transferEn: Ask who conducts the large ensemble before a concert.

senseEn: a flying insect with two pairs of often colorful wings
en: Did the blue butterfly land on your sleeve?
zh: 那只蓝色蝴蝶落在你袖口了吗？
transfer: 问园丁哪些花会吸引蝴蝶。
transferEn: Ask which flowers attract the colorful winged insects to a garden.

senseEn: the politically motivated killing of a prominent person
en: Does the exhibition discuss the election before the assassination?
zh: 展览有没有介绍那起暗杀事件之前的选举？
transfer: 读历史年表时核实暗杀事件发生在哪一年。
transferEn: Check the year of a political killing on a historical timeline.

senseEn: to produce flowers
en: When do the apple trees usually bloom here?
zh: 这里的苹果树通常什么时候开花？
transfer: 问园丁这盆花今年是否还会再开。
transferEn: Ask a gardener whether a potted plant will flower again this year.

senseEn: an exclamation expressing amusement, surprise or disbelief
en: She read the old forecast and said, “Hah, not a drop!”
zh: 她读了旧天气预报，说：“哈，一滴雨也没下！”
transfer: 朋友开玩笑自称认路时，用轻轻一笑回应。
transferEn: Respond with a short amused exclamation when a friend jokingly claims to know the way.

senseEn: to open something secured by a lock
en: Who can unlock the cupboard with the folding chairs?
zh: 谁能打开存放折椅的柜子？
transfer: 请前台用备用钥匙打开你的储物柜。
transferEn: Ask reception to open your locked locker with a spare key.

senseEn: relating to a shop selling food and household supplies
en: Is there a grocery store within walking distance?
zh: 步行范围内有食品杂货店吗？
transfer: 和室友商量本周谁负责采购食品杂货。
transferEn: Arrange with a roommate who will shop for food and household supplies.

senseEn: to have or own something
en: Does the archive possess a copy of the original score?
zh: 档案馆藏有原始乐谱的副本吗？
transfer: 询问博物馆是否拥有那位画家的早期作品。
transferEn: Ask whether a museum owns an artist's early work.

senseEn: a message verifying that an arrangement is complete
en: I received a confirmation email but no seat number.
zh: 我收到了确认邮件，却没有座位号。
transfer: 订房后请旅馆再发一次书面确认。
transferEn: Ask a hotel to resend written proof of a booking.

senseEn: to join or repair materials with thread
en: Can you sew the button back on my coat?
zh: 能帮我把扣子缝回外套上吗？
transfer: 制作窗帘时问朋友能不能缝一道直边。
transferEn: Ask a friend to stitch a straight hem while making curtains.

senseEn: the outer covering of a tree trunk or branch
en: Why is the bark peeling off this plane tree?
zh: 这棵悬铃木为什么在掉树皮？
transfer: 让孩子观察两棵树的树皮纹理。
transferEn: Ask a child to compare the outer coverings of two tree trunks.

senseEn: a specific period allocated for an activity
en: Is there a morning slot for my interview?
zh: 我的面试可以安排在上午的时段吗？
transfer: 问理发师周末下午还有什么空档。
transferEn: Ask a barber about available appointment times on a weekend afternoon.

senseEn: to shed tears, often from strong feeling
en: Did the final scene make the audience weep openly?
zh: 最后一幕让观众当场落泪了吗？
transfer: 讲述重逢时某个角色喜极而泣。
transferEn: Describe a character shedding tears of joy at a reunion.

senseEn: the second month of the year
en: Does the winter market continue through February?
zh: 冬季集市会持续整个二月吗？
transfer: 跟朋友确认旅行订的是二月还是三月。
transferEn: Check whether a trip is booked for the second or third month of the year.

senseEn: large military guns considered collectively
en: Which gallery contains the historical artillery collection?
zh: 哪个展厅陈列着历史火炮藏品？
transfer: 看历史照片时向馆员确认展签中火炮类别的翻译。
transferEn: Ask a curator about the category name for historic large guns in a caption.

senseEn: to bend or twist out of shape
en: Will this shelf warp in a damp bathroom?
zh: 这个架子放在潮湿的浴室会变形吗？
transfer: 问木工把琴放在窗边会不会让木料翘曲。
transferEn: Ask whether window-side storage could bend an instrument's wood out of shape.

senseEn: to pause because of uncertainty
en: What made you hesitate before accepting the offer?
zh: 是什么让你在接受邀请前犹豫了？
transfer: 面试时解释你为什么曾对搬到另一座城犹豫。
transferEn: Explain why you paused over relocating during a job interview.

senseEn: a paved path for pedestrians beside a road
en: Is the sidewalk wide enough for a wheelchair here?
zh: 这里的人行道够宽，轮椅能过吗？
transfer: 告诉朋友施工路段哪侧的人行道开放。
transferEn: Tell a friend which pedestrian path remains open beside roadworks.

senseEn: the scientific study of mind and behavior
en: Does the psychology course cover how children learn languages?
zh: 心理学课程涉及儿童如何学习语言吗？
transfer: 问图书馆员去哪里找心理学入门教材。
transferEn: Ask a librarian for a beginner's textbook on mind and behavior.

senseEn: to allow a group to leave after class or a meeting
en: Will the teacher dismiss the class before the last bus?
zh: 老师会在末班公交车前让大家下课吗？
transfer: 排练结束前问导演什么时候允许临时演员离开。
transferEn: Ask when a director will let the extras leave rehearsal.

senseEn: a dance in triple time usually performed by a pair
en: Is the opening waltz part of tonight's lesson?
zh: 今晚课程包括开场的华尔兹吗？
transfer: 舞会前问乐队会不会演奏三拍子的华尔兹。
transferEn: Ask a band whether it will play a triple-time partner dance.

senseEn: a figure moved by a performer to tell a story
en: Does the fox puppet need two people to operate it?
zh: 这只狐狸木偶需要两个人操纵吗？
transfer: 请孩子为手偶剧挑选一只主角木偶。
transferEn: Ask a child to choose the main figure for a hand-operated show.

senseEn: a small rodent often seen climbing trees
en: Did the squirrel hide a nut in the planter?
zh: 那只松鼠是不是把坚果藏进了花盆？
transfer: 在公园问孩子树上那只蓬尾巴的小动物在做什么。
transferEn: Ask what the small bushy-tailed animal is doing in a park tree.

senseEn: a person who cuts hair and often trims beards
en: Does the barber take walk-ins on Sundays?
zh: 这位理发师周日接待没预约的客人吗？
transfer: 问邻居哪位理发师擅长修胡子。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor who gives good beard trims.

senseEn: a strip used by aircraft to take off or land
en: Can you see the runway from this waiting area?
zh: 从这个候机区能看到跑道吗？
transfer: 询问机场导览是否能看到飞机在跑道着陆。
transferEn: Ask whether an airport tour overlooks the strip where planes land.

senseEn: used to mark a point as especially significant
en: More importantly, can everyone get home after the late show?
zh: 更重要的是，晚场结束后大家都能回家吗？
transfer: 介绍新场地时指出最重要的一点是无障碍通道。
transferEn: Emphasize accessibility as the key point when introducing a venue.

senseEn: related to preventing an opponent from scoring
en: Who organizes the defensive line when the captain is out?
zh: 队长缺阵时谁组织防线？
transfer: 赛后问教练下周要练哪些防守动作。
transferEn: Ask which moves for preventing goals the coach plans to practice.

senseEn: the killing of animals for meat
en: Does this archive describe the slaughter of livestock in the old town?
zh: 这份档案描述了古镇过去的牲畜屠宰情况吗？
transfer: 在农业史展上询问牲畜屠宰管理记录保存在哪里。
transferEn: Ask where records regulating livestock slaughter are kept at an agricultural history exhibit.

senseEn: a person who reads a text or publication
en: Who is the intended reader of this guide?
zh: 这本指南是写给哪类读者的？
transfer: 给校刊编辑写信，转达读者对新栏目的意见。
transferEn: Relay someone's reaction after reading a new column to a school editor.

senseEn: a man formally supporting a child at baptism
en: Is your godfather coming to the family lunch?
zh: 你的教父要来参加家庭午餐吗？
transfer: 看洗礼合照时，请朋友指出孩子的教父。
transferEn: Ask a friend to identify the child's male baptismal sponsor in a photo.

senseEn: a plant known for fragrant flowers
en: Is it the jasmine by the window that smells so sweet?
zh: 这么香的是窗边的茉莉吗？
transfer: 问园丁阳台能不能种茉莉。
transferEn: Ask a gardener whether the fragrant white-flowered plant suits a balcony.

senseEn: sadness when expectations aren't met
en: Missing the final was a real disappointment for the team.
zh: 错过决赛让全队非常失望。
transfer: 跟朋友表达期待已久的演出取消后的失落。
transferEn: Tell a friend how let down you felt when a long-awaited show was canceled.

senseEn: anywhere, especially in informal American English
en: Can we buy water anyplace nearby?
zh: 我们能在附近什么地方买到水吗？
transfer: 随口问导游附近有没有地方能躲雨。
transferEn: Casually ask a guide whether anywhere nearby offers shelter from rain.

senseEn: six groups of ten
en: Do we need sixty cups for the reception?
zh: 招待会需要六十个杯子吗？
transfer: 跟新同学说一小时有多少分钟。
transferEn: Tell a new student how many minutes make one hour.

senseEn: an aromatic herb with a cooling taste
en: Is that fresh mint in the lemonade?
zh: 柠檬水里放的是新鲜薄荷吗？
transfer: 问朋友阳台上种的是哪种薄荷。
transferEn: Ask which cooling herb a friend is growing on the balcony.

senseEn: a surprise attack from a concealed position
en: In the novel, is the scene after the ambush told by the doctor?
zh: 小说中埋伏袭击后的场景是医生叙述的吗？
transfer: 讨论历史剧时核实故事在哪一幕后才提到这次伏击。
transferEn: Identify when a historical drama first mentions the surprise attack.

senseEn: an artistic representation of a person
en: Who painted the portrait beside the library stairs?
zh: 图书馆楼梯旁的肖像是谁画的？
transfer: 询问画廊能否为家庭肖像预约画师。
transferEn: Ask a gallery about booking an artist for a family likeness.

senseEn: intense and persistent dislike
en: Does the final letter explain her hatred of the old regime?
zh: 最后一封信解释了她对旧政权的憎恨吗？
transfer: 讨论回忆录时区分主人公的恐惧与仇恨。
transferEn: Distinguish fear from intense hostility in a memoir discussion.

senseEn: retaliation for a perceived wrong
en: Does the protagonist choose forgiveness over vengeance?
zh: 主人公选择原谅而非复仇了吗？
transfer: 在电影讨论中指出哪个角色放弃了报复。
transferEn: Identify which character abandons retaliation in a film.

senseEn: a solemn personal promise
en: Did she write her wedding vow herself?
zh: 她的婚礼誓词是自己写的吗？
transfer: 讨论小说里主人公是否兑现了照料家人的誓言。
transferEn: Discuss whether a character kept a solemn promise to care for family.

senseEn: from or relating to Asia
en: Which Asian cities are included in the rail exhibition?
zh: 铁路展介绍了哪些亚洲城市？
transfer: 询问电影节有哪些来自亚洲的导演。
transferEn: Ask which directors at a festival come from Asia.

senseEn: a large spotted wild cat
en: Did the trail camera capture a leopard near the rocks?
zh: 步道相机在岩石附近拍到豹了吗？
transfer: 在自然展询问怎样从斑纹区别豹和猎豹。
transferEn: Ask a guide how to distinguish the spotted large cat from a cheetah.

senseEn: awkward in movement or handling
en: I feel clumsy in these thick gloves. Can I try thinner ones?
zh: 戴这副厚手套我感觉手很笨，可以试试薄的吗？
transfer: 安慰刚学舞的人，说自己最初也动作不协调。
transferEn: Reassure a novice dancer that you also moved awkwardly at first.

senseEn: extra time granted beyond an original deadline
en: Could we get an extension on the equipment return date?
zh: 我们能延长设备归还期限吗？
transfer: 问老师申请论文延期需要怎样说明理由。
transferEn: Ask how to request more time for an essay.

senseEn: the act or scheduled time of leaving
en: Has the departure time changed since we booked?
zh: 订票后出发时间有改动吗？
transfer: 约车去车站时告诉司机你的列车发车时间。
transferEn: Tell a driver when your train leaves while booking a ride.

senseEn: the condition of having no shortcomings
en: Do we need perfection here, or a working sample for tomorrow?
zh: 这里要做到完美，还是先做出明天能用的样品？
transfer: 安慰朋友第一次演出不必追求完美无缺。
transferEn: Reassure a friend that a first performance needn't be flawless.

senseEn: the way someone or something acts
en: Did the observer note a change in behaviour after lunch?
zh: 观察员有记录午饭后的行为变化吗？
transfer: 问英国老师校方如何记录学生的课堂表现。
transferEn: Ask a British teacher how the school records students' conduct in class.

senseEn: a brief stop before continuing
en: Can we take a short pause before the final section?
zh: 最后一部分开始前能稍停一下吗？
transfer: 朗读时在两个角色的对白之间留个停顿。
transferEn: Leave a brief silence between two characters' lines when reading aloud.

senseEn: using electronic data rather than physical media
en: Can I download a digital copy of the town map?
zh: 我可以下载电子版城镇地图吗？
transfer: 问摄影师是否会提供电子版毕业照。
transferEn: Ask whether a photographer supplies graduation pictures as electronic files.

sense: 针对同性恋者的辱称（极冒犯）
senseEn: a highly offensive anti-gay slur in American English
en: The moderator removed the slur “fag” from the forum.
zh: 管理员从论坛里删除了这个针对同性恋者的辱称。
transfer: 在编辑培训中说明为什么不能用这个词随意称呼别人。
transferEn: Explain to an editor why this anti-gay insult should never be used as a casual label.

senseEn: to the same degree or in the same proportion
en: Will both teams share equally in the prize money?
zh: 两队会平分奖金吗？
transfer: 问室友搬家费用是否平均承担。
transferEn: Ask whether roommates will bear the moving costs in the same proportion.

senseEn: extremely ugly or unpleasant to look at
en: Was the monster's hideous mask made for this production?
zh: 怪兽那副丑陋吓人的面具是为这次演出做的吗？
transfer: 描述旧旅馆里那张极难看的地毯图案。
transferEn: Describe the exceptionally unattractive carpet pattern in an old hotel.

senseEn: a person or organization that employs someone
en: Can my former employer confirm my start date?
zh: 我以前的雇主能证明我的入职日期吗？
transfer: 问新雇主是否提供通勤补贴。
transferEn: Ask the organization hiring you whether it offers a commuting allowance.

senseEn: feeling grateful for something
en: We're thankful for the extra hands at the book sale.
zh: 我们很感激有人来帮忙卖书。
transfer: 告诉邻居他的及时来电让你多么感激。
transferEn: Tell a neighbor how grateful you are for a timely call.

senseEn: imitating a real situation for practice
en: Will the mock interview be recorded for feedback?
zh: 模拟面试会录下来供反馈吗？
transfer: 问老师下周的模拟考试有多长。
transferEn: Ask how long next week's practice exam lasts.

senseEn: an informal abbreviation for ammunition
en: Does the archive spell out the abbreviation “ammo” in its catalog?
zh: 档案馆的目录把“弹药”这个简称写全了吗？
transfer: 阅读历史剧字幕时指出哪个口语简称指弹药。
transferEn: Identify the informal short form for ammunition in a period drama's subtitles.

senseEn: a container for discarded material
en: Which recycling bin takes glass jars?
zh: 玻璃罐该丢进哪个回收桶？
transfer: 在车站询问用过的纸杯应该丢到哪里。
transferEn: Ask where the station keeps the container for used paper cups.

sense: 黑人（英语历史旧称，现代使用通常冒犯）
senseEn: an outdated racial term for a Black person, generally offensive in modern use
en: The archive quotes the historical term “Negro” and explains its context.
zh: 档案馆引用了这一历史旧称，并解释了它在当时的语境。
transfer: 编辑老报刊展签时说明这个旧称不宜用作当下称呼。
transferEn: Explain why this outdated racial label in a newspaper exhibit is unsuitable as a current description.

senseEn: a partner dance associated with Argentina and Uruguay
en: Are beginners welcome at the tango lesson?
zh: 探戈课欢迎初学者吗？
transfer: 舞会开始前问哪首曲子适合跳探戈。
transferEn: Ask which song at a dance suits the Argentine partner dance.

senseEn: a strong desire to achieve something
en: Was opening a bakery always your ambition?
zh: 开面包店一直是你的志向吗？
transfer: 向老师讲述你想成为插画师的抱负。
transferEn: Tell a teacher about your aspiration to become an illustrator.

senseEn: a person one knows but not closely
en: Is he an old acquaintance from your photography class?
zh: 他是你摄影班里以前认识的人吗？
transfer: 向同事解释介绍人是熟人而非亲密朋友。
transferEn: Explain that someone introducing you is a person you know casually.

senseEn: hurt feelings caused by disrespectful words or actions
en: I meant no offence by asking about the house.
zh: 我问起房子的事并无冒犯之意。
transfer: 给英国朋友写信，澄清那句玩笑没有恶意。
transferEn: Write to a British friend to explain that a joke wasn't meant to cause hurt.

senseEn: the function of managing money in an organization
en: Has the finance team approved the refund?
zh: 财务团队批准退款了吗？
transfer: 请接待员把发票问题转给财务部门。
transferEn: Ask reception to direct an invoice question to the department managing money.

sense: 成瘾者（称人时可能带污名）
senseEn: a label for a person experiencing addiction that can be stigmatizing
en: The clinic replaced the label “addict” with person-first wording.
zh: 诊所把可能带来污名的“成瘾者”标签换成了以人为先的措辞。
transfer: 在公共卫生材料里说明为什么要避免用单一标签代替对人的描述。
transferEn: Discuss why health materials should avoid reducing a person to a label for addiction.

senseEn: to remove the outer skin of a fruit or vegetable
en: Should I peel the carrots before roasting them?
zh: 胡萝卜烤前要削皮吗？
transfer: 准备水果沙拉时问苹果要不要去皮。
transferEn: Ask whether to remove the apple skins for a fruit salad.

senseEn: principles concerning right conduct
en: Does the journalism course cover interview ethics?
zh: 新闻课程讲采访伦理吗？
transfer: 请老师举例说明研究伦理如何影响问卷设计。
transferEn: Ask for an example of how moral standards affect survey design.

senseEn: a person or organization providing financial support
en: Can we thank the sponsor on the concert program?
zh: 能在音乐会节目单上感谢赞助方吗？
transfer: 问组织者哪家企业资助了比赛奖品。
transferEn: Ask which organization funded the prizes at a competition.

senseEn: someone opposing an established authority
en: Was the narrator a rebel before joining the council?
zh: 叙述者加入委员会前是反叛者吗？
transfer: 讨论历史小说时指出哪位角色公开反抗王室。
transferEn: Identify the character who openly opposes royal authority in a historical novel.

senseEn: a long-eared animal related to the horse
en: Is the donkey allowed to eat these carrots?
zh: 这头驴可以吃这些胡萝卜吗？
transfer: 请孩子在农场画出那头长耳朵的驴。
transferEn: Ask a child to draw the long-eared relative of a horse on a farm.

senseEn: a residential institution historically caring for children without parents
en: Was this library once an orphanage?
zh: 这座图书馆以前是孤儿院吗？
transfer: 参观档案馆时问旧孤儿院的校务记录保存在哪里。
transferEn: Ask where records of a former children's residential institution are kept.

senseEn: a boat carrying people or vehicles on a regular crossing
en: Can we take the ferry back after sunset?
zh: 日落后还可以乘渡轮回来吗？
transfer: 问售票员哪班渡轮可以载自行车。
transferEn: Ask which scheduled boat crossing accepts bicycles.

senseEn: a small insect living in organized colonies
en: There's an ant crawling along the lip of your cup.
zh: 有只蚂蚁在你杯沿上爬。
transfer: 请孩子观察一只蚂蚁把面包屑搬到了哪里。
transferEn: Ask a child where a small colony insect carries its crumb.

senseEn: a dish a cook or place is especially known for
en: Is the bean stew the house specialty?
zh: 炖豆子是这家店的招牌菜吗？
transfer: 在海边小镇问哪种当地特色菜最值得尝试。
transferEn: Ask which signature local dish to try in a coastal town.

senseEn: the state of having paid work
en: Do I need proof of current employment to rent the flat?
zh: 租这套房需要提供目前的在职证明吗？
transfer: 询问职业中心是否为毕业生提供就业咨询。
transferEn: Ask a careers center about advice for graduates seeking paid work.

senseEn: a quick look, sometimes taken secretly
en: Can we take a quick peek at the costumes before the show?
zh: 演出前我们能先瞧一眼戏服吗？
transfer: 礼物拆开前告诉孩子先不要偷看。
transferEn: Ask a child not to take a secret look at a present before unwrapping it.

senseEn: separated from home or without an owner present
en: Is that stray dog wearing an identification tag?
zh: 那只流浪狗身上有身份牌吗？
transfer: 发现一只流浪猫时给收容所描述它的毛色。
transferEn: Describe a wandering cat's coat to an animal shelter.

senseEn: to bring stomach contents back up through the mouth
en: Did you vomit after the boat ride or during it?
zh: 你是在乘船后还是途中呕吐的？
transfer: 就诊时说明孩子昨晚有没有呕吐。
transferEn: Tell a clinician whether a child was sick to their stomach last night.

senseEn: an area where people are buried
en: Is the church graveyard included on the history walk?
zh: 历史徒步路线包括教堂墓地吗？
transfer: 问管理员墓地哪扇门下午开放。
transferEn: Ask a caretaker which gate to the burial ground opens in the afternoon.

senseEn: a handle turned to operate a mechanism
en: Is the window crank stiff because the frame shifted?
zh: 窗户的摇柄发紧，是窗框移位了吗？
transfer: 参观老磨坊时问哪个手柄用来转动机器。
transferEn: Ask which turning handle operates a machine at an old mill.

senseEn: a shirt-like upper garment often worn by women
en: Does this blouse need to be washed by hand?
zh: 这件女式衬衫要手洗吗？
transfer: 试衣时问那件丝质上衣有没有大一号。
transferEn: Ask whether a silk shirt-like top comes in a larger size.

senseEn: a person who rents property to tenants
en: Has the landlord agreed to replace the lock?
zh: 房东同意换锁了吗？
transfer: 搬家前问房东什么时候来收钥匙。
transferEn: Ask the property owner when they will collect the keys before a move.

senseEn: to rest on one or both knees
en: Could you kneel beside the chair to check the loose leg?
zh: 能在椅旁跪下来看看松掉的椅腿吗？
transfer: 拍儿童合影时请后排大人单膝跪下。
transferEn: Ask the adults to rest on one knee for a group picture with children.

senseEn: gradual development or change over time
en: Does the exhibition trace the evolution of city bicycles?
zh: 展览呈现了城市自行车的演变过程吗？
transfer: 问老师哪篇文章讲述了书写系统的发展变化。
transferEn: Ask which article traces the gradual development of writing systems.

senseEn: a member of an organized criminal group
en: Which actor plays the retired gangster in this drama?
zh: 这部剧里哪个演员扮演退出黑帮的那个人？
transfer: 在读书会上澄清哪位虚构角色曾是犯罪团伙成员。
transferEn: Clarify which fictional character used to belong to a criminal gang.

senseEn: a person regarded as speaking by divine inspiration
en: Is the prophet in this mural holding a scroll?
zh: 这幅壁画里的先知拿着卷轴吗？
transfer: 向讲解员询问画中哪一位是宗教传统里的先知。
transferEn: Ask a guide which painted figure is described as a divinely inspired messenger.

senseEn: a subject for discussion or study
en: Can I change my essay topic before Friday?
zh: 我能在周五前更换作文题目吗？
transfer: 主持读书会时请大家提出下次讨论的话题。
transferEn: Invite a book club to suggest a subject for its next discussion.

senseEn: falling below a required standard
en: Leaving that exit blocked is unacceptable during opening hours.
zh: 营业时间堵住那个出口是不可接受的。
transfer: 给供应商说明为什么破损包装不能接受。
transferEn: Explain to a supplier why damaged packaging falls below your standard.

senseEn: damaged so software cannot read or use it correctly
en: Does the error mean the file is corrupt?
zh: 这个错误提示是说文件损坏了吗？
transfer: 请同事核对备份中的图片是不是已经损坏。
transferEn: Ask a colleague to check whether an image in a backup is unreadable.

senseEn: the legal authority to handle a matter
en: Whose jurisdiction covers the road between the two towns?
zh: 两个镇之间这段道路归谁管辖？
transfer: 向市政服务台询问这间公园归哪个机构管理。
transferEn: Ask a city desk which agency has authority over a park.

senseEn: characterized by a sudden powerful release
en: Does the film show an explosive eruption or a slow lava flow?
zh: 影片里是爆发式喷发还是熔岩缓慢流动？
transfer: 请讲解员指出哪张地质图记录了猛烈的火山喷发。
transferEn: Ask which geological diagram records a sudden violent volcanic eruption.

senseEn: a blood vessel carrying blood away from the heart
en: Which artery supplies the arm in this diagram?
zh: 这幅图上哪条动脉给手臂供血？
transfer: 在生物课上请老师区分图中动脉与静脉。
transferEn: Ask a teacher to distinguish a vessel carrying blood away from the heart from a vein.

senseEn: a group of singers performing together
en: Does the community choir rehearse on Tuesday evenings?
zh: 社区合唱团周二晚上排练吗？
transfer: 音乐会前问合唱团会演唱哪首歌。
transferEn: Ask which song the group of singers will perform.

senseEn: cannabis, especially when discussed as a drug
en: Does the health survey ask about marijuana use within the past year?
zh: 健康问卷询问过去一年是否使用过大麻吗？
transfer: 阅读公共健康手册时核实哪一章讨论大麻。
transferEn: Check which chapter of a public health handbook discusses cannabis.

senseEn: a person authorized to speak or act for others
en: Will a union representative attend the meeting?
zh: 工会代表会参加会议吗？
transfer: 询问班级由谁代表去参加校务座谈。
transferEn: Ask who will speak for the class at a school forum.

senseEn: an amount of medicine taken at one time
en: Where is the prescribed dose written on this label?
zh: 标签上哪里写了医嘱剂量？
transfer: 致电药房确认该从哪份说明上查到每次用药量。
transferEn: Call a pharmacy to ask which instructions specify the amount per administration.

senseEn: an arrangement to work together
en: How did the partnership between the museum and school begin?
zh: 博物馆和学校之间的合作是怎样开始的？
transfer: 向社区解释新合作关系会给图书馆带来什么。
transferEn: Explain what a new collaboration will bring to the library.

senseEn: a small house, especially in the countryside
en: Does the lakeside cottage have a working kitchen?
zh: 湖边的小屋有能做饭的厨房吗？
transfer: 租乡间小屋前问最近的车站有多远。
transferEn: Ask about the nearest station before renting a small country house.

senseEn: a plant-based seasoning with a distinctive flavor
en: Which spice gives the soup that smoky flavor?
zh: 哪种香料让汤有这种烟熏味？
transfer: 帮朋友做炖菜时问最后一种香料何时放。
transferEn: Ask when the last aromatic seasoning goes into a friend's stew.
