en: Would a scanned copy be an acceptable substitute for the original?
zh: 可以用扫描件代替原件吗？
transfer: 订房时确认晚一小时入住是否可以接受。
senseEn: good enough to be allowed
transferEn: Ask whether arriving an hour late is allowed when booking a room.

senseEn: the quality of being amusing or finding things funny
en: Does the novel's dry humour come through in translation?
zh: 译本保留了小说那种冷幽默吗？
transfer: 给英国朋友描述一场喜剧演出的幽默风格。
transferEn: Describe the comedy style of a performance to a British friend.

sense: 疯子（带贬义的旧式称呼）
senseEn: a dated, often offensive label for a man perceived as mentally unstable
en: The curator places the label “madman” in quotation marks when discussing the old poster.
zh: 策展人讨论旧海报时，把里面“疯子”这个贬称加了引号。
transfer: 向编辑解释为什么报道不应采用这个带污名的称呼。
transferEn: Explain why a reporter should avoid adopting this stigmatizing label.

senseEn: a sauce made from meat juices or a savory substitute
en: Could I have the gravy in a separate jug?
zh: 肉汁可以另外装在小壶里吗？
transfer: 点餐时问有没有素食版肉汁配土豆泥。
transferEn: Ask whether a vegetarian savory sauce is available for mashed potatoes.

senseEn: relating to events or conditions in the past
en: Are the costumes based on historical records?
zh: 这些服装有历史记录作依据吗？
transfer: 问讲解员哪些细节是有史料依据的。
transferEn: Ask which details of a reconstruction are supported by records from the past.

senseEn: a sudden urge to do something
en: I bought the postcard on impulse as we left the museum.
zh: 离开博物馆时我一时兴起买了那张明信片。
transfer: 讲述自己临时起意报名唱歌课的经过。
transferEn: Tell someone how a sudden urge led you to sign up for singing lessons.

senseEn: the only one
en: Is Maya the sole contact for the weekend deliveries?
zh: 周末送货只联系玛雅一个人吗？
transfer: 向学校确认谁是这场展览唯一的赞助方。
transferEn: Ask a school which organization is the exhibition's only sponsor.

senseEn: to welcome someone when they arrive
en: Could you greet the visitors while I set up the screen?
zh: 我装投影幕时你能迎接来宾吗？
transfer: 安排家庭聚会时问谁去车站迎接亲戚。
transferEn: Arrange for someone to welcome relatives at the station.

senseEn: a statement that something is untrue
en: Did the editor publish the mayor's denial beside the allegation?
zh: 编辑有没有在指控旁刊出市长的否认声明？
transfer: 讨论小说时指出主人公在哪一章否认自己拿过信。
transferEn: Identify the chapter where a character says they did not take the letter.

senseEn: one more than twelve
en: We've sold thirteen tickets for the morning tour.
zh: 上午的导览已经卖出了十三张票。
transfer: 发点心时解释只剩十三份，十四个孩子不够分。
transferEn: Explain how many snacks remain if fourteen children are one short.

senseEn: being the only one present
en: Did you see the lone tree on the far ridge?
zh: 你看到远处山脊上那棵孤零零的树了吗？
transfer: 描述拍到的草地上唯一一只鹿。
transferEn: Describe the single deer in a photo of a meadow.

senseEn: a sound asking someone to be quiet
en: “Sh, the baby is asleep,” Mia whispered.
zh: 米娅低声说：“嘘，宝宝睡着了。”
transfer: 电影开场时用一个轻声提示让同伴安静。
transferEn: Give a quiet signal for silence when a movie starts.

senseEn: a state of intense absorption or reduced awareness
en: The slow music seemed to put him in a trance.
zh: 缓慢的音乐似乎让他进入了恍惚状态。
transfer: 描写故事人物入神地盯着火光的样子。
transferEn: Describe a fictional character gazing at a fire as if unaware of everything else.

senseEn: a lack of consideration or respect
en: I meant no disrespect when I asked about the old name.
zh: 我问起旧名字并没有不尊重的意思。
transfer: 向同事解释打断发言并非有意失礼。
transferEn: Explain that interrupting a colleague was not meant to show a lack of respect.

senseEn: the inside part of something
en: Can we photograph the interior of the clock tower?
zh: 我们可以拍钟楼内部吗？
transfer: 看房时问室内最近一次翻修是什么时候。
transferEn: Ask when the inside of a house was last renovated.

senseEn: a channel carrying rainwater from a roof
en: Is the gutter above the door blocked by leaves?
zh: 门上方的檐沟是不是被树叶堵住了？
transfer: 告诉维修工雨天哪段檐沟会溢水。
transferEn: Tell a repairer which roof drainage channel overflows when it rains.

senseEn: someone who creates plans for products or visual work
en: Can the designer move the title above the photograph?
zh: 设计师能把标题移到照片上面吗？
transfer: 问展览负责人是谁设计了新座椅。
transferEn: Ask an exhibition organizer who designed the new seating.

senseEn: to send a written message by phone
en: Could you text me when the ferry docks?
zh: 渡轮靠岸时能给我发条短信吗？
transfer: 向朋友说明到不了现场就发短信告诉你。
transferEn: Ask a friend to send you a phone message if they cannot come in person.

senseEn: an act or work expressing admiration or respect
en: Was the concert a tribute to the retiring conductor?
zh: 这场音乐会是向即将退休的指挥致敬吗？
transfer: 介绍一本纪念老师的学生作品集。
transferEn: Introduce a student anthology honoring a teacher.

senseEn: a pen making a bold visible line
en: Can I use this marker on the whiteboard?
zh: 这支记号笔能用在白板上吗？
transfer: 做名牌前问哪支笔写在塑料上不掉色。
transferEn: Ask which thick-tipped pen stays on plastic when making name tags.

senseEn: to make an animal go away, often with a word or gesture
en: Could you shoo the hens out of the garden?
zh: 你能把母鸡赶出菜园吗？
transfer: 野餐时请同伴轻轻赶走桌边的海鸥。
transferEn: Ask a picnic companion to gently send the gulls away from the table.

senseEn: the chemical element with symbol C
en: Does this model show a carbon atom at the center?
zh: 这个模型中间的是碳原子吗？
transfer: 请老师指出周期表中符号为 C 的元素。
transferEn: Ask a teacher to point out the element with the symbol C.

senseEn: a product used to remove a coating
en: Is this paint stripper suitable for an old wooden chair?
zh: 这种脱漆剂适合旧木椅吗？
transfer: 翻修门框前向店员核对去漆产品的适用材质。
transferEn: Check with a clerk which surfaces a coating remover is intended for.

senseEn: acting as though one is superior to others
en: Did my reply sound too arrogant in the group chat?
zh: 我在群里的回复听起来是不是太傲慢了？
transfer: 修改求职信时让朋友指出哪句话显得自大。
transferEn: Ask a friend which sentence of a cover letter sounds self-important.

senseEn: to upset someone through words or actions
en: Would that nickname offend our guest?
zh: 那个绰号会冒犯我们的客人吗？
transfer: 在写玩笑贺卡前问同伴内容会不会让收卡人不快。
transferEn: Check whether a joke on a greeting card might upset the recipient.

senseEn: a spherical model of Earth
en: Can you find the island on the globe?
zh: 你能在地球仪上找到这座岛吗？
transfer: 让孩子用地球仪指出赤道。
transferEn: Ask a child to locate the equator on a model of Earth.

senseEn: an informal word for the feeling of a place
en: Does the upstairs room have a quieter vibe?
zh: 楼上房间的氛围更安静吗？
transfer: 向朋友描述旧唱片店给你的第一感觉。
transferEn: Casually describe the feeling you got on entering an old record shop.

senseEn: a person entitled to receive someone's property or title
en: Was the niece named the sole heir in the novel?
zh: 小说里侄女被指定为唯一继承人了吗？
transfer: 参观古宅时询问哪位继承人扩建了花园。
transferEn: Ask which inheritor enlarged a historic garden.

senseEn: the sound or action of guns firing
en: Is the distant gunfire in the documentary original audio?
zh: 纪录片里远处的枪声是原始录音吗？
transfer: 讨论历史影片音效时，指出枪声在哪一幕停止。
transferEn: Discuss which scene marks the end of the firing sounds in a historical film.

senseEn: a hard stone often polished for building or sculpture
en: Is the countertop made of real marble?
zh: 这个台面是真大理石做的吗？
transfer: 问讲解员楼梯上的大理石来自哪里。
transferEn: Ask a guide where the polished stone on a staircase was quarried.

senseEn: silly in a playful and amusing way
en: Can we take a goofy photo after the formal one?
zh: 拍好正式照后能再拍张搞怪的吗？
transfer: 形容一个朋友在聚会上跳的逗趣舞步。
transferEn: Casually describe a friend's silly, amusing dance at a party.

senseEn: exact and clearly specified
en: Can you give me a precise measurement for the glass panel?
zh: 能告诉我玻璃板的精确尺寸吗？
transfer: 预约取货时向对方确认准确的门牌号。
transferEn: Ask for an exact house number when arranging a pickup.

senseEn: to pay back money or return a favor
en: Can I repay you for lunch by bank transfer?
zh: 午餐的钱我可以转账还你吗？
transfer: 和朋友约定什么时候还借来的车票钱。
transferEn: Arrange when to pay back money borrowed for a train ticket.

senseEn: a flat green plant part usually growing from a stem
en: Is this leaf from the maple beside the gate?
zh: 这片叶子是门边那棵枫树上掉下来的吗？
transfer: 自然课上请孩子挑一片边缘有锯齿的叶子。
transferEn: Ask a child to choose a leaf with a toothed edge for nature class.

senseEn: a derogatory and stigmatizing label for someone with drug addiction
en: The editor removed the word “junkie” from the profile.
zh: 编辑从人物报道里删掉了“瘾君子”这个贬称。
transfer: 在记者培训中解释这个带污名的标签为什么不适合新闻叙述。
transferEn: Explain why a stigmatizing label for addiction is unsuitable for a news profile.

senseEn: money provided regularly for a particular expense
en: Does the job include a travel allowance?
zh: 这份工作有交通津贴吗？
transfer: 向学校确认实习生是否有午餐补贴。
transferEn: Ask whether the school gives interns a meal stipend.

senseEn: to dance energetically and informally
en: Come boogie with us after the band starts!
zh: 乐队开演以后，来跟我们跳舞吧！
transfer: 用轻松的语气邀请朋友在派对上跳一曲。
transferEn: Casually invite a friend to dance energetically at a party.

senseEn: a doctor with expertise in one field
en: Can my doctor refer me to a skin specialist?
zh: 医生能把我转诊给皮肤科医生吗？
transfer: 询问眼科专科医生周五是否出诊。
transferEn: Ask whether a doctor focused on eye care is available Friday.

senseEn: someone fleeing authorities or custody
en: Which chapter explains why he became a fugitive?
zh: 哪一章解释了他为什么成了逃亡者？
transfer: 讨论历史小说时问逃亡者后来是否返回故乡。
transferEn: Ask whether a person fleeing authorities ever returned home in a historical novel.

senseEn: a person or organization purchasing something
en: Does the buyer pay for shipping the secondhand desk?
zh: 这张二手桌子的运费由买家承担吗？
transfer: 出售画作前向画廊确认作品何时交给买家。
transferEn: Check when a painting will be handed to its purchaser.

senseEn: a break in a bone
en: Did the X-ray show a fracture near the wrist?
zh: X 光片显示手腕附近有骨折吗？
transfer: 复诊时询问上次发现的骨折愈合情况。
transferEn: Ask how a broken bone from a previous visit is healing.

senseEn: to undo a knot or fastening
en: Can you untie the ribbon without cutting it?
zh: 能不剪断丝带，把结解开吗？
transfer: 孩子脱鞋时请他先解开鞋带。
transferEn: Ask a child to undo their shoelaces before taking shoes off.

senseEn: magnetic tape used to store moving pictures and sound
en: Is our school concert still on that old videotape?
zh: 我们学校的音乐会还保存在那盘旧录像带上吗？
transfer: 问档案馆能不能把婚礼录像带转成电子文件。
transferEn: Ask an archive about converting a wedding video cassette into a digital file.

senseEn: care taken to avoid danger or mistakes
en: Please use extra caution on the wet bridge.
zh: 过湿滑的桥时请格外小心。
transfer: 给新骑手说明为什么黄昏路段需要特别谨慎。
transferEn: Explain why a new cyclist should take extra care at dusk.

senseEn: a narrow strip used for holding or carrying something
en: Can the shoulder strap on this bag be shortened?
zh: 这个包的肩带能调短吗？
transfer: 检查相机挂带是否牢靠后再出门。
transferEn: Check whether the narrow band holding your camera is secure before leaving.

senseEn: an appliance or compartment for keeping food frozen
en: Is there room in the freezer for the ice cream?
zh: 冷冻柜里还有地方放冰激凌吗？
transfer: 搬家前问室友哪些冷冻柜里的食物该先吃。
transferEn: Ask a roommate which frozen foods should be used up before moving.

senseEn: basic and not highly developed in design
en: Was this primitive camera built before glass lenses were common?
zh: 这台简陋的相机是在玻璃镜头普及之前制造的吗？
transfer: 在科技馆比较早期和现代计算器的设计。
transferEn: Describe the basic design of an early calculator compared with a modern one.

senseEn: a fine strand used in sewing
en: Does this blue thread match the jacket lining?
zh: 这根蓝线和夹克衬里配色吗？
transfer: 补背包时问哪种缝纫线更结实。
transferEn: Ask which sewing strand is stronger for repairing a backpack.

senseEn: a quality considered morally good
en: Is patience a virtue the story rewards?
zh: 耐心是这个故事所嘉许的美德吗？
transfer: 谈谈守信用为什么是你看重的品德。
transferEn: Explain why keeping promises is a quality you value.

senseEn: a large irregular piece of something
en: Could you cut a hunk of bread for the soup?
zh: 能切一大块面包来配汤吗？
transfer: 野餐时请同伴从奶酪上切一大块分给大家。
transferEn: At a picnic, ask someone to cut a large piece of cheese for sharing.

senseEn: a particular setting for operating a device
en: Is the camera in portrait mode or video mode?
zh: 相机现在是人像模式还是录像模式？
transfer: 出发前问如何把导航切到步行模式。
transferEn: Ask how to switch navigation to its walking setting.

senseEn: a garment covering both legs separately, usually to the ankles
en: Can these linen trousers be shortened by two centimeters?
zh: 这条亚麻长裤能改短两厘米吗？
transfer: 问英国店员正装长裤有没有更深的颜色。
transferEn: Ask a British shop assistant for darker formal pants.

senseEn: a barrier contraceptive worn during sex
en: Is the condom expiry date printed on each individual packet?
zh: 每个安全套的独立包装上都印有有效期吗？
transfer: 在药房询问这种屏障避孕用品有没有不含乳胶的。
transferEn: Ask a pharmacist for a latex-free version of this barrier contraceptive.

senseEn: informal shorthand for a representative
en: Can the sales rep show us a working sample?
zh: 销售代表能给我们看看可运行的样品吗？
transfer: 问哪位工会代表参加下午的会议。
transferEn: Ask which union representative will attend the afternoon meeting, using the casual short form.

senseEn: a large formal meal for many guests
en: Is the awards banquet in the main hall?
zh: 颁奖宴会在主厅举行吗？
transfer: 给活动负责人确认宴会有多少桌。
transferEn: Ask an organizer how many tables the large formal dinner needs.

senseEn: a mild informal exclamation of surprise
en: Golly, that kite is taller than the tent!
zh: 哎呀，那只风筝比帐篷还高！
transfer: 看到孩子做出的超大纸船时，用温和语气表示惊讶。
transferEn: Give a mild exclamation at the enormous paper boat a child made.

senseEn: a person who parks cars for guests
en: Should I leave the key with the valet?
zh: 我应该把钥匙交给代客泊车员吗？
transfer: 向酒店询问几点还能请工作人员把车开过来。
transferEn: Ask until what hour the hotel parking attendant can bring your car around.

senseEn: an abnormal growth of tissue
en: Does the report describe the tumor size in millimeters?
zh: 报告里肿瘤的大小是按毫米写的吗？
transfer: 向医生确认影像上提到的肿瘤在什么位置。
transferEn: Ask a clinician where the tissue growth mentioned on a scan is located.

senseEn: to set aside a previous decision using greater authority
en: Can the committee override the decision to close the hall?
zh: 委员会可以推翻关闭礼堂的决定吗？
transfer: 问经理谁有权撤销已批准的排班调整。
transferEn: Ask who has authority to set aside an approved scheduling change.

senseEn: without being affected by a particular factor
en: The fee is the same regardless of age.
zh: 不论年龄，费用都一样。
transfer: 解释活动无论下不下雨都会举行。
transferEn: Explain that an event will take place whether it rains or not.

senseEn: according to a claim that has not been confirmed
en: The lift is supposedly working again. Has anyone tried it?
zh: 据说电梯又能用了。有人试过了吗？
transfer: 转述据说周末会延长营业的消息，同时表示尚未确认。
transferEn: Relay an unconfirmed claim about longer weekend opening hours.

senseEn: easily broken or damaged
en: Can you wrap the fragile glasses separately?
zh: 能把这些易碎玻璃杯分别包起来吗？
transfer: 寄包裹时告诉柜员里面的瓷花瓶容易碎。
transferEn: Tell a shipping clerk that a porcelain vase inside may break easily.

senseEn: unrelated to the issue being considered
en: Is my old address irrelevant to this application?
zh: 我的旧地址和这份申请无关吗？
transfer: 改文章时指出哪条例子和论点没有关系。
transferEn: Indicate which example does not relate to an essay's argument.

senseEn: the part of the body between ribs and hips
en: These trousers fit at the waist but feel tight at the knees.
zh: 这条裤子腰部合适，但膝盖处有点紧。
transfer: 做演出服时请裁缝再量一次腰围。
transferEn: Ask a tailor to remeasure around the middle of your body for a costume.

sense: 酒馆（尤指旧时美国西部）
senseEn: a drinking establishment associated especially with the historical American West
en: Is the saloon scene in the Western filmed on location?
zh: 这部西部片里的酒馆那场戏是在实地拍的吗？
transfer: 参观影视城时问哪扇门通往西部酒馆布景。
transferEn: Ask which door leads to the old Western bar set on a studio tour.

senseEn: very surprised or impressed
en: I was amazed by how clearly the old recording played.
zh: 那段老录音放出来竟然这么清晰，我很惊讶。
transfer: 告诉朋友你对孩子这么快学会骑车感到惊奇。
transferEn: Tell a friend how surprised you were by a child learning to ride so quickly.

senseEn: recognition of someone's help or contribution
en: Can we show our appreciation with a handwritten card?
zh: 我们可以写张手写卡片表示谢意吗？
transfer: 给队友写两句话表达对其额外付出的感谢。
transferEn: Write a teammate a short note recognizing their extra effort.

senseEn: to discover the presence of something
en: Can the monitor detect a change in room temperature?
zh: 这台监测仪能检测到室温变化吗？
transfer: 问技术员传感器能不能发现漏水。
transferEn: Ask whether a sensor can register water escaping from a pipe.

senseEn: more than half of a group
en: Did a majority of residents vote for the new hours?
zh: 超过半数的居民投票赞成了新开放时间吗？
transfer: 统计班级调查时说明多数人更喜欢哪种活动。
transferEn: Report the activity preferred by more than half of the class.

senseEn: not yet fully grown
en: Is that a juvenile eagle or an adult of another species?
zh: 那是只幼鹰，还是另一物种的成年鸟？
transfer: 请向导解释幼年海豹与成年海豹的毛色差异。
transferEn: Ask a guide how the coat of a young seal differs from an adult's.

senseEn: to take more than one's share of something
en: I don't want to hog the microphone. Who else has a question?
zh: 我不想一直霸着麦克风。还有谁想提问？
transfer: 共用厨房时提醒朋友不要独占全部台面。
transferEn: Ask a friend to leave others some counter space in a shared kitchen.

senseEn: in the area behind the stage
en: Can parents wait backstage after the school play?
zh: 校剧结束后家长可以在后台等吗？
transfer: 问舞台经理演员应在后台哪个位置集合。
transferEn: Ask a stage manager where performers should gather behind the stage.

senseEn: to fall in individual drops
en: Does water drip from the tap only at night?
zh: 水龙头只在夜间滴水吗？
transfer: 放好水桶后问漏水还会不会滴到地板上。
transferEn: After placing a bucket, check whether drops still reach the floor.

senseEn: the framework of bones in a body
en: Is the whale skeleton in the entrance hall complete?
zh: 入口大厅里的鲸骨架完整吗？
transfer: 问老师哪副骨架模型缺了一根肋骨。
transferEn: Ask which model of bones is missing a rib.

senseEn: without others knowing
en: Did the class secretly plan the teacher's farewell concert?
zh: 全班是瞒着老师筹备欢送音乐会的吗？
transfer: 讲述朋友如何悄悄为你准备生日卡。
transferEn: Describe how friends prepared a birthday card without you knowing.

senseEn: a short phrase expressing a guiding belief
en: Who chose the school motto above the entrance?
zh: 校门上方的校训是谁选的？
transfer: 请队长解释印在球衣上的队训。
transferEn: Ask a captain to explain the guiding phrase printed on team shirts.

senseEn: to drink a little at a time
en: Can I sip the broth before you add the salt?
zh: 你加盐之前我能先小口尝尝汤吗？
transfer: 提醒小朋友热茶要一小口一小口喝。
transferEn: Remind a child to drink hot tea in very small mouthfuls.

senseEn: likely to tip, shift or fall
en: This stool feels unstable on the tiled floor.
zh: 这把凳子放在瓷砖地上感觉不稳。
transfer: 发现书架会晃后向房东说明情况。
transferEn: Tell a landlord that a bookcase wobbles rather than standing firmly.

senseEn: an area with equipment for children to play on
en: Does the playground have swings for younger children?
zh: 这个游乐场有给小孩子玩的秋千吗？
transfer: 向邻居打听公园里的游乐场何时重新开放。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor when the children's play area in the park will reopen.

senseEn: not subject to death
en: Is the guardian truly immortal in the legend?
zh: 传说里那位守护者真的不会死吗？
transfer: 讨论神话时指出哪位角色想获得永生。
transferEn: Discuss which mythical character wants to live forever.

senseEn: to make written material publicly available
en: Will the society publish the essays as a book?
zh: 协会会把这些文章结集出版吗？
transfer: 请校刊编辑说明获奖诗歌会在哪一期发表。
transferEn: Ask a school editor which issue will print a prize-winning poem.

senseEn: a thick sweet liquid
en: Can I get the maple syrup in a little jug?
zh: 枫糖浆可以用小壶另外装吗？
transfer: 点咖啡时问可以少放一些香草糖浆吗。
transferEn: Ask for less sweet vanilla liquid in a coffee.

senseEn: to move a growing plant to a new place
en: When can we transplant the seedlings into bigger pots?
zh: 什么时候可以把幼苗移到大盆里？
transfer: 请园丁说明这棵小树能否秋天移栽。
transferEn: Ask whether a young tree can be moved to a new spot in autumn.

senseEn: containing a large amount of fat
en: Is the shoulder a fatty cut of lamb?
zh: 羊肩是油脂较多的部位吗？
transfer: 点汤前问厨师表面是不是有很多油。
transferEn: Ask a cook whether the soup has much fat on its surface.

senseEn: from or relating to Vietnam
en: Does the Vietnamese café serve breakfast on weekdays?
zh: 那家越南咖啡馆工作日供应早餐吗？
transfer: 请朋友推荐一种越南传统汤品。
transferEn: Ask a friend for a traditional soup from Vietnam.

senseEn: off the side of a boat into the water
en: Did my hat fall overboard when we turned?
zh: 拐弯时我的帽子是不是掉进水里了？
transfer: 告诉船员你看见一个空袋子从船边落入水中。
transferEn: Tell a crew member an empty bag went off the side into the water.

senseEn: a built-in place for a fire in a room
en: Is the fireplace in the cottage usable or decorative?
zh: 小屋里的壁炉能用，还是只作装饰？
transfer: 请主人指出起居室壁炉工具放在哪里。
transferEn: Ask a host where tools for the living-room hearth are kept.

senseEn: having a strong rhythmic groove associated with funk
en: Who plays that funky bass line in the opening track?
zh: 开场曲里那段放克味十足的贝斯是谁弹的？
transfer: 请乐队为舞会选一首节奏感强的放克曲。
transferEn: Ask a band for a dance tune with a strong funk groove.

senseEn: a raised sacred table or place used in worship
en: May visitors photograph the stone altar outside services?
zh: 礼拜以外的时间访客可以拍石祭坛吗？
transfer: 问讲解员祭坛上的花代表什么。
transferEn: Ask a guide about the meaning of flowers on a sacred table.

senseEn: the offense of betraying one's country
en: Was the minister charged with treason in the historical novel?
zh: 历史小说里那位大臣被控叛国了吗？
transfer: 读史料时问哪一段记录了这项叛国指控。
transferEn: Identify the passage documenting a charge of betraying the state.

senseEn: a hard stone, often green, used for carving
en: Is the jade pendant carved from one piece?
zh: 这块玉吊坠是整块雕刻的吗？
transfer: 在博物馆询问玉碗由哪种石料雕成。
transferEn: Ask about the stone used for a carved green bowl in a museum.

senseEn: not expected to happen
en: Is a refund unlikely after the event has started?
zh: 活动已经开始的话，是不是不太可能退款？
transfer: 根据发车时间说明我们很可能赶不上早班车。
transferEn: Explain why catching the early train seems improbable.

senseEn: to judge something as smaller or easier than it is
en: Did we underestimate the time needed to clean the hall?
zh: 我们是不是低估了打扫礼堂需要的时间？
transfer: 提醒同伴别低估上坡路的难度。
transferEn: Warn a companion not to judge an uphill trail as easier than it is.

senseEn: solely, without another purpose or element
en: Is this panel purely decorative, or does it open?
zh: 这块面板只是装饰，还是能打开？
transfer: 向同事说明今天的会面纯粹是为了收集意见。
transferEn: Tell a colleague the meeting is solely for gathering opinions.

senseEn: a suggestion given after consideration
en: Which design gets your recommendation for a busy entrance?
zh: 人流量大的入口你推荐哪种设计？
transfer: 请图书管理员推荐一本适合朗读的书。
transferEn: Ask a librarian for a suggested book that works well read aloud.

senseEn: to close and reopen the eyelids briefly
en: Try not to blink until the photograph is taken.
zh: 拍照前尽量别眨眼。
transfer: 拍完集体照后问自己是不是眨眼了。
transferEn: Ask whether your eyes closed briefly in a group photo.

senseEn: a person who repairs vehicles or machines
en: Can the mechanic check the brakes before Friday?
zh: 修车师傅能在周五前检查刹车吗？
transfer: 问邻居哪位修车师傅熟悉老式自行车。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor for someone experienced in repairing old bicycles.

senseEn: a small place serving coffee and light food
en: Does the corner cafe have outdoor tables?
zh: 街角的咖啡馆有露天座位吗？
transfer: 约朋友在博物馆楼下的咖啡馆见面。
transferEn: Arrange to meet a friend at the place serving coffee below a museum.

senseEn: a narrow decorative strip of fabric
en: Could you tie the green ribbon around the box?
zh: 你能把绿色丝带系在盒子上吗？
transfer: 包装花束时问花店有没有白丝带。
transferEn: Ask a florist for a white decorative strip to tie around flowers.

senseEn: the internal passage from the external genitals to the cervix
en: Does this diagram label the vagina separately from the cervix?
zh: 这张图是否分别标出了阴道和宫颈？
transfer: 就诊时用准确的解剖名称询问手册中标示的部位。
transferEn: Use the anatomical name to ask a clinician about the passage labeled in a booklet.

senseEn: a short catchy tune used in advertising
en: Who wrote the jingle for the old railway advert?
zh: 旧铁路广告里的短歌是谁写的？
transfer: 问朋友还记不记得小时候听过的广告曲。
transferEn: Ask a friend whether they remember a catchy commercial tune from childhood.

senseEn: with pleasure or willingness
en: I'd gladly cover the desk while you collect the tickets.
zh: 你去取票时我很乐意照看前台。
transfer: 主动表示愿意帮邻居给新家具拍照。
transferEn: Offer enthusiastically to photograph a neighbor's new furniture.

senseEn: making or containing a lot of sound
en: Is the street noisy at night when the shops close?
zh: 商店关门后这条街晚上还吵吗？
transfer: 向管理员说明哪台取暖器运转时太吵。
transferEn: Tell a caretaker which heater makes too much sound while running.

senseEn: a fastening on a strap or belt
en: Can you replace the buckle on this leather belt?
zh: 这条皮带的扣能换吗？
transfer: 借背包时检查肩带上的扣子有没有裂纹。
transferEn: Check the fastening on a borrowed backpack strap for cracks.

sense: 存放的一小批东西（口语）
senseEn: a supply kept aside, often in a hidden place
en: Where's the stash of spare pencils for quiz night?
zh: 为答题夜备下的那批铅笔放哪儿了？
transfer: 告诉室友应急巧克力藏在哪里。
transferEn: Tell a roommate where a small reserve of emergency chocolate is hidden.

senseEn: complete or absolute, used for emphasis
en: The two different maps caused utter confusion at the trailhead.
zh: 两张不同的地图让步道入口处的人彻底糊涂了。
transfer: 描述演出开始前礼堂出奇地一片寂静。
transferEn: Describe the complete silence in a hall just before a show.

senseEn: to formally leave a job or position
en: Did Nia resign from the committee before the vote?
zh: 妮娅是在投票前辞去委员会职务的吗？
transfer: 向主管说明你准备何时正式辞去兼职。
transferEn: Tell a manager when you intend to step down from a part-time role.

senseEn: an infection causing inflammation in the lungs
en: Is the follow-up for my pneumonia on Tuesday?
zh: 我的肺炎复诊是在周二吗？
transfer: 问诊所检查报告是否已经交给跟进肺炎的医生。
transferEn: Ask whether results reached the doctor following up on a lung infection.

senseEn: the process of calculating and paying staff wages
en: Who handles payroll questions when our manager is away?
zh: 经理不在时，谁负责解答工资发放的问题？
transfer: 入职时询问何时会被加入工资发放系统。
transferEn: Ask when you will be added to the system paying staff wages.

senseEn: a dog from a group bred for hunting or tracking
en: Is that a rescue hound beside the trainer?
zh: 训练师旁边那只是救助回来的猎犬吗？
transfer: 参观犬展时问哪只猎犬属于擅长追踪气味的品种。
transferEn: Ask which dog at a show belongs to a breed known for following scent.

senseEn: to move something with a quick light motion
en: Could you flick the switch beside the mirror?
zh: 能拨一下镜子旁的开关吗？
transfer: 提醒朋友用手指轻轻弹去衣袖上的线头。
transferEn: Suggest using a quick finger movement to remove a loose thread from a sleeve.

senseEn: to think about a decision again
en: Would you reconsider the date now that the hall is free?
zh: 礼堂现在有空，你愿意重新考虑日期吗？
transfer: 请编辑看过新照片后再考虑一下封面选择。
transferEn: Ask an editor to revisit a cover decision after seeing new photos.

senseEn: an image returned by a reflective surface
en: Can you see the reflection of the tower in the lake?
zh: 你能看到塔在湖里的倒影吗？
transfer: 拍照时让朋友挪动位置以避开玻璃上的倒影。
transferEn: Ask a friend to move away from a reflected image in a window when taking a photo.

senseEn: to provide a sound reason for a decision or cost
en: Can the extra seats justify the cost of a larger bus?
zh: 多出的座位能说明订更大巴士这笔钱花得值吗？
transfer: 向老师说明你为什么选择这份资料作证据。
transferEn: Give a convincing reason for choosing a source as evidence.

senseEn: for the most part
en: Is the workshop mainly for beginners or experienced singers?
zh: 这个工作坊主要面向新手还是有经验的歌手？
transfer: 告诉访客展览以当地摄影作品为主。
transferEn: Tell a visitor that an exhibition consists mostly of local photography.

senseEn: an area with shared geographic or cultural features
en: Which region of Spain does this cheese come from?
zh: 这款奶酪产自西班牙哪个地区？
transfer: 计划骑行时问哪个地区春天雨水最少。
transferEn: Ask which area receives the least spring rain when planning a cycling trip.

senseEn: something that saves someone from a difficult situation
en: The spare battery was our salvation when the microphone died.
zh: 麦克风没电时，备用电池成了我们的救星。
transfer: 讲述末班车停运后，一位邻居如何帮你解围。
transferEn: Describe how a neighbor saved the day after the last bus was canceled.

senseEn: based on sound reasoning
en: Is there a rational explanation for the two different totals?
zh: 两个合计数不同，有没有合理的解释？
transfer: 向团队提出一个合乎理性的改期理由。
transferEn: Give a team a reasoned argument for rescheduling.

senseEn: a lasting contribution passed on to others
en: Is the orchard her lasting legacy to the village?
zh: 这片果园是她给村里留下的长久遗产吗？
transfer: 说明一位老师给学校留下的长远影响。
transferEn: Describe the lasting contribution a teacher left to a school.

senseEn: a feeling that someone or something deserves little respect
en: Does the narrator speak with contempt about the landlord?
zh: 叙述者提起房东时语气里有轻蔑吗？
transfer: 读对白时指出哪些措辞透露出不屑。
transferEn: Identify wording that reveals a character's lack of respect in a dialogue.

senseEn: powder made from processed cacao beans
en: Does the recipe call for unsweetened cocoa or drinking chocolate?
zh: 这份食谱用无糖可可粉还是冲饮巧克力粉？
transfer: 做蛋糕时向邻居借两勺无糖可可粉。
transferEn: Borrow two spoonfuls of unsweetened cacao powder for a cake.

senseEn: tactful in handling a sensitive situation
en: Can you think of a diplomatic way to mention the noise?
zh: 你能想个委婉的办法提一下噪音问题吗？
transfer: 帮同事把反馈写得得体一些，同时保留要点。
transferEn: Help a colleague express criticism tactfully without losing the main point.

senseEn: a large humped animal adapted to dry conditions
en: Is the camel in this photo carrying water or grain?
zh: 照片里的骆驼驮的是水还是粮食？
transfer: 参观动物园时询问这只骆驼属于单峰还是双峰。
transferEn: Ask whether a desert animal at a zoo is of the one-humped or two-humped kind.

sense: 怪异得令人不安的（口语）
senseEn: strange in a startling or unsettling way
en: That freaky echo makes the empty tunnel sound crowded.
zh: 那阵怪异的回声让空隧道听起来好像挤满了人。
transfer: 向朋友描述旅馆里一幅让你发毛的画像。
transferEn: Casually describe an unnerving portrait in a hotel.

senseEn: the distinctive taste of food or drink
en: Does roasting give the tomatoes a sweeter flavor?
zh: 烤过以后番茄味道更甜吗？
transfer: 请朋友辨认茶里那股淡淡的水果味。
transferEn: Ask a friend to identify a faint fruity taste in tea.

senseEn: sadness caused by a lack of companionship
en: Did joining the choir help with your loneliness?
zh: 加入合唱团有没有缓解你的孤独感？
transfer: 告诉朋友刚搬家时，邻居的探访如何减轻了你的寂寞。
transferEn: Describe how a neighbor's visits eased your sense of isolation after a move.

senseEn: a small brush used to clean teeth
en: Does the guest kit include a toothbrush?
zh: 客用品里有牙刷吗？
transfer: 出门前问孩子有没有把牙刷装进洗漱包。
transferEn: Ask a child whether the brush for cleaning teeth is in the wash bag.

senseEn: a large self-service food and household goods store
en: Is the supermarket across the street open after nine?
zh: 街对面的超市九点以后还开吗？
transfer: 跟旅伴约好在超市蔬菜区碰面。
transferEn: Arrange to meet a companion in the produce section of a large grocery store.

senseEn: a portable electric light, in British English
en: Bring a torch for the walk back to the cottage.
zh: 走回小屋时带上手电筒。
transfer: 问英国露营地工作人员哪里能借到手电筒。
transferEn: Ask a British campsite worker where to borrow a handheld electric light.

senseEn: to overcome a strong fear or obstacle
en: What helped you conquer your fear of deep water?
zh: 是什么帮你克服了对深水的恐惧？
transfer: 跟同学说说你如何克服上台讲话的害怕。
transferEn: Explain to a classmate how you overcame a fear of public speaking.

senseEn: crackling interference in a radio or audio signal
en: Can you hear the static on this radio station?
zh: 你听得到这个电台的杂音吗？
transfer: 给技术人员描述录音中反复出现的干扰声。
transferEn: Describe recurring crackling interference in a recording to a technician.

senseEn: from or relating to Canada
en: Is the Canadian film showing with subtitles tonight?
zh: 今晚放的那部加拿大电影有字幕吗？
transfer: 参观摄影展时问哪位艺术家来自加拿大。
transferEn: Ask which artist at a photography exhibition comes from Canada.

senseEn: the liquid component of blood
en: Is this leaflet about plasma donation or whole-blood donation?
zh: 这份宣传页介绍的是捐血浆还是捐全血？
transfer: 在课堂上问老师血浆和血细胞有什么区别。
transferEn: Ask a teacher how the liquid component of blood differs from blood cells.

senseEn: a plant used to season food
en: Which fresh herb gives this sauce its lemony smell?
zh: 是哪种新鲜香草让这酱汁有柠檬香？
transfer: 问花店哪种可食用香草适合放在厨房窗边。
transferEn: Ask which edible seasoning plant suits a kitchen windowsill.

senseEn: to make certain something happens
en: How can we ensure everyone gets a seat on the last bus?
zh: 怎样确保每个人都能坐上末班车？
transfer: 交稿前提出一个确保人名拼写正确的办法。
transferEn: Suggest a way to make certain every name is spelled correctly before submission.

senseEn: a mildly vulgar informal word for poor quality
en: The review calls it “a crappy lock” but never says what broke.
zh: 评论用不雅口语骂它是一把烂锁，却没说明哪里坏了。
transfer: 帮顾客把投诉中粗俗的评价改成具体的产品问题。
transferEn: Help a customer replace a crude negative judgment with a specific product fault.

senseEn: achieving a result with little wasted time or effort
en: Is scanning the forms more efficient than entering them by hand?
zh: 扫描表单比手动录入更高效吗？
transfer: 向同事推荐一种能节省清点时间的方法。
transferEn: Recommend a time-saving way to count inventory.

senseEn: able to be seen
en: Is the lighthouse visible from the campsite?
zh: 从营地看得见灯塔吗？
transfer: 问同伴最后一排能不能看清字幕。
transferEn: Ask a companion whether the subtitles can be seen from the back row.

senseEn: to return something to a previous condition
en: Can we restore the original settings without losing the files?
zh: 可以恢复原设置又不丢文件吗？
transfer: 请管理员恢复你之前的借阅权限。
transferEn: Ask an administrator to reinstate your previous borrowing privileges.

senseEn: relating to trade, resources and money in a society
en: Does the report cover the economic impact of the new rail line?
zh: 报告包含新铁路带来的经济影响吗？
transfer: 请老师解释港口关闭对当地经济有什么影响。
transferEn: Ask a teacher how closing a port affects local business and jobs.

senseEn: a soft-bodied creature similar to a snail without a visible shell
en: Did a slug eat these holes in the lettuce?
zh: 生菜上的洞是蛞蝓咬的吗？
transfer: 向孩子指出花盆旁没有壳的软体小动物。
transferEn: Show a child the shell-less snail-like creature beside a flowerpot.

senseEn: the expected number of strokes for a golf hole
en: Is this hole a par four from the shorter tee?
zh: 从较短的发球台打，这洞是标准四杆吗？
transfer: 问教练你这一洞比标准杆多用了几杆。
transferEn: Ask how many strokes above the expected score you took on a hole.

senseEn: a person taking part in a run or race
en: Does each runner collect a number before warm-up?
zh: 每个跑者都要在热身前领号码吗？
transfer: 问志愿者最后一名跑者是否通过了补水站。
transferEn: Ask a volunteer whether the last person in the race has passed the water station.

senseEn: a scoring play in American football worth six points
en: Did the referee confirm the touchdown after the review?
zh: 裁判回看后确认达阵了吗？
transfer: 问朋友哪位球员在最后一节达阵。
transferEn: Ask a friend who scored the six-point play in the final quarter.

senseEn: a golf score one stroke below par
en: Was that putt for birdie or for par?
zh: 那一推是争取小鸟球还是保标准杆？
transfer: 询问球友今天在哪一洞打出了低于标准杆一杆的成绩。
transferEn: Ask a golfer which hole they finished one stroke below par today.

senseEn: a report of recent changes or progress
en: Could you send a quick update on the window repairs?
zh: 能简单说说窗户维修的最新情况吗？
transfer: 请朋友告诉你行李寻找工作有无进展。
transferEn: Ask for fresh news on the search for a lost bag.

senseEn: the way a person lives day to day
en: Does the village suit your quieter lifestyle now?
zh: 现在村里适合你较为安静的生活方式吗？
transfer: 和朋友比较搬家前后的日常生活方式。
transferEn: Compare how you live day to day before and after a move.

senseEn: a device that captures sound
en: Can I place the recorder between us for the interview?
zh: 采访时我能把录音设备放在我们中间吗？
transfer: 排练前确认录音设备有没有装存储卡。
transferEn: Check whether the sound-recording device has a memory card before rehearsal.

senseEn: hair grown above the upper lip
en: Did the actor grow a mustache for the part?
zh: 演员是为了这个角色留的小胡子吗？
transfer: 描述旧照片时说明哪位亲属留着上唇胡须。
transferEn: Identify the relative with hair above his upper lip in an old photo.

senseEn: a newcomer in a profession or sport
en: Is the rookie goalkeeper starting in today's match?
zh: 今天这场比赛是新人守门员首发吗？
transfer: 介绍刚加入车队的新手骑手。
transferEn: Introduce a cyclist spending their first season on a team.

senseEn: a quick drawing capturing basic features
en: Can I make a quick sketch of the stage before rehearsal?
zh: 排练前我能给舞台画张速写吗？
transfer: 请朋友画一张车站到旅馆的简图。
transferEn: Ask a friend for a rough drawing of the route from station to hotel.

senseEn: a short test of knowledge
en: Will the quiz cover the new chapter or last week's reading?
zh: 小测考新章节还是上周的阅读内容？
transfer: 询问老师课后小测能不能重做。
transferEn: Ask a teacher whether a short after-class test can be retaken.

senseEn: lasting a long time or recurring regularly
en: Does the clinic offer help with chronic pain?
zh: 这家诊所能为慢性疼痛提供帮助吗？
transfer: 问医生表格上的“慢性”是否包括长期反复出现的症状。
transferEn: Ask whether long-recurring symptoms fall under the form's category for lasting conditions.

senseEn: not clearly seen or heard
en: The voice is too indistinct to transcribe. Is there a clearer copy?
zh: 人声太模糊，没法转写。有更清楚的版本吗？
transfer: 告诉朋友雾中远处的塔看不清轮廓。
transferEn: Describe how hard it is to make out a tower's outline in fog.

senseEn: an archaic third-person singular form meaning has
en: The poem says, “The moon hath risen.” How would you put that today?
zh: 诗中用古语写“月亮已经升起”。换成现代说法怎么讲？
transfer: 朗读古文时指出哪个旧式助动词对应现代英语的 has。
transferEn: Identify the old auxiliary corresponding to modern “has” in a literary reading.

senseEn: not taking enough care
en: Was it careless of me to omit the room number?
zh: 我漏写房间号是不是太粗心了？
transfer: 讲讲一次因疏忽漏掉附件的经历。
transferEn: Describe a time inattention caused you to leave out an attachment.

senseEn: a removable cover for a container
en: Does the blue lid fit the large jar?
zh: 蓝盖子配得上那个大罐子吗？
transfer: 热汤打包前请店员把盖子压紧。
transferEn: Ask a server to secure the cover before packing hot soup.

senseEn: a person or company that makes something
en: Is the maker's name stamped under the bowl?
zh: 碗底印着制作者的名字吗？
transfer: 向工艺市集负责人打听那盏灯是谁做的。
transferEn: Ask a craft market organizer who made a particular lamp.

senseEn: taking risks without proper care
en: Would it be reckless to cross before the water drops?
zh: 水位降下去之前过河会不会太冒险？
transfer: 提醒同伴在结冰路面上赶时间是不顾安全的。
transferEn: Tell a companion why rushing on an icy road would be dangerously careless.

senseEn: relating to art or its creation
en: Who makes the artistic decisions for the festival?
zh: 艺术节的艺术创作由谁拍板？
transfer: 请老师评价海报设计的艺术效果。
transferEn: Ask a teacher for feedback on a poster's artistic qualities.

senseEn: an official authorization, in British English
en: Do I need a fishing licence for this lake?
zh: 在这个湖钓鱼需要许可证吗？
transfer: 去英国租车前确认要带哪种驾驶证。
transferEn: Check which driving permit to bring before renting a car in Britain.

senseEn: a short pointed blade, often seen in historical collections
en: Is the jeweled dagger a ceremonial piece in this exhibit?
zh: 展览里那把镶宝石的匕首是礼仪用的吗？
transfer: 在历史馆询问匕首展品的铭文写于哪个时期。
transferEn: Ask which period the inscription on a museum's historical short blade dates from.

senseEn: a person from Finland
en: Was the architect a Finn who later moved to Sweden?
zh: 那位建筑师是后来移居瑞典的芬兰人吗？
transfer: 在校友访谈里确认受访者是否来自芬兰。
transferEn: Check whether the person in an alumni interview comes from Finland.

senseEn: relating to a group of Indigenous peoples of North America
en: Which Apache community helped curate the language exhibit?
zh: 哪个阿帕奇社群参与策划了语言展？
transfer: 阅读博物馆资料时询问所说的是哪一支阿帕奇社群。
transferEn: Ask which specific Indigenous Apache community a museum source concerns.

senseEn: the act of getting rid of unwanted material
en: Is battery disposal available at this recycling center?
zh: 这个回收站能处理废电池吗？
transfer: 问物业怎样处理旧油漆罐。
transferEn: Ask building management how to get rid of old paint cans.

senseEn: immature in an inappropriate way
en: Was hiding his notes a childish response to the argument?
zh: 吵架后藏起他的笔记是不是很幼稚？
transfer: 讨论小说时说明哪个角色在争执中的表现不够成熟。
transferEn: Discuss which character behaved immaturely in a fictional argument.

senseEn: in or to another country
en: Will my bank card work while I'm abroad?
zh: 我在国外时这张银行卡能用吗？
transfer: 问学校去国外交换一学期需要准备什么。
transferEn: Ask what to prepare for a semester studying in another country.

senseEn: direct without softening one's words
en: Was my blunt reply too harsh for a first email?
zh: 我在第一封邮件里回得那么直，会不会太生硬？
transfer: 请朋友帮你修改一句过于直接的拒绝。
transferEn: Ask a friend to soften a refusal that sounds too direct.

senseEn: relating to machinery or its moving parts
en: Is the noise a mechanical fault or just a loose panel?
zh: 这声音是机械故障，还是面板松了？
transfer: 问修理师手表是机械的还是电子的。
transferEn: Ask a repairer whether a watch uses moving mechanisms or electronics.

senseEn: the study of living things
en: Does the introductory biology course include fieldwork?
zh: 生物学入门课包括实地考察吗？
transfer: 问老师哪间实验室专门用于生物课。
transferEn: Ask which lab is reserved for studying living organisms.

senseEn: a small long-bodied predatory mammal
en: Is the animal in this photo a weasel or a young ferret?
zh: 照片里这只动物是鼬，还是幼年雪貂？
transfer: 在自然博物馆比较鼬和水獭的体形。
transferEn: Compare the long-bodied small mammal with an otter at a nature museum.

senseEn: capable of causing harm through poisonous properties
en: Are these berries toxic to dogs?
zh: 这种浆果对狗有毒吗？
transfer: 问园丁阳台上哪种花对猫有毒。
transferEn: Ask a gardener which balcony flowers can poison a cat.

senseEn: to take someone's attention away
en: Will background music distract the readers in the study room?
zh: 背景音乐会让自习室里的读者分心吗？
transfer: 向室友说明手机提示音如何打断你的注意力。
transferEn: Explain how phone notifications pull your attention from your work.

senseEn: the act or extent of taking part
en: How much community involvement was there in planning the garden?
zh: 花园规划过程中社区参与度有多高？
transfer: 问活动负责人家长能以什么方式参与。
transferEn: Ask what part parents can play in organizing an event.

senseEn: completely or to the fullest degree
en: I was utterly surprised to see my first teacher at the concert.
zh: 在音乐会上见到我的启蒙老师，我完全没想到。
transfer: 描述你到达后发现门已关闭时有多困惑。
transferEn: Describe how completely puzzled you felt on finding the door closed.

senseEn: genuinely and honestly
en: I sincerely appreciate your patience with the delay.
zh: 我由衷感谢你对延误的耐心。
transfer: 向寄宿家庭写信，真诚感谢他们的照顾。
transferEn: Write to a host family expressing genuine thanks for their care.

senseEn: a loose, untidy pile
en: Please sort the heap of mail by the door.
zh: 请把门边那一堆邮件整理一下。
transfer: 做园艺时让朋友把落叶堆指给你看。
transferEn: Ask a friend to point out the pile of fallen leaves while gardening.

senseEn: with strong affection or attachment
en: We dearly miss our neighbor's morning piano practice.
zh: 我们很怀念邻居每天早晨练琴的声音。
transfer: 寄贺卡时告诉家人你多么深切地想念他们。
transferEn: Tell family how deeply you miss them in a greeting card.

senseEn: a physical feeling perceived by the body
en: Do you feel a tingling sensation in your fingers?
zh: 你的手指有麻刺感吗？
transfer: 向牙医描述冷饮让牙齿产生什么感觉。
transferEn: Describe to a dentist the feeling a cold drink produces in a tooth.

senseEn: unable to feel normal sensation
en: My toes are still numb after the cold walk.
zh: 在寒风里走过之后，我的脚趾还麻着。
transfer: 看牙后询问嘴唇麻木感通常何时消退。
transferEn: Ask when the loss of feeling in your lip usually wears off after dental work.

senseEn: the ability to guide a team or organization
en: Who showed strong leadership when the schedule changed?
zh: 日程改变时谁表现出了很强的领导能力？
transfer: 推荐志愿者当队长时举例说明其带队能力。
transferEn: Give an example of someone's ability to lead when recommending them as captain.

senseEn: a particular published version of a work
en: Does the new edition include an index?
zh: 新版有索引吗？
transfer: 请图书馆员帮忙找到带地图的那一版。
transferEn: Ask a librarian to locate the version that includes maps.

senseEn: a profane intensifier expressing strong irritation
en: The transcript marks “that goddamned noise” as profanity.
zh: 逐字稿将“那该死的噪音”标为了粗俗表达。
transfer: 向编辑说明某条抱怨中的脏话起什么语气作用。
transferEn: Explain how a profane intensifier functions in a complaint.

senseEn: an informal farewell borrowed from Italian
en: She waved and called, “Ciao, see you Monday!”
zh: 她挥手说：“再见，周一见！”
transfer: 和熟悉的意大利朋友分别时随意道别。
transferEn: Use an informal borrowed farewell when parting from an Italian friend.

senseEn: relating to atoms
en: Does this table list atomic mass or atomic number?
zh: 这张表列的是原子质量还是原子序数？
transfer: 问老师元素符号旁边哪个数字表示原子序数。
transferEn: Ask which number beside an element's symbol identifies its proton count.

senseEn: a tool with a heavy blade for chopping wood
en: Does the museum's old axe have its original wooden handle?
zh: 博物馆那把旧斧子还保留着原木柄吗？
transfer: 看工具目录时请馆员解释斧子展品的年代。
transferEn: Ask a curator to date a woodcutting tool in an exhibit catalog.

senseEn: a country's official office assisting its citizens abroad
en: Can the consulate replace a lost travel document?
zh: 领事馆能补办遗失的旅行证件吗？
transfer: 询问领事馆在节假日是否接受预约。
transferEn: Ask whether the office serving citizens abroad takes holiday appointments.

senseEn: not conveying useful information or purpose
en: Is the total meaningless without knowing the group size?
zh: 如果不知道小组人数，这个总数就没有意义吗？
transfer: 解释为什么没有日期的销量图无法传达有用信息。
transferEn: Explain why an undated sales graph conveys little useful information.

senseEn: to check that information is correct
en: Could you verify the address before printing the labels?
zh: 印标签之前能核实地址吗？
transfer: 请同学查阅原始名单核实人名拼写。
transferEn: Ask a classmate to check a name against the original list.

senseEn: the act or condition of being apart
en: Did the separation of glass and paper make recycling easier?
zh: 把玻璃和纸张分开让回收更方便了吗？
transfer: 问老师教室分区能否把阅读和游戏空间分开。
transferEn: Ask whether dividing a classroom keeps reading and play spaces apart.

senseEn: an electrical safety component that melts when current is excessive
en: Could a blown fuse explain why only this light went out?
zh: 只有这盏灯熄了，会不会是保险丝烧断了？
transfer: 问维修师发票上哪项是更换保险丝的费用。
transferEn: Ask which line on an electrician's bill covers replacing an electrical safety link.

senseEn: a plant grown for harvesting or its yield
en: Which crop grows best on this hillside?
zh: 这片山坡最适合种哪种作物？
transfer: 参观农场时问今年哪种作物收成最好。
transferEn: Ask which cultivated plant produced the best harvest this year.

senseEn: the teaching staff of a school or college
en: Can students attend the faculty meeting as observers?
zh: 学生可以旁听教职工会议吗？
transfer: 问院系谁负责向全体任课教师发通知。
transferEn: Ask who sends notices to all the department's instructors.

senseEn: a French expression of thanks
en: She handed back the map and said, “Merci, that helped!”
zh: 她把地图还回来，说：“谢谢，真有帮助！”
transfer: 在法国旅行时，用一句简短的法语感谢为你指路的人。
transferEn: Thank the person who gave you directions using a short French expression.

senseEn: a feeling of awkward self-consciousness
en: To my embarrassment, I introduced the same speaker twice.
zh: 让我尴尬的是，我把同一位讲者介绍了两遍。
transfer: 描述你叫错朋友名字时的窘迫。
transferEn: Describe how awkward you felt after using the wrong name.

senseEn: a period of ten years
en: Has the library changed much over the past decade?
zh: 过去十年图书馆变化大吗？
transfer: 问照片里的车站是哪一个十年时期的样子。
transferEn: Ask which ten-year period a station photograph depicts.

senseEn: appropriate for a particular purpose or person
en: Is this glue suitable for children's craft projects?
zh: 这种胶适合儿童手工吗？
transfer: 订房前问这间房是否适合行动不便的客人。
transferEn: Ask whether a room suits guests with limited mobility.

senseEn: to find a satisfactory end to a problem
en: Can we resolve the overlap before sending the timetable?
zh: 发时间表前能解决时段重叠的问题吗？
transfer: 请房东帮忙解决两家共用车位的分歧。
transferEn: Ask a landlord to help settle a disagreement over shared parking.

senseEn: necessary for a purpose
en: Is a reservation essential for this ferry in summer?
zh: 夏天坐这班渡轮一定要预约吗？
transfer: 问向导夜游时哪些装备必须带。
transferEn: Ask which items are indispensable for a night walk.

senseEn: covering only part of an amount or whole
en: Can I get a partial refund for the canceled session?
zh: 取消的那节课能退一部分费用吗？
transfer: 问会计这笔转账是全款还是部分付款。
transferEn: Ask whether a transfer settles a whole bill or only part.

senseEn: a building's water supply and drainage system
en: Was the plumbing replaced when the kitchen was renovated?
zh: 厨房翻新时更换了管道系统吗？
transfer: 问房东谁负责修理卫生间的供排水管道。
transferEn: Ask a landlord who handles bathroom pipe repairs.

senseEn: unable to settle or stay still
en: The children got restless during the long wait.
zh: 等得太久，孩子们开始坐不住了。
transfer: 跟朋友说你一整天待在家里后有些闲不住。
transferEn: Tell a friend you feel unable to sit still after a day indoors.

senseEn: regular payments received after retiring
en: Who can explain the pension plan for new staff?
zh: 谁能给新员工讲解养老金计划？
transfer: 问人事部门去哪里查看自己的养老金缴款记录。
transferEn: Ask HR where to check records of retirement contributions.

senseEn: for this reason, especially in formal writing
en: The road floods easily, hence the raised walkway.
zh: 这条路容易积水，所以修了架高的步道。
transfer: 在报告中解释因样本太小，所以需要再次调查。
transferEn: Formally link a small sample size to the need for a second survey.

senseEn: a device controlling the flow of gas or liquid
en: Is the shutoff valve under the sink or behind the washer?
zh: 截止阀是在水槽下还是洗衣机后？
transfer: 请水管工指出花园水管的控制阀。
transferEn: Ask a plumber to identify what controls the flow to the garden hose.

senseEn: a professional rider in horse races
en: Which jockey rode the winner in the final race?
zh: 最后一场比赛中，获胜马匹的骑师是谁？
transfer: 问工作人员今天哪位骑师是第一次参赛。
transferEn: Ask which professional horse racer is competing for the first time today.

senseEn: a scaled reptile usually with legs and a long tail
en: Did the lizard slip behind the flowerpot?
zh: 那只蜥蜴钻到花盆后面了吗？
transfer: 在自然展问墙上那种蜥蜴叫什么。
transferEn: Ask the name of the small long-tailed reptile shown on an exhibit wall.

senseEn: a named military unit traditionally made up of battalions
en: Which regiment appears on the badge in this old portrait?
zh: 这张旧肖像的徽章上写着哪个团？
transfer: 在家族档案里核对祖辈所属团的名字。
transferEn: Check the name of an ancestor's military unit in a family archive.

senseEn: to take advantage of an opportunity promptly
en: Should we seize the chance to exhibit while the hall is free?
zh: 礼堂免费时我们要不要抓住机会办展？
transfer: 鼓励同事把握一次去新部门学习的机会。
transferEn: Encourage a colleague to take an opportunity to train in a new department.

en: Could you translate this note from my landlord into Spanish?
zh: 你能把房东写的这张便条翻成西班牙语吗？
transfer: 在车站请双语乘客帮忙翻译广播通知。
senseEn: to express the same meaning in another language
transferEn: Ask a bilingual passenger to put a station announcement into your language.

senseEn: made by people rather than occurring naturally
en: Are those artificial flowers safe to leave outdoors?
zh: 那些人造花能放在户外吗？
transfer: 参观水池时询问池底的石头是不是人造的。
transferEn: Ask whether the stones in a display pool are manufactured or natural.

senseEn: the paid temporary use of something
en: Does the bike rental include a lock?
zh: 租自行车包含车锁吗？
transfer: 订车前确认租赁价格里是否包含第二位司机。
transferEn: Ask whether a temporary car hire price covers a second driver.

senseEn: toward the upper or more northerly part of a city
en: Does this train go uptown after the museum stop?
zh: 这班车过了博物馆站后往上城区开吗？
transfer: 在纽约打车时告诉司机你要往上城区去。
transferEn: Tell a New York cab driver you are heading toward a more northerly part of town.

senseEn: to sing a tune with closed lips
en: Could you hum the tune so I can find the right track?
zh: 你能哼一下曲调吗？我好找到对应曲目。
transfer: 忘了歌词时，请朋友只哼副歌的旋律。
transferEn: Ask a friend to sing the chorus melody with closed lips when the words escape you.

senseEn: discriminating against people on the basis of race
en: How did the editors address the racist language in the old review?
zh: 编辑们是如何处理旧评论中的种族歧视用语的？
transfer: 请老师说明怎样举报带种族歧视色彩的言论。
transferEn: Ask a teacher how to report a remark discriminating against people by race.

senseEn: a broad-tailed rodent that builds dams
en: Did a beaver gnaw these marks into the tree?
zh: 树上的这些齿痕是海狸啃出来的吗？
transfer: 问向导哪座水坝是海狸筑成的。
transferEn: Ask which dam was built by the broad-tailed rodent.

senseEn: in a lasting way, without an intended reversal
en: Will this stain permanently discolor the tablecloth?
zh: 这块污渍会让桌布永久变色吗？
transfer: 问房东能否把自行车架永久固定在墙上。
transferEn: Ask whether a bicycle rack may be fixed to a wall for good.

senseEn: not strongly spicy or sharp
en: Could I have the mild curry for the children?
zh: 可以给孩子们点不辣的咖喱吗？
transfer: 买芥末时询问哪款味道较温和。
transferEn: Ask which mustard has the least sharp taste.

senseEn: goods offered for sale
en: Can discounted merchandise be returned after the holiday?
zh: 节后打折商品可以退吗？
transfer: 问活动主办方哪里可以买官方纪念商品。
transferEn: Ask where official souvenir goods are sold at an event.

senseEn: ease of doing something without difficulty
en: We chose this flat for the convenience of walking to school.
zh: 我们选这套公寓是因为步行上学方便。
transfer: 跟朋友解释提前网上登记给你带来的便利。
transferEn: Describe how advance online registration made a visit easier.

senseEn: material made by weaving or knitting fibers
en: Can I take a fabric sample home to check the color?
zh: 我能带一块面料样布回家对一下颜色吗？
transfer: 请裁缝推荐适合夏天长裤的面料。
transferEn: Ask a tailor which textile suits lightweight summer trousers.

senseEn: a selfish desire for more than one needs
en: Does the story blame his greed for the broken friendship?
zh: 故事把友谊破裂归咎于他的贪婪吗？
transfer: 讨论寓言时指出哪个选择体现了贪欲。
transferEn: Identify the decision in a fable driven by wanting more than a fair share.

senseEn: an answer to a message or question
en: Have you had a reply from the venue about our booking?
zh: 场地方回复我们的预订消息了吗？
transfer: 告诉朋友你还在等图书馆对续借请求的答复。
transferEn: Tell a friend you are waiting to hear back about a library renewal.

senseEn: a meeting of the school community
en: Will the school assembly finish before the first bus leaves?
zh: 学校集会会在头班车发车前结束吗？
transfer: 向老师确认家长能否参加周五的全校集会。
transferEn: Ask whether parents may attend Friday's whole-school gathering.

senseEn: a slight irritating sensation
en: I've got a tickle in my throat when I sing.
zh: 我一唱歌喉咙就有点发痒。
transfer: 告诉医生鼻子发痒是在进花园之后开始的。
transferEn: Tell a clinician the slight irritation in your nose began after entering a garden.

senseEn: done before a final assessment or decision
en: Can we see the preliminary figures before next week's meeting?
zh: 下周开会前我们能看看初步数据吗？
transfer: 向队员说明现在公布的是初步名单。
transferEn: Explain that the roster currently posted is not yet final.

senseEn: to change the size, form or details of something
en: Can you alter this jacket without removing the pockets?
zh: 能在不拆口袋的情况下改这件夹克吗？
transfer: 问房东能不能改动窗帘轨道的位置。
transferEn: Ask whether a curtain rail's position may be changed.

senseEn: strong and forceful
en: Did the fierce wind blow the garden gate open?
zh: 是猛烈的大风把花园门吹开了吗？
transfer: 描述海岸步道上突然袭来的强风。
transferEn: Describe the powerful gusts that hit a coastal path.

senseEn: worrying and offering little comfort
en: Was the situation as grim as the first report suggested?
zh: 情况真像第一份报告里说的那么严峻吗？
transfer: 阅读小说时形容暴风雨中人物面临的严峻处境。
transferEn: Describe the bleak situation facing characters in a fictional storm.

senseEn: the feeling of being unhappy about a loss or event
en: The last photograph filled me with unexpected sadness.
zh: 最后那张照片让我涌起意想不到的悲伤。
transfer: 描述送别老邻居时的难过。
transferEn: Describe how you felt saying goodbye to a longtime neighbor.

senseEn: a worn piece of cloth used for wiping
en: Is there a clean rag for wiping the paint tin?
zh: 有擦油漆罐用的干净抹布吗？
transfer: 修自行车时向同伴借块旧布擦手。
transferEn: Ask for an old cloth to wipe your hands while repairing a bicycle.

senseEn: one's native country or ancestral land
en: Did the chef return to her homeland to learn these recipes?
zh: 这位厨师是回故乡学的这些食谱吗？
transfer: 采访音乐人时问哪首曲子最让他想起故土。
transferEn: Ask a musician which tune most reminds him of his native land.

senseEn: an affectionate informal word for a cat
en: Is your little pussycat hiding under the guest bed again?
zh: 你家那只小猫咪又躲在客床下面了吗？
transfer: 哄孩子时亲切地称呼来窗边的小猫。
transferEn: Use an affectionate word for the cat visiting the window while talking to a child.

senseEn: a public performance marking an event, often with costumes
en: Are the costumes ready for the village pageant?
zh: 村里庆典表演的服装准备好了吗？
transfer: 问老师孩子在历史庆典表演里会扮演谁。
transferEn: Ask which part a child will play in a historical community performance.

senseEn: requiring considerable effort or showing high aspirations
en: Is finishing by Friday too ambitious for two people?
zh: 两个人要在周五前做完，目标是不是定得太高？
transfer: 请导师评价你的研究计划是不是过于宏大。
transferEn: Ask an adviser whether your research plan aims too high.

senseEn: completely and with close attention
en: Are the bottles thoroughly dry before we add the labels?
zh: 贴标签前，这些瓶子都完全干了吗？
transfer: 告诉清洁人员地毯需要彻底清洗。
transferEn: Tell a cleaner the carpet needs a complete wash.

senseEn: to make distinctions unclear to someone
en: Will the similar names confuse new visitors?
zh: 这些相似的名字会让新来的访客搞混吗？
transfer: 提醒同学不要把两个报名日期混淆。
transferEn: Caution a classmate against mixing up two registration dates.

senseEn: as much as is required
en: Is one hour sufficient for the final sound check?
zh: 最后试音留一个小时够吗？
transfer: 问送货人员一台手推车够不够搬全部箱子。
transferEn: Ask whether one trolley meets the need for moving all the boxes.

senseEn: an approximate calculation of cost or amount
en: Could you give me an estimate before repairing the frame?
zh: 修理镜框前能先估个价吗？
transfer: 装修前询问对方能否先估算工期。
transferEn: Ask for an approximate duration before renovation begins.

senseEn: a reduction from the usual price
en: Is there a discount for groups larger than ten?
zh: 十人以上的团体有折扣吗？
transfer: 询问店员样品是否享有折扣。
transferEn: Ask a clerk about a price reduction for a display model.

senseEn: a long-handled tool used to sweep
en: Could you bring the broom for these dry leaves?
zh: 能把扫帚拿来扫这些干树叶吗？
transfer: 打扫楼梯前问楼管扫帚放在哪里。
transferEn: Ask a caretaker where to find a sweeping tool for the stairs.

senseEn: a seed of a cereal crop used as food
en: Is quinoa cooked the same way as a grain of rice?
zh: 藜麦和米粒的烹调方法一样吗？
transfer: 参观粮店时让孩子看一粒小麦有哪些部分。
transferEn: Ask a child to inspect a single wheat seed in a grain shop.

senseEn: a person working professionally in banking
en: Did the banker explain the fee before opening the account?
zh: 银行工作人员开户前解释手续费了吗？
transfer: 采访一位银行家时问他最初在哪个部门工作。
transferEn: Ask a banking professional which department they started in.

senseEn: the work of promoting products or services to customers
en: Who handles marketing for the Saturday food market?
zh: 谁负责周六食品市集的营销推广？
transfer: 问公司销售与营销团队怎样分工。
transferEn: Ask how a company divides responsibilities for sales and promotion.

senseEn: not bright or well lit
en: Is the reading lamp too dim for small print?
zh: 看小字时这盏阅读灯是不是太暗了？
transfer: 看房时告诉房东走廊灯光有点暗。
transferEn: Tell a landlord the hallway isn't bright enough.

senseEn: the American football player who directs offensive plays
en: Who played quarterback in the final quarter?
zh: 最后一节谁打四分卫？
transfer: 问同学哪位四分卫是新转学来的。
transferEn: Ask which player directing the offense recently transferred to the school.

sense: 伏都教（使用名称须尊重文化）
senseEn: a name used for certain Afro-Caribbean religious traditions
en: Does the catalog use the term “voodoo” or the community's preferred name?
zh: 目录采用“伏都教”这个称呼，还是社群自己偏好的名称？
transfer: 讨论展览说明时询问相关社群如何称呼自己的信仰。
transferEn: Ask how the featured community names its religious tradition in an exhibit.

senseEn: to defeat completely, especially in a story
en: How does the hero vanquish the fear that keeps her indoors?
zh: 主人公如何战胜不敢出门的恐惧？
transfer: 用文学语气描述主人公最终克服的障碍。
transferEn: Describe in literary language the obstacle a protagonist ultimately overcomes.

senseEn: containing many carefully arranged details
en: How long did they spend on the elaborate costumes?
zh: 这些精心制作的繁复戏服花了他们多久？
transfer: 向布景设计师询问最复杂的舞台装饰是怎样完成的。
transferEn: Ask a designer how the most intricate stage decorations were made.

senseEn: to go somewhere with someone
en: May a parent accompany the child into the treatment room?
zh: 家长能陪孩子进诊室吗？
transfer: 问访客是否希望有人陪他到车站。
transferEn: Ask a guest whether they'd like someone to go with them to the station.

senseEn: covering the simplest or most basic level
en: Is elementary Spanish offered in the evening?
zh: 晚上有初级西班牙语课吗？
transfer: 向老师询问初级绘画班是否需要基础。
transferEn: Ask whether the basic drawing course requires prior experience.

senseEn: to have a connection to something
en: How does this graph relate to the survey question?
zh: 这张图和调查问题有什么关联？
transfer: 请学生解释例子与文章主题怎样联系起来。
transferEn: Ask a student to explain the link between an example and an essay's theme.

senseEn: the act of placing a dead body in the ground
en: Does the record give the burial date or just the year?
zh: 档案里写了安葬的具体日期，还是只有年份？
transfer: 查家谱时询问教堂有没有保存安葬登记册。
transferEn: Ask whether a church keeps records of interments when tracing family history.

senseEn: relating to medical diagnosis or treatment of mental health conditions
en: Does the clinic offer psychiatric consultations by appointment?
zh: 该诊所可以预约精神科咨询吗？
transfer: 询问医院精神科门诊在哪栋楼。
transferEn: Ask which building houses the outpatient mental health medical service.

senseEn: a sample preserved or examined for scientific study
en: Is the insect specimen from the island survey?
zh: 这件昆虫标本来自岛屿调查吗？
transfer: 请馆员说明哪件植物标本最早入藏。
transferEn: Ask a curator which preserved plant sample entered the collection first.

senseEn: an archaic or dialectal affirmative, a variant of aye
en: In the play, “Ay, sir” means the sailor agrees.
zh: 在这出戏中，水手说“是，先生”表示同意。
transfer: 排练历史剧时，读出剧本里的旧式肯定答语。
transferEn: Rehearse an old-fashioned affirmative reply as printed in a historical play.

senseEn: a bowed string instrument held under the chin
en: Can I rent a violin for the first month of lessons?
zh: 我能在上课的第一个月租一把小提琴吗？
transfer: 请音乐老师检查孩子的小提琴是否合适。
transferEn: Ask a music teacher about the fit of a child's bowed string instrument.

senseEn: a new business project involving risk
en: Who funded the new venture before the first café opened?
zh: 第一间咖啡馆开张前，谁资助了这个创业项目？
transfer: 采访创业者时问她如何为第一项事业找搭档。
transferEn: Ask a founder how she found partners for her first business project.

senseEn: to devote resources for a future benefit
en: Should we invest more time in training before buying new tools?
zh: 买新工具前，是不是该先多花点时间培训？
transfer: 向团队询问是否愿意给用户研究投入人力。
transferEn: Ask whether a team will devote staff time to user research.

senseEn: eerie in a mildly frightening way
en: The empty platform feels rather spooky after midnight.
zh: 午夜后的空站台有点阴森。
transfer: 向朋友形容万圣节展览里最瘆人的走廊。
transferEn: Describe the eeriest hallway in a Halloween exhibit.

senseEn: stating agreement or confirmation
en: Was that an affirmative reply to our request?
zh: 那是对我们请求的肯定答复吗？
transfer: 核对会议记录时确认委员会是否给出了肯定答复。
transferEn: Check whether a committee answered yes in meeting minutes.

senseEn: a large area of sea extending into land
en: Is the ferry crossing the gulf or following the coast?
zh: 渡轮是横穿海湾还是沿着海岸走？
transfer: 请老师在地图上指出哪片海湾连接这两个港口。
transferEn: Ask which large inlet connects two ports on a map.

senseEn: located or available on a vehicle or vessel
en: Is there an onboard café on the afternoon ferry?
zh: 下午那班渡轮上有咖啡馆吗？
transfer: 订火车票前问车上无线网络是否要付费。
transferEn: Ask whether the train's own Wi-Fi costs extra.

senseEn: quietly and gently
en: Please speak softly near the reading room.
zh: 阅览室附近请轻声说话。
transfer: 讲睡前故事时问孩子是否希望你声音更轻些。
transferEn: Ask a child if they'd like a bedtime story read in a quieter voice.

senseEn: a young cat
en: Can the new kitten stay in the spare room tonight?
zh: 新来的小猫今晚能住空房间吗？
transfer: 问动物收容所最小的猫咪什么时候可以领养。
transferEn: Ask when the youngest cat at a shelter can be adopted.

senseEn: to strike one's hands together to applaud
en: Should we clap after each movement or wait until the end?
zh: 我们该每个乐章后鼓掌，还是等到结束？
transfer: 排练时告诉同学什么时候给孩子们的表演鼓掌。
transferEn: Tell classmates when to applaud the children's performance.

sense: 同性恋的（较正式或历史用语）
senseEn: describing attraction to people of the same sex; often formal or dated in everyday use
en: The editor explains why the old survey used the term “homosexual”.
zh: 编辑解释了旧问卷为什么使用“同性恋的”这一较正式的词。
transfer: 讨论历史问卷里的性取向词汇时，说明语域怎样随时代变化。
transferEn: Explain how register has changed for a term about same-sex attraction in a historical survey.

senseEn: an annual publication recording a school's people and events
en: Can I borrow the school yearbook from the year we graduated?
zh: 我能借我们毕业那年的学校年鉴吗？
transfer: 问校友办公室年鉴里是否有合唱团合照。
transferEn: Ask whether a school annual contains a choir group photo.

senseEn: careful and covering all relevant details
en: Can we do a thorough check before the chairs go back?
zh: 把椅子还回去前能仔细检查一遍吗？
transfer: 感谢同事对申请材料所做的全面审阅。
transferEn: Thank a colleague for a careful and comprehensive review of application papers.

senseEn: unfortunately, with sadness or regret
en: The old café has sadly closed for good.
zh: 很遗憾，那间老咖啡馆已经永久关门了。
transfer: 告诉朋友你很遗憾无法参加他们的庆祝活动。
transferEn: Express regret when telling a friend you cannot attend a celebration.

senseEn: an item kept as a reminder of a visit or event
en: Can I keep the printed ticket as a souvenir?
zh: 我能留下这张纸票作纪念吗？
transfer: 请店员推荐一件能放进背包的小纪念品。
transferEn: Ask a shop assistant for a small memento that fits in a backpack.

senseEn: an underground conduit carrying wastewater
en: Is the smell coming from the sewer under the street?
zh: 气味是从街道下面的下水道传来的吗？
transfer: 问物业修理下水道时哪个入口会封闭。
transferEn: Ask which entrance will close while the wastewater conduit is repaired.

senseEn: someone competing against you
en: Have you played your next opponent before?
zh: 你以前和下一位对手交过手吗？
transfer: 询问辩论赛中你的对方辩手来自哪所学校。
transferEn: Ask which school your debate competitor represents.

senseEn: someone who teaches a practical skill or course
en: Can the driving instructor meet me outside the station?
zh: 驾驶教练能在车站外等我吗？
transfer: 向社区中心询问谁负责教初学陶艺。
transferEn: Ask a community center who teaches beginner pottery.

senseEn: to pull sharply or suddenly
en: Don't yank the cable; the plug comes out easily.
zh: 别猛拽电线，插头很容易拔出来。
transfer: 提醒孩子别用力扯被抽屉夹住的布。
transferEn: Remind a child not to pull sharply on cloth trapped in a drawer.

senseEn: a flat floating craft or an inflatable river craft
en: Does the raft have room for all our dry bags?
zh: 筏子上放得下我们所有的防水袋吗？
transfer: 问向导筏子在哪里上岸。
transferEn: Ask where a river group's floating craft will land.

senseEn: a version of a text in another language
en: Which English translation of the poem should we read?
zh: 这首诗我们该读哪一版英译？
transfer: 请图书管理员帮忙找一本小说的日语译本。
transferEn: Ask a librarian for the Japanese version of a novel originally written elsewhere.

senseEn: a long piece of fabric worn around the neck
en: Did I leave my wool scarf on the back of that chair?
zh: 我是不是把羊毛围巾落在那把椅背上了？
transfer: 给朋友挑礼物时问哪条围巾和灰外套相配。
transferEn: Ask which neck wrap matches a gray coat when choosing a gift.

senseEn: someone who steals by force or threat
en: Did the witness recognize the robber in the final scene?
zh: 最后一幕里证人认出了抢劫者吗？
transfer: 讨论小说时指出是谁把路人错认成抢劫者。
transferEn: Identify who mistook a passerby for the person who committed a robbery.

senseEn: the process of making someone a legal child or taking an animal into one's care
en: Is the older cat ready for adoption this week?
zh: 那只年纪较大的猫这周可以领养了吗？
transfer: 向收容所询问领养后是否会安排回访。
transferEn: Ask a shelter whether it follows up after a pet joins a permanent home.

senseEn: a place offering baths or wellness treatments
en: Does the hotel spa open before breakfast?
zh: 酒店的水疗中心早餐前开门吗？
transfer: 预约前问水疗中心是否提供毛巾。
transferEn: Ask whether towels are provided at a wellness and bathing center.

senseEn: a formal agreement between governments
en: Which countries signed the treaty shown in the exhibit?
zh: 展出的条约由哪些国家签署？
transfer: 在历史课上询问那份条约何时生效。
transferEn: Ask when a formal agreement between states took effect.

senseEn: a sand-filled hazard on a golf course
en: Did your ball land in the bunker beside the green?
zh: 你的球落到果岭旁的沙坑里了吗？
transfer: 问球友第二洞的沙坑在球道哪一侧。
transferEn: Ask which side of the fairway has a sand hazard on the second hole.

senseEn: a tool used to cut a particular material
en: Is there a paper cutter in the copy room?
zh: 复印室里有切纸机吗？
transfer: 做饼干时问星形切模放在哪个抽屉。
transferEn: Ask which drawer holds the star-shaped tool for cutting cookie dough.

senseEn: to show how something works by doing it
en: Could you demonstrate the first fold before we try it?
zh: 我们动手前，能示范一下第一折吗？
transfer: 请教练演示如何调整划船机的座位。
transferEn: Ask a trainer to show how to adjust the seat on a rowing machine.

senseEn: the painful feeling of being publicly made to feel small
en: Does the diary describe the humiliation of being laughed at in class?
zh: 日记里是否描述了在班上被嘲笑时的羞辱感？
transfer: 谈谈小说人物公开道歉时感到的屈辱。
transferEn: Discuss a character's sense of shame at a forced public apology.

senseEn: something used in place of another item
en: Would oat milk work as a substitute for cream in this soup?
zh: 这道汤里燕麦奶能代替奶油吗？
transfer: 做模型时问什么材料可以代替软木。
transferEn: Ask what material could replace cork in a model.

senseEn: a major branch of a tree
en: Can the gardener check the broken limb over the footpath?
zh: 园丁能检查一下悬在人行道上方的断枝吗？
transfer: 描述风暴后落在篱笆上的那根大树枝。
transferEn: Describe the large branch that fell on a fence after a storm.

en: Could you check the inventory before ordering more gloves?
zh: 再订手套之前，你能查一下库存清单吗？
transfer: 搬工作室时让同事核对相机设备清单。
senseEn: a list of items on hand
transferEn: Ask a colleague to check the camera equipment list when moving studios.

senseEn: continuous casual talk
en: Could you hear the guide above the chatter in the hall?
zh: 厅里一片聊天声，你听得见导游说话吗？
transfer: 描述列车开动前车厢里轻快的交谈声。
transferEn: Describe the lively sound of informal conversations before a train departs.

senseEn: to take a child or animal into one's family
en: Can we adopt the two kittens together?
zh: 我们能一起领养这两只小猫吗？
transfer: 询问收容所领养一只年长狗需要什么手续。
transferEn: Ask how to take an older shelter dog into your family.

senseEn: connected with formal education or scholarship
en: Does the application require an academic reference?
zh: 申请需要学术推荐信吗？
transfer: 问学校学年什么时候正式开始。
transferEn: Ask when the institution's teaching year officially begins.

senseEn: a camera component that focuses incoming light
en: Can I borrow a wider lens for the group photo?
zh: 拍合照时能借我一支更广角的镜头吗？
transfer: 询问相机店哪支镜头适合拍鸟。
transferEn: Ask a camera shop which optical attachment suits bird photography.

senseEn: one section of a poem or song
en: Can you read the final verse more slowly?
zh: 你能把最后一节读慢一点吗？
transfer: 让合唱团从第二段主歌开始练。
transferEn: Ask the choir to rehearse from the song's second stanza.

senseEn: to make a feature or device start working
en: Do I need to activate the pass before boarding?
zh: 上车前需要激活通票吗？
transfer: 问图书馆员怎样启用新卡的在线借阅功能。
transferEn: Ask how to enable online borrowing on a new library card.

senseEn: a particular area of activity or thought
en: Does this problem fall within the realm of design or engineering?
zh: 这个问题属于设计领域还是工程领域？
transfer: 请老师解释报告哪些内容属于历史学范畴。
transferEn: Ask which parts of a report belong to the field of history.

senseEn: a particular organized crime network, especially of Italian origin
en: Does the archive distinguish the Mafia from other crime groups?
zh: 档案资料把黑手党和其他犯罪团伙区分开来了吗？
transfer: 讨论电影评论时指出作者特指的是哪个有组织团体。
transferEn: Identify which specific organized crime network a film critic means.

senseEn: a small amount or degree, in informal speech
en: Could you turn the music down a tad?
zh: 能把音乐调小一点点吗？
transfer: 试衣时随口说袖口稍微紧了点。
transferEn: Casually mention that a cuff feels a little too tight.

senseEn: a British informal term for a man
en: The bloke at the ticket desk found my scarf.
zh: 售票处那位男士找到了我的围巾。
transfer: 和英国朋友随口谈起昨天帮你修车的男子。
transferEn: Casually mention the man who fixed your bike to a British friend.

senseEn: unwanted disturbance in a signal
en: Is the crackling caused by radio interference?
zh: 噼啪声是无线电干扰造成的吗？
transfer: 向技术员描述麦克风附近的设备怎样干扰收音。
transferEn: Describe how a nearby device disturbs the microphone signal.

senseEn: failing to take proper care or meet one's duties
en: Would it be irresponsible to leave the stall unattended?
zh: 把摊位放着不管是不是不负责任？
transfer: 解释为什么把确认人数拖到最后一刻是不负责任的安排。
transferEn: Explain why delaying the head count until the last minute shows a lack of responsibility.

senseEn: giving encouragement or practical help
en: My team was really supportive when I changed roles.
zh: 我换岗位时，团队给了我很多支持。
transfer: 向一位在你备考时不断鼓励你的朋友道谢。
transferEn: Thank a friend who gave you steady encouragement while you studied.

senseEn: happening once each week
en: Is the weekly market still on Saturday mornings?
zh: 每周一次的市集还是在周六早晨吗？
transfer: 问同事每周例会是否换了地点。
transferEn: Ask whether the meeting held every week has a new location.

senseEn: a great victory or achievement
en: Was finishing the race a personal triumph after your injury?
zh: 伤后完成比赛对你来说是一次重大胜利吗？
transfer: 向剧组祝贺首演大获成功。
transferEn: Congratulate a theater company on the great success of its first performance.

senseEn: someone visiting a place for pleasure
en: Can a tourist buy the same travel card as a resident?
zh: 游客能买和居民一样的交通卡吗？
transfer: 问向导夏天游客最多的街区在哪里。
transferEn: Ask a guide which area receives the most leisure visitors in summer.

senseEn: a late-night venue offering music and dancing
en: Does the nightclub below the hotel close before midnight?
zh: 旅馆楼下的夜总会午夜前关门吗？
transfer: 和朋友计划跳舞时询问夜店是否有最低年龄要求。
transferEn: Ask about the age limit at a late-night dance venue.

senseEn: relating to towns or cities
en: Does the course cover urban transport as well as housing?
zh: 这门课除了住房，还讲城市交通吗？
transfer: 问规划师公园会如何改变周边城区的生活。
transferEn: Ask a planner how a park will change life in the surrounding city area.

senseEn: a group of birds moving or feeding together
en: Did the flock of geese return to the marsh this morning?
zh: 那群鹅今早回到湿地了吗？
transfer: 向朋友描述日落时飞过湖面的鸟群。
transferEn: Describe birds flying together over the lake at sunset.

senseEn: moved quietly and secretly
en: The cat snuck into the laundry basket while we packed.
zh: 我们收拾行李时，猫悄悄钻进了洗衣篮。
transfer: 讲述孩子怎样偷偷进厨房准备生日早餐。
transferEn: Describe how a child entered the kitchen unnoticed to prepare a birthday breakfast.

senseEn: basic consideration and respect for others
en: He had the decency to call before canceling the ride.
zh: 他取消接送前还算有礼，先打了电话。
transfer: 谈谈演出取消时通知观众是最基本的礼貌。
transferEn: Explain that informing an audience of a cancellation is basic consideration.

senseEn: light coming directly from the sun
en: Does this corner get direct sunlight in winter?
zh: 冬天这个角落能晒到直射阳光吗？
transfer: 问主人下午哪里适合把毯子拿去晒太阳。
transferEn: Ask where sunshine reaches in the afternoon for airing a blanket.

senseEn: a person caring for children while parents are out
en: Can the babysitter stay until the concert ends?
zh: 临时保姆能待到音乐会结束吗？
transfer: 临出门前把紧急联系电话留给照看孩子的人。
transferEn: Leave an emergency number for the person watching your child while you go out.

senseEn: powered by or relating to energy from the sun
en: Do the solar lights stay on after a cloudy day?
zh: 阴天过后这些太阳能灯还能亮吗？
transfer: 询问露营地淋浴热水是不是由太阳能加热。
transferEn: Ask whether the campground showers use energy from the sun to heat water.

senseEn: a measurement of length, width or height
en: Which dimension is the depth on this cabinet drawing?
zh: 这张柜子图纸上哪个尺寸是深度？
transfer: 订窗帘前确认窗户还有哪一个尺寸没量。
transferEn: Check which window measurement is missing before ordering curtains.

senseEn: the side of an animal's body
en: Is the white patch on the horse's flank visible in the photograph?
zh: 照片里马侧腹的白斑看得见吗？
transfer: 描述牧场里那头小牛侧腹上的花纹。
transferEn: Describe the markings on the side of a calf's body.

senseEn: the characteristic sound a duck makes
en: Was that a duck's quack from the reeds?
zh: 刚才芦苇里的那声是鸭叫吗？
transfer: 在自然录音里指出哪一声是鸭子发出的。
transferEn: Identify the sound made by a duck in a nature recording.

senseEn: with little pressure or force
en: Press the dough lightly with your fingertips.
zh: 用指尖轻轻按一下面团。
transfer: 提醒孩子触碰画纸时下手轻些。
transferEn: Remind a child to use very little pressure when touching drawing paper.

senseEn: not showing appreciation for help or kindness
en: Would it seem ungrateful to decline their generous offer?
zh: 拒绝他们慷慨的提议会不会显得不知感恩？
transfer: 向朋友解释你为什么担心退还礼物显得不领情。
transferEn: Explain why returning a gift might seem to show little appreciation.

senseEn: practical given the actual circumstances
en: Is Friday a realistic deadline for all three translations?
zh: 三份翻译都在周五前完成，这个期限现实吗？
transfer: 请教练帮你设定一个切实可行的比赛目标。
transferEn: Ask a coach for a target that fits your actual preparation.

senseEn: to create something new that did not exist before
en: Did the students invent this game for the science fair?
zh: 这个游戏是学生为科学展发明的吗？
transfer: 请孩子为雨天发明一个新的室内游戏。
transferEn: Invite a child to devise a new indoor activity for a rainy day.

senseEn: to remove goods from a vehicle
en: Where can we unload the chairs before the van leaves?
zh: 货车离开前我们可以把椅子卸在哪里？
transfer: 问码头工作人员哪批箱子要先卸。
transferEn: Ask dock staff which boxes should come off the boat first.

senseEn: someone trained to compete in sports
en: Is the youngest athlete running in both events?
zh: 最年轻的运动员两个项目都要跑吗？
transfer: 介绍一位伤愈后重返比赛的运动员。
transferEn: Introduce a trained competitor returning after an injury.

en: Slow down before the sharp curve by the pond.
zh: 池塘旁有个急弯，入弯前减速。
transfer: 给跑友指路时，告诉他补水站在弯道之后。
senseEn: a bend in a road or path
transferEn: Tell a runner the water station is just after the bend.

senseEn: to begin, especially in formal announcements
en: At what time will boarding commence for the night ferry?
zh: 夜班渡轮将于几点开始登船？
transfer: 为毕业典礼写一句正式的开场时间通知。
transferEn: Write a formal notice giving the start time of a graduation ceremony.

senseEn: a small explosive weapon, here named as a historical exhibit
en: Is the grenade replica in the display made of wood?
zh: 展柜里的手榴弹复制品是木制的吗？
transfer: 在影视道具展上询问哪张标签介绍的是手榴弹模型。
transferEn: Identify the label for a nonfunctional grenade model in a film-prop exhibition.

sense: 贬称矮小症患者的辱称
senseEn: an offensive and outdated slur for a person with dwarfism
en: The editor flagged the slur “midget” in the old caption.
zh: 编辑指出旧图注中那个针对矮小症患者的辱称带有冒犯性。
transfer: 审阅旧采访时说明为什么不能沿用这个称呼。
transferEn: Explain why a derogatory label in an archival interview should not be adopted as a current description.

senseEn: someone giving individual or small-group instruction
en: Can the math tutor meet us in the library?
zh: 数学辅导老师能在图书馆和我们见面吗？
transfer: 向学校询问是否有帮助练习发音的一对一老师。
transferEn: Ask whether the school offers individual instruction in pronunciation.

senseEn: a cucumber preserved in vinegar or brine
en: Can I have an extra pickle with the sandwich?
zh: 我的三明治能多加一根腌黄瓜吗？
transfer: 问汉堡店能否把腌黄瓜另外放。
transferEn: Ask a burger shop to serve the preserved cucumber separately.

senseEn: a printed guide to a performance, in British English
en: Does the programme list tonight's understudy?
zh: 节目单上写了今晚替补演员的名字吗？
transfer: 在英国剧院问哪里能买到演出的节目册。
transferEn: Ask where to buy the performance booklet at a British theater.

senseEn: a book of blank or ruled pages for notes
en: Can I borrow your notebook to copy the homework dates?
zh: 能借你的笔记本抄一下作业日期吗？
transfer: 去采访前问朋友是否带了空白笔记本。
transferEn: Ask whether a friend packed a blank book for taking interview notes.

senseEn: to stop an operation before completion
en: Can I abort the upload without losing the original file?
zh: 我可以中止上传而不丢失原文件吗？
transfer: 向技术人员确认取消打印任务会不会影响后续文件。
transferEn: Ask whether stopping a print job before completion affects the files after it.

senseEn: decisively important to an outcome
en: Which figure is crucial to the budget decision?
zh: 哪个数字对预算决策至关重要？
transfer: 告诉团队为什么文件交接的时间很关键。
transferEn: Explain why the timing of a file handover matters decisively.

senseEn: showing exceptional courage
en: Who wrote the account of the heroic rescue at sea?
zh: 是谁记录了那次英勇的海上救援？
transfer: 在纪念活动致辞中描述志愿者勇敢救人的举动。
transferEn: Describe a volunteer's act of exceptional courage in a commemorative speech.

senseEn: involving thought, reasoning or understanding
en: Did the puzzles offer enough intellectual challenge for the group?
zh: 这些谜题对小组来说有足够的思维挑战吗？
transfer: 描述哪门课最能激发你的思考。
transferEn: Describe the class that most challenges your reasoning.

en: Why does this phenomenon occur only when the lake freezes?
zh: 这种现象为什么只在湖面结冰时出现？
transfer: 看见天空出现双彩虹时，请老师解释这一现象。
senseEn: an observable event or occurrence
transferEn: Ask your teacher to explain the double rainbow you saw.

senseEn: a binding material used in building
en: Has the cement around the post set yet?
zh: 柱子周围的水泥凝固了吗？
transfer: 问建材店修补小台阶需要多大一袋水泥。
transferEn: Ask a builder's merchant what size bag of binding material a step repair needs.

senseEn: an insulting informal term for a foolish or unpleasant person
en: The review was edited to remove the insult “schmuck”.
zh: 评论经过编辑，删掉了“蠢货”这个辱称。
transfer: 讨论礼貌表达时说明这个俚语为什么不适合写在投诉里。
transferEn: Explain why this insulting slang term is unsuitable in a written complaint.

senseEn: protection offered by a state to someone fleeing danger
en: Does the history exhibit explain why the writer sought asylum?
zh: 历史展有没有解释那位作家为什么寻求庇护？
transfer: 阅读回忆录时核实哪个国家向主人公提供了庇护。
transferEn: Check which country offered the memoir's subject protection after they fled.

senseEn: a person who takes part in betting
en: Is the narrator a gambler or just a spectator at the race?
zh: 叙述者是投注的人，还是只看比赛的观众？
transfer: 在小说讨论中指出哪个人物一直在赛马场下注。
transferEn: Identify the character who regularly places bets at a racetrack.

senseEn: the large hard-shelled fruit of a tropical palm
en: Is this curry made with coconut milk?
zh: 这道咖喱是用椰奶做的吗？
transfer: 买甜点前确认有没有加椰丝。
transferEn: Ask whether a dessert contains shreds of the tropical palm fruit.

senseEn: a rule requiring people to stay in after a set time
en: Is there a curfew at the youth hostel?
zh: 青年旅舍规定几点以后不能外出吗？
transfer: 在夏令营说明会上询问晚上必须回房的时间。
transferEn: Ask when campers must be inside their rooms at night.

senseEn: a business providing hair or beauty services
en: Does the salon take walk-ins for a trim?
