zh: 这家美发店接受没预约的客人来修剪头发吗？
transfer: 想染发前向朋友打听附近评价好的美发店。
transferEn: Ask a friend for a nearby hairdressing business before booking color treatment.

senseEn: a French greeting used during the day
en: Our host greeted us with “Bonjour, come in!”
zh: 主人说“你好，快请进”，迎接我们。
transfer: 去法国咖啡馆时先用法语向店主打个招呼。
transferEn: Greet a café owner in French when entering during the day.

senseEn: a long-bodied predatory freshwater fish
en: Are there pike in this lake as well as perch?
zh: 这湖里除了鲈鱼也有狗鱼吗？
transfer: 在自然展上确认哪条鱼是长吻的淡水狗鱼。
transferEn: Identify the long-snouted freshwater predatory fish at a nature exhibit.

senseEn: to understand an idea or meaning
en: Did the diagram help you grasp the concept?
zh: 图解有没有帮你理解这个概念？
transfer: 向老师说明你还没弄懂证明的哪一步。
transferEn: Tell a teacher which part of a proof you have not yet understood.

senseEn: nearly vertical in slope
en: Can you see the sheer cliff beyond the lighthouse?
zh: 能看到灯塔那边那片陡直的悬崖吗？
transfer: 问向导哪段海岸以陡直的岩壁出名。
transferEn: Ask which coastal section is known for nearly vertical rock faces.

senseEn: a marked contrast between expectation and reality
en: Did you notice the irony of the timekeeper arriving late?
zh: 你注意到计时员迟到这件事的反讽意味了吗？
transfer: 解释故事里救生员反而需要被救的反差。
transferEn: Explain the contrast when a lifeguard ends up needing rescue in a story.

senseEn: public acknowledgment of someone's work or achievement
en: Did the volunteers receive recognition for organizing the event?
zh: 志愿者因筹办活动而得到表彰了吗？
transfer: 建议团队公开肯定幕后设计师的贡献。
transferEn: Suggest publicly acknowledging the designer's behind-the-scenes contribution.

senseEn: belonging to a grammatical gender category
en: Is this noun feminine in French?
zh: 这个名词在法语里是阴性吗？
transfer: 请老师指出几个西班牙语名词中哪一个是阴性。
transferEn: Ask which Spanish noun belongs to the grammatical category associated with feminine articles.

senseEn: a bar used for support or protection
en: Hold the hand rail as you step onto the boat.
zh: 上船时请扶住栏杆。
transfer: 问管理员楼梯旁是否有一侧连续的扶手。
transferEn: Ask whether one side of a staircase has a continuous support bar.

senseEn: related to large-scale manufacturing
en: Was this industrial building converted into studios recently?
zh: 这栋工业建筑是最近才改成工作室的吗？
transfer: 参观城市历史展时问哪里原先是工业区。
transferEn: Ask which area used to house factories at a city history exhibit.

senseEn: in or to a foreign country
en: Will my phone plan work while I'm overseas?
zh: 我出国时手机套餐还能用吗？
transfer: 给校友写信询问去海外读书的住宿体验。
transferEn: Ask an alumnus about housing while studying in a foreign country.

senseEn: to run away from danger
en: Why did the villagers flee the valley in the old account?
zh: 旧记载中村民为什么逃离山谷？
transfer: 在小说讨论中解释主人公为何不得不逃离故乡。
transferEn: Explain why a fictional character had to escape their hometown.

senseEn: an extra playing card with a special role in some games
en: Does the joker count as a wild card in this game?
zh: 这个游戏里，鬼牌可以当万能牌吗？
transfer: 洗牌前询问这次要不要把两张鬼牌拿出来。
transferEn: Ask whether to remove the two special extra cards before shuffling.

senseEn: troops stationed in a town or fortress
en: Does the museum list the names of the garrison stationed in the fort?
zh: 博物馆列出了驻守这座要塞的守军名单吗？
transfer: 读史料时询问驻军何时撤离这座港口。
transferEn: Ask when the historical force stationed in a port departed.

senseEn: immediately or without noticeable delay
en: Does the digital ticket appear instantly after payment?
zh: 付款后电子票会立刻显示吗？
transfer: 描述第一次试用新灯时它是否马上亮起。
transferEn: Describe whether a new light came on immediately during its first test.

senseEn: for a limited period
en: Is the east gate temporarily closed for repairs?
zh: 东门是因为维修暂时关闭了吗？
transfer: 告诉邻居门铃暂时不能用，请敲门。
transferEn: Tell a neighbor the bell is out of service for a short time and ask them to knock.

senseEn: a range of options available
en: Does the shop have a wider selection of frames upstairs?
zh: 楼上是不是还有更多款式的画框可选？
transfer: 问书店哪个分店的双语书品种更多。
transferEn: Ask which branch offers more options for bilingual books.

senseEn: a device that captures sound for amplification or recording
en: Can everyone hear the second microphone from the back row?
zh: 坐在后排的各位能听清第二支麦克风的声音吗？
transfer: 采访前问嘉宾愿意用领夹式还是手持麦克风。
transferEn: Ask an interview guest whether they prefer a clip-on or handheld sound pickup.

senseEn: a person gaining supervised experience at work
en: Can the new intern join our client meeting to observe?
zh: 新实习生能旁听客户会议吗？
transfer: 向人事询问谁负责指导暑期实习生。
transferEn: Ask HR who supervises the summer trainee.

senseEn: a historical pointed weapon on a long shaft
en: Is the ceremonial spear in this portrait a symbol of office?
zh: 肖像里的仪式用矛是身份的象征吗？
transfer: 参观历史展时询问玻璃柜里的矛属于哪个时期。
transferEn: Ask which period a historical long-shafted weapon in a museum case dates from.

senseEn: a stocky short-faced breed of dog
en: Is the bulldog on the poster available for adoption?
zh: 海报上的斗牛犬可以领养吗？
transfer: 在犬展上询问斗牛犬什么时候参展。
transferEn: Ask when the stocky short-muzzled breed appears at a dog show.

senseEn: large enough to be important or noticeable
en: Will hiring a van save considerable time on delivery day?
zh: 送货那天租一辆面包车会节省不少时间吗？
transfer: 说明修复旧照片将需要相当大的耐心。
transferEn: Explain that restoring old photos will take a substantial amount of patience.

senseEn: a warm and generous welcome to guests
en: Thank you for your hospitality during our week on the island.
zh: 谢谢你在我们岛上那一周热情招待。
transfer: 离开寄宿家庭后写信感谢他们的款待。
transferEn: Write to a host family expressing appreciation for their warm welcome.

senseEn: not clearly or precisely stated
en: Is “near the entrance” too vague for the delivery note?
zh: 送货备注写“入口附近”是不是太含糊了？
transfer: 请同事把会议邀请中含糊的时间写得明确一些。
transferEn: Ask a coworker to clarify an imprecise time in a meeting invitation.

senseEn: a large amount of unpleasant dirt
en: What's the safest way to remove the filth from this old tile?
zh: 怎样清除这块旧瓷砖上的厚污垢才不会损坏它？
transfer: 描述漏水后储物间地板上的污物。
transferEn: Describe the heavy grime on a storeroom floor after a leak.

senseEn: an appliance that dries laundry
en: Can this blanket go in the dryer?
zh: 这条毯子能进烘干机吗？
transfer: 在自助洗衣店问烘干机多久能用。
transferEn: Ask when a machine for drying clothes will be free at a laundromat.

senseEn: a high-end apartment at the top of a building
en: Does the penthouse share the lift with the other flats?
zh: 顶层豪华公寓和其他住户共用电梯吗？
transfer: 看楼盘图时问哪套顶层公寓带露台。
transferEn: Ask which luxury top-floor flat on a building plan has a terrace.

senseEn: a puzzling question with a cleverly hidden answer
en: Can I have a hint for the last riddle?
zh: 最后一道谜语能给点提示吗？
transfer: 让朋友给孩子讲一道答案是动物的谜语。
transferEn: Ask a friend for a word puzzle whose answer is an animal.

senseEn: a casual British way to say thanks
en: “Ta for the lift,” she said as she got out.
zh: 她下车时随口说：“谢谢你捎我。”
transfer: 英国朋友递给你笔时，用简短随和的说法道谢。
transferEn: Use a brief casual British thank-you when a friend hands you a pen.

senseEn: to increase or improve something
en: Did the posters boost attendance at the evening class?
zh: 海报有没有提高夜校课程的到课人数？
transfer: 建议一个办法提升志愿者的参与热情。
transferEn: Suggest a way to increase volunteers' enthusiasm.

senseEn: to feel strong dislike or contempt for something
en: Why does the narrator despise the custom he once defended?
zh: 叙述者为什么鄙视起自己曾经捍卫的习俗？
transfer: 讨论主人公对欺骗行为的强烈厌恶。
transferEn: Discuss a character's deep contempt for dishonest behavior.

senseEn: genuine and not an imitation
en: How can the gallery confirm an authentic signature?
zh: 画廊怎样确认签名是真迹？
transfer: 问店主这块表有没有真品证明。
transferEn: Ask a seller whether a watch comes with proof it is genuine.

senseEn: to practice a performance before presenting it
en: Can we rehearse the ending before the lights go off?
zh: 熄灯前能把结尾再排练一下吗？
transfer: 跟搭档约时间练习婚礼致辞。
transferEn: Arrange a time with a partner to practice a wedding speech beforehand.

en: Beans are our main source of protein on this camping trip.
zh: 这次露营我们主要靠豆类补充蛋白质。
transfer: 在食堂询问哪道素菜含的蛋白质比较多。
senseEn: a nutrient needed for growth and repair
transferEn: Ask which vegetarian cafeteria dish supplies more of this muscle-building nutrient.

senseEn: a person or business issuing books or other publications
en: Did the publisher approve the illustrated cover?
zh: 出版方批准了这张插画封面吗？
transfer: 问作者哪家出版社负责新译本。
transferEn: Ask the author which business is issuing a new translation.

senseEn: an informal term for a sexually explicit film
en: The guide marks the word “porno” as informal language for an adult film.
zh: 指南把这个指色情片的词标为非正式用语。
transfer: 在电影资料的用词说明里区分这个俗称与正式类别名。
transferEn: Distinguish the informal label from a formal category name in a film catalog.

senseEn: strong interest and eagerness
en: Did their enthusiasm for gardening surprise you?
zh: 他们对园艺的热情让你意外吗？
transfer: 感谢新成员在读书会表现出的热情。
transferEn: Thank new members for the eagerness they showed at a book club.

senseEn: a brain injury caused by a blow or violent movement
en: Was the player assessed for concussion after the fall?
zh: 球员摔倒后接受脑震荡评估了吗？
transfer: 复诊时询问脑震荡的评估结果是否已经记录。
transferEn: Ask at follow-up whether the evaluation of a head injury was recorded.

senseEn: a tradesperson who installs or repairs pipes
en: Can the plumber check both taps in one visit?
zh: 水管工能一次上门检查两个水龙头吗？
transfer: 问邻居能否推荐会修老式暖气管的水管工。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor for a pipe professional familiar with older heating systems.

senseEn: eager or strongly interested
en: Is your daughter keen on joining the choir?
zh: 你女儿很想参加合唱团吗？
transfer: 跟朋友表达你很想试一堂陶艺课。
transferEn: Tell a friend how interested you are in trying pottery.

senseEn: in a way that seems unexpected or odd
en: The hall was strangely quiet before the concert.
zh: 音乐会前礼堂里安静得反常。
transfer: 描述通常繁忙的市场今天出奇地空。
transferEn: Describe how unexpectedly empty a normally busy market is today.

sense: 哎呀，意识到小失误时的感叹
senseEn: an informal exclamation after a small mistake or accident
en: Whoops, I sent that photo to the wrong chat.
zh: 哎呀，我把那张照片发错群了。
transfer: 不小心洒了一点水时发出简短感叹并道歉。
transferEn: React briefly and apologize after accidentally spilling a little water.

senseEn: a whole shaped mass of baked bread
en: Could you slice the whole loaf for sandwiches?
zh: 能把整条面包切成做三明治的片吗？
transfer: 向面包师询问一条黑麦面包够几个人吃。
transferEn: Ask how many people a whole rye bread will serve.

senseEn: delicious, in casual or child-directed speech
en: These yummy peach slices are from our own tree.
zh: 这些好吃的桃片是用我们自己树上的桃子切的。
transfer: 和小朋友聊午餐时称赞蛋饼很美味。
transferEn: Casually praise a tasty omelet while talking to a child about lunch.

senseEn: the apparent line where land or sea meets the sky
en: Can you see the ship on the horizon?
zh: 你看得见地平线上的船吗？
transfer: 告诉同伴太阳刚从海平面升起。
transferEn: Tell a companion the sun has just appeared where the sea meets the sky.

senseEn: a long-distance running race of about 42 kilometers
en: Does the city marathon finish beside the river?
zh: 市马拉松的终点在河边吗？
transfer: 问跑友今年的马拉松是否开放报名。
transferEn: Ask a running friend whether registration for this year's long-distance race has opened.

senseEn: a woman holding a duchy or married to a duke
en: Was the duchess in this portrait also the garden's designer?
zh: 这幅肖像里的公爵夫人也是花园的设计者吗？
transfer: 参观城堡时问是哪位女公爵收藏了这些书。
transferEn: Ask which woman holding ducal rank collected the books in a castle.

senseEn: kindness and friendliness shown toward others
en: We remembered the warmth of our hosts long after the trip.
zh: 旅行结束很久后，我们仍记得主人的热情。
transfer: 感谢老师在新生报到时给予的温暖欢迎。
transferEn: Thank a teacher for the friendliness shown at student orientation.

senseEn: a place offering a wide view
en: Is the lookout on the ridge accessible by bus?
zh: 山脊上的观景处坐公交能到吗？
transfer: 向徒步向导打听看日出的最佳观景点。
transferEn: Ask a hiking guide about the best viewpoint for sunrise.

senseEn: a grate or device used for cooking over direct heat
en: Is the outdoor grill available to hostel guests?
zh: 旅舍客人可以使用户外烤架吗？
transfer: 野餐前问公园是否提供烧烤架。
transferEn: Ask whether a park provides cooking grates for a picnic.

senseEn: the source or beginning of something
en: Does the label explain the origin of this festival?
zh: 说明牌介绍了这个节日的起源吗？
transfer: 问老师这个词最早来自哪种语言。
transferEn: Ask a teacher about the language a word originally came from.

senseEn: a brief small cloud of smoke, steam or air
en: Did you see a puff of steam above the teapot?
zh: 你看到茶壶上方冒出的一小团蒸汽了吗？
transfer: 描述老火车启动时冒出的第一团烟。
transferEn: Describe the first small cloud of smoke from an old train starting up.

senseEn: a room where lessons take place
en: Which classroom has the working projector?
zh: 哪间教室的投影仪能用？
transfer: 向老师确认明天的课是否换了教室。
transferEn: Ask whether tomorrow's lesson has moved to another teaching room.

senseEn: to value deeply and hold dear
en: I'll cherish this photograph of our last choir rehearsal.
zh: 我会珍藏这张最后一次合唱排练的照片。
transfer: 给朋友写信，说明你珍惜两人一同旅行的回忆。
transferEn: Tell a friend how deeply you value memories of traveling together.

senseEn: in this animal name, a small domesticated South American rodent
en: Does the guinea pig need a quieter spot for its cage?
zh: 这只豚鼠的笼子需要放在更安静的地方吗？
transfer: 问收容所哪只豚鼠已经找到伴了。
transferEn: Ask a shelter which of the small guinea pigs already has a companion.

senseEn: a systematic collection of answers or observations
en: Can parents complete the travel survey online?
zh: 家长可以在网上填写出行调查吗？
transfer: 问同学班级调查一共收到了多少份答卷。
transferEn: Ask how many replies a class questionnaire received.

senseEn: a practice involving postures, breathing and concentration
en: Do I need my own mat for the yoga class?
zh: 上瑜伽课需要自带垫子吗？
transfer: 问健身中心哪天有初学瑜伽。
transferEn: Ask when a sports center offers beginner sessions in the posture-and-breathing practice.

senseEn: having a small but intensely devoted following
en: Has the old film become a cult classic at the local cinema?
zh: 这部老片在当地影院已经成了小众影迷追捧的经典吗？
transfer: 向朋友介绍一张虽然不畅销却有忠实粉丝的专辑。
transferEn: Describe an album with a devoted following despite limited sales.

senseEn: a usually black bird known for its hoarse call
en: Was that a crow carrying a twig to the chimney?
zh: 叼着小枝飞向烟囱的是乌鸦吗？
transfer: 问向导湖边那只黑鸟是乌鸦还是渡鸦。
transferEn: Ask whether a black bird beside the lake is a crow or a raven.

senseEn: a period of separation to prevent possible disease spread
en: Does the shelter have a quarantine area for newly arrived cats?
zh: 收容所有为新到的猫设置隔离区吗？
transfer: 向兽医询问新领养动物何时可以结束隔离。
transferEn: Ask a veterinarian when a newly adopted animal's separation period ends.

senseEn: a mythical human able to turn into a wolf
en: Does the village recognize the werewolf before sunrise in the film?
zh: 电影里，村民在日出前认出狼人了吗？
transfer: 让朋友推荐一个有狼人角色的民间故事。
transferEn: Ask a friend for a folktale featuring a person who turns into a wolf.

senseEn: trouble or difficulty caused by an arrangement
en: Would moving the pickup point cause much inconvenience?
zh: 改变接人地点会给你带来很多不便吗？
transfer: 向访客说明换入口可能带来的不便。
transferEn: Explain the trouble a change of entrance might cause visitors.

senseEn: covered with perspiration
en: My hands are too sweaty to hold the glass securely.
zh: 我手上汗太多，杯子都拿不稳。
transfer: 训练后问朋友要不要换下被汗湿透的衣服。
transferEn: Ask a friend whether they'd like to change perspiration-soaked clothes after practice.

senseEn: lasting resentment over a past wrong
en: Does she still hold a grudge about the canceled trip?
zh: 她还对那次旅行被取消耿耿于怀吗？
transfer: 在读书会上解释为什么老朋友之间多年的怨气终于消散。
transferEn: Explain why old friends' long-held resentment finally fades in a novel.

senseEn: a short, often secret look
en: Could we have a peep at the model before the unveiling?
zh: 揭幕前我们能先瞄一眼模型吗？
transfer: 孩子拆礼物时请另一个孩子先别偷看。
transferEn: Ask a child not to sneak a look while another opens a gift.

senseEn: extremely unpleasant or disgusting
en: What is that vile smell coming from the bin?
zh: 垃圾桶里那股恶臭是什么？
transfer: 向管理员描述走廊里令人作呕的气味。
transferEn: Describe a disgusting odor in a hallway to the caretaker.

senseEn: a meal where guests serve themselves from several dishes
en: Does the breakfast buffet include fresh fruit?
zh: 早餐自助餐含新鲜水果吗？
transfer: 问主办方自助晚餐何时停止供应。
transferEn: Ask an organizer when the self-service dinner ends.

senseEn: pigs considered collectively, especially in agricultural contexts
en: Does this swine exhibit include local breeds?
zh: 这个猪类展区包含当地品种吗？
transfer: 在农业展询问哪块面板介绍猪的饲养史。
transferEn: Ask which agricultural display covers the history of raising pigs.

senseEn: a member of a state police force in the US
en: Did the state trooper direct traffic during the flood?
zh: 洪水期间是那位州警在指挥交通吗？
transfer: 请目击者说明是哪位州警帮助了滞留的游客。
transferEn: Ask a witness which state police officer helped stranded travelers.

senseEn: easy to slip on
en: Watch your step on those slippery tiles.
zh: 小心脚下那些湿滑的地砖。
transfer: 提醒队友桥面结冰。
transferEn: Warn a teammate about an icy bridge.

senseEn: give someone a higher position
en: They want to promote Lena to shift supervisor.
zh: 他们想提拔莉娜当值班主管。
transfer: 告诉朋友你们店谁要升任经理。
transferEn: Tell a friend who is moving up to manager at your store.

senseEn: put up with something difficult
en: How did you endure the noise during construction?
zh: 施工期间你怎么受得了那些噪声？
transfer: 说说长途乘车中最难忍受的事。
transferEn: Describe the hardest part of a long bus ride to put up with.

senseEn: the raised part on a camel's back
en: That camel has one hump.
zh: 那头骆驼有一个驼峰。
transfer: 描述照片里双峰驼的特征。
transferEn: Describe the back of the two-humped camel in a photo.

senseEn: end with similar sounds
en: Do “light” and “kite” rhyme in English?
zh: light 和 kite 在英语里押韵吗？
transfer: 给孩子找两个读音押韵的动物名。
transferEn: Find two animal names with matching end sounds for a child.

senseEn: an opening that lets air through
en: Your suitcase is blocking the air vent.
zh: 你的行李箱挡住了通风口。
transfer: 告诉维修工哪个房间的通风口一直响。
transferEn: Tell a repair worker which room has a noisy air opening.

senseEn: a building where courts meet
en: The interpreter will meet us outside the courthouse.
zh: 口译员会在法院大楼外面和我们碰面。
transfer: 给要去旁听的人指出法院入口。
transferEn: Show someone attending a hearing the entrance to the court building.

senseEn: a young child's word for a dog
en: Look, that doggy has a blue coat!
zh: 看，那只狗狗穿着蓝色外套！
transfer: 用孩子能懂的话说邻居的小狗睡了。
transferEn: Tell a toddler in familiar language that the neighbor's dog is asleep.

senseEn: a formal assessment
en: My performance evaluation is on Thursday.
zh: 我的工作表现评估在星期四。
transfer: 询问培训结束后谁来评估授课质量。
transferEn: Ask who will assess the teaching after the course.

senseEn: someone who gives guidance
en: My academic advisor helped me choose a major.
zh: 我的学业顾问帮我选了专业。
transfer: 告诉室友应该找谁咨询选课。
transferEn: Tell your roommate who gives advice on course selection.

senseEn: beyond what natural forces can explain
en: The show gives the twins supernatural powers.
zh: 剧中那对双胞胎拥有超自然能力。
transfer: 介绍一部有超自然元素的小说。
transferEn: Introduce a novel that features forces beyond nature.

senseEn: a device sent to gather information
en: The space probe sent back photos of the moon.
zh: 太空探测器传回了月球的照片。
transfer: 给同学解释探测器要在火星上测什么。
transferEn: Tell a classmate what a research device will measure on Mars.

senseEn: a loss of electrical power
en: We played cards during the blackout.
zh: 停电时我们玩了纸牌。
transfer: 问邻居昨晚停电持续多久。
transferEn: Ask a neighbor how long the power was out last night.

senseEn: used in the name for a small coin bank
en: She dropped two coins into her piggy bank.
zh: 她往自己的小猪存钱罐里丢了两枚硬币。
transfer: 告诉孩子把找回的零钱存在哪儿。
transferEn: Tell a child where to save the change from the store.

senseEn: take part in an activity
en: Can renters participate in the vote?
zh: 租户能参与投票吗？
transfer: 问老师外校学生可否参加辩论。
transferEn: Ask if students from other schools may join the debate.

en: I heard that remark about my accent. What did you mean?
zh: 我听到了你对我口音的评论。你是什么意思？
transfer: 请同事解释他在会上对预算作的那句评论。
senseEn: a brief spoken comment
transferEn: Ask a colleague what they meant by their comment about the budget.

senseEn: distance from a center to its edge
en: We deliver within a five-mile radius of the bakery.
zh: 我们配送到以面包店为中心五英里半径以内的地方。
transfer: 描述你想在车站周围多大范围内找房。
transferEn: Say how far around the station you want to search for housing.

senseEn: belonging to the tradition of classical music
en: My aunt plays classical music while she cooks.
zh: 我姨妈做饭时放古典音乐。
transfer: 问音乐会售票员本周有没有古典钢琴演出。
transferEn: Ask the ticket clerk about classical piano performances this week.

senseEn: running alongside in the same direction
en: The bike path runs parallel to the canal.
zh: 自行车道沿着运河平行延伸。
transfer: 给司机指出与商业街平行的那条路。
transferEn: Point out the road that runs alongside the shopping street.

senseEn: an old-fashioned term for a man devoted to elegant dress
en: The portrait shows a dandy in a silk waistcoat.
zh: 画像中是位衣着考究的男子，穿着丝绸马甲。
transfer: 给戏服师描述剧里的那位讲究穿着的公子。
transferEn: Describe the play's fashion-conscious gentleman to the costume designer.

senseEn: crush soft food into a paste
en: Use a fork to mash the banana.
zh: 用叉子把香蕉捣成泥。
transfer: 教朋友怎样把煮软的土豆做成馅。
transferEn: Explain how to turn boiled potatoes into a soft filling.

senseEn: bringing about a major change
en: At the time, a portable camera was a revolutionary idea.
zh: 在那个年代，便携式相机是个革命性的构想。
transfer: 介绍一种彻底改变印刷业的发明。
transferEn: Describe an invention that transformed printing.

senseEn: a large house often used for vacations
en: We rented a seaside villa with room for both families.
zh: 我们租了一栋海滨别墅，住得下两家人。
transfer: 问房东那栋山间别墅是否有厨房。
transferEn: Ask whether the hillside vacation house has a kitchen.

senseEn: a military aviation unit
en: My grandfather served in a rescue squadron.
zh: 我祖父曾在一支空中救援中队服役。
transfer: 给参观者介绍合影中的飞行中队。
transferEn: Introduce the aviation unit shown in a group photograph.

senseEn: something given to help a shared effort
en: Finding that venue was your biggest contribution.
zh: 找到那个场地是你作出的最大贡献。
transfer: 感谢同事为社区菜园做的一项具体贡献。
transferEn: Thank a coworker for a specific way they helped the community garden.

senseEn: reverse an action
en: Can I undo that edit without closing the file?
zh: 我能在不关闭文件的情况下撤销那次编辑吗？
transfer: 问同伴怎样撤销刚刚的裁剪。
transferEn: Ask how to reverse the crop you just applied to a photo.

senseEn: choke by squeezing tightly
en: Loose netting can strangle a bird if it gets tangled.
zh: 鸟被松散的网缠住可能会被勒得窒息。
transfer: 向园丁说明为何要收起松脱的网绳。
transferEn: Explain to a gardener how loose net cords can choke wildlife.

senseEn: happening very quickly
en: The chart shows a rapid increase in battery temperature.
zh: 图表显示电池温度迅速上升。
transfer: 描述订票网站访问量的快速增长。
transferEn: Describe how quickly visits to the ticket site increased.

senseEn: a small leftover piece of material
en: I wrote the number on a scrap of paper.
zh: 我把号码写在一小片纸上。
transfer: 问裁缝有没有一小块布可以试针。
transferEn: Ask a tailor for a leftover bit of fabric to test a stitch.

senseEn: well-organized and calm
en: The ushers helped everyone make an orderly exit.
zh: 引导员帮助大家有序退场。
transfer: 描述雨天校门口学生有序排队的情景。
transferEn: Describe how students lined up calmly at the school gate in the rain.

senseEn: a vegetable in the pumpkin family
en: I'm roasting butternut squash for the soup.
zh: 我在烤奶油南瓜，准备做汤。
transfer: 问摊主哪种南瓜适合烤着吃。
transferEn: Ask the seller which kind of squash roasts well.

senseEn: a curved nail on an animal's foot
en: The cat caught a claw in my sweater.
zh: 猫的一只爪子勾住了我的毛衣。
transfer: 告诉兽医小狗哪只爪子裂了。
transferEn: Tell the vet which of the puppy's nails has split.

senseEn: existing only in the imagination
en: Our daughter sets a place for her imaginary friend.
zh: 女儿给她想象中的朋友摆了一套餐具。
transfer: 向同学介绍你为故事虚构的小岛。
transferEn: Introduce the island you invented for a story.

senseEn: someone making a phone call
en: The first caller asked about the missing cat.
zh: 第一位来电者问起了那只走失的猫。
transfer: 告诉接线员上一位来电者留了什么口信。
transferEn: Tell the operator what message the previous person on the phone left.

senseEn: a British term of abuse that can offend
en: The editor flagged the word “bugger” as too rude for the letter.
zh: 编辑指出 bugger 一词太粗鲁，不宜写进信里。
transfer: 解释为什么要删掉投诉信中这个骂人的词。
transferEn: Explain why you removed this insult from a complaint letter.

senseEn: a temporary stop
en: Fog forced the suspension of ferry service.
zh: 大雾迫使渡轮暂停运营。
transfer: 通知会员泳池课程暂时停课。
transferEn: Inform members of a temporary halt to swimming lessons.

senseEn: a Japanese dish made with seasoned rice
en: Does the sushi platter include any cooked fish?
zh: 这份寿司拼盘里有熟鱼吗？
transfer: 向厨房确认素寿司里有哪些蔬菜。
transferEn: Ask the kitchen which vegetables are in the vegetarian sushi.

senseEn: wonderful, in British spelling
en: What a marvellous view from your balcony!
zh: 你家阳台上的景色真棒！
transfer: 向朋友称赞昨晚的钢琴独奏。
transferEn: Tell a friend how wonderful last night's piano solo was.

senseEn: a marksman who shoots from concealment
en: The actor plays a retired sniper in the new drama.
zh: 这位演员在新剧中饰演一名退役狙击手。
transfer: 向朋友介绍小说主角以前在部队的身份。
transferEn: Tell a friend about the novel protagonist's former role as a military marksman.

senseEn: a website giving access to services
en: Upload the form through the student portal.
zh: 请通过学生门户网站上传表格。
transfer: 告诉同事从哪个门户网站查工资单。
transferEn: Tell a colleague which online portal holds their pay slips.

senseEn: an amount of food served to one person
en: Could we share a portion of fries?
zh: 我们能合吃一份薯条吗？
transfer: 在食堂问能否要半份米饭。
transferEn: Ask the cafeteria server for half a serving of rice.

senseEn: protected against a particular disease
en: The nurse asked whether I was immune to measles.
zh: 护士问我是否对麻疹有免疫力。
transfer: 向医生询问怎么查自己是否对风疹有免疫力。
transferEn: Ask how to check whether you have protection against rubella.

senseEn: the condition of having too little money for basic needs
en: The report tracks child poverty in our city.
zh: 这份报告追踪本市儿童贫困状况。
transfer: 问研究员农村贫困数据来自哪里。
transferEn: Ask where researchers got their figures on rural poverty.

senseEn: a tool with a heavy blade for chopping wood
en: We keep the ax with the other firewood tools.
zh: 我们把斧头和其他处理木柴的工具放在一起。
transfer: 询问营地管理员劈柴用的斧头存放在哪儿。
transferEn: Ask the campsite manager where the woodcutting tool is stored.

senseEn: someone who lived through a dangerous event
en: A flood survivor from our town spoke at the memorial.
zh: 镇上一位洪灾幸存者在纪念仪式上发了言。
transfer: 介绍采访中那位海难幸存者。
transferEn: Introduce the person in an interview who survived a shipwreck.

senseEn: a person who catches fish
en: A local fisherman showed us where the boats dock.
zh: 一位当地渔民带我们看了渔船停靠的地方。
transfer: 问船主他当渔民多少年了。
transferEn: Ask a boat owner how long he has fished for a living.

senseEn: a pawn in chess
en: You're missing one white pawn from this set.
zh: 这副国际象棋少了一枚白兵。
transfer: 向教练询问这个棋局里的兵能否前进一步。
transferEn: Ask a coach if the pawn in this position can move forward one square.

senseEn: an informal word for a group of friends
en: Nina arrived with her usual posse from the skate park.
zh: 妮娜和滑板场那帮老朋友一起来了。
transfer: 跟朋友提起常和你去看球的那帮人。
transferEn: Tell a friend about the group you usually go to games with.

senseEn: a substance that counteracts a poison
en: The hospital stocked an antidote for that particular venom.
zh: 医院备有针对那种毒液的解毒剂。
transfer: 向讲解员询问展览中的解毒剂针对哪种毒素。
transferEn: Ask a museum guide which toxin the displayed antidote counteracts.

senseEn: plan and arrange an activity
en: Could you organize the book swap this spring?
zh: 今年春天的换书活动能由你筹办吗？
transfer: 邀请同事帮忙筹办欢送午餐。
transferEn: Invite a coworker to help arrange a farewell lunch.

senseEn: uncomfortably cool
en: It gets chilly by the lake after sunset.
zh: 日落后湖边凉飕飕的。
transfer: 提醒要在清早等车的客人带件外套。
transferEn: Warn an early-morning bus passenger about the cool air.

senseEn: spoken rather than written
en: The final includes an oral exam in Spanish.
zh: 期末考包括一场西班牙语口试。
transfer: 问老师展示是否要用口头报告形式。
transferEn: Ask if the presentation should take the form of a spoken report.

senseEn: someone who gathers particular items as a hobby
en: A stamp collector bought the whole album.
zh: 一位集邮者买下了整本邮册。
transfer: 向来宾介绍借出老唱片的收藏者。
transferEn: Introduce the person who lent old records from their collection.

senseEn: the act of going missing
en: Police are investigating the disappearance of a hiker.
zh: 警方正在调查一名徒步者失踪的案件。
transfer: 告诉邻居走失猫咪失踪前在哪里出现过。
transferEn: Say where a missing cat was seen before its disappearance.

senseEn: produced according to organic farming standards
en: Do you sell organic eggs by the dozen?
zh: 你们的有机鸡蛋可以按打买吗？
transfer: 问菜农哪些菠菜是按有机标准种植的。
transferEn: Ask a grower which spinach was grown to organic standards.

senseEn: an agreement to stop fighting
en: Both sides agreed to a temporary truce.
zh: 双方同意暂时休战。
transfer: 向同学解释故事里的两大家族为何决定休战。
transferEn: Explain why two rival families in a story agreed to stop fighting.

senseEn: a collection of pages under one web address
en: Our opening hours are on the museum website.
zh: 博物馆的网站上有开放时间。
transfer: 询问报名表在哪个网站。
transferEn: Ask which site hosts the registration form.

senseEn: a large room for dancing
en: The wedding band is setting up in the ballroom.
zh: 婚礼乐队正在舞厅里布置。
transfer: 问酒店工作人员从大堂怎么去舞厅。
transferEn: Ask a hotel employee how to reach the dance hall from the lobby.

senseEn: a place where animals are protected
en: The injured owl now lives in a wildlife sanctuary.
zh: 那只受伤的猫头鹰现在生活在野生动物保护区。
transfer: 问鸟类保护区周末是否向访客开放。
transferEn: Ask whether the bird refuge welcomes weekend visitors.

senseEn: full of juice
en: Save those juicy peaches for dessert.
zh: 把那些多汁的桃子留着当甜点。
transfer: 告诉卖水果的人你想买汁水多的橙子。
transferEn: Tell a fruit seller you want oranges with plenty of juice.

senseEn: make something smaller in amount
en: Closing the curtains can reduce the glare on your screen.
zh: 拉上窗帘可以减少屏幕上的眩光。
transfer: 提议怎样减少午餐时丢掉的食物。
transferEn: Suggest a way to cut down on food waste at lunch.

senseEn: take on and work on a problem
en: Let's tackle the billing errors before we send the invoices.
zh: 我们先处理账单上的错误，再发票据吧。
transfer: 告诉团队你打算先处理哪个排班问题。
transferEn: Tell the team which scheduling problem you will take on first.

senseEn: eat a meal, in fairly formal language
en: Guests may dine on the terrace after six.
zh: 六点以后客人可以在露台用餐。
transfer: 用酒店告示的语气说明客人可以在哪里用晚餐。
transferEn: Write a hotel notice telling guests where they may eat dinner.

senseEn: a strap used to control a dog
en: Please keep your dog on a leash near the ducks.
zh: 在鸭子附近请用牵引绳牵好狗。
transfer: 问遛狗的人有没有看到你掉的红色牵引绳。
transferEn: Ask a dog walker about a red lead you dropped.

senseEn: the identification of a medical condition
en: I'm still waiting for a diagnosis from the specialist.
zh: 我还在等专科医生的诊断结果。
transfer: 问医生何时能和家人讨论诊断结果。
transferEn: Ask when you can discuss the diagnosis with your family.

senseEn: a US store selling medicines and other everyday items
en: I bought bandages at the corner drugstore.
zh: 我在街角的药妆店买了绷带。
transfer: 问酒店前台附近哪家药妆店卖隐形眼镜护理液。
transferEn: Ask reception for a nearby pharmacy that sells contact lens solution.

senseEn: a fungus that grows on damp surfaces
en: We found black mold behind the bathroom cabinet.
zh: 我们在浴室柜子后面发现了黑霉。
transfer: 向房东描述窗框上长出的霉菌。
transferEn: Describe mold growing on a window frame to the landlord.

senseEn: an object used to hold something
en: Put the leftover rice in a clean container.
zh: 把剩饭装进干净的容器里。
transfer: 问同事装沙拉的容器能不能盖严。
transferEn: Ask if the box for the salad has a tight lid.

senseEn: a period of one thousand years
en: People have lived in this valley for over a millennium.
zh: 人们在这个山谷定居已经超过一千年。
transfer: 向观众解释展品跨越了整整一千年。
transferEn: Tell visitors that the exhibits span a whole thousand years.

senseEn: the person who oversees maintenance in an apartment building
en: Call the building superintendent about the broken lobby light.
zh: 大堂灯坏了，给楼管打个电话吧。
transfer: 问新邻居怎样联系负责维修的楼管。
transferEn: Ask a new neighbor how to reach the person who maintains the building.

senseEn: a minister who leads a Christian congregation
en: Our pastor welcomed the new families after the service.
zh: 礼拜结束后，牧师向新来的几家人表示欢迎。
transfer: 问教堂秘书牧师什么时候有空见你。
transferEn: Ask the church secretary when the minister can meet with you.

senseEn: speak directly to someone about a difficult issue
en: Will you confront the manager about the missing tips?
zh: 你会就小费不翼而飞的事当面质问经理吗？
transfer: 向朋友解释你为何决定当面找散布谣言的人谈谈。
transferEn: Explain why you decided to face the person spreading a rumor.

senseEn: an act of presenting a person to others
en: Thanks for the introduction to your editor.
zh: 谢谢你把我介绍给你的编辑。
transfer: 请主持人给新来的演讲者作个简短介绍。
transferEn: Ask the host to briefly introduce the new speaker.

senseEn: mix ingredients until smooth
en: Could you blend the soup before we serve it?
zh: 上桌前能把汤搅打细滑吗？
transfer: 告诉朋友做奶昔时应该把哪些原料一起打匀。
transferEn: Tell a friend which ingredients to mix together for a milkshake.

senseEn: cut a small amount off
en: Can you trim the hedge by the gate?
zh: 能修一下大门旁的树篱吗？
transfer: 请理发师只修一下发梢。
transferEn: Ask a hairdresser to cut just the ends.

senseEn: involving deep or fundamental change
en: Moving the whole school online was a radical change.
zh: 整所学校转为线上教学是一次根本性的改变。
transfer: 向同事说明新方案为何彻底改变了排班方式。
transferEn: Explain how a new proposal fundamentally changes shift scheduling.

senseEn: a space between two things
en: Cold air comes through the gap under the door.
zh: 冷风从门底下的缝隙钻进来。
transfer: 请木工量一下书柜和墙之间的空隙。
transferEn: Ask a carpenter to measure the space between a shelf and the wall.

senseEn: grass forming the surface of a playing field
en: The grounds crew replaced the damaged turf near the goal.
zh: 场地维护人员换掉了球门附近受损的草皮。
transfer: 问教练训练场铺的是哪种草皮。
transferEn: Ask the coach what type of grass surface the practice field has.

senseEn: the pay received for a period of work
en: My first paycheck covered the deposit on my room.
zh: 我用第一笔工资付了房间押金。
transfer: 问人事本周加班费会在哪次工资里发。
transferEn: Ask payroll which payment will include this week's overtime.

senseEn: a person's relatives
en: Who should we list as your next of kin?
zh: 我们应该登记谁为你的最近亲属？
transfer: 询问养老院如何联系住户的近亲。
transferEn: Ask how the care home contacts a resident's closest relative.

senseEn: an absorbent garment worn by a baby
en: There's a clean diaper in the side pocket.
zh: 侧袋里有一片干净的尿布。
transfer: 请伴侣在出门前给宝宝换尿布。
transferEn: Ask your partner to change the baby before leaving.

senseEn: dishonest use of power for private gain
en: The audit uncovered corruption in the housing office.
zh: 审计发现住房管理部门存在腐败问题。
transfer: 问记者是谁最早揭露了采购中的腐败问题。
transferEn: Ask a reporter who first exposed corruption in purchasing.

senseEn: relating to the spine or spinal cord
en: The scan showed a spinal injury.
zh: 扫描显示脊柱受了伤。
transfer: 向护士确认明天预约的是脊柱专科门诊。
transferEn: Confirm with a nurse that tomorrow's appointment is with a spine specialist.

senseEn: a shape with three straight sides
en: Fold the napkin into a triangle.
zh: 把餐巾折成三角形。
transfer: 教小朋友用三根冰棍棒拼一个三角形。
transferEn: Help a child make a three-sided shape with three craft sticks.

senseEn: a large fruit with a thick rind and juicy flesh
en: Could you cut the melon into wedges?
zh: 你能把甜瓜切成瓣吗？
transfer: 在水果摊问哪个甜瓜熟了可以今天吃。
transferEn: Ask which melon at a fruit stall is ripe enough to eat today.

senseEn: causing intense fear
en: Being stuck in that elevator was a terrifying experience.
zh: 被困在那部电梯里实在太吓人了。
transfer: 向朋友描述夜里突然听见巨响有多吓人。
transferEn: Describe how frightening a sudden crash sounded at night.

en: The extra checkout lane greatly reduced the wait.
zh: 增开一条收银通道大大缩短了等候时间。
transfer: 反馈新地图如何大大改善了找路体验。
senseEn: to a large extent
transferEn: Tell the designers how much easier the new map made finding your way.

senseEn: attract someone with something appealing
en: The shop hopes to lure customers with free samples.
zh: 这家店希望用免费试吃吸引顾客。
transfer: 解释民宿怎样用淡季折扣吸引游客。
transferEn: Explain how an inn attracts travelers with off-season discounts.

senseEn: a small meeting for study and discussion
en: I'm attending a seminar on translation this Friday.
zh: 我这周五要去参加翻译研讨会。
transfer: 问讲师周末的写作研讨会还有没有名额。
transferEn: Ask the instructor if there is room in the weekend writing seminar.

senseEn: an act that breaks someone's trust
en: Sharing my diary felt like a betrayal of trust.
zh: 把我的日记给别人看，让我觉得自己的信任遭到了背叛。
transfer: 解释故事里那封秘密来信为什么让主人公觉得被背叛。
transferEn: Explain why a secret letter in a story makes the main character feel betrayed.

senseEn: acting secretly to avoid being noticed
en: That was a sneaky way to read my notes.
zh: 你竟然这样偷偷摸摸地看我的笔记。
transfer: 在讨论小说时描述一个角色偷听时的举动。
transferEn: Describe a character's secretive behavior while eavesdropping in a novel.

senseEn: refuse to accept something
en: We had to reject the offer because the hours conflicted.
zh: 因为时间冲突，我们只好拒绝了那个提议。
transfer: 向承包商说明为什么得拒绝这份报价。
transferEn: Explain to a contractor why you must turn down a quote.

senseEn: a strong desire to do something tempting
en: I resisted the temptation to peek at my birthday gift.
zh: 我忍住了偷看生日礼物的冲动。
transfer: 描述攒钱时你最难抵挡的购物诱惑。
transferEn: Describe the hardest purchase to resist while saving money.

senseEn: cloth stretched for painting
en: The artist left a blank canvas beside the easel.
zh: 画家在画架旁放了一块空白画布。
transfer: 问美术店有没有适合画肖像的小画布。
transferEn: Ask an art shop for a small painting surface for a portrait.

senseEn: a layered bulb used as a vegetable
en: Slice one red onion for the salad.
zh: 把一个红洋葱切片做沙拉。
transfer: 点汉堡时请店员去掉生洋葱。
transferEn: Order a burger without raw onion.

senseEn: someone who helps another commit a crime
en: The detective suspects the thief had an accomplice.
zh: 侦探怀疑小偷有共犯。
transfer: 讨论推理小说里是谁帮窃贼掩盖行踪。
transferEn: Discuss who helped the thief cover their tracks in a mystery novel.

senseEn: a man known for pleasure-seeking and casual romances
en: The film casts him as a wealthy playboy.
zh: 他在片中饰演一位富有的花花公子。
transfer: 描述小说里那位以风流出名的继承人。
transferEn: Describe the pleasure-seeking heir in a novel.

senseEn: Italian-style noodles of various shapes
en: Is the pasta served with tomato sauce?
zh: 这道意大利面配番茄酱吗？
transfer: 问朋友想在意大利面里加什么蔬菜。
transferEn: Ask which vegetables your friend wants with the pasta.

senseEn: official permission to enter or stay in a country
en: My student visa expires in June.
zh: 我的学生签证六月到期。
transfer: 问旅行社办理旅游签证需要交什么照片。
transferEn: Ask the travel agency about photos for a visitor visa.

senseEn: the body's protection against a disease
en: The study measured immunity to flu in older adults.
zh: 这项研究测量了老年人对流感的免疫力。
transfer: 问研究人员如何检测参与者对某种病毒的免疫力。
transferEn: Ask how researchers check participants' protection against a virus.

senseEn: a woman married to someone's parent who is not their mother
en: My stepmother taught me how to ride a bike.
zh: 是继母教会了我骑自行车。
transfer: 在毕业典礼上把继母介绍给老师。
transferEn: Introduce your stepmother to a teacher at graduation.

senseEn: clear or easy to notice
en: The leak became apparent after the rain.
zh: 下雨后，漏水的问题就明显了。
transfer: 说明新招牌在天黑后显现出什么问题。
transferEn: Say what problem with a new sign becomes obvious after dark.

senseEn: openly and without restriction
en: Can we speak freely in this room?
zh: 我们在这个房间能畅所欲言吗？
transfer: 告诉新成员在小组讨论中可以自在地提问。
transferEn: Tell new members they can ask questions without holding back.

senseEn: not taking either side
en: Our moderator promised to remain neutral.
zh: 主持人承诺会保持中立。
transfer: 请共同的朋友在争执中保持中立。
transferEn: Ask a mutual friend to avoid taking sides in a disagreement.

senseEn: a small amount of liquid added quickly
en: Add a splash of milk to the eggs.
zh: 往蛋液里加一点牛奶。
transfer: 跟服务员说苏打水里只需加一点果汁。
transferEn: Tell a server you want just a little juice in your soda water.

senseEn: a sweet fried cake, often ring-shaped
en: I saved a glazed doughnut for you.
zh: 我给你留了一个糖霜甜甜圈。
transfer: 问面包师哪个甜甜圈里面有果酱。
transferEn: Ask a baker which doughnut has jam inside.

senseEn: stop something before it reaches its intended receiver
en: Maya managed to intercept the pass near midfield.
zh: 玛雅在中场附近成功截下了那记传球。
transfer: 描述后卫如何抢在前锋之前截住传中球。
transferEn: Describe how a defender cut off a cross before it reached the striker.

senseEn: able to attract or attach by magnetism
en: My shopping list is on a magnetic pad on the fridge.
zh: 我的购物清单写在冰箱上的磁吸便签本上。
transfer: 问售货员这个手机支架是不是磁吸的。
transferEn: Ask if a phone mount attaches using a magnet.

senseEn: a product for washing hair
en: Is there any unscented shampoo in the shower?
zh: 淋浴间里有无香洗发水吗？
transfer: 问酒店前台能否再送一小瓶洗发水。
transferEn: Ask hotel reception to send another small bottle for washing your hair.

senseEn: off the ground and in the air
en: We were finally airborne an hour after boarding.
zh: 登机一小时后，我们终于升空了。
transfer: 描述风筝何时终于飞离地面。
transferEn: Describe when a kite finally left the ground.

senseEn: a very young baby
en: Does an infant need a separate ticket?
zh: 婴儿需要单独买票吗？
transfer: 告诉接待员同行的乘客里有一名婴儿。
transferEn: Tell reception that your party includes a very young baby.

senseEn: a privately owned apartment in a shared building
en: My sister bought a small condo above the bakery.
zh: 我姐姐买了面包店楼上的一套小公寓。
transfer: 问房产经纪那套产权公寓每月管理费多少。
transferEn: Ask the agent about the monthly fees for a condominium.

senseEn: suddenly become more intense
en: Dry winds caused the fire to flare up again.
zh: 干风使火势再次突然加剧。
transfer: 告诉维修工炉火什么时候会突然蹿高。
transferEn: Tell a technician when the stove flame suddenly grows stronger.

senseEn: a written request signed by a group
en: Will you sign the petition to keep the library open?
zh: 你愿意签名请愿，让图书馆继续开放吗？
transfer: 告诉邻居支持保留老树的请愿书在哪儿。
transferEn: Tell a neighbor where to find the written petition to save an old tree.

senseEn: from or relating to Cuba
en: That café serves Cuban coffee in tiny cups.
zh: 那家咖啡馆用很小的杯子供应古巴咖啡。
transfer: 问音乐节工作人员古巴乐队何时上台。
transferEn: Ask when the band from Cuba will take the festival stage.

senseEn: the main body of a boat
en: The mechanic spotted a crack in the hull.
zh: 机械师发现船体上有一道裂缝。
transfer: 问船主上次给船体上漆是什么时候。
transferEn: Ask a boat owner when the body of the boat was last painted.

senseEn: an informal way to address a priest or chaplain
en: Thank you, Padre, for visiting my father.
zh: 神父，谢谢您来看望我父亲。
transfer: 在电影对白里以这个称呼向随军牧师问好。
transferEn: Write a film greeting that addresses a military chaplain by this title.

senseEn: strongly motivated to win
en: My sister gets very competitive over board games.
zh: 我姐姐玩桌游时特别好胜。
transfer: 向队友形容自己参加接力赛时的好胜心。
transferEn: Tell a teammate how eager you are to win a relay race.

senseEn: preserved and sold in sealed metal cans
en: I use canned tomatoes when fresh ones cost too much.
zh: 鲜番茄太贵时我就用罐装番茄。
transfer: 问店员罐装豆子在哪排货架。
transferEn: Ask a clerk which aisle has beans in tins.

senseEn: a small cloth carried for wiping one's face or nose
en: Grandpa folded his handkerchief into his coat pocket.
zh: 爷爷把手帕折好放进大衣口袋。
transfer: 问洗衣店有没有在衣袋里找到一块绣花手帕。
transferEn: Ask the cleaner about an embroidered cloth left in a pocket.

senseEn: someone who looks after a garden
en: Our gardener pruned the roses this morning.
zh: 园丁今天早上修剪了我们的玫瑰。
transfer: 向园丁请教花坛应种什么耐阴植物。
transferEn: Ask the person tending the garden about shade-loving plants.

senseEn: a military aircraft designed to drop bombs
en: The museum restored a wartime bomber for its aviation exhibit.
zh: 博物馆为航空展修复了一架战时轰炸机。
transfer: 向讲解员询问展厅里轰炸机的服役年代。
transferEn: Ask the guide when the bomber on display was in service.

senseEn: without anyone taking action
en: The app automatically saves a copy when you close the file.
zh: 关闭文件时，应用会自动保存一个副本。
transfer: 告诉住客走廊灯在有人经过时会自动亮。
transferEn: Explain to a guest what the hallway light does when someone walks past.

senseEn: make someone feel deeply embarrassed
en: Please correct the mistake privately so you don't humiliate him.
zh: 请私下指出错误，免得他当众难堪。
transfer: 劝队长别在全队面前嘲笑新队员。
transferEn: Ask the captain to spare a new player the embarrassment of being mocked in front of the team.

senseEn: having a deep or lasting effect
en: That first teacher had a profound influence on my choice of career.
zh: 第一位老师对我的职业选择影响深远。
transfer: 在采访中讲搬家如何深刻改变了你的生活。
transferEn: Tell an interviewer how moving house changed your life in a lasting way.

senseEn: exceptionally beautiful and finely made
en: Look at the exquisite embroidery along the collar.
zh: 看看领口那圈精美的刺绣。
transfer: 参观陶器展时请朋友留意茶杯精美的花纹。
transferEn: At a pottery exhibition, draw a friend's attention to the fine pattern on a teacup.

senseEn: fully grown and ready to eat
en: These peaches aren't ripe enough to serve tonight.
zh: 这些桃子还没熟到今晚能端上桌。
transfer: 向摊主说明你需要今天能吃的牛油果。
transferEn: Ask the stallholder for an avocado that's ready to eat today.

senseEn: send light back from a surface
en: Angle the mirror to reflect the light onto the desk.
zh: 调一下镜子的角度，让光反射到桌面上。
transfer: 摄影时解释为什么用白板把光反射到模特脸上。
transferEn: Explain how a white board redirects light onto a model's face during a photo shoot.

senseEn: done without prior planning
en: Pack light; this is a spontaneous trip and we haven't booked a room.
zh: 少带点东西吧，这次旅行是临时起意的，我们还没订房。
transfer: 向朋友讲起一次临时决定办的晚餐聚会。
transferEn: Tell a friend about a dinner party you decided to throw on the spur of the moment.

senseEn: have a sensation that makes you want to scratch
en: Those wool gloves make my hands itch.
zh: 那副羊毛手套戴得我手痒。
transfer: 试戴耳环后告诉店员你的耳朵开始发痒。
transferEn: After trying on earrings, tell the assistant about the scratchy sensation in your ears.

senseEn: exceptional achievement or quality
en: For this coach, bringing out the best in others is a sign of greatness.
zh: 在这位教练看来，能激发别人的潜力才显得卓越。
transfer: 颁奖时解释为什么这名选手的卓越不只体现在速度上。
transferEn: At an award ceremony, explain why the athlete's exceptional qualities go beyond speed.

senseEn: someone who makes or alters clothes
en: Can the tailor shorten these trousers before Friday?
zh: 裁缝能在周五前把这条裤子改短吗？
transfer: 婚礼前询问旅馆附近有没有人能修改西装。
transferEn: Before a wedding, ask where near the hotel you can find someone to alter a suit.

senseEn: an awkward or uncool person, informally
en: I felt like such a dork waving back at someone who wasn't waving at me.
zh: 人家根本没跟我打招呼，我还挥手回应，感觉自己真呆。
transfer: 自嘲第一次跳舞时同手同脚的样子。
transferEn: Poke fun at how awkward you looked moving the wrong arm during your first dance.

senseEn: a structure that carries smoke out of a building
en: Call the sweep before we use the chimney this winter.
zh: 今年冬天用烟囱之前，先请人来清扫。
transfer: 指路时让快递员找带砖烟囱的房子。
transferEn: Direct a courier to the house with the brick structure that carries smoke above the roof.

senseEn: the peak of sexual pleasure
en: Since starting this medication, I've found it harder to reach orgasm.
zh: 开始服这种药以后，我发现自己更难达到性高潮。
transfer: 就诊时询问手术后达到性高潮的能力是否可能变化。
transferEn: At a consultation, ask whether surgery could affect your ability to reach sexual climax.

senseEn: pleasantly plump
en: In my baby photos I have chubby cheeks just like my son's.
zh: 我婴儿时期的照片里脸蛋胖乎乎的，跟我儿子一样。
transfer: 描述画里一只圆滚滚的小仓鼠。
transferEn: Describe the plump little hamster in a drawing.

senseEn: someone who privately provides information
en: The editor removed the address to protect the informant.
zh: 编辑删去了地址，以保护提供消息的线人。
transfer: 向办案人员解释为什么线人的身份需要保密。
transferEn: Explain to an investigator why a source's identity must remain secret.

senseEn: a group produced or handled together
en: The first batch of rolls is cooling by the window.
zh: 第一批小面包正在窗边晾凉。
transfer: 告诉同事第二批邀请邮件要到明早才发。
transferEn: Tell a colleague that the next group of invitation emails won't go out until tomorrow morning.

senseEn: a disappointing experience, informally
en: The trail's closed? Oh, what a bummer!
zh: 步道关了？哎，真扫兴！
transfer: 听说朋友一直期待的演出取消了，用口语回应。
transferEn: React informally when a friend says the show they were looking forward to has been cancelled.

senseEn: coming immediately after the ninth
en: Meet me by the lift on the tenth floor.
zh: 在十楼电梯旁等我。
transfer: 告诉伙伴接力比赛中你排第十个出发。
transferEn: Tell your teammate where you start in the relay if nine runners go before you.

senseEn: too valuable to put a price on
en: That recording of Grandma singing is priceless to me.
zh: 那段奶奶唱歌的录音对我来说无比珍贵。
transfer: 搬家时解释为什么孩子的第一幅画一定要带走。
transferEn: Explain why your child's first painting is too precious to leave behind when moving.

senseEn: very tired after effort or strain
en: After the overnight coach ride, I was too weary to explore the city.
zh: 坐了一夜长途车，我太累了，没力气去城里逛。
transfer: 马拉松结束后告诉朋友你累得走不回家。
transferEn: After a marathon, tell a friend you're too exhausted to walk home.

senseEn: a box where letters are delivered
en: Could you check the mailbox for my new bank card?
zh: 你能看看我的新银行卡寄到信箱里了吗？
transfer: 请邻居在你度假时收取信件。
transferEn: Ask a neighbour to collect your letters while you're on holiday.

senseEn: a cereal grain used in bread
en: Can I have rye bread instead of white toast?
zh: 我能把白吐司换成黑麦面包吗？
transfer: 向面包师询问深色面包里是否加了黑麦。
transferEn: Ask the baker whether the dark loaf contains the grain traditionally used in pumpernickel.

senseEn: a narrow channel in a surface
en: Slide the glass panel into the groove before tightening the frame.
zh: 先把玻璃板滑进凹槽，再拧紧边框。
transfer: 安装抽屉时提醒伙伴让轮子对准槽。
transferEn: While installing a drawer, remind your partner to align the wheel with its channel.

senseEn: a character who deliberately causes harm
en: I'd rather play the villain in the school play.
zh: 学校演出我更想演反派。
transfer: 讨论电影时解释为什么反派比主角更让你难忘。
transferEn: In a film discussion, explain why the antagonist was more memorable than the lead.

senseEn: the control that starts a vehicle's engine
en: You've left the key in the ignition.
zh: 你把钥匙忘在点火开关上了。
transfer: 向修车师傅说明钥匙插入启动开关后拧不动。
transferEn: Tell a mechanic that the key won't turn in the engine's starting switch.

senseEn: a close bond of loyalty among people
en: Living together on the boat gave the crew a sense of brotherhood.
zh: 同住在船上的日子让船员之间有了兄弟般的情谊。
transfer: 在老队员聚会上说起共同训练培养出的情谊。
transferEn: At a reunion, describe the bond formed through training together.

senseEn: a short leisurely walk
en: We've got time for a stroll before dinner.
zh: 晚饭前我们有时间去散散步。
transfer: 邀请朋友看完展后沿运河随意走走。
transferEn: Invite a friend for a leisurely walk along the canal after an exhibition.

senseEn: deep commitment to someone or something
en: Her devotion to the choir kept rehearsals going all winter.
zh: 她对合唱团的投入让排练整个冬天都得以持续。
transfer: 颁奖时感谢志愿者多年对动物收容所的付出。
transferEn: At an awards ceremony, recognise a volunteer's years of commitment to an animal shelter.

senseEn: a card sent by mail without an envelope
en: Let's send a postcard to Mum from the island.
zh: 我们从岛上给妈妈寄张明信片吧。
transfer: 向邮局询问寄一张风景卡到海外的邮资。
transferEn: At the post office, ask the cost of mailing a picture card overseas.

senseEn: showing no mercy in pursuing a goal
en: A ruthless manager fired everyone who questioned the cuts.
zh: 一名冷酷的经理解雇了所有质疑裁员的人。
transfer: 讨论小说时描述一个为争权完全不顾他人的角色。
transferEn: In a book discussion, describe a character who ignores other people's suffering in pursuit of power.

senseEn: having an unpleasant odour
en: Please don't leave your smelly socks on the radiator.
zh: 别把臭袜子放在暖气片上。
transfer: 向管理员反映垃圾桶气味难闻，需要清理。
transferEn: Tell the caretaker that the rubbish bins smell bad and need cleaning.

senseEn: clean a floor with a long-handled wet cleaning tool
en: I'll mop the floor once the chairs are out of the way.
zh: 等椅子挪开我就拖地。
transfer: 果汁洒在厨房，请朋友把那块地面拖一下。
transferEn: After juice spills in the kitchen, ask a friend to wet-clean that patch of floor.

senseEn: professional support for emotional difficulties
en: Does the college offer counseling during exam season?
zh: 学校考试季提供心理咨询吗？
transfer: 问公司员工能否预约保密的心理支持服务。
transferEn: Ask whether employees can book confidential support for emotional concerns.

senseEn: delivery of medicine through a needle
en: Which arm would you prefer for the injection?
zh: 你希望打在哪一侧手臂？
transfer: 预约前向诊所确认疫苗是否通过注射给药。
transferEn: Before booking, ask whether the vaccine is given through a needle.

senseEn: a thick solid piece
en: There's a chunk of ginger in the soup; take it out before serving.
zh: 汤里有一大块姜，上桌前把它捞出来。
transfer: 野餐时请同伴切一大块奶酪来分着吃。
transferEn: At a picnic, ask a friend to cut a substantial piece of cheese to share.

senseEn: equipment that uses sound to locate objects underwater
en: We use sonar to map the lake bed before laying the cable.
zh: 铺电缆前我们用声呐测绘湖底。
transfer: 参观研究船时问科学家用什么声学设备测水深。
transferEn: On a research vessel, ask about the acoustic equipment used to measure depth.

senseEn: remove material by rubbing with a hard edge
en: Let me scrape the paint off the hinge so the door can close.
zh: 我把铰链上的油漆刮掉，这样门就能关了。
transfer: 请室友用刮板清除烤盘上烧焦的食物。
transferEn: Ask your flatmate to remove burnt food from a baking tray with a scraper.

senseEn: force something open using leverage
en: Can you pry the lid off this paint tin?
zh: 你能撬开这罐油漆的盖子吗？
transfer: 组装家具时请搭档帮忙撬开钉住的包装板。
transferEn: Ask your assembly partner to lever open a nailed packing board.

en: The grant paid for the establishment of a village library.
zh: 这笔拨款资助村里建起了一座图书馆。
transfer: 为校刊写稿，描述一笔捐款如何促成奖学金的设立。
senseEn: the act of formally setting something up
transferEn: Write for the school magazine about how a donation made a new scholarship possible.

senseEn: get back something previously left or stored
en: I can retrieve the file from yesterday's backup.
zh: 我可以从昨天的备份中找回这个文件。
transfer: 向失物处说明你来取回落在列车上的背包。
transferEn: Explain to lost property that you've come to get back the backpack you left on the train.

senseEn: the work someone does for a living
en: Please write your occupation in the box below your name.
zh: 请在姓名下方的方框里填写职业。
transfer: 填写调查问卷时问学生该在职业栏填什么。
transferEn: Ask what a student should enter in the field asking how they earn their living.

senseEn: excessive pride in one's looks or achievements
en: I kept the award on my desk out of vanity, I'll admit.
zh: 我承认把奖杯放在桌上是出于虚荣心。
transfer: 解释小说中人物为何只因虚荣而买下名表。
transferEn: Explain why a character bought an expensive watch merely to impress others.

senseEn: too sure of one's own abilities
en: I want to describe the win without making our team sound cocky.
zh: 我想讲讲这场胜利，又不想显得我们队太自负。
transfer: 提醒朋友面试时别因为熟悉题目而显得过于自信。
transferEn: Warn a friend against appearing overconfident in an interview just because the questions seem familiar.

senseEn: having bad luck
en: We were unlucky with the weather on both camping trips.
zh: 两次露营我们运气都不好，都碰上了坏天气。
transfer: 安慰抽签两次都排在最后的同学。
transferEn: Console a classmate who drew the last place twice.

senseEn: a member of someone's extended family
en: Is the bride a relation of yours?
zh: 新娘是你的亲戚吗？
transfer: 填写紧急联系人时说明那位女士与你有亲属关系。
transferEn: When naming an emergency contact, explain that the woman belongs to your extended family.

senseEn: a group's confidence and enthusiasm
en: That thank-you note from the client really helped lift morale.
zh: 客户的感谢信确实提振了大家的士气。
transfer: 向教练建议在球队连败后如何重振士气。
transferEn: Suggest to a coach how to restore the team's spirits after several losses.

senseEn: save something useful from damage or loss
en: We managed to salvage the photos before the floodwater reached the shelf.
zh: 洪水淹到架子前，我们设法抢救出了照片。
transfer: 活动场地取消后，向搭档建议怎样保住原计划的一部分。
transferEn: After losing the venue, suggest how to preserve a useful part of the original plan.

senseEn: a brass instrument played through a small mouthpiece
en: Could you play the trumpet a little more softly in this room?
zh: 在这间屋里你能把小号吹得轻一点吗？
transfer: 乐队排练前问谁带了小号备用吹嘴。
transferEn: Before band practice, ask who has a spare mouthpiece for the high brass instrument.

senseEn: an old-fashioned British informal term for tea
en: Fancy a cup of cha before we head out?
zh: 出门前想喝杯茶吗？
transfer: 给历史短剧写一句英国工人休息时向工友要茶的台词。
transferEn: Write a period-drama line in which a British worker asks a mate for tea during a break.

senseEn: the ceremonial head of a university in some countries
en: The chancellor will present the honorary degrees after lunch.
zh: 校监将在午餐后颁授荣誉学位。
transfer: 毕业典礼彩排时确认校监从哪一侧上台。
transferEn: At a graduation rehearsal, check which side the university's ceremonial head enters from.

senseEn: almost or nearly
en: Let's catch the early train; it's virtually empty on Sundays.
zh: 我们坐早班火车吧，周日车上几乎没人。
transfer: 向同事说明活动门票几乎卖光了。
transferEn: Tell a colleague that almost all the event tickets have been sold.

senseEn: strikingly beautiful or impressive
en: Take the upstairs room for a stunning view of the falls.
zh: 选楼上的房间吧，从那里看瀑布特别壮观。
transfer: 向摄影师称赞她拍的夜空照片令人惊艳。
transferEn: Tell a photographer how strikingly beautiful you find her night-sky picture.

en: Do part-time staff qualify for paid leave?
zh: 兼职员工有资格享受带薪假吗？
transfer: 向学校询问转学生是否符合奖学金申请条件。
senseEn: meet the requirements for something
transferEn: Ask the school whether transfer students meet the scholarship requirements.

senseEn: the raised edge between a road and pavement
en: I'll wait by the curb with the suitcases.
zh: 我会带着行李箱在路缘等。
transfer: 帮推婴儿车的朋友指出路缘较低的位置。
transferEn: Show a friend pushing a stroller where the raised edge of the pavement dips.

senseEn: less important than the main concern
en: For the shelter, appearance is a secondary concern; warmth comes first.
zh: 对避难所来说外观是次要的，保暖才最重要。
transfer: 选合租房时说明距离是首要条件，装修靠后。
transferEn: When choosing a shared flat, explain that location comes first and decoration matters less.

senseEn: having no force or validity
en: This ticket is void if the date has been altered.
zh: 日期一经涂改，这张票就无效了。
transfer: 向客服问保修卡没盖章是否无效。
transferEn: Ask customer service whether a warranty card is invalid without a stamp.

senseEn: advanced in age
en: I'm picking up groceries for an elderly neighbour who can't get out today.
zh: 我在帮一位今天出不了门的年长邻居买菜。
transfer: 安排聚会时询问是否有年长客人需要带靠背的椅子。
transferEn: When setting up a gathering, ask whether any older guests need chairs with backs.

senseEn: a person easily fooled or taken advantage of
en: I felt like a chump after paying twice for the same ticket.
zh: 同一张票付了两次钱，我觉得自己像个冤大头。
transfer: 向朋友自嘲没比价就买下高价纪念品。
transferEn: Poke fun at how gullible you felt buying an overpriced souvenir without checking prices.

senseEn: a performer whose job is to make people laugh
en: The comedian added a second show after Friday sold out.
zh: 周五的票售罄后，那位喜剧演员加演了一场。
transfer: 帮社团晚会询问能否请一位喜剧演员开场。
transferEn: Ask about booking a performer to open the club evening with stand-up.

senseEn: someone aged thirteen through nineteen
en: As a teen, I worked at that cinema every summer.
zh: 我十几岁时，每年夏天都在那家电影院打工。
transfer: 聊起童年住所时，说你十几岁才搬进市区。
transferEn: While discussing childhood homes, say you didn't move into the city until your teenage years.

senseEn: a sturdy box for storage or transport
en: Pack the pottery in a wooden crate for the ferry trip.
zh: 坐渡轮运送时，把陶器装进木箱里。
transfer: 搬运水果时请人检查箱底有没有松动。
transferEn: When moving fruit, ask someone to check the bottom of the shipping box for loose boards.

senseEn: a large family group with shared ancestry
en: Every branch of our clan sent someone to the reunion.
zh: 我们宗族各支都派了人来聚会。
transfer: 在家族档案里说明一枚旧徽章属于哪个宗族。
transferEn: In a family archive, identify the extended family group to which an old crest belonged.

senseEn: a proposed or adopted change to a formal text
en: I propose an amendment allowing students to vote remotely.
zh: 我提议增加一项修正案，允许学生远程投票。
transfer: 理事会开会时问修改会费规则的提案何时表决。
transferEn: At a board meeting, ask when the proposed change to the dues rule will be voted on.

senseEn: the use of violence or threats to intimidate for political aims
en: The memorial lists the names of local victims of terrorism.
zh: 纪念碑上列着当地恐怖主义受害者的姓名。
transfer: 为历史展览拟一句介绍受恐怖主义影响的社区的文字。
transferEn: Write an exhibition caption introducing communities affected by politically motivated violence against civilians.

senseEn: a minor unexpected difficulty
en: There's one hitch: the venue doesn't open until noon.
zh: 有个小问题，场地中午才开门。
transfer: 摄影棚已订好，但灯要晚到，向搭档说明这个小麻烦。
transferEn: Explain the snag in a photo shoot: the studio is booked but the lights will arrive late.

senseEn: something good enough to hold on to
en: That folding chair is a keeper; it fits behind the door.
zh: 那把折叠椅值得留下，它正好能放在门后。
transfer: 试过新菜谱后对家人说这个方子值得留着。
transferEn: After trying a new recipe, tell your family it's good enough to keep using.

senseEn: another name used by the same person
en: The poet published her first book under an alias.
zh: 那位诗人用别名出版了她的第一本书。
transfer: 核对演出名单时问乐手是否用了艺名。
transferEn: When checking a programme, ask whether the musician appears under another name.

senseEn: spoken lines exchanged by characters
en: Turn on subtitles; the music is drowning out the dialogue.
zh: 打开字幕吧，音乐把对白都盖住了。
transfer: 排练时请两位演员把结尾的对白再念一遍。
transferEn: At rehearsal, ask two performers to repeat their final exchange.

senseEn: someone who gives money or resources
en: An anonymous donor paid for the library's new ramp.
zh: 一位匿名捐赠者出资修建了图书馆的新坡道。
transfer: 向捐助校服的人写一句感谢的话。
transferEn: Write a note thanking the person who contributed money for school uniforms.

senseEn: a card game in which players aim for a total near twenty-one
en: Shall we play blackjack with buttons instead of money?
zh: 我们用纽扣当筹码玩二十一点怎么样？
transfer: 在桌游会上问哪张桌子正在玩目标点数为二十一的游戏。
transferEn: At a games evening, ask which table is playing the card game with a target of twenty-one.

senseEn: appearing real despite having no actual source
en: Restarting the sensor stopped the phantom alerts.
zh: 重启传感器后，那些虚假警报就消失了。
transfer: 向客服描述手机在没有新消息时发出的假通知。
transferEn: Describe notifications appearing on your phone despite there being no new messages.

senseEn: of fundamental importance
en: Our cardinal rule in the archive is to keep every original label.
zh: 我们档案室的首要规则是保留所有原始标签。
transfer: 向新演员介绍排练时最重要的一条原则。
transferEn: Explain the single most important rehearsal rule to a new actor.

senseEn: a large bulky object, often an abandoned one
en: You can still see the rusting hulk of the ferry from the pier.
zh: 从码头仍能看到那艘锈迹斑斑的渡轮残骸。
transfer: 描述废弃矿区里一台锈蚀的巨大机器。
transferEn: Describe the bulky remains of a rusted machine at an abandoned mine.

senseEn: how great or widespread something is
en: We won't know the extent of the damage until the water recedes.
zh: 要等水退了才知道受损程度。
transfer: 维修前请师傅解释生锈已经影响到什么程度。
transferEn: Before repairs, ask how far the corrosion has spread.

senseEn: careful to avoid drawing attention
en: Give me a discreet signal when our guest arrives.
zh: 客人到的时候悄悄给我个信号。
transfer: 演出中请工作人员低调地带迟到者入座。
transferEn: At a performance, ask an usher to seat latecomers without attracting attention.

senseEn: a group of things sharing a characteristic
en: Which category should I enter my animation in?
zh: 我的动画应该报哪个类别？
transfer: 整理支出时询问快递费应归入哪一类。
transferEn: When sorting expenses, ask where delivery charges belong.

senseEn: unsure of one's abilities or worth
en: I feel insecure singing alone, so could we start with a duet?
zh: 我单独唱没信心，我们能先合唱一首吗？
transfer: 告诉导师你在陌生人面前发言时不太自信。
transferEn: Tell your mentor how uncertain you feel when speaking in front of strangers.

senseEn: full of energy and activity
en: The outdoor tables have a lively atmosphere on market days.
zh: 赶集日，露天桌位那一带气氛很热闹。
transfer: 给朋友描述昨晚演出后街区的热闹气氛。
transferEn: Describe how energetic the neighbourhood felt after last night's show.

senseEn: clever at getting one's way through trickery
en: Watch the final scene: the detective finally meets a cunning opponent.
zh: 看看最后一幕，侦探终于遇到了狡猾的对手。
transfer: 讨论寓言时解释狐狸如何靠狡猾的办法拿走食物。
transferEn: In a fable discussion, explain how the fox tricked someone into giving up their food.

senseEn: a room prepared for a baby
en: Please put the clean blankets in the nursery.
zh: 请把干净的毯子放到婴儿房。
transfer: 看房时问哪一间最适合留给新生儿。
transferEn: At a viewing, ask which room would work best for the new baby.

senseEn: a public display of works or objects
en: The exhibition closes on Sunday, so let's go tomorrow.
zh: 展览周日结束，我们明天去吧。
transfer: 向美术馆询问摄影展是否允许带学生参观。
transferEn: Ask the gallery whether you can bring a student group to its photography show.

senseEn: moving without anyone in control
en: A runaway trolley rolled across the empty car park.
zh: 一辆失控的手推车滑过空荡荡的停车场。
transfer: 让行人留意斜坡上无人控制的购物车。
transferEn: Alert a pedestrian to an unattended shopping cart rolling down a slope.

senseEn: an instrument that indicates direction using magnetic north
en: Pack a compass in case the trail signs are missing.
zh: 带上指南针，以防路标不见了。
transfer: 向户外老师借能辨别南北的工具。
transferEn: Ask an outdoor instructor to lend you a tool for telling north from south.

senseEn: a system that treats people as property and denies their freedom
en: Our class is researching the abolition of slavery in the Caribbean.
zh: 我们班正在研究加勒比地区废除奴隶制的历史。
transfer: 向博物馆讲解员询问奴隶制怎样影响当地港口的发展。
transferEn: Ask a museum guide how the system of forced ownership of people shaped the local port.

senseEn: an exclamation of pleasure at food
en: Yum, is that fresh basil in the sauce?
zh: 真好吃，酱汁里放的是新鲜罗勒吗？
transfer: 刚尝到朋友烤的苹果派，用简短感叹回应。
transferEn: Respond with a short appreciative exclamation after tasting a friend's apple pie.

senseEn: increase an engine's speed
en: Please don't rev the engine outside the baby's window.
zh: 请别在婴儿房窗下轰油门。
transfer: 录音前请司机稍微提高发动机转速。
transferEn: Before a recording, ask the driver to briefly raise the engine speed.

senseEn: annoyed by having to wait
en: People are getting impatient; can we tell them how long the delay is?
zh: 大家等得不耐烦了，能告诉他们还要延误多久吗？
transfer: 向朋友解释自己排队时为什么开始着急。
transferEn: Explain to a friend why you began losing patience in the queue.

senseEn: work done in advance to get ready
en: Thanks to careful preparation, we finished the move before noon.
zh: 多亏事前准备充分，我们中午前就搬完了。
transfer: 问老师野外写生前需要做哪些准备。
transferEn: Ask your teacher what advance work is needed for an outdoor sketching trip.

en: Meeting the growers made it a worthwhile trip.
zh: 能见到种植户，让这趟行程很值得。
transfer: 解释你为何觉得周末去社区厨房帮忙很值得。
senseEn: worth the time or effort involved
transferEn: Explain why volunteering at the community kitchen on weekends feels worth your time.

senseEn: tense and unable to relax
en: I've been so uptight about the audition that I can barely sleep.
zh: 为了试镜我一直很紧张，几乎睡不着。
transfer: 告诉朋友正式晚宴让你很拘谨。
transferEn: Tell a friend how tense formal dinners make you feel.

senseEn: having qualities traditionally associated with men
en: Dad says he grew that moustache to look manly at eighteen.
zh: 爸爸说他十八岁时留那撮胡子，是想显得有男子气概。
transfer: 采访演员时问某套戏服是否让角色显得更有男子气概。
transferEn: Ask an actor whether a particular costume made the character appear more masculine.

senseEn: a unit of weight equal to one sixteenth of a pound
en: Add an ounce of butter while the potatoes are hot.
zh: 趁土豆还热，加一盎司黄油。
transfer: 邮寄样品前确认重量是否多出一盎司。
transferEn: Before mailing a sample, check whether it exceeds the limit by one sixteenth of a pound.

en: The Republican candidate will speak at the library tonight.
zh: 那位共和党候选人今晚将在图书馆发言。
transfer: 阅读选票说明时，向朋友指出哪一栏列着共和党候选人。
senseEn: belonging to the US political party traditionally associated with the elephant
transferEn: Show a friend which column on the ballot lists candidates from the party represented by the elephant.

senseEn: money paid for teaching or enrolment in a course
en: Does the scholarship cover tuition for both semesters?
zh: 奖学金能覆盖两个学期的学费吗？
transfer: 报名夏校时确认住宿费是否包含在学费中。
transferEn: When registering for summer school, ask whether accommodation is included in the teaching fee.

senseEn: produce a quantity of something
en: Will these trees yield enough apples for the school fair?
zh: 这些树结的苹果够学校集市用吗？
transfer: 帮邻居估算一排番茄能产多少果实。
transferEn: Help a neighbour estimate the harvest from one row of tomato plants.

senseEn: a person who takes and holds someone against their will
en: The court heard testimony from a witness who identified the kidnapper.
zh: 法庭听取了一名认出绑架者的证人的证词。
transfer: 在小说读书会上说明哪段证词揭示了绑架者的身份。
transferEn: At a book club, identify the testimony that revealed who abducted the missing person.

senseEn: a slang insult for an informer
en: In that old film, the gang calls anyone who talks to the police a fink.
zh: 那部老电影里，那伙人把跟警察说话的人都骂作告密者。
transfer: 给电影字幕选词时指出角色用了俚语辱骂告密者。
transferEn: When discussing subtitles, point out the slang insult a character uses for an informer.

senseEn: British informal language for useful inside information
en: Has anyone got the gen on the new rehearsal space?
zh: 有人知道新排练场地的具体情况吗？
transfer: 问熟悉场地的英国朋友能不能透露周末市集的实用消息。
transferEn: Ask a British friend who knows the venue for the inside information on the weekend market.

senseEn: so impressive that it excites strong interest
en: Stay for the relay; last year it had a sensational finish.
zh: 留下来看接力赛吧，去年最后一段精彩极了。
transfer: 给错过音乐会的朋友形容压轴独奏有多精彩。
transferEn: Tell a friend who missed the concert how extraordinary the closing solo was.

senseEn: a small object used in place of money for a particular service
en: Where can I get a token for the lockers?
zh: 哪里可以拿到储物柜用的代币？
transfer: 向游乐场工作人员询问每次坐旋转木马要用几枚代币。
transferEn: Ask a fairground attendant how many special coins you need for the carousel.

senseEn: widely celebrated for exceptional achievements
en: Tonight a legendary pianist returns to the hall where she made her debut.
zh: 今晚，一位传奇钢琴家将重返她首演的音乐厅。
transfer: 向年轻球迷介绍一位声名远扬的老门将。
transferEn: Introduce a celebrated former goalkeeper to a young fan.

senseEn: a loud deep continuous noise
en: We couldn't hear the announcement over the roar of the engines.
zh: 发动机轰鸣声太大，我们听不清广播。
transfer: 描述瀑布水声大到同伴要提高嗓门。
transferEn: Describe the deep noise of a waterfall that forced everyone to raise their voices.

senseEn: a device that sends signals
en: Check the battery in the wireless transmitter before the show.
zh: 演出前检查一下无线发射器的电池。
transfer: 问老师哪一件设备负责把声音信号发给扬声器。
transferEn: Ask which device sends the audio signal to the speaker.

senseEn: a rural agricultural worker of low social status in historical societies
en: This ledger shows what a peasant family paid in rent in 1750.
zh: 这本账簿记载了一个农民家庭在1750年交的地租。
transfer: 介绍历史画作里农民在秋收时做的工作。
transferEn: Describe the agricultural labourers at harvest in a historical painting.

senseEn: a distilled alcoholic drink made from grain
en: We brought a bottle of whisky for the host.
zh: 我们带了一瓶威士忌送给主人。
transfer: 在纪念品店询问这款威士忌是否在当地蒸馏。
transferEn: Ask whether the grain spirit sold in the gift shop was distilled locally.

senseEn: a freshwater fish related to salmon
en: Is the grilled trout served with potatoes or rice?
zh: 烤鳟鱼是配土豆还是米饭？
transfer: 在河边问导游春天能不能看到鳟鱼。
transferEn: Ask a river guide whether the salmon relatives with spotted bodies can be seen in spring.

senseEn: spoil the appearance or quality of something
en: Use a soft cloth so you don't mar the finish.
zh: 用块软布，免得损伤表面涂层。
transfer: 提醒搬家人员金属扣可能会刮坏木地板外观。
transferEn: Warn the movers that a metal buckle could spoil the appearance of the wooden floor.

senseEn: a small tile marked with dots for a matching game
en: We're missing one domino from the double-six set.
zh: 我们那套双六骨牌少了一块。
transfer: 收拾桌游时请孩子检查沙发下有没有掉落的骨牌。
transferEn: When packing away a tile game, ask the child to check under the sofa for a missing dotted tile.

senseEn: easy to carry and use in different places
en: Bring a portable charger; the coach has no sockets.
zh: 带个便携充电器吧，长途车上没有插座。
transfer: 在租设备时说明要能搬到室外的投影仪。
transferEn: When renting equipment, specify a projector you can easily carry outdoors.

senseEn: a short trip to do a practical task
en: I've got one more errand before lunch: picking up the dry cleaning.
zh: 午饭前我还得跑一趟，去取干洗的衣服。
transfer: 告诉同事下班路上你还要顺便去邮局办件事。
transferEn: Tell a colleague you have one small task at the post office on your way home.

senseEn: the direction between north and west
en: Head northwest after you cross the bridge.
zh: 过桥后向西北走。
transfer: 用方位说明营地在湖的哪一侧。
transferEn: Place the campsite on the side of the lake between north and west.

senseEn: freedom to manage one's own affairs
en: The bus pass helped Mum regain her independence.
zh: 有了公交卡，妈妈又能独立出行了。
transfer: 解释第一次独居怎样培养了你的自主能力。
transferEn: Explain how living alone helped you manage life for yourself.

senseEn: a trick played for amusement
en: Relax, the plastic spider was a prank.
zh: 放心，那只塑料蜘蛛只是个恶作剧。
transfer: 朋友以为桌上的假蛋糕是真的，解释这是玩笑。
transferEn: Explain the trick when a friend mistakes a fake cake for a real one.

senseEn: a small juicy fruit that grows in clusters
en: I'll have grape juice instead of wine.
zh: 我不喝酒，给我葡萄汁吧。
transfer: 点果冻时问有没有葡萄味。
transferEn: Ask whether the jelly comes in the flavour of the fruit used to make wine.

senseEn: relating to the major international summer or winter games
en: We booked tickets for the Olympic final.
zh: 我们订了奥运会决赛的门票。
transfer: 向教练询问奥运会游泳池有多长。
transferEn: Ask your coach about the pool length used at the Games.

senseEn: bring bad luck to something
en: Don't announce the win yet; you might jinx it.
zh: 先别宣布赢了，小心招来霉运。
transfer: 朋友提前庆祝，半开玩笑说怕这样会坏了好运。
transferEn: Joke that celebrating early could spoil your good luck.

senseEn: a shape with triangular sides meeting at a point
en: Stack the oranges in a pyramid of four layers.
zh: 把橙子堆成四层金字塔形。
transfer: 告诉孩子如何用积木搭一个上尖下宽的造型。
transferEn: Tell a child how to arrange blocks in a pointed shape with a broad base.

senseEn: a ridge of rock or coral in the water
en: Our guide asked us to swim above the reef without touching it.
zh: 导游请我们从礁上方游过，不要碰它。
transfer: 问船长这条航线会经过哪片珊瑚礁。
transferEn: Ask the captain which coral ridge the route passes.

en: Engineers shut down the reactor for inspection.
zh: 工程师关闭反应堆进行检查。
transfer: 在科学馆询问模型中哪一部分代表反应堆。
senseEn: equipment in which a controlled nuclear reaction takes place
transferEn: At a science museum, ask which part of the model represents the unit where the nuclear reaction takes place.

senseEn: a swear word expressing strong frustration
en: I've been fighting with this goddam zipper all morning.
zh: 我一上午都在跟这该死的拉链较劲。
transfer: 给小说人物写一句私下抱怨坏闹钟的粗话。
transferEn: Write a character's private expletive about a broken alarm clock.

senseEn: an Italian title used before a man's name
en: Is Signor Rossi expecting us at the gallery?
zh: 罗西先生在画廊等我们吗？
transfer: 为一位意大利男宾读出带称谓的姓名。
transferEn: Introduce an Italian male guest by surname with the customary Italian title.

senseEn: say what is likely to happen
en: Advance bookings help us predict the turnout.
zh: 预订量能帮助我们预测到场人数。
transfer: 问园丁能否估计今年果实何时成熟。
transferEn: Ask the gardener to forecast when this year's fruit will ripen.

senseEn: specialist knowledge or skill
en: Could we borrow your expertise in restoring old photographs?
zh: 能借助你修复老照片的专业知识吗？
transfer: 请熟悉音响的同事为场地布置提供专业意见。
transferEn: Ask a colleague with specialist audio skills for help setting up a venue.

senseEn: move one's head to signal agreement or understanding
en: If you can hear the interpreter, just nod.
zh: 如果你能听见口译员，请点点头。
transfer: 演出前约定用点头示意开始。
transferEn: Agree on a silent head movement to signal the start of a performance.

senseEn: allowing considerable freedom or flexibility
en: We chose this supplier because it has a liberal return policy.
zh: 我们选择这家供应商，是因为它的退货政策宽松。
transfer: 比较两家图书馆哪家的续借规定更宽松。
transferEn: Compare the flexibility of two libraries' renewal rules.

senseEn: flavoured with the aromatic pod used in desserts
en: Could I swap the vanilla ice cream for mango?
zh: 我能把香草冰淇淋换成芒果味吗？
transfer: 问咖啡师是否在拿铁里加了香草糖浆。
transferEn: Ask the barista whether the latte contains syrup flavoured with the fragrant baking pod.

senseEn: give something to help a cause
en: Can we donate books after the library closes?
zh: 图书馆关门后我们还能捐书吗？
transfer: 向收容所询问能否捐干净的毯子。
transferEn: Ask a shelter whether it accepts gifts of clean blankets.

senseEn: an organised arrangement of people or objects
en: The dancers enter in formation from the left.
zh: 舞者从左侧按队形入场。
transfer: 拍合照前告诉队员们排成什么队形。
transferEn: Describe how the team should arrange themselves for a group photograph.

senseEn: a large outdoor container for waste
en: Put the broken shelf in the dumpster behind the building.
zh: 把坏架子扔进楼后的大垃圾箱。
transfer: 向管理员询问装修垃圾应该投进哪个大箱。
transferEn: Ask the caretaker which large waste container to use for renovation debris.

senseEn: an ancient reptile such as a stegosaurus
en: Are those dinosaur tracks real or casts?
zh: 那些恐龙足迹是真的还是翻模的？
transfer: 在博物馆问哪具古生物骨架属于三角龙。
transferEn: At a museum, ask which prehistoric reptile skeleton belongs to a triceratops.

senseEn: from or associated with Egypt
en: The Egyptian pottery is in the room beside the courtyard.
zh: 埃及陶器在庭院旁边的展室。
transfer: 向图书管理员询问埃及现代文学的书架位置。
transferEn: Ask a librarian where to find modern literature from Egypt.

senseEn: a sound used in an excited cheer
en: Woo hoo, our relay team made the final!
zh: 太棒了，我们的接力队进决赛了！
transfer: 朋友抢到最后两张演出票，用欢呼声回应。
transferEn: Cheer when your friend gets the last two tickets.

senseEn: a liquid mixture used in cooking
en: Let the batter rest while I heat the pan.
zh: 我热锅时，让面糊静置一会儿。
transfer: 做松饼时问是否应该往面糊里加牛奶。
transferEn: When making pancakes, ask whether to add milk to the uncooked mixture.

senseEn: for each person or item
en: These notebooks are three dollars apiece if you buy five.
zh: 买五本的话，这些笔记本每本三美元。
transfer: 分蛋糕时说明每人可以拿两块。
transferEn: Tell the guests how many slices each person may take.

senseEn: the organ that holds urine
en: Do I need a full bladder for this scan?
zh: 做这项扫描需要憋尿吗？
transfer: 看人体图时问哪一处是储存尿液的器官。
transferEn: Ask someone to identify the organ that stores urine on an anatomy chart.

senseEn: connected with a community's arts or customs
en: Which cultural events are free during the festival?
zh: 节日期间哪些文化活动免费？
transfer: 向交换生介绍本地的文化传统。
transferEn: Introduce an exchange student to customs that are part of your community's heritage.

senseEn: made without meat or fish
en: Is there a vegetarian option besides salad?
zh: 除了沙拉还有别的素食选择吗？
transfer: 为不吃肉的同事询问活动餐是否提供素食。
transferEn: Check whether catering offers a meat-free meal for a colleague.

senseEn: relating to the heart
en: Which lift goes to the cardiac unit?
zh: 哪部电梯通往心脏科病区？
transfer: 为探病者询问心脏康复诊室在哪层。
transferEn: Ask which floor houses rehabilitation for heart patients.

senseEn: the deliberate killing of many people
en: The plaque names the villagers lost in the massacre.
zh: 牌匾上刻着屠杀中遇难村民的姓名。
transfer: 向纪念馆询问哪场仪式悼念这次集体杀戮的遇难者。
transferEn: Ask which ceremony commemorates the victims of the mass killing.

senseEn: risk a stake on a predicted result
en: I'll wager a coffee that Nina finishes the puzzle first.
zh: 我赌一杯咖啡，妮娜会第一个拼完。
transfer: 朋友预测比赛比分，你提议以洗碗为赌注。
transferEn: Propose staking the washing-up on your friend's match prediction.

senseEn: overused or embarrassingly sentimental
en: Dad opened his speech with a corny joke about weddings.
zh: 爸爸用一个老套的婚礼笑话开场。
transfer: 审阅广告时指出一句标语显得俗套。
transferEn: Review an advert and explain that one slogan sounds embarrassingly clichéd.

senseEn: someone who personally saw an event
en: The reporter spoke to an eyewitness who saw the tree fall.
zh: 记者采访了一名亲眼看到树倒下的目击者。
transfer: 问车站工作人员有没有人亲眼看见行李掉落。
transferEn: Ask station staff whether anyone personally saw the suitcase fall.

senseEn: a tool used to turn nuts or bolts
en: Do you have a wrench that fits this nut?
zh: 你有能拧这个螺母的扳手吗？
transfer: 请搭档从工具箱里拿出修自行车轮需要的扳手。
transferEn: Ask a partner for the tool that turns the bicycle wheel's axle nut.

senseEn: a dog of mixed ancestry
en: We adopted a friendly mutt from the shelter.
zh: 我们从收容所领养了一只友善的混种狗。
transfer: 随意向邻居介绍你的混种小狗。
transferEn: Casually introduce your mixed-breed puppy to a neighbour.

senseEn: a type of beer fermented with top-fermenting yeast
en: Which local ale goes best with the pie?
zh: 哪种本地艾尔啤酒最配这款派？
transfer: 参观酒厂时问这款艾尔啤酒是否全年酿造。
transferEn: On a brewery tour, ask if their top-fermented beer is brewed year-round.

senseEn: a flat cake cooked in a frying pan
en: Keep the first pancake warm while I cook the rest.
zh: 我煎剩下的饼时，先把第一张薄煎饼保温。
transfer: 在早餐店问能否只点一张煎饼。
transferEn: Ask the breakfast server for a single flat griddle cake.

senseEn: a person trained for space travel
en: Our guest is an astronaut who spent six months in orbit.
zh: 我们的嘉宾是一位曾在轨道上停留六个月的宇航员。
transfer: 科学节上问宇航员失重时是怎么睡觉的。
transferEn: At a science festival, ask a space traveller how they slept in zero gravity.

senseEn: an affectionate name for a grandmother
en: My nana taught me to mend a torn sleeve.
zh: 我奶奶教我补破了的衣袖。
transfer: 用亲切称呼向朋友介绍给你烤蛋糕的祖母。
transferEn: Introduce the grandmother who baked your cake using an affectionate family name.

senseEn: the joining of separate organisations
en: Will our library cards still work after the merger?
zh: 两家图书馆合并后，我们的借书证还能用吗？
transfer: 向人事询问两家公司合并后谁负责培训。
transferEn: Ask HR who will oversee training once the two companies join.

senseEn: reasonable in the circumstances
en: After two cancellations, your hesitation is perfectly understandable.
zh: 取消了两次之后，你有所犹豫完全可以理解。
transfer: 回应初次登台的孩子，说紧张情有可原。
transferEn: Reassure a first-time performer that feeling nervous makes sense.

senseEn: the result of an event or process
en: We'll email you the outcome of the interview on Friday.
zh: 我们周五会用邮件通知你面试结果。
transfer: 请委员会公布投票结果。
transferEn: Ask the committee to publish the result of its vote.

senseEn: noise or activity that interrupts the peace
en: Sorry about the disturbance; the repair crew is leaving now.
zh: 抱歉打扰了，维修人员这就走。
transfer: 向酒店前台说明走廊里的喧闹让你无法入睡。
transferEn: Tell reception that a commotion in the corridor kept you awake.

senseEn: a quicker route to a destination
en: Is there a shortcut through the station to the museum?
zh: 穿过车站去博物馆有近路吗？
transfer: 告诉骑车的朋友哪条小巷能缩短回家路程。
transferEn: Tell a cyclist which alley shortens the trip home.
