transferEn: Express moral disapproval of deliberately humiliating an opponent in a match.

sense: 揭露；发现原本隐藏的事
senseEn: discover or reveal something previously hidden
en: The inspection helped uncover the cause of the leak.
zh: 检查帮助查明了漏水的原因。
transfer: 说明审计找出了此前被隐藏的错误。
transferEn: Explain that an audit revealed mistakes that had previously been hidden.

senseEn: a tense face-to-face disagreement or conflict
en: I asked to speak privately to avoid a confrontation in the lobby.
zh: 我要求私下交谈，以免在大堂发生正面冲突。
transfer: 向朋友解释为什么你想先冷静，再讨论争执。
transferEn: Explain to a friend why you want to calm down before a tense face-to-face argument.

senseEn: continuing without interruption
en: The machine makes a continuous beep when the door is open.
zh: 门打开时，机器会持续鸣响。
transfer: 向维修人员说明噪声一直不停，没有间歇。
transferEn: Tell a technician that a noise goes on without any breaks.

senseEn: sincerely or in a real and honest way
en: I was genuinely pleased to see my old teammate again.
zh: 再次见到老队友，我由衷地高兴。
transfer: 向朋友说明你确实感谢他的帮助，并非客套。
transferEn: Tell a friend that your gratitude for their help is sincere.

senseEn: the destructive force available from weapons
en: The history exhibit explains why one army had greater firepower.
zh: 历史展览解释了为什么一支军队拥有更强的火力。
transfer: 概述历史讲座对双方武器火力的比较。
transferEn: Summarize a history lecture comparing the destructive capacity of two armies' weapons.

senseEn: find and follow a route
en: We used a paper map to navigate the old town.
zh: 我们用纸质地图在老城区辨路。
transfer: 说明你在陌生机场如何找到登机口。
transferEn: Explain how you found your way through an unfamiliar airport.

senseEn: the natural color and appearance of the skin on the face
en: The portrait shows a woman with a pale complexion and dark hair.
zh: 肖像画中是一位肤色白皙、头发乌黑的女性。
transfer: 向画家描述模特脸部的自然肤色。
transferEn: Describe a model's natural facial skin tone to an artist.

senseEn: driven by an urge that is difficult to control
en: She described her compulsive checking of the door lock to the counselor.
zh: 她向咨询师描述了自己难以控制地反复检查门锁的行为。
transfer: 描述一个人明知没必要却难以停止的反复行为，不作诊断。
transferEn: Describe repeated behavior that someone finds hard to stop without making a diagnosis.

senseEn: to a very great degree or in an uncontrolled way
en: The two websites gave wildly different prices for the same room.
zh: 两家网站给同一个房间报出的价格相差极大。
transfer: 说明几位朋友对电影的评价差距非常大。
transferEn: Say that your friends' opinions of a film differ to an extreme degree.

senseEn: popular or considered stylish at a particular time
en: Wide trousers are fashionable this year, but I prefer a straight cut.
zh: 阔腿裤今年很流行，但我更喜欢直筒的。
transfer: 询问店员哪种颜色这季比较流行。
transferEn: Ask a shop assistant which colors are currently considered stylish.

senseEn: in a polite way that shows regard for someone
en: I respectfully disagree with the proposal to close the library.
zh: 对于关闭图书馆的提议，我恕难赞同。
transfer: 在会议上礼貌地表达不同意见。
transferEn: Express disagreement politely during a meeting.

senseEn: question someone formally and persistently
en: In the crime drama, detectives interrogate the suspect separately.
zh: 犯罪剧中，侦探们单独审问嫌疑人。
transfer: 概述小说里警方正式盘问嫌疑人的情节。
transferEn: Summarize a novel's scene in which police formally question a suspect.

senseEn: no longer used because something newer has replaced it
en: The office replaced its obsolete software last year.
zh: 办公室去年替换了已经过时的软件。
transfer: 向同事说明旧设备已经被新型号取代。
transferEn: Explain to a colleague that an old device is no longer used because newer models replaced it.

senseEn: offering more comfort or features than a standard version
en: Does a deluxe room include a balcony?
zh: 豪华客房带阳台吗？
transfer: 询问酒店高级房型与标准房型有什么区别。
transferEn: Ask a hotel how its more luxurious room category differs from the standard one.

sense: 播种；与母猪一词同形异音
senseEn: plant seeds in the ground; pronounced /soʊ/
en: We'll sow the seeds in labeled trays this spring.
zh: 今年春天我们会把种子播在贴有标签的育苗盘里。
transfer: 问园艺老师这类花种应该何时播下。
transferEn: Ask a gardening teacher when to plant these flower seeds.

senseEn: serious danger, especially in formal or literary use
en: The report warns that the historic building is in peril after the storm.
zh: 报告警告说，暴风雨过后那座历史建筑处境危险。
transfer: 用正式措辞说明一处古迹因洪水面临危险。
transferEn: Use formal wording to say that flooding has put a historic site in serious danger.
